qa: Vragen van de leden Griffith en Ten Broeke (beide VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken over de identificatieplicht voor kiesgerechtigden die in het buitenland wonen (ingezonden 22 april 2010).

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs whether expired identity documents would be accepted for voter registration from abroad and in polling stations, and why The Hague required a copy of a valid ID for registration. The State Secretary answered that the ministerial rule covers only identification at polling stations, that registration from abroad requires a valid Dutch passport or ID card or a nationality certificate no older than three years, and that a driving licence cannot prove nationality.
No, a driving licence cannot establish the applicant's Dutch nationality.
Nee, met een rijbewijs kan het Nederlanderschap van de verzoeker niet worden vastgesteld.

Daar waar slachtoffers erop vertrouwden dat een rechter een onafhankelijk oordeel zou vellen over de zaak waar ze bij betrokken waren, gebeurt dit nu niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Bikker over de aflevering van Undercover in Nederland over uitbuiting en illegale prostitutie

MPs Knops and Bikker asked the Minister of Justice about exploitation and illegal prostitution exposed by a Undercover in Nederland broadcast, including prosecution of pimps, municipal enforcement against facilitators, cooperation with municipalities and housing corporations, and sexual health care for sex workers. The State Secretary answered that prosecution requires coercion or abuse of vulnerability, cited prosecution statistics and municipal enforcement tools, reported that 80% of municipalities have a contact officer, and described the pending Wrs regulation bill and existing sexual health services.
The cabinet is fully committed to tackling all possibilities for abuses in the sex industry.
Het kabinet zet zich ten volste in om alle mogelijkheden tot misstanden in de seksbranche tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het bericht ‘Sittardse gevangenis zet tbs’er per ongeluk op straat’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a case in which a tbs detainee was wrongly released onto the street after a Sittard prison failed to record his status, and about measures to prevent recurrence and the link to the Court of Audit report on forensic care. The minister said agreements with chain partners were made to share status information, that the Court of Audit report does not concern day-to-day information exchange, and that a quality framework and trajectory indicators are being developed.
DJI has made or reconfirmed agreements with the chain partners involved to prevent recurrence.
DJI heeft met de betrokken ketenpartners afspraken gemaakt dan wel herbevestigd om herhaling te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Nispen, Knops en Agnes Mulder over de toetreding van de EU tot het EVRM

MPs Van Dijk, Van Nispen, Knops and Mulder asked about the status of the EU's accession to the European Convention on Human Rights, the remaining legal and political objections, and when talks would resume. The minister replied that negotiations are progressing slowly through seven rounds since 2020, that several legal objections remain (partly resolved), the next round is scheduled for May 2022, and the Netherlands will actively push to speed up accession.
The Netherlands wishes to fulfil the treaty obligation for the EU's accession to the ECHR as quickly as possible.
Nederland wenst de verdragsrechtelijke verplichting tot toetreding van de EU tot het EVRM zo snel mogelijk te vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Knops over het bericht 'FIOD-speurders thuis na vergoedingenruzie'

CDA MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reports that a FIOD special operations team was sent home for months over an allowance dispute and alleged fear-based management culture. The State Secretary declined to discuss specifics because of the labour and court proceedings, denied knowledge of such a culture without signals, and said efforts were underway to find a quick solution.
This is a labour-law dispute between employees and their employer. I cannot make any public statements about it.
Er is hier sprake van een arbeidsrechtelijk geschil tussen werknemers en hun werkgever. Ik kan hierover in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over de plannen voor het hyperscale datacenter van Facebookmoederbedrijf Meta in Zeewolde en andere datacenters

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch (PvdD) asked about Meta's hyperscale data centre plans in Zeewolde, the sale of state land, energy and water use, and grid tariffs. The minister answered that the state conditions the land sale on energy and water standards, and that the government will tighten national steering and licensing criteria for hyperscale data centres.
The cabinet will tighten the choices in the NOVI regarding data centres.
Het kabinet zal de keuzes in de NOVI over datacenters aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over digitale veiligheid

MP Leijten (SP) asked the government about the European and Dutch digital identity schemes, data storage and blockchain use, lobbying, ethics, cyber vulnerabilities and dependence on single providers. The state secretary answered at length, defending the planned EU framework and Dutch rules against data commercialisation, but gave largely general replies and deferred some matters to other bodies or future policy.
I agree with the experts that citizens' personal data are not a tradeable commodity and that providers' business models may not be based on it.
Ik ben het met de experts eens dat persoonsgegevens van burgers geen handelswaar zijn en dat verdienmodellen van aanbieders daarop ook niet gebaseerd mogen zijn.
Antwoord op van vragen van de leden Van Dam en Knops over het bericht ‘Stop leningen aan politieagenten voor afkopen dienstplicht Turkije’

MPs Van Dam and Knops asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police officers could borrow up to 6,000 euro interest-free to buy out Turkish military service, and whether this and the similar Defence scheme should be ended, as previously requested in a 2011 motion. The minister answered that 24 police officers used the scheme from 2013 to 2017, that the scheme will be abolished soon because Turkish rules were relaxed in 2016, and that the Defence scheme is under discussion with the public sector unions.
This scheme will therefore be abolished soon.
Deze regeling wordt daarom binnenkort afgeschaft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Knops over het bereiken van een definitief akkoord tussen Turkije en Rusland over het leveren van S-400 luchtverdedigingssystemen

MPs Ten Broeke and Knops asked whether Erdogan's claim of a settled deal with Russia on S-400 air defence systems is confirmed, why Turkey chose Russian rather than NATO-compatible systems, and what the consequences would be for NATO if a deal is final. The government answered that no definitive agreement has been confirmed, so it cannot yet assess motives or consequences, though interoperability problems and exclusion from NATO networks are likely if the purchase proceeds.
The cabinet therefore cannot confirm that Russia and Turkey have concluded a definitive agreement.
Het kabinet kan daarom niet bevestigen dat Rusland en Turkije een definitieve overeenkomst hebben gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ten Broeke, Knops, Van Ojik, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over de arrestatie van een Turkse Nederlander in Turkije

MPs from six parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Turkey of Dutch-Turkish national Volkan Çalışkan over a banner, whether consular assistance was given, and about the travel bans on eleven Dutch citizens and wider rule-of-law concerns. The minister confirmed the arrest, said the Netherlands requested consular access and will ask the Turkish authorities for attention to the cases, and described diplomatic efforts on Turkey's rule of law.
The Netherlands will continue to request extra attention for these cases so that those involved can return to the Netherlands as soon as possible.
Nederland zal extra aandacht voor deze gevallen blijven vragen opdat betrokkenen zo spoedig mogelijk naar Nederland kunnen terugkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Nederlander vast na kritiek op Erdogan’

CDA MPs asked about a Dutch national detained after criticising Erdogan and about Dutch citizens barred from leaving Turkey, including travel advice and consular action. The minister said about ten people have reported exit bans, withheld their circumstances for privacy reasons, described existing travel warnings and consular efforts, and promised continued pressure on Turkish authorities.
For reasons of privacy protection, I cannot provide your House with information about the background to these cases in this public letter.
Vanwege privacybescherming kan ik uw Kamer via deze openbare brief geen informatie verstrekken over de achtergronden bij deze zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Amhaouch over de afbraak en inbeslagname van door Nederland gefinancierd zonne-energie project door Israël

MPs Knops and Amhaouch asked whether Israeli authorities demolished and largely confiscated a Dutch-funded solar project in Jubbet adh Dhib without notice, and about its harm, legal obligations, and Dutch and EU responses. The ministers confirmed the demolition, reported about 40,000 euro in damage, said Israel has promised to return the panels after Dutch protests, and noted ongoing talks and EU coordination.
Prime Minister Netanyahu has informed the Netherlands by letter that the panels will be returned to the Netherlands.
Premier Netanyahu heeft per brief laten weten dat de panelen teruggegeven zullen worden aan Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Knops over de confiscatie van 50 kerken, kloosters en begraafplaatsen door Turkije

MPs Van Helvert and Knops asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's reported confiscation of 50 churches, monasteries and cemeteries in Mardin, the Aya Sofia Koran reading and alleged Islamist-driven Christian persecution. The minister answered that the transfers stem from lawful administrative reorganisation, that the embassy is monitoring the Aramean community, and that Aya Sofia should not become a site of provocation, while declining to characterise Turkey as systematically persecuting Christians.
The Netherlands will continue to raise the rights of religious minorities in Turkey with the authorities.
Nederland zal de rechten van religieuze minderheden in Turkije bij de autoriteiten blijven aankaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Keijzer en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Nederland op het spoor is van contacten tussen hulporganisaties en smokkelbendes

MPs Knops, Keijzer and Van Helvert asked the ministers about reports that Dutch and German intelligence were tracking contacts between aid organisations and smuggling networks in the Mediterranean, and about EU operation Sophia and a near-collision with the Libyan coast guard. The government declined to discuss intelligence operations, said it awaits the outcome of an Italian fact-finding investigation, and noted that Sophia's mandate does not cover combating contacts between aid organisations and smugglers.
No public statements are made about operations of the Dutch intelligence services or about the exchange of information with partners.
Over operaties van de Nederlandse inlichtingendiensten en het uitwisselen van informatie met partners worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de VN-Veiligheidsraad

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked whether the government would make prosecution of MH17 downers and ISIS fighters priorities of Dutch Security Council membership, and whether it would send the monthly programme of the presidency. The minister said priorities would be sent in a letter in autumn, that MH17 accountability remains top priority, that ISIS prosecution will be explored, and that the programme will be sent monthly.
To that end, the House will receive a letter in the autumn, after government-wide consultation.
Daartoe zal de Kamer in het najaar een brief toegaan, na rijksbrede afstemming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Knops, Ten Broeke, Martin Bosma en Van der Staaij over de verboden stille tocht van Christenen voor Israël in Rotterdam

Six MPs asked why Rotterdam's mayor banned a silent march by Christians for Israel, questioning the security rationale given the comparable treatment of a Palestinian Return Centre congress and the impact on Jewish residents. The minister replied that maintaining public order is the mayor's responsibility and accountable to the municipal council, that the organisation itself chose to cancel the march, and that police capacity decisions in similar future cases rest with the mayor.
Maintaining public order in Rotterdam is the responsibility of the mayor of Rotterdam.
De handhaving van de openbare orde in Rotterdam is de verantwoordelijkheid van de burgemeester van Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Ten Broeke , Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Grashoff en Voordewind over schandalige intimidatiepraktijken en misleiding door Turkije

Six MPs asked the government about reported intimidation of Turkish-Dutch citizens and a Rotterdam CDA councillor by Turkish consular officials, whether the consul misled Dutch authorities, and whether the consul should be expelled. The government answered by referring the MPs to a separate letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 34 824, nr. 195) on the ministerial campaign visits and the events of 11 March 2017, without answering the questions in the reply itself.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Baudet, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Knops over haatzaaien in Palestijnse schoolboeken

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether Palestinian schoolbooks incite hatred against Israel, glorify martyrdom and fuel terrorism, and whether the Netherlands funds such curricula. The minister answered that UNRWA screens textbooks and found problematic passages in some, that the government has no comparative data showing a trend toward more incitement, and that the Netherlands is not a donor to the Palestinian education sector.
The Netherlands is not a donor to the Palestinian education sector and therefore does not contribute to the curriculum.
Nederland is geen donor voor de Palestijnse onderwijssector en draagt derhalve ook niet bij aan het curriculum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Azmani, Jasper van Dijk, Sjoerdsma, Kuiken, Knops en Voordewind over het bericht “Onrust op ministeries over komst Eritrese partijfunctionaris”

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a planned Eritrean youth congress in the Netherlands, the planned speech by regime official Yemane Gebreab, and possible measures against regime-linked persons and the diaspora tax. The minister answered that the congress was banned by the Veldhoven mayor, that voluntariness of contacts with Eritrean authorities must remain the principle, that visa decisions are individual, that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, and that a diaspora tax study is ongoing and will be reported in Q2 2017.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has commissioned an independent bureau to research the nature and extent of the Eritrean regime's diaspora tax.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft een onafhankelijk bureau opdracht gegeven om onderzoek te doen naar de aard en omvang van de diasporabelasting van het Eritrese regime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Knops over de aangekondigde evaluatie van de helikopterlaagvlieggebieden

Two MPs asked the Defence Minister why the promised 2014 evaluation of helicopter low-flying areas was delayed, what the plan and timeline are, and how complaints are handled. The minister attributes the delay to waiting for a Council of State ruling and staff reductions, commits to presenting a draft report to the advisory group by end of May 2017 with a decision by year-end, and describes the complaint handling and communication practices.
The evaluation must result by the end of this year in a proposal on how a wider spread of low-flying exercises can be achieved.
De evaluatie moet voor het einde van dit jaar uitmonden in een voorstel op welke wijze meer spreiding van laagvliegoefeningen mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Thieme, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Knops, Karabulut en Van Rooijen over repressieve maatregelen tegen de oppositie door de regering van Wit-Rusland

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister about repressive measures against the opposition in Belarus, including arrests of demonstrators and Christian Democrat leaders around the 25 March protest. The minister said the Belarusian authorities' measures were disproportionate, that Nederland raised concerns via EU statements and with the Belarusian ambassador, and that the issue was discussed in the OSCE Permanent Council.
In the cabinet's view, the measures of the Belarusian authorities are not proportionate.
De maatregelen van de Wit-Russische autoriteiten zijn in de ogen van het kabinet niet proportioneel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Knops over de lobby om het Europese geneesmiddelenagentschap naar Nederland te halen

Two CDA MPs asked why the government focuses its bid to host the European Medicines Agency on a site near Schiphol and whether South Limburg was considered. The minister answered that Schiphol's accessibility and facilities best meet the agency's criteria and that South Limburg was assessed but offers fewer connections, while declining to commit to including South Limburg in the bid.
The Netherlands wants to put the best possible bid on the table, and the cabinet believes the Netherlands creates the most promising offer with an EMA location near Schiphol.
Nederland wil het best mogelijke bod op tafel leggen en het kabinet is van mening dat Nederland het meest kansrijke aanbod creëert met een locatie van de EMA in de nabijheid van Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij en De Roon over aanslagen op christenen in de Sinaï, Egypte

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about ISIS killings of Christians in North Sinai, whether Egypt can protect them, whether the government will raise concerns with Egypt and President Sisi, and whether Dutch radar deliveries to the Egyptian navy improve Sinai surveillance. The minister answered that the government is concerned, cannot judge the army's protection capacity given limited access and information, will raise concerns bilaterally and via the EU, and that the radars are not yet operational and are not clearly linked to Sinai surveillance.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Knops over het bericht 'Veiligheid is in het geding, waarschuwt Schiphol'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Knops (CDA) asked ministers whether KMar border-guard capacity at Schiphol would be expanded given rising passenger numbers and terror threat, and about funding and timing of extra staff. The government answered that 135 temporary FTE are funded from incidental resources and available by summer 2017, that structural capacity will be considered in the 2018 budget and formation options, and that it declines to bear the 190 million euro automation cost at Schiphol.
In the current situation, with Schiphol's healthy financial position and a competitive cost level for airlines, the cabinet sees no reason to also contribute financially to the investment programme.

Het kabinet ziet in de huidige situatie, met een gezonde financiële positie van Schiphol en een concurrerend kostenniveau voor luchtvaartmaatschappijen, geen aanleiding om ook financieel bij te dragen aan het investeringsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Keijzer en Ten Broeke over uitspraken van de president van Mali over terugname van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers en illegalen

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the ministers whether Mali's president's statements that Mali would never sign a readmission agreement undermined the EU-Mali migration deal and whether Mali was cooperating enough on returning its nationals, and whether pressure or aid conditionality should be used. The government answered that the joint declaration remains valid, that Mali is bound by international law to cooperate on returns, that only about ten Malians returned voluntarily since 2014 and none forcibly, and that it prefers a broad pragmatic approach over negative incentives such as cutting aid.
The cabinet is of the view that measures to encourage this cooperation are most effective when they are part of a broader package.
Het kabinet is van mening dat maatregelen om deze medewerking te stimuleren het effectiefst zijn als zij onderdeel zijn van een breder pakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Knops en Van Bommel over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2017 van Open Doors

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2017 ranking of Christian persecution, including whether the rise in persecution, the role of religious nationalism and Saudi-linked financing in Sub-Saharan Africa, Dutch policy and the fight against ISIS are being addressed. The minister confirmed the increase in persecution, said the causes are hard to pin down, described Dutch efforts through the Human Rights Fund and diplomacy, and said the fight against ISIS also serves Christians.
To gain more clarity on this, the Netherlands is supporting research in the region into both the sources and the effects of these financing flows in the Horn of Africa.
Om hier meer duidelijkheid over te krijgen steunt Nederland onderzoek in de regio naar zowel bronnen als effecten van deze financieringsstromen in de Hoorn van Afrika.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Van Klaveren en Knops over de wapenopbouw van Hezbollah

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Hezbollah's arms build-up in southern Lebanon, Iranian supply, civilian shielding, and possible Dutch support for Israel and tougher action against Iran. The minister answered that the government cannot verify the reports, condemns any use of civilians as shields, urges Iran to play a constructive role, and says new sanctions against Iran are not currently on the table.
The government has taken note with concern of the media reports but cannot comment on the accuracy of this information.
Het kabinet heeft met zorg kennisgenomen van de berichtgeving in de media maar kan geen uitspraken doen over de juistheid van deze informatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de eindejaarswensen van de Nederlandse ambassade in Berlijn

MPs Knops, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked why the Dutch embassy in Berlin sent only New Year wishes and no Christmas wishes, and whether other Dutch embassies do the same. The minister replied that embassies are not obliged to send season's greetings, that the choice is left to each post, and that the Berlin embassy did send a digital card wishing a merry Christmas and a happy 2017, so no reference was avoided.
So there is no question of messages being avoided.
Er is dus geen sprake van dat boodschappen worden gemeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Knops, Voordewind en Servaes over de arrestatie van een Nederlandse journalist in Panama

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Panama of Dutch journalist Okke Ornstein, whom they linked to exposing corruption, and what the ministry was doing about it. The minister answered that Ornstein faced criminal defamation charges, that the Dutch embassy and minister pressed Panama for press freedom and visits, and that a presidential pardon was expected so he would be released soon.
At my request, the Dutch ambassador spoke with several ministers of the Panamanian government and with President Varela.
Op mijn verzoek sprak de Nederlandse ambassadeur met verschillende ministers van de Panamese regering en met president Varela.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Amhaouch en Knops over ziekenhuizen in Limburg die operaties moeten uitstellen omdat ze door de jaarvergoeding heen zijn

MPs asked whether Limburg hospitals such as VieCuri, AZM, Laurentius and Sint Jans Gasthuis had exhausted annual budgets and postponed operations, and how insurers and the NZa ensure patient information and waiting-time norms. The minister said she lacks insight into individual hospitals' finances, placed responsibility on hospitals and insurers, and pointed to NZa supervision of insurer information duties.
I have no insight into the financial situation of individual hospitals.
Ik heb geen zicht op de financiële situatie van individuele ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de vorstelijke vertrekregelingen bij de Belastingdienst en het gapend AOW-gat bij Defensie

Two CDA MPs asked the Defence and Finance ministers about the suspended defence pay talks, the AOW (state pension) gap for former defence staff, and the generous early-retirement scheme at the Tax Administration. The minister answered that talks have resumed, that a new AOW arrangement is being pursued in response to court rulings and that Finance is not her responsibility, while distinguishing the two schemes' purposes.
As employer, I have the responsibility to make a provision for the AOW gap of civilians and military personnel in (former) service at Defence.
Als werkgever heb ik de verantwoordelijkheid om een voorziening te treffen voor het AOW-gat van burgers en militairen in (voormalige) dienst bij Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Knops over het bericht ‘Geen gedeeltelijke herbouw van het Genneperhuis’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether partial physical rebuilding of the Genneperhuis ruin in Gennep should be ruled out, and about its heritage status, the Keverberg precedent and RCE cooperation. The Minister answered that the RCE advised that rebuilding would overly damage the monument's archaeological and historical value, so it is not an option, but alternatives such as limited visualisation or a virtual presentation could be discussed.
Over the implementation of these alternatives, one can certainly talk.
Over de uitvoering van deze alternatieven valt zeker te praten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Ten Broeke, Jasper van Dijk, Knops, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Grashoff en Van der Staaij over het gebruik van chemische wapens in Darfur

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's report of possible chemical weapons use in Darfur, lack of humanitarian and UNAMID access to Jebel Marra, and whether Sudan should be asked to explain under the Chemical Weapons Convention and face inspection. The minister said the OPCW is examining the report, has requested more information from Sudan, and that Netherlands will press for accountability and raise the issue with EU and UN partners if use is confirmed.
The Netherlands asked the OPCW to act proactively and to actively inform the States Parties about the findings.
Nederland heeft de OPCW verzocht om proactief optreden en de Staten Partijen actief over de bevindingen te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Bommel, Bontes, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops en Sjoerdsma over het uitoefenen van internationale druk op Noord-Korea

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how North Korea's missile launches and nuclear tests affect regional stability, what diplomatic and sanctions pressure can be applied via China and the UN/EU, and how the Netherlands prepares for regime destabilisation. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns the launches, supports UN sanctions enforcement and IAEA action, will press for a human rights resolution at the UN General Assembly, and sees no concrete signs of regime collapse.
The Netherlands will – as in recent years – continue to raise human rights violations both bilaterally and in relevant international forums.
Nederland zal – net als in afgelopen jaren – zowel bilateraal als in relevante internationale fora aandacht blijven vragen voor mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord op de vragen leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, De Roon en Knops over het wereldwijd toegenomen geweld tegen Joden

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a reported global rise in violence against Jews, including the Pew Research figures, its causes, the countries affected, Dutch funding of BDS-linked organisations, monitoring, and follow-up on a motion on antisemitism. The minister answered that the findings are concerning, that causes are complex and context-specific, that BDS activities are protected by free speech, and listed Dutch and EU initiatives against discrimination and antisemitism.
These findings from Pew Research are very concerning.
Deze bevindingen van Pew Research zijn zeer zorgelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Knops en Rog over de uitlatingen van de Turkse consul-generaal te Rotterdam over de Hizmet/Gülen-beweging en de invloed die Turkije uitoefent op burgers in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt, Knops and Rog asked the ministers about the Turkish consul-general in Rotterdam's remarks on the Gülen movement, pressure on Turkish-Dutch citizens, threats and the effects of the post-coup crackdown in the Netherlands. The government condemned intimidation, said Turkish authorities must not interfere with Dutch citizens' choices, noted about 175 reports and ongoing investigations, and answered the remaining questions largely by restating policy and citing ongoing proceedings.
It is unacceptable that foreign governments openly try to influence those choices.
Het is onacceptabel dat buitenlandse overheden die keuzes openlijk proberen te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Knops over het bericht “Nederlandse pro-Erdogan-agent lekt informatie aangifte bedreiging”

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police leaked information about a woman who filed a threat complaint against a pro-Erdogan supporter, whether she is protected, and what consequences the officer faces. The minister condemns any breach of trust, says an investigation is ongoing, and will inform parliament of any measures after its outcome.
I do not want to anticipate possible outcomes of the currently ongoing investigation.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op eventuele uitkomsten van het thans lopende onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Golfstaten Nederland informatie over financiële steun aan religieuze instellingen verstrekken

Four MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that Gulf states share information on financing of religious institutions in the Netherlands, including whether a list of Saudi-financed institutions exists and why it is withheld. The answer refers to the oral questions asked on the same topic, so no substantive answers to the written questions are given here.
The written questions from MPs Sjoerdsma (D66), Azmani (VVD), Knops (CDA) and Karabulut (SP) (question number 2016Z14749, submitted 13 July 2016) have been answered through oral questions.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma (D66), Azmani (VVD), Knops (CDA) en Karabulut (SP) (vraagnummer 2016Z14749 , ingezonden 13 juli 2016) zijn beantwoord middels mondelinge vragen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind c.s. over de bijdrage van Nederland aan politietrainingen op Papua

Dutch MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch support for police training on Papua, including monitoring of Indonesian security forces, possible human rights abuses by trained officers, and the Community Policing Programme's design and evaluation. The minister answered that a mid-term evaluation shows gradual progress, that no guarantee can be given that trained officers did not commit abuses, and that embassy staff monitor the situation through dialogue with local actors.
No guarantee can be given that trained officers did not take part in violating human rights.
Er kan geen garantie worden gegeven dat getrainde agenten niet hebben deelgenomen aan het schenden van mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Ronnes en Fokke over de verhuizing van het Financieel Service Centrum Defensie van Limburg naar Utrecht

MPs Knops, Ronnes and Fokke asked the Defence Minister why the Financieel Service Centrum (FSC) in Eygelshoven is being moved to Utrecht despite earlier promises to keep work in Limburg, and how this fits with union and works-council opposition, job losses in Limburg, and the motion on fair treatment of peripheral provinces. The Minister answered that a 2015 evaluation showed the split was not natural, that US forces returning to Eygelshoven make the site unsuitable for offices, and that the decision is based primarily on operational grounds with the works council involved in implementation.
These developments were decisive in revising the earlier decision.
Deze ontwikkelingen zijn doorslaggevend geweest om het eerder genomen besluit te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over het beeld Terrorismebestrijding Turkije: ISIS door draaideur, academici in de cel

MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's handling of ISIS suspects, releases of suspects, MIT powers and the EU visa-liberalisation benchmark on terrorism law. The minister said the cabinet cannot judge Turkish proceedings without the case files, that Turkey's terrorism law is used against terrorist groups but also criticised on press freedom, and that visa liberalisation requires meeting all benchmarks, which has not yet happened.
Since the cabinet has no access to the investigation files, it is not possible to judge the Turkish legal process in these cases.
Aangezien het kabinet geen inzage heeft in de onderzoeksdossiers is het niet mogelijk een oordeel te vellen over de Turkse rechtsgang in deze zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma en Grashoff over de arrestatie van een Nederlandse vrouw in Qatar

MPs from eight parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of a Dutch woman in Qatar after she reported rape, and what the government had done to free her. The minister confirmed the arrest and sentencing, described consular assistance provided by the Doha embassy, and said the woman was to be deported within days.
For privacy reasons and to prevent misunderstandings, the ministry does not provide information to other persons, including (close) family members, without the consent of the person concerned.
Om privacyredenen en om misverstanden tegen te gaan, verstrekt het ministerie zonder toestemming van betrokkene geen informatie aan andere personen, inclusief (naaste) familieleden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops en Grashoff over de vernietiging van Palestijnse waterbronnen door Israël

MPs from D66, PvdA, SP, CDA and GroenLinks asked whether Israel plans to destroy water cisterns in Kusra built with Dutch funding, and whether the Netherlands could recover damages. The government answered that the cisterns are subject to stop-work orders that owners are contesting legally, that nothing has yet been destroyed so no compensation arises, and that the Dutch representation is intensifying dialogue with Israeli authorities and following legal developments closely.
In this context the Representation has lodged a protest against the latest stop-work orders and will continue to follow the legal developments very actively.
In dit kader heeft de Vertegenwoordiging protest aangetekend tegen de laatste stop-work-orders en zal het de juridische ontwikkelingen zeer actief blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Toorenburg, Knops en Keijzer over de zaak Saban B. in Turkije

CDA MPs asked about the case of Saban B., convicted in the Netherlands to 7 years 9 months for trafficking and assault but still free in Turkey, and about Turkey's cooperation on enforcing Dutch sentences. The minister answered that Turkish proceedings are still pending, that Dutch requests since 2010 cover 23 persons with at least 6 granted, and that a memorandum of understanding is being negotiated, but did not provide a complete list or the requested one-week timeline.

In the context of protecting the privacy of the persons concerned, I can only inform you that since 2010 the Netherlands has, under the Wots, expressed to Turkey the wish to transfer enforcement of a Dutch sentence for 23 persons.

In het kader van bescherming van de privacy van de betrokken personen, kan ik u slechts mededelen dat Nederland vanaf 2010 op grond van de Wots ten aanzien van 23 personen aan Turkije de wens kenbaar heeft gemaakt de tenuitvoerlegging van een Nederlands vonnis aan Turkije over te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Voordewind en Knops over geweld tegen christenen door extremistische hindoes in India

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about attacks on Christians by extremist Hindus in India, including whether police intervened and what the government would do internationally. The minister acknowledged rising religiously motivated violence, said six suspects were arrested, and described diplomatic efforts on religious freedom without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet uses various opportunities to raise human rights, including freedom of religion and belief, with India.
Het kabinet maakt van verschillende mogelijkheden gebruik om mensenrechten – en daarbinnen vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging – in India aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Knops, De Roon, Van der Staaij en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Abbas confirms PA still paying terrorists’ salaries’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the shift of prisoner salary payments from the Palestinian Authority to the PLO is merely cosmetic, given EU and Dutch funding, and whether the Netherlands will object as Norway did. The minister replied that the Netherlands has no objection in principle to support for prisoners if transparent and proportionate, that the Dutch Pegase contribution does not fund prisoner payments and has robust verification, and that the government will keep raising the issue bilaterally.
The government has no insight into the total income or expenditure of the PLO.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzage in de totale inkomsten of uitgaven van de PLO.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over een eventueel gratieverzoek voor een in Egypte veroordeelde Nederlandse journaliste

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands has not pursued or joined pardon requests for Dutch journalist Rena Netjes, convicted in absentia in Egypt, despite other countries supporting such requests. The minister answered that a pardon request can only be filed by Netjes herself, that the Netherlands will support it if she files, and that Netjes has so far declined to file.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over confisqueren van kerken en vernielen van cultureel erfgoed door Turkije

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister about Turkey's expropriation of about 6,300 parcels in Diyarbakir's historic Sur district, including churches, damage to heritage sites, a police photo mocking Christians, and whether the Netherlands will protest or request independent investigation. The minister answered that expropriation is legal for restoration under Turkish law with compensation and appeal rights, damage stems from mutual fighting, church damage is limited, and the Netherlands urges an end to violence and monitors the situation.
Affected parties can further appeal against expropriation.
Betroffenen kunnen verder beroep aantekenen tegen onteigening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Servaes, Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Knops en Van Bommel over de situatie in West-Papoea

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports of 'slow genocide' against Papuans, the failure of quiet diplomacy, the Netherlands' historical responsibility, and whether he would raise the issue with Indonesia. The minister answered that the report was not yet public, outlined ongoing concerns and recent gestures by Jakarta, described bilateral and EU/UN channels, and committed to studying the report and raising the issue during his Indonesia visit.

As explained in the letter to Parliament of 22 November 2005, Professor Drooglever's academic research is a further contribution to describing Papua's own history and the course of events surrounding the 'Act of Free Choice'.

Zoals in Kamerbrief van 22 november 2005, stuk 30 300V is toegelicht vormt het academische onderzoek van professor Drooglever een nadere bijdrage aan de beschrijving van de eigen geschiedenis van Papoea en het verloop van de gebeurtenissen rond de «Act of Free Choice» .

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Knops over de aanslag op Eerste Paasdag in Lahore, Pakistan, waarbij 72 mensen om het leven zijn gekomen en in het bijzonder christenen doelwit waren

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the Easter Day bombing in Lahore that killed 72 people, including whether Christians are targeted, whether Pakistani state protection for religious minorities is adequate, and how Pakistan's fight against Taliban-linked groups can be supported. The minister acknowledged the attack, described the claimed motives, said the Netherlands raises minority protection bilaterally and multilaterally, and pointed to planned NGO programmes and EU and GCTF cooperation on counterterrorism.
The Netherlands therefore intends to support NGO programmes in Pakistan from this autumn via the Addressing Root Causes fund.
Nederland is daarom voornemens om vanaf dit najaar via het Addressing Root Causes fonds ngo-programma's in Pakistan te steunen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over Salafisme onverenigbaar met waarden Defensie

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports of radicalisation in the French army and police, Salafism within Dutch Defence, whether Salafism should be treated as a totalitarian anti-Western ideology, and how Defence handles security clearances and Salafist conduct. The minister answered largely by referring to earlier letters and reports, saying the MIVD findings go through the usual channels, that clearance decisions rest on actual conduct, and that the motion will be addressed in a broader cabinet letter.
I inform the House of the outcomes of MIVD investigations through the appropriate channels.
Over uitkomsten van onderzoeken van de MIVD informeer ik de Tweede Kamer via de daartoe geëigende kanalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Knops en Voordewind over het onderzoeksrapport over christenvervolging door Boko Haram in Nigeria

MPs from SGP, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about an Open Doors report on Christian persecution by Boko Haram and related violence in Nigeria, and how Dutch efforts compare and what concrete action is possible. The minister answered that the violence is serious but driven largely by economic and ethnic-religious conflicts, described existing Dutch and EU support for dialogue, deradicalisation and a regional task force, and acknowledged the particular vulnerability of Christian communities.
The Netherlands actively works worldwide for freedom of religion and belief for everyone.
Nederland zet zich wereldwijd actief in voor vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging voor iedereen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de bijstand die verleend wordt aan Romano van der Dussen, die op 11 februari 2016 is vrijgelaten

Two CDA MPs asked how Romano van der Dussen, released from a Spanish prison in February 2016 after 12 years, will receive reintegration help, legal assistance, and progress on his case. The government replied that consular assistance, coordination with Spanish authorities and Dutch reclassering/municipal support are available, that further legal procedures are his own responsibility, and referred to earlier letters for the case history.
See my letter to your House of 17 February 2016 (TK 30 010, no. 26).
Zie mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 17 februari 2016 (TK 30 010, nr. 26 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over bericht Turkse journalisten bedreigd met levenslang vanwege 'Adana-gate'

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish prosecutors seeking life sentences against journalists Can Dündar and Erdem Gül over reports on alleged arms transports to Syria, including press freedom, prison access, EU action and the case for an international inquiry. Minister Koenders answered that the Netherlands raises press freedom with Turkey, views the charges as very serious, and sees no need for an independent international investigation, while leaving judicial matters to the courts.
The cabinet sees no need for an independent international investigation.
Het kabinet ziet geen noodzaak voor een onafhankelijk internationaal onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, De Roon, Van Bommel en Knops over de deelneming van Arabische landen aan de bombardementen tegen ISIS

MPs from D66, PVV, SP and CDA asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs how many airstrikes against ISIS were carried out by Arab coalition partners (Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, UAE, Jordan) and when they last struck. The minister answered that the US publishes total coalition strike counts without a breakdown by partner, that Bahrain was omitted from earlier answers by mistake, and that the precise share of Arab partners' airstrikes is not disclosed publicly.
No public statements are made about the precise share (number of airstrikes) of Arab allies in the air campaign against ISIS.
Over het precieze aandeel (aantallen luchtaanvallen) van Arabische bondgenoten in de luchtcampagne in de strijd tegen ISIS worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over ‘Toenemende twijfels over neerhalen Russisch gevechtsvliegtuig door Turkije’

MP Knops (CDA) asked the government whether it still believes Turkey's account of shooting down a Russian Su-24, given analyses of radar data suggesting the jet did not clearly enter Turkish airspace, and whether the Netherlands has independent intelligence. The government replied that the exact circumstances cannot be verified from the released radar images alone, that it relies on the consistent assessments of several allies and NATO's Secretary General, does not comment publicly on intelligence sources, and sees no reason for an international investigation.
The cabinet does not publicly comment on the information position or sources of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de informatiepositie of bronnen van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over over leveranties van gifgas aan jihadisten in Syrië via Turkije

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey facilitated sarin precursor supplies to jihadists in Syria, the related Turkish prosecution case, and whether the government would investigate or seek clarification from Turkey. The minister replied that the government has no independent information to judge these claims, notes the case details and the status of parliamentary immunity proceedings, and sees no reason to reopen the Ghouta investigation or support an international inquiry.
The cabinet has no information that would allow it to form an independent judgement on these claims.
Het kabinet heeft geen informatie een eigenstandig oordeel te vellen over deze beweringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Knops en De Roon over de ranglijst christenvervolging van Open Doors

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, CDA and PVV asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2016 ranking on Christian persecution, including rising killings, Dutch policy response, a proposed UN inquiry and ISIS treatment of minorities. The minister said the government shares serious concern, cites funding for religious freedom projects and EU/UN engagement, but opposes a UN inquiry focused on one group in favour of an inclusive approach.
The cabinet is however not in favour of a UN inquiry focused on one specific group.
Het kabinet is echter geen voorstander van een VN-onderzoek gericht op één specifieke groep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Van Helvert en Knops over aanhoudende incidenten bij Belgische kerncentrales

Three CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about recent incidents at Belgian nuclear plants Doel and Tihange, including Dutch involvement in extended operation, follow-up of IAEA recommendations, closure scenarios, communication with Dutch authorities, and joint inspections. The Minister answered that nuclear safety is a national Belgian matter, that she supports better involvement of Dutch authorities and has asked Belgium to explore it, that closure decisions rest with the Belgian regulator FANC, and that joint inspections with Belgium have started and more are planned.
The FANC will take a decision on that, if the FANC sees reason to do so.
Het FANC zal daarover, indien het FANC daar aanleiding toe ziet, een besluit nemen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon, Voordewind, Grashoff, Van der Staaij, Thieme, Bontes, Kuzu, Van Vliet, Krol, Klein en Houwers over de levensbedreigende situatie

MPs asked the ministers about the humanitarian siege of Madaya in Syria, where about 40,000 people face starvation, and whether the Netherlands would press for a ceasefire, humanitarian access and airdrops. The ministers confirmed the severity of the situation, described Dutch funding and diplomatic efforts through the UN and ICRC, and explained why airdrops are not considered feasible.
The Netherlands has for some time been pressing within the UN for a ceasefire so that humanitarian aid can be provided to the population.
Nederland dringt in VN-verband al geruime tijd aan op een staakt-het-vuren zodat humanitaire hulp geboden kan worden aan de bevolking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon en Voordewind over de deelname van Arabische landen aan de bombardementen tegen ISIS

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister whether Arab coalition partners such as Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, the UAE and Jordan have stopped bombing ISIS, citing a US statement, and requested monthly strike figures per country. The government declined to confirm the claims or publish country-level data, citing operational classified information and the need to present the coalition as one entity, though it listed the participating countries and aggregate sortie figures and did not meet the requested deadline.
Information on who carried out which bombings and when is not shared publicly.
Informatie over wie wanneer welke bombardementen heeft uitgevoerd, wordt niet in het openbaar gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het neerhalen van een Russisch gevechtsvliegtuig door Turkije

An MP from the CDA asks the government about Turkey's shootdown of a Russian Su-24, questioning Turkey's account (the 17-second claim, speed calculations, Rules of Engagement, warnings) and whether NATO should investigate. The ministers answer that the government has no independent information, sees no reason for its own investigation, considers Turkey's right to protect its airspace subject to necessity and proportionality, and backs NATO's call for de-escalation without taking a position on the legal merits.
The cabinet does not have sufficient information to make well-founded statements about the application of those requirements in this specific case.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over voldoende informatie om gefundeerde uitspraken te kunnen doen over de toepassing van die vereisten in dit specifieke geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Nederland gooit deur dicht voor Amerikaanse delegatie’

MPs Knops and Verhoeven asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands would not host a US Congress–European Parliament Transatlantic Legislators' Dialogue meeting during its EU presidency, and whether this was due to cost or hassle. The minister replied that no formal request had been received, that he welcomes such contacts, that Brussels is the preferred venue for third-country meetings for cost and coherence reasons, and that relations with the US are good.
If the cabinet receives a formal request to host this meeting – which has not been the case so far – I will of course look at it seriously, in close consultation with your parliament.

Als het kabinet een formeel verzoek ontvangt om gastheer te zijn van deze ontmoeting – wat tot op heden niet het geval is – dan zal ik daar uiteraard serieus naar kijken, in nauw overleg met uw parlement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops inzake nieuwe onthulling over wapenleveranties Turkije aan jihadisten in Syrië

An MP from CDA asked the ministers whether they recognised a leaked German intelligence finding that Turkey supplied weapons to rebel groups in Syria, whether those groups are jihadist, and whether the Netherlands would raise this with Turkey and Germany or confirm it through AIVD/MIVD. The government answered that it is aware of reports of Turkish support to jihadist groups but that the situation is complex, that it has regular contacts with Turkey and Germany, and that AIVD and MIVD do not publicly comment on their findings.
No public statements are made about the subjects or the results of investigations by the AIVD and MIVD.
Over de onderwerpen of de resultaten van onderzoek door AIVD en MIVD worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over salafisme

An MP asks the Defence Minister how a stated rejection of radical salafism within the armed forces squares with her opposition to a motion to ban salafism in Defence, and about the difference between peaceful and jihadist salafist currents, dismissal of a salafist soldier in Germany, and whether Dutch practice differs. The minister answers that salafism has diverse currents, that the government acts against behaviour incompatible with the democratic legal order, that dismissal in Dutch law depends on proven conduct, and that Defence screening weeds out persons posing a security risk.
Regardless of personal convictions, every citizen in the Netherlands is expected to respect the democratic legal order.
Ongeacht persoonlijke overtuigingen wordt van iedere burger in Nederland verwacht dat hij of zij de democratische rechtsorde eerbiedigt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Servaes, Ten Broeke, Van Klaveren, Knops en Voordewind over “De oplaaiende terreur in Nigeria”

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about escalating attacks on civilians, many of them Christians, in Central Nigeria, the government's protection efforts, Boko Haram's trajectory, regional cooperation, humanitarian funding and gender-specific attention. The minister answered that the Middle Belt violence is largely driven by economic and land/water conflicts between herders and farmers, that Nigerian authorities have been ineffective at protecting civilians, and that Nigeria bears primary responsibility for countering Boko Haram, with Dutch support channelled through EU and humanitarian programmes.
The violence against the population makes clear that the Nigerian authorities have not been effective in protecting civilians.
De gewelddadigheden tegen de bevolking maken duidelijk dat de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten niet effectief zijn geweest in de bescherming van burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over de zaak R. van der D.

MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of Romano van der Dussen, including when the government learned of a DNA match to another prisoner, whether consular assistance was adequate, and for release of the case file. The minister answered that consular help was adequate, provided a chronology of consular contacts, but declined to hand over the underlying documents citing their personal and sensitive nature.

Because of the strongly individual and personal character of the file and the many documents and views of third parties, I limit myself to providing the aforementioned information and not to submitting the documents themselves.

Vanwege dit sterke individuele persoonlijke karakter van het dossier en de vele stukken en opvattingen van derden beperk ik mij tot het verstrekken van voornoemde inlichtingen en niet tot het overleggen van de documenten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over de rol van Turkije in de strijd tegen PKK en ISIS

Members Omtzigt and Knops (CDA) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about Turkey's airstrikes on Kurdish groups (PKK, YPG) and ISIS, including alleged civilian casualties, coordination with the US-led coalition, and a proposed buffer zone in northern Syria. The government said it lacks independent information on Turkish operations, that Turkey and the US have agreed deconfliction and joint operations against ISIS, that it will look into the Zergele allegations via Turkey's announced inquiry, and that it sees no need for an independent investigation into alleged Turkish support for ISIS.
The cabinet does not have independent information on the circumstances of the Turkish air operations and the associated risks to American military personnel.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie over de omstandigheden van de Turkse luchtoperaties en de daaraan verbonden risico's voor Amerikaanse militairen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het bericht dat via een Nederlands handelsbedrijf afgedankte Duitse legertrucks terecht zijn gekomen bij het Sudanese leger

An MP from the CDA asked the Dutch ministers whether they knew that ex-German army trucks sold via a Dutch trading firm ended up with the Sudanese army, whether export controls failed, and what would prevent recurrence. The ministers answered that the trucks were demilitarised and treated as civilian under Dutch rules so no licence was required, that Germany now requires re-export consent in its contracts, and that the government will examine aligning Dutch policy with Germany and the EU, while also addressing Sudan's human rights abuses, humanitarian access and UN reporting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Knops inzake het bericht ‘Wintelre is overlast Eindhoven Airport zat’

MPs Van Helvert and Knops (CDA) asked the State Secretary whether route optimisation 1B has increased noise and fine-particle nuisance in Wintelre, and about noise monitoring, route evaluation, and compensation for Eindhoven Airport. The government acknowledges increased complaints, reports no rise in fine particles, promises extra noise monitoring before 1 October 2015, an evaluation after one year, and a decision on a compensation fund in September.
I am aware that route optimisation 1B has led residents of Wintelre to report more nuisance from air traffic.
Ik ben er van op de hoogte dat de routeoptimalisatie 1B ertoe heeft geleid dat de inwoners van Wintelre aangeven meer overlast te ervaren van het vliegverkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over de zaak van R. van der D. (vervolgvragen)

MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked why the minister withheld the confidential Grimbrere report on the case of R. van der D., when the government first learned of the DNA match, and what it has done to secure a Spanish DNA comparison and review. The minister answers that the report contains sensitive personal data so disclosure is the individual's choice, that Dutch policy is not to intervene in foreign judicial verdicts, and that the embassy is pressing Spanish authorities for a swift DNA verification.
The trust report contains special personal data (health and criminal data) within the meaning of the Dutch Data Protection Act, which stand in the way of sharing that information.

Het vertrouwensrapport bevat bijzondere persoonsgegevens (daar wordt onder verstaan: gezondheid en strafrechtelijke gegevens) zoals bedoeld in paragraaf 2, hoofdstuk 2 van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens, die eraan in de weg staan om die informatie te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Oskam over het bericht dat Kosovaren in toenemende mate komen asielshoppen

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about reports that Kosovars increasingly apply for asylum mainly to obtain the return allowance, and whether this abuse is tolerable, why it was not restricted earlier, and whether Switzerland's fast procedure or a broader evaluation of the return scheme is warranted. The state secretary answered that monitoring showed a sharp rise in Kosovar asylum applications, that the allowance was likely a key reason, and that Kosovar eligibility for return support has been ended, while defending the current procedure and declining a large-scale evaluation.
Where there are indications that return support is being used improperly, measures are taken and countries can be excluded.
Daar waar er aanwijzingen zijn dat op oneigenlijk wijze gebruik wordt gemaakt van de terugkeerondersteuning, worden maatregelen getroffen en kunnen landen worden uitgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de luchtaanvallen op IS en PKK doelen door Turkije

MP Knops (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey's airstrikes against both IS and PKK targets, and their implications for NATO, the anti-IS coalition, Turkish base use, travel advice and evacuation of tourists, were compatible with international law and Dutch policy. The ministers answered most questions substantively, explaining Turkey's motives, the legal basis Turkey invoked, and that consular assistance is limited to the traveller's own responsibility, though several answers restated general policy.
As the Netherlands also stated in the North Atlantic Council on 28 July, Turkish measures against terrorist threats, including those emanating from the PKK, must be proportionate.
Zoals Nederland ook in de Noord Atlantische Raad (NAR) van 28 juli jl. verklaarde, moeten maatregelen van Turkije tegen terroristische dreigingen, ook als die uitgaan van de PKK, proportioneel zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de zaak van R. van der D.

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about Romano van der Dussen's Spanish conviction, consular visits, a commissioned defence-counsel report, and a DNA match on a victim. The government answered that consular visits continue, that the report is confidential and did not address guilt, and that the Spanish courts alone can decide on reopening, with Dutch consular assistance continuing.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not make confidential reports public.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken maakt vertrouwensrapporten niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over inbeslagname van irrigatiepijpen van Palestijnse boeren in de Jordaanvallei

An MP asked whether Israeli authorities seized nearly 1.9 km of irrigation pipes from Palestinian farmers in the Jordan Valley, including a Dutch-funded project, and what the government would do about it and about obstructions to Dutch projects in Area C. The minister confirmed the seizure, said the pipes would be released after talks with Israeli authorities, outlined Dutch aid priorities in Area C and noted that other donors face similar problems.
It has been agreed that the pipes will therefore be released in the short term.
Afgesproken is dat de leidingen daarom op korte termijn zullen worden vrijgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over nieuwe onthullingen over wapenleveranties Turkije aan jihadisten Syrië

The MP Knops asked the Foreign Minister about Reuters reports that Turkish intelligence transported weapons to jihadists in Syria, and about the arrests of officials who investigated these shipments. The minister replied that the government knows of the reports but cannot draw conclusions, noted Turkey's counter-terrorism efforts, declined to seek clarification from Turkey or to call for an independent international investigation.
On the basis of these articles, and the investigations and quoted persons cited therein, no conclusion can yet be drawn about this.
Op basis van deze artikelen, en de daarin genoemde onderzoeken en geciteerde personen, kan daarover nog steeds geen conclusie worden getrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over mogelijke wapenleveranties aan Boko Haram via Turkish Airlines

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister how to assess alleged arms transports to Nigeria via Turkish Airlines, a leaked call, and UNODC findings on arms trafficking, and whether the government would verify the call or seek independent investigation. The minister answered that the government cannot verify the recording, will not speculate on unconfirmed reports, declined to raise it with Turkey, and will only generally urge research into how Boko Haram obtains weapons.
There is too little confirmed information to justify a Dutch diplomatic intervention, in a matter that primarily concerns the relationship between Turkey and Nigeria.
Er is te weinig bevestigde informatie om een Nederlandse diplomatieke interventie te rechtvaardigen, in een zaak die primair de relatie tussen Turkije en Nigeria betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Omtzigt en Knops over de bouw van een moskee in Gouda

MPs Oskam, Omtzigt and Knops (CDA) asked ministers how the sale of the PWA barracks in Gouda to a large mosque project was handled, including the origin of its funding, the Bibob review, and whether the state would follow the process. The ministers answered that the matter is a local responsibility, that a new local process is under way, and that financing was checked by a forensic accountant and Bibob advice, but that the results are not publicly disclosed and no independent state investigation will be launched.
No, this concerns a local matter.
Nee, dit betreft een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over Actieplan EU over mensenrechten

MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked why freedom of religion or belief is absent from the EU Action Plan on Human Rights and Democracy, and how the Dutch parliament will be able to weigh in. The minister replied that Dutch efforts had pushed for concrete religious-freedom actions, that the plan refers to existing EU guidelines, and that parliament will receive an assessment fiche and can comment at a committee meeting before adoption.
This fiche will be shared with the House of Representatives in early June.
Dit fiche wordt begin juni met de Tweede Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt over de situatie in Burundi en de inzet van Nederland om escalatie (zoals massamoord en mogelijke genocide) te voorkomen

CDA MPs asked the ministers about the Burundi crisis over President Nkurunziza's third term, the court ruling, possible genocide risk, Dutch diplomatic and aid responses, and sanctions. The government answer refers the MPs to a separate letter (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163) answering these questions rather than answering them in this document.

The written questions from MPs Agnes Mulder, Knops and Omtzigt (all CDA), question number 2015Z08595, have been answered by the letter 'Response to committee request on the situation in Burundi and answer to questions from MPs Van Laar and Servaes, Sjoerdsma and Mulder, Knops and Omtzigt' (Parliamentary paper 29 237, no. 163).

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt (allen CDA), vraagnummer 2015Z08595 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op commissieverzoek inzake situatie in Burundi en antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes, Sjoerdsma en Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt» (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Van Toorenburg over de onttrekking van een TBS-er tijdens zijn verlofperiode in de Rooyse Wissel

MPs Knops and Van Toorenburg asked why no full signalement or dangerousness information was shared after a TBS patient absconded during escorted leave from the Rooyse Wissel clinic, and why the Kamer was informed only via media. The Staatssecretaris answered that a signalement was in fact issued via Burgernet, described the standard notification procedures and the leave-approval process, and declined to change the policy of not informing parliament about individual absconding incidents.
Measured against roughly 70,000 leave movements, the 38 unauthorised absences and no escapes from clinics in 2014 give no reason to change its position (on informing parliament about such incidents).

Naar aanleiding van de motie van de heer Oskam. Afgezet tegen het totale aantal van circa 70.000 gepraktiseerde verlofbewegingen, vormen de 38 ongeoorloofde afwezigheden en de afwezigheid van ontvluchtingen uit klinieken in 2014, geen aanleiding om een ander standpunt in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Knops over de komst van een megamoskee in Gouda

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the government's position on the Gouda mega-mosque had changed after the Prime Minister's remarks on financing doubts, whether the municipality had withdrawn the original plan, and whether the sale of the former PWA barracks should be suspended. The Minister replied that the government takes no position on this local matter, described the PwC financial investigation and pending Bibob advice, noted the mosque board's offer of a smaller building, and refused to suspend the sale, stating that Muslims in Gouda have the right to build a mosque provided they obey the law.
In line with the constitutional structure of the Netherlands, the cabinet has taken no position on this local matter.
Het kabinet heeft conform de staatkundige inrichting van Nederland geen standpunt ingenomen over deze lokale kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Knops over het bericht dat criminele organisaties in Zuid-Limburg minderjarigen inzetten op hennepplantages

MPs Oskam and Knops asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that criminal organisations in South Limburg use minors to trim cannabis plants, and what is being done to protect them, prosecute recruiters, and tackle the phenomenon through the RIEC and regional teams. The minister replied that the Public Prosecution Service found no information on minors in cannabis cultivation, that the chief prosecutor urged anonymous reporting, that the offences are already criminal under the Opium Act with sentencing able to reflect involvement of minors, and that intensified undermining-crime teams have been active since late 2014 with reported arrests and seizures and accountability reports to follow.
However, the investigation has yielded no information about minors being deployed in cannabis cultivation.
Het onderzoek heeft echter geen informatie opgeleverd over minderjarigen die worden ingezet bij de hennepteelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de diefstal van tenten, F-16 onderdelen en heftrucks

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the theft of tents, heavy trucks and compressors from containers returned from Afghanistan, which arrived at Volkel air base filled with stones, and whether F-16 parts were involved. The minister confirmed the containers were tampered with although seals were intact, the KMAR investigation was closed without finding how the goods disappeared, and no F-16 parts were involved.
The KMAR has meanwhile closed the investigation.
Inmiddels heeft de KMAR het onderzoek gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de aanschaf van Chinese 'Patriots' door Turkije

An MP asked the foreign and defence ministers whether pressure from the West had been applied to Turkey to drop a Chinese air defence system, whether Turkey was linking its procurement to the Armenian genocide commemoration, and whether NATO interoperability concerns would be raised. The government answered that allies including the Netherlands had conveyed interoperability concerns, that negotiations were ongoing with no decision date known, and that it was up to Turkey to decide.
NATO allies, including the Netherlands, clearly conveyed concerns to Turkey about the interoperability of a Chinese air and missile defence system.
NAVO-bondgenoten, inclusief Nederland, hebben aan Turkije duidelijk de zorgen overgebracht over de interoperabiliteit van een Chinees lucht- en raketverdedigingssysteem
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Keijzer over de hulp aan gewonde oud-militair die met Koerden vocht tegen ISIS

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Health about the plight of a seriously wounded former conscript who fought alongside Kurds against ISIS, and whether the government would help repatriate and treat him. The government answered that he was not a veteran, that consular assistance was provided, that he left Northern Iraq, and that without adequate insurance the state does not finance treatment or repatriation.
With due regard to the security aspect, the usual consular assistance was provided to the person concerned.
Met in achtneming van het veiligheidsaspect is aan betrokkene de gebruikelijke consulaire bijstand verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Patriot-eenheid is teruggekeerd uit Turkije

An MP from the CDA asked the Defence Minister about reports that the Dutch Patriot unit returning from Turkey was worn out, including overdue maintenance, spare-parts shortages, and overextended specialists. The minister acknowledged overdue maintenance and that the systems will be non-operational for about a year, while defending the personnel measures taken and declining to commit to a fourth Patriot battery pending the broader defence review.
It is true that the major maintenance and modification of the systems will still take at least a year.
Het is juist dat het groot onderhoud en de modificatie van de systemen nog zeker een jaar zullen duren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de beschikbaarheid van de krijgsmacht in het kader van terreurdreiging

Knops (CDA) asked the Defence Minister whether the Dutch armed forces are sufficiently available for terrorism-related domestic deployment, given NRF and overseas commitments, and whether defence cuts should be reversed. The minister answered that the forces can largely meet their readiness targets, with some limits (medical posts, CBRN decontamination), and that the government will decide on the defence ambition level and the motion Van der Staaij in spring 2015, reporting before the summer recess.

The cabinet will inform parliament by May or June at the latest, or as early as possible, of the outcome of its deliberations, so that it can be discussed with the House of Representatives before the summer recess.

61 ), zal het kabinet het parlement uiterlijk in mei of juni – of zoveel eerder als mogelijk – op de hoogte stellen van de uitkomsten van zijn beraadslagingen, opdat hierover vóór het zomerreces met de Tweede Kamer kan worden gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Omtzigt en Knops over de vestiging van een mega-moskee in Gouda

CDA MPs asked the government about the financing of a planned large mosque in Gouda, its links to salafist fundraising, and the sale of the former Prins Willem Alexander barracks with a nuclear bunker. The minister answered that the sale and onward sale are a local matter, that PWC found no obstacles and a Bibob advice is pending, that the bunker will be demolished, and that national security is not a criterion for such sales.
The proposed decision on the onward sale to El Wahda may be changed by the mayor and aldermen after receipt of the Landelijk Bureau Bibob advice.
Het voorgenomen besluit over de doorverkoop aan El Wahda kan door het college van burgemeester en wethouders eventueel worden gewijzigd na ontvangst van het advies van het Landelijk Bureau Bibob.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de smokkel van wapens en munitie naar ISIS en Al Nusra, via Turkije

An MP from CDA asks the Foreign Minister about a UN monitoring report finding that most weapons held by ISIS and Al Nusra were seized or smuggled, mainly via Turkey, and whether Turkey should be pressed to act. The minister answers that smuggling cannot be fully prevented, that Turkey has repeatedly assured it will counter smuggling, that the government cannot confirm Turkish state support to jihadists, and that the matter is raised in bilateral contacts.
The cabinet cannot confirm that Turkey provides support to jihadist organisations.
Daarnaast kan het kabinet niet bevestigen dat Turkije steun levert aan jihadistische organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Omtzigt en Knops over de vestiging van een moskee/islamitisch centrum in Gouda

MPs Oskam, Omtzigt and Knops asked ministers about a planned mega-mosque and Islamic centre in former Gouda barracks, including sale arrangements, financing from abroad, links of preachers to jihadism and counter-radicalisation measures. The government answered most questions, declining to comment on individual cases and noting that the municipality is responsible for land use and the financing investigation is ongoing.
I do not make public statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doe ik in het openbaar geen uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het hoofdkwartier van Hamas in Turkije

CDA MP Knops asked the ministers whether Turkey hosts a Hamas headquarters from which attacks on Israel are organised and whether the Netherlands will press Turkey, the EU or NATO on this. The government could not confirm the reports, saw no need for an independent investigation, declined to put the matter on the NATO ministerial agenda, and said it is critical of Turkey where necessary.
The cabinet cannot confirm this reporting.
Het kabinet kan deze berichtgeving niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de vernieling van diverse kerken in Khartoum door het regime in Sudan

Three MPs asked the foreign minister about the demolition of churches in Khartoum, arrests of church members, a claimed ban on new church construction, and whether the government would protest and seek further sanctions. The minister confirmed awareness, explained the seizures as stemming from a land dispute and missing permits, said the ban was announced in 2012 and is unclear in writing, and stated the Netherlands raises religious freedom bilaterally and in EU and UN fora but sees no current plans for new sanctions.
Freedom of religion and belief is one of the priorities of Dutch human rights policy; the cabinet therefore rejects any obstacle a government places on people in practising their faith.

Vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging is een van de speerpunten van het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid, elke belemmering die een overheid aan mensen oplegt in de uitvoering van hun geloof keurt het kabinet daarom af.
