Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Servaes, Ten Broeke over doodschieten van Papoea's door de Indonesische politie

Seven MPs asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about reports that Indonesian police or soldiers shot dead five Papuans during a protest, and what the Netherlands would do. The Minister said the government deeply regrets the deaths, that Indonesia has launched an inquiry, that he will raise it with his counterpart, and that the Netherlands supports community policing and human rights training in Papua.
The Indonesian authorities immediately launched an investigation into the circumstances.
De Indonesische autoriteiten hebben direct een onderzoek naar de toedracht ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de uitspraken van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens in twee zaken die Somalische piraten hadden aangespannen tegen Frankrijk

MP Knops asked about two ECHR rulings against France involving Somali pirates, including compensation, whether France acted under UN mandate, and whether the Netherlands could intervene in a Grand Chamber referral. The minister answered that the rulings concern detention without prompt judicial appearance, that the Netherlands handles such cases differently, that Dutch navy operations are unaffected, and that Dutch intervention would depend on a referral and offer legal added value.
The Netherlands has so far organised this procedure differently.
Nederland heeft deze procedure tot dusver op andere wijze vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over opheldering over uniformverbod militairen

An MP from the CDA asked the Defence Minister to clarify whether soldiers are obliged to follow the ban on wearing uniforms during commuting, whether it is an order, and why the government communicated inconsistently about it. The minister replied that the precautionary measure was ordered on security advice, that soldiers can be addressed on compliance, that communication could have been clearer, and that the measure stays in force until further notice.
It is not customary for every internal precautionary measure, order, directive or instruction to be shared with the House.
Het is niet gebruikelijk dat elke interne voorzorgsmaatregel, order, richtlijn of bevel met de Kamer wordt gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Van Hijum en Hachchi over het bericht ‘Ziek personeelslid vliegbasis Twenthe kreeg 100.000 euro schadevergoeding’

MPs asked whether the Defence Minister knew of a media report that a sick former employee at Twenthe air base received 100,000 euro in damages after 14 years, allegedly on condition of dropping further legal steps, and whether such payouts had occurred before. The Minister confirmed the settlement after a long process delayed by medical uncertainty, denied any gag clause, reported fourteen related claims with five liability acknowledgements, and agreed to an independent broad investigation of all Defence staff exposed to chromium-6.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Van Hijum over een onderzoek op het voormalige NAVO-depot in Vriezenveen naar een mogelijk verband tussen gezondheidsklachten van oud-medewerkers en het werken met de giftige verf

MPs Knops and Van Hijum asked the Defence Minister why an investigation into health complaints of former workers with the paint CARC was launched for a depot in Limburg but not in Vriezenveen, and how former workers can have their complaints independently examined. The Minister answered that the research is being expanded to all defence sites using CARC and chromium VI, including Vriezenveen, that both studies run simultaneously, and that former workers can register with a reporting point, with individual follow-up after the RIVM results.
The investigations in Limburg and Vriezenveen are taking place simultaneously.
De onderzoeken in Limburg en Vriezenveen vinden gelijktijdig plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de mogelijke sluiting van de Spoedeisende Hulp in Weert

MPs Bruins Slot and Knops asked the minister about the possible closure of the emergency department at Sint Jans Gasthuis in Weert, the planned regional reorganisation of acute care, and whether the 45-minute access norm and quality criteria are adequately protected. The minister answered that insurers bear primary responsibility for contracting, the joint insurer plan has been suspended after ACM concerns, and the 45-minute norm remains the key safeguard, while declining to make the regional plans public.
It is also not for me to make these plans public.
Het is ook niet aan mij om deze plannen openbaar te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over de tweet waarin een ambtenaar van het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie stelt dat ‘Islamitische Staat (IS) een vooropgezet plan van zionisten is die bewust de Isl

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a civil servant's tweet claiming IS is a Zionist plot, and whether IS is monitored online and what policy applies to civil servants who support or excuse IS. The minister distanced the government from the tweet, explained that the NCSC monitors digital security rather than all online expressions, and set out the limits on civil servants' freedom of expression under the Ambtenarenwet, with disciplinary sanctions possible after advice from an advisory committee.
I completely distance myself from the content of the tweet.
Ik neem volledig afstand van de inhoud van de tweet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Eijsink over Russische oorlogsschepen en bommenwerpers in de buurt van Nederland

MPs Knops and Eijsink asked the Defence Minister about Russian warships and bombers near Dutch waters in 2014, including escorts by the Royal Netherlands Navy and the frequency of Russian bomber flights. The minister answered that the escorts and passages were routine or within international waters, that Russian bomber flights do not violate Dutch airspace, and listed past bomber patrol dates since 2007 while acknowledging a rise in assertive Russian behaviour.
Exact details of the actions taken by NATO are classified and cannot be included in this answer.
Exacte gegevens over de acties die door de Navo zijn genomen, zijn gerubriceerd en kunnen niet in dit antwoord worden verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Van Toorenburg over het mogelijk op straat zetten van 250 militairen

Two CDA MPs asked whether reinstating cleaning staff into government employment would force Defence to dismiss 250 military and civilian personnel, and whether this would cut the defence budget. The government denied a forced choice, said Defence is only connected from 2018 for office premises with a near budget-neutral business case, and gave a partial answer on compensation.
As stated in Minister Blok's letter of 23 June, the cabinet's choices for the departments lead to an almost budget-neutral business case for performing the cleaning work in-house.

Zoals in de brief van Minister Blok van 23 juni jl. is vermeld, leiden de keuzes van het kabinet voor de departementen tot een vrijwel budgettair neutrale business case voor het in eigen beheer uitvoeren van de schoonmaakwerkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi, Knops en Eijsink over het voornemen van de marineleiding om tweedehands helikopters aan te schaffen

Three MPs asked the Defence Minister whether the naval leadership plans to buy second-hand helicopters amid a helicopter shortage linked to NH90 problems, and what the financing, risks and training implications would be. The minister answered that the headline was incorrect, that the statements came from the naval officers' association chair rather than naval leadership, that no purchase is planned, and that compensating measures focus on extending existing Cougar helicopters and using other countries' helicopters.
The headline above the report is not correct.
De kop boven het bericht is niet juist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het gebruik van artikel 7d van de Rijkswet goedkeuring en bekendmaking verdragen

MPs Knops, Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked how often since WWII the cabinet has used article 7d of the treaty approval act to exempt confidential treaties from parliamentary approval, and asked for the titles and texts. Minister Timmermans answered that the provision dates from 1994, that confidential treaties were notified to parliament under confidentiality, and that a list of notification letters will be shared confidentially; titles for 1945-1994 are available online.
As usual, you will shortly be sent an overview of these notification letters for confidential inspection.
Zoals gebruikelijk zal u op korte termijn een overzicht van deze mededelingsbrieven ter vertrouwelijke kennisneming worden toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over ontwijken van de verhuurderheffing

MP Knops (CDA) asked the minister whether liberalising rented homes to avoid the landlord levy is occurring, its scale, and whether offering sitting tenants a switch to liberalised contracts should be halted. The minister said he has no signals of liberalisation aimed at avoiding the levy, will assess effects in the evaluation due in early 2016, and will not intervene because contractual freedom applies.
Should the practice you have identified occur frequently, this will become visible in the evaluation.
Mocht de door u geconstateerde praktijk zich veelvuldig voordoen, dan zal dit in de evaluatie zichtbaar worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de F-35 die naar Nederland komt voor geluidsmeting en Luchtmachtdagen

An MP asked whether the Defence Minister would bring an F-35 test aircraft to Volkel or Leeuwarden to clarify noise levels and give clarity to residents of Uden. The Minister answered that no concrete prospect exists yet since the Dutch test aircraft are in the US until 2018, that additional Dutch noise measurements are not expected to be necessary, and that US noise analysis results are expected after summer.
As soon as this is the case, I will inform you of that.
Zodra dit wél het geval is, zal ik u daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het bericht dat woningcorporatie WoningNet Holland Rijnland sinds 1 mei 2014 alle informatie uitsluitend per e-mail laat verlopen

MP Knops asks whether housing corporation WoningNet Holland Rijnland may end registrations of applicants without an email address, and how digital-only service fits government policy on accessibility for less digitally skilled people. Minister Plasterk answers that corporations are not obliged to use particular channels, that a fallback exists for applicants without email, and that digitalisation is government policy, leaving support to the corporations.
Housing corporations are not obliged under the regulations to communicate with their tenants and applicants in any particular way.
Corporaties zijn op grond van de regelgeving niet verplicht om op een bepaalde wijze met hun huurders en woningzoekenden te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de uitbesteding van de SAR-taken

MP Knops (CDA) asked the Defence Minister whether maritime search and rescue helicopter tasks were being outsourced because of delays in the NH-90, whether the Chamber was informed, and whether the decision was driven by budget cuts. The minister confirmed the outsourcing is a temporary measure due to NH-90 introduction delays, stated SAR policy is set by Infrastructure and Environment and operationally by the Coast Guard, denied budget motives, and promised to inform the Chamber about the NH-90 problems before the summer recess.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment is policy-responsible for SAR.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu is beleidsverantwoordelijk voor SAR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over dalende defensiebudgetten

An MP from the CDA asked the Defence Minister whether she shared US President Obama's concern about falling European defence budgets, including the Netherlands' spending at around 1% of GDP, and how she viewed statements by the Foreign and Finance Ministers on defence funding. The minister answered that international cooperation is necessary and that Dutch defence spending was welcomed, but declined to say whether she wanted more or less money for defence, only expressing support for the extra budget agreed in 2013.
Do you want more or less money for Defence?
Wilt u meer of minder geld voor Defensie?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Knops over gemeentelijk voorrangsbeleid bij het uitgeven van bouwkavels

MPs Van Hijum and Knops asked whether the Minister opposes Raalte's rules giving local-binding priority in building-plot allocation, and whether municipal autonomy and the Huisvestingswet allow this. The Minister answered that such binding criteria require a huisvestingsverordening under the Huisvestingswet, which Raalte lacks, so its rules conflict with the law; the municipality has said it will comply, and a pending bill would further restrict such local rules.
It has emerged that no housing ordinance has been adopted in the municipality of Raalte. The criteria it set therefore conflict with the Huisvestingswet.
Gebleken is dat er in de gemeente Raalte geen huisvestingsverordening is vastgesteld. De vastgestelde kaders staan daarom op gespannen voet met de Huisvestingswet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over nucleaire ontwapening en non-proliferatie

Two CDA MPs asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers whether the B61 nuclear bomb modernisation adds new military capabilities, citing claims of greater precision, yield reduction and F-35 compatibility. The government answered that the US-run life-extension programme adds no new military capabilities, that the Netherlands has no say in it, and that it will not speculate on Russian reactions.
The cabinet is not responsible for the content and implementation of the US life-extension programme and therefore makes no statements about the US Government Accountability Office's claims on this.

Het kabinet is niet verantwoordelijk voor inhoud en uitvoering van het Amerikaanse levensduurverlengingsprogramma en doet dan ook geen uitspraken over beweringen van de Amerikaanse Rekenkamer hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de verkoop van alle huurwoningen in Stuifzand

An MP asks the Minister for Housing whether he knows of housing corporation Actium's plan to sell all social rental homes in Stuifzand, and whether this breaches the municipality's housing vision and the MG 2013-02 sale rules. The Minister confirms the plan, states that corporations need no prior permission for sales to owner-occupiers, and says new legislation will strengthen the municipality's role, while denying any breach of the rules and seeing no reason to change policy.
I have regulations in preparation that will strengthen the role of the municipality.
Ik heb regelgeving in voorbereiding waarmee de rol van de gemeente versterkt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het bericht ‘Landmacht betwijfelt inzetbaarheid Patriots in Turkije’

An MP from the CDA asked the Defence Minister whether the Patriot missile systems in Turkey were struggling with heat, dust, parts delays and overdue maintenance, and why Parliament had not been informed earlier. The minister acknowledged strain and logistic efforts, said the systems remain reliable, and promised to inform Parliament if structural deployability were at risk and to address the issue in a later evaluation.
If circumstances arise that would put the structural deployability of Patriot in jeopardy, your House will be informed about this.
Indien er zich omstandigheden voordoen waardoor de structurele inzetbaarheid van Patriot alsnog in het geding zou komen, wordt uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Bashir over bijstellingsregeling directe belasting

MPs Knops, Omtzigt and Bashir asked when the Secretary of State learned of the 2014 indexation raising the eigenwoningforfait from 0.6% to 0.7%, why earlier calculations assumed 0.6%, and how the rise affects taxpayers, provisional assessments and cost estimates. The government answered that the indexation follows the statutory mechanism, was signed on 18 December 2013 and published without notifying parliament, and that provisional assessments used 0.65% with later requests recalculated at 0.7%, with a commitment to adjust the trial calculation.
It is not customary to share the outcomes of statutory indexation mechanisms with members of the cabinet.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om de uitkomsten van wettelijke indexeringsmechanismes aan leden van het kabinet mede te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Agnes Mulder over nazorg steenkoolwinning

MPs Knops and Mulder asked the minister of Economic Affairs why damage from coal mining in Limburg is not compensated, given that claims are time-barred, why the government ignores its own technical commission's findings, whether morally owed compensation should be paid, and why the Netherlands did not share costs for securing old shafts as Germany was helped. The minister answered that claims against the Mining Damage Guarantee Fund are barred under the 30-year limitation rule, that the fund cannot pay outside legal grounds, that a separate letter on follow-up steps would be sent, and that research into post-mining effects and shaft safety is underway.

On the steps that may be taken in this context and on the investigations announced in the answer to question 8 regarding aftercare for coal mining, I will inform you further by separate letter at the same time.

Over de eventueel te nemen stappen in dit kader en over de in het antwoord op vraag 8 aangekondigde onderzoeken in het kader van de nazorg voor de steenkolenwinning zal ik u gelijktijdig bij separate brief nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Knops over een strakker regime van certificering van schietverenigingen

MPs Oskam and Knops asked whether the stricter certification regime for shooting clubs from 2015 is in place, and about the model self-declaration for new members, its privacy compliance, objections from clubs, whether board members can judge applicants, verification of answers, and whether shooting guilds are exempt. The minister confirmed the regime, said the KNSA model was tested under privacy law and discussed with the ministry, that boards are trained to assess risks, and that no exemption is planned since guilds were already consulted.
There is no certainty that the questions have been answered truthfully.
Er bestaat geen zekerheid of de vragen naar waarheid zijn ingevuld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over het akkoord tussen de koepelorganisatie voor de woningcorporaties Aedes en het kabinet, waarin onder meer is afgesproken dat de integratieheffing komt te vervallen

MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked about the August 2013 agreement with Aedes that abolishes the integration levy, whether this applies to all sectors, the budgetary effect, and timing. The minister confirmed the levy is abolished entirely via the Belastingplan 2014 from 1 January 2014, with a total revenue loss of 95 million euros per year, of which about 35 million is attributed to housing associations.
The proposal that forms part of the Belastingplan 2014 aims to abolish the integration levy entirely and not only for the housing association sector.
Het voorstel dat onderdeel uitmaakt van het Belastingplan 2014 beoogt de integratieheffing in het geheel te laten vervallen en niet alleen voor de corporatiesector.
Antwoord vragen Knops over het bericht ‘Militairen bij het grof vuil gezet’

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether hundreds of military and civilian staff received automatically generated, unsigned dismissal letters, why this happened, and what will be done about dignified farewells. The minister acknowledged the letters were standard template letters generated automatically, said signing was delayed by technical issues, and promised attention to personal farewells without committing to a concrete new measure.
For technical reasons, signing of appointment and dismissal letters for military personnel was only possible since last May.
Om technische redenen was ondertekening van aanstellings- en ontslagbrieven aan militairen pas mogelijk sinds mei jongstleden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt betreffende de zorg aan militairen die niet onder de Zorgverzekeringswet valt

Two CDA MPs asked why active-duty soldiers, who are outside the Zorgverzekeringswet, end up with a higher taxable income and lower benefits than comparable employees, and whether this was deliberate. The State Secretary confirmed the difference, explained that soldiers' health costs run through the military insurer SZVK with a taxable employer share, called it a consequence of soldiers' special position and the Wet ULB, and described a one-off 2013 fix with a structural solution to follow for 2014.
For 2014 and onward, work is under way on a structural solution.
Voor 2014 en verder wordt gewerkt aan een structurele oplossing
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over een eventuele bijdrage van Nederland aan de EU trainingsmissie in Mali

Christian Democrat MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked why the Netherlands offered troops to the EU training mission in Mali without informing parliament, why the offer was not coordinated with Belgium, and whether defence cuts motivated participation. The government answered that the offer was made under political reservation during the force generation process, that the mission had no current need for it, and that participation decisions rest on substantive grounds, not budget considerations.
If the cabinet again considers a Dutch contribution in the future, the House will be informed about it.
Als het kabinet in de toekomst opnieuw een Nederlandse bijdrage overweegt, wordt de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.

An MP asks whether the Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw delays decisions on guarantee capacity for housing corporations until December 2013, cutting their access to guaranteed capital markets and the 6% VAT rule. The minister denies any such delay, says the guarantee volume for 2014 was provisionally capped and a fast-track process is in place, and promises to keep pressing the fund to inform corporations in time.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het opinieartikel «Lesje in staatsrecht helpt tegen afbraak van essentiële taken» van defensiedeskundige De Wijk

An MP from the CDA asked the Defence Minister about a newspaper op-ed claiming new budget cuts of about 400 million euros on Defence, staff uncertainty, and the timing of a future-of-the-armed-forces vision. The minister denied extra cuts beyond already-known measures, listed the existing budget reductions, and promised the vision document before the 2014 Defence budget debate.
The note will be sent to you as soon as possible, but no later than the Defence budget debate later this year.
De nota zal u zo spoedig mogelijk worden toegestuurd, doch uiterlijk voor de begrotingsbehandeling van Defensie later dit jaar.

Antwoord vragen Knops en Omtzigt over de problemen als gevolg van de huidige regelgeving met betrekking tot  hypotheekrenteaftrek die kunnen optreden voor mensen met een eigen woning die in scheiding liggen

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked the government about problems for divorcing homeowners with negative equity under current mortgage interest deduction rules, including sale times, tax treatment at divorce, and bank conditions. The minister replied that existing measures (restschuld financing, temporary tax deduction on residual debt, divorce exceptions, extended move-out periods) are sufficient within budget limits, declined to extend the divorce term or relax the amortisation requirement, and said banks reassess the finances of the remaining partner.

Within the tight budgetary margins caused by the current economic crisis, this is currently the maximum that can be done about the problem of homes being underwater and its consequences for taxpayers going through divorce.

Binnen de – door de huidige economische crisis – krappe budgettaire marges is dit op dit moment het maximale dat gedaan kan worden aan het probleem van het «onder water staan» van woningen en de gevolgen daarvan voor belastingplichtigen die aan het scheiden zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Knops over het bericht verstandelijk beperkt echtpaar in de vrieskou

MPs Van Toorenburg and Knops asked about a couple with intellectual disabilities evicted from a Dordrecht senior flat over rent arrears, and about cooperation to prevent evictions. The minister answered that the eviction followed a court ruling, that prevention is mainly the landlord's responsibility, that a new prevention covenant with Dordrecht was signed, and that the government will underline the importance of prevention in consultations.
Preventing evictions is a responsibility of landlords.
Het voorkomen van huisuitzettingen is een verantwoordelijkheid van verhuurders.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over het bericht "Duitse Patriot-militairen belaagd in zuiden Turkije"

Omtzigt and Knops (CDA) asked the Foreign and Defence ministers about reports that German Patriot soldiers were harassed in southern Turkey, and whether further unrest and host-nation funding for the Patriot deployment are expected. Minister Timmermans answered that the soldiers were unharmed, that demonstrations are small and the Patriots enjoy broad Turkish support, and that the NATO-Turkey funding agreement was completed on 12 January 2013 without being hindered by the anti-Western sentiment.
De militairen zijn niet gewond geraakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Van Hijum over de Nationale Hypotheekgarantie

CDA MPs Knops, Omtzigt and Van Hijum asked the ministers about the Nationale Hypotheekgarantie (NHG): claim numbers, debt write-offs, sale methods, approval of forced sales, controls on lenders and the maximum state risk. Minister Blok answered with WEW data, noting forced-sale approval rules were tightened from 1 January 2013 and that the maximum exposure is well below the guaranteed EUR 149 billion.
The WEW states it has no data on this.
Het WEW geeft aan hierover geen gegevens te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Van Hijum over executieveilingen en onderhandse executies

Three CDA MPs asked ministers about foreclosure auctions and private sales of homes, citing lower prices, falling auction numbers, bank conduct, notaries' role and NMa cartel fines. Minister Blok answered that auction prices are lower for structural reasons, that data on private foreclosure sales are incomplete, that the pending bill on foreclosure auctions and existing NHG and AFM measures are the response, and that no new legislation or research is planned.
There is no publicly available data on the number of private foreclosure sales for the entire Dutch housing market.
Er zijn geen openbaar beschikbare gegevens over de aantallen onderhandse verkopen voor de gehele Nederlandse woningmarkt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over het bericht van 4 januari jl. in het Financieel Dagblad “Toezichthouder negeerde risico Vestia”,

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked the minister whether the Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw (WSW) lawfully guaranteed loans for housing corporation Vestia despite its large equity and its derivative exposure, and who is accountable. The minister answered that the WSW followed its own rules, declined to disclose individual loan and derivative details citing commercial sensitivity, and said the CFV and WSW each had a limited supervisory role.
Information at the WSW on individual loans and derivatives is commercially sensitive, so the WSW cannot provide it without prior written consent from the participant.

De informatie bij het WSW met betrekking tot (individuele) leningen en derivaten is bedrijfsgevoelig en kan het WSW derhalve niet verstrekken zonder voorafgaande schriftelijke toestemming van de deelnemer.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Knops over het bericht dat honderdduizenden Nederlanders teveel betalen voor gas

MPs Agnes Mulder and Knops asked the minister whether consumers are overpaying for gas transport because of oversized connections, whether tariffs should be lowered, and whether they will be compensated. The minister disputed the VEH's conclusions, said the regulator NMa sets tariffs and he cannot compel lower ones, and noted that network operators will offer free downsizing and review compensation case by case.
I cannot force the network operators to lower the gas transport tariffs.
Ik kan de netbeheerders niet dwingen de tarieven voor het transport van gas naar beneden bij te stellen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Knops over de voorgenomen sluiting op- en afrit Nuth (A76)

MPs De Rouwe and Knops asked why the Nuth A76 on/off ramp is to be closed while a new ramp is planned nearby, and about rat-running traffic and consultation with the province and municipalities. The minister answered that the closure is agreed in a 2010 convenant, is part of the Parkstad Buitenring plan led by the province, and that the province, as competent authority, handles the trade-offs and consultation.
The province of Limburg is the responsible competent authority and has initiated a PIP procedure to weigh the interests.
De provincie Limburg is het verantwoordelijke bevoegde gezag en heeft ten behoeve van de belangenafweging een PIP-procedure ingezet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de ontvoering van de Nederlandse fotojournalist Jeroen Oerlemans

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of two British nationals linked to the kidnapping of Dutch photojournalist Jeroen Oerlemans, Turkish intelligence's role in his release, and whether the government evaluated the case. The minister confirmed cooperation with British police, declined to discuss the arrestees' involvement because the British investigation is ongoing, denied receiving any Turkish confidentiality request, and said the case was reviewed without any policy change.
Since the arrests took place at the request of the British authorities and the investigation there is still ongoing, I cannot give any information on this.
Aangezien de aanhoudingen hebben plaatsgevonden op verzoek van de Britse autoriteiten en het onderzoek aldaar nog loopt kan ik hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Hijum en Knops over de hypotheekrenteaftrek

Three CDA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance about the planned phased reduction of the mortgage interest deduction top rate (fourth bracket) from 52% to 38% and its effect on marginal tax rates. The government confirmed the plan, said details on the marginal tax effects and the mechanism (no tax credit route) would follow in a bill, and stated that the phasing-down timetable runs over 28 years to give housing market certainty.
It is premature to make statements now about the tax rate that will then apply in the third bracket or the combined tax and premium rate in the second bracket.
Het is voorbarig om nu uitspraken te doen over het dan geldende belastingpercentage in de derde schijf of het gecombineerde belasting- en premiepercentage in de tweede schijf.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Knops over de mogelijke sluiting van de centrale Buggenum

MPs Agnes Mulder and Knops asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the possible closure of the Buggenum Willem-Alexander power plant, its jobs, the government's options to keep it open, and security of supply. The minister answered that closure is a market decision by Nuon, that the government does not steer which plants stay open, and that security of supply remains good.
I have brought this to the attention of Nuon.
Ik heb dit onder de aandacht gebracht van Nuon.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oskam en Knops over schutterijen die aanlopen tegen knelpunten in de wapenwet- en regelgeving

MPs Oskam and Knops (CDA) asked the State Secretary whether shooting clubs (schutterijen) would get their own weapons rules, and about practical problems under the Cwm and Wwm, including carrying deactivated weapons, replica weapons, sponsor shooting with children, and the KNSA licence requirement. The State Secretary answered that the club input was considered in the evaluation, that some problems (carrying during drill, sponsor shooting) will be examined and may lead to rule changes, but rejected the idea that clubs could issue their own licences and KNSA membership could lapse.
I will examine whether the laws and regulations need to be adjusted on this point.
Ik zal bezien of de wet- en regelgeving op dit punt aanpassing behoeft.
Antwoord vragen Knops over de bezuinigingen op Defensie

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether her earlier claim that there would be no further cuts to troops squared with the coalition agreement's budget reductions for Defence, including a €48m structural cut, a €250m reallocation to an international security fund, and an extra €84m target. The minister confirmed the statements, said the €48m cut will be filled with efficiency measures while operational units are protected, and committed to informing the Chamber on the financial effects before the budget debate.
Antwoord vragen Knops over het bericht problemen financiering AWACS basis Geilenkirchen

An MP from the CDA asked the Defence Minister about reports of a funding dispute over maintenance of the AWACS runway at Geilenkirchen, including France's refusal to pay its share and the consequences for timing and noise. The minister answered that NATO has not yet agreed on common funding, the runway works will be carried out in 2014 subject to agreement, the delay does not add noise, and the Chamber will be informed once NATO decides.
Once NATO has taken a decision on this, the Chamber will be informed.
Zodra de Navo daarover een besluit heeft genomen zal de Kamer worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt en Knops over het bericht “het weigeren van de toegang tot India van twee begeleiders van het Dendron college uit Horst”

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister whether he was aware that two supervisors of a Horst school were refused entry to India despite valid visas, and whether he would ask the Indian ambassador to explain and correct this. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Indian embassy was willing to explain the refusal to the supervisors, and noted that under international law states have sovereign authority over entry to their territory.
Under international law, states have the sovereign right to grant or deny foreigners access to their territory.
Volgens internationaal recht hebben landen het soevereine recht vreemdelingen al dan niet toegang tot hun grondgebied te verschaffen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Knops en De Rouwe over spoedwerkzaamheden om de Lauwersmeerdijk te verstevigen

Two MPs from the CDA asked the minister about emergency reinforcement works on the Lauwersmeerdijk, earlier 2010 test results, other weakened dikes, innovative monitoring and the 2013 budget cut. The state secretary answered that the works prevent an acute safety problem, that the dike failed the third test round and will be addressed in the nHWBP programme to be fixed in 2014, and that the budget cut has no effect on 2013 works.
The emergency works on the Lauwersmeerdijk prevent an acute safety problem, as the channel has shifted landward.
Met de spoedwerkzaamheden aan de Lauwersmeerdijk wordt een acuut veiligheidsprobleem, doordat de geul zich landwaarts heeft verplaatst, voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ormel en Knops over de uitspraken van de Amerikaanse president Obama over eventueel militair ingrijpen in Syrië

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister about President Obama's statements on possible military intervention in Syria if chemical weapons are used, and about the risk to the region, the position of Christians, and Turkey's proposal for a buffer zone. The minister confirmed awareness, called the chemical weapons situation worrying, said the Netherlands supports international involvement, and declined a buffer zone for now as lacking a legal basis.
The cabinet, like partners such as the US and UK, sees the Turkish proposal as an extreme measure that is currently not on the agenda.
Het kabinet, evenals partners als de VS en het VK, ziet het Turkse voorstel als een uiterst middel dat momenteel niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Knops over het bericht ‘Anderhalf keer Balkenende-norm voor fusiedirecteur’

An MP from the CDA asks whether the reported salary of about €275,000 for the director-board member of the merging housing corporations in Landgraaf and Kerkrade, and the failure of supervisory boards to set it in line with sector codes, is acceptable, and what means the minister has to enforce compliance. The minister replies that the merger is still under way and no salary has been set, that enforcement of sector codes lies with the branch itself, and that he will press for compliance at the merger decision and rely on the Woningwet/WNT powers once in force.
I do not have the formal legal means to enforce application of the sector codes.
Ik beschik niet over de formele wettelijke middelen om de toepassing van de sectorcodes af te dwingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Knops over mogelijke fraude bij bouwconcern Ballast Nedam

An MP from the CDA asked the Defence Minister whether the government knew of possible fraud by Ballast Nedam in building the Kromhout barracks, whether there were signs of competition-restricting conduct raising Defence's costs, and what action it would take. The minister answered that the competition authority is only verifying claims, that offers were assessed without finding harm to Defence, that Defence had been informed earlier, and that it will cooperate with any investigation and act if restrictive conduct is found.
Naturally, Defence will cooperate with the NMa investigation if requested.
Vanzelfsprekend zal Defensie desgevraagd medewerking verlenen aan het NMA-onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Knops over de vrijlating van de fotograaf Jeroen Oerlemans

MP Knops (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister about the release of photographer Jeroen Oerlemans, including the ministry's and KLPD's role, the basis for the minister's public statement, whether media statements affected the release, and lessons learned. The minister declined to share details on the operation for security reasons, said the statement was based on available sources, denied receiving a request for secrecy, and said the case will be evaluated.
Because of the vulnerability and risks in kidnapping cases, no statements can be made about this, including with a view to the future.
Vanwege de kwetsbaarheid en risico’s bij ontvoeringszaken kunnen hierover, ook met het oog op de toekomst, geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen leden Koopmans en Knops over uitbesteding van graslandbeheer op defensielocaties

CDA MPs asked the Defence minister whether the grassland management at Venray air base could be outsourced to a dairy farmer at no cost, saving Defence money, and whether similar outsourcing occurs elsewhere. The minister refused the proposal, arguing that the existing low-intensity grassland management is required for flight safety against bird strikes, that the offer does not reduce costs for Defence, and that the Leeuwarden grassland management is already outsourced.
Defence is therefore not willing to respond to Vreba's proposal to change the current low-intensity grassland management of the military airfield.
Defensie is dus niet bereid in te gaan op het voorstel van Vreba om het huidige schraal grasbeheer van het militaire luchthaventerrein anders in te richten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Holtackers en Knops over de aanbieding energiecontract Veteraneninstituut

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Defence about a commercial energy-contract mailing to veteran-pass holders that carried the Veterans Institute's logo and was co-signed by its director, and whether this was acceptable and how privacy is protected. The Minister answered that the Institute is independent, the mailing costs were borne by the energy company, the commercial action is a less desirable development he will raise with the director, and veterans' data remain private via a separate address file.
The commercial action mentioned in the question is a less desirable development. I will call the director of the Veterans Institute to account for it.
De commerciële actie die in de vraag wordt genoemd, is een minder goede ontwikkeling. Ik zal de directeur van het Veteraneninstituut daarop aanspreken.
Antwoord vragen Knops en Holtackers over averij bij proefvaart rubberboot mariniers

Two CDA MPs asked the Defence Minister about reported damage (broken seats, torn upholstery, a broken windscreen, bent rails) during sea trials of the FRISC rubber boat for the Marines, and whether the supplier would bear repair costs and whether delays affected operations. The minister answered that the defects are being fixed at the supplier's expense under the contract, that eleven vessels have been delivered, that all remaining vessels will be tested before operational use, and that the delays did not impede Marines or Coast Guard operations.
Defence does not accept vessels that have not been tested.
Defensie accepteert geen vaartuigen die niet zijn getest.
Antwoord vragen Samsom en Knops over de mogelijkheid voor vreemdelingen met een verblijfsvergunning op medische gronden om arbeid te verrichten

MPs Samsom and Knops asked how the adopted Sterk motion, which asks that holders of medical residence permits and their family members be allowed to work under the same conditions as asylum seekers, is being implemented, and whether this can take effect with the Modern Migration Policy Act. The minister replies that the cabinet advised against the motion, that work access should only come after three years and voluntary continuation of residence, and that the three-year period will not be shortened.
I will therefore not shorten the three-year period after which work may be performed.
Ik zal daarom de termijn van drie jaar, waarna wel werkzaamheden mogen worden verricht, niet verkorten.
Antwoord vragen Knops en Van Nieuwenhuizen over een hek op de grens tussen Griekenland en Turkije om de toestroom van illegale immigranten tegen te gaan

MPs Knops and Van Nieuwenhuizen asked whether Greece is building a fence on the Turkish border to curb illegal immigration, about its cost, EU funding refusal, Frontex and EASO support, and cooperation with Turkey on readmission. The minister confirmed construction, said the fence has at most a local and temporary effect, and described Dutch and EU support and ongoing talks with Turkey, without any strong commitments.
The fence may have a local effect, so that the inflow of illegal migrants through that part of Greece's external border with Turkey will decrease, possibly only temporarily.
Het hek heeft mogelijk een plaatselijk effect waardoor de instroom van illegale migranten, en dan mogelijk tijdelijk, via dat deel van de buitengrens van Griekenland met Turkije zal afnemen.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink en Knops over de arbeidsmarkttoeslag voor reservisten

MPs Eijsink and Knops asked the Defence Minister whether ending the labour-market allowance for reservists would reduce reservist availability amid budget cuts, and whether reservists who object would no longer be called up. The minister answered that the allowance is being applied more selectively by the CLAS commander, that he does not expect a major effect on reservists' willingness to serve, and that objecting reservists would indeed not be called up.
This is the responsibility of the commander of the relevant operational command.
Dit is de verantwoordelijkheid van de commandant van het desbetreffende operationeel commando.

Vragen van de leden Knops (CDA) en Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de Iraakse regering die niet langer wil meewerken aan gedwongen terugkeer van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers uit Ned

MPs Knops (CDA) and Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD) asked why Iraq no longer cooperates with forced return of rejected asylum seekers from the Netherlands and other EU states, and what the government will do about it. The minister says Iraq now requires a travel document for forced return, is in talks with Iraqi authorities, notes Denmark, Norway and the UK have return MoUs, and will press Iraq diplomatically and consider sanctions if needed.
I have spoken with the Iraqi ambassador in the Netherlands about the situation that has arisen and about possibilities to carry out forced return of undocumented aliens.
Ik heb met de Iraakse ambassadeur in Nederland gesproken over de ontstane situatie en over mogelijkheden om de gedwongen terugkeer van ongedocumenteerde vreemdelingen te effectueren.

Vragen van de leden Ormel en Knops (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de berichtgeving rond de beschuldiging van planning van een couppoging ten aanzien van een groot aantal hooggeplaatste militaire

CDA MPs asked the foreign minister about reports of a large coup-plot case against serving and retired Turkish officers, the concerns about fair trials and transparency, Turkey's disputes with Cyprus and Israel, and whether this threatens EU and NATO ties. The minister said Dutch concerns about fair and transparent trials are being raised in EU circles, that Turkey's NATO position is not in question, and that Dutch concerns about regional tensions have been raised with Turkey.
I advocate this within the EU framework.
Vragen van de leden Knops en Haverkamp (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Defensie over Vliegbasis Volkel (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

MPs Knops and Haverkamp asked why the Volkel air base airport decision was repeatedly postponed since 2002 and whether residents can be allowed new housing in the village in the meantime. The ministers explained the delays through successive changes (F-16 reductions, regional requests for optimisation) and offered a consultation with the municipality of Uden by year end on local housing options.
I will inform you further about the outcome of this.
Over de uitkomst hiervan zal ik u nader informeren.

Vragen van de leden Knops en Çörüz (beiden CDA) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat de Turkse moslimextremist E. in Nederland asiel heeft aangevraagd (ingezonden 26 au

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about reports that a Turkish Islamist extremist linked to Turkish Hezbollah applied for asylum in the Netherlands, including whether he was convicted in Turkey, whether extradition was requested, and how many Turkish asylum claims are made and granted. Minister Leers answered that the IND screens for exclusion under Article 1F of the Refugee Convention, that no Hezbollah-activist figure can be given because it is not registered in IND systems, and that no extradition request had been made by Turkey.
Your question how many Hezbollah activists have applied for asylum in the Netherlands in recent years, I cannot answer concretely at this moment.
Uw vraag hoeveel Hezbollah-activisten in de afgelopen jaren in Nederland om asiel hebben gevraagd kan ik op dit moment niet concreet beantwoorden.

Vragen de leden Van Hijum en Knops (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor Immigratie en Asiel over een verblijfsstatus en het recht op kinderbijslag (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

MPs Van Hijum and Knops asked the ministers about a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that parents without a valid residence permit may be entitled to child benefit after long residence, and what follow-up policy, cassation and measures to prevent such entitlement are planned. The government answered that the ruling is being contested in cassation before the Hoge Raad, will inform parliament once the consequences are clear, and says its streamlining programme aims to prevent prolonged residence through stacked procedures.
The Sociale Verzekeringsbank has lodged an appeal in cassation with the Hoge Raad.
De Sociale Verzekeringsbank heeft cassatieberoep ingesteld bij de Hoge Raad.

Vragen van de leden Knops, Koopmans en Ormel (allen CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de Floriade (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

CDA MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs why Yemen and Sudan were present at the Floriade 2012 in Venlo and what criteria governed invitations, including for Iran and Syria. The minister replied that invitations went to BIE member states, Iran was not invited on Foreign Affairs advice, Syria and Yemen were invited under earlier relations, participation is for commercial firms, and any official attendance will be assessed under current policy.
The presence of government officials from these countries is not foreseen.
Aanwezigheid van overheidsfunctionarissen uit deze landen is niet voorzien.

Vragen van de leden Ten Broeke (VVD), Knops (CDA) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Defensie over de dreigende sluiting van recreatiepark «OASE Hoenderloo» dat grenst aan Schietkamp Harskamp (ingezonden 8

MPs Ten Broeke, Knops and Voordewind asked the Defence Minister why Defence will not renew the ground lease of recreation park OASE Hoenderloo, which borders a shooting range, and whether it will reconsider given budget cuts and a residents' counter-proposal. The minister answers that the range's 2007 environmental permit with noise zoning restricts its operational use, that the lease ends by law in 2013 and was announced in 2008, and that there is no link to budget cuts, so no reconsideration is planned, while ongoing talks with the owners are not disrupted by direct contact with the residents' committee.
To prevent these talks with the owners from being disrupted, Defence has communicated with the residents' committee of De Oase only in writing.
Om te voorkomen dat deze gesprekken met de eigenaren worden doorkruist, heeft Defensie met de recreantencommissie van De Oase alleen schriftelijk gecommuniceerd.

Vragen van de leden Knops en Koopmans (beiden CDA) aan staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Defensie over het bericht «Varen houdt nog twaalf legertrucks Soesterberg vast» (ing

Two CDA MPs asked why twelve army trucks at Soesterberg remain stuck because of a protected fern population, questioning costs, the duty of care under the Flora and Fauna Act, and the operational cost. The state secretary confirmed the exemption and costs of EUR 18,000 plus EUR 4,000, said an evaluation in September 2011 will decide the remaining population, and noted the Nature Conservation Act integration will reflect the biodiversity goal.
Depending on this evaluation, it will be decided in consultation with the Ministry of Defence how to deal with the remaining population.
Afhankelijk van deze evaluatie zal in overleg met het Ministerie van Defensie worden besloten hoe om te gaan met de nog resterende populatie.
Vragen van de leden Ormel en Knops (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over de onbevaarbaarheid van de Indische Oceaan (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers about Somali piracy in the Indian Ocean, shipowners' calls to declare the area a war zone, and whether marines should be placed on ships and how to counter impunity. The ministers answered that shipowners bear primary responsibility for protection, that naval deployments and EU/UN action continue, that a policy framework on Vessel Protection Detachments will follow, and that the Lang report will guide further anti-impunity measures.
In the short term the House will receive a policy framework on this.
Op korte termijn zal de Kamer hierover een beleidskader ontvangen.
Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Knops (CDA), Voordewind (CU) en Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over Egyptische asielzoekers (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

Four MPs asked the immigration minister how many Egyptian asylum seekers had been refused and told to leave, whether Coptic Christians can safely return given recent violence, when updated country reports would appear, and whether deportations should pause amid upheaval. The minister said refusals were indicative only, that individual assessment remains the basis, that no separate country report was needed, and that no departure moratorium applies to Egypt at present.
On the basis of these indicative figures it cannot be concluded that this is also the actual number of former Egyptian asylum seekers who had to leave the Netherlands.
Op basis van deze indicatieve cijfers kan niet worden geconcludeerd dat dit ook het daadwerkelijke aantal Egyptische ex-asielzoekers betreft die Nederland daadwerkelijk moest verlaten.
Vragen van het lid Knops (CDA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over Zambrano (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

An MP from the CDA asks the minister for Immigration and Asylum about the 2011 Zambrano ruling of the EU Court of Justice on the nationality of children born abroad, the possibility for parents to secure Colombian nationality, the effects for Dutch and other EU policy, and possible measures against residence rights derived from children. The minister answers that Colombian nationality is not automatically granted to children born abroad but can be obtained by registration, that the ruling bears on exceptional situations, and refers to a separate letter for the remaining questions.
I cannot say whether the Belgian authorities investigated this before the children obtained Belgian nationality.
Ik kan geen uitspraak doen over de vraag of de Belgische autoriteiten hiernaar onderzoek hebben gedaan alvorens de kinderen de Belgische nationaliteit hebben verkregen.

Vragen van de leden Knops (CDA) en Spekman (PvdA) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel, van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over rechterlijke uitspraken in Afghaanse asielzaken, die mede zijn gebase

MPs Knops and Spekman asked ministers whether court rulings in Afghan asylum cases, partly based on WikiLeaks material, mean the Foreign Affairs country reports on Afghanistan are unreliable and what follows for asylum policy. The government answered that the July 2010 report stands, that WikiLeaks material cannot be verified and will not be used as objective sources, and that it sees no reason to change its policy or pending cases, while appeals are ongoing.
Given the nature of the reports published on WikiLeaks, the information in them cannot be verified for accuracy, and these reports are therefore not suitable for use as objective source material.

Gezien de aard van de berichten die op Wikileaks zijn gepubliceerd, is daarin opgenomen informatie niet op juistheid te toetsen en lenen deze berichten zich derhalve niet voor het gebruik als objectief bronnenmateriaal.

Vragen van de leden Van Bochove, Blanksma-van den Heuvel en Knops (allen CDA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Financiën over aflossingsvrije hypotheken (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers of Finance and Interior whether Rabobank's halt to fully interest-only mortgages in shrinking regions such as Groningen breaches equal treatment and encourages shrinkage, and whether they would seek agreements with banks. The minister replied that Rabobank denies any policy to stop interest-only loans, that advice depends on the client's personal situation, and that the postcode rule in the Gedragscode Hypothecaire Financiering prohibits discrimination on area grounds.
Under the Mortgage Lending Code, the mere fact that the mortgaged home is located in a particular postcode area cannot be grounds to reject the application.
Het enkele feit dat de hypothecair te verbinden woning is gelegen in een bepaald postcodegebied kan volgens de Gedragscode Hypothecaire Financiering geen grond zijn om de aanvraag af te wijzen.
Vragen van het lid Knops (CDA) aan de minister van Defensie over de onderschepping van twee Russische bommenwerpers boven de Noordzee (ingezonden 21 oktober 2010).

Member Knops (CDA) asked the Minister of Defence whether Dutch F-16s intercepted two Russian bombers over the North Sea, whether they were authorised to fly there, and whether Russian overflights have increased. The minister confirmed the escort in international airspace, said Russia broke no international rules but should file flight notifications, and attributed the flights mainly to training and demonstration purposes without describing an increase in 2010.
Exact data on numbers and the actions taken by NATO are classified and cannot be included in this answer.
Exacte gegevens over aantallen en de acties die door de Navo zijn genomen, zijn gerubriceerd en kunnen niet in dit antwoord worden verwerkt.
Vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Knops (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Defensie over gevechtstenue voor vrouwelijke militairen (ingezonden 17 september 2010).

CDA MPs Bruins Slot and Knops asked the Defence Minister whether Defence is developing a combat uniform for women, what it would cost, and whether this is justified given shortages of basic clothing and equipment. The minister confirmed that size specifications for women's combat uniforms were set, that they are not materially different from men's, and that they will be ordered with regular stock replenishment at no extra cost.
This clothing does not differ further from that of male military personnel.
Deze kleding wijkt verder niet af van die van mannelijke militairen.

Vragen van de leden Knops en Biskop (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Defensie en aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het aansmeren van verzekeringspolissen aan scholieren (ingezonden 20 mei

Two CDA MPs asked whether insurance policies were being pushed on pupils during lessons at vocational colleges (ROCs), whether companies may collect pupil data for commercial approaches, and whether this fits the Veiligheid & Vakmanschap curriculum. The state secretary answered that no signs were found of insurance sales during lessons, that commercial activity at ROCs is not acceptable, and that data collection for commercial purposes does not fit the curriculum.
The Ministry of Defence also sent a letter to all ROCs with a defence training programme asking them to ensure the programmes are not used for commercial purposes.

Voorts heeft het ministerie van Defensie naar alle roc's met een defensieopleiding een brief gestuurd met daarin het verzoek erop toe te zien dat de opleidingen niet gebruikt worden voor commerciële doeleinden.
Vragen van de leden De Pater-van der Meer en Knops (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over wachtgeld van een oud-wethouder (ingezonden 22 april 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about a former alderman in Meerssen who received about EUR 61,715 too much in severance pay due to a municipal error, and whether the error was properly handled and why the matter was not made public. The state secretary confirmed the overpayment, said the municipality is responsible for administering it, that the error was an isolated administrative failure now addressed by improvements, that repayment rules limit recovery, and that the case was kept private for privacy reasons.
In my view, there is no need for further measures.
Een noodzaak tot verdere maatregelen is naar mijn mening niet aan de orde.
Vragen van de leden Aasted Madsen-van Stiphout en Knops (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Defensie over Poms sites (ingezonden 8 april 2010).

The CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Defence about the closure of the US-used Poms site in Eygelshoven, the recent remediation of the site, and whether Dutch equipment returning from Afghanistan could be serviced there to preserve jobs in Parkstad. The minister confirmed the facts, said Defence does not foresee structural use of the complex but is examining using it for cleaning and repair support for equipment returning from Afghanistan.
Defence is currently examining the possibilities for this.
Defensie beziet momenteel de mogelijkheden daartoe.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht ‘Sociale media niet geschikt voor kinderen, concludeert Consumentenbond’

An MP asked the government about a Consumentenbond finding that social media platforms are unsuitable for children, including personalised advertising to minors and data privacy concerns. The state secretary responded that the AVG already protects children, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is responsible for enforcement, and that the government supports EU-level restrictions on profiling minors while proposing to promote the Dutch Code voor Kinderrechten Online and adjust national rules.
The cabinet wants to protect children more against inappropriate online advertising and child-directed marketing and give children the right not to be tracked and not to receive data profiles.
Het kabinet wil kinderen extra beschermen tegen niet-passende online reclame en kindermarketing en kinderen het recht geven om niet gevolgd te worden en geen dataprofielen te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over de beantwoording van de vragen 'Litouwen adviseert consument geen Xiaomi-telefoons meer te kopen'

MPs Rajkowski asked the ministers about Chinese censorship software on Xiaomi phones, state use of such devices, and whether oversight could detect it. The government answered that Lithuanian and German investigations found the functionality disabled in the EU, pledged to consider amending the Telecommunications Act, and declined an additional independent investigation.

As long as the e-privacy regulation is not yet in force, a complicating factor is that article 11.2a of the Telecommunications Act, which transposes article 5 of the e-privacy directive, is directed only at providers of public electronic communication networks and services and not at third parties such as the phone supplier.

Zolang de e-privacyverordening nog niet van kracht is, is een complicerende factor dat artikel 11.2a van de Telecommunicatiewet waarin artikel 5 van de e-privacyrichtlijn is omgezet, zich alleen richt tot aanbieders van openbare elektronische communicatienetwerken en diensten en dus niet tot derden zoals de leverancier van de telefoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over Nederlands hulpgeld voor de wederopbouw van Sint Maarten dat nog steeds niet is uitgekeerd aan Sint Maarten

An MP asked why about half of the Dutch reconstruction aid for Sint Maarten after hurricane Irma still sits at the World Bank trust fund, and what the government would do to speed disbursement and rehousing. The state secretary answered that implementation is Sint Maarten's responsibility with World Bank support, that the Netherlands monitors via a steering committee, that the fourth tranche was transferred in December 2021, and that housing and shelter are Sint Maarten's autonomous competence.
Sint Maarten is responsible for implementing the reconstruction and is supported by the World Bank in doing so.
Sint Maarten is verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de wederopbouw en wordt daarbij ondersteund door de Wereldbank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het rapport Kwetsbaar door software – Lessen naar aanleiding van beveiligingslekken door software van Citrix

MP Kathmann asked the ministers about the Safety Board's report on software vulnerabilities (Citrix) and whether software makers should bear responsibility, invest more, and face liability. The government says it is studying the report, points to existing measures such as the Roadmap for Digitally Secure Hardware and Software and EU certification efforts, and defers liability and quality-requirement questions to the European level, promising a full response before summer.
As stated in the letter to parliament of 16 December 2021, the cabinet will study the report carefully and respond in writing to the OVV within the statutory six-month period.
Zoals aangegeven in de Kamerbrief van 16 december 2021 zal het kabinet het rapport zorgvuldig bestuderen en binnen de wettelijke reactietermijn van zes maanden schriftelijk richting de OVV reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Veerdienst Saba/Statia gestrand door blunderende ministeries'

An MP asked the State Secretary and ministers why the Saba/Sint Eustatius ferry service failed to start on 1 November 2021, whether customs and Marechaussee were unprepared, and about affordability and remaining obstacles. The government answered that the start slipped to 14 November due to tender extensions and missing safety certificates, that the ferry started on 1 December 2021, and that ministries coordinated with the island authorities.
Due to the extension of the tender period at the request of the participating parties, the target start date had to be adjusted to 14 November 2021.
Door verlenging van de aanbestedingstermijn op verzoek van de deelnemende partijen moest de streefdatum van de start echter worden bijgesteld naar 14 november 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wuite over het artikel ‘Veerdienst Saba/Statia gestrand door blunderende ministeries’

An MP asked why the Saba/Statia ferry service failed to start on schedule and whether the ministries involved, including the Rijksdienst Caribisch Nederland, were responsible. The government answered that tender delays, missing safety certificates and late agreement on the sailing schedule with the Marechaussee and Customs caused the postponement, and that the service started on 1 December 2021.
In its coordinating role, the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations initiated consultation with the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management to resolve this.
Vanuit de coördinerende rol heeft het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties overleg geïnitieerd met het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat om dit op te lossen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over illegale casino’s op Curaçao

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations about the scale of illegal online gambling from Curaçao, the Dutch Gambling Authority's (Ksa) ability to collect fines, and the status of a motion on the Team Bestrijding Ondermijning. The government answered that Curaçao is autonomous in licensing and enforcement, that it is working with the Netherlands on reform under the Curaçao package, that Ksa fines against Curaçao-based firms are hard to collect, and that the motion is considered fulfilled.
Imposing an order subject to a penalty or a fine is, however, only one of the means that can be used to stop illegal providers.
Het opleggen van een last onder dwangsom of boete is echter maar één van de middelen die kunnen worden ingezet om illegale aanbieders te stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het gebruik van gezichtsherkenning bij toegang tot evenementen

An MP from the SP asked the government about the use of facial recognition for event access, including the risks to privacy, whether consent is truly voluntary when alternatives are slower, and oversight capacity. The minister replied that no overview of events using facial recognition exists, that the AVG strictly limits such use and requires genuinely free consent, and that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and data protection officers oversee compliance.
Such an overview does not exist.
Een dergelijk overzicht is er niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Strolenberg over de Kamerbrief 'Reactie op de motie van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over een cyberverdedigingsprotocol voor gemeenten'

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary why many municipalities lack cyber incident protocols and whether he will implement the Yesilgöz-Zegerius motion for a protocol. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for their own information security under the BIO framework, that he will not impose a single protocol, and points to ENSIA, IBD support and a 'kaartje in de meterkast' tool instead.
I support this by strengthening the supervisory role (horizontal oversight) of the municipal council, including through the ENSIA approach to Single Information Audit.
Ik ondersteun dit door de controlerende taak (het horizontale toezicht) van de gemeenteraad te versterken met onder andere de aanpak Eenduidige Normatiek Single Information Audit (ENSIA)
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat door de huidige vorm van geboorteaangifte bij de burgerlijke stand de risico’s op fraude of illegale adoptie groot zijn

Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the current birth registration procedure allows fraud and illegal adoption, whether the government has data on the scale of the problem, and whether it will consult FIOM, Defence for Children and the Dutch association for civil registry officers. Minister Dekker replies that safeguards in Dutch birth registration are sufficient, that cases of fraud in the Netherlands are very rare and no current indications exist, that false foreign birth certificates are a residual risk beyond Dutch control, and that the government will keep watching signals and is willing to discuss with the organisations concerned.
Regarding possible signals of recent cases of illegal taking-in of children, I am willing to discuss with the organisations involved.
Over mogelijke signalen van recente gevallen van illegale opneming ga ik graag in overleg met de betrokken organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de rol van het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf in het tijdelijke Kamergebouw

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about agreements with the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf on responsibility for major building changes, space requirements, cost allocation and sustainability in the temporary parliament building. The State Secretary answered that the Tweede Kamer's programme of requirements and the Technisch Ontwerp 100% govern the work, that changes go through the regular client-request and budget process, and that costs are charged to users via a usage fee.

This programme of requirements was translated into the 'Technisch Ontwerp 100%' (with detailed designs of all rooms in the building), which was adopted by the presidium of the House of Representatives as representative of this user.

Dit programma van eisen is vertaald naar het «Technisch Ontwerp 100%» (met de detailontwerpen van alle ruimten van het gebouw) dat is vastgesteld door het presidium van de Tweede Kamer als vertegenwoordiger van deze gebruiker.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Jasper van Dijk over in Nederland geboren Molukkers die stateloos zijn

MPs Paulusma and Van Dijk asked about Dutch-born Moluccans who are stateless but hold Dutch travel documents under the Moluccans Position Act, including how many there are, how naturalisation works, and whether they should be actively informed about the option of Dutch nationality with voting rights. The state secretary answers that about 850 such people hold documents, at least 450 have obtained Dutch nationality over the years, and she is willing to discuss the matter with the Moluccan community while showing restraint in actively promoting nationality, since the Act was a deliberate choice.
I am of course willing to discuss this with representatives of the Moluccan community.
Ik ben uiteraard bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan met vertegenwoordigers van de Molukse gemeenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het inperken van het demonstratierecht voor de ingang van de nieuwe Tweede Kamer

An MP asked the government whether restricting protest space in front of the temporary Tweede Kamer building, and the Hague municipality's updated demonstration policy, undermine the constitutional right to demonstrate, and what role the Chamber's presidium and the cabinet played. The minister answered that the right is fundamental, that protest facilitation is solely the local mayor's responsibility, and that the cabinet and presidium have no competence, while not committing to any concrete step.
Facilitating demonstrations is a local responsibility.
Het faciliteren van demonstraties is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over het bericht ‘Hoe gelijk zijn man en vrouw voor gemeenten?’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why women often lack digital access to tax records for property they co-own with men, since municipalities and water boards usually issue tax assessments in one person's name. The minister explained the legal basis and municipal discretion, said there is no legal barrier to addressing all co-owners, and committed to discussing alternatives with municipalities and water boards.
I am willing to discuss with the other tiers of government what the options are for giving all owners of a property insight into the tax records.
Ik ben bereid om met de medeoverheden te bespreken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om alle eigenaren van een eigendom inzicht te geven in de belastinggegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over de wateroverlast

MPs Boswijk, Van Dijk and Amhaouch asked ministers about flood damage and whether the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen applies to farmers outside Limburg, and about sand bags, food safety, manure bookkeeping and working-time rules. Minister Schouten answered that the compensation law applies only to disasters meeting the Wet veiligheidsregio's definition, that uiterwaard damage is excluded and still under study, and that a ministerial regulation and RVO quick scan are being prepared.
Currently the desirability and possibilities of compensating damage in floodplains along the Maas are being explored, about which your House has been informed.
Momenteel wordt de wenselijkheid en mogelijkheden voor tegemoetkoming van schade in uiterwaarden langs de Maas verkend waarover uw Kamer is geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Bromet over de gecombineerde 22ste/23ste/24ste periodieke rapport van het Committee on the Elimination of Racial Discrimination over het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden

MPs Wuite and Bromet asked the State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations about the UN CERD committee's criticism of conditions on COVID-19 liquidity aid to Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, discrimination against Caribbean Dutch, Kingdom-wide climate funding, Statute reform and decolonisation. The State Secretary defended the conditions as customary, rejected a Kingdom climate fund citing the autonomy of the countries, said no immediate Statute reform is needed, and disagreed that decolonisation is incomplete.
When allocating subsequent tranches, that will always be the starting point.
Bij het toekennen van volgende tranches zal dat steeds het uitgangspunt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Onmacht Almere met paspoorten wekt irritatie bij Marechaussee’

An MP asked the State Secretary about Almere's inability to issue passports and BRP extracts during summer peak demand, and the Marechaussee being overloaded with emergency document requests. The State Secretary answered all 14 questions in substance, attributing the backlog to capacity and COVID-related factors, noting BZK and the KMar can only help to a limited extent, and committing to clarify communication and guidance on emergency documents.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for their service provision.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun dienstverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wuite en Van der Werf over het artikel 'Steeds moeilijker om naar Aruba te vluchten; 'we blijven het proberen''

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretaries about reports that migrants were being expelled from Aruba to Venezuela while asylum or appeal proceedings were pending, whether Aruba was breaching the Refugee Convention, and about detention conditions and legal aid in Aruba and Curaçao. The government answered that Aruban and Curaçaoan migration and asylum policy are national matters for those countries' own authorities, while offering support and cooperation, and committed to a working group on rule-of-law cooperation within the Kingdom.
Aruba's immigration policy is a matter for the country itself. It is for the authorities and judiciary of Aruba to state or assess to what extent international rules are being complied with.

Het vreemdelingenbeleid van Aruba is een landsaangelegenheid. Het is aan de autoriteiten en aan de rechterlijke macht van Aruba om zich uit te laten of te beoordelen in hoeverre conform internationale regelgeving gehandeld wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over de renovatie van het Binnenhof

An MP asked the State Secretary for the Interior why the Binnenhof renovation cost estimate rose again, why the increase was announced at the start of recess, why security and sustainability costs were not foreseen earlier, and whether the estimate can be treated as a ceiling. The State Secretary answered that the budget was always subject to four disclaimers, that security requirements changed after 2020 and sustainability costs followed a parliamentary motion, and that the estimate is not a fixed ceiling and remains subject to those disclaimers.
The amount of € 475 million (price level 2015) is therefore not a static amount and has already been adjusted as a result of the disclaimers, and this may again be necessary in the coming period.
Het bedrag van € 475 miljoen (prijspeil 2015) is daarmee geen statisch bedrag en is als gevolg van de disclaimers reeds bijgesteld en dat kan de komende periode op basis hiervan opnieuw nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van den Berg en Kuik over de aanpak van mensenhandel in de Caribische delen van het Koninkrijk

MPs asked about the government's approach to human trafficking in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom, including prosecutions, victim reporting, information sharing and whether the National Rapporteur's mandate should extend to the BES islands. The government answered that combating trafficking is largely a country matter, gave case and reporting figures for Caribbean Netherlands, declined to extend the National Rapporteur's mandate, and committed to raising the issue at the next Justice Ministers' meeting and evaluating the MoU in 2022.

Are you willing to come to the budget debate for the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations with scenarios on how information gathering, information sharing, reception, investigation and prosecution of human trafficking in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom can be improved?

Bent u bereid voor de behandeling van de begroting Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties met scenario's te komen hoe de informatievergaring, informatiedeling, opvang, opsporing en vervolging op het gebied van mensenhandel in de Caribische delen van het Koninkrijk kan worden verbeterd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Winair bungelt aan randje faillissement'
