MPs Aukje de Vries and Rudmer Heerema asked the ministers about the risks of a Winair bankruptcy for connectivity to Saba and Sint Eustatius, the financial exposure of the Netherlands, support requests, and the governance of the state shareholding. The minister answered that Winair is the only scheduled carrier to those islands, that the Netherlands has only a hypothecary loan secured on the hangar, that a steunverzoek is under review with the primary responsibility resting with Sint Maarten, and that the shareholding is being evaluated with a letter promised later this year.
As soon as more is known about this, I will inform your House.
Zodra daarover meer bekend is, zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de wateroverlast in Limburg

An MP asked the government about end-June flooding in Limburg (Eygelshoven, Meerssen), whether it shares the cause of the mid-July disaster, and whether victims and entrepreneurs can get compensation when insurers do not pay. The minister answered that the June rains are not comparable to the July disaster, that the Wts does not apply, that no separate fund is planned, and that loss of turnover is excluded from Wts compensation but the government will discuss it with the region, pointing to the NOW 4 wage subsidy.
The cabinet does however want to discuss this with the region and entrepreneurs' representatives, paying attention to proportionality, feasibility and precedent.
Het kabinet wil evenwel het gesprek hierover met de regio en ondernemersvertegenwoordigers voeren, waarbij ook aandacht is voor proportionaliteit, uitvoerbaarheid en precedentwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over verzekeraars die wateroverlastschade van ondernemers in Valkenburg niet vergoeden

MP Ploumen asked ministers whether they would compensate Valkenburg business owners whose flood damage is not covered by their insurers, and whether they would press insurers such as Lloyd's to pay. The government answered that it is in contact with the insurers' association, that the Wts disaster compensation scheme can cover damage that is not reasonably insurable, that Lloyd's is mapping its exposure and will report back, and that other schemes are being examined.
Lloyd's will inform the Minister of Finance about the progress of this process.
Lloyd’s zal de Minister van Financiën informeren over de voortgang van dit proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over tegemoetkoming gedupeerden wateroverlastschade Limburg

An MP asked the ministers whether flood victims in Limburg, many not sure their insurer will pay, should get generous support under the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen regardless of water source, and when the scheme's details and advance payments would be clarified. The minister answered that the Wts was declared applicable, that flood damage from the Maas is not reasonably insurable for private persons so they can claim compensation, that the RVO opened a damage reporting form on 9 August, and that advance payments were deferred because they would slow down assessments, with a regulation to follow as soon as possible.
The cabinet decided to declare the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) applicable to the disaster in Limburg.
Het kabinet heeft besloten om de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) van toepassing te verklaren op de ramp in Limburg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Rajkowski over de berichtgeving over onbruikbare overheidsapps voor mensen met een beperking

MPs De Kort and Rajkowski asked the State Secretary for the Interior about reports that government apps are unusable for people with disabilities, and what the EU accessibility rules require. The State Secretary answered that municipalities and other public bodies are responsible for accessibility, that 108 app accessibility statements had been published by 23 June 2021 with most apps not fully compliant, and that the ministry supports them through DigiToegankelijk and related teams.
Subnational governments and public organisations are themselves responsible for making their websites and apps more accessible.
Medeoverheden en overheidsorganisaties zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het toegankelijker maken van hun websites en apps.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch, Ellemeet en Bromet over de wateroverlast in Limburg

MPs asked the government about the flooding in Limburg: the adequacy of responders, damage estimates, applying the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen to victims, flood buffers and climate adaptation funding, and the long-term aid. The minister answered that the government will apply the compensation law, outlined eligible damage categories, said a damage quick scan is being prepared, and described responder support, climate-adaptation programmes and a planned evaluation table.
Given the nature and scale of the disaster, the cabinet has decided to apply the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts).
Het kabinet heeft besloten om, gelet op de aard en de omvang van de ramp, de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) toe te gaan passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de huidige stand van zaken met betrekking tot de digitale beveiliging van overheidswebsites in Nederland

An MP from DENK asked the State Secretary for the Interior about digital security of government websites, including sites of the Tax Authority, GGDs and water boards that reportedly fail NCSC guidelines, and about Wordpress warnings. The State Secretary answered that security is the responsibility of each organisation under the BIO baseline and risk assessments, denied a systemic failure, and pointed to ongoing standardisation monitoring.
It is up to government organisations to determine, by taking the mandatory BIO measures and additional measures arising from a risk assessment, how Wordpress can be used securely.

Het is aan overheidsorganisaties om door het treffen van de verplichte maatregelen uit de BIO en aanvullende maatregelen, voortvloeiend uit een risicoafweging te bepalen hoe Wordpress veilig kan worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Leijten over het bericht 'Overheid heeft nog jaren nodig om «foute persoonsgegevens» op te ruimen'

MPs Ceder and Leijten asked the State Secretary of Interior about reports that the government needs years to clean up improperly used personal data in risk models, including use of nationality, ethnicity and birthplace, privacy impact assessments, proportionality, and timelines. The State Secretary answered that a DPIA check and inventory will be carried out across departments, that such data use is only allowed when objectively justified, that the operation may run until 2025, and that a first progress report will be sent before the budget debate.
As I wrote to your House in my letter of 8 April, we are starting with an inventory of data processing and a check on lawfulness.
Zoals ik uw Kamer schreef in mijn brief van 8 april, starten we met een inventarisatie van de gegevensverwerkingen en een toetsing op rechtmatigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over Nederlandse militairen die als migrant geregistreerd zijn

An MP asked whether Dutch military personnel posted abroad are registered as immigrants in the civil registry and whether this harms their pension rights and families. The State Secretary explained that the registry term 'immigration' is used for returns after temporary stays, that no effect on rights follows, and promised to examine adding a second address and clearer labelling.
Ja, daar ben ik het mee eens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Bromet over het bericht dat algoritmes van de gemeente Rotterdam kunnen leiden tot vooringenomen uitkomsten

MPs Bouchallikh and Bromet (GroenLinks) asked about reports that Rotterdam's algorithms may produce biased outcomes, including the Rekenkamer Rotterdam report, use of possibly discriminatory variables, transparency toward benefit recipients, the SyRI ruling, and the need for an algorithm register. State Secretary Knops answered that municipalities are responsible, that the government is developing guidance, an impact assessment and a national inventory of unlawful use of nationality/ethnicity in risk models, and that a register is being studied.
Ultimately, municipalities are themselves responsible for complying with the law.
Uiteindelijk zijn gemeenten zelf verantwoordelijk voor naleving van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Diertens over het bericht 'Faillissement van BOPEC kost overheid Bonaire € 300.000'

MPs Kuiken and Diertens asked about the bankruptcy of oil company BOPEC on Bonaire, its skeleton crew for safety risks, union involvement, responsibility for safety, the role of government policy, and the Bonaire public body's bridging credit. The government answered that the curator and regulators (ILT, RWS) selected the skeleton crew after a union-agreed list became unworkable, that safety responsibility lies with the licence holder and then the curator, and that the Bonaire body granted a 250,000 USD contribution consistent with the Wet FinBES.
The OLB has in the meantime committed a contribution of 250,000 dollars.
Het OLB heeft inmiddels een bijdrage van 250.000 dollar toegezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Paternotte over het bericht 'Europees vaccinatie-certificaat ook goed nieuws voor de eilanden'

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about the progress, timing and invention issues for introducing the EU digital green (vaccination) certificate in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom, and whether travel between overseas territories and countries would be possible. The state secretary answered that working groups are preparing, the target date of 21 June also applies, residents without a BSN/DigiD face a special route that is being discussed, and travel between territories will be possible.

Currently it is being examined what the technical and legal requirements of the certificate are and whether introducing the digital green certificate is deemed opportune by the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom.

Momenteel wordt bekeken wat de technische en juridische vereisten zijn van het certificaat en of het in gebruik nemen van het digitale groen certificaat opportuun wordt geacht door de Caribische delen van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden leden Kuiken en Diertens over het bericht ‘Raad van State Rijkswet COHO strijdig met Statuut’

MPs Kuiken and Diertens asked the State Secretary for the Interior whether the COHO Kingdom Act was checked for legal compliance with the Statute, and about its consequences if the Council of State finds it conflicts with the Statute. The State Secretary answered that legal review took place, though under time pressure and only partially, that the Council of State did not find a conflict but has doubts on some parts, and that the consequences for the country packages and financial support are still being discussed with the Caribbean countries.
The department preparing the bill is primarily responsible for a proposal, and therefore also for its legal quality.
Het departement dat het wetsvoorstel voorbereidt is primair verantwoordelijk voor een voorstel, en dus ook voor de juridische kwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de mogelijkheid voor gemeenten om zelfstandig staatloosheid te onderzoeken en/of vast te stellen

An MP asked whether municipalities can independently investigate and establish statelessness and recode 'nationality unknown' to 'stateless' in the BRP, and whether they should be given guidance. The state secretary answered that municipalities have only a limited registration competence based on evident documents and refused a broader investigative duty, pointing instead to a forthcoming court-based statelessness determination procedure and declining to issue a guidance document.
This concerns a low-threshold procedure open to every person who claims to be stateless, regardless of their residence status.
Het betreft een laagdrempelige procedure die toegankelijk is voor elke persoon die stelt staatloos te zijn, ongeacht diens verblijfsstatus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Aukje de Vries over het verplicht moeten tonen van een negatief testbewijs bij de grens tussen Nederland en Duitsland

Two VVD MPs asked the Dutch government about the German requirement to show a negative test when crossing the border, including for cross-border workers and pupils, and whether the government would raise the problem with Germany. The State Secretary answered that a Dutch test facility is being set up, that Germany has relaxed some rules for cross-border commuters, and that the government has been in ongoing contact with German authorities.
The cabinet shares this view and therefore wants to create a testing facility for these specific groups.
Het kabinet deelt deze mening, en wil voor deze specifieke groepen daarom een testvoorziening creëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Diertens over de ontwikkelingen van de gezondheidssituatie op Bonaire en Curaçao

MPs Kuiken and Diertens asked about COVID-19 hospitalisations, the call centre, vaccination capacity, reduced regular care and overload risk on Bonaire and Curaçao, and whether a negative PCR test should be required for travellers to the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered with figures, reports of resolved call-centre problems, cross-island patient transfers, and the designation of the islands as high-risk areas with testing obligations.
Talks are also being held about transferring patients to other countries in the region when local capacity proves insufficient despite joint efforts.
Ook worden gesprekken gevoerd over de overplaatsing van patiënten naar andere landen in de regio, wanneer de lokale capaciteit ondanks gezamenlijke inspanningen onvoldoende blijken te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Curaçao kan geen coronapatiënten meer opnemen, IC ligt helemaal vol'

MP Kuiken asked the health and kingdom relations ministers how the government will support Curaçao after reports that its ICU was full and it could no longer take COVID patients, and whether the navy ship Karel Doorman could be deployed. The Staatssecretaris answered by pointing to a letter on three support lines, to cross-island hospital cooperation, extra staff and equipment, and patient transfers, while stating that VWS has no authority over the Karel Doorman and that no assistance request has been made to Defence.
The Ministry of VWS has no authority over the deployment of the ZMS Karel Doorman.
Het Ministerie van VWS heeft geen zeggenschap over de inzet van de ZMS Karel Doorman.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het terugtrekken van Nederlandse banken uit de BES-eilanden

Diertens (D66) asked whether ABN AMRO's plan to close euro accounts held by residents of the Caribbean Netherlands (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba) affects access to banking, and whether residents have a right to a basic payment account. The minister confirmed the risk of higher costs, said residents have no EU basic-account right as overseas territories, and reported ongoing talks with banks and a planned regulatory change to ease euro account offerings.
I am therefore preparing an amendment to the Besluit financiële markten BES so that Dutch European banks may offer payment accounts in the Caribbean Netherlands without an additional licence.
Ik bereid daarom een wijziging van het Besluit financiële markten BES voor waardoor Europees Nederlandse banken betaalrekeningen in Caribisch Nederland mogen aanbieden zonder extra vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de Startup in Residence challenge ‘Gezocht: Ontwikkel een tool waarbij het beantwoorden van Kamervragen verbeterd en versneld wordt’

An MP asked whether a Startup in Residence challenge to build a tool speeding up answers to parliamentary questions treats symptoms rather than causes, and whether transparency, staff rotation or information provision are at fault. The government replied that the tool only improves access to existing public documents, that parliament was not consulted on this specific tool, and that it rejects the suggestion that ministry information provision is deficient.
This specific tool has not been discussed with parliament.
Over dit specifieke hulpmiddel is niet gesproken met het parlement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over het bericht ‘BAM sloopt koraalrif en de Curaçaose overheid haalt de schouders op’

MPs De Groot and Diertens asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about BAM's damage to a coral reef on Curaçao and whether BAM can be held accountable in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that the matter is a Curaçao responsibility, that Curaçao has sued BAM for compensation, and that the Dutch government expects companies to follow OECD guidelines, while no concrete Dutch action was announced.
It is up to the Curaçao government to hold the construction company responsible for the damage it has caused.
Het is aan de Curaçaose overheid om het bouwbedrijf verantwoordelijk te stellen voor de schade die zij hebben aangericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de petitie van Sint Maarten

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about a 2021 petition on behalf of Sint Maarten's parliament and citizens alleging neo-colonial, racist treatment and failure to promote self-government, covering financial oversight, reconstruction funds, social welfare, the prison and independence. The State Secretary largely rejected the racism and colonialism claims, attributed financial problems to pre-existing issues and Sint Maarten's own responsibilities, and said independence is a matter for Sint Maarten to initiate.
I am therefore not willing to take the lead in this.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid het voortouw hierin te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de financiële steun aan Sint Maarten

The MP Van Raak asks whether the Dutch government will accept that financial support to Sint Maarten is oppressive or colonial, whether support depends on local political backing, and whether it will suspend aid and push a referendum on independence. The State Secretary rejects the characterisation, says political consensus is needed, requests written reassurance from Sint Maarten's Prime Minister before any suspension, and declines to initiate an independence process.
I have asked the Prime Minister of Sint Maarten for clarification and written reconfirmation of the support previously expressed for this process by both her government and the Estates.
Ik heb de Minister-President van Sint Maarten verzocht om opheldering en een schriftelijke herbevestiging van de eerder uitgesproken steun voor dit traject van zowel haar regering als van de Staten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over het bericht 'Ombudsman wil meer aandacht voor obstakels Caribische studenten'

MPs Diertens and Paternotte asked the ministers about the Ombudsman's report on obstacles faced by Caribbean students in Dutch higher education, including study results, healthcare, BSN numbers and loan repayment. The minister answered that the government is working on improvement measures, has commissioned research and a regional steering group, and promised further letters and investigations on several points.
I have pointed out the Ombudsman's report to my fellow education ministers in the Kingdom.
Ik heb mijn collega-ministers van onderwijs in het Koninkrijk gewezen op het rapport van de Ombudsman.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de mogelijke aanleg van een containerhaven op Bonaire

An MP from GroenLinks asked the ministers about reported plans for a container port near Hato on Bonaire, including environmental impacts, alternatives, coral reef protection and whether a planning study had been commissioned. The minister answered that the decision rests with the Bonaire executive board, that the ministry assists with further study, that no planning study has been commissioned yet, and that environmental assessment will follow later.
The decision whether a new cargo port (location) should actually be built, and if so where, rests with the Bonaire Executive Council.
Het besluit of er daadwerkelijk, en zo ja waar, een nieuwe vrachthaven(locatie) dient te komen is aan het Bestuurscollege van Bonaire.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Verzet tegen plan Bonaire voor containerhaven'

An MP asked whether the government shares concerns that a container port near Hato on Bonaire would damage a pristine reef in a marine park, and what steps it will take. The minister replied that the decision rests with the Bonaire executive council, that a further feasibility study was agreed in the convenant, that an environmental impact assessment (MER) will be required later, and that no planning study has been commissioned yet.
The decision on whether, and where, a new cargo port should be built rests with the Bonaire executive council.
Het besluit of er daadwerkelijk, en zo ja waar, een nieuwe vrachthaven(locatie) dient te komen is aan het Bestuurscollege van Bonaire.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het rapport Onderzoeksrapport Feitenrelaas verkoop pand Noordeinde 64/64a van de Auditdienst Rijk

An MP asks, after the Auditdienst Rijk report on the sale of Noordeinde 64/64A, whether integrity breaches, conflicts of interest, favouritism or a non-market price occurred, and whether the sale should be annulled. The State Secretary answers that the report shows no integrity breaches or insider-knowledge abuse, that he sees no need for further research, and that the valuations and the sale price were market-conform, rejecting annulment and declining to answer questions on the Hague city council and mayor.
I therefore see no reason for further investigation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding voor verder onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het salaris van de top van Winair

An MP asks what the managing director of Winair earned and whether cutting the top salaries was part of the rescue operation. The government reports the CEO earned EUR 169,000 in 2019, refers to the annual state-holdings report for board pay, and states that the board's salaries were cut by 25% in April 2020 and that the loan conditions bar bonuses and dividends.
Board remuneration is reported in the annual State Holdings Management Report that the Minister of Finance sends to your House each year.
Over de beloningen van de Raad van Bestuur wordt gerapporteerd in het Jaarverslag Beheer Staatsdeelnemingen dat uw Kamer jaarlijks van de Minister van Financiën ontvangt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Amhaouch over de hypothecaire lening aan Winair

Two CDA MPs asked whether Winair's financial problems stem only from COVID-19, what conditions attach to the state-backed mortgage loan, whether competing routes and the state's 7.95% shareholding affect the decision, and what happened to recommendations on subsidising inter-island flights. The government answered that the loan followed a economic and political assessment, carries conditions such as no dividends and minimum daily flights, and was needed to keep Saba and Sint Eustatius connected, while stating that the wider connectivity question remains under review.
The results of Phase B contain commercially sensitive information; these will be shared confidentially with the House.
De uitkomsten van Fase B bevatten bedrijfsgevoelige informatie; deze worden vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Middendorp en Aartsen over de uitvoering van de compensatieregeling eHerkenning

VVD MPs asked why businesses that obtained standard eHerkenning before the special Belastingdienst login became available must downgrade it, possibly at cost, to claim compensation, and about the status of the scheme. The Secretary of State answered that downgrading is free at five of six providers, that 1014 claims had been filed and paid by 25 January 2021 (no split by route possible), and that the Belastingdienst contacted about 540 organisations unable to register in the Trade Register.
RVO cannot see, when logging in with the specific eHerkenning Belastingdienst means, whether this was first a generic eH3 login means.
RVO kan bij het inloggen met het specifieke «eHerkenning Belastingdienst» middel niet zien of dit eerst een generiek te gebruiken eH3 inlogmiddel is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht 'Onzekerheid over vaccinatiedatum BES en CAS'

An MP asked the state secretaries about preparations for COVID-19 vaccination on the Caribbean Dutch islands and Curaçao, Aruba and Sint Maarten, including logistics, staffing, cold chain and undocumented residents. The government answered that plans and cold-chain equipment are in place, vaccination of healthcare staff and over-60s is intended from mid-February subject to RIVM approval, and it referred to earlier letters for quantities and timelines.
My intention is therefore to start vaccinating this group in mid-February.
Mijn voornemen is dan ook om half februari te starten met het vaccineren van deze groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de mogelijkheid voor ouders in het buitenland om een levenloos geboren kind bij te schrijven in de Basisregistratie Personen

MP Bergkamp asked whether Dutch parents living abroad can register a stillborn child in the Basisregistratie Personen (BRP), and whether this can be made possible through legislation. The Secretary of State answered that parents who were registered residents when the stillbirth occurred can already request registration after emigrating, and that a bill submitted in November 2020 would extend registration to parents who are or become residents, regardless of nationality or residence at the time of birth.
I am willing to take into account the circumstance that there are parents living abroad who wish to have data on their live and/or stillborn children recorded in the BRP when developing it.

Ik ben bereid om de omstandigheid dat er ouders zijn die in het buitenland wonen en wensen dat gegevens over hun levend en/of levenloos geboren kinderen in de BRP worden opgenomen, bij de uitwerking daarvan mee te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht 'Zeventien illegalen ontsnappen uit detentie op Curaçao'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about the escape of 17 migrants from detention on Curaçao, Dutch involvement in the search, the number of Venezuelan detainees, access to legal aid, a repatriation flight, and arrests during the curfew. The government answered that Dutch authorities were not involved in the search, that 26 Venezuelans were held in detention on 12 December, and that asylum and return policy is a matter for Curaçao, with the Curaçao authorities reporting on legal aid and voluntary departures.
Asylum, reception and return policy, including providing legal aid to foreigners, is a matter for the country of Curaçao.
Asiel-, opvang- en terugkeerbeleid, waaronder ook het bieden van juridische bijstand aan vreemdelingen, is een aangelegenheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de vergelijking tussen hem en Escobar, Napoleon en Hitler

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations how he views Sint Maarten parliamentarians comparing him to Pablo Escobar, Napoleon and Hitler, why he trusts that the Sint Maarten parliament will cooperate given such remarks, and whether he fears this will frustrate aid to the island. The answer refers the reader to a letter on the third tranche of liquidity support for Sint Maarten, without answering the questions directly.

The written questions from MP Van Raak (SP) to the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations on the comparison between him and Escobar, Napoleon and Hitler (2020Z25129) have been answered by letter 'Agreement on third tranche of liquidity support for Sint Maarten' (Parliamentary paper 35 420, no. 203).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de vergelijking tussen hem en Escobar, Napoleon en Hitler ( 2020Z25129 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «Akkoord derde tranche liquiditeitssteun Sint Maarten» (Kamerstuk 35 420, nr. 203 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Geen zorgtoeslag door mogelijke fraude met de Basisregistratie Personen’

An SP MP asked the government about a tenant denied childcare allowance because the landlord and her child remained registered at the address in the Personal Records Database, despite a rental contract showing they did not live there. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case, citing confidentiality, explained that the tax authority may depart from the registry only when there is reasonable doubt and that a registry check is the municipality's responsibility, and promised a discussion with the policy ministries.

However, if the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances has reasonable doubt about the accuracy of the registration (for example following an objection), it must notify the municipality so that the municipality investigates the accuracy of the registration.

Indien de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen echter gerede twijfel heeft over de juistheid van de inschrijving (bijvoorbeeld naar aanleiding van een bezwaar), dient deze hiervan melding te doen aan de gemeente, zodat de gemeente onderzoek doet naar de juistheid van de inschrijving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Dam over de verkoop van paspoorten

Two MPs from the CDA asked the government about golden passport schemes, including whether Curaçao's investor residence scheme meets European Commission requirements, how many people used it, an overview of such schemes in the Kingdom, and how many people in the Netherlands hold passports bought via Malta, Cyprus or Bulgaria. The government answered that Curaçao's scheme falls outside the Commission's requirements, that citizenship is a Kingdom matter, that Curaçao must account for participant numbers itself, and that the Netherlands has no investment-based citizenship scheme, while noting it does not know how EU citizens resident in the Netherlands obtained their nationality.
It is up to the Curaçao government to account for that.
Het is aan de Curaçaose regering om daarover verantwoording af te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de uitzondering voor casino’s in de coronamaatregelen op Sint Maarten

MP Van Raak asked why casinos on Sint Maarten were exempted from closing-time restrictions and whether holiday travel there should be allowed given the risk. The State Secretary answered that Sint Maarten is responsible for its own COVID measures, that it is noteworthy it chose to exempt casinos, and that alleged ties between gambling and politics are outside his remit, though the Public Prosecution Service and a Dutch-funded joint investigation team handle criminality.
I cannot make statements about alleged ties between the gambling world and politics.
Over vermeende banden tussen de gokwereld en de politiek kan ik geen uitspraken doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Diertens over een onderzoek van de Raad voor de rechtshandhaving naar de bejegening van in bewaring gestelde vreemdelingen in Curaçao en het AIV-rapport ‘Veiligheid en recht

MPs Groothuizen and Diertens asked about a Raad voor de rechtshandhaving inspection of detention conditions for migrants in Curaçao, the AIV advisory report on Caribbean security, the ombudsman's complaint that his recommendations are ignored, lack of legal aid and NGO access for Venezuelans, two minors reportedly detained, a Human Rights Institute recommendation, and a recent fire at the SDKK facility. The State Secretary answered that Curaçao decides whether to adopt inspection recommendations, though the Netherlands keeps pressing for improvements and Curaçao's project plan includes recommended measures, declined to intervene in the ombudsman matter, said legal aid is Curaçao's responsibility, denied that minors are currently held, and deferred the AIV-related questions to a later government response.
Under the Kingdom Act on the Council for Law Enforcement, it is up to the authorities of Curaçao to decide whether the recommendations in the inspection report are adopted.
Op basis van de Rijkswet Raad voor de Rechtshandhaving is het aan de autoriteiten van Curaçao om te bepalen of de aanbevelingen uit het betreffende inspectierapport worden overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en De Groot over het bericht 'Olieplatform verbrijzelt koraalrif op Curaçao – en daarna werd het stil'

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about a reported oil platform that damaged coral reef off Curaçao in 2017 and 2019, including whether Dutch assistance would be offered and what rules have changed. The State Secretary answered that the matter is the responsibility of the Curaçao government, that no assistance has been requested, that no safety rules have changed yet, and that the investigation is still ongoing.
No assistance has been requested from the Netherlands.
Er is geen assistentie gevraagd aan Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over gesprekken met jongeren in Caribisch Nederland

MP Özütok asked whether the government will involve young people from Caribbean Netherlands in decision-making on the covid-19 crisis, citing the citizens' initiative 'Betrek jongeren'. State Secretary Knops says he knows the initiative, has spoken with young people on his visits, and will hold an online conversation with young people on 23 November, bringing their ideas to the cabinet.
On 23 November I have planned a first conversation with young people from Caribbean Netherlands to speak online about the themes that concern them.
Op 23 november a.s. heb ik een eerste gesprek gepland met jongeren uit Caribisch Nederland om via een online verbinding te spreken over de thema’s die bij hen leven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat overheden regels voor toegankelijke websites aan hun laars lappen

Bergkamp (D66) asked the State Secretary of the Interior why government websites still fail accessibility rules despite the 2018 decree and the 23 September 2020 deadline, and how this will be remedied, including missing accessibility statements, the politie.nl rating, and mobile apps. Knops answers that accessibility remains insufficient, explains the obstacles, and commits to contacting non-compliant bodies via accessibility teams, updating a priority top-10 list, and reminding bodies of the June 2021 app deadline.

To have all government organisations publish an accessibility statement as quickly as possible, all municipalities, water boards, provinces and national government organisations without a valid statement will be approached in the coming months by government accessibility teams and the expertise centre Digitoegankelijk.

Om zo snel mogelijk alsnog alle overheidsorganisaties een toegankelijkheids-verklaring te laten publiceren, worden in elk geval de komende maanden alle gemeenten, waterschappen, provincies en rijksoverheidsorganisaties zonder een (geldige) verklaring benaderd door toegankelijkheidsteams van de overheid en het expertisecentrum Digitoegankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Middendorp over het bericht 'Nog steeds doodverklaard: verwisselingsfout van drie jaar terug blijft Fred Marree achtervolgen'?

MPs Van der Molen and Middendorp asked about a Rotterdam municipal error that wrongly registered a living man as deceased, with consequences for his insurance, passport, driving licence and pension. The State Secretary confirmed the error, said the municipality contacted agencies to correct it and provided a new travel document, and reported that a central complaints point for basic registries is expected to start in early 2021.
From the municipality I understood that it contacted the agencies directly after the error to correct the mistake and its consequences as quickly as possible.
Van de gemeente begreep ik dat zij de instanties direct na de fout hebben benaderd om de fout en gevolgen zo snel mogelijk recht te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Diertens over de besmettingen met COVID 19 in het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk

MPs Kuiken and Diertens asked about COVID-19 infections in the Caribbean Kingdom, including Sint Eustatius' quarantine exemptions for essential workers, Aruba's and Bonaire's healthcare capacity and testing, the use of Zr.Ms. Karel Doorman, and mandatory testing for visitors to Bonaire. The government answered that exemptions are limited to essential work under strict protocols, that support to Aruba and Bonaire has been provided, and that a legal basis for mandatory test certificates for Caribbean Netherlands is being considered.
I am currently considering whether it is desirable to provide, for the Caribbean Netherlands only, a legal basis for requiring visitors to the islands to present a test result.
Ik beraad mij nu over de wenselijkheid om alleen voor Caribisch Nederland te voorzien in een wettelijke basis voor het verplicht overleggen van een testresultaat aan bezoekers van de eilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht 'Protestmars bij grens met Saint Martin'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for the Interior and the Foreign Minister about French border controls between Sint Maarten and Saint Martin, including their reasons, the government's view, and efforts to coordinate COVID-19 policy. The minister answered that the French controls were introduced for COVID-19 reasons, that the Netherlands respects them but considers them undesirable long term, that they were lifted on 15 September, and that health-sector coordination with the island is ongoing.
The Netherlands respects the French decision to introduce these controls, but considers such a situation undesirable in the long term.
Nederland respecteert het Franse besluit tot invoering van deze controles, maar acht een dergelijke situatie op lange termijn niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Onderwijs is failliet’

ChristenUnie MPs asked whether planned education cuts on Curaçao (a further 18% for special education on top of 12.5% wage cuts) follow from Dutch crisis-support conditions, and whether a proper impact analysis, equal funding and governance improvements are in place. The State Secretary replied that no cuts have been decided, the 12.5% wage reduction is a Curaçao-determined measure rather than a specific education demand, and a joint review of education governance and financing will precede any reforms.
The reforms in education proposed by the Netherlands will start with a thorough, joint review of the current state of education, which will also examine governance and financing.

De door Nederland voorgestelde hervormingen in het onderwijs starten met een gedegen, gezamenlijke doorlichting van de huidige staat van het onderwijs, waarbij ook gekeken zal worden naar de governance en de financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat vrouwelijke ambtenaren op de werkvloer worden gediscrimineerd en geïntimideerd

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about reports that young female civil servants face discrimination and intimidation at work, and whether the government will act on the Sjoerdsma motion and investigate pay gaps. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem as serious, said culture change and consistency are needed rather than more measures, promised exploration of further steps with other ministries, and said a pay-gap study is underway with results expected in autumn 2020.
However, I do not have insight into how much impact undesirable behaviour has on civil servants, because no quantitative research has been done on this.
Inzicht in hoeveel impact ongewenste omgangsvormen op ambtenaren hebben, heb ik echter niet omdat hiernaar geen kwantitatief onderzoek is gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Kuiken  over voorwaarden van noodsteun en de brief aan de Kamercommissie KR (11 augustus 2020) over het ontwerp consensus rijkswet houdende regels omtrent de instelling van de

Two MPs (Diertens, Kuiken) asked the Dutch State Secretary for Kingdom Relations about the conditions attached to emergency liquidity aid for Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten and the draft Rijkswet establishing the Caribbean Reform Entity (CHE), including its budget-law, autonomy and legitimacy implications. The answers were delivered by letter to the Chamber, referring to the state of affairs of the third aid tranche and the draft Rijkswet rather than answering each question individually.
Question 1: Have you taken note of reports of dissatisfaction over the emergency aid and the CHE?
Vraag 1 Heeft u kennisgenomen van berichten over de onvrede over de totstandkoming van de noodsteun en de CHE?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Koopmans en Middendorp over het bericht dat honderden Chinezen hun valse identiteit ‘herstelden’ bij gemeenten

MPs from the VVD asked the government about reports that hundreds of Chinese nationals 'restored' false identities through municipalities, covering detection, document verification, nationality consequences, limitation periods and sanctions. The State Secretary answered at length, describing existing procedures and safeguards, rejecting several proposed legal changes, and committing only to approach Chinese authorities if useful.
It is not possible to answer this question using data from the BRP.
Het is niet mogelijk om met behulp van gegevens uit de BRP deze vraag te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Slootweg over het bericht 'Verstrekken van leningen/kredieten zonder vergunning is strafbaar'

MPs Van Dam and Slootweg asked about a report that unlicensed high-interest lending in Bonaire is criminal, the trend in this crime, consumer protection, and whether enforcement bodies are adequately equipped amid COVID-related financial distress. The minister answered that the case was already prosecuted, outlined existing licensing and interest-rate rules, planned a law amendment, extra prosecutorial capacity and training, and noted that bank de-risking is being addressed through tighter AML rules.
In addition, the fight against undermining and financial-economic crime is also being intensified in the Caribbean Netherlands.
Daarnaast wordt de bestrijding van ondermijning en van financieel economische criminaliteit ook op Caribisch Nederland geïntensiveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over 'de rol van het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf bij door Covid-19 getroffen huurders’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary how the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, as a model landlord, treats tenants in Veenhuizen affected by COVID-19 measures, including the share of horeca tenants, whether rent is reduced or only deferred, and what other solutions exist. The state secretary answered that individual tenants received three-month rent deferrals and some received a second deferral, with repayment arrangements agreed case by case, and no rent reductions or waivers.
Where deferral of rent payment was requested, this was granted.
Waar uitstel van huurbetaling is gevraagd, is dat gehonoreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat er grootschalige handel plaatsvindt in privégegevens verkregen via callcenters

MP Van Raak asked the State Secretary of Interior about reports of large-scale trade in personal data obtained through corrupt call centre staff, whether such cases were known at tax, unemployment and student finance call centres, and about the share of temporary and external staff and salary levels there. The State Secretary answered that he knows of the report, that the tax, UWV and DUO agencies know of no such cases, and gave staffing and contract figures.
The Tax Helpline, UWV and DUO all report that no cases are known in which information was obtained in this way via the call centres of these government agencies.
Zowel de BelastingTelefoon, het UWV en DUO melden dat er geen gevallen bekend zijn dat op deze manier informatie is verkregen via callcenters van deze overheidsinstanties.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Raak over de kosten voor niet-digitale aanvragen bij gemeenten

An MP asked whether some municipalities charge far more (over 2.5 times) for non-digital applications of certificates than for digital ones, and whether the government would end these price gaps. The minister answered that municipal fees are a matter of municipal autonomy for the council to decide, and only noted that digital applications generally involve fewer costs.
Setting the tariffs for municipal services falls under municipal autonomy.
Het vaststellen van de tarieven van gemeentelijke dienstverlening behoort tot de gemeentelijke autonomie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de aanbesteding voor koffie-, drank- en snackmachines over de Rijksdienst Caribisch Nederland op Saba en Statia

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations why the Rijksdienst Caribisch Nederland prioritises tendering coffee, drink and snack machines for its staff on Saba and Statia during the COVID-19 crisis, and why it is split into four lots and not sourced from local suppliers. The State Secretary replied that the tender is a regular process, that it is local-first with local suppliers invited and the lots reflect what local suppliers can deliver, and he also outlined the emergency support packages for Caribbean Netherlands.
The tender is part of regular processes that serve the staff.
De aanbesteding is onderdeel van reguliere processen die ten dienste staan van het personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht 'Eindhoven gaat windhinder bij nieuwe woontorens te lijf'

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about wind nuisance from high-rise buildings, whether national rules exist, and whether Eindhoven's pre-testing approach and the lessons from Rijksvastgoedbedrijf incidents should be applied more broadly. The Minister answered that municipalities may regulate wind nuisance through their own rules and the NEN 8100 standard, that no national instruction rules exist for this aspect, and that the building-code wind-load requirements cover structural safety.
It is up to municipalities to include the prevention of wind nuisance in their municipal regulations.
Het is aan gemeenten om in hun gemeentelijke regelgeving het tegengaan van windhinder mee te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door van het lid Ronnes over het bericht ‘Coronavirus bedreigt ook bouw van nieuwe woningen’

MP Ronnes (CDA) asked the government about COVID-19 threats to housing construction, including whether an ambitious public-private plan could prevent job losses, whether the 75,000 homes per year target is achievable, NOW wage subsidy eligibility for construction firms, accelerating permits and maintenance, investment plans, NHG and tax measures, and a countercyclical role for housing corporations. The minister answered that a package of measures (doorbouwplan, expert teams, subsidy adjustments, and accelerated public investment) is being pursued, while disputing some premises and promising further measures around Prinsjesdag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs inzake 'Privacywaakhond AP verhuist naar historisch hart Den Haag om uit te kunnen breiden'

An MP asked the State Secretary of the Interior why the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) needs a 400-staff building in a costly central Hague location despite smaller staffing scenarios and understaffing, and asked about office norms, rental pricing and why the building had earlier been sold off. The State Secretary answered that the building is needed under the government's office masterplans, that an external study on the AP's tasks and resources is due in summer 2020, that surplus space would go to other state services, and that the rent was validated as market-conform by an external valuer.
A external study into balancing the AP's tasks and resources, promised to the House, is currently underway.
Op dit moment loopt er een aan uw Kamer toegezegd extern onderzoek naar het in evenwicht brengen van de taken en middelen van de AP
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over uitzetting van ongedocumenteerde Venezolanen

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that three undocumented Venezuelans on Bonaire were detained for deportation, and about safeguards given the risks in Venezuela. The government said it could not find the report, stressed that deportations are assessed under Article 3 ECHR, declined to comment on individual cases, and refused to monitor deportees after return.
As previously communicated to the House, I do not make statements about individual cases.
Zoals eerder aan de Kamer is bericht, doe ik geen uitspraken over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Leijten over overwerk in relatie tot toeslagen

Two SP MPs asked whether the government will protect care and other essential workers from losing childcare, rent and healthcare allowances because of overtime during the coronavirus crisis, and whether it will give certainty about having to repay allowances. The government answered that it cannot identify overtime effects on household income, that allowances must follow actual income, and that it will focus on communication and individual arrangements rather than a special scheme, apologising for the delay.

The cabinet will now primarily focus on communication to point citizens to the importance of reporting expected changes in household income for 2020 to the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances as soon as possible.

Het kabinet zal nu primair inzetten op communicatie om burgers te wijzen op het belang om verwachte wijzigingen in het huishoudinkomen van 2020 zo snel mogelijk door te geven aan de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over steun voor The Daily Herald op Sint Eustatius en Saba

An SP MP asked whether The Daily Herald, a Sint Maarten paper serving Sint Eustatius and Saba, should be supported during the coronavirus crisis, given its dependence for local news and its financial strain. The ministers answered that the government values local information provision, that a one-off emergency fund for Caribbean Netherlands media has been created, and that The Daily Herald will be able to claim a fixed amount per island.
Yes. The Daily Herald will be able to claim a fixed amount per island within its service area in the Caribbean Netherlands from the OCW-Caribbean Area department of the RCN.
Ja. The Daily Herald zal bij de afdeling OCW-Caribisch Gebied in RCN aanspraak kunnen maken op een vast bedrag per eiland binnen haar verzorgingsgebied binnen Caribisch Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over watertekort op Sint Eustatius

An MP asked the ministers about water shortages on Sint Eustatius, including how long the drinking water supply problems were known, whether pipeline materials were unsuitable, rationing information and storage, and financial relief during COVID-19. The government answered that subsidies and new pipelines and storage are being put in place, rationing has been eased, and water tariffs were set to zero for eight months, though it did not fully answer several historical questions.
From 8 June 2020 rationing has been eased and drinking water comes from the tap from 5 a.m. to 8 p.m.
Met ingang van 8 juni 2020 is de rantsoenering versoepeld en komt er van 5 uur ’s ochtends tot 20 uur ’s avonds drinkwater uit de kraan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Helvert over het rapport 'Situation Analysis on Children and Adolescents on Sint Maarten 2020'

MPs Van Dam and Van Helvert asked the State Secretary about the 2020 UNICEF situation analysis on children's rights on Sint Maarten, including early childhood care, foster care, and responsibility for child rights. The State Secretary answered that Sint Maarten is autonomous and primarily responsible, describing the shortfalls, joint Kingdom task force work, and a UNICEF-led project funded from a trust fund.
As an autonomous country, the government of Sint Maarten is responsible for the welfare of the population, including children and young people.
Als autonoom land is de regering van Sint Maarten verantwoordelijk voor het welzijn van de bevolking, inclusief kinderen en jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Van der Molen en Özütok over de coronacrisis en bewonersinitiatieven

Three MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether non-commercial citizen initiatives hit by COVID-19 revenue losses can access support schemes, and whether the ministry will coordinate emergency funding with municipalities and national funds. The minister answered that such bodies only qualify for some schemes if they count as enterprises, expressed willingness to consider case-by-case help with municipalities, but saw no need for a general additional support measure.
Beyond the cabinet-wide support package and support through the multi-year Democracy in Action programme, I see no reason at present to take additional initiative for a general support measure.

Naast het kabinetsbrede ondersteuningspakket en de ondersteuning via het meerjarige samenwerkingsprogramma Democratie in Actie zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding om op dit moment extra initiatief te nemen voor een algemene ondersteuningsmaatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Özütok en Van Raak over het bericht ‘Van 2 uitvaarten per week naar 2 per dag: uitvaartondernemer Marjan Damen draait overuren’

MPs asked the ministers about reports that funeral directors were overstretched by rising COVID-19 deaths, including capacity in mortuaries, the role of Defence and coordination, protective equipment, coffin supply and Islamic and Jewish burial rights. The minister answered that the sector is coping, that a coordination point and Defence support can be arranged if needed, that mortuary and coffin capacity is sufficient with contingency plans, and that burial options exist.
I indeed receive questions from the funeral sector about the Corona crisis, including about the cabinet's measures and RIVM guidelines.
Ik ontvang inderdaad vragen uit de uitvaartsector over de Corona-crisis, waaronder ook over de maatregelen van het kabinet en de richtlijnen van het RIVM.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Dik-Faber over de registratie van kinderen die kort na geboorte zijn overleden maar waarvan geen akte van overlijden is opgemaakt

Two Christian Union MPs asked how parents whose infant died shortly after birth, without any death certificate having been issued, can have this registered, and whether they must hire a lawyer to go to court. The minister confirmed a court procedure exists, that a lawyer is generally needed, and promised to map the problem with civil registrars and report in the second half of the year, and a bill is being prepared to allow registration of such children in the BRP.

I will, in consultation with the professional association of civil registrars, map the scale of the problem and on that basis examine whether there is reason to further assist parents, in addition to the existing options.

Ik zal in overleg met de beroepsvereniging van ambtenaren van de burgerlijke stand, de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Burgerzaken (NVVB), in kaart brengen wat de omvang van de problematiek is en op basis daarvan nagaan of er aanleiding is om -aanvullend op de bestaande mogelijkheden- ouders nader tegemoet te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over watertekorten op Sint Eustatius

An MP asked the state secretary about water shortages on Sint Eustatius, where residents get drinking water only in three-hour blocks, and why rationing was not prevented earlier. The minister acknowledged the rationing, attributed it to rising demand and a leaking transport pipeline, and promised three projects due by end 2020 and 2021 plus information via STUCO channels.
That is of course an undesirable situation.
Dat is uiteraard een onwenselijke situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over een dakloos gezin dat zich niet kan inschrijven bij gemeenten

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about a homeless family reportedly refused registration by several municipalities, and whether the government will enforce the duty to register people without a fixed address. The State Secretary confirmed municipalities have a legal duty to register under the BRP Act, said he was unaware of the specific case, announced a legislative clarification, and offered to look into the situation if the family contacts the RVIG.
Yes, municipalities have the duty to register under the BRP Act.
Ja, gemeenten hebben de plicht tot inschrijving conform de Wet BRP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de verkoop van het pand Noordeinde 64/64A te Den Haag

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Interior about the sale of Noordeinde 64/64A in The Hague to a bag maker below its later-valued price, asking about the valuations, secrecy, the sale process and integrity. The State Secretary answered that the sale followed the reallocation procedure at the valuation of Frisia, that the MVGM valuation was unknown to the seller, and that an ADR investigation is ongoing, with the reallocation procedure to be adjusted later.
I also wish to inform you that I am currently having an ADR investigation carried out into the sale of this property, the results of which I expect before the summer.
Tevens wil ik u in dit verband melden dat ik momenteel een ADR-onderzoek laat uitvoeren naar de verkoop van dit pand, waarvan ik voor de zomer de resultaten verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Eijs over de Gemeentelijke VerduurzamingsRegeling

MPs Van der Lee and Van der Eijs asked the Minister of Interior about the Gemeentelijke VerduurzamingsRegeling (GVR), a municipal home-insulation financing scheme, its legal soundness, and its role in the energy transition. The Minister answered that building-linked financing is planned for 2022, that the GVR's use of the municipal betterment levy is legally problematic and advised against, and that the Klimaatakkoord measures are the preferred route.
I therefore advise municipalities not to use the GVR, and advise them to point homeowners to the existing range of financing options.
Ik raad gemeenten daarom af gebruik te maken van de GVR, en raad hen aan woningeigenaren te wijzen op het bestaande palet van financieringsopties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Özütok over de beknotting van de persvrijheid op Aruba

MPs Van Raak and Özütok asked whether journalists on Aruba may be barred from working during the COVID-19 curfew, how a journalist was arrested, and whether aid conditions should protect press freedom. The State Secretary replied that journalists were not an exempt category under the curfew regulation, that three journalists were later allowed out during curfew, and that no aid conditions on press freedom were warranted.
No exemption ground has been included for journalists.
Voor journalisten is er geen uitzonderingsgrond opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over de glasplaten in het rijkskantoor Rijnstraat 8

MPs Nijboer and Kuiken asked the Minister of Interior about dangerous glass panels at the Rijnstraat 8 government building in The Hague, including whether staff and passers-by are safe and why the panels have not all been replaced. The State Secretary replied that a temporary management plan keeps people safe, that TNO found nickel-sulphide inclusions likely caused breakages but no full explanation, and that a decision on permanent replacement will follow on 2 June 2020 with the contractor PoortCentraal held to account.
I have held PoortCentraal to account for its contractual responsibility for a safe and undisturbed building, without additional management measures.
Ik heb PoortCentraal aangesproken op haar contractuele verantwoordelijkheid voor een veilig en ongestoord te gebruiken gebouw, zonder aanvullende beheersmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over installaties die het huishoudelijk verbruik van energie en drinkwater stevig kunnen reduceren

An MP asked the government about household water and energy saving installations (Hydraloop), including subsidies, payback periods and building-code uptake. The minister answered that no specific subsidy exists, preferred demonstration projects, gave only estimated payback figures, and promised to raise the theme with the new-build platform.
Furthermore, I will bring this theme to the attention of the platform for very energy-efficient new construction.
Voorts zal ik dit thema onder de aandacht brengen van het platform zeer energiezuinige nieuwbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de aanhoudende intimidatie van vrouwen buiten abortusklinieken

MP Ploumen asked ministers why intimidation of women outside abortion clinics continues despite earlier debates and motions, and what measures are being taken, including whether municipalities have sufficient powers, buffer zones, group bans, and criminal law changes. The government answers that it finds such intimidation undesirable but that demonstration rights are constitutionally protected, that municipalities report sufficient powers under the Wom, that criminal law can address misconduct, and that it will keep consulting municipalities and clinics and inform parliament annually without proposing legislative change.
Municipalities have indicated that they have sufficient powers to steer the demonstrations in the right direction.
Gemeenten hebben aangeven dat zij over genoeg bevoegdheden beschikken om de demonstraties in goede banen te leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de hoge kosten van rouwvervoer voor overleden coronapatiënten

An SP MP asked whether relatives of COVID-19 patients transferred to other hospitals for capacity reasons are charged high funeral transport costs, and whether the minister would press insurers or create a fund to cover them. The minister confirmed such costs are sometimes passed on, said insurers usually cover them and some funeral firms show leniency, and committed to having his ministry reimburse the extra costs for about thirty affected families, with the Ombudsman for Funeral Services as contact point.
I am willing to bear these extra costs and have obtained the agreement of the Ombudsman for Funeral Services to serve as contact point for any affected persons.
Ik ben bereid deze extra kosten te dragen en heb de Ombudsman voor het Uitvaartwezen bereid gevonden om als aanspreekpunt voor eventuele gedupeerden te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over “de coronacrisis en gevolgen voor ondernemers in de grensregio”

An MP asked the ministers whether cross-border entrepreneurs living in one country but registered as businesses in another face a precarious situation, when clarity on support will come, and whether residence or establishment requirements could be waived. The government answered that a ministerial regulation now lets such self-employed people claim living-cost or business-capital support in the country where they live or work, and that cross-border employers can use the NOW wage subsidy for Dutch-insured staff.

Therefore it is provided that the self-employed person who lives in the Netherlands and has their business or practises their self-employed profession outside the Netherlands can claim living-cost assistance, and vice versa.

Daarom wordt erin voorzien dat de zelfstandige die in Nederland woont en buiten Nederland zijn bedrijf heeft c.q. zijn zelfstandig beroep uitoefent, aanspraak kan maken op bijstand voor levensonderhoud en andersom
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Van Ojik , Van der Lee, Özütok, Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Westerveld over de coronacrisis

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about COVID-19 measures, including drug shortages, ventilator procurement, religious gatherings, Hungary's emergency law and EU funds, tourism in the Wadden area, sex workers' access to support, and charity funding. The government answered most questions substantively, declining to ban religious gatherings in non-public places for lack of legal basis and deferring some matters to EU or regional bodies.
The cabinet emphasises that there is currently no reason to ban religious gatherings of fewer than thirty people.
Het kabinet stelt voorop dat er thans geen aanleiding is voor een verbod op religieuze bijeenkomsten van minder dan dertig personen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Canada en Nederland testen trans-Atlantische vluchten zonder paspoort’

D66 MPs asked about a Canada-Netherlands pilot testing passport-free transatlantic travel via facial recognition and a digital traveller identity, including its origins, necessity, duration, privacy safeguards, data use and function creep. The Secretary of State answered that the pilot is voluntary, governed by a data protection impact assessment, will be evaluated and shared with parliament, but gave only general or deferred answers on several points and no firm plans for other countries.
The outcomes and evaluation of the test will be published and I will share them with your House.
De uitkomsten en evaluatie van de test worden gepubliceerd en deel ik met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over de dwangsom bij niet tijdig beslissen door de overheid

SP MPs asked whether the government should decide on time, whether the penalty-for-delay (dwangsom) regime still works as intended, why the Tax Administration has a different regime, and how much penalties were paid out in 2015-2019 per organisation. The minister agreed timely decisions matter, reported the regime has a preventive effect with some side effects, explained the Tax Administration's separate rules, and gave incomplete, non-uniform payment figures while noting the IND's sharp rise.
It turned out that these figures are not kept everywhere or in a uniform way.
Gebleken is dat deze cijfers niet overal en niet uniform worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Koerhuis over het bollenvloerdossier

MPs Ronnes and Koerhuis asked whether TNO's follow-up research on the bollenvloer (bulb floor) dossier would be finished before summer, and whether the inspection obligation for the highest consequence class could be postponed pending those results. The minister said the TNO research may narrow the obligation for lower classes, that the obligation for CC3 buildings is not postponed, and that she will share the proposal and results with the House later.
I will share the research proposal with you after I have received it and commissioned TNO to carry out the work.
Ik zal het onderzoeksvoorstel met u delen nadat ik het heb ontvangen en opdracht aan TNO heb verstrekt voor de uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Harbers over de uitspraken van netbeheerders over de energietransitie

MPs Koerhuis and Harbers asked ministers about grid operators' statements on the energy transition, including whether older homes can be heated without gas, reuse of gas infrastructure for green gas and hydrogen, and costs of replacing the gas network. The minister answered that the transition follows the 'feasible and affordable' principle, that municipalities will decide per neighbourhood with local analysis, and that cost estimates depend on future hydrogen availability, so no firm numbers on connections remaining are given yet.

Because there is still uncertainty about the availability of sustainable gas for now, and because a first picture of the future heat supply will only emerge from the Heat Transition Visions at the end of 2021, I cannot in this phase say how many homes will remain connected to the gas network.

Doordat er voorlopig nog onzekerheid bestaat over de beschikbaarheid van duurzaam gas en omdat pas eind 2021 uit de Transitievisies Warmte een eerste beeld ontstaat van hoe de toekomstige warmtevoorziening is samengesteld kan ik in deze fase geen uitspraken doen over het aantal woningen dat aangesloten blijft op het gasnet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van den Bosch over de berichten ‘Gemeentelijke belastingen voor huiseigenaren stijgen hard in 2020‘, en ‘Miljoenenstrop voor gemeenten door bedrijfjes die WOZ-waarde aanvechten‘

MPs Lodders and Van den Bosch asked whether local taxes rising in 2020, the cost of no-cure-no-pay WOZ objection firms to municipalities, and the fairness of the local tax system warrant reform. The Minister answered that a reform of local taxes is desirable, that a WODC study on WOZ objection costs is pending, and that the WOZ system is still sound, rejecting the claim that 40% of WOZ values are wrong.
A systemic reform of local taxes seems desirable to me indeed.
Een systeemherziening in de lokale belastingen lijkt mij inderdaad wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht dat het ministerie een rapport over falen van de ruimtelijke ordening tegen hield

An MP asked whether the Inspectorate for Living Environment and Transport (ILT) had been pressured by the Ministry of Interior to alter a critical report on spatial planning, and why the report was not published. The ministers answered that the ILT decided itself not to publish the report and that no pressure was exerted, that the ministry only asked questions on a draft annual report, and that the Aanwijzingen inzake de rijksinspecties will be evaluated with results by year-end.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Gemeentelijke websites vaak beperkt toegankelijk’

Two MPs asked the ministers about the accessibility of municipal websites for visually and hearing-impaired people, after a report that about two-thirds remain inaccessible. State Secretary Knops answered that a new legal duty to publish accessibility statements applies from 23 September 2020, that municipal councils and provinces handle supervision with existing legal tools, and that he will urge municipalities to improve, referring to the helpdesk and existing communication.
I will hold municipalities and other authorities to their responsibility.
Ik zal gemeenten en andere overheden aanspreken op hun verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Middendorp over het jaarverslag van de Kiesraad over 2019

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about the Electoral Council's 2019 annual report, including budget additions for replacing the election software (OSV), whether that work was completed, and the security findings and next steps for a new digital tool. The minister explained the budget composition, said the 2019 software work was completed, described a new OSV version commissioned for upcoming elections, and promised to inform the House before the summer recess of 2020 on vulnerabilities and tendering.
My planning aims to inform the House further on this before the 2020 summer recess, including on the timing of the tender.
Mijn planning is erop gericht om de Tweede Kamer daar voor het zomerreces van 2020 nader over te informeren, onder meer over het moment van aanbesteding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over 65 miljard euro aan schade door verzakkende huizen

An MP asked the ministers about reported 65 billion euro in damage from sinking houses, cost drivers, owner obligations, financing options, and whether the government is responsible for groundwater levels. The minister answered that costs depend on foundation area, that owners are responsible for their own foundations with some municipal and national support, that the 65 billion figure rests on uncertain assumptions, and that the government is monitoring the problem and informing municipalities.
Almost all factors involved in foundation problems are uncertain.
Bijna alle factoren die een rol spelen bij funderingsproblematiek zijn onzeker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over de voorbereidingen op de implementatie van de Wet Kwaliteitsborging voor het Bouwen

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers about preparations for implementing the Wet Kwaliteitsborging voor het Bouwen, including pilot projects, the 10% pilot target, information to municipalities, the planned 1 January 2021 start date and the number of certified quality assessors. The minister answered that the 2021 date can no longer be met because of the delay to the Omgevingswet, that a final start date will be communicated before summer 2020, and that pilots are progressing with a shortfall against the 10% target.
My aim is to inform the House of Representatives of a definitive start date before summer 2020.
Mijn streven is om uw Kamer vóór de zomer van 2020 te informeren over een definitieve invoeringsdatum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Graaf over een werkbezoek aan Groningen op maandag 2 maart 2020

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Graaf asked the ministers about differing reinforcement regimes in Overschild, slow reinforcement advice, cost recovery from NAM, small-field gas damage claims, vacant housing, and Delfzijl evacuations. Minister Ollongren answered that regime differences are unavoidable given evolving policy, that the new law gives residents a choice of control, and that the damage protocol and Commission should be operational by 1 July 2020, while largely deferring details to other bodies.
The bill does not change agreements made within the implementation of the various batches.
Het wetsvoorstel brengt geen wijzigingen aan in afspraken die in het kader van uitvoering van de verschillende batches zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het wetsvoorstel Samenvoeging van de gemeenten Appingedam, Delfzijl en Loppersum (Kamerstuk 35344)

An MP from 50PLUS asked whether the COVID-19 lockdown would hamper preparations for the November 2020 municipal elections in the new Eemsdelta municipality, and whether elections could be postponed. The minister said there is currently no reason to expect serious problems, that postponement is legally possible by the provincial executive for weighty reasons, and that further postponement would require a specific statutory regulation.

However, I will maintain contact with the municipalities concerned in the coming months if restrictive COVID-19 measures remain in force and possible bottlenecks in organising the (election) process need to be addressed.

Ik zal evenwel in de komende maanden contact onderhouden met de betrokken gemeenten indien beperkende maatregelen rond het COVID-19 virus van kracht blijven en mogelijke knelpunten moeten worden geadresseerd in de organisatie van het (verkiezings)proces.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Wilders, Buitenweg, Futselaar, Kuiken, Van der Graaf, Ouwehand, Van Otterloo, Azarkan, Stoffer, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de mogelijke inzet van apps in het ka

Thirteen MPs asked the ministers about the possible use of contact-tracing apps in the COVID-19 'test, trace and stay home' policy, covering their purpose, effectiveness, privacy, source code, cybersecurity and accessibility. The government answered by referring to its separate COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249) rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van den Hul, Nijboer en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party asked the government about measures during the coronavirus crisis across care, education, housing, debt, and the Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered most questions by referring to earlier letters, while giving substantive answers on mantelzorg communication, eviction restrictions, and utility disconnection protections.
Because there may be obvious reasons for eviction, such as criminal activity or extreme nuisance, the cabinet is not willing to impose a moratorium.
Omdat er evidente redenen kunnen zijn om tot huisuitzetting over te gaan, zoals criminele activiteiten of extreme overlast, is het kabinet niet bereid om tot een moratorium over te gaan.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Krol, Sazias, Van Brenk en Van Otterloo over alle berichtgeving omtrent het coronavirus

Four 50PLUS MPs asked a range of questions about COVID-19 coverage, care for the elderly and family carers, unemployment benefits, the economy and EU financing, and emergency powers and enforcement. The government answered most questions substantively, commits to several concrete steps, and declines to say whether a state of emergency will be declared, pointing instead to ordinary crisis structures.
The cabinet took a decision on this on Tuesday 31 March.
Het kabinet heeft hier op dinsdag 31 maart jl. een besluit over genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Ronnes over zonnepanelen op sociale huurwoningen

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers how to rapidly expand solar panels on social rental housing, including a proposal from Urgenda and housing corporations to use part of the landlord levy in 2020. The government answered that the levy cannot be used this way, pointed to SDE+/SDE++ subsidies and a planned bill on corporations' energy generation, and said it would present a further package to meet the Urgenda ruling.
I am positive about the initiative of Urgenda and housing corporations to expand the number of solar panels on roofs.
Ik sta positief tegenover het initiatief van Urgenda en woningcorporaties om het aantallen zonnepanelen op daken uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Van der Graaf over het weigeren door Knab van religieuze organisaties als zakelijke klant

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked whether Knab's policy of refusing religious organisations as business clients complies with Dutch and European anti-discrimination and anti-money-laundering rules, and what can be done for those affected. The government answered that the Wwft does not allow refusing a whole category of clients without an individual risk assessment, that assessing discrimination is not for the cabinet, and that affected organisations can use the College voor de Rechten van de Mens, anti-discrimination bodies, courts or Kifid.
Under the Wwft, banks are not permitted to refuse an entire type of organisation as a client across the board.
Het is banken op grond van de Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme (Wwft) niet toegestaan om een bepaald type organisatie integraal als klant te weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Geurts en Von Martels over schade aan mestkelders, ventilatiekanalen en funderingen veroorzaakt door mijnbouwactiviteiten in Groningen

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers whether agricultural damage to manure cellars, ventilation shafts and foundations from Groningen gas extraction had been wrongly excluded from reinforcement and damage handling by NAM, CVW and the TCMG, and how farmers are heard and supported.
