The government answered that the TCMG handles new damage claims, uses civil liability law with the statutory presumption of causation, is consulting an expert panel on manure cellar damage due around June 2020, and is working with the Province on a programmatic approach for farmers.
The panel's advice is expected to be ready around mid-June 2020.
Naar verwachting is het advies van het panel medio juni 2020 gereed.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de aardbevingen van 22 en 23 maart ten tijde van corona

An MP asked ministers about earthquakes in Groningen on 22-23 March 2020 during the coronavirus lockdown, including whether residents can safely stay home, whether monitoring thresholds were exceeded, the TCMG's reduced evening availability, relocation to temporary housing, speeding up reinforcement, and asking Shell/NAM for extra money. The ministers answered that no monitoring thresholds were exceeded, that TCMG adjusted opening hours and piloted remote damage inspections while keeping acute-unsafe-situation handling, that reinforcement is being accelerated as gas extraction falls, and that all reinforcement costs are borne by NAM and its shareholders.
I have the authority to intervene in extraction at any time if the safety situation gives cause for it.
Ik heb de bevoegdheid om te allen tijde in de winning in te grijpen als de veiligheidssituatie daar aanleiding toe geeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat Defensie klimaatactivisme en werken als reservist onverenigbaar vindt

An MP asked whether Defence considers climate activism incompatible with serving as a reservist, and whether this restricts the right to demonstrate. The government answers that climate activism is not in principle incompatible with reservist service, that the right to demonstrate applies to military personnel subject to limits in the Wet ambtenaren Defensie, and that individual cases cannot be discussed publicly.
Taking action for a liveable planet is in principle not assessed by Defence as incompatible with working as a reservist.
Actie voeren voor een leefbare aarde wordt bij Defensie in beginsel niet als onverenigbaar met het werken als reservist beoordeeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag, Beckerman en Agnes Mulder over het rapport van de Noordelijke Rekenkamer ‘Herverdeling onder Hoogspanning, een onderzoek naar de verdeling naar de kosten en baten rondom wind- en

MPs asked the ministers about the Northern Audit Office report on how costs and benefits of wind and solar parks are distributed, including whether provinces can enforce compensation for residents and whether uniform national rules are needed. The minister said financial participation is important, that provinces' legal powers are being mapped with the interbestuurlijk level and will be reported after summer 2020, and that he opposes uniform national legal norms because projects differ.
Within interbestuurlijk consultation, it is currently being mapped which legal possibilities and powers decentralised governments have to set requirements on financial participation.
Binnen interbestuurlijk verband wordt momenteel in kaart gebracht welke juridische mogelijkheden/bevoegdheden decentrale overheden hebben om eisen te stellen aan financiële participatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over agrarische panden

MPs Middendorp and Lodders asked about the poor condition of 164 state-owned farmsteads leased to tenant farmers, the timing of repairs, the Grondkamer rent-review process and a recent ruling, and the strategic status of the farms. The ministers answered that repairs will start once funds are freed in the spring budget process (estimated at about 24 million euro), that 153 farms are strategic, and that the rent norms remain adequate, while declining to draw conclusions for other tenants from the ruling.
Once the funds become available, further repair work will be started as quickly as possible.
Na het beschikbaar komen van de middelen wordt zo snel mogelijk gestart met de verdere herstelwerkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Bosman over het bericht ‘Lagere ticketprijzen tussen eilanden laten nog wel even op zich wachten’

MPs Kuiken and Bosman asked why no concrete measures had been taken on the expert group's advice to partly compensate inter-island ticket prices in the Caribbean Netherlands, and when measures would follow. The government answered that a proposal is being developed with the Caribbean islands and ministries, to be tested for legal, financial and organisational feasibility, but it cannot yet give a timeline.
Therefore, at this stage it cannot yet be stated within what timeframe measures can be taken.
Er kan daarom in dit stadium nog niet aangegeven worden binnen welke termijn er maatregelen genomen kunnen worden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over strengere regulering en betere certificering van zowel installateurs als installatiebedrijven met betrekking tot kleinschalige duurzame energie installaties

MP Van der Lee asked the ministers whether stricter regulation and certification of installers and installation firms for small-scale renewable energy systems is needed, citing fire problems with pellet stoves and poor installations. The minister replied that installer quality is a shared concern, that EZK required certified installers and product standards under ISDE, that no broadly supported industry proposal emerged, and promised talks with industry and a letter to the House afterwards.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over de belastingen voor woningcorporaties die Vestia willen helpen

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about tax and policy measures for housing corporations, including the Vestia rescue, the transfer of Vestia homes to other corporations, property transfer tax exemptions and the Tweebosbuurt case. The minister answered that a Vestia housing transfer study is pending, that abolishing the rental levy only for corporations is not an option, and declined to comment on several local or ongoing legal matters.
This concerns a local matter on which Vestia must weigh considerations in consultation with the municipality.
Het betreft hier een lokale aangelegenheid waarover Vestia in samenspraak met de gemeente een afweging moet maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Bizarre wending in bollenvloeren-dossier: inspectie en versterking onnodig’

MPs Ronnes and Koerhuis asked whether buildings with suspect hollow-core slabs would escape inspection and whether a Cobouw report on a reversal in policy was accurate. Minister Knops answered that an inspection duty for the highest-consequence buildings takes effect in April 2020, that the report was incorrect and there is no change of course, and that TNO will study a possible narrowing of later phases.
That is not correct. I refer to my answers to question 2 and question 4.
Dit klopt niet. Ik verwijs daarbij naar mijn antwoord op vraag 2 en vraag 4.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Sneller over de lokale noodverordeningen in verband met de bestrijding van het coronavirus

Two MPs (D66) asked the ministers about the legal basis, decision-making, democratic oversight and publication of local COVID-19 emergency ordinances, and about Latvia's suspension of ECHR rights. The minister acknowledged the omitted legal basis, described the regional chairs' emergency ordinances and the accountability route via municipal councils, and said current measures fit within ECHR limitation clauses.
Omitting the legal basis was an oversight.
Het niet vermelden van de wettelijke grondslag was een omissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het weigeren van de rechtbank Zeeland-West-Brabant locatie Breda om gedenkplaten te plaatsen

MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked why the Zeeland-West-Brabant court (Breda location) refuses to install commemorative plaques for Jewish judges murdered in WWII, as exist in Amsterdam and The Hague. The Minister replied that the judiciary independently decides on such memorials, that the court found no evidence of Jewish staff victims in its archives, and that the Minister will not engage the court.
The judiciary has the authority to independently decide whether or not to place a memorial.
De Rechtspraak heeft de bevoegdheid om zelfstandig te beslissen over het al dan niet plaatsen van een gedenkteken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het fysiek bijwonen van Provinciale Statenvergaderingen gedurende de coronacrisis

Baudet asked the Minister of BZK about the Flevoland commissioner's call for MPs to attend a physical Provincial States meeting during the COVID-19 crisis, including the reappointment of the commissioner, and whether digital decision-making should be enabled. The minister said decentral bodies should meet physically only when strictly necessary, that provincial states decide for themselves, and that a temporary legal provision for digital decision-making would be proposed to Parliament.
Ultimately, the decision whether or not to meet rests with the provincial states, as a democratically elected body, and not with the commissioner of the King or the Minister of BZK.
Uiteindelijk is de beslissing om al dan niet te vergaderen aan provinciale staten, als democratisch gekozen orgaan, en niet aan de commissaris van de Koning of de Minister van BZK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over digitale besluitvorming in gemeenten en provincies

MP Kuiken asked whether councils and provincial assemblies should be allowed to take legally valid decisions digitally during the COVID-19 crisis, and whether legislation would be proposed. The minister said physical meetings are the default, digital deliberation is possible but voting requires a physical meeting, and a temporary statutory exception for digital council decision-making is being prepared and will be sent to parliament soon.
However, I am of the view that a temporary exception must be made in these exceptional circumstances, provided that the public nature of council meetings is preserved
Ik ben echter van mening dat daar in deze uitzonderlijke omstandigheden een tijdelijke uitzondering op moet komen, mits de openbaarheid van raadsvergaderingen behouden blijft
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de erkenning van een Nederlands huwelijk in het buitenland

An MP asked whether a marriage converted from a registered partnership is recognised abroad, and how Dutch citizens abroad can obtain an effective marriage without a cumbersome dissolution procedure. The minister confirmed that some countries do not recognise such conversions, explained that a Dutch-law conversion is available and that an international marriage extract can be requested, and promised to improve public information and ask the civil registry commission for guidance.
I will ask the NVvB whether all municipalities are willing to place this link on their websites.
Ik zal bij de NVvB vragen of alle gemeenten deze link op hun website willen plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Dik-Faber en Harbers over de organisatie van de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen

Four MPs asked the Minister about reported internal chaos at the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG), its absorption of the CVW, staff turnover and whether this threatens reinforcement work. The Minister denied chaos, called reorganisation necessary, said public execution is now with the NCG and the TCMG/IMG handles compensation, and promised further attention to staff retention and continued contact.
The image that there would be chaos, as the headline above the cited report suggests, I do not recognise.
Het beeld dat er sprake zou zijn van chaos, zoals de kop boven het aangehaalde bericht suggereert, herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de besteding van de gelden van het Nationaal Programma Groningen (NPG)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about how funds from the Nationaal Programma Groningen (NPG) are being spent, including the share already allocated, the costs of programme management, and links to Shell and the New Energy Coalition. The Minister answered most questions, explaining the allocation process, the six project conditions, participation channels, and that several requested breakdowns are not yet available.
At this moment it is not yet possible to state precisely how much of the 1,150 million euros goes to 'making plans' or 'starting projects'.
Het is op dit moment nog niet mogelijk om al precies aan te geven hoeveel van de 1.150 euro miljoen gaat naar het «maken van plannen» of het «opstarten van projecten».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Kops over anti-Israëlstraatnaamborden in Eindhoven

PVV MPs Wilders and Kops asked whether street-name signs in Eindhoven describing Israeli places as 'in Palestine' are factually wrong, and whether the municipality should be forced to replace them promptly. Minister Knops agreed the descriptions are incorrect, said the municipality now plans to replace the signs this spring and has already updated the register, and rejected the claim that the signs reflect anti-Israel policy.
The municipality is thereby acting in accordance with its 2014 commitments.
Daarmee handelt de gemeente conform de toezeggingen uit 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema, Smeulders, Westerveld en Özütok over het coronavirus (COVID-19)

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about its whole-of-government approach to COVID-19, equipment and ICU capacity, school decisions, Caribbean Netherlands coordination, economic measures like part-time unemployment benefit, accessibility of public communication, and intensified publicity. The minister answered that broad measures are in place, outlined capacity expansions and procurement steps, and committed to letters on decision-making and a school decision framework.
During the debate of Thursday 5 March I committed to inform you about this by letter.
Ik heb tijdens het debat van donderdag 5 maart toegezegd u hierover per brief te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht 'Computer zegt nee. Hoe Saskia twintig jaar vastliep in het systeem'

An SP MP asked ministers about a case in which a citizen was wrongly treated by government bodies over many years and whether she would be compensated and apologised to. The Minister of the Interior replied that a last attempt at a total solution failed, that the police acknowledged fault and apologised, and that he expressed regret in person; no concrete compensation offer was disclosed, citing privacy.
Partly because of the privacy of the person concerned, I am not free to disclose the amount of damages claimed by her and the proposal offered to her.
Het staat mij, mede gelet op de privacy van betrokkene, niet vrij om mededelingen te doen over de omvang van de door mevrouw gevorderde schade en het aan haar aangeboden voorstel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Van ‘t Wout over het bericht ‘Einde van lintje voor brandweerlieden zorgt voor bittere smaak: “wij zetten een stap naar voren als anderen er een terug doen.”’

MPs Van der Graaf and Van 't Wout asked whether the end of automatic honours for long-serving volunteer firefighters, and the government's refusal to reconsider, undermines recruitment and retention, and whether the Royal Chancery would be consulted. The minister defended the decision, said volunteer firefighters can still be honoured on other grounds and that alternative brigade medals will be officially recognised this year.
I therefore see no reason to enter into discussion about this with the Chancery.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om hierover in gesprek te treden met de Kanselarij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over de zorgwekkende situatie bij een belangrijke IT-dienstverlener van de Nederlandse overheid

MP Martin Bosma asked the Minister of Interior whether the reported financial losses at Centric, a major IT supplier to the Dutch government, pose a serious risk and what the impact of a possible bankruptcy would be. The minister replied that the situation is not considered worrying since Centric corrected its reporting and showed a profit for 2018, that the impact of a bankruptcy lies with the municipalities concerned, and that taking emergency measures is not opportune at this time.
Responsibility for the impact of a possible bankruptcy of a supplier to a municipality lies with the specific municipality that does business with this supplier.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de impact van een mogelijk faillissement van een leverancier aan een gemeente ligt bij de specifieke gemeente die zaken doet met deze leverancier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Contractors lay off 80 workers at Statia’s oil storage terminal’

Mr Van Dam (CDA) asked about reports that around 80 contract workers were laid off at the Statia oil terminal, its effect on the island's economy, and the ILT's enforcement against GTIS. The government answered that about 115 people were dismissed mostly by subcontractors for cost reasons, that the ILT started enforcement over late tank inspections and fire-fighting systems, and that the government is developing an economic strategy for the island.
Statistics Netherlands (CBS) cannot provide specific figures on GTIS for reasons of confidentiality.
Het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) kan om redenen van vertrouwelijkheid geen specifieke cijfers over GTIS geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Diertens over het bericht ‘Vreemdelingenadvocaten: ‘Curaçao zet Venezolanen collectief uit’

MPs Groothuizen and Diertens asked about reports that Curaçao collectively expelled Venezuelans and about detention conditions in the immigration barracks on Curaçao, including whether the Kingdom should intervene. The government answered that Curaçao is responsible for detention conditions, that Netherlands supports improvements, and that Kingdom intervention is a last resort, while promising continued monitoring and not committing to an independent visit.
Intervention by the Kingdom under the Charter is a last resort.
Ingrijpen door het Koninkrijk op grond van het Statuut is een laatste redmiddel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman en lid Hijink over het bericht dat een man in hongerstaking gaat

MPs Beckerman and Hijink asked the government how it will help Dhani Hoekstra, who announced a hunger strike over Groningen earthquake damage, and what it will do for people suffering psychological distress from gas extraction. The minister said the case is handled by responsible bodies, declined to comment on the individual case, and outlined gas-extraction phase-out, extra funding for social-emotional support and mental health care, without giving a count of users.
Beyond that, I will not comment on this individual case.
Voor het overige doe ik geen uitlatingen over deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over gedetineerde asielzoekers in hongerstaking op Curaçao

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about twelve Venezuelan asylum seekers on hunger strike in immigration detention on Curaçao, their medical care, whether their long detention among convicts breaches human rights, and whether the Netherlands will press Curaçao and offer help. The minister answered that Curaçao reports the group has received medical care and is in good health, that Curaçao and its judiciary are responsible for assessing detention conditions and lawfulness, and that the Netherlands supports Curaçao on the migration chain and detention conditions.

It is up to the authorities and the judiciary of Curaçao to assess, in any cases that may arise, the extent to which the conditions of detained foreigners conflict with national and/or international obligations.

Het is aan de autoriteiten en de rechterlijke macht van Curaçao om in eventueel voorkomende gevallen te beoordelen in hoeverre de omstandigheden van vreemdelingen in bewaring op gespannen voet staan met nationale en/of internationale verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over 70 branden met pelletkachels, d.d 21 december 2019

An MP asked about 70 fire incidents involving pellet stoves in northern provinces and about the causes, data and effect of ending the subsidy. The minister answered that no national fire data exist, that most incidents were overheating or smoke rather than house fires, and agreed to consult the stove trade about installer quality.
Inquiries with Brandweer Nederland revealed that no national data on fires involving pellet stoves are kept.
Uit navraag bij Brandweer Nederland is gebleken dat er geen landelijke gegevens van branden met pelletkachels worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de Rotterdamse klimaatplannen

An MP from the PVV asks the ministers whether Rotterdam's plan to remove gas from 100,000 homes and halve CO2 emissions in ten years is feasible, whether municipalities may force homeowners off gas, what climate effect the Rotterdam plans achieve, and whether the Climate Agreement should be scrapped. The minister rejects the criticism, citing the Climate Agreement, a DCMR estimate of 0.15 megaton CO2 reduction from Rotterdam's building measures by 2030, and voluntary choices for residents, and refuses to withdraw the plans.
No one is forced to participate.
Niemand wordt gedwongen mee te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat KPMG en Deloitte schikken met Vestia

An MP asked whether KPMG and Deloitte were settling with housing corporation Vestia for 84 million euro against a 2.7 billion euro loss, what the status of open claims against banks was, and whether Vestia must repay the 675 million euro of public support. The minister declined to share settlement status, said 2019 accounts are not yet available, and pointed to a 2022 review of whether the support converts to a gift or must be repaid.
Since this would not benefit the course of negotiations between these parties, the Authority for Housing Corporations (Aw) states that no statements can be made about this.
Aangezien dit het verloop van de onderhandelingen tussen deze partijen niet ten goede komt, geeft de Autoriteit woningcorporaties (Aw) aan dat hier geen mededelingen over gedaan kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gedupeerde huizenkopers in Brielle

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about home buyers in Brielle left unprotected after the failed builder guarantee firm Betaal Garant Nederland, covering municipal help, the bankruptcy curator's claims, consumer information duties under the Wkb, criminal prosecution of its director, and DNB's supervisory response. The Minister answered that the municipality of Brielle is providing support, that the Wkb information duty is being examined, and that DNB handles signals under confidentiality limits, without committing to a mandatory guarantee.
Because of supervisory confidentiality, DNB can only address its handling of signals in general terms.
DNB kan vanwege de toezichtvertrouwelijkheid alleen ingaan op de aanpak van signalen in het algemeen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp, Lodders en Koerhuis over het inschrijven in de BRP.

MPs Middendorp, Lodders and Koerhuis asked the government about registration in the Basisregistratie Personen (BRP), including cases where new residents are registered without the main tenant's consent and suffer consequences. Minister Knops answered that he opposes mandatory prior verification and mandatory consent from existing residents, points to municipal responsibility and ongoing work on a BRP change and complaints point, and promises a progress letter in spring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over een ‘Decision on interim measure’ van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens

An MP asked the Interior and Justice ministers about a European Court of Human Rights interim measure concerning a suspect held beyond 10 days in the Philipsburg police cells, and about detention conditions on Sint Maarten. The minister answered that the detainee was transferred to Point Blanche prison, that Sint Maarten lacks prison capacity and has adjusted its procedure, and that the Netherlands is concerned but Sint Maarten must act, with container cells offered as support.
It is up to Sint Maarten to take measures to improve the situation.
Het is aan Sint Maarten om maatregelen te nemen om de situatie te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het verplichte gebruik van eHerkenning bij de Belastingdienst

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked why the Tax Administration makes eHerkenning (level 3, a private authentication means) mandatory for payroll and corporation tax returns from 1 January 2020, questioning its legal basis, communication, EU comparisons, liability, impact assessment and the relation to the Digital Government Act. The state secretary answered that article 2:15 Awb and the AWR/Regeling EBV provide the basis, that the requirement follows from GDPR security duties, and that notice was given by letter and website, while acknowledging the regulation's annex needed correcting and that no formal impact assessment was made.
This will be corrected in the short term by means of a ministerial regulation with retroactive effect to 1 January 2020.
Dit zal op korte termijn door middel van een ministeriële regeling met terugwerkende kracht tot 1 januari 2020 rechtgezet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Middendorp en Aartsen over de eHerkenning en het artikel ‘MKB en VNO-NCW: gedupeerden nieuw aangiftesysteem compenseren’

MPs Lodders, Middendorp and Aartsen (VVD) asked the Finance, Interior and Economic Affairs ministers about internal resistance at the Tax Administration to eHerkenning, its costs, the fate of about 60,000 businesses lacking a suitable login, and whether small firms can keep filing free. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered that concerns were addressed, that about 540 organisations cannot obtain eHerkenning, that proactive deadline extensions and an older portal for VAT remain, and that a further letter on support for small firms would follow.
The Tax Administration proactively grants extensions to employer-liable businesses that are legal entities and last filed via the old business portal.

De Belastingdienst verleent proactief uitstel voor ondernemers die aangifteplichtig zijn voor de loonheffingen, rechtspersoon zijn en hun laatst ingediende aangifte hebben gedaan via het oude ondernemersportaal van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de wijze waarop een vreedzame demonstratie op Schiphol werd beëindigd en het verschil met de boerendemonstraties

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked why a peaceful Greenpeace demonstration at Schiphol on 14 December 2019 was ended forcefully, with arrests and a 48-hour area ban, and why it was treated differently from farmers' protests and a KLM concert. The government answered that the mayor of Haarlemmermeer is responsible for demonstration management and emergency orders, that the matter is subject to council accountability and possible court review, and that it cannot judge the mayor's conduct.
It is not for me to intervene in that.
Het is niet aan mij om daarin te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over het niet verstrekken van een volmacht door de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) voor betalingen van versterkingsprojecten

An SP MP asked why residents in Groningen could not sign depot agreements for reinforcement works after NAM's role ended on 1 January 2020, who holds the authority, and how residents could start in January. The Minister answered that no work was blocked, that the NCG now signs depot agreements in place of NAM, and that ongoing cases continue under the NCG, with advance payments used in the interim.
As a result, since 1 January 2020 it is the NCG, not NAM, that concludes the depot agreements for reinforcement with residents.
Het gevolg van die handeling is dat sinds 1 januari 2020 niet NAM maar de NCG de depotovereenkomsten voor de versterking aangaat met de bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over huurders die in Appingedam vanuit een onveilig huis in een huis met gebreken komen

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about tenants in the Groningen earthquake area who moved into energy-neutral homes in Appingedam still suffering mould, defects and heat-pump failures, and about Woongroep Marenland refusing mediation and heading to court. The Minister answered that the corporation reports no mould problems, that complaints are being addressed, and that he is convening a 'corporatietafel' with housing corporations, municipalities and tenant groups, while noting the tenant-law framework and legal aid options.
I keep a finger on the pulse.
Ik houd een vinger aan de pols.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Wethouder: ‘niet eens met Talis over energietransitie’’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a municipal alderman's objection to a housing corporation renovating homes while keeping gas connections, and about whether corporations are refusing aardgasvrij renovations and are aware of subsidies. The minister answered that renovation rules allow gas reconnection, that gemeenten have sufficient legal tools to steer new gas connections, and that corporations are reached via subsidy schemes and information campaigns.
Given the options that article 10(7) of the Gas Act provides, in my view municipalities have sufficient options to steer where no new gas connections may be made.
Door de mogelijkheden die artikel 10 lid 7 van de Gaswet biedt, hebben gemeenten naar mijn mening voldoende mogelijkheden om te sturen waar geen nieuwe gasaansluitingen mogen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de vertraging van de wet Versterken

An MP asked why the Versterken (reinforcement) bill for Groningen earthquake-damaged homes was delayed, including the short two-week internet consultation and when it would reach the Council of State. The minister replied that the bill was put to consultation on 6 November, the short period was chosen to speed things up after prior consultation with stakeholders, the bill is expected to go to the Council of State that month, and the timetable depends on close coordination with the region.
The aim is to submit the bill to the Council of State for advice this month.
Het streven is om het wetsvoorstel nog deze maand ter advisering voor te leggen aan de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Raak over het meewerken van Aruba Airlines aan de uitzetting van dissidenten uit Cuba

An MP asked whether Aruba Airlines helped Cuba deport dissidents, and whether the Dutch government knew and could have approved it. The minister answered that aviation is an Aruban matter, the airline denies knowingly facilitating forced deportation, Aruba's government was not informed beforehand, and the Kingdom countries could adopt rules if they wish.
Aviation is a matter for Aruba.
Luchtvaart is een aangelegenheid van Aruba.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over het bericht dat een Chinese geneticus van het Erasmus MC werkt voor de Chinese politie

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked the government about reports that a Chinese geneticist at Erasmus MC worked for the Chinese police, and what the government had done in response, including contacts with China, funding, screening of Chinese researchers and university awareness. The minister answered that the disputed face-shape research was separate from the Rotterdam height study, was not funded by Erasmus MC or the EU, that the Chinese embassy was warned about misuse of knowledge, and that the cabinet is examining broader knowledge-security measures.

I cannot give detailed statements on what information is or is not known to the intelligence and security services, because this would reveal the current knowledge level, modus operandi and/or sources of the services.

Ik kan geen gedetailleerde uitspraken doen over welke informatie al dan niet bekend is bij de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten omdat dit inzicht geeft in het actuele kennisniveau, de modus operandi en/of bronnen van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Den Bosch over het bericht ‘gemeentelijke belastingen voor huiseigenaren stijgen hard in 2020’

Two VVD MPs asked whether rising local property taxes (OZB, waste and water levies) in 2020 undermine purchasing power, why the macro-norm was abolished, and what the new municipal benchmark will achieve. The minister answered that local lasten developments await the COELO atlas, that local councils decide tax increases democratically, and that benchmarking informs local debate, while rejecting new proposals for now.
It is up to the municipalities themselves to determine why the increase is necessary.
Het is aan gemeenten zelf om te bepalen waarom de stijging noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Computer zegt nee. Hoe Saskia twintig jaar vastliep in het systeem'

MPs Alkaya and Van Dijk asked why a woman whose car was stolen in 1998 was pursued for 20 years by the CJIB and tax authorities over insurance and road tax fines, and how she would be helped. The minister answered that the RDW only deregistered the car in 2011, that registry rules were recently relaxed to allow backdating, that coordination has been taken on personally, and that a central reporting point for registry errors will be set up.
I have looked further into this situation, which is a very unpleasant one for the woman, which has now been going on for 20 years.
Ik heb me nader in deze situatie verdiept, waar sprake is van een zeer vervelende situatie voor mevrouw, die inmiddels al 20 jaar loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Bosman over het bericht ‘Koraal Curaçao vernield door olieplatform’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether they knew of reports that an oil platform damaged coral reef off Curaçao, and about the extent of damage, responsibility, recovery and prevention. The government acknowledged the irreversible damage, said Curaçao's ministry is investigating the cause, noted coral planting is possible but limited, and stated Curaçao itself is responsible for shipping safety rules.
Curaçao is itself responsible for making and enforcing regulations on shipping safety to prevent such incidents.
Curaçao is zelf verantwoordelijk voor het maken en handhaven van voorschriften met betrekking tot de scheepvaartveiligheid om dergelijke incidenten te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de implementatie van de Wet kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen

MP Nijboer asked the Minister of the Interior about press reports suggesting the Wet kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen is misunderstood, the municipal role under it, whether municipalities need a preventive risk analysis, who is responsible for checking compliance, and progress on an motion on approved technical solutions. The Minister rejects the misunderstanding claim, explains the division of responsibilities between builder, quality assurer, the toelatingsorganisatie and municipalities, and reports on stakeholder talks about Erkende Technische Toepassingen.
On the basis of this file the municipality can assess the extent to which all statutory requirements have been met.
De gemeente kan op basis van dit dossier beoordelen in hoeverre aan alle wettelijke vereisten is voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat huurders in Ten Post de versterking “on hold” willen zetten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about tenants in Ten Post who want reinforcement works paused, including fears of moving, rent increases, and a threatened legal route to end leases if 70% did not sign the social plan. The Minister answered that the corporation and municipality are engaging with tenants, that tenants will be involved in planning, and that the corporation says court enforcement of the 70% norm is not on the table.
Wierden en Borgen has stated that enforcing the 70% norm for signing the social plan through the courts is not an issue.
Wierden en Borgen heeft aangegeven dat de 70%-norm voor het tekenen van het sociaal plan via de rechter afdwingen niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Dam, Bosman, Diertens, Van der Graaf, Van Raak, Kuiken, Krol, Kuzu en Bisschop over de aanleg van wegen op Sint Eustatius

MPs asked why road works on Sint Eustatius (Cherry Tree Road) have barely progressed since 2018, whether tendering rules and European-style technical requirements excluded local contractors, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges the delay, explains the tender chose a simplified international approach open to local bidders, and says the island's public works department will finish Cherry Tree itself, backed by about 9.5 million euro in funding.
For the Cherry Tree project, after the contract with the contractor was terminated, the public body chose to complete it itself.
In het geval van het project Cherry Tree heeft het openbaar lichaam er na beëindiging van het contract met de aannemer voor gekozen dit nu in eigen beheer af te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Diertens over het bericht ‘Vreemdelingenadvocaten: 'Curaçao zet Venezolanen collectief uit’

MPs Groothuizen and Diertens asked about reports that Curaçao collectively expels Venezuelan migrants without individual assessment, detention conditions, minors, oversight by the Kingdom, and Dutch military assistance. The minister answers that individual screening is procedurally required, that Curaçao's judiciary must review compliance, that 95 of 97 intercepted persons were returned after individual assessment, and that Dutch military support was provided under Curaçao's authority with some improvements to detention facilities pending.
It is not for the Dutch government but for the judiciary of Curaçao to assess, where relevant cases arise, to what extent irregularities occur in an expulsion.

Het is niet aan de regering van Nederland, maar aan de rechterlijke macht in Curaçao om in eventueel voorkomende gevallen te beoordelen in hoeverre er zich onregelmatigheden voordoen bij een uitzetting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over verkiezingswaarnemers op Sint Maarten

MP Van Raak asked whether the Netherlands paid for election observers on Sint Maarten, why the Sint Maarten premier claimed no funds existed, and whether observers could still be sent before the 9 January election. Minister Knops confirmed the ministry paid for observers in the past, regretted that no observation request came from Sint Maarten for the January election, and said organising observation takes preparation time.
It is up to the government of Sint Maarten to provide clarity on this.
Het is aan de regering van Sint Maarten om hier duidelijkheid over te verschaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Van der Graaf over de herbenoeming van burgemeesters

Two MPs asked whether the re-appointment procedure for mayors (art. 61a Gemeentewet) should be changed, including limits on terms, a new profile before re-appointment, and a 3-5-7 career principle. The minister replied that re-appointment is tailored per case, no term limit or new profile is needed, the existing council-and-commissioner procedure is adequate, and career talks will be intensified.
I therefore see no reason to amend the Municipal Act on this point.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om de Gemeentewet op dit punt aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Gijs van Dijk, Paternotte, Groothuizen, Van den Berge en Özütok over geweld tegen de actiegroep Kick Out Zwarte Piet

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister and the Justice and Interior ministers how violence against the Kick Out Zwarte Piet congress was allowed, whether local authorities knew in advance, and how demonstrations and the Sinterklaas processions will be protected. The ministers condemned intimidation and violence, said police and prosecutors are investigating, and said local authorities (mayor, police, prosecutor) decide within legal limits, with a handreiking offered to municipalities; several answers were evasive about advance knowledge.
In our constitutional state it is unacceptable that (groups of) individual citizens disrupt a gathering of other citizens with violence and intimidation.
Het is in onze rechtsstaat ontoelaatbaar dat (groepen van) individuele burgers een bijeenkomst van andere burgers verstoren met geweld en intimidatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht dat de IRMA-app wordt gebruikt in een huisartsenpost

An MP asked about a GP-practice portal in Uden that lets patients log in with the IRMA app, raising privacy, legal basis and BSN concerns. The Minister says the legal position is still open: the Dutch Data Protection Authority has not excluded IRMA, national rules on private login means await the Digital Government Act, and the government is cautiously positive about attribute-based authentication while keeping DigiD as the current standard.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority has not yet ruled out IRMA.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens heeft IRMA nog niet uitgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Van den Hul en Bergkamp over de gemeentelijke basisadministratie voor kinderen van transgenders

MPs asked whether a transgender parent's gender change should also be reflected in their child's birth certificate and what children can do about the discrepancy with the BRP. The minister replied that the birth certificate is not amended after a parent's change, that the BRP may show the parent's new first name, and pointed to documentary and BRP-based ways to show the link.
Following these parliamentary questions, the government website information has been expanded to address these options.
Naar aanleiding van deze Kamervragen is in de informatie op de website van de rijksoverheid aandacht besteed aan deze mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Raak over het bericht dat mensen niet meer naar buiten durven vanwege een gebrek aan openbare toiletten

MPs Hijink and Van Raak asked why many municipalities do not provide public toilets and whether a national minimum norm should be imposed. Minister De Jonge answered that municipalities are responsible for deciding how many public toilets are needed, pointed to voluntary programmes and alternatives, and said a national norm is not appropriate.
Municipalities themselves have the freedom and responsibility, together with residents with and without disabilities, to determine how many (semi-)public toilets are needed.
Gemeenten hebben zelf de vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid samen met inwoners, met en zonder beperking, te bepalen hoeveel (semi)openbare toiletten nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van den Hul over discriminatie op de woningmarkt

Two MPs asked the government about ongoing discrimination against housing seekers on the Utrecht housing market, including licensing for estate agents, fines, and ACM or Public Prosecution action. The minister said the problem is not surprising, outlined an approach of awareness, mystery-guest testing and local pilots, but declined new fines or a licensing law for now.
I have no intention of amending the law on this point.
Ik heb geen voornemen de wet op dit onderdeel aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Nederland draait op voor Antilliaanse douanefraude'

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked the ministers about reports that the Netherlands is liable for customs fraud by the Antilles (Curaçao and Aruba), including the case's timeline, the Kingdom's legal status as an EU member, LGO status, and the division of competences within the Kingdom. The government explained the liability under the EU's Court of Justice ruling, stated that the ruling does not change obligations of the Caribbean countries, and said that the implications are being examined under a parliamentary motion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van den Bosch over het bericht 'Boeren moeten het ontgelden, waterschapsbelasting omhoog'

MPs Dijkstra and Van den Bosch asked the ministers about a reported rise in water board taxes for farmers after a Supreme Court ruling on unpaved verges. The minister says water boards set their own rates democratically, that the ruling only redistributes costs within the unbuilt-property category, and that the ministers will inform parliament after the Unie van Waterschappen decides on further review.
The water boards will inform me about their decision-making.
De waterschappen zullen mij over hun besluitvorming informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Gevangenis Pointe Blanche: The Devil’s Rock van Sint Maarten'

An MP asked about reports on the Pointe Blanche prison in Sint Maarten, progress on improvement measures, the status of Council of Europe supervision after the Corallo judgment, and whether TBS (ter beschikking stelling) can be imposed and executed in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom. The Minister reported slow progress on prison improvements, marine assistance in late October and November, periodic monitoring with Sint Maarten, that Council of Europe assessment is awaited in early 2020, and that TBS is executed by the countries themselves with no facilities in the Netherlands.
With Sint Maarten, progress on the agreed improvement measures is reviewed every 2 weeks.
Met Sint Maarten wordt elke 2 weken gekeken naar de voortgang van de afgesproken verbetermaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Renkema over het rapport ‘Beleidsscan VN-Verdrag handicap’ van de NVRR?

MPs Özütok and Renkema asked ministers about the NVRR report on municipal implementation of the UN Disability Convention, including why most municipalities lag, the lack of attention to women with disabilities, national implementation steps, and the convention's status in the Caribbean and Kingdom countries. The minister answered that municipalities face challenges, that the VNG project 'Iedereen doet mee' and the 'Onbeperkt Meedoen!' programme are underway, that the NVRR did not investigate the cause regarding women, and that the convention awaits implementing legislation in Caribbean Netherlands and has not been ratified by the other Kingdom countries.
The NVRR did not investigate the cause of why municipalities pay no particular attention to the position of women with disabilities.
De NVRR heeft niet onderzocht wat de oorzaak is waarom gemeenten geen bijzondere aandacht besteden aan de positie van vrouwen met een beperking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over agrarische panden

MPs Middendorp and Lodders asked about the poor condition of state-owned farmhouses leased by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, complaint channels, rent setting, inspections, repair timelines and the policy against selling these farms. Minister Ollongren answered substantively, reporting complaint figures, inspection status, a budget increase and a plan to start interdepartmental talks, while confirming the ban on selling non-strategic farms to tenants only under conditions.
In the context of the spring memorandum 2020, I will start interdepartmental consultation to free up the funds needed to carry out the maintenance work.
Ik zal in het kader van de voorjaarsnota 2020 een interdepartementaal overleg starten om de middelen vrij te maken, die nodig zijn om de onderhoudswerkzaamheden uit te kunnen voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özütok over het rapport 'FC Twente, Feyenoord en de Europese regels voor staatssteun'

MPs Westerveld and Özütok asked the ministers about a report claiming state aid to professional football clubs (FC Twente, Feyenoord) is unlawful and that municipalities are pressured into paying, and whether the EU Commission and national rules adequately police this. The Minister rejects the claims of coercion and unfair advantage, says anyone can complain to the Commission and that the Commission can act ex officio, and explains that municipalities are primarily responsible for state-aid compliance, with the Rijk supporting this through a knowledge centre, but commits to no new action.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Bosman over het bericht ‘Aboutaleb: kapotte drugsscanners Curaçao gevaarlijk voor Nederland'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports that most drug scanners at Curaçao's port and airport have been broken for years, and what this means for drug flows to the Netherlands. The minister answered that the port scanners have been defective for about two years, that the airport has a working but not fully deployable body scanner, that Schiphol keeps 100% checks on passengers from Curaçao, and that the issue will be raised at the January 2020 Justice Four-Party Consultation, and provided seizure statistics from 2015 to 2019.
The Curaçao authorities state they cannot share operational information about when the scanner is or is not deployed and the reasons for this.
Tevens geven Curaçaose autoriteiten aan geen operationele informatie te kunnen delen over wanneer de scanner al dan niet wordt ingezet en wat de redenen daarvan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Agnes Mulder over de vertraging van de noodkeuken op de Johan Willem Frisokazerne in Assen

MPs Van Helvert and Agnes Mulder asked why the emergency kitchen at the Johan Willem Friso barracks in Assen is delayed by a year, despite earlier promises of operation in summer, and what is being done about food safety and meal quality. The state secretary acknowledges the one-year delay, explains it by a switch to a new interim kitchen location after the old building proved unfit, and states the kitchen is expected in the second half of 2020 while meals are supplied from elsewhere.
Is it correct that the placement of the emergency kitchen at the Johan Willem Friso barracks in Assen has been delayed by one year?
Klopt het dat de plaatsing van de noodkeuken op de Johan Willem Friso kazerne in Assen met een jaar vertraagd is?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over verhuurders die woningen verhuren aan de hoogste bieder

An MP asked the housing minister about landlords renting homes to the highest bidder and whether this is allowed, whether it exploits housing shortages, and whether rent protection should be extended. The minister referred to earlier answers, said no other cases are known, and pointed to planned housing policy and income-limit changes for social rentals.

As announced in my letter 'State of the Housing Market and overview of measures' of 7 November 2019, I want to safeguard the accessibility, affordability and quality of housing for people with middle incomes or starters on the housing market.

Zoals aangekondigd in mijn brief «Staat van de Woningmarkt en overzicht van maatregelen» van 7 november 2019 wil ik de toegankelijkheid, de betaalbaarheid en kwaliteit van het wonen voor mensen met een middeninkomen of starters op de woningmarkt borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Wörsdörfer en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Een klik verwijderd van je schuldeisers’

VVD MPs asked the state secretaries about schuldenwijzer.nl, a debt-overview site that currently shows only debts enforced by bailiffs, and why tax authority, municipal and water board debts are not yet included, plus the legal obstacles around citizen service numbers. The government answered that the site helps citizens gain insight, that expansion is in progress led by bailiffs and the Belastingdienst is working on its own portal, and that no concrete legal obstacle has been identified beyond what is still to be signalled by bailiffs.
The Ministry of SZW discusses progress with SNG and KBvG and whether and how government organisations can join.
Het Ministerie van SZW bespreekt met SNG en KBvG de voortgang en ook of en zo ja, hoe overheidsorganisaties kunnen aansluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Breda willens en wetens in strijd met de wet voorwaarden verbindt aan het afgeven van een briefadres

An SP MP asked whether Breda imposes conditions on issuing a postal address (briefadres) contrary to the Personal Records Database Act, and whether the minister will act. The minister confirmed the law requires registration, said Breda deliberately keeps some homeless people registered as a way to monitor them, which is not permitted, and said the Rijksdienst and a letter to Breda have pointed out the violation.
I have had the Dutch Identity Data Agency contact the municipality of Breda.
Ik heb de Rijksdienst voor Identiteitsgegevens contact laten opnemen met de gemeente Breda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Paspoortscanner op mobieltje vormt risico voor identiteitsfraude’

MP Verhoeven asked whether phone apps that read passport chips, the BSN appearing on documents, and a planned QR-code on passports create identity-fraud risks, and whether certification of chip readers is needed. The minister answered that the apps add no new risk beyond showing a passport, that chips are protected by international standards, that the AVG applies to app makers, and that certification would add burdens disproportionate to the risk.
Naturally I will continue to monitor developments in identity fraud to determine whether measures are needed.
Vanzelfsprekend blijf ik ontwikkelingen op het gebied van identiteitsfraude volgen om te bepalen of er maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Dik-Faber over de registratie van levend geboren kinderen die voor het doen van geboorteaangifte reeds waren overleden

MPs Van der Graaf and Dik-Faber asked whether children born alive but dead before birth registration could only be recorded as stillborn in the population register, and whether ouders could have them registered as born alive and later deceased. The State Secretary explained the civil-status and population-register procedures, said a pre-1994 child cannot get its own record with a death date, but that the birth date appears on the parent's record, and declined new instructions or legislation.
Because the BRP already shows in the current situation that the child lived, I do not consider additional instructions and legislation necessary.
Omdat in de huidige situatie al uit de BRP blijkt dat het kind heeft geleefd, acht ik aanvullende instructies en wetgeving niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over aan allochtonen toe te rekenen kosten op het gebied van woning/huisvesting (sociale huurwoningen, huurtoeslag, subsidies etc.)

PVV MPs Wilders, Fritsma and Van Dijk asked the government to quantify housing-related costs (social rentals, rent allowance, subsidies) attributable to non-Western immigrants, compare them with the group's share of the population and its housing-market effects, and break them down by year. The minister answered that no data exist on costs attributable to people with a migration background, that no central administration tracks this, and that no realistic estimate can be made given the many organisations involved.
I have no insight into what share of all housing-related costs can be attributed to Dutch nationals with a Western or non-Western migration background, and I cannot calculate this either.

Ik heb geen inzicht in welk deel van alle aan wonen/huisvesting gerelateerde kosten toe te rekenen zijn aan Nederlanders met een (westerse of niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond en kan dit ook niet berekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over kosten, die voortvloeien uit de aanwezigheid van (niet-westerse) allochtonen in Nederland

PVV MPs asked the government to quantify costs arising from the presence of (non-Western) immigrants in the Netherlands, including police, intelligence, BZK programmes, provincial and municipal funds. The minister answered that most of these costs cannot be broken down by ethnic background because such data are not kept or not permitted, pointing to other responsible ministries and municipalities.
Data on the costs of police deployment for citizens with a (non-Western) migration background are not available.
Gegevens over de kosten van de inzet van politie ten aanzien van burgers met een (niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond, zijn niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp, Ldders en Koerhuis over het inschrijven in de Basisregistratie Persoon (BRP)

MPs Middendorp, Lodders and Koerhuis asked whether residents can register at any address in the BRP without the consent of existing occupants, and about the checks municipalities must perform, in cases where people are registered without the main resident knowing and suffer financial harm. The state secretary answered that registration depends on actual residence rather than consent, that municipalities control registrations under the BRP law and the adres onderzoek circular, that consent-based registration would undermine the BRP, and that the ministry is discussing solutions with municipal and implementing bodies.
Registration in the BRP at an address in the municipality is therefore not dependent on the consent of the resident already registered at that address.
Inschrijving in de BRP op een adres in de gemeente is derhalve niet afhankelijk van de instemming van de reeds op dat adres ingeschreven bewoner.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma en Diertens over de situatie op Curaçao

MPs Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma and Diertens asked about the situation on Curaçao, including the Article 3 ECHR protection procedure, detention conditions for Venezuelan migrants, border and drug and arms smuggling controls, and funding. The government answered that the procedure was revised and adopted, that detention upgrades are being funded, and that border controls and support measures are being strengthened, while stressing that law enforcement is Curaçao's autonomous responsibility.
It is primarily up to the country of Curaçao to ensure that the procedure is properly implemented and to ensure that effective legal remedies and the necessary capacity exist.

Het is primair aan het land Curaçao om erop toe te zien dat op goede wijze invulling wordt gegeven aan de procedure en zorg te dragen voor het bestaan van effectieve rechtsmiddelen en de daarbij benodigde capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Bestuurscollege Bonaire huurt journalisten in voor communicatiebeleid’

Rep. Bosman asked the State Secretary for the Interior about a report that the Bonaire executive council hired a journalist as communications adviser, and about that journalist's independence and the effect of his critical writing. The State Secretary answered that such dual roles are not normal under central government guidance, but that the hiring was a sovereign decision of the Bonaire executive council, a local matter it must account for to its island council.
I regard this as a local matter in which the executive council can account for itself in the public debate and (when asked) to the island council of Bonaire.
Ik beschouw dit als een lokale zaak waarbij het bestuurscollege in het publieke debat en (desgevraagd) richting de eilandsraad van Bonaire verantwoording kan afleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Bosman over de politieke situatie op Sint Maarten

MPs Van Dam and Bosman asked whether the Sint Maarten premier's description of ungovernability, lack of integrity and disregard for the constitution is accepted, what the Kingdom can do under the Statute to restore a functioning democratic rule of law, and whether unorthodox measures are considered. The State Secretary expressed concern and said the Kingdom must stay alert and use available instruments, but stressed Sint Maarten's autonomy, the need for great restraint, and a preference for cooperation over intervention.
That is why the Dutch government is closely monitoring this situation, all the more given our involvement in reconstruction and strengthening the rule of law in Sint Maarten.
Daarom houdt de Nederlandse regering deze situatie wel nauwlettend in de gaten, temeer gelet op onze betrokkenheid bij wederopbouw en het versterken van de rechtsstaat in Sint Maarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de financiële problemen die Curaçaose oud-studenten ondervinden bij het aflossen van studieschulden

An MP asked whether DUO's repayment and collection practices put former students on Curaçao in financial trouble, and whether repayment schemes reflect local income conditions. The minister denied DUO obstructs repayment, explained the income-based draagkracht procedure and the staged collection steps, and promised DUO staff visits to Curaçao and a review of concrete cases.
If the further information from the Minister of OWCS shows that things have gone wrong there, I will certainly take measures.
Als uit de nadere informatie van de Minister van OWCS blijkt dat daar zaken mis zijn gegaan, zal ik zeker maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Oud-studenten op Curaçao in financiële problemen door DUO’

CDA MPs Van Dam and Van der Molen asked the Education Minister about reports that at least a hundred former students on Curaçao got into financial trouble through DUO's communication and collection practices, including a Curaçao minister's claim of a non-integrous approach with a local bailiff. The minister said DUO had not received concrete cases, rejected the claim as unsupported, promised to examine specific cases, and committed to a joint meeting with the Curaçao minister and on-site DUO staff to help debtors.
DUO has asked the Ministry of Education, Science, Culture and Sport for concrete cases in which something would have gone wrong, but has not yet received them.
DUO heeft het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Wetenschap, Cultuur en Sport (OWCS) gevraagd naar concrete zaken waarin iets zou zijn misgegaan, maar deze nog niet ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het herstel van de luchthaven van Sint Maarten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations why Sint Maarten's government and parliament hesitate to accept the Dutch offer to finance airport reconstruction, and whether the population is harmed by local political games. The State Secretary answered that the government and parliament have repeatedly committed to the financing plan, that Dutch conditions on airport governance professionalisation and security vetting of its board are in place, and that the airport should become less vulnerable to local political influence.

Approval of the World Bank and EIB financing plan in the trust fund steering group was also subject, by me, to a number of conditions aimed at structural improvement and professionalisation of the airport management.

Aan goedkeuring van het financieringsplan van de Wereldbank en de EIB in de stuurgroep van het trustfonds werden daarnaast door mij een aantal voorwaarden verbonden die moeten zien op structurele verbetering en professionalisering van het luchthavenbestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de opvang van Venezolaanse migranten

An MP asked whether the 23.8 million euro Dutch funding for Aruba and Curaçao concerning Venezuelan migrants is mainly spent on deterrence and detention, how much goes to asylum procedure and reception, and whether a share should fund fair treatment. The State Secretary answered that 7.2 million is reserved for optimising the migration chain and that migration policy is an autonomous matter of the Caribbean countries, with reception funded for vulnerable groups such as trafficking victims.
The starting point for Dutch support to the countries is that, in line with the constitutional relations within the Kingdom, responsibility for migration policy is an autonomous matter.

Uitgangspunt voor de Nederlandse ondersteuning aan de landen is dat conform de staatsrechtelijke verhoudingen binnen het Koninkrijk de verantwoordelijkheid voor het migratiebeleid een autonome aangelegenheid betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Honderden ouderen in Caribisch Nederland hebben nauwelijks te eten'

Kuiken (PvdA) asked the ministers about a report by the National Ombudsman finding that hundreds of elderly people in Caribbean Netherlands have barely enough food, asking whether the conditions are unacceptable, whether the government will act on the recommendations, the proposed Caribbean table, how the poverty threshold relates to elderly living conditions, what measures will be taken, and whether child poverty will be investigated. The ministers acknowledge the difficult situation, say they will discuss the findings with the Ombudsman, list income and cost-of-living measures already taken or planned, commit to annual monitoring, and point to a forthcoming UNICEF-based letter on children's rights.
The cabinet considers the National Ombudsman's point about looking more broadly than only the income of the elderly valuable.
Het kabinet vindt het aandachtspunt van de Nationale ombudsman om breder te kijken dan alleen het inkomen van ouderen waardevol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over de toegankelijkheid van de tijdelijke huisvesting van de Tweede Kamer voor blinden en slechtzienden

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the State Secretary of Interior whether blind and visually impaired people will have good access to the Tweede Kamer's temporary accommodation, including an audio model of the chamber, and which other facilities will be provided. The State Secretary agreed access should be good, but said placing the audio model is a matter for the Tweede Kamer organisation, suggested it be moved over, and said the public areas will meet the ITs Publiek accessibility standard while other areas keep existing facilities.

Placing an audio model as part of the facilities in the temporary accommodation is, however, due to the division of roles between the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and the users of the temporary accommodation, a matter for the Tweede Kamer organisation.

Het plaatsen van een audiomaquette als onderdeel van de voorzieningen in de tijdelijke huisvesting is echter vanwege de rolverdeling tussen het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf en de gebruikers van de tijdelijke huisvesting, een zaak van de Tweede Kamerorganisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht ‘Kabinet laat Caribische ouderen achter in ‘mensonwaardig bestaan’

An MP from D66 asked several ministers about reports that elderly residents of the Caribbean Netherlands live in poverty and that government support is inadequate. The state secretaries acknowledged the difficult situation, pointed to measures and shared responsibility with island authorities, but gave limited concrete timelines and said the Ombudsman's criticisms are addressed through ongoing monitoring.
The cabinet understands the wish of the National Ombudsman for more clarity on the timeline of the announced measures.
Het kabinet begrijpt de wens van de Nationale ombudsman om meer houvast voor wat betreft het tijdpad van de aangekondigde maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over de gevaarlijke situatie na spontaan springen van ramen bij ministeries Rijnstraat 8

MPs Nijboer and Kuiken asked about window breakages at the Rijnstraat 8 government building, the safety risks, costs, and whether the building is fit for purpose. The state secretary answered that responsibility lies with the contractor PoortCentraal, that wind-speed closures and inspections were introduced, that a root-cause study is pending, and that costs to the state are about 600,000 euro.
Your House has not been separately informed.
Uw Kamer is niet separaat geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Ramen in gebouw ministerie springen kapot’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Interior about cracked windows at a Rijnstraat 8 government building in The Hague, including safety risks, causes, inspection and regulation gaps, and links to the AFAS stadium roof collapse. The government answered that there is no danger to occupants, that the outer panes were replaced with a calamity plan in place, that the cause is still under investigation, and that the Minister will consider steps once the AFAS investigations conclude.
Because of this ongoing investigation, it is still too early to conclude that regulations need to be amended.
Vanwege dit lopende onderzoek is het nog te vroeg om te concluderen dat regelgeving aangepast moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het dekolonisatieproces van de voormalig Nederlandse Antillen

An MP (Bosman, VVD) asked the State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations, through 19 questions, about decolonisation of the former Netherlands Antilles, the free choice behind the Statute, and the legal status of the 2018 ICJ written statement, including whether Article 73 UN Charter still applies. The State Secretary (Knops) answered that the Antilles reached full self-government in 1954 by free acceptance of the Statute, that the post-colonial self-determination right remains, and that the 2018 position merely clarifies the legal basis without changing the status of the islands.
This clarification, however, has no material legal consequences for the islands concerned.
Deze precisering heeft overigens geen wezenlijke juridische gevolgen voor de betreffende (ei)landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over het bericht 'Overheid lanceert digitaal paspoort op mobiele telefoon'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about government initiatives on digital identity (virtual ID, self-sovereign identity, KTDI), their coordination, and links to pending bills and the regie op gegevens policy. The government answered that these initiatives are in an early experimental phase under binding legal frameworks, coordinated under NL DIGIbeter, and that the regie op gegevens letter has been sent to the Chamber.
Coordination regarding the possible development of a digital identity lies with me.
De coördinatie ten aanzien van de mogelijke ontwikkeling van een digitale identiteit ligt bij mij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over “exorbitante salarissen aan de top van overheidsbedrijven op Curaçao”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs why salaries at the top of state-owned companies on Curaçao exceed the Prime Minister's pay, why these pay levels are not public, and whether the financial supervisor Cft has insight into their finances, and whether public officials should never earn more than the Prime Minister. The State Secretary answered that pay supervision on Curaçao and Sint Maarten is a matter for those countries, that Cft cannot supervise such entities under the Rft but requests information regularly, and that he encourages Curaçao to act.
The remuneration of directors of state-owned limited companies on Curaçao and Sint Maarten and the supervision thereof is a matter for the respective countries.
De bezoldiging van bestuurders van overheids-nv's op Curaçao en Sint Maarten en het toezicht daarop is een aangelegenheid van de desbetreffende landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Sneek calls for speed-up of road-building project'

An MP asked about reports that the Cherry Tree Road renovation on Sint Eustatius is delayed and whether the road network will be maintained long-term. The government confirms a delay caused by a dispute over cement type, sets a new completion date of March 2020, and says a maintenance plan for 2020-2023 will follow in autumn.

Between the public body and the contractor, new agreements have also been made on the conditions under which the contractor may still complete the project, with a delayed completion date of March 2020 at the latest.

Tussen het openbaar lichaam en de aannemer zijn daarnaast nieuwe afspraken gemaakt over de voorwaarden waaronder de aannemer het project alsnog, met een vertraagde opleverdatum van uiterlijk maart 2020, mag afmaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Nederlander in buitenland moet op pad voor extra check DigiD’

MPs Verhoeven and Sjoerdsma asked whether DigiD two-step verification is safe and why Dutch citizens abroad must collect an activation code at a counter in person, often far away, and whether this is acceptable. The State Secretary defends two-step verification as safer, explains the face-to-face requirement as necessary for reliable identity checks, and promises to explore improvements such as more counters and NFC-based activation from the second half of 2020.
I recognise and regret that for some Dutch citizens living abroad who want or need a DigiD this causes inconvenience and that they experience it as a problem.
Ik realiseer mij en betreur dat dit voor een deel van de Nederlanders die in het buitenland wonen en een DigiD willen of moeten hebben tot ongemak leidt en dat zij dit als een probleem ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Dagelijks rechten geschonden’ inzake het gevangeniswezen op Sint Maarten

An MP asked the government about reports of daily rights violations in Sint Maarten's prison, including cell confinement, lack of rehabilitation and psychiatric care, and suspects being sent home instead of held in pre-trial detention. The State Secretary answered that prisons are a country matter, cited the minimum two hours outdoor time and limited reclassering capacity, referred the release policy to Sint Maarten authorities, and said the Corallo supervision and 11 transferred containers cells are being monitored.
It is not for me to assess the factual findings presented in the article.
Het is niet aan mij om de in het artikel weergegeven constateringen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Diks en Van Ojik over Venezolaans conflictgoud dat via Curaçao en Aruba wordt verhandeld

Three GroenLinks MPs asked the government about Venezuelan conflict gold being traded via Curaçao and Aruba, and how this fits with Dutch recognition of Guaidó and the gold covenant. The State Secretary answered that Curaçao and Aruba have banned Venezuelan gold trade, that no Venezuelan gold import was declared in Caribbean Netherlands in five years, and that the EU conflict minerals regulation applies from 2021, with the gold covenant and due diligence as the main tools.
Regarding the nature and scale of gold trade on Sint Maarten, despite inquiries with the Sint Maarten government, I currently have no figures available.
Van de aard en omvang van de handel in goud op Sint Maarten zijn mij, ondanks navraag bij de regering van Sint Maarten, op dit moment geen cijfers bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Dam over de gevolgen van de problemen bij het Sehos-ziekenhuis in Willemstad

MPs Van den Berg and Van Dam asked about the consequences of the Sehos hospital problems in Curaçao for Bonaire patients, including referrals, waiting lists, costs and the hospital's finances. The State Secretary answered that Curaçao is responsible for hospital care, that few Bonaire patients go to Sehos for non-urgent surgery, that reimbursement of travel costs applies, and that the financial supervisor monitors the situation.
Curaçao, as an autonomous country, is itself responsible for (hospital) care.
Curaçao is als autonoom land zelf verantwoordelijk voor de (ziekenhuis)zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Ronnes over het bericht ‘Graf Jacoba van Beieren hoort op Tholen’

MPs Geluk-Poortvliet and Ronnes asked about reports that Countess Jacoba of Bavaria, buried in the Binnenhof Hofkapel, had wished for burial in Tholen, and about the planned research into historic graves and the plaque at the Binnenhof. The Minister answered that the RCE is studying whether Van Oldenbarnevelt's remains can be identified, that the plaque will not be changed but may receive attention during renovation, and that relocating Jacoba's remains is not a condition for honouring her history.
The research report will be available in September.
Het onderzoeksrapport zal in september beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over gratis internetbankieren vanaf de BES-eilanden

An MP asked whether residents of the Caribbean Netherlands can open online bank accounts, whether this can be free, which local rules hinder advertising, why accounts must be opened by post, and whether ABN AMRO can be pushed to offer digital banking quickly. The minister replied that current law allows it under conditions, that the government is examining with DNB and the AFM whether to clarify licensing rules, that account fees apply regardless of location, that advertising will be examined, that digital opening is possible only for addresses in Europe, and that findings will follow in a letter by end 2019.
I am entering into discussion with the sector and will report the outcomes to you in my letter at the end of 2019.
Ik ga met de sector in gesprek en meld u de uitkomsten in mijn brief eind 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Raak over een grensconflict tussen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden en de Republiek Frankrijk in Oyster Pond  op Sint Maarten

An SP MP asked why the Kingdom and France have not resolved the disputed border around a restaurant and marina at Oyster Pond, Sint Maarten, and what the status and planned negotiations are. The government answered that the 1648 treaty does not fix the border there, that the status quo was agreed in 2014, that France carried out inspections in 2016, that land-border negotiations are being prepared, and that Sint Maarten is responsible for rebuilding.
The land border negotiations are expected to begin at the end of this year.
Naar verwachting zullen de landgrensonderhandelingen eind van dit jaar aanvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de weigering van parlementariërs op Sint Maarten om te bezuinigen op hun eigen hoge vergoedingen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Interior about Sint Maarten's delayed 2019 budget, Dutch liquidity loans, and Sint Maarten parliamentarians' reluctance to cut their own allowances. The State Secretary answered that the budget was completed on 2 July, that 10% salary cuts for ministers and a budget reduction for MPs were included, and that any 2019 liquidity support is conditional on cutting MPs' salaries or allowances.
Any liquidity support for 2019 is in any case conditional on lowering the salaries and/or emoluments of the members of the Staten.
Aan eventuele liquiditeitssteun over 2019 is in ieder geval het verlagen van de salarissen en/of de emolumenten van de Statenleden als voorwaarde verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de architectenrel op het Binnenhof

MP Ploumen asks the State Secretary for the Interior about reports that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf considered Koen van Velsen as executive architect for the Binnenhof renovation, his time as interim Rijksbouwmeester, and why OMA was chosen. The State Secretary answers that Van Velsen was discussed for design phases but no appointment followed due to unresolved business terms, that his prior role did not block an appointment, and that Pi de Bruijn was not considered.
These discussions did not lead to an appointment.
Deze gesprekken hebben niet tot een aanstelling geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Drost over de registratie van een levenloos geboren kind na een abortus
