MPs Dik-Faber and Drost asked why a stillborn child after abortion could be registered in the Basisregistratie Personen, whether this was foreseen, and how it fits with the law on abortion and the legal status of unborn life. The State Secretary answered that registration follows parents' wishes without conditions, that no legal consequences attach, that the Waz framework is unchanged, and declined to launch a broader societal debate.
I have received similar questions from municipalities and will shortly look into what can be done about this.
Ik heb overigens vergelijkbare vragen ontvangen vanuit gemeenten en zal op korte termijn bekijken wat hieraan gedaan kan worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Bosman over de berichten ‘Sint Maarten heeft nog paar maanden voor wetgeving rond witwassen’ en ‘Sint Maarten weigert strijd tegen witwassen en terrorismefinanciering aan

MPs Van der Linde and Bosman asked the government about reports that Sint Maarten was lagging on anti-money-laundering legislation and about the scale of the problem and possible political obstruction. The State Secretary answered that AML is a national responsibility of Sint Maarten, that several laws were recently adopted, that a CFATF public statement was withheld as a confidential draft, and that Dutch support and monitoring continue.
The statement in question concerns a confidential internal draft of an international body that was not adopted after CFATF deliberation and therefore was not published.
De genoemde verklaring betreft een vertrouwelijk intern concept van een internationaal orgaan, dat na besluitvorming in de CFATF niet is vastgesteld en daarom niet is gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de berichten 'Sint Maarten niet ver verwijderd van een blokkade internationaal betalingsverkeer' en 'FATF geeft Sint Maarten ervan langs'

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked whether FATF pressure could block international payments for Sint Maarten and affect the BES islands, and about the status of anti-money-laundering laws and the Team Bestrijding Ondermijning. The State Secretary answered that a public warning would bring extra due diligence or, at worst, transaction refusals, that Sint Maarten has adopted some laws with others still pending, and that the government will report on BES banking by year end.
At the end of this year, your House will be informed about the progress.
Eind dit jaar wordt uw Kamer over de voortgang geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Drost over het bericht ambtenaren steeds vaker en luxer in businessclass naar de Caraïben

An MP asked the State Secretary whether rising, more luxurious business-class travel by civil servants to the Caribbean is appropriate given the islands' size and financial oversight from The Hague, and whether the travel decision framework should be tightened. The government denies excessive spending, attributes the increase to reinforced support for Caribbean Netherlands and hurricane Irma aftermath, and declines to tighten the framework, leaving business-class choice to the civil servant under the six-hour rule.
For the breakdown per ministry I refer you to the published FOI request where this data is included.
Voor de opsplitsing per ministerie verwijs ik u naar het gepubliceerde WOB-verzoek waar deze gegevens in zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Sneller over berichten dat Sint Maarten niet optreedt tegen witwassen

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary and Finance Minister about reports that Sint Maarten is not acting against money laundering, including the economic consequences of FATF non-compliance, EU and Kingdom implications, casino transaction reporting, and the Integrity Chamber. The government answered that Sint Maarten is responsible for implementing FATF recommendations, outlined possible CFATF countermeasures and grey-list risks, noted Dutch and World Bank technical support, and described the Integrity Chamber's powers, while stating that money laundering prosecution falls outside that chamber.
Foremost, anchoring the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) recommendations in legislation is a responsibility of the country of Sint Maarten.
Voorop staat dat de verankering van de aanbevelingen van de Financial Action Task Force (FATF) in wetgeving een verantwoordelijkheid is van het land Sint Maarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Venezuela belangrijk thema op Koninkrijksoverleg’

An MP asked the government about Aruba's push for a visa requirement for Venezuelans, the Caribbean visa framework, alleged visa fraud by Dominicans and overstay figures. The minister said no common Kingdom position exists yet, that Aruba will first exhaust national measures, and that the government sees no organised visa abuse but will keep monitoring.
Neither the Ministry of Foreign Affairs nor the Aruban authorities have any knowledge of organised abuse of Caribbean visas for Aruba.
Er is bij het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken noch bij de autoriteiten van Aruba iets bekend over georganiseerd misbruik van Caribische visa voor Aruba.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Amsterdam wil 'eerlijke' computers in de stad’

MPs Middendorp and Van den Bosch asked the State Secretary whether municipalities such as Amsterdam may audit algorithms of national companies, and about national frameworks for algorithms. The State Secretary answered that municipalities have regulatory and enforcement powers within their territory, that existing legal bases for algorithm checks are limited to specific competition and data protection authorities, and that the national government supports municipalities with frameworks and coordination.
Municipalities have powers for setting frameworks and enforcement, and nationally operating companies will also have to comply with these.
Gemeenten hebben bevoegdheden voor kaderstelling en handhaving en daar zullen ook nationaal opererende bedrijven aan moeten voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Sneller inzake de groeiende maatschappelijke zorgen over de plannen voor Paleis Soestdijk

MPs Van Eijs and Sneller (D66) asked whether the Paleis Soestdijk redevelopment by Made by Holland, which now adds a 120-room hotel and about 33 extra homes beyond the original bid, is still within the sale concept and how the municipality and province should be involved. The Secretary of State answers that the changes fit the original concept under the sale contract, that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf consented, and that planning decisions and conditions such as the number of homes and use of proceeds are the responsibility of the province and municipality.
Since this concerns a further elaboration of the plan area, the province and municipality are the competent authorities because of its public-law character.
Aangezien het om een nadere invulling van het plangebied gaat, zijn de provincie en de gemeente vanwege het publiekrechtelijke karakter het bevoegde gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Middendorp over de bunker Seyss Inquart

MPs Aartsen and Middendorp asked why the sale and repurposing of the Seyss-Inquart bunker proceeds before the government's promised vision and action plan on WWII heritage, and how this relates to the Beckerman motion. The State Secretary replied that a Nota van Uitgangspunten is not a final sale, that no irreversible steps will be taken before 1 October 2019, and that the sale continues while the motion is implemented in that sense.

No irreversible steps are being taken in the current sale process before the Minister of Education, Culture and Science has presented the promised vision and action plan on Second World War heritage (by 1 October 2019 at the latest).

Er worden geen onomkeerbare stappen gezet in het onderhavige verkoopproces, vóórdat de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW) de toegezegde visie met actieplan voor het erfgoed van de Tweede Wereldoorlog heeft gepresenteerd (uiterlijk 1 oktober 2019).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het artikel ‘Vrouwen kunnen niet autorijden en dit is waarom’

An MP asked the government about gender data gaps in policy and products, following a column on women and driving, including whether gender effects are assessed in legislation and the Digital Government Act. The minister answered that a new gender-equality effects test was added to the policy framework, that diverse teams are desirable though not a government matter for product design, and that a further gender check on the Digital Government Act is not considered necessary.
To take account of the effects on gender equality in policy and legislation, I have had a new 'gender equality effects' test added to the Integral Policy and Regulation Assessment Framework.

Om bij beleid en wet-of regelgeving rekening te houden met de effecten op gendergelijkheid, heb ik in het Integraal Afwegingskader voor beleid en regelgeving (IAK) een nieuwe toets «effecten op gendergelijkheid» laten opnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het gevangeniswezen Sint Maarten

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister about a Voortgangscommissie letter proposing that the Kingdom take full responsibility for Sint Maarten's prison system, the poor detention conditions, and whether detainees should be returned. The government declined to send the internal letter, rejected the claim it was insufficiently cooperative, said it monitors agreed improvement measures and intends to return detainees as agreed.

It is therefore established cabinet policy not to make documents drawn up for internal deliberation a subject of political debate, so that thoughts can be exchanged in confidence to ensure careful decision-making.

Het is dan ook staand beleid van het kabinet om documenten die zijn opgesteld voor intern beraad, geen onderwerp te maken van het politieke debat om ervoor te zorgen dat in vertrouwelijkheid van gedachten kan worden gewisseld ten behoeve van zorgvuldige besluitvorming.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Middendorp over de artikelen ‘Molly Russell’s father: cutting, biting, burning — my daughter was shown it all on social media’ en ‘You have amazing ability, Damian Hinds tells te

Two MPs asked the government about UK press reports on the death of a teenager linked to social media content, whether similar Dutch cases are known, whether Dutch research on social media and suicide will be undertaken, and what action will be taken. The minister said no Dutch data on causes of suicide are kept, a 113 Suicide Prevention study on 2017 youth suicides is underway with results expected at year end, and pointed to EU audiovisual rules, media literacy in the curriculum and existing support networks.
In the Netherlands no data are kept on the causes of suicide.
In Nederland worden geen gegevens bijgehouden over de oorzaken van zelfdoding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Koerhuis over het bericht 'ABN-AMRO-economen: bouw is miljarden kwijt door fouten'

MPs Van Eijs and Koerhuis asked the minister how the government will reduce the high failure costs in Dutch construction, citing an ABN-AMRO report. The minister answers that the Kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen bill, along with stricter contractor liability and the Bouwagenda, is the main route, and commits to answering the questions within the time frame.
The bill on quality assurance for construction aims at such a system, which may also contribute to the necessary cultural change in the sector.
Het wetsvoorstel Kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen beoogt zo'n stelsel, dat tevens kan bijdragen aan de noodzakelijke cultuuromslag in de sector.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over rijnvarenden, die grote persoonlijke naheffingen ontvingen van de Nederlandse belastingdienst voor sociale premies, die zij ook al in Luxemburg betaald hebben

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked why Rhine boatmen face large Dutch social premium back-assessments already paid in Luxembourg, and what steps the authorities took to recover the debt from former employers and ensure only one country collects premiums. The government answered that the tax authority cannot pursue employers for individual income-tax debts, that refund claims lie with Luxembourg authorities under its law, that it will raise the issue with Luxembourg, and that payment arrangements are available, but gave no clear timeline for resolving the double premium problem.

Although the Netherlands is not a party to these requests, I will, together with the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment, actively and promptly raise the signals with the Luxembourg authorities.

Hoewel Nederland geen partij is bij deze verzoeken, zal ik met de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, die verantwoordelijk is voor de vaststelling van de verzekeringsplicht, de signalen hierover actief en op korte termijn bij de Luxemburgse autoriteiten onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het functioneren van het gezagsregister

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for the Interior about how the Central Gezagsregister (guardianship/parental authority register) functions, including its scope, access by the Royal Marechaussee, and its use by professionals. The government answered that the register only records authority arising from court decisions, that the Rvdr is responsible for it, and that additional documents are sometimes needed, while promising to look into better information provision.
I will investigate how the information provision can be improved.
Ik zal onderzoeken hoe de informatievoorziening verbeterd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over foutieve registratie in de Basisregistratie Personen

An SP MP asked why the Landentabel in the Basisregistratie Personen no longer allows the name '(bezet) Palestijns gebied' and why people born there may be registered as born in Israel. The State Secretary replied that the name does not fit the Landentabel's systematics as an administrative/state list, so 'Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever met inbegrip van Oost-Jeruzalem' will be used, with a change planned for 1 July 2019 and a registration option for affected persons.
An effort is being made to have the change take effect on 1 July 2019.
Er wordt naar gestreefd om de wijziging op 1 juli 2019 in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over eenzijdige besluiten van Zorgverzekeringskantoor Caribisch Nederland inzake patiëntenvervoer tussen Saba en Sint Maarten

An MP asked the state secretary whether Saba's island authorities were properly consulted and informed before the health insurance office ZVK changed patient transport arrangements between Saba and Sint Maarten. The answers state that no change in statutory rules occurred, so consultation of local authorities was not required, while ZVK says it held talks with key Saba parties before deploying a new airline.
In cases where changes to laws and regulations have a significant effect on the residents of the BES islands, the public bodies are consulted, but that was not the case here.

In gevallen waarbij wijziging van wet- en regelgeving ingrijpend effect hebben op de inwoners van de BES-eilanden worden de openbare lichamen geconsulteerd, maar daar was in dit geval geen sprake van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Gezaghebber over vertraging verkiezingen: ‘Dit mag nooit meer gebeuren’’

Mr. Van Dam (CDA) asked about reports of long queues, identification problems and 47 missing ballots during the March 2019 elections on Bonaire. The minister answered that all voters in line were able to vote, identification caused no problems, the ballot discrepancies have several possible causes, and the elections will be evaluated with an OAS observer report and possible expert support for the island.
The public body has been asked to fill in a questionnaire on the organisation and course of the elections.
Het openbaar lichaam is daartoe gevraagd een vragenlijst in te vullen over de organisatie en het verloop van de verkiezingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over dak- en thuislozen die zich niet kunnen inschrijven bij gemeenten

Peters (CDA) asked the state secretary about homeless people who cannot register with municipalities despite the legal duty, including the status of a planned law change and how homeless people can enforce their right. The secretary confirmed the registration duty already exists under the Wet BRP, said the amendment to clarify it will be sent to parliament in autumn 2019, sent a letter to municipalities, and referred affected people to support organisations and the RVIG.
The duty of municipalities to register already exists under the Wet BRP.
De plicht van gemeenten tot inschrijving is er al vanuit de Wet BRP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het commentaar 'Analyse: Curaçao staat voor kantelpunt'

An MP asks whether Curaçao requested the Council of Ministers to apply Article 25 of the financial supervision law, what other options exist, and whether the Kingdom will inform parliament of its decision. The State Secretary confirms a letter was sent, promises to share it after deliberation, lists the available instruments, and says he cannot yet give a timeline for the decision.
I am willing to send the letter to your House after it has been discussed in the Council of Ministers.
Ik ben bereid na behandeling in de Rijksministerraad de brief aan uw Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van Eijs over het artikel 'Soap rond architecten verbouwing Binnenhof'

MPs Middendorp and Van Eijs asked the State Secretary about press reports of turmoil among architects for the Binnenhof renovation, including the replacement of the Eerste Kamer architect and the search for new architects. The State Secretary answered that the timeline and budget are unaffected, that architect Pi de Bruijn will be commissioned for building N, and that governance will be reviewed with the House's user groups.
That is why I want to examine with the users of the House of Representatives whether it is possible to make changes to the existing project structure
Vandaar dat ik met de gebruikers van de Tweede Kamer wil bezien of het mogelijk is om wijzigingen in de bestaande projectstructuur aan te brengen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Rechter moet tussenbeide komen bij ICT-ruzie binnen UWV’

MPs Wiersma and Middendorp (VVD) asked about reported internal conflict over UWV's ICT reorganisation, including new IV-director posts, decentralisation of ICT staff, software maintenance costs and coordination with other agencies. Minister Koolmees answered that the transition is UWV's own responsibility as an autonomous body, that the implementation is temporarily suspended for talks with the works council, and that no new management layer is added.
As an autonomous administrative body, however, the Executive Board of UWV is itself responsible for the proper organisation of the agency.
Als zbo is de Raad van Bestuur van UWV echter zelf verantwoordelijk voor een goede inrichting van de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Aruba op zwarte lijst EU belastingontwijking’

MPs Van Dam and Omtzigt asked whether Aruba was placed on the EU blacklist of non-cooperative tax jurisdictions, why it was moved from the grey list, what measures Aruba must take, and whether the Netherlands supported Aruba. The State Secretary confirmed the listing, said Aruba committed to repeal its transparency regime and is expected to be delisted at the 16 May Ecofin, and stated no figures are available on Dutch persons using Aruban tax arrangements and that Aruba bears responsibility for its own tax rules.
No figures are known about this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het pleidooi van de Nationale ombudsman voor een aanwijzing aan Nederland wegens misstanden in Caribisch Nederland

MP Özütok asked whether the government will act on the National Ombudsman's call for a binding directive against poverty and social inequality in the Caribbean Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that the Ombudsman has no role in interbestuurlijk toezicht and pointed to existing government letters on income security in the BES islands.
I do not see a role for the National Ombudsman in this matter.
Ik zie bij dit vraagstuk geen rol weggelegd voor de Nationale ombudsman.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Westerveld over het bericht 'Ook stichting kijkonderzoek verzamelde data met omstreden methode'

GroenLinks MPs Özütok and Westerveld asked whether the audience-measurement method reported by NOS (collecting data via a contested method, with questions on legality, informed consent, and whether public broadcasters should stop participating) is lawful and whether it should be banned. Minister Slob replied that the GDPR question is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority to judge, that the AVG rules are adequate, and that he expects the NPO and its contractors to comply with the law.
It is not for me to make a statement on this.
Het is niet aan mij om hier een uitspraak over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een schikking met KPMG

An MP asked ministers why KPMG's Curaçao affiliate received a small settlement for facilitating money laundering, whether the settlement should have waited for ongoing cases, and whether the Dutch prosecution service was involved. The minister answered that the decision lies with the Curaçao prosecution service, which is outside Dutch responsibility, and gave no further commitment.

In this case it is for the Curaçao prosecution service to decide whether to proceed to prosecution of the suspect in an individual criminal case and which disposal modality is appropriate and warranted.
Het is in dit geval aan het OM Curaçao om te beslissen of in een individuele strafzaak tot vervolging van de verdachte wordt overgegaan en welke afdoeningsmodaliteit passend en geboden is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Agnes Mulder over het bericht 'Kazerne moet lang wachten op keuken'

MPs Bruins Slot and Agnes Mulder asked why the kitchen at the Johan Willem Friso barracks in Assen faces a long wait for new construction and whether it could be accelerated. The State Secretary answered that new building requires several lengthy steps, that an interim kitchen will open in the second half of 2019, and that procurement and appeal rules leave no room to speed up construction.
Based on the laws and regulations on procurement, objection and appeal, there are no options to speed up the new construction.
Op basis van de wet- en regelgeving op het gebied van aanbesteding, bezwaar en beroep zijn er geen mogelijkheden om de nieuwbouw te versnellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Van der Staaij over antwoorden op Kamervragen over foutieve registratie in de Basisregistratie Personen

MPs Bisschop and Van der Staaij asked about the Council of State ruling on a disputed birthplace entry in the BRP, the legal basis for including non-recognised territories in the country table, and whether adding 'Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever' implies de facto recognition of Palestine. The State Secretary answered that the ruling was correctly applied, that exceptions for non-recognised areas are allowed in the country table, and that the change does not alter Dutch policy on Palestinian statehood.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Pieter Heerma en Van den Berg over de last onder dwangsom werkgeversportaal UWV

MPs Van der Molen, Heerma and Van den Berg (CDA) asked about the Dutch Data Protection Authority's penalty order against the UWV employer portal, the choice of eID assurance level (eHerkenning substantial versus eIDAS high), the role of UZI cards, and cost estimates for employers. The minister answered that UWV's 2018 risk analysis found the substantial level appropriate, that the cost estimates were not too low, and that the UZI card is only for patient identification.
I do not share the view that eHerkenning means were prescribed at the wrong level.
Ik deel niet de mening dat sprake is van het voorschrijven van eHerkenningsmiddelen op een verkeerd niveau.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en van Haga over de berichten ‘Limburg genoemd als locatie voor megadistributiecentrum van Chinese webwinkelreus Alibaba’ en 'Rutte wil Alibaba binnenhalen, maar douane is e-com

Two VVD MPs asked the government about the growing role of online retail, the possible Alibaba distribution centre in the Benelux, cross-border goods flows, customs and product-safety gaps for non-EU online sellers. The government answered that data on cross-border flows is largely unavailable, customs and market supervisors already control non-EU imports, and it is pushing in EU negotiations for an EU-based contact point for third-country online sellers.
No figures are known on this, and well-founded estimates cannot be given.
Hierover zijn geen cijfers bekend, en goed onderbouwde schattingen zijn niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het voorstel op Sint Maarten om het geld voor wederopbouw te gebruiken voor de bouw van een heel duur nieuw parlement

An MP asks whether reconstruction funds for Sint Maarten after hurricane Irma could be used for a costly new parliament building, and about high MP salaries on the island. The Secretary of State says the proposal is not in parliament, excludes such prestige projects from the trust fund, and that the salary cut for the Statenleden remains pending.
The Netherlands will only be able to agree to financing projects that, where necessary, contribute to the reconstruction of Sint Maarten.
Nederland zal alleen akkoord kunnen gaan met financiering van projecten die, waar nodig, bijdragen aan de wederopbouw van Sint Maarten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Geen M of V, maar X: voor het eerst paspoort veranderd in genderneutraal’

Two D66 MPs asked why the government changed its stance on allowing a gender-neutral (X) passport and whether it regrets earlier expectations, and asked about timing of a plan on unnecessary gender registration, whether M/V counts as unnecessary, and why the advisory commission's view should be awaited. The Secretary of State answers that a legal change to the birth certificate would be needed, that passport sex must follow the birth certificate for reliability, that the government will examine feasibility with other ministries and report before summer.
I cannot yet commit to a legal amendment, because it must first be clear what the consequences are in legal, practical and ICT terms.
Een wetswijziging kan ik op dit moment nog niet toezeggen, omdat eerst duidelijk moet zijn welke gevolgen dit in juridische, praktische en ICT-technische zin heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de verlopen vergunning voor medisch noodtransport vanaf Sint Eustatius

An MP asked about the lapsed permit that stopped the Sint Eustatius trauma helicopter from flying night medical missions, how it happened, and how to prevent recurrence. The government explained that a 2017 permit lapsed unnoticed, that no medical complications occurred, and that a temporary permit was issued in January 2019 with a formal review to follow, plus internal investigation and process reforms.
As for why no application was made after the ILT's first warning in December 2017, an internal investigation is underway at the public body of Sint Eustatius.
Naar de vraag waarom niet over is gegaan tot aanvraag na de eerste verwittiging van de ILT in december 2017 loopt intern onderzoek bij het openbaar lichaam Sint Eustatius.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘Behoud gebouwen schietbanen Leusderheide’

Two CDA MPs asked the government whether it values the former Leusderheide shooting-range buildings as cultural-historical military heritage and what Defence and the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf are doing to preserve them. The minister replied that no specific reuse or demolition plans exist, the buildings are in the maintenance programme, and a final position will follow a broader heritage vision and action plan.

Based on the coherent vision and action plan for management, preservation, research and public presentation of Second World War heritage and archaeology that I promised you, I will determine my position.

Op basis van de samenhangende visie en het actieplan voor beheer, behoud, onderzoek en aan een breed publiek tonen van erfgoed en archeologie uit de Tweede Wereldoorlog dat ik u heb toegezegd, zal ik mijn standpunt bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Diertens en Bouali over het bericht 'Caribische eilanden kunnen grotere toestroom Venezolanen verwachten'

MPs Groothuizen, Diertens and Bouali asked whether UNHCR projections of a rising Venezuelan refugee flow to the Caribbean reflect a real threat, and about funding, detention, asylum procedures and rights on Aruba and Curaçao. The government answered that the UNHCR figures cover the wider Caribbean, that interceptions fell in 2018, that Curaçao has requested assistance on detention and the asylum procedure, and that asylum applications are assessed individually.

The Ministry of Justice and Security asks the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for a country report when a high number of asylum applications from nationals of a given country is lodged in the Netherlands.

Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid vraagt het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken om een ambtsbericht als er in Nederland een hoog aantal asielaanvragen wordt ingediend van personen uit een bepaald land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Von Martels en Omtzigt over de brand bij een Duitse kerncentrale vlakbij de Nederlandse grens

MPs from the CDA asked why the Dutch government and safety regions were not informed about a fire at a nuclear fuel plant in Lingen, Germany, and how the incident was classified and would be evaluated. The state secretary answered that the fire was not at the Emsland plant, no radioactive release occurred, it was provisionally classed INES-0, and the Veiligheidsregio Twente will evaluate it and share the findings with parliament.
The Veiligheidsregio Twente has indicated that it will evaluate this incident and involve the ANVS, the DCC IenW and the NCC (JenV).
De Veiligheidsregio Twente heeft aangegeven dit incident te gaan evalueren en daarbij de ANVS, het DCC IenW en het NCC (JenV) te zullen betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het graaigedrag rondom een Nederlandse topambtenaar op Curaçao

An SP MP asked why a senior Dutch civil servant received a foreign-posting allowance of 2,319 euro per day present for 18 days of work over nine months despite living in the Netherlands, and whether the excess will be recovered. The government answered only by referring to an earlier letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 35 000 VII and IV, nr. 89), without addressing the questions on substance.

The written questions from MP Van Raak (SP), question number 2018Z21681, were answered by means of the letter 'The profiteering around a Dutch senior civil servant on Curaçao' (Parliamentary paper 35 000 VII and 35 000 IV, no. 89).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Raak(SP), vraagnummer 2018Z21681 , zijn beantwoord middels brief «Het graaigedrag rondom een Nederlandse topambtenaar op Curaçao» (Kamerstuk 35 000 VII en 35 000 IV, nr. 89 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Groothuizen over gouden paspoorten en visa

MPs Den Boer and Groothuizen asked whether golden passports and golden visas, which let wealthy investors obtain EU residence or citizenship, pose crime and terrorism risks and whether the Netherlands should abolish its investor residence permit. The government acknowledged the risk if screening is inadequate, said Dutch investor permits are strictly checked, and promised an evaluation of the Modern Migration Policy Act in Q2 2019 and participation in EU-level discussion.
Based on this evaluation, it can in due course be assessed whether it is desirable to adjust admission schemes.
Op basis van deze evaluatie kan te zijner tijd worden beoordeeld of het wenselijk is dat toelatingsregelingen worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over de berichten ‘pilots met Idensys stopt per 31 december 2018’ en ’Einde pilot inloggen met Idensys en iDIN’

An MP asks the State Secretary whether he remembers written questions from 7 December 2018 about reports that the Idensys and iDIN login pilots would end, and whether he will answer them before a committee debate on e-identity and passports. The answer states that the original questions have been answered in the parliamentary appendix and does not address the substance of the reports.
The written questions from MP Middendorp (VVD), question number 2019Z01312, have been answered in the Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1427.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Middendorp (VVD), vraagnummer 2019Z01312 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1427 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over de berichten ‘pilots met Idensys stopt per 31 december 2018’ en ’Einde pilot inloggen met Idensys en iDIN’

The MP asked why pilots with private login means Idensys and iDIN were stopped on 31 December 2018, how many users were involved, and about the evaluation and next steps. The State Secretary answered that the pilots were ended to clear the way for a tender for private login means for (semi)public services, that 39,146 means were issued (6,004 by Idensys, 33,142 iDIN), and that the evaluation by the Kuipers committee was used.
I have no picture of the costs that companies incurred for participating in the pilots.
Ik heb geen beeld van de kosten die bedrijven hebben gemaakt voor de deelname aan de pilots.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Geen M of V, maar X: voor het eerst paspoort veranderd in genderneutraal’

MPs Den Boer and Bergkamp asked whether a court ruling allowing an 'X' gender marker in a passport means others can get it via their municipality, and what legal changes are needed. The Secretary of State answered that an X marker is only possible for people whose sex cannot be determined at birth, requiring a court order to amend the birth certificate, and that the government sees no need for legislative change for now.
In these cases, assessment by a judge remains necessary to amend the birth certificate.
In deze gevallen blijft een beoordeling door de rechter noodzakelijk om tot een wijziging van de geboorteakte te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van Oosten over het bericht ‘Nederlandse vingerafdrukken gedeeld met FBI’

Two VVD MPs asked whether Dutch fingerprint data shared with the FBI under the PCSC treaty, the alleged 2011 destruction of a national fingerprint database, and the case for a new central database are justified. The government answered that no central fingerprint database was ever created, that passport fingerprints are deleted after issuance and not shared, and that a central database would require amending the Paspoortwet, while not committing to any such change.
The article wrongly claims that a national fingerprint database was destroyed in 2011.
Het artikel stelt ten onrechte dat er in 2011 een landelijke databank met vingerafdrukken is vernietigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Helvert over parkeerplaatsen bij het belastingkantoor in Maastricht

CDA MPs Ronnes and Van Helvert asked why the Tax Office in Maastricht does not open its car park to the public outside office hours and whether they would seek a solution with stakeholders. State Secretary Knops answered that security, safety and vandalism concerns, plus a higher FIOD security regime, mean the Tax Office will not admit third parties, while the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and Tax Office will study shared use of space at other sites.
The Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and the Tax Office will jointly examine the possibility of multiple use of space and map what is feasible at locations where the Tax Office is the user.

Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf en de Belastingdienst zullen samen de mogelijkheid tot meervoudig ruimtegebruik onderzoeken en in beeld brengen wat er mogelijk is bij locaties waar de Belastingdienst de gebruiker is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de afvalbranden op Sint Maarten

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for the Kingdom about toxic smoke from waste fires at the Sint Maarten dump, including whether test results were being withheld and why the Word Bank decision on the problem was slow. The State Secretary answered that Sint Maarten is responsible for measurements and publication, that Netherlands RIVM will conduct health measurements in January 2019 at Sint Maarten's request, and that the World Bank will publish its report shortly.
Carrying out measurements and communicating their results are primarily the responsibility of the autonomous country of Sint Maarten.
Het verrichten van metingen en het communiceren over de resultaten daarvan behoren primair tot de verantwoordelijkheden van het autonome land Sint Maarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Helvert over internet langs de grens in Schinveld

MPs Van der Molen and Van Helvert asked why residents of Schinveld lost internet access despite permits, and whether a cross-border solution would be pursued. The State Secretary replied that the government did not cut any existing connection, explained the wiretap and 112 conditions for a new network, and said talks with Agentschap Telecom and residents are ongoing with a progress update promised.
However, there has been no question of the government cutting the existing internet connection, nor any intention to do so.
Van het verbreken van de (bestaande) verbinding met internet door de Nederlandse overheid is echter geen sprake geweest, evenmin van een intentie daartoe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het levend ontvinnen van een haai in Caribisch gebied

MP Wassenberg asked the minister about a video showing fishermen in Curaçao finning a live shark, whether the EU ban applies there, and what steps will be taken on the shark reserve, strategy and ICCAT. The minister answered that Curaçao is a national matter, the shark reserve and Curaçao's commitment are not yet implemented, and the national shark strategy will be sent to parliament in Q1 2019 with some commitments to pursue a global finning ban.
It is not for me to address the Curaçao government on this, as it is a matter for the country.
Het is niet aan mij om de Curaçaose regering hierop aan te spreken daar het een landsaangelegenheid betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Beveiliging data fiscus ondermaats’

MPs Lodders and Middendorp asked about press reports that the tax authority cannot technically secure personal data, and about logging, data location, staff training and AVG compliance. The State Secretary of Finance answers that the limitation concerns only logging of data use once extracted to staff workstations in one department, that measures have been taken, and that an Analytical Data Perimeter will be introduced in 2019.
Actions with data in the central data environment of DF&A are logged and monitored.
Handelingen met gegevens in de centrale dataomgeving van DF&A worden wel gelogd en gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Raak over de vluchtelingencrisis op Curaçao

SP MPs asked whether Curaçao requested Dutch help during the Venezuelan migrant crisis, what aid could be given, and whether returning migrants to Venezuela was part of the border-reopening deal. The State Secretary answered that Curaçao requested support, that the Netherlands provided expertise visits and a EUR 132,000 detention contribution pending a proposal, and that returns to Venezuela were not part of the agreement.
This is also not part of the agreement, which was published on the central government website following the Zembla FOI request.
Dit is ook geen onderdeel van het akkoord dat n.a.v. het WOB-verzoek van Zembla is gepubliceerd op de website van de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de penitentiaire inrichting Sint Maarten

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations about the Raad voor de Rechtshandhaving report finding Point Blanche prison in Sint Maarten unfit for detention, unsafe, and ignoring CPT recommendations, and whether the Kingdom's guarantee function under Article 43 of the Statute should be invoked. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, said Sint Maarten is responsible for detention and must meet the 2017 post-Irma aid commitments, and that the guarantee function is a last resort not yet warranted given the 19 October 2018 agreement on short-term improvement measures.
Detention is a national affair of Sint Maarten.
Het detentiewezen is een landsaangelegenheid van Sint Maarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Den Boer over de Verordening mechanisme om juridische en administratieve belemmeringen in een grensoverschrijdende context uit de weg te ruimen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for the status of the EU regulation on a mechanism to remove legal and administrative obstacles in cross-border situations, including negotiation positions and next steps. The State Secretary answered that the Commission proposal is with member states, the Dutch position is set out in a BNC fiche, the Austrian presidency will not put it on the agenda this year, and the Kamer will be informed periodically in quarterly reports.
I will inform the Kamer periodically through the usual information channels about developments regarding this proposal.
Ik zal de Kamer via de gebruikelijke informatievoorziening periodiek informeren over de ontwikkelingen met betrekking tot dit voorstel
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Diertens over het rapport 'Opgesloten en uitgezet' van Amnesty International

MPs Groothuizen and Diertens asked the State Secretaries about the Amnesty report on detention and expulsion of Venezuelans in the Caribbean Kingdom islands, covering numbers, UNHCR registration, asylum procedures, detention conditions, and independent investigation. The government answered that Curaçao is responsible for its own asylum and detention matters, confirmed it will not commission independent investigations there, and offered only support for optimising Curaçao's Article 3 ECHR procedure.
The constitutional relations within the Kingdom do not allow me to unilaterally commission research into matters that concern an autonomous responsibility of the country of Curaçao.

De staatkundige verhoudingen binnen het Koninkrijk staan mij niet toe om eenzijdig onderzoek te laten verrichten naar zaken die betrekking hebben op een autonome verantwoordelijkheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over erfpacht

An MP from D66 asked for a full history of the leasehold (erfpacht) situation on the Wadden islands, including the Groothuis, Van der Werf and RVB valuation reports, the commitments made to parliament and leaseholders, the scientific-integrity assessment of the RVB valuation method, and the legal protection of leaseholders. The State Secretary answered that Staatsbosbeheer has offered most leaseholders a sale or continued lease, that the LOWI complaints were declared unfounded so the RVB method is not in question for the government, and that leaseholders' interests are protected by civil law and general principles of good governance.

There is now a court case brought by a number of leaseholders in which the valuation method used by the RVB is being challenged. I am awaiting the outcome of this procedure and will inform you about it in due course.

Thans is sprake van een door een aantal erfpachters aangespannen gerechtelijke procedure waarin de door het RVB gebruikte taxatiemethode ter discussie wordt gesteld. Ik wacht de uitkomsten van deze procedure af en zal u er te zijner tijd over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Diertens over het rapport 'Duurzame en betaalbare energie in Caribisch Nederland'

Two D66 MPs asked whether geothermal exploration permits on Saba, granted by the island council to Teranova rather than via EZK and the Staatscourant, comply with the Mijnwet BES, and what the legal consequence would be. The minister answered that the Mijnwet BES contains no geothermal rules, so responsibility lies with Saba's public body, and promised to consider amending the law and consult the public bodies concerned.
I will examine how the granting of geothermal permits for the BES islands can be anchored and whether an amendment of the Mijnwet BES is desirable.
Ik zal bezien hoe de vergunningverlening rond geothermie voor de BES eilanden verankerd kan worden en of daarbij een aanpassing van de Mijnwet BES gewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het recht zich te vergissen

An MP (D66) asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs whether the Netherlands should introduce a French-style 'right to make mistakes' for citizens, and what consequences and costs this would have. The State Secretary says the principle appeals to him and that existing Dutch law already allows leniency, but that a general statutory right is not opportune given the Council of State's advice; he will convene a roundtable on the human scale of administrative enforcement and will only study costs if that leads to a general right.
In view of the above and the Council of State's advice, it does not appear opportune to amend the law in the Netherlands to introduce a general right to make mistakes.
Gezien het bovenstaande en het advies van de Raad van State lijkt het niet opportuun in Nederland een wetswijziging door te voeren in de zin van introductie van een algemeen recht op zich vergissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de reactie van Bonaire op het 'onderzoek ijkpunt sociaal minimum Caribisch Nederland en kabinetsreactie'

An MP asks whether Bonaire's island council was properly consulted on the Regioplan minimum-living-standard study and cabinet response, and whether its objections were taken into account. The State Secretary answers that consultation was carried out through the required channels, that the study's design was agreed with a steering group including Bonaire, and that Bonaire's objections were not all accepted, with talks on a governance agreement continuing.
As I indicated in my letter to the Bonaire executive board, I have held various discussions in recent period with the members of the executive board and the island council of Bonaire.

Zoals ik in mijn brief aan het bestuurscollege van Bonaire heb aangegeven, heb ik in de afgelopen periode diverse gesprekken met (de leden van) het bestuurscollege en de eilandsraad van Bonaire gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Nog steeds post van overledenen naar berichtenbox’

An MP asked the State Secretary for the Interior about digital post addressed to deceased persons still arriving in citizens' mailboxes and whether relatives are adequately helped. The State Secretary reported a roundtable with government bodies, a planned fix via linking MijnOverheid to the civil registry by early 2019, and promised improved online information and municipal outreach on handling post for the deceased.
I recognise the picture painted by the National Ombudsman.
Ik herken het beeld dat door de Nationale ombudsman wordt geschetst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht “Capgemini schikt ict-fiasco SVB voor 20,2 miljoen”

An MP asked whether settlements between ministries and ICT suppliers after failed ICT projects should be disclosed to Parliament, how many such settlements occurred in five years, and whether ministries must report them to the CIO Rijk. The minister agreed transparency is desirable, said no government-wide rules on disclosing settlements exist, and committed to ask the CIO Rijk to agree rules with departments and to include an annual overview of reported settlements in the annual Rijk operations report.
Specifically regarding the sharing of such settlement information with your House, no government-wide agreements have been made.
Specifiek over het delen van dergelijke schikkingsinformatie met uw Kamer zijn geen rijksbrede afspraken gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Premier Sint Maarten mengt zich in strafzaak Theo Heyliger'

MP Bosman asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about the Sint Maarten Prime Minister's public remarks on the Heyliger criminal case, which called for oversight of the public prosecutor and raised concerns about political influence. The State Secretary answered that such remarks are highly unusual and inappropriate in a rule-of-law state, and that he had conveyed this to the Prime Minister directly.

I share the view that it is highly unusual and inappropriate for a prime minister in a constitutional state to make this kind of statement, and I conveyed this to Prime Minister Leona Marlin-Romeo during my visit to Sint Maarten on 4 September.
Ik deel de mening dat het hoogst ongebruikelijk en ongepast is dat een premier in een rechtsstaat dit soort uitlatingen doet en heb Minister-President Leona Marlin-Romeo dit ook zo laten weten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over het bericht ’Grote ICT-projecten overheid zeker €1 mrd duurder dan begroot’

An MP (Middendorp, VVD) asked the Interior Minister about a Financieel Dagblad report that large government ICT projects are at least €1 billion over budget, covering cost causes, budgeting, the BIT review body and the Elias commission's estimates. The minister answered that the figure mixes multi-year re-estimates with other costs, promised a letter in autumn on improving cost estimates, and said no overview of projects at risk exists.
I cannot do that without going into the individual case details of each project.
Dat kan ik niet zonder op de individuele casuïstiek van ieder project in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de verantwoordelijkheid van het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden voor de uitstoot van de Isla-raffinaderij

An MP asked whether the Kingdom of the Netherlands can be held responsible for human rights violations caused by emissions from the Isla refinery on Curaçao, and whether the Kingdom should intervene. The State Secretary acknowledged the report, but said responsibility for policy and enforcement lies with Curaçao, that human rights questions are before a court there, and that the Netherlands only assists on request.
Responsibility for policy aimed at the Isla refinery and for enforcing the applicable environmental standards rests with the autonomous country of Curaçao.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het beleid gericht op de Isla-raffinaderij en voor handhaving van de geldende milieunormen berust bij het autonome land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over Opinie 7/2018 van de Europese databeschermingsautoriteit (EDPS) over het voorstel om vingerafdrukken op ID-kaarten op te nemen

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary about the EDPS opinion 7/2018 criticising the proposed mandatory fingerprint storage on EU identity cards and its proportionality. The State Secretary agreed fingerprints are sensitive data, said Netherlands will keep questioning proportionality in negotiations, and promised to raise the issue again at the 14 September working group, while deferring to existing purpose-limitation rules.
In response to this and to the opinion of the European Data Protection Supervisor (EDPS), I will continue to raise the proportionality of mandatory fingerprint collection.

Naar aanleiding hiervan en naar aanleiding van de opinie van de European Data Protection Supervisor (EDPS) 1 blijf ik de proportionaliteit van de verplichte afname van vingerafdrukken aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Van Tongeren over het bericht 'Klagen over ongelijke behandeling kan niet in Caribisch Nederland'

MPs Özütok and Van Tongeren asked whether complaints about unequal treatment can be lodged in Caribbean Netherlands, given that equal-treatment law does not apply there, and which rights protections are missing. Minister Ollongren answered that residents can still go to court under the Constitution, international treaties and the BWBES, that the government considers legislative restraint necessary, and that an exploration of extending equal-treatment legislation to the islands will be carried out.

I intend, partly in response to the College's recommendation in its report 'Five years College for Human Rights', to have an exploration carried out into the possibility of introducing equal-treatment legislation in Caribbean Netherlands.

Ik ben, mede naar aanleiding van de aanbeveling van het College in zijn rapport «Vijf jaar College voor de Rechten van de Mens», voornemens om een verkenning te laten uitvoeren naar de mogelijkheid om de gelijkebehandelingswetgeving in te voeren in Caribisch Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de herleidbare vermelding van het persoonlijke Burgerservicenummer (BSN) op de voorzijde van het paspoort

An MP asked whether the BSN printed on the front of post-2014 passports, which enables identity fraud, should be removed from the front of passports. The State Secretary acknowledged the risk, explained the ICAO-based reasons for the current placement, and committed to moving the BSN off the machine-readable zone at the next passport revision, pending agreement on timing with agencies.
Yes, I intend to remove the BSN from the MRZ and make it automatically readable on the back of the passport data page and identity cards.
Ja, ik ben voornemens het BSN uit de MRZ te halen en automatisch uitleesbaar te maken op de achterzijde van de houderpagina van paspoorten en identiteitskaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht 'Rijbewijs vanaf 4 juni met toepassing inloggen DigiD'

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that driving licences issued from 4 June 2018 carry a DigiD login chip before the Digital Government Act is in force, and whether citizens can use it and need the municipality to activate it. The State Secretary confirmed the chip rollout, said the login function will be usable once the pilot succeeds and the relevant law provisions take effect (expected 2019), and that citizens activate it online without the municipality.
Since 4 June, driving licences with this new chip are being issued.
Sinds 4 juni worden rijbewijzen met deze nieuwe chip uitgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van den Berg en Ronnes over het bericht ‘Centrale Bank van Curaçao plaatst Ennia onder curatele’

MPs Van den Berg and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister whether DNB had earlier warnings about Ennia, what steps it took, whether policyholders were informed, and about Ennia's market share and hurricane claims. The minister declined to give details on DNB's warnings and actions citing its statutory confidentiality duty, said Curaçao's central bank (CBCS) is responsible for prudential supervision of Ennia, and refused to comment on consequences for policyholders in another country.

Partly because of this statutory confidentiality duty, and because as Minister I in principle do not receive information on individual institutions supervised by DNB, it is not possible to answer the questions about the content of warnings and any steps taken.

Vanwege onder meer deze geheimhoudingsplicht -en vanwege mijn systeemverantwoordelijkheid als Minister – waarbij geldt dat ik in principe geen informatie over individuele onder toezicht staande instellingen van DNB ontvang – is het niet mogelijk om de vragen over de inhoud van waarschuwingen en eventueel genomen stappen te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de bestuurlijke impasse op Bonaire

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked whether the administrative deadlock on Bonaire is too long, why trust in the island council and executive members is warranted, whether investment is wasted while duties are neglected, and whether the State Secretary will intervene temporarily under the Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba Public Bodies Act. The State Secretary acknowledged the deadlock must be broken, pointed to agreed steps for a governing agreement soon after the summer, said the executive bears responsibility for good governance as a condition for further investment, and declined to intervene because existing structures do not prevent solutions.
Clear agreements have been made with the Executive Board on a governing agreement to be concluded, in which a large number of existing administrative knots will be untangled.
Met het Bestuurscollege zijn heldere afspraken gemaakt over een te sluiten bestuursakkoord waarin een groot aantal bestaande bestuurlijke knopen wordt ontward.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Kustwacht Bonaire niet versterkt'

MP Bosman asked ministers whether the coast guard presence around Bonaire should be expanded amid Venezuelan migration, and what the Raad voor de Rechtshandhaving report implies. The government answers that the Kustwachtcommissie presidium found extra deployment not currently needed, that the coast guard already operates about 309 presence days in 2017 and intercepted 99 illegal migrants in early 2018, and that a contingency plan exists.
The presidium of the Kustwachtcommissie discussed the governor's letter at two of its meetings and concluded that additional deployment is currently not necessary.
Het presidium van de Kustwachtcommissie heeft in twee van zijn vergaderingen over de brief van de gezaghebber gesproken en geconcludeerd dat extra inzet thans niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over agrarische panden

Two VVD MPs asked why the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (Dutch state property agency) let maintenance of its leased farm buildings lapse, why it does not sell them, and which conditions apply. The State Secretary answered that the agency manages 164 farms, has an inspection and maintenance plan for 2018 after a 2017 letter to tenants, and maintains a policy of not selling farm buildings, while knowing of no operational hindrance from the maintenance backlog.

Because there is a backlog in maintenance of agricultural buildings, the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf notified all tenants of agricultural buildings by letter on 14 September 2017 that they could report faults and problems to a national fault line.

Omdat er een achterstand is in het onderhoud van agrarische gebouwen heeft het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf op 14 september 2017 alle pachters van agrarische gebouwen per brief gemeld dat zij melding kunnen maken van storingen en problemen op een landelijk storingsnummer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Arno Rutte, Middendorp en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Agentschap Telecom slaat alarm over hackbare apparaten’

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government shares the Agentschap Telecom's call to hurry a security mark for 'smart' connected devices, how it is progressing, and related questions on consumer visibility, ISP involvement, company-led certification and innovation. The government answers that it supports a European CE-type mark with mandatory minimum digital security requirements under the Radio Equipment Directive, that it has proposed this in Europe, and that it is working with ISPs and on EU cybersecurity certification.

Together with the European Commission, the cabinet is examining how to give effect to the aforementioned possibility of extending the current CE mark of the RED with minimum digital security requirements for wireless devices.

Met de Europese Commissie onderzoekt het kabinet hoe invulling te gegeven aan voornoemde mogelijkheid om het huidige CE-keurmerk van de RED uit te breiden met minimale eisen aan de digitale veiligheid van draadloze apparaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Wie koopt bunker van nazi-topman Seyss-Inquart?'

An MP asked whether the Julianabunker (Seyss-Inquart's command bunker, a rijksmonument) and its cultural-historical value will be protected when the state sells it, and why it is not maintained to standard. The government says the monument's heritage value is protected under the Erfgoedwet and the Nota van Uitgangspunten, that sale goes by open tender with heritage-respecting plans, and that storm damage repair is delayed by a power-supply split.
The repair of this damage will take place soon, after connection to the regular power network.
Het herstel van deze schade zal binnenkort plaatsvinden, na aansluiting op het reguliere stroomnetwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Waarom dode mensen post van de belasting krijgen’

An MP asked why deceased persons keep receiving digital government mail and DigiD accounts remain active after death, and what heirs can do. The Secretary of State explained the complexity, admitted it is undesirable, said heirs can ask agencies to stop mailings, and committed to a round-table with agencies and further measures including an heirs' authorisation under the Machtigen programme.
I want to make agreements with government organisations soon to put an end to this undesirable situation.
Ik wil binnenkort met overheidsorganisaties afspraken maken om aan deze ongewenste situatie een einde te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de vrees van de Arubaanse premier dat Aruba een tweede Syrië aan het worden is als gevolg van de instroom van Venezolanen

An MP asked the State Secretary about the Aruban Prime Minister's claim that Aruba is becoming a second Syria due to Venezuelan inflows, and about related figures on migrants, weapons smuggling and Kustwacht interceptions. The State Secretary answered that the government sees no imminent mass migration, disputed the quoted statements, gave interception figures, and said cost-sharing from Curaçao for the Kustwacht was still outstanding.
I am not aware of any concrete figures on the number of Venezuelans who have left for the Leeward Islands in recent years.
Mij zijn geen concrete cijfers bekend over het aantal Venezolanen dat de laatste jaren naar de Benedenwindse Eilanden is vertrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van den Berg over kinderrechten in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Diertens and Van den Berg asked whether funding exists to support families with children in Caribbean Netherlands, how child poverty will be tackled there, and how the social minimum and the 1 July 2018 deadline will be met. The government replied that the claim of no funding is premature, that a benchmark study on subsistence security is pending with a reaction to follow, and that BZK is involved through its coordinating role.
A study into a benchmark for subsistence security in Caribbean Netherlands has been promised to both chambers of the States General.
Aan de beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal is een onderzoek naar een ijkpunt voor de bestaanszekerheid in Caribisch Nederland toegezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over het bericht ‘RVB wil dat onjuiste pachtnota's betaald worden’

MPs Middendorp and Lodders asked why the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf sent tenants invoices and reminders for April 2018 based on outdated rent percentages, and what would be done about payment pressure and liquidity risk. The Staatssecretaris admitted a process step was wrongly skipped, apologised, committed to no automatic follow-up calls and to stopping collection with interest refunds.

When sending the invoices for rent for the period 1 October 2017 to 30 April 2018, it was not possible to implement in time in the administrative systems the rent price adjustments applying from 1 July 2017.

Bij het verzenden van de facturen voor de pacht over de periode 1 oktober 2017 t/m 30 april 2018 is het niet gelukt om de aanpassingen van de pachtprijzen die gelden vanaf 1 juli 2017 tijdig in de administratieve systemen door te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over het bericht 'Nieuwe pachtrekeningen door softwarefout'

MPs Middendorp and Lodders asked the State Secretary about reports that Rijksvastgoedbedrijf farm rent invoices failed to apply July 2017 rent adjustments due to a process step being skipped (not a software bug), why this surfaced late, poor reachability and itemised invoicing. The government admitted the error, apologised, promised corrections and contact channels, and said a letter on rent policy would follow.
All tenants have now received a letter about the rent adjustment that was not implemented, apologising for how matters unfolded.
Inmiddels hebben alle pachters een brief ontvangen over de niet doorgevoerde pachtprijsherziening, waarin excuses worden aangeboden over de gang van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Diertens over het rapport ‘Duurzame en betaalbare energie in Caribisch Nederland’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about results, targets, timelines and affordability of renewable energy in the Caribbean Netherlands following a report. The minister replied island by island (Saba, Sint Eustatius, Bonaire), noting new solar and wind capacity, prioritising reliability and affordability on Bonaire, and stating that small consumers have an affordable tariff though not a cheap one.
A sustainable energy supply is of great importance in the Caribbean Netherlands, as are safety, security of supply and affordability.
Een duurzame energievoorziening is van groot belang in Caribisch Nederland, evenals veiligheid, leveringszekerheid en betaalbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Diertens over de stijging van water- en elektriciteitstarieven op Bonaire

MPs Jetten and Diertens asked the ministers about rising water and electricity tariffs on Bonaire and whether low-consumption households are unfairly burdened. The government answered that it has provided subsidies, is preparing a short-term amendment to the Wet elektriciteit en drinkwater BES to restore a discount for small consumers, and will examine tariff options, while stating that the subsidy does not imply dependence on the Netherlands.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Grenswerkers klem tussen Nederlandse en Duitse belastingdienst’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Interior about reports that cross-border workers are caught between Dutch and German tax authorities, including rising problem cases, information provision, DGA salary double taxation, and capacity. The government denies a clear rise in problems, says information provision is adequate and monitored, sees no need for new Germany-specific agreements or additional measures now, and commits only to continued monitoring.
However, there are no figures available on all cases where problems arise from differing interpretation of those tax rules in relation to Germany.
Er zijn echter geen cijfers beschikbaar van alle gevallen waar zich problemen voordoen door verschillende interpretatie van die (belasting)regels in relatie tot Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Leijten over het bericht dat ouderen er de dupe van zijn dat er bij sommige gemeenten alleen gepind kan worden

MPs Van Raak and Leijten asked whether it is wrong that some municipalities accept only card payments, which can hurt elderly people and debt-restructuring clients, and whether the government will force municipalities and public bodies to accept cash. The minister agrees that card-only payment should not block access to official documents and is willing to consult municipalities and public bodies on accepting cash, but does not commit to binding measures.
I am willing to consult further with municipalities and public institutions on the acceptance of cash.
Ik ben bereid tot nader overleg met de gemeenten en publieke instellingen over de acceptatie van contant geld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over de berichten 'Debacle met digitale rechtspraak was voorzienbaar' en 'Digitalisering blijft steken'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary of Interior about press reports on failed digitalisation, including the Commission-Elias follow-up, ICT dependence on large suppliers, open source, and the role of the BIT. The government answered that the Programma Digitaal 2017 was effective and efficient within its frame, that most Elias recommendations were implemented, and that further steps (open source policy, digitalisation agenda) will follow.
The BIT will continue to give attention to the learning effect of BIT advice and ensure that accumulated knowledge and skills remain disseminated.
Het BIT blijft aandacht geven aan het lerend effect van BIT-adviezen en ervoor zorgen dat de opgebouwde kennis en kunde verspreid blijven worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Algoritme voorspelt wie fraude pleegt bij bijstandsuitkering’

MPs Raemakers and Verhoeven asked whether municipalities use algorithms to detect welfare benefit fraud, which firms supply them, what data is used, and how discrimination and transparency are controlled. The state secretary answered that data-driven enforcement is supported within legal limits, that the algorithm may be withheld to protect detection methods, that data comes from municipal benefit records, and that a BZK study on government algorithms is expected in the second half of 2018.
In the interest of protecting the modus operandi for detecting fraud, the municipal executive may decide not to release the algorithm.
In het belang van het beschermen van de modus operandi om fraude op te sporen, kan door het college worden besloten het algoritme niet vrij te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht 'Stapels werk door nieuwe eisen toegankelijkheid'

An MP asked the State Secretary of the Interior about reports that new accessibility rules for government websites create a backlog, and about the current state of accessibility at national, provincial, municipal and water board level. The State Secretary answered that a temporary decree will make accessibility statements mandatory, that many public bodies have not yet fully complied, and that he will support bodies and inform the House on progress, without a fixed September 2018 deadline for action plans.
Of course I am willing to inform the House about the progress in implementing the temporary decree on digital accessibility of government.
Uiteraard ben ik wel bereid om de Kamer te informeren over de voortgang van de uitvoering van het tijdelijk besluit toegankelijkheid digitale overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Wörsdörfer en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Kabinet zet koppositie ICT op het spel, waarschuwt Eelco Blok’

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether they agreed with Eelco Blok's claim that the cabinet lacks a long-term ICT vision and risks Dutch digital leadership, and asked about spectrum auction timing and the national digitalisation strategy. The government disputed the claim, pointed to Dutch strengths and the coming Digitaliseringsstrategie, and confirmed that auction dates and the 3.5 GHz options would be sent to parliament before the relevant recesses.
To be able to lead in the coming years, the coalition agreement contains the necessary ambitions and actions regarding digitalisation.
Om de komende jaren voorop te kunnen lopen, bevat het regeerakkoord de nodige ambities en acties bevat als het gaat om digitalisering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de opvang van Venezolanen op Aruba en Curaçao en de Nederlandse bijstand daarbij

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about the reception of Venezuelans on Aruba and Curaçao and Dutch assistance, including requests for support, UNHCR's call for prima facie refugee status, the emergency plan for Bonaire, official counts of Venezuelans, and onward travel to the Netherlands. The government answered that Curaçao has requested support for a possible emergency, that asylum admission and expulsion is a national (country-level) matter with Dutch expertise offered, that protection claims are assessed individually, that official figures on undocumented Venezuelans are unavailable while registered numbers are given, and that Venezuelans need a temporary residence permit to stay in the Netherlands beyond 90 days.
I have informed the government of Curaçao that the Netherlands will, should such a case arise, provide support where possible, for example in the form of knowledge and expertise on migration.

Ik heb de regering van Curaçao laten weten dat Nederland – mocht zo’n geval zich voordoen – waar mogelijk ondersteuning zal bieden, bijvoorbeeld in de vorm van kennis en expertise op bijvoorbeeld het terrein van migratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de steun van Nederland ten behoeve van detentie en uitzetting van ongedocumenteerden op Curaçao

An MP asked whether the Netherlands offered Curaçao 100,000 euro for detention of undocumented migrants, what aid was offered, whether it is voluntary, how many migrants await removal, and whether Venezuelan migrants are registered. The government confirmed a voluntary contribution of 132,000 euro for additional detention capacity plus expert support, and gave detention and registration figures from Curaçao and Aruba authorities.
The support mentioned under answer 2 is not an obligation but a voluntary contribution.
De onder antwoord 2 genoemde steun betreft geen verplichting, maar een vrijwillige bijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Tongeren over het bericht: ‘Woningstichting FCB ‘not amused’ over opstelling Knops’

MPs Voortman and Van Tongeren asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about reports that the Bonaire housing foundation FCB is 'not amused' by his refusal to provide a state guarantee for social housing loans, and about the housing shortage and tools across the Caribbean Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that he prefers alternatives to guarantees, that FCB's collaboration with Dutch housing corporations stalled, that the housing policy is an island-level task, and that the Housing Market Act implementation was postponed.
I will use the coming period to look into this further and to get back in contact with FCB.
Ik zal de komende periode gebruiken om mij hier verder in te verdiepen en opnieuw in contact treden met FCB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de proefboringen naar olie en gas op Aruba

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about the start of exploratory oil and gas drilling on Aruba, questioning whether a sustainable budget should come before creating funds for such revenues, and the role of the College Aruba Financieel Toezicht. The State Secretary answered that the use of possible oil and gas revenue is for Aruba to decide, shared concerns about Aruba's public finances and debt, and said he had asked the Aruban Finance Minister for a budget compliant with CAft recommendations, while the CAft advises on the financial implications of such policy choices.

In my conversation with the Aruban Minister of Finance, Ms. Ruiz-Maduro, on 22 March, I expressed these concerns and asked her to come as quickly as possible with a 2018 budget that complies with the recommendations of the College Aruba Financieel Toezicht (CAft).

In mijn gesprek met de Minister van Financiën van Aruba, mevrouw Ruiz-Maduro, op 22 maart jl. heb ik deze zorgen ook kenbaar gemaakt en heb ik haar gevraagd zo snel mogelijk te komen met een begroting 2018 welke voldoet aan de aanbevelingen van het College Aruba financieel toezicht (CAft).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Agnes Mulder over de enorme stijging van elektriciteitstarieven op Bonaire

CDA MPs asked why electricity tariffs on Bonaire rose about 24% from January 2018, whether they are cost-covering, and whether there is protection for vulnerable consumers. The minister said tariffs were previously kept artificially low by a subsidy funded by Dutch taxpayers, that the rise is mainly due to oil prices and network costs, that a subsidy will lower network tariffs and a bill for drinking water is being prepared, and that a usage-independent tariff is introduced on 1 April.
I am in discussion with WEB about how to deploy the subsidy.
Ik ben in gesprek met WEB over hoe de subsidie in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over het artikel 'Het voelt als dat bordspel: De Betoverende Doolhof'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about a newspaper article describing how cross-border workers face a maze of fiscal and social rules, and whether bilateral agreements could help without more EU involvement. The State Secretary answered that the government points to grensinfopunten, the Belastingdienst and SVB back offices, existing bilateral tax treaties with compensation schemes, and promised a letter on cross-border policy progress.

A letter on the state of cross-border policy, including progress on all action points on neighbouring-language and culture and accessibility drawn up in January 2017 for the cross-border economy and labour, I will send to your House ahead of the general consultation on cross-border cooperation of 25 April 2018.

Een brief over de stand van zaken van het grensoverschrijdend beleid met daarin de voortgang van alle actiepunten, waaronder buurtaal en -cultuur en bereikbaarheid, die voor de grensoverschrijdende economie en arbeid in januari 2017 zijn opgesteld, stuur ik voor het algemeen overleg over grensoverschrijdende samenwerking van 25 april 2018 naar uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over een gesprek met Professionalisering L.V.V. Bonaire

An MP asked the state secretary about the project to professionalise the agriculture service (L.V.V.) on Bonaire, its contribution to economic development, obstacles raised by the island authority, and available Dutch support. The government replied that the project would help reduce food import dependence, that a 2015 Memorandum of Understanding stalled after the island executive approved a different plan, and that it will consult the island authority and consider alternative initiatives.
The Ministry of LNV now wants first, together with my ministry, to consult the public body to examine how the LVV domain can be developed in the original sense of the MoU.

Het Ministerie van LNV wil nu eerst, samen met mijn ministerie, in overleg met het openbaar lichaam treden om te bezien op welke wijze het LVV terrein kan worden ontwikkeld in de oorspronkelijke zin van het MoU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de begroting van het Openbaar Lichaam Bonaire voor het dienstjaar 2017, inzake de Landbouw, Veeteelt en Visserij (L.V.V.)

Bosman (VVD) asked about the Bonaire budget for agriculture (LVV) for 2017, including the effect of spending, the reasons for flat revenues, whether maintenance funds were spent, which partners are involved, and agricultural development since 2010. The State Secretary answered that the funds are reserved, the spending will be checked in the 2017 accounts by the auditor, and questions on results are for the island government and the island council to assess.
