The reliability and lawfulness of the budget expenditures will be established during the audit of the 2017 annual accounts by the accountant.
De betrouwbaarheid en rechtmatigheid van de bestedingen van de begroting zal tijdens de controle van de jaarrekening 2017 door de accountant worden vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak “over goudsmokkel vanuit Venezuela naar Aruba, Curaçao en Bonaire”

MP Van Raak asked whether the government can claim no signals of gold smuggling from Venezuela via Aruba, Curaçao and Bonaire, given a recent Aruban gold smuggling case and earlier convictions. The State Secretary replied that he relies on information from the autonomous authorities, which report no signals, and that the Aruban case is under ongoing investigation so no statements can be made; he declined to say whether gold smuggling is being investigated.
Given that this concerns an ongoing investigation, no statements can therefore be made about this case.
Gelet op het feit dat het hier gaat om een lopend onderzoek, kunnen er derhalve geen uitspraken over deze zaak worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over het bericht 'Problemen met vloeren ministerie BZK: honderden inspecties, tijdelijke ontruiming en aanpassingen vereist'

An MP asked about structural floor problems and mandatory inspections at the Ministry of Interior's Turfmarkt 147 building, including why problems arose and what they will cost. The State Secretary answered that inspections of prefabricated floor slabs are ongoing until end of April, that the floors are safe for current use with load restrictions, and that costs cannot yet be estimated, with the Chamber to be informed after the studies conclude.
I will inform the Chamber as soon as possible after the investigations are concluded.
Ik zal de Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk na afronding van de onderzoeken informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Koopmans over de berichtgeving over het proefschrift van Marlies van Eck van de Tilburg University

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a PhD thesis finding that citizens are insufficiently legally protected against computer-driven financial decisions by government, and whether computer instructions should be open to third parties or reviewed by an independent body. The State Secretary answered that existing law already requires correctable, well-reasoned decisions, that the Wet Openbaarheid van Bestuur allows third parties to request source code, that an algorithms study is under way, and that no independent review body is planned.
In line with this practice, I see no reason for now to establish an independent body to assess source codes.
In lijn met deze praktijk zie ik vooralsnog geen reden om een onafhankelijke instelling in het leven te roepen voor de beoordeling van broncodes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de verantwoordelijkheid van Nederland voor de offshore en de gokindustrie op Aruba, Curaçao en Sint Maarten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations whether the Dutch government was responsible for offshore gambling on Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, including its supervision and enforcement before 2010 and the safeguards against money laundering. The government answered that licensing, supervision and enforcement of offshore gambling fall under the autonomous competence of those countries, and that Dutch cooperation and prosecution support exist, but it did not answer the historical questions substantively and said the questions sent to Curaçao in 2016 remain unanswered.
The drafting and adoption of a national ordinance is done by the government and parliament of Aruba, Curaçao or Sint Maarten.
Het opstellen en aannemen van een landsverordening geschiedt door de regering en het parlement van Aruba, Curaçao of Sint Maarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Diertens over het bericht ‘Kwetsbare gezinnen op Bonaire dupe van bezuinigingen’

MPs Van den Berg and Diertens asked whether Bonaire's planned 13% cut to housing foundation FCB's subsidy would hit vulnerable tenants and jeopardise plans for 500 social rental homes. The State Secretary confirmed the cut would raise rents for the lowest-income tenants, said it is a Bonaire island responsibility, and promised continued talks with the parties involved.
Housing market policy is an island-level task.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de begroting van het openbaar lichaam Bonaire voor het dienstjaar 2018

An MP asks the State Secretary whether a flat 13.25% subsidy cut in the 2018 Bonaire budget reflects good governance and whether it affects projects important to Bonairians. The State Secretary says the public body must present a balanced budget and that policy choices are its own, but acknowledges insufficient early informing of affected parties and reports that the island executive is reconsidering subsidy amounts for seven social institutions.
Given the great public outcry, my view is that this has now not been done sufficiently.
Getuige de grote maatschappelijke commotie, is mijn beeld dat dit nu onvoldoende is gebeurd.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van den Bosch over het bericht "Dit gaan ze niet leuk vinden, Rik’’

VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about a newspaper report on a website built from open government pesticide data, and whether it is the ministry's role to prevent or resolve such conflicts over open-data reuse in the digitalisation strategy. The minister answered that open data should be freely reusable by anyone, with or without profit, that the state remains responsible for its own use of data, and that the policy will not be changed.
Open data are made available without imposing requirements on their use by third parties.
Open data worden beschikbaar gesteld zonder eisen te stellen aan de toepassing door derden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Interim gezaghebber stapt per onmiddellijk op’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior about reports that the interim governor of Bonaire resigned immediately, whether this breaks trust, its consequences for governability, and what will be done to ensure stable governance. The State Secretary confirmed the resignation, said the relationship was disrupted but the governor agreed to serve until 1 February, saw no direct consequences for governability, and committed to a broadly supported action plan with the Bonaire executive after a visit.
I have called on the Bestuurscollege to improve this.
Het Bestuurscollege opgeroepen om dit te verbeteren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Koopmans over het bericht 'Online burgerinspraak kan leiden tot teleurstelling in politici' en het rapport van het Rathenau instituut 'Online meebeslissen'

MPs Middendorp and Koopmans asked the government about reports on the limited impact and unrepresentative participation of online citizen consultation, and about how digital participation is shaped and improved. The minister answered that internetconsultatie.nl is the main national tool, that low awareness of the site is acknowledged and being addressed, and that a digital democracy pilot with municipalities starts in April, while broader national measures await the Staatscommissie Parlementair Stelsel report.
For national-level digital participation, additional measures are being considered mainly in conjunction with the publication of the report of the State Committee on the Parliamentary System.

Voor wat betreft digitale participatie op het landelijke niveau worden aanvullende maatregelen m.n. bezien in samenhang met het verschijnen van het rapport van de Staatscommissie Parlementair Stelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de illegale goudsmokkel uit Venezuela

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for the Interior whether gold smuggling from Venezuela via Aruba, Curaçao and Bonaire occurs under military supervision, whether money laundering infrastructure exists, and which bodies should control it. The government answered that no official Venezuelan figures exist, that Aruban and Curaçaoan authorities report no known signals of smuggling, that customs and the Kustwacht carry out controls, and that Bonaire customs found no gold and the OM BES has no signals of such trade.
There are no signals known to the OM BES that point to illegal gold trade via Bonaire.
Er zijn bij het OM BES geen signalen bekend die wijzen op illegale handel in goud via Bonaire.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Meer gemeenten ruilen e-mail om voor online formulier’

An MP asked whether municipalities replacing email with online contact forms weakens accessibility, whether such forms deter citizens, whether excessive personal data (including gender) is requested, and how those without DigiD can reach government. The State Secretary answered that well-designed forms can preserve or improve accessibility, that municipalities must justify data requests under privacy law, that everyone should be able to contact government digitally and a right to digital communication will be added to the General Administrative Law Act, and that he is willing to discuss the topic with municipal, provincial and water board associations.
I am of the view that everyone must be able to contact the government digitally.
Ik ben van mening dat iedereen de overheid digitaal moet kunnen benaderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het rapport inzake Voorinvesteringen en medezeggenschap in het hoger onderwijs

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs why politicians in Sint Maarten receive the highest allowances in the Kingdom, how often their parliament meets, whether they are always paid at least one year of severance, and whether they will respond to a call to cut pay by thirty percent. The State Secretary answered that the allowances are a matter for Sint Maarten itself, pointed to a public attendance overview, confirmed the severance rule, and said he would raise the call in his own political contacts.
That is difficult to explain. An explanation for this will first have to be given by Sint Maarten, because the level of the allowances is a matter for the country.
Dat is moeilijk te verklaren. Een verklaring hiervoor zal allereerst gegeven moeten worden door Sint Maarten, omdat de hoogte van de vergoedingen een landsaangelegenheid betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Middendorp over het bericht ‘grenswerker schiet weinig op met Europese eenheid’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about barriers to cross-border labour in border regions, the growth potential, the EU's role and bilateral arrangements. The State Secretary pointed to a CPB study and an action agenda with partners, said the EU's role is mainly funding and support, and promised a progress report to the Tweede Kamer in spring 2018.
I will, in my previously announced progress report to the House of Representatives in spring 2018, go into greater detail on the progress of that.
Ik zal in mijn eerder aangekondigde voortgangsbericht aan de Tweede Kamer in het voorjaar van 2018 uitvoeriger stilstaan bij de voortgang daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Merendeel gemeenten mailt onveilig’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about reports that most municipalities do not yet apply secure e-mail standards, and whether a national generic facility should be created. The State Secretary acknowledged the risk, said municipalities are working on information security and performing relatively well compared with other public bodies, and stated there are no plans for a generic national e-mail project beyond existing initiatives.
Beyond these actions, there are no plans to develop an ICT project for generic e-mail within the government.
Naast deze acties zijn er geen plannen om te komen tot een ICT-project voor generieke e-mail bij de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Dijksma over kindermisbruik op Aruba

MPs Kuiken and Dijksma asked why a 2015 motion calling for a joint Kingdom approach to child abuse on Aruba has not yet produced one, and whether a delay is acceptable. The state secretary cited Aruba's own responsibility, the postponed Kingdom working conference to March 2018, and ongoing interisland child-rights initiatives, but made no new binding commitment.
For Aruba, the approach to domestic violence and child abuse is a responsibility of the country itself.
Voor Aruba geldt dat de aanpak van huiselijk geweld en kindermishandeling een verantwoordelijkheid is van het land zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over kindermishandeling op Aruba

An MP asked the State Secretary about child abuse on Aruba, including reported prevalence, a planned Aruban commission on domestic violence, and Dutch support for child protection. The government confirmed awareness, referred prevalence to a prior answer, noted Aruba adopted an integrated social plan with a crisis chapter on domestic violence, and said Dutch help would be considered on request and discussed during a January visit.
If the Aruban government makes a request for help and/or assistance, the Dutch government will examine how to appropriately follow up on it.
Indien de regering van Aruba een verzoek voor hulp en/of bijstand doet, zal de Nederlandse regering nagaan hoe op gepaste wijze daaraan opvolging te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de berichten omtrent de nieuwbouw van het Sint Elisabeth Hospitaal (Sehos) op Curaçao

An MP asked about press reports on the Sehos hospital rebuild on Curaçao, including financial mismanagement, an inspection order, and risks to the new HNO hospital and the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that financial responsibility lies with Curaçao, that the Cft monitors and can advise, and that the loan was taken under the Kingdom financial supervision framework with no separate Dutch risk identified.
It is up to the country of Curaçao to keep its own financial household in order.
Het is aan het land Curaçao om de eigen financiële huishouding op orde te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arissen over het bericht dat de vingerafdruk op het Nederlandse paspoort nooit wordt gecontroleerd

An MP asked whether fingerprints in Dutch passports are never checked at airports, whether they serve anti-fraud purposes, their cost, and whether their mandatory collection infringes privacy and freedom of movement. The state secretary confirmed they are not checked at airports yet because certificate exchange with other member states is pending (expected mid-2018), defended the EU-required collection as proportionate under the Schwarz ruling, and answered the cost and other questions largely on substance.
I do not keep records of how often that happens.
Ik houd geen administratie bij van hoe vaak dat gebeurt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Thieme, Baudet, Kuzu, Van de Hul en Knops over het bericht dat de Nederlandse overheid grote steken heeft laten vallen in het verle

MPs from many parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the Dutch government failed to assist Mr Singh, a Dutch national imprisoned in the US for 33 years, including over consular visits, a transfer request and the handling of his case. The government rejects the picture of failure, says it cannot intervene in foreign justice, explains that transfer was refused on legal grounds and pledges continued support for parole and review requests.
The ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice and Security do not recognise that picture.
De ministeries van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid herkennen zich niet in dat beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht “CFT: Opschorten terugbetalingen Saba”

MP Bosman (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about a news report that repayments of Saba's loans would be suspended, and whether the College Financieel Toezicht (Cft) should give political advice. The State Secretary confirmed the report, explained that the Cft advised suspending 2018 loan repayments to keep Saba's budget balanced on a cash basis, and said he has not yet received Saba's budget and will decide on approval by 15 November.
I have not yet received Saba's budget including the advice addressed to me.
De begroting van Saba inclusief het aan mij gerichte advies heb ik nog niet ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en van Dam over het artikel ‘Ik hoop dat je gepakt wordt’; De Turkse Kliklijn’

MPs Knops and Van Dam asked the Foreign Minister about reports of a Turkish consulate 'click line' for reporting Turkish Dutch citizens and threats of reporting them to Turkish intelligence. The minister said there is no evidence of a current reporting line in the Netherlands, condemned such practices, and said the government raises the issue with Turkey and will act directly if a reporting line exists.
If a click line were to exist, the Dutch government will therefore act directly.
In het geval van het bestaan van een kliklijn zal de Nederlandse overheid dus direct optreden.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Dekken ter vervanging van nr. 100 over € 0,775 miljoen voor versterking van breedtesport
Shifts 775,000 euro within the sports budget to fund grassroots sport projects by sports federations.
This amendment provides that 775,000 euro is made available for the sports federations
Dit amendement regelt dat € 775.000 wordt vrijgemaakt voor de sportbonden
Motie van de leden Van der Velde en Van Dekken over verbreding van het Beter Leven keurmerk
Asks the government to extend the Beter Leven label to dairy products and to environmental aspects.
requests the government to contribute to extending the Beter Leven label to dairy products
verzoekt de regering, bij te dragen aan de verbreding van het Beter Leven keurmerk naar zuivelproducten
Motie van de leden Leenders en Van Dekken over de overgang van gangbare naar natuurinclusieve landbouw
Asks the government to draw up a detailed plan for transitioning from conventional to nature-inclusive agriculture and inform the Chamber by 1 March.
requests the government to make a worked-out plan for the transition from conventional to nature-inclusive agriculture
verzoekt de regering, een uitgewerkt plan te maken voor de overgang van gangbare naar natuurinclusieve landbouw
Amendement van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Dekken over € 1,1 miljoen voor versterking van de breedtesport
Shifts 1.1 million euro within the sport budget from sport and exercise programmes and knowledge items to project subsidies for sports federations.
This amendment provides that 1.1 million euro is freed up for sports federations with the main aim of strengthening grassroots sport in the Netherlands.
Dit amendement regelt dat € 1,1 miljoen wordt vrijgemaakt voor de sportbonden met als hoofddoel het versterken van de breedtesport in Nederland.
Motie van het lid Van Dekken over het stimuleren van sportbeoefening door kinderen uit gezinnen met een laag inkomen
Asks the government to have buurtsportcoaches actively seek out low-income children not yet playing sport and link them to clubs and the Jeugdsportfonds.
requests the government to consult relevant parties so that the buurtsportcoaches' task description includes actively seeking out children not yet playing sport because of their parents' income

verzoekt de regering om in overleg te treden met relevante partijen teneinde in de concrete opdrachtomschrijving van de buurtsportcoaches op te nemen dat zij kinderen die vanwege het inkomen van hun ouders nog niet sporten, actief opzoeken
Motie van de leden Vermue en Van Dekken over dalende leerlingenaantallen en goed en bereikbaar onderwijs in krimpregio's
Asks the government to map where falling pupil numbers in shrinking regions threaten good and accessible education and to report the financial implications before summer.
requests the government to map where falling pupil numbers in shrinking regions threaten good and accessible education
verzoekt de regering, in kaart te brengen waar dalende leerlingenaantallen in krimpregio's ten koste dreigen te gaan van goed en bereikbaar onderwijs
Motie van de leden Thieme en Van Dekken over uitfasering van CO2-bedwelming van varkens
Asks the government to consider alternatives to CO2 stunning of pigs in its forthcoming action plan and, if alternatives are viable, to set a deadline for phasing it out.
requests the government to pay attention in the forthcoming action plan to alternatives to CO2 stunning of pigs
verzoekt de regering, in het aankomende plan van aanpak hieromtrent aandacht te geven aan alternatieven voor CO 2 -bedwelming bij varkens
Amendement van de leden Van Dekken en Yücel ter vervanging van nr. 16 dat een bedrag van 2,5 miljoen euro uit de SZW-begroting reserveert voor het Jeugdsportfonds
Amendment reallocating 2.5 million euro within the social affairs budget to the Jeugdsportfonds for children from low-income families.
Coverage for this is found within the commissions item of article 2
Dekking hiervoor wordt gevonden binnen de post opdrachten van artikel 2
Amendement van de leden Van Dekken en Yücel dat een bedrag van 2,5 miljoen euro uit de SZW-begroting reserveert voor het Jeugdsportfonds
Amendment moving 2.5 million euro within the SZW budget to reserve funds for the Youth Sports Fund for children from low-income families.
Submitters intend to reserve an additional 2.5 million euro for the Youth Sports Fund in 2016.
Indieners beogen in 2016 een extra bedrag van 2,5 miljoen euro te reserveren voor het Jeugdsportfonds.
Motie van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Dekken over het terugeisen van de gemaakte kosten voor het WK-bid in het geval van corruptie
Asks the government to reclaim the costs of the World Cup bid from FIFA if corruption in the 2018 award to Russia is confirmed.
to reclaim the costs made for the WK bid from FIFA
de gemaakte kosten voor de WK-bid terug te eisen bij de FIFA
Motie van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Dekken over het inzetten van extra middelen van Lotto en Staatsloterij voor de basissportinfrastructuur
Asks the government to channel any extra Lotto and Staatsloterij funds from a merger into grassroots sports infrastructure.
to make these extra funds available for our grassroots sports infrastructure
deze extra middelen beschikbaar te stellen voor onze basissportinfrastructuur
Amendement van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Dekken dat regelt dat er € 1,7 miljoen wordt vrijgemaakt voor sportbonden
Moves €1.7 million within the sport budget from sport-in-neighbourhood and international-organisation funds to project subsidies for smaller sports federations via NOC*NSF.
This amendment provides that €1.7 million is made available for sports federations.
Dit amendement regelt dat er € 1,7 miljoen wordt vrijgemaakt voor sportbonden.
Motie van de leden Van Dekken en Van Nispen over onderzoek naar een verplicht uniform zwemdiploma
Asks the government to determine swimming proficiency requirements and investigate a mandatory uniform swimming diploma at the end of primary school.
requests the government to have determined which requirements apply for sufficient swimming proficiency
verzoekt de regering om, vast te laten stellen welke eisen gelden voor voldoende zwemvaardigheid
Motie van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Dekken over aandacht voor alle dimensies van good governance bij internationale sportbonden
Asks the government, during the EU presidency, to address all dimensions of good governance, including transparency and checks and balances, at international sports federations.

requests the government, when putting sport integrity on the agenda during the EU presidency, not only to include the awarding of events but also explicitly to address improving all dimensions of good governance

verzoekt de regering, bij het agenderen van integriteit van de sport tijdens het EU-voorzitterschap niet alleen het toewijzen van evenementen mee te nemen, maar ook expliciet aandacht te schenken aan verbetering van alle dimensies van good governance
Motie van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Dekken over herverdelen van medailles bij verjaarde zaken als er sprake is van bewezen dopinggebruik
Motion asking the government to identify athletes who lost medals due to doping and honour them, and to urge the IOC to reallocate medals in time-barred doping cases.
requests the government to investigate which athletes missed a (gold) medal at major events due to competitors' doping
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken welke sporters op grote evenementen als EK's, WK's en Olympische Spelen een (gouden) medaille zijn misgelopen door dopinggebruik van concurrenten
Motie van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Dekken over het onderzoeken van achterstanden qua beloning en waardering van vrouwelijke sporters
Asks the government to study pay and recognition gaps between female and male athletes across sports and how they can be closed.
asks the government to investigate which sports are ahead and which are behind in participation, pay and recognition of female athletes
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken welke sporten voor- en welke achterlopen in deelnemersaantallen, beloning en waardering van vrouwelijke sporters
Motie van de leden Van Dekken en Rudmer Heerema over prioriteit geven aan kinderen uit gezinnen met laag inkomen bij Sportimpuls-subsidies
Asks government to examine prioritising children from low-income families in Sportimpuls sport subsidy rounds.
requests the government to examine the possibilities of making children from low-income families a priority in upcoming Sportimpuls subsidy rounds
verzoekt de regering om, de mogelijkheden te laten bekijken om kinderen uit gezinnen met een laag inkomen de komende Sportimpuls-subsidierondes tot een prioriteit te maken
Amendement van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Van Dekken dat risicovolle sportweddenschappen uitsluit van het kansspelaanbod
Expands the regulatory powers for sports prize contests and totalisators to exclude risky sports bets and set rules against match-fixing, after consultation with the gambling authority.
risky sports bets are excluded from the gambling offering
risicovolle sportweddenschappen worden uitgesloten van het kansspelaanbod
Motie van de leden Van Dekken en Dijkhoff over een meer open en publieksvriendelijk voetbal
Asks the government to consult football partners on a more open, fan-friendly football experience and report back by 1 August 2015.
requests the government to consult all involved partners on how a more open and fan-friendly football can be achieved
verzoekt de regering om, met alle betrokken partners ... in overleg te treden hoe er gekomen kan worden tot een meer open en publieksvriendelijk voetbal

Amendement van het lid Van Dekken dat regelt dat een bevel van de burgemeester als bedoeld in artikel 172a, eerste en tweede lid, van de Gemeentewet alleen kan worden gekoppeld aan bij algemene maatre
Amendment limits mayoral orders linked to private-organisation sanctions to sanctions designated by general administrative order, as an extra safeguard against hasty orders affecting citizens.
an exhaustive list of sanctions by a private organisation in a general administrative order offers an extra safeguard
een limitatieve opsomming van de sancties door een private organisatie in een algemene maatregel van bestuur een extra waarborg biedt
Motie van het lid Servaes c.s. over opnemen van mensenrechtennormen in reglementen van internationale sportfederaties
Motion asking the government to work for inclusion of human rights and workers' rights norms in international sports federations' rules for major events.
requests the government to work, both internationally and with national sports bodies, for the inclusion of human rights norms
verzoekt de regering, zich zowel in internationaal verband als in samenwerking met nationale sportkoepels in te zetten voor de opname van mensenrechtennormen

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Ouwehand en Van Dekken ter vervanging van nr. 33 over het mede toepassen van artikel 22 van de Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen op de centrale commissie dierproe
Removes the exception so the minister can annul decisions of the Central Animal Experiments Committee under the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen.
Motie van het lid Van Dekken over €234.000 voor het Jeugdsportfonds
Asks the government to provide 234,000 euros per year from the sports budget to the Youth Sports Fund for three years.
requests the government to make available 234,000 euros annually from the existing sports budget to the Youth Sports Fund for the next three years
verzoekt de regering, voor het Jeugdsportfonds de komende drie jaar uit het bestaande budget voor sport en bewegen in de buurt, jaarlijks € 234.000 ter beschikking te stellen
Amendement van de leden Ouwehand en Van Dekken ter vervaning van nr. 31 over het mede toepassen van artikel 22 van de Kaderwet zelfstendige bestuursorganen op de centrale commissie dierproeven
Removes the exception so that the minister keeps the power under the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen to annul decisions of the Central Animal Experiments Committee in exceptional cases.
The submitters consider removing the minister's power to annul decisions in exceptional situations, as provided in the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen, undesirable.
Indieners achten het schrappen van de bevoegdheid van de minister om in uitzonderlijke situaties besluiten te vernietigen, zoals bedoeld in de Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen, ongewenst.
Motie Jasper van Dijk en Van Dekken over een verkenning naar de ondersteuning van popmuziek in het buitenland
Asks the government to explore support for pop music abroad and whether similar funds could be created in the Netherlands.
requests the government to conduct an exploration of support for pop music in these countries
verzoekt de regering, een verkenning te doen naar de ondersteuning van popmuziek in deze landen
Motie van de leden Ouwehand en Van Dekken over een verplichte identificatie en registratie van katten
Motion asks government to require identification and registration of all cats from 2015 in the animal companion decree.
requests the government to include in the companion animals decree an obligation for general identification and registration of cats
verzoekt de regering, in het Besluit gezelschapsdieren een verplichting op te nemen voor een algehele identificatie- en registratie van katten
Motie van de leden Ouwehand en Van Dekken over een verbod op de verkoop van dieren buiten speciaalzaken
Asks the government to include in the Besluit gezelschapsdieren a ban from 1 January 2015 on selling animals online, at fairs, garden centres and other places other than certified pet shops.
requests the government to include in the Companion Animals Decree a ban from 1 January 2015 on selling animals on the internet
verzoekt de regering, in het Besluit gezelschapsdieren een verbod op te nemen per 1 januari 2015 op de verkoop van dieren op internet
Motie van de leden Thieme en Van Dekken over huisvestingssystemen opnemen in het Besluit houders van dieren
Asks the government to require prior testing of animal housing systems for effects on animal welfare in the Besluit houders van dieren.
housing systems for animals are tested in advance for their effects on the welfare and health of the animal kept
huisvestingssystemen voor dieren vooraf worden getoetst op de effecten ervan voor het welzijn en de gezondheid van het te houden dier
Motie van het lid Thieme c.s. over een maximumtransportduur voor slachtvee
Asks the government to investigate binding a maximum transport duration on slaughter animal transports within or from the Netherlands.
requests the government to investigate possibilities to bind transports of slaughter animals within or from the Netherlands to a maximum transport duration
verzoekt de regering, onderzoek te doen naar mogelijkheden om de transporten met slachtvee binnen Nederland of vanuit Nederland aan een maximumtransportduur te binden
Amendement van het lid Huizing c.s. om de Nederlandse sport op Olympisch niveau te brengen
Shifts 800 thousand euros within the sport budget toward top sport, funded by cutting research budget after dropping the Olympic Games bid.
The funding is found by lowering the budget for research and studies
De dekking wordt gevonden in het verlagen van het budget voor onderzoeken en studies
Motie van het lid Van Dekken over de "Jantje Beton"-norm
Asks the government to reserve 3% of space in new neighbourhoods for sport and play, following the Jantje Beton norm.
requests the government to meet the Jantje Beton norm by reserving 3% of space in new neighbourhoods for sport and play
verzoekt de regering om, te voldoen aan de «Jantje Beton»-norm om bij de inrichting van nieuwe wijken 3% van de ruimte te reserveren voor sport en spel
Motie van de leden Van Dekken en Pia Dijkstra over de subsidie aan Service Médical
Asks the government to extend the subsidy to Service Médical by at least one year.
to extend the subsidy to Service Médical by at least one year
de subsidie aan de Service Médical met minimaal een jaar te verlengen
Amendement van het lid Bruins Slot c.s. over het verhogen van het budget voor dopingbestrijding
Raises the anti-doping budget by moving funds from the Olympic ambition subsidy within the sport budget.
Developments at home and abroad have shown that the fight against doping deserves more attention.
Ontwikkelingen in binnen- en buitenland hebben laten zien dat de strijd tegen doping meer aandacht verdient.
Motie van het lid Van Dekken over regulering van spelersmakelaars op nationaal niveau
Asks the government to intervene with legislation to regulate football player agents nationally, because FIFA is dropping its framework and self-regulation has failed.
requests the government to intervene through legislation because self-regulation has not sufficiently achieved the objectives
verzoekt de regering, over te gaan tot interventie door middel van wetgeving omdat zelfregulering onvoldoende heeft geleid tot het bereiken van de doelstellingen
Motie van het lid Van Dekken c.s. over De Youth Olimpic Games 2018
Asks the government to work to bring the 2018 Youth Olympic Games to Rotterdam and to use the 2028 Olympics study budget to support that bid.
also requests the government to use the budget for studies related to the 2028 Olympics as a contribution to organising the 2018 Youth Olympic Games in Rotterdam

verzoekt de regering tevens, het budget voor onderzoeken en studies in verband met de Olympische Spelen in 2028 in te zetten als bijdrage aan de organisatie van de Youth Olympic Games 2018 in Rotterdam
Motie van het lid van Dekken over informatie over de gevraagde en verleende ontheffingen
Asks the government to inform the House every half year about requested and granted exemptions, so that Parliament can monitor them.
requests the government to inform the House every six months about the requested and granted exemptions
verzoekt de regering, de Kamer halfjaarlijks te informeren over de gevraagde en verleende ontheffingen
Motie Jacobi / Van Dekken over misstanden bij de fazantenjacht
Asks the government to permanently close pheasant hunting because of illegal practices and weak justification for culling.
requests the government to permanently close pheasant hunting
verzoekt de regering de jacht op fazanten definitief te sluiten
Motie Jacobi en Van Dekken over een sterrensysteem
Asks the government, with the Dierenbescherming, to develop a star rating system based on the Beter Leven label to set rising standards for new livestock stables.
requests the government, in consultation with the Dierenbescherming, to develop a star system based on the Beter Leven label
verzoekt de regering in samenspraak met de Dierenbescherming te komen tot een sterrensysteem op basis van het keurmerk Beter Leven
Asks the government to consult Service Médical on keeping the medical expertise of 175 staff for major sporting events and report back to the House.
requests the government to consult with Service Médical
verzoekt de regering om met Service Médical in overleg te treden
Motie Van Dekken over een onafhankelijk meldpunt voor misstanden
Motion asks the government to appoint an independent reporting point and independent confidential adviser where parents and children can report abuses in youth sport.
requests the government to appoint an independent reporting point and independent confidential adviser where parents and children can expose abuses
verzoekt de regering om een onafhankelijk meldpunt en een onafhankelijke vertrouwenspersoon aan te stellen waar ouders en kinderen misstanden aan de kaak kunnen stellen
Motie Van Dekken over zelfregulering van spelersmakelaars
Asks the government to encourage self-regulation of football player agents and to legislate if self-regulation fails by 1 January 2013.
requests the government to encourage self-regulation of player agents and to intervene through legislation if needed.
verzoekt de regering om in overleg met de belanghebbenden zelfregulering van de spelersmakelaars te stimuleren en over te gaan tot interventie door middel van wetgeving
Motie Van Dekken over het laten sporten van kinderen
Asks the government to take a less one-sided approach to getting children in poverty to take part in sport, examining how participation can be promoted directly.
requests the government to choose a less one-sided approach
verzoekt de regering om te kiezen voor een minder eenzijdige aanpak
Motie Van Dekken over vasthouden aan de volksgezondheidsnormen voor milieu en ruimte
Asks the government to keep environmental and spatial health-based standards uniform across the country and not allow lower norms in some regions.
requests the government to prevent lower standards from applying in some parts of the country
verzoekt de regering te voorkomen dat er lagere normen gaan gelden in sommige delen van het land
Motie Van Dekken c.s. over een onderzoek naar de effectiviteit en de kosten
Asks the government to commission a study of the effectiveness and costs of a binding EU energy-efficiency target and inform the House before negotiating.
requests the government, before negotiating on the energy efficiency directive, first to study the effectiveness and costs of such a European obligation

verzoekt de regering om alvorens in onderhandeling te treden over de richtlijn energie-efficiency eerst een onderzoek te doen naar de effectiviteit en de kosten van een dergelijk Europese verplichting
Motie Van Dekken c.s. over een verbod op legbatterijen
Motion asking the government to strictly enforce the ban on battery cages and to press other EU member states to keep the ban.
Requests the government to strictly enforce the ban on the battery cage
verzoekt de regering streng te handhaven op het verbod op de legbatterij
Motie Thieme en Van Dekken over koloniehuisvesting
Asks the government to immediately ban colony housing for laying hens, which the motion calls an enriched cage.
requests the government to immediately ban colony housing
verzoekt de regering per direct de koloniehuisvesting te verbieden
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over de verhoogde kans op longontsteking nabij pluimveebedrijven

MPs Van Dekken and Leenders asked about a study finding higher pneumonia rates near poultry farms and what the government will do about it. The state secretary cited the study's statistical association, pointed to forthcoming measures and an interim wet veedichte gebieden bill, and said emissions rose after the battery-cage ban.
Work is also underway on a proposal for an interim act on densely farmed areas.
Verder wordt gewerkt aan het voorstel voor een interim-wet veedichte gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Nijboer en Jan Vos over het initiatief van de Stichting Meent van der Sluis voor de oprichting van Het Andere Monument

Three MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about a proposed monument ('Het Andere Monument') for victims of Groningen gas-extraction earthquake damage, including municipal land availability and funding for a youth work-learning project. The minister confirmed awareness, expressed appreciation, noted the National Coordinator Groningen mediated, and said the Social Affairs minister would explore a work-learning route.
The Minister of SZW will explore the possibilities for a work-learning project and will contact the foundation about it.
De Minister van SZW zal de mogelijkheden voor een leer-werktraject onderzoeken en daarover in contact treden met de stichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries, Van Dekken en Jan Vos over het bericht ‘Bouwregels Stad genegeerd’

MPs asked whether a Groningen builder ignored earthquake-resistant design rules, whether earthquake-proof building should become the norm with funding, why the NPR 9998 standard is not yet in the Building Decree, and whether NAM will generously apply the new-build compensation scheme. The minister answered that NPR use is not mandatory and cannot be excluded for some buildings, that the government is exploring regulation so NAM keeps covering reasonable extra costs with a decision expected by end 2017, and that the scheme's percentage compensation will be raised with the ongoing review.
Application of the NPR is not mandatory.
De toepassing van de NPR is niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij de Primark in Groningen

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported working conditions at the Primark store in Groningen, including workload, intimidation, ignored health complaints, unpaid overtime, and missing works councils, and whether the Labour Inspectorate would inspect and act. The minister said he could not confirm the signals, that the Inspectorate has accepted a union request for further investigation, that earlier inspections led to limited action, and that the company has announced it will set up a works council, with the ministry to raise the legal duty with the clothing sector.
FNV has shared its findings with the Labour Inspectorate and recently requested a further investigation into working conditions at Primark.
FNV heeft haar bevindingen met de Inspectie SZW gedeeld en heeft recent aan de Inspectie een verzoek gedaan tot een nader onderzoek naar de arbeidsomstandigheden bij Primark.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over het Q-koorts kompas en het advies van Brabantadvies

Two PvdA MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about the Q-fever compass published by Q-support and a BrabantAdvies warning that Q-fever knowledge and experience may be lost, asking whether patients get adequate support and whether the advice will be adopted. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports but deferred substantive answers to a forthcoming letter covering all Q-fever advice.
In the letter of 21 February on the committee's request for a response to the BrabantAdvies advice, we indicated that we wish to inform the House comprehensively on all Q-fever advice.

In de brief van 21 februari jl naar aanleiding van de vraag van de vaste Kamercommissie om een reactie op het advies van BrabantAdvies is aangegeven dat wij de Kamer graag in samenhang willen berichten over alle adviezen over Q-koorts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Van Dekken over een ZEMBLA-uitzending over de gezondheidseffecten van rubbergranulaat

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health and the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment whether a ZEMBLA broadcast on health effects of rubber granulate on sports pitches warranted new measures or a different RIVM advice, and how the tyre industry's norm compares to EU and RIVM norms. The minister answered that the broadcast does not change RIVM's advice that safe use of the pitches is possible, that RIVM will consider the unpublished study once published, and that the industry norm is stricter than the existing EU limits while the government aims to lower it further.
As long as it is not known which substances in which concentrations were found by the VU, RIVM cannot make a statement
Zolang niet bekend is welke stoffen in welke concentraties door de VU zijn aangetroffen, kan het RIVM geen uitspraak doen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de door het Europees Parlement aangenomen resolutie over matchfixing

An MP asked whether the Netherlands will criminalise match-fixing as a specific offence following a European Parliament resolution, and whether further research is warranted. The Minister replied that no specific offence is being studied, as current fraud, bribery, money laundering and forgery provisions are considered sufficient.
A specific criminal offence for match-fixing is not being investigated.
Een specifieke strafbaarstelling van matchfixing wordt niet onderzocht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Van Dekken over de berichten ‘Veel sportclubs melden seksueel overschrijdend gedrag niet bij instanties’, ‘Bij elke club kan een verborgen camera in de kleedkamer hangen’ en 'Vertr

MPs Volp and Van Dekken asked the ministers about reports that many sports clubs do not report sexual misconduct, the Vertrouwenspunt Sport of NOC*NSF, and the need for a reporting code, VOG checks, a blacklist and independent research. The minister answered that reporting should be encouraged, that the independent research will inform further measures, that a VOG is voluntary (free) rather than mandatory in sport, and that an independent inquiry will be supported financially.
It is important that it is a high-quality study that makes use of the knowledge and experience gained in recent times from earlier studies in other sectors.

Het is van belang dat het een kwalitatief goed onderzoek is waarbij gebruik wordt gemaakt van de kennis en ervaringen die in de afgelopen tijd zijn opgedaan bij eerdere onderzoeken in andere sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Van Dekken over een voorstel voor aanpassingen van de Gecombineerde opgave

MPs Leenders and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the current Gecombineerde opgave creates a negative incentive against trees and hedges on farmland, and whether it could be changed as proposed by landscape designer Heebing. The State Secretary denied any such negative incentive, explained that landscape elements are not counted as agricultural land, and said the proposed approach conflicts with EU requirements, so it cannot be realised.
The working method proposed by Mr Heebing is not in line with the European requirements and therefore cannot be realised.
De door de heer Heebing voorgestelde werkwijze is niet in overeenstemming met de Europese vereisten en kan daarom niet gerealiseerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Van Dekken over het bericht 'Hoe de lobby het rubber in het gras hield'

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked about press reports on industry lobbying over rubber granulate in artificial turf and whether the Netherlands shifted from treating it as an article to a mixture under REACH. The government answered that it reversed its position to align with the European Commission and most member states, that the health risk to sports users was judged low, and that it did not commit to a new national action beyond pursuing a lower EU norm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kuiken over het bericht dat een Brabantse amateurvoetbalclub vier voetballertjes heeft weggestuurd omdat ze te weinig lootjes hebben verkocht

MPs Van Dekken and Kuiken asked the minister whether an amateur football club was right to expel four children for not selling enough lottery tickets, whether minors can be obliged to sell tickets, and what legal recourse parents have. The minister answered that the club has since reconciled with the parents and the children are welcome back, that clubs may impose obligations on members via their statutes, and that members may appeal a royement internally and then to the civil courts.
A royement can only be imposed if the member acts in breach of the association's statutes, regulations or decisions, or if the association is unreasonably harmed.
Een royement kan alleen worden uitgesproken als het lid in strijd handelt met de statuten, reglementen of besluiten van de vereniging of de vereniging op onredelijke wijze benadeelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over een knokpartij tussen hooligans van Feyenoord en AZ

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the government about a staged fight between Feyenoord and AZ hooligans, whether crimes were committed, and whether the state tolerates such violence. Minister Blok answered that the public prosecutor has opened an investigation, that such violence is criminal and unacceptable, and that research into hooligan fights is underway with results expected before summer.
The public prosecution services of Alkmaar and Rotterdam have started an investigation.
Het OM Alkmaar en het OM Rotterdam zijn een onderzoek gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de aanpak van matchfixing in het tennis

MP Van Dekken asked the ministers whether the national matchfixing platform is adequate, whether the Public Prosecution Service should take a more active role given the limits of sports-body disciplinary rules, and whether betting on lower-tier Future tournaments should be banned. The minister defended the platform as a structured information-sharing forum, rejected a change in prosecution approach citing no signals of inadequacy, and said the risk exists at all levels and will be limited through rules under the online gambling bill.
I have committed to informing you further on this before summer 2017.
Ik heb toegezegd u hier voor de zomer 2017 nader over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Jan Vos en Wolbert over de bezinningsperiode in de Drentse Veenkoloniën

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he would insert a reflection period in the Drenthe wind park decision, pending the Council of State appeal, and pause irreversible steps while exploring alternatives with local stakeholders. The minister refused to withdraw or suspend the permit, citing the provincial renewable energy target, but committed not to start placing turbines before the Council of State ruling and to explore solar alternatives with local authorities.
Pending the Council of State ruling, no start will be made on placing the wind turbines.
In afwachting van de uitspraak van de Raad van State zal geen begin met de plaatsing van de windmolens worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de versterkingsoperatie die nu ineens tien jaar kan gaan duren

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked why the Groningen reinforcement operation now may take ten years instead of five, whether residents are left in uncertainty too long, how many homes must be reinforced, and why the new compensation scheme took a year. The minister replied that the approach has the support of all administrative parties, that a block-by-block inspection-then-reinforcement method is used with work starting in Q4 2017, and that the total scope and resident displacement cannot yet be determined, deferring to ongoing inspections.
No statement can currently be made about the scope of the total reinforcement task.
Over de omvang van de totale versterkingsopgave is op dit moment geen uitspraak te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over het weigeren van een Spaans rechtshulpverzoek door PSV

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice why PSV refused a Spanish legal assistance request to identify fans who humiliated beggars in Madrid, and what Dutch authorities would do to help Spanish prosecution. The minister replied that football clubs' stadium bans and criminal prosecution are separate tracks that can be used alongside each other, that Dutch justice will help Spain, and that PSV has since done further research and the request is being considered at administrative level.
After the Spanish judicial authorities indicated they would persist with the request, Dutch justice made a repeated demand to PSV to identify the football supporters concerned.

Nadat de Spaanse justitiële autoriteiten hebben aangegeven bij het verzoek te persisteren, heeft de Nederlandse justitie een herhaalde vordering gedaan aan PSV om de betreffende voetbalsupporters te identificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Groot over het bericht 'Om te winnen is elke truc toegestaan'

MPs Van Dekken and Groot asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about tax and money-laundering oversight of football finances revealed by Football Leaks, including Dutch company use, transfer-pricing of image rights, and a delayed DNB investigation. The government answered that the Tax Authority will check the leaked information and act where Dutch tax is evaded, describes existing supervision by the Tax Authority, FIOD, DNB and KNVB, and says DNB will publish its general conclusions soon.
The Tax Authority is collecting the information published in Football Leaks and will verify it, as it has done with earlier leaks.
De Belastingdienst verzamelt de informatie die wordt gepubliceerd in Football Leaks en zal deze natrekken, zoals ook bij eerdere leaks is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Cegerek over het bericht ‘Maak nieuwe regels voor kunstgraskorrels’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary whether artificial turf rubber granules should fall under stricter consumer PAH limits, and whether a special norm closer to the consumer standard should be set after consulting industry and RIVM. The government answered that EU REACH treats granules as a mixture with a looser limit, that it will push at EU level to lower the limit toward the consumer standard, and that it will continue talks with industry.
The cabinet aims for a source-based approach, in this case the cleanest possible car tyres.
Het kabinet streeft naar een aanpak aan de bron, in dit geval naar zo schoon mogelijke autobanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over een bericht dat Nederlandse profvoetbalspelers niet mee hebben gedaan naar een onderzoek naar matchfixing en arbeidsomstandigheden

An MP asked the minister about a FIFPro global survey on match-fixing and working conditions, and why Dutch professional footballers and their union VVCS did not take part. The minister answered that the survey questions were judged not relevant to the Dutch situation, that match-fixing is nonetheless recognised as a risk in the Netherlands, and that the VVCS already sits on the national match-fixing platform with frequent consultation.
That is why we are working in the Netherlands on a joint approach to this problem.
Daarom werken wij in Nederland aan een gezamenlijke aanpak van dit probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Yücel over een bericht dat de KNWU een onderzoek instelt naar misstanden in de wielersport

Two MPs asked the minister whether she knew of misconduct and intimidation in cycling, including the CIRC report on women's cycling, and what the government was doing about it. The minister said she supports the KNWU-commissioned investigation, points to the existing sports safety action plan and reporting channels, and gave no commitment to a broader government inquiry.
A broad investigation into abuses and intimidation in sport does not seem necessary to me.
Een breed onderzoek naar misstanden en intimidatie in de sport lijkt mij niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het niet oplossen van schade door de NAM in Termunterzijl

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the minister about NAM's refusal to resolve damage to a house in Termunterzijl, including whether it is linked to gas extraction, the family's forced relocation on NAM's advice, and reversal of the burden of proof. The minister declined to go into substance because of pending litigation against NAM and the State, noted rising non-earthquake damage reports, and said the burden-of-proof bill is pending in the Senate with entry into force expected before year-end.

A court case concerning this file is pending before the Northern Netherlands District Court, in which NAM and the State are defendants. Against that background I will not go into the substance of this file.
Over dit dossier is een procedure aanhangig bij de rechtbank Noord-Nederland, waarin NAM en de Staat zijn gedaagd. Tegen die achtergrond ga ik niet inhoudelijk in op dit dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kerstens over het bericht ‘Hoe Ajax en Feyenoord flirten met te jonge buitenlandse talenten’

MPs Van Dekken and Kerstens asked whether Ajax and Feyenoord evade FIFA and Dutch rules when recruiting very young foreign football talents, and whether rules should change. The minister replied that FIFA article 19 and the Wav already give strict safeguards, no unlawful transfers are known, a referee-style intermediary quality mark is being developed, and no further talks are needed.
Moreover, I am not aware of any cases of unlawful transfers of (too) young talented football players.
Overigens zijn bij mij geen gevallen bekend van onrechtmatige transfers van (te) jonge talentvolle voetbalspelers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over matchfixing in het voetbal

An MP asked the ministers about reports that matchfixers are buying European football clubs, whether Dutch clubs could be affected, and whether the KNVB's integrity checks and clemency for players who report matchfixing are adequate. The ministers answered that the KNVB has no signals of Dutch takeovers, that takeover screening is for the KNVB to decide, that clemency is rejected in general criminal law, and that cooperation platforms and international expert groups are in place.
As long as the investigation is ongoing, the KNVB will make no statements about it.
Zolang het onderzoek loopt doet de KNVB hierover geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het KNMI, dat aardbevingen niet goed zou registreren

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the KNMI misrepresents Groningen earthquakes by naming quakes after the nearest village, so that eleven quakes are attributed to Garmerwolde rather than Groningen city, and whether this distorts regional spread and should be corrected. The minister answered that the KNMI never claimed only one quake hit Groningen city, that the naming procedure was changed on 1 December 2016 to use municipal boundaries, and that the regional picture is unaffected since analyses use coordinates.
On 1 December 2016 the KNMI retroactively introduced a new naming procedure that looks at the distance between the epicentre and a municipal boundary.
Op 1 december 2016 heeft het KNMI met terugwerkende kracht een nieuwe naamgevingsprocedure geïntroduceerd waarbij wordt gekeken naar de afstand tussen het epicentrum en een gemeentegrens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over matchfixing

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about a Slovenian match-fixer caught at Schiphol with EUR 75,000 cash, whether the Slovenian conviction is final, whether he is suspected of match-fixing in the Netherlands, and what new insights the case gives. The Justice minister answered that the FIOD found no signs of match-fixing in the Netherlands, that the information was shared with Europol and Interpol, that the man was convicted in Slovenia and in the Netherlands for laundering the cash, and that further details cannot be given because the investigation continues.
I cannot make further statements about this, because this information is still the subject of further investigation.
Ik kan hierover geen nadere mededelingen doen, omdat deze informatie nog onderwerp is van verder onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Cegerek en Leenders naar aanleiding van berichtgeving over de toename van fijn stof in Zuidoost Brabant

Three PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about press reports that fine particulate matter in south-east Brabant would exceed norms in 2020, asking about health effects, prevention measures and causes. The state secretary acknowledged the forecast exceedance of the daily fine-dust norm in five Brabant municipalities near livestock farms, cited RIVM estimates of about nine months of life-years lost, and described an existing package of measures and an upcoming update on poultry-sector air quality.
You will be informed about this shortly.
U wordt hier binnenkort over geïnformeerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de bemoeienis van NAM met bouwprojecten in Groningen

Three PvdA MPs asked the minister whether NAM's involvement in new-build projects in Groningen, including the absence of a new-build scheme in the multi-year programme, causes delays and should be curbed. The minister answered that the NPR 9998 standard is being made legally binding, that a revised new-build scheme will be proposed by year end, and that the NCG is discussing NAM's role with NAM and municipalities, without committing to stop NAM's involvement.
The draft multi-year programme 2017–2021 provides that a revised scheme must be established, agreed with the administrative and societal steering committee.
In het concept Meerjarenprogramma Aardbevingsbestendig en Kansrijk Groningen 2017–2021 is opgenomen dat een herijkte regeling tot stand dient te komen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Van Dekken over de giftige stoffen in rubbertegels

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health whether rubber playground tiles containing carcinogenic substances pose a health risk, why no research was done at introduction, which alternatives exist, and when EU limits apply. The minister answered that NVWA considered risks negligible, a RIVM risk assessment is expected early 2017, the current 1 mg/kg PAK limit is precautionary, and further measures will follow if risks are found.
The RIVM is currently working on a risk assessment of the rubber tiles. If it turns out the tiles pose a risk to public health, I will take additional measures.
Het RIVM werkt op dit moment aan een risicobeoordeling van de rubbertegels. Als daar uitkomt dat de tegels een risico vormen voor de volksgezondheid zal ik aanvullende maatregelen treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Van Dekken over het ziek worden van sporten op kunstgrasvelden

MPs Tanamal and Van Dekken asked whether artificial turf rubber infill poses health risks to players and to workers who install the fields, and whether RIVM and the labour inspectorate will investigate. The minister maintains RIVM's view that exposure poses no health risk, but has asked RIVM for a literature review and a representative sampling study, and will await those results before deciding further steps.
Because the broadcast caused considerable public unrest, the Minister of VWS asked RIVM to conduct a technical literature review.
Omdat de uitzending de nodige onrust in de samenleving heeft veroorzaakt heeft de Minister van VWS het RIVM gevraagd om een technisch literatuuronderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over de Q-koortsepidemie

Two PvdA MPs asked the Health Minister about the Q-fever epidemic, including the division of lead between Health and Economic Affairs, the Van Dijk commission's recommendation, delayed reporting by farms, and compensation for victims. The minister answered that Health takes the lead in practice, that Q-fever victims received a 10 million euro foundation rather than compensation as the state accepts no liability, and that a screening advice was pending.
Given that the public health interest is paramount for both ministers, the Ministry of VWS takes the lead.
Vanuit het gegeven dat het belang van de volksgezondheid voor beide bewindslieden voorop staat, heeft het Ministerie van VWS daarbij de lead.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Cegerek over luchtvervuiling op het platteland door de veehouderij

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked about a study linking living near livestock farms to reduced lung function, about low public awareness of air pollution, and about why EU air quality limits are looser than WHO guidelines. The government said it will inform parliament on measures and follow-up research, points to existing public information channels, and says a push for stricter EU norms is not currently realistic while it keeps working toward WHO levels.
The cabinet intends to inform parliament shortly by letter about the measures to be taken and the follow-up research.
Het kabinet is voornemens uw Kamer binnenkort per brief te informeren over de te nemen maatregelen en het vervolgonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het doden van gezonde kalveren

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why about 1% of healthy calves are still slaughtered despite the sector's 'Vitaal kalf' plan, and whether regulation should be imposed. The State Secretary replied that the sector must find useful destinations for calves, that slaughter figures are around 3,400 per year, and that he will await further results and keep monitoring the situation without committing to new binding rules.
I therefore first want to await the further results of that.
Ik wil daarom eerst de verdere resultaten daarvan afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch, Van Dekken en Nijboer over Het bericht 'Lijmklassieker blijft een succes' en de problemen met de Europese regelgeving

Three PvdA MPs asked the government whether new EU limits on lead migration in children's toys and paints, which they claimed make paint production impossible, are justified and whether the government has acted on such regulation. The Minister of Health answered that the limit is a migration limit that is 340 times stricter than the drinking water standard, that production is not made impossible, that no cases of EU rules burdening entrepreneurs are known, and that no action has been taken because there is no reason to.
No. The limit value for migration of lead in this type of toy is currently 3.4 mg/kg.
Nee. De grenswaarde voor migratie van lood in dit type speelgoed is op dit moment 3,4 mg/kg
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over dubieuze spelersmakelaars in het voetbal

An MP asked the ministers of Health and of Justice about dubious football player agents who take money from parents with false promises, and what rules govern agents. The government answered that no other signals had been received, that only KNVB-registered intermediaries may act, that a quality mark is in development, and that a fraud complaint has been filed and will be investigated by police.
Only persons registered with the KNVB as intermediaries may also act as such.
Uitsluitend personen die bij de KNVB staan geregistreerd als intermediair mogen ook als zodanig optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over vechtende voetbalhooligans

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice Minister about secret fights between football hooligans, whether they resemble the 1997 Beverwijk fight in which a man died, and whether clubs share responsibility. The minister says the scale is unknown but appears limited to a few incidents, that the fights are less comparable to Beverwijk, that clubs should take a stand, and that participants commit a crime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Groot over belastingschulden van amateur voetbalclubs

MPs Van Dekken and Groot asked the ministers about tax debts at amateur football clubs, how the KNVB and the Tax Authority share information on suspected fraud, and whether the KNVB licensing system and club accounts can help prevent it. The State Secretary answered that contact with the KNVB is regular, that the Tax Authority is bound by fiscal secrecy and cannot share fraud data with the KNVB, and that the KNVB will explore sporting sanctions while criminal investigations are not disclosed.
The Tax Authority has a general fiscal confidentiality obligation that also applies towards the KNVB licensing committee.
De Belastingdienst heeft een algemene fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht die ook werkt jegens de KNVB licentiecommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Van Dekken over het bericht “Machinisten Arriva: Veiligheid reiziger staat op het spel”

MPs Hoogland and Van Dekken asked about reported safety incidents (STS passages) involving temporary Arriva train drivers on the northern rail network, their training, and whether the ILT report should lead to talks with Arriva and VVMC. The State Secretary answered that only one incident is known to Arriva, that the driver was suspended and an ILT licence suspension started, that the training practice was not in breach of rules, and that ILT is investigating and further measures depend on the outcome.
Depending on the outcome of this investigation, I will inform your House whether it is desirable to take additional measures.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek zal ik uw Kamer informeren of het wenselijk is extra maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de invloed van NAM op bouwprojecten  in Groningen

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM is interfering in new construction projects in Groningen, causing delays and overreaching on design and location, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister acknowledges the NAM compensation schemes and that the Boterdiep parking-garage project was delayed, says an exception was made after mediation by the National Coordinator Groningen, and states that delay is undesirable and that the NCG is working to revise the scheme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Afgunst en bonje kost Oost-Groningen miljoenen’

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked whether the state will make the promised funds available so workers in East Groningen are not harmed by the dispute over the Akkoord van Westerlee. The Secretary of State replied that a maximum of 10 million euros is available for 2016-2018 and that the Akkoord will be implemented with the municipalities that remain willing, keeping the door open for the others.
I indicated that a maximum of 10 million euros is available for implementation in the years 2016, 2017 and 2018.
Ik heb aangegeven dat ten behoeve van de uitvoering in de jaren 2016, 2017 en 2018 maximaal 10 mln euro beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over het transport van dieren bij hoge temperaturen

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about animal transport at high temperatures, including NVWA inspection numbers, EU temperature and water rules for short journeys, and planned measures. The government reported 78 inspections on hot days with 23 non-compliant situations, said EU rules leave room for member states, and pointed to the national heat protocol and six-monthly evaluations as progress.
A limited number of inspections had not yet been administratively processed at the time of answering these questions.
Een beperkt aantal controles zijn ten tijde van de beantwoording van deze vragen nog niet administratief verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de NAM die niet meer wil samenwerken met een onafhankelijk contra-expertisebureau

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM may end cooperation with the independent counter-expertise firm Vergnes Expertise, and whether this undermines residents' trust and calls for moving damage assessment to the NCG. The minister answered that NAM stopped reimbursing new Vergnes counter-expertises after failed quality improvement talks, that NAM may terminate such private contracts without NCG consent, and that the NCG will take a supervisory role over the CVW.
It is important that experts deliver quality and that residents are adequately helped.
Het is van belang dat experts kwaliteit leveren en dat bewoners adequaat worden geholpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over ‘de Groninger Bodembeweging en het Groninger Gasberaad, die niet meer praten met Nationaal Coördinator Groningen’

MPs Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the minister about Groningen residents' refusal to talk with the National Coordinator Groningen over the NAM damage protocol, including the rise in rejected c-damage claims, NAM's and CVW's influence, and the damage contour line. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to ongoing audits and research due in early 2017, and agreed to individually assess claims without a contour line, though he declined to give the NCG the power to set the protocol itself.
The damage protocol, established by NAM, is intended to achieve rapid and low-threshold handling of damage claims by the CVW.
Het schadeprotocol, dat is vastgesteld door NAM, is bedoeld om tot snelle en laagdrempelige afhandeling te komen van schadeclaims door het CVW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over het nieuwe Europese steunpakket aan boeren

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the EU's new EUR 500 million farm support package, including how Dutch funds will be spent, whether pig farmers' exit is being delayed, and whether national top-ups risk unfair competition. The State Secretary answered that about EUR 23 million goes to the Netherlands via a national envelope, to be spent on sustainability, restructuring and market stabilisation measures agreed with the dairy and pig sectors, with a pig sector action plan to be finalised later.
Once I have determined the package of measures, I will inform your House about it.
Zodra ik het maatregelenpakket heb vastgesteld, zal ik uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en van Dekken over de ‘Soldiers of Odin’

MPs Marcouch and Van Dekken asked the ministers about the Soldiers of Odin group, a far-right street patrol in Winschoten, including whether a man allegedly assaulted by the group had been properly investigated and whether the police response was too lenient. The minister answered that the group is limited in size, opposes intimidation, that police investigated the injuries and the man's conduct, and that no criminal offences were yet established.
Intimidating or discriminating against groups or persons is prohibited.
Het intimideren en/of discrimineren van groepen of personen is verboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het validatieonderzoek van de TU Delft

MPs Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a TU Delft validation study finding that NAM's Arcadis-based damage contour around the Groningen gas field is not tenable, and whether NAM and the CVW will drop it and compensate damage outside it. The minister agreed the contour is not tenable, said NAM and CVW accept that all reported damage must be assessed individually via a pilot overseen by an independent steering committee, and said a supervisory role for the NCG on the CVW will be detailed later.
Based on the results of the TU Delft study, the NCG concludes that the damage contour set by NAM is not tenable and all reported damage must be individually assessed.

Op basis van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van de TU Delft concludeert de NCG dat de door NAM vastgestelde schadecontourlijn niet houdbaar is en alle aangemelde schade alsnog individueel moet worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de uitspraak van het College van Beroep over de leefomstandigheden van kuikens in broederijen

An MP asked the state secretary about a Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal ruling that the 2014 WUR report on withholding food and water from chicks in the first 72 hours after hatching was insufficiently founded, and whether he would revoke his position, act on it, and share new research. The state secretary answered that WUR will conduct a literature study and new observations within six months, will assess the findings before deciding on any changes to supervision and enforcement, and will share results with parliament.
I will await the outcome of the research mentioned in the answer to question 2 and will based on that consider whether changes in supervision and enforcement are needed.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van het onderzoek, genoemd in het antwoord op vraag 2, af en zal op basis daarvan bezien of er wijzigingen qua toezicht en handhaving nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de uitzending 'hoe de mysterieuze Stellar-group voetbalfamilies verleidt'

An MP asked the ministers whether they would investigate the Stellar Group's approaches to young footballers' families before the boys turn 16, and about the rules, supervision and possible new measures against child transfers. The minister answered that FIFA and the KNVB supervise the rules, that existing rules are adequate, and that no new measures are planned, while declining to say whether the Public Prosecution Service investigates.
As previously indicated to your House, the Public Prosecution Service (OM) cannot make statements about whether or not it is investigating something.
Zoals eerder aangegeven richting uw Kamer, kan het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) geen mededelingen doen over waar het wel of geen onderzoek naar doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Kinderen verdwenen uit azc Ter Apel; verdachten kinderuitbuiting opgepakt’

MPs Kuiken and Van Dekken asked about reports that children had disappeared from the Ter Apel asylum centre and that suspects in child exploitation were arrested, asking about the children's status, Dublin procedures, and police tracing and European cooperation. The minister confirmed awareness of the arrests but declined to discuss the individual children on privacy and safety grounds, stated no links were seen to other disappearances, and referred to an earlier answer for tracing and cooperation measures.
For reasons of privacy and the safety of the young people, I will not go into the individual circumstances of this case.
Omwille van de privacy en de veiligheid van de jongeren ga ik niet in op de individuele omstandigheden in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Proef met koeien in de wei zonder fysieke afrastering’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a trial in which cows are kept in pasture by a GPS-based virtual electric fence with sound and shock signals. The State Secretary answered that the government is not involved, that the method is a virtual electric fence that should be treated like conventional electric fencing under the draft exemption, and that animal welfare effects will be studied before judging.

In the text of the draft decree submitted to the Council of State, the said exception will – if the project proves successful – be clarified so that virtual electric fences such as the Cow Guide are explicitly included in the exception.

In de tekst van het ontwerpbesluit zoals dat aan de Raad van State wordt aangeboden, zal de genoemde uitzondering – indien uit het project blijkt dat het succesvol is – worden verduidelijkt, zodanig dat virtuele elektrische afrasteringen zoals de Cow guide expliciet in de uitzondering zijn begrepen.
