Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Dekken over het bericht “LTO Noord: op basis van dit onderzoek kun je toch geen conclusies trekken?”

MPs Jan Vos and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that LTO Noord calls a Sweco study on uneven land subsidence in Groningen agricultural fields too thin to support conclusions, and whether gas extraction is excluded as a cause and whether independent research and dialogue with LTO Noord will happen. The minister answered that the Sweco report is not yet public and that he has asked the NCG to review it with the commission and LTO Noord, after which he will inform parliament.
The Sweco report is not yet public.
Het rapport van onderzoeksbureau Sweco is nog niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over schade aan huurwoningen door gaswinning

MPs asked why housing corporation Woongroep Marenland refuses to repair gas-extraction damage to tenants' homes in Appingedam and what the minister and the NCG will do about it. The minister declined to comment on an individual case, citing a pending court dispute, but reported that the damage was repaired under NAM supervision and during an NCG inspection, and agreed tenants must be taken seriously.
As a rule I do not go into individual cases. There is a conflict between a tenant and a housing corporation involving a pending court ruling.
In de regel ga ik niet in op een individuele casus. Er is hier sprake van een conflict tussen een huurder en een woningcorporatie waarbij een gerechtelijke uitspraak aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kerstens over de uitbuiting van Nederlandse voetbaltrainers in China

MPs Van Dekken and Kerstens asked whether reports that Dutch football coaches in China receive little pay and return disillusioned, and any related exploitation, corruption or deception, warrant government action and whether the KNVB should warn coaches of the risks. The minister said the individual case is unknown, coaches should prepare themselves, Dutch embassy advised seeking a lawyer, the government sees no direct role beyond the courts, and the KNVB will be consulted on informing coaches.
Since I do not know the individual case, I cannot make a statement about it.
Aangezien ik de individuele casus niet ken kan ik hier geen uitspraak over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over matchfixing en georganiseerde criminaliteit

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about match-fixing, organised crime links, information exchange with Germany (Rode Paul case) and prosecution priorities. The minister answered that police and prosecutors give match-fixing priority, that international cooperation will be stepped up through EU expert groups, and that organised-crime links will be examined in a 2017 threat assessment.
Repeatedly requesting the same case documents from German colleagues by different investigative and prosecution services has indeed not been efficient.
Het meermalen opvragen in het verleden door verschillende opsporings- dan wel vervolgingsdiensten van dezelfde dossierstukken bij de Duitse collega’s is inderdaad niet efficiënt geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over sport en bewegen voor cliënten in de opvang

An MP asked the minister about sport and exercise opportunities for clients in shelters, including for asylum seekers in COA locations, and about the results of the Meedoen programme and its continuation. The minister said such opportunities are important, pointed to existing funding and projects, reported satisfaction with Meedoen results, and committed to talks with the Federatie Opvang on keeping the results in place.
As promised in the sport committee debate of 30 June, I spoke with the State Secretary at your request to examine whether sport and exercise are embedded.
Zoals toegezegd in het AO sport van 30 juni jongstleden heb ik op uw verzoek gesproken met de Staatssecretaris om te bezien of sport en bewegen is ingebed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het gebruik van antibiotica door boeren

An MP from the PvdA asked the state secretaries whether they were aware of the SDa report on antibiotic use in livestock in 2015, why the 58% reduction since 2009 falls short of the 70% target and what further steps will be taken, and whether more demanding targets, further analysis and binding measures are planned for farms that show no reduction. The government welcomed the reduction, announced additional measures for high-use farms and vets, committed to a sector analysis of critical success factors and a pilot at high-use farms, and promised to inform parliament before the summer recess.
Before the summer recess we will inform you about this follow-up policy.
Voor het zomerreces informeren wij u over dit vervolgbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch, Yücel en Van Dekken over onveiligheid voor  homo's en lesbiennes

MPs asked the Justice Minister about insecurity for gay men and lesbians in nightlife, reports that incidents were not reported to police, and how reporting rates would be raised. The minister confirmed that 30.2% of gay men and lesbians feel unsafe near nightlife venues, said the police is improving the reporting process and training, and listed a campaign and Roze in Blauw networks to increase reporting.
Reports arising from such incidents must be taken seriously.
Aangiften n.a.v. dergelijke incidenten dienen serieus genomen te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over het bericht ‘Nederlandse vogels massaal uit de natuur geroofd’

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of mass illegal bird trapping and trade in the Netherlands, and whether NVWA enforcement capacity and bird markets are adequately supervised. The State Secretary could not confirm the figures but acknowledged such illegal practices occur, admitted no separate statistics are kept, judged NVWA's 20 inspectors sufficient, and saw no reason to tighten supervision of bird markets beyond asking NVWA to pay more attention to them.
I do not have such figures, because the registrations of police, justice and the NVWA do not record these poaching offences separately.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke cijfers, want in de registraties van politie, justitie en de NVWA worden deze stroperijdelicten niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het wel produceren van rapporten maar niet repareren van de schade

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM and the Centrum Veilig Wonen produce costly reports without repairing gas-damage, including claims of 25,000 euro in reports, that these exceed the actual damage, and that they rarely call back. The minister declined to discuss the individual case in detail, said agreement had been reached so repairs can start, noted the CVW is improving its communication, and said handling speed depends on repair complexity.
It does not befit me as Minister to go into the details of an individual damage case at length.
Het past mij als Minister niet om uitgebreid in te gaan op de details van een individueel schadegeval.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de plofkipfabriek in Veenendaal

The MP asks whether a Ukrainian poultry firm's meat-cutting plant in Veenendaal, its welfare and hygiene oversight, and the labelling of its meat as Dutch comply with Dutch and EU rules, and whether the state can stop it. The State Secretary answers that live poultry imports from Ukraine are banned, that EU-approved Ukrainian plants are supervised by Ukraine and audited by the EU, that origin labelling rules apply, and that the plant already complies with Dutch law so no intervention is warranted.
The cutting plant in Veenendaal currently complies with the laws and regulations, so there is no ground or reason for the Dutch government to intervene.
De uitsnijderij in Veenendaal voldoet op dit moment aan de wet- en regelgeving en daarmee is er geen grond of reden voor ingrijpen vanuit de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over matchfixing in het tennis

An MP asked the ministers of Health and of Justice whether matchfixing in professional tennis is more widespread than known, whether attempts occurred at Dutch matches, whether they are punishable, whether complaints or criminal investigations exist. The minister answered that signals were shared with the Tennis Integrity Unit, that attempted fixing is criminally punishable under certain articles if leads arise, that no complaint was filed because players involved were unidentified, and that the Public Prosecution Service does not disclose investigations.
The Public Prosecution Service makes no announcement about whether or not it is investigating anything.
Het Openbaar Ministerie doet geen mededeling over waar het wel of geen onderzoek naar doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over schadetaxaties door het Groninger Taxatie Bureau

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about allegations that the Groninger Taxatie Bureau, acting for the Centrum Veilig Wonen, routinely rejects earthquake damage claims, makes counter-expertise dependent on NAM-set limits and underreports damage, and whether NAM and CVW prioritise keeping compensation costs low. The minister denied these allegations, stating that experts follow the NAM protocol and Handboek Aardbevingsschade, that residents may choose a counter-expert and the Arbiter Aardbevingsschade, and that he has no signals of a gap between management and the workfloor.
No. The resident is free to choose their own counter-expert, who is paid by the CVW at a set hourly rate.
Nee. De bewoner is vrij om zelf een contra-expert te kiezen die wordt betaald door het CVW volgens een vastgesteld uurtarief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het feit dat er veel meer doden door Q-koorts zijn gevallen dan gedacht

MP Van Dekken asked the minister about reports that many more people died from Q fever than previously thought, and whether further research and missed patients were being addressed. Minister Schippers acknowledged the impact, said the new research shows 74 deaths and that more research and a follow-up on diagnosis and treatment will be shared with parliament, but stated no reason to think patients are not getting correct treatment.
I will share the results with your House.
Ik zal de resultaten met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek en Van Dekken over de hoogspanningsverbinding van 380 kV in Groningen van Eemshaven naar Vierverlaten

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the promised further study into undergrounding part of the 380 kV line in Groningen, the status of that study, and whether all area partners are involved in the upcoming administrative consultation. The minister confirmed TenneT's study is ongoing with a decision after summer 2016, and said provincial and municipal officials and residents' groups are consulted at set moments, though not always at the same table.
Based on this study and consultation with the region, I will take a decision after the summer of 2016.
Mede op basis van dit onderzoek en overleg met de regio zal ik na de zomer van 2016 een besluit nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over schelden bij jeugdvoetbal

An MP asked the ministers about verbal abuse, aggression and discrimination at youth football and what the Naar een veiliger sportklimaat programme has achieved. The minister answered that the programme is being extended by two years with a focus on weak clubs and volunteer board members, and pointed to fair play competitions and the referee and player licence system, without addressing the MP's specific questions in detail.
For that reason I have extended the action plan 'Towards a Safer Sports Climate' by two years.
Om die reden heb ik dan ook het actieplan «Naar een Veiliger Sportklimaat» met twee jaar verlengd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over Q-koorts en een geitenstal in Rossum

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Minister of Health whether a large goat stall in Rossum, which the GGD warned could pose risks if operations deviate even slightly, is acceptable given the Q-fever outbreak history, and why residents' objections were overridden. The government answered that the GGD gave positive advice, that Q-fever measures and vaccination mean no raised risk, that the municipality is responsible for the zoning plan and emissions, and that objections were handled in the normal zoning process.
For the environmental measures the municipality is responsible in its capacity as competent authority for the environmental permit.
Voor de milieumaatregelen is de gemeente verantwoordelijk in zijn hoedanigheid van bevoegd gezag voor de omgevingsvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Cegerek over particuliere speeltoestellen in de openbare ruimte

MPs Van Dekken and Çegerek asked the Minister of Health about a possible three-year pilot letting municipalities set safety rules for privately placed play equipment, its design, safety, parent information, and whether it leads to legislation. The minister answered that the pilot is still under study, municipal views vary, consultation with the ROW has taken place, and any evaluation would be independent and could lead to a single national solution.
An evaluation will then be carried out by an independent research bureau.
Een evaluatie zal dan door een onafhankelijk onderzoeksbureau worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht dat de Dopingautoriteit opheldering wil van NOC*NSF over bloedtesten

An MP asks whether NOC*NSF's sports-medical bloodtesting, including the off-score, can and must be shared with the Dopingautoriteit, and whether a Dutch anti-doping law is planned. The minister answers that the medical programme is not aimed at detecting doping, that NOC*NSF has no legal duty to share such data, that cooperation will be improved through agreements, and that a Wet uitvoering anti-dopingbeleid is pending before the Raad van State.
There is no legislation that obliges NOC*NSF to share collected data that may indicate doping use with the Dopingautoriteit.
Er is geen wetgeving die NOC*NSF verplicht verzamelde gegevens die kunnen wijzen op dopinggebruik te delen met de Dopingautoriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Servaes over het Amnesty-rapport 'WK Voetbal Qatar: FIFA negeert uitbuiting arbeidsmigranten'

MPs Van Dekken and Servaes asked the ministers about Amnesty's report on exploitation of migrant workers building Qatar 2022 World Cup venues, FIFA's inaction, and Qatar's sponsorship system. The ministers acknowledged serious abuses remain, pointed to EU-level pressure on FIFA and Qatar, the ILO mission and complaint process, and the EU Presidency's integrity agenda, without committing to new binding steps.
The cabinet will therefore continue to press for improvements in the position of migrant workers in talks with Qatar and business.
Het kabinet zal zich daarom in de gesprekken met Qatar en het bedrijfsleven blijven inzetten voor de verbetering van de positie van arbeidsmigranten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Van Dekken over de risico’s voor de volksgezondheid die de groei van de melkveestapel met zich mee brengt en heeft gebracht

MPs Thieme and Van Dekken asked whether growing dairy herds and farm sizes pose public health risks, including infectious disease and Streptococcus agalactiae, and whether hard caps on cow numbers should be set. The minister answered that farm size is only one factor among many, that no link to S. agalactiae in humans is established, that the VGO study on livestock and resident health will report before summer, and that no hard caps are planned.
A possible link between livestock farming and public health, however, I take very seriously.
Een mogelijk verband tussen veehouderijen en volksgezondheid neem ik echter zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over gezondheidsklachten als gevolg van meervoudige mijnbouwschade

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about health complaints linked to repeated gas-extraction damage in Groningen, the RUG Gronings Perspectief findings, and how policy would respond. The minister confirmed the interim findings, said the NCG already prioritises relieving affected residents and will use the results to improve procedures, and declined to speculate on the study's final conclusions about underlying causes.
In response to this report, the NCG has already indicated that the results will be used to improve the damage protocol and the working method of the Centre for Safe Living (CVW) in that respect.
In reactie op dit rapport heeft de NCG reeds laten weten dat de resultaten zullen worden benut om het schadeprotocol en de werkwijze van het Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW) in dat opzicht te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de waardedalingsregeling

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Groningen value-decline compensation scheme applies in some municipalities but not Oldambt, whether value-increase rules also exclude Oldambt, and about the status of a motion for a similar scheme. The minister confirmed awareness, explained the value-increase scheme now covers all earthquake damage above 1,000 euro, said the motion will be considered in the spring memorandum, and justified the value-decline geographic boundary by a CBS study of housing-market functioning.
The cabinet will take this motion into account in the decision-making for the spring memorandum and will then inform the House of Representatives about it.
Het kabinet betrekt deze motie bij de besluitvorming in het kader van de voorjaarsnota en zal uw Kamer hierover vervolgens informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dekken over het bericht 'Gemaskerd protest tegen ‘asielfabriek’

Two MPs asked whether the Kameraadschap Noord-Nederland demonstrations against an asylum centre were legally notified, whether masked participants can be restricted, and whether they can be asked for ID. The minister answered that the group is extreme-right, that Oldambt required notice for one demonstration, that the mayor could impose mask bans and issued an emergency order, and that police may request ID when there is a good reason.

This emergency order requires demonstrators wearing face-covering clothing in Winschoten to keep away from, or be removed on first police instruction from, the gathering before, during and after the event, until 23.00.

In dit noodbevel is voorzien in een verplichting voor demonstranten met gezichtsbedekkende kleding die zich in Winschoten bevinden om zich voor, tijdens en na de bijeenkomst op eerste aanzegging van de politie verwijderd te houden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over geweld in het amateurvoetbal

Two MPs asked whether violence in amateur football is increasing and what the government will do about it. The minister answered that police and KNVB figures show no clear upward trend, that incidents still occur, and that the safer sports action plan will be continued with added support for at-risk clubs.
On the basis of the available figures, there is so far no sign of an increase in violence in amateur football.
Op basis van de beschikbare cijfers lijkt van een stijging van geweld in het amateurvoetbal vooralsnog geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de investeringen van verzekeraars in bedrijven die bont en exotisch leer verkopen

An MP asked whether insurers' indirect investments in fur and exotic leather firms are regulated, whether the government will create rules, ensure transparency and talk to insurers to phase these investments out. The government answered there is no current regulation, relies on self-regulation via a planned multistakeholder CSR convenant with the insurance sector that may cover animal welfare and transparency, and noted two insurers are willing to engage on animal welfare.
Within the framework of (international) corporate social responsibility, the government relies on self-regulation.
In het kader van (internationaal) maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen (iMVO) zet de overheid in op zelfregulering.
Antwoord op vragen van de Rudmer Heerema en Van Dekken over de opmerking van Blatter dat het WK-bid van Nederland en België altijd kansloos is geweest

MPs Heerema and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether Blatter's claim that the Netherlands-Belgium World Cup bid was always hopeless is true, and whether the costs of about 10 million euros could be recovered. The minister replied that the KNVB feels misled, awaits an external audit of the Diallo payment due in June before deciding on action, and that she has put sports integrity and transparent event awards on the EU presidency agenda.
An external accountant is currently conducting an investigation, commissioned by the KNVB, into the payment to Diallo in the Netherlands-Belgium World Cup bid.
Momenteel loopt in opdracht van de KNVB het onderzoek door een extern accountant naar de betaling aan Diallo bij het Nederlands-Belgisch WK-bid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de behandeling van uitgelegde hennen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the NVWA supervises the catching and transport of laying hens, including the slaughterhouses abroad, and whether the EFSA should investigate and the sector invest in better transport. The State Secretary answered that the NVWA carries out unannounced checks, that foreign slaughterhouses are supervised by their own authorities, and that the sector is being engaged on improvements and possible stricter enforcement.
The Netherlands has no data on this.
Nederland heeft hier geen gegevens over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Dekken naar aanleiding van de stalbrand in Oirschot

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs how many animals were in the Oirschot barn fire, whether injured animals stayed alive for many hours, the cause of the fire, whether the building fell under the updated building code, and how such fires can be prevented. The state secretary answered that about 9,000 animals were likely present, that asbestos delayed entry until about 20 hours after the fire, that the cause is still under investigation with a report expected mid-June, and pointed to the existing Action Plan on barn fires with an evaluation planned for late 2016.
The official report with the results of this investigation is expected around mid-June.
Het officiële rapport met de resultaten van dit onderzoek worden rond half juni verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Van Dekken over het mogelijk moeten sluiten van gevangenissen

MPs Volp and Van Dekken asked whether eight prisons and three youth institutions would close, whether staff had been informed, and how the government would respect the De Vries motion on regional job losses. The State Secretary answered that a WODC study and second opinion on the forecasting model are underway, DJI has been asked to draft a flexibility plan to be discussed with mayors, and the motion is one criterion in that assessment.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de afhandeling van meldingen van aardbevingsschade door het Centrum voor Veilig Wonen (CVW) buiten de contour

Three PvdA MPs asked why claims for earthquake damage outside the damage contour are not being processed by CVW while a validation study is pending, and whether registration and provisional payments could proceed now. The minister replied that NAM's Arcadis study finds such damage negligible, that an independent validation is due around summer and the minister will inform parliament then, and that NAM will visit all reporters but wants the validation results first; a judgement now would almost certainly mean rejection.
I will inform your House at that moment.
Ik zal uw Kamer op dat moment informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht 'Verdachte weddenschappen bij NEC-Willem II'

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about reported suspicious betting around NEC-Willem II, how the KNVB, OM and European partners share information on match-fixing, and how reports can be made. The ministers describe existing platforms, EU cooperation, reporting channels and say the OM does not disclose whether it investigates specific cases.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Van Dekken over de jacht op zwanen

MPs Leenders and Van Dekken asked the state secretary about EenVandaag footage of swan hunting, provincial culling permits, enforcement and compensation paid for swan damage. The state secretary answered that provinces grant and supervise the permits, no violations were recorded, police are assessing the footage, and provinces remain responsible, so no permits will be withdrawn.
Under the Flora and Fauna Act it is the responsibility of the provinces to approve wildlife management plans and grant the permits based on them.
Het is ingevolge de Flora- en faunawet de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies om faunabeheerplannen goed te keuren en daarop gebaseerde ontheffingen te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over oerwoudgeluiden bij Harkemase boys

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked about racist shouting by a supporter toward a dark-skinned player at an amateur football match, whether such incidents are frequent, and what the Safe Sport programme does to prevent them. The minister condemned the behaviour, said no figures exist on amateur incidents, pointed to reporting channels, and described the KNVB-HALT action plan and monitoring results showing reduced feelings of insecurity.
No figures are available on how often incidents of this kind occur on amateur football pitches.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal keer dat incidenten van deze aard plaatsvinden op het amateurveld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over het hoge aantal gevallen van longkanker in Brabant en het effect hierop van de intensieve veeteelt

Two MPs asked whether the government will act on reports of high lung cancer rates in Brabant linked to intensive livestock farming, including research, registration and a moratorium on new permits pending study. The minister replied that the ongoing VGO study does not cover lung cancer, that the GGD has started an exploratory study with results expected end of April, and that the Health Council may be asked to revise its 2012 advice, but no permit moratorium is accepted since no scientific indications of risk are known.
Following the report, the GGD in the Brabant region is immediately starting an exploratory study into the relationship between lung cancer and livestock farming.
Naar aanleiding van het genoemde bericht start de GGD in de regio Brabant per direct een verkennend onderzoek naar de relatie longkanker en veehouderij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over wangedrag van zichzelf voetbalsupporter noemende Nederlanders in Madrid

MPs asked how the government views Dutch football supporters' misconduct in Madrid, whether mayors can impose liberty-restricting measures under article 172a of the Municipalities Act for racist behaviour, and when the new football-violence law takes effect. The minister said Spanish authorities lead, the club has issued stadium bans, mayors decide on individual measures, and the law has applied since 1 July 2015, extending the available powers.
It is up to the mayor of the municipality from which a person originates to determine whether there is cause to impose a measure under the Municipalities Act.
Het is aan de burgemeester van de gemeente waaruit een persoon afkomstig is om te bepalen of er aanleiding is om een maatregel op grond van de Gemeentewet op te leggen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over de uitbuiting van Roemeense scheepsbouwers

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the minister about Romanian shipyard workers paid around 1 euro per hour via A1 posting certificates, questioning the legality and fairness of wage gaps and the scale of posting. The minister said the case may be a sham construction, that wage-cost differences under the posting directive are undesirable, and outlined EU-level work on A1 misuse while noting the system does not record sector and a meldingsplicht is planned.
An A1 certificate cannot record which sector an employee or self-employed person is active in.
Op een A1-verklaring kan niet worden ingevuld welke sector een werknemer of zelfstandige actief is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de rol van Europa in de illegale dierenhandel

An MP asks the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the EU's role in illegal wildlife trade, the need for more budget and priority, and Europol's claim that wildlife crime lacks priority. The State Secretary answers that Dutch capacity is sufficient, that existing funding (4 million from EZ and 2 million from BZ) was reprioritised, and that the Netherlands will push for strong Council conclusions on the EU action plan.
In my view, the Netherlands' efforts and capacity to combat wildlife crime are sufficient, partly because of intensive cooperation between enforcement authorities at European and global level.

Naar mijn mening is de inzet en capaciteit van Nederland om wildlifecriminaliteit aan te pakken voldoende, mede vanwege de intensieve samenwerking op Europees en mondiaal niveau tussen de handhavingsinstanties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders, Van Dekken en Recourt over wildstroperij

MPs Leenders, Van Dekken and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the safety of green BOA enforcement officers fighting poaching, their training, the lack of separate registration of poaching, equipment, and police capacity. The minister answered that deployment is the responsibility of private employers and local triangles, that poaching is not a separate offence so is not registered, that equipment can be granted on justified request, and that a provincial coordination platform is being set up.
Poaching is not a separately defined criminal offence in law, so separate registration is not possible.
Wildstroperij is geen afzonderlijk in de wet opgenomen strafbaar feit, waardoor aparte registratie niet mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Thieme over het doden van honderden gezonde kalveren

MPs Van Dekken and Thieme asked the State Secretary about hundreds of healthy under-weight calves being killed for economic reasons, including whether the government would intervene given dairy expansion, transport and antibiotic problems, and the reliability of industry registrations. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to a sector plan and NVWA enforcement, and stated that industry registrations show about 200 calves per week euthanised, with the photographed dead calves being illustrative only.
I will still study the plan, but I am mainly pleased that these sectors are taking their joint responsibility here and have come up with an integrated action plan.
Ik ga het plan nog bestuderen maar ik ben vooral blij dat deze sectoren hier hun gezamenlijke verantwoordelijkheid nemen en zijn gekomen met een integraal plan van aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de afschaffing van de contourenregeling

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he welcomed NAM director Schotman's call to abandon the contour map (contourenkaart) for gas-extraction damage, and how this fits with the proposed evidentiary presumption law that still relies on the earthquake contour. The minister answered that NAM must compensate damage regardless of location, that the map plays no role, and that the presumption is limited to the Groningen field effect area because a broader presumption would be disproportionate.
The bill aims to strengthen the evidentiary position of those harmed, without leading to a disproportionate situation.
Het wetsvoorstel beoogt de bewijspositie van benadeelden te versterken, zonder tot een onevenredige situatie te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Van Dekken over een slechte bereikbaarheid van 112 in de omgeving Vlagtwedde, Oost Groningen

MPs Vermue and Van Dekken asked whether 112 is poorly reachable by mobile phone around Vlagtwedde in Groningen, whether this is an exception, and what steps will be taken. The government answered that mobile reachability of 112 is good nationally, that 100% is not achievable, that supplementary tests show 99.58% success, and referred to a letter of 18 February for the status update.
100% mobile reachability of 1-1-2 is not possible.
100% mobiele bereikbaarheid van 1-1-2 is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Van Gerven over uitbreiding van nertsenhouderijen en bont

MPs Van Dekken and Van Gerven asked why Zeeland provincial authorities allowed mink farm expansion despite the Fur Farming Ban, how enforcement works, and how consumers can identify real versus synthetic fur labelling. The State Secretary answered that municipalities cannot refuse permits on this ground, the ban prohibits starting or expanding mink farming regardless of permits, enforcement is initiated by municipalities and cassation is pending, and that EU labelling changes are unlikely while the Commission is reluctant.
The Fur Farming Ban Act prevents starting or expanding a mink farm even with an environmental permit obtained.
De Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij verhindert het starten of uitbreiden van een nertsenhouderij met de eventueel verkregen omgevingsvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Van Dekken over het aanbieden van jachtarrangementen in Nederland

MPs Leenders and Van Dekken asked whether hunting arrangements allowing foreign hunters in the Netherlands can be banned under current or new nature law, and what this would require. The state secretary replied that a legal amendment to the Wet natuurbescherming is needed, provinces currently lack such powers, and that talks with provinces and the hunters' association are ongoing.
No, introducing a ban on hunting arrangements for foreign hunters requires an amendment to the Nature Conservation Act.
Nee, voor de invoering van een verbod op jachtarrangementen voor buitenlandse jagers is een wijziging van de Wet natuurbescherming nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht 'Poging tot matchfixing in eredivisie'

An MP asked ministers about reports of attempted match-fixing in the Eredivisie, including the scope of approaches to players, the criminal investigation and the KNVB's notification of clubs. The minister condemned the conduct, confirmed a criminal investigation by the Openbaar Ministerie without disclosing its target, and deferred answering the remaining questions until the investigation concludes.
On the question of who the investigation is directed at, the OM makes no statements.
Over de vraag op wie het onderzoek zich richt, doet het OM geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over het aanvallen van een scheidsrechter door spelers van de voetbalclub Nieuw Sloten

Two MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers whether a complaint had been filed over football players of Nieuw Sloten attacking a referee, whether the Public Prosecution Service would prosecute, and whether the KNVB was investigating. The minister answered that no complaint was filed, the OM decided not to prosecute given the seriousness, the referee's wish not to file, and the club withdrawing the team, and that the KNVB disciplinary investigation is ongoing with players suspended.
The Public Prosecution Service decided not to prosecute ex officio, given the seriousness of what occurred.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft besloten niet ambtshalve tot vervolging over te gaan, vanwege de ernst van hetgeen dat is voorgevallen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Dekken over gebrekkige arbeidsomstandigheden in Qatar bij de voorbereidingen op het WK voetbal van 2022

MPs Servaes and Van Dekken asked the foreign and trade ministers about poor labour conditions for migrant workers in Qatar ahead of the 2022 World Cup, including Amnesty's report of stalled reforms, the concrete steps taken on the Parliament's June motion, and FIFA's transparency. The ministers answered that Qatar has taken some positive steps but reforms are incomplete, that the Netherlands is pressing Qatar bilaterally, in the EU and through the ILO (including a high-level ILO mission), and that FIFA integrity questions await ongoing investigations.
Various (criminal) investigations into the awarding of these World Cups are currently underway. The cabinet is awaiting the outcomes of these investigations before taking a position.

Momenteel worden er diverse (strafrechtelijke) onderzoeken verricht naar de toewijzing van deze Wereldkampioenschappen. Het kabinet wacht de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken af alvorens een standpunt in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders, Van Dekken en Recourt over de berichten 'Nieuwe generatie jagers op komst'  en 'Aantal stropers is verdubbeld op de Veluwe'

MPs Leenders, Van Dekken and Recourt asked the Justice Minister about reports of 'new hunters' and a doubling of poaching on the Veluwe, including sentencing, enforcement and national trends. The minister said poaching is not a separate offence and prosecution can yield unconditional prison terms, described enforcement cooperation with private landowners' wardens, and said poaching is not registered separately so national trends and arrest figures cannot be provided without disproportionate manual review.
In police and justice registrations, poaching offences are not recorded separately.
In de registraties van politie en justitie worden stroperijdelicten niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht “Matchfixing en het Nederlandse tennis”

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about a report that Dutch authorities are lax in detecting match-fixing in tennis and cooperate poorly with Belgium on a suspected fixed match. The minister denied the claim, said the Functioneel Parket leads match-fixing enforcement with police and FIOD capacity available, and declined to say whether any investigation exists into the specific match, citing investigative and privacy interests.
The Public Prosecution Service makes no statement about whether or not it is investigating any matter.
Het OM doet geen mededeling over waar het wel of geen onderzoek naar doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Van Dekken over het aanbieden van jachtarrangementen in Nederland

MPs Leenders and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about websites advertising goose hunting in the Netherlands for foreign hunters, and how the Nature Conservation Act and related rules allow, condition and control such visits. The government answered that foreign hunters may hunt under a time-limited guest permit only when accompanied by a Dutch licence holder and with landowner or wildlife-unit permission, and it said it will consult provinces and the hunters' association on ending commercial hunting trips.
I disapprove of organising commercial hunting trips and the associations this raises. I will therefore consult with the provinces and the Royal Hunters Association about ending such practices.

Het organiseren van commerciële jachtreizen en de associaties die dit oproept keur ik af. Ik zal daarom met provincies en de Koninklijke Jagersvereniging in overleg treden over de beëindiging van dergelijke praktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jasper van Dijk inzake de inkomenspositie van popmuzikanten

MPs Van Dekken and Van Dijk asked the Minister about falling incomes of pop musicians, fees paid by subsidised pop venues, and royalties from streaming platforms. The Minister called the findings worrying, deferred advice from the Raad voor Cultuur, said fee-setting is the sector's responsibility while referring subsidy conditions to municipalities, and pointed to pending EU copyright work and a forthcoming pop policy letter.
I have asked the Raad voor Cultuur to advise me on how to deploy the EUR 2 million earmarked for improving artists' position on the labour market.
Ik heb de Raad voor Cultuur gevraagd mij te adviseren over de inzet van de € 2 miljoen euro
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Van Gerven over de uitbreiding van nertsenhouders

MPs Van Dekken and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about mink farms expanding after the Fur Farming Ban was suspended and about video showing mink being thrown and kicked into a gas chamber, including inspection frequency and a promised independent-offence measure. The government said it is still consulting the Public Prosecution Service, that inspections are unannounced but mink-killing dates are reported in advance, that cameras cannot be mandated, and that a policy response on a standalone ban will follow soon.
At present I am still consulting the Public Prosecution Service about the consequences of this ruling for enforcement.
Op dit moment ben ik nog in overleg met het Openbaar Ministerie over de gevolgen van deze uitspraak voor de handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Pia Dijkstra over gesjoemel bij het Nederlands-Belgisch WK-bid

MPs Van Dekken and Pia Dijkstra asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about alleged payments, including EUR 10,000 to vote-canvasser Amadou Diallo, in the Netherlands-Belgium World Cup bid. The minister answered that the KNVB found no violations in an initial review, that an independent accountant is investigating with results expected in Q1 2016, that business-sensitive documents will not be made public, and that she will await outcomes before considering recovering funds.
Documents containing business-sensitive information that give insight into the operational process for this bid have not been made public by me under the Wob.
Documenten met bedrijfsgevoelige informatie, die inzicht geven in het bedrijfsvoeringproces ten behoeve van dit bid zijn, in het kader van de Wob, door mij niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over een snel stijgend aantal beschadigingen aan boerderijen en drainagesystemen door bodemdaling in Groningen

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why NAM and the Commissie Bodemdaling dismiss rising damage to farms and drainage systems from subsidence in Groningen as mere settlement damage, whether NAM will pay, and when the Grontmij study is due. The Minister confirmed complaints have risen, explained that the official studies find uniform subsidence with no absolute effect on water levels, noted NAM must pay damage caused by gas extraction, gave a spring 2016 timeline for the study, and pointed to a case-manager arrangement while negotiating with NAM.
Yes, I am aware that the number of damage reports has increased.
Ja, het is mij bekend dat het aantal meldingen van schade is toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de onderlinge samenwerkingsovereenkomst tussen de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM) en het Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW)

Opposition MPs asked the minister whether the cooperation agreement between NAM and the Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW) is public, whether CVW is independent of NAM, and how contra-expertise hours are allocated. The minister said the agreement is private and not public, but was reviewed by the Commission of Toezicht, which found CVW independent and the relationship critical but sound, and promised to amend the damage protocol on contra-expertise.
This agreement is not public, but it has been reviewed by the Supervisory Committee on the Centrum Veilig Wonen, set up by me, in order to assess the working relationship between NAM and CVW.
Deze overeenkomst is niet openbaar, maar wel ingezien door de door mij ingestelde Commissie van Toezicht op het Centrum Veilig Wonen om de werkverhouding tussen NAM en CVW te kunnen beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Nijboer en Van Dekken over massale schade door gaswinning bij Delfzijl

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about widespread gas-extraction damage in villages near Delfzijl and whether he would press the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen for a fast investigation and speedy settlement. The minister confirmed the reports, said an investigation into the causes of high damage rates at the edges of the earthquake area starts in the first quarter of 2016, and promised attention to speedy, careful settlement of damage claims.

The National Coordinator Groningen (NCG) will start an investigation in the first quarter of this year into the causes of the high percentages of damage cases located at the edges of the earthquake area.

De Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) start in het eerste kwartaal van dit jaar met een onderzoek naar de oorzaken van de hoge percentages schadegevallen die gelokaliseerd zijn aan de randen van het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Nijboer en Van Dekken over de gelijke behandeling van aardbevingsschade in alle gemeenten

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked whether earthquake damage in Oldambt villages such as Nieuwolda, 't Waar and Nieuw-Scheemda mirrors the situation in Delfzijl, and asked the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen to extend its investigation to the whole area. Minister Kamp answered that the NCG will start in early 2016 an investigation into causes of high damage percentages at the edges of the earthquake area, including the municipalities named.

The Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) will start in the first quarter of this year an investigation into the causes of the high percentages of damage cases located at the edges of the earthquake area.

De Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) start in het eerste kwartaal van dit jaar met een onderzoek naar de oorzaken van de hoge percentages schadegevallen die gelokaliseerd zijn aan de randen van het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over het inspectierapport van Eyes on Animals over paardenmarkten

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about an Eyes on Animals inspection report on horse markets, including welfare concerns, transport times, body condition assessment, and night-time NVWA enforcement. The State Secretary acknowledged the welfare risks, said no ban is planned, and promised to revise the horse market protocol, tighten NVWA supervision and export rules, while describing existing inspection staffing and the body condition scoring method.

I will consult with the Horse Sector Council and other stakeholders, including the Animal Protection Society and Eyes on Animals, to consider how the horse market protocol should be revised and tightened.

Ik zal in overleg met de Sectorraad Paarden en de andere stakeholders, waaronder de Dierenbescherming en Eyes on Animals, bezien op welke wijze het paardenmarktenprotocol dient te worden herzien en te worden aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het aardbevingsbestendig maken van de chemiesector in Delfzijl

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked why the Groningen National Coordinator's programme lacks a concrete plan for making Delfzijl's chemical sector earthquake-resistant, when it will come and when binding standards will exist. The minister answered that an industry table chaired by the coordinator will develop a joint approach expected in Q1 2016, that a Deltares/TNO guideline exists while standards are still under discussion, and that much of the research lies with industry itself.
Companies and competent authorities will jointly develop, via the so-called Industry Table, a comprehensive approach linking existing and planned methods and studies.
Bedrijven en bevoegde instanties zullen via de zogenaamde Industrietafel samen een sluitende aanpak ontwikkelen, die bestaande en voorgenomen methodieken en onderzoeken verbindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over een verschuiving van de aardbevingen naar de randen van het gaswinningsgebied

MPs asked whether earthquakes are shifting to the edges of the Groningen gas field after production cuts at Loppersum, and whether closure sequencing could worsen the situation and be included in the gas-extraction decision. The minister answered that faults do not move, that quakes in the edge areas follow local pressure decline and production, and that NAM has been asked to optimise production allocation across the field, with SodM supervising the work.

In line with SodM's advice of 1 December 2015, I have asked NAM what the optimal production distribution across the entire field (including the Loppersum area) is, in order to further reduce the risk now and in the future.

Conform het advies van SodM van 1 december 2015 heb ik NAM gevraagd wat de optimale productieverdeling over het gehele veld (inclusief het Loppersumgebied) is, om het risico nu en in de toekomst verder te verkleinen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over de lange afstandstransporten van kalveren

MPs asked the State Secretary about long-distance calf transports, including reported welfare problems, the number of animals and violations, and whether maximum transport times should be tightened. The government answered that it lacks centralized data on health complaints and violation types, has stopped certifying export of unweaned calves over long distances since December 2015 because vehicles do not meet EU requirements, and has commissioned Wageningen UR research on conditions for such transport.
I am not aware of any figures on complaints regarding the health or possible mortality of the animals imported.
Er zijn mij geen aantallen bekend van klachten met betrekking tot de gezondheid of eventuele sterfte van de dieren die aangevoerd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland, Van Dekken, Nijboer over de stremming van het treinverkeer tussen Bad Nieuweschans en Leer

MPs asked the State Secretary about the closure of the rail bridge between Bad Nieuweschans and Leer, its duration, passenger and freight impacts, alternatives, and consequences for the Groningen–Bremen rail project's national funding and EU grant. The State Secretary answered that replacement may take 3 to 5 years, will write to the German counterpart, provides replacement buses, and says funding conditions and the EU study budget are still being assessed.
In the short term I will send my German counterpart a letter drawing attention to the current disruption.
Op korte termijn zal ik mijn Duitse ambtscollega een brief sturen, waarin ik aandacht zal vragen voor de huidige hinder
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug, Van Dekken, Mei Li Vos en Jasper van Dijk over de economische positie van makers van reclamedeuntjes

MPs asked whether the economic position of jingle composers is weakened by a near-monopoly of a few advertising music firms and by practices of Buma/Stemra and broadcasters, and what the Auteurswet and Buma/Stemra could do about it. The government answered that competition law and the new author-contract law provide remedies, that complaints must come from the makers themselves, and that the law will be evaluated within five years.
Buma/Stemra is not a party to the agreement that composers and lyricists conclude with a client.
Buma/Stemra is geen partij bij de overeenkomst die componisten en tekstschrijvers sluiten met een opdrachtgever.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Nijboer en Van Dekken over de onafhankelijkheid van het Centrum Veilig Wonen

MPs Jan Vos, Nijboer and Van Dekken asked the minister whether the Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW), which handles earthquake damage claims for NAM, is truly independent of NAM, and raised concerns about the oversight commission, the damage assessment process, pressure towards demolition, the Handboek Aardbevingsschade and the reversal of the burden of proof. The minister replied that NAM remains legally liable, that CVW is operated at arm's length under a tender, that the oversight chair is independent, that damage assessments and contra-expertise are handled properly, and that a bill on a statutory presumption of causation will be submitted after Council of State advice.
I have asked the Council of State for urgent advice on the bill concerning the statutory presumption of evidence.
Ik heb de Raad van State gevraagd om spoedadvies over het wetsvoorstel omtrent het wettelijk bewijsvermoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Van Dekken en Jan Vos over het onderzoek van RTV-Noord dat Groningers uit een bepaald gebied geen rechtsbijstandverzekering kunnen afsluiten

MPs Recourt, Van Dekken and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether residents of the Groningen earthquake area can obtain legal expenses insurance, whether insurers should offer alternatives for non-quake disputes, and about insurers' deal with the Stichting WAG. The minister replied that the claim is inaccurate, that some insurers accept new clients from the area and others do not, that the NCG will examine whether conditions are disproportionate, and that insurers decide how to inform clients about the WAG agreement.
The Minister of Economic Affairs has additionally asked the NCG to conduct further research into the conditions insurers impose for taking out legal expenses insurance within the earthquake area.

De Minister van Economische Zaken heeft daarnaast de NCG gevraagd om nader onderzoek te doen naar de voorwaarden die verzekeraars stellen om een rechtsbijstandsverzekering af te sluiten binnen het aardbevingsgebied.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Van Dekken over de uitspraken van de voorzitter van de Regiegroep Vitale Varkenshouderij, waarin hij stelt dat hij geen heil ziet in het verkleinen van de varkensstapel

MPs Dikkers and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs to respond to the chair of the pig sector steering group, who said reducing the pig herd is no solution, and asked whether the government will keep pushing for shrinking and extensifying pig farming. The State Secretary replied that the current export-dependent model offers little prospect, that the steering group will present a plan in early 2016, and that the herd size may be an outcome of the sector's process rather than a target.
The size of the pig herd may be a result of this process.
De omvang van de varkensstapel kan een resultante zijn van dit proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug, Kerstens en Van Dekken over de exorbitante gouden handdruk voor de vertrekkend directeur van Buma

MPs Oosenbrug, Kerstens and Van Dekken asked whether the large severance payment to the departing Buma/Stemra director, who refused to moderate pay under the WNT, is acceptable, and whether the rules could prevent such payments. The minister answered that pre-WNT contracts fall under transitional law, that the College van Toezicht examined the arrangement, that the contract's content is a matter between private parties, and that no change to transitional rules is planned.
Beyond that, it is not for me to disclose the content of the employment contract between two private parties.
Het is voor het overige niet aan mij om mededeling te doen over de inhoud van de arbeidsovereenkomst tussen twee private partijen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken en Jan Vos over het bericht dat Nederlandse banken een megakippenbedrijf in Oekraïne financieren

Two PvdA MPs asked whether Dutch banks financing a huge Ukrainian poultry company, export credit guarantees for intensive livestock systems, and Dutch versus Ukrainian animal welfare standards were acceptable. The minister answered that Ukrainian standards are currently lower but the EU association agreement requires convergence, that export credits are assessed under IFC standards including animal welfare, and that the government sees no reason to refuse credits on the basis of herd size.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over een vergunningsaanvraag voor een megastal in Dinkelland

MPs Van Dekken and Leenders ask the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a permit application for a large pig farm in Dinkelland, including whether the municipality can block it given its own land-use vision, grandfathering and salvage rules, the PAS nitrogen scheme, and what residents, the municipality, province or national government can still do. The government answers that the municipality and province are competent for land-use and the permit was handled under PAS transitional law, that the 2013 vision could not alone bar the farm under provincial rules, and that residents retain ordinary legal remedies while no national interest warrants a directive.
The Programme for Addressing Nitrogen (PAS) has no consequences for this case because the application for the Nature Conservation Act permit was submitted before 1 July 2015.
Het Programma Aanpak Stikstof (PAS) heeft geen gevolgen voor deze casus omdat de aanvraag voor de Natuurbeschermingswetvergunning was ingediend vóór 1 juli 2015
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht dat het WADA en het IOC voor de Winterspelen in Sotsji hadden moeten ingrijpen in Rusland

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether WADA and the IOC should have intervened over suspected Russian doping before the Sochi 2014 Winter Games, including the reinstatement of a suspended lab, and what the Netherlands would do during its EU presidency. The minister answered that sports bodies bear primary responsibility, that the lab had improved in time, that independent observers found no major irregularities, and that the Netherlands will put sports integrity and an anti-doping conference on the EU presidency agenda.
It is up to WADA and the IOC themselves to take their responsibility if they have concrete indications of systematic doping by athletes in a country.
Het is aan WADA en aan het IOC zelf om hun verantwoordelijkheid te nemen indien zij concrete aanwijzingen hebben over systematisch dopinggebruik van atleten in een land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Van Dekken over misstanden in de nertsenhouderij en massale uitbreidingen door nertsenhouders

MPs Van Gerven and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about footage of injured mink, inspection and enforcement at mink farms, and reported mass expansions of mink farms. The State Secretary declined to explain the footage without knowing its origin, said inspections and warnings were carried out by the NVWA, confirmed some expansions via municipal permits while noting the ban had been suspended by court, and promised further examination of the matter.
Because it is unclear how, where and when the footage you refer to was obtained, I cannot interpret it further in relation to the current situation in the Dutch mink farming sector.
Omdat het onduidelijk is hoe, waar en wanneer de door u aangeduide beelden verkregen zijn, kan ik deze niet nader duiden in relatie tot de huidige situatie in de Nederlandse nertsenhouderij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over het bericht dat gemeenten uitbreidingsvergunningen voor nertsenhouderijen goedkeuren

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked the state secretary about municipalities approving expansion permits for mink farms despite the suspended fur farming ban. The secretary confirmed about 15,000 additional breeding animals permitted in Noord-Brabant since 2013, said municipalities hold zoning powers, and that enforcement is being examined with the Public Prosecution Service.
The province of Noord-Brabant cannot confirm whether the cages for the number of permitted animals have actually been built.
De provincie Noord-Brabant kan niet bevestigen of de kooien voor het aantal vergunde dieren ook daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Van Dekken over het bericht dat uitzendkrachten die bij de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) werken twee weken onbetaald thuis moeten blijven

PvdA MPs Vermeij and Van Dekken asked whether DUO temporary agency workers were being sent home unpaid for two weeks, and whether this was acceptable. The minister denied that workers were sent home unpaid, explaining that agency staff were rostered only where needed and that many took leave, while committing to gradually reduce flexible staffing under a union agreement.
Sending home employees without a permanent contract is not the case.
Van naar huis sturen van medewerkers zonder vast contract is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het terugeisen van belastinggeld dat besteed is voor het WK bid 2018

The MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether the Netherlands should reclaim money spent on the 2018 World Cup bid from FIFA, given alleged corruption in the vote. The Minister declined to take a position, awaiting outcomes of US and Swiss investigations, and said the Dutch state contributed 3 million euros, with the KNVB and KBVB exploring reclaiming funds.
I make no statement on that. As I have already said above, I will first await the results of the ongoing investigations.
Ik doe daar geen uitspraak over. Zoals ik hierboven al heb gesteld wacht ik eerst de resultaten van de lopende onderzoeken af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij Klesch Aluminium Delfzijl

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about working conditions and reduced pay after the Klesch Aluminium Delfzijl rescue of a bankrupt firm, and about similarities to pre-pack bankruptcies like Estro and Princen. The minister declined to judge the individual case, said the Labour Inspectorate sees no reason to investigate, and pointed to pending legislation (Wet continuïteit ondernemingen I) to regulate pre-pack practice.
I do not judge the concrete facts and circumstances of the individual case.
Ik oordeel niet over de concrete feiten en omstandigheden van het individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Van Dekken over de toename van het aantal kiloknallers

MPs Dikkers and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the rise in supermarket 'kilo bargain' meat promotions and whether harder measures were needed. The State Secretary said such promotions are undesirable and shares concern about price pressure, but declined to verify the NGO research and pointed to the sector's sustainability agreement and voluntary commitments.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs does not conduct its own research into supermarket promotions.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken voert geen eigen onderzoek uit naar aanbiedingen van supermarkten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over Ajax-fans die gedupeerd worden door antisemitische uitlatingen van anderen

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the government about antisemitic chants at a football match and whether an KNVB sanction that let FC Utrecht fans sit elsewhere in the stadium undermined the fight against antisemitism. The minister replied that the sanction was legally applied, that no perpetrators could be identified for criminal prosecution, and that a zero-tolerance policy already exists.
I understand that FC Utrecht has decided to allow the supporters of the Bunnikside to take seats elsewhere.
Ik heb begrepen dat FC Utrecht besloten heeft de supporters van de Bunnikside in de gelegenheid te stellen elders plaats te nemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Cegerek over het bericht dat gemeenten de geuroverlast van veehouderijen niet terug mogen dringen

MPs Van Dekken and Cegerek asked whether municipalities can tighten odour rules in overburdened areas, citing a reported Council of State ruling, and whether cumulative odour nuisance and resident perception should be reflected in the Wet geurhinder en veehouderij evaluation. The state secretary corrected the press report, said the evaluation working group will advise before any response, noted the Crisis- en herstelwet has not yet been used coercively, and confirmed the RIVM comparison and that these matters will be part of the evaluation.
Yes. At my request the RIVM carried out a comparative analysis in which the research methods and results of the Utrecht University and GGD study were compared with the 2001 PRA study.
Ja. Het RIVM heeft op mijn verzoek een duidingsonderzoek uitgevoerd waarin de onderzoeksmethodiek en resultaten van het onderzoek van de Universiteit Utrecht en de GGD
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘NAM mag druk onder Langelo opvoeren, ondanks kans op zwaardere bevingen’

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the NAM's plan to increase gas storage at Norg despite the risk of stronger earthquakes, and why residents were not informed. The minister said the storage expansion approval dates from June 2014, the August 2015 change only lifts a compartment-level pressure restriction, municipalities and province were informed but residents were not, and seismic risk remains very limited according to SodM and TNO, with a monitoring network planned.
The residents were not separately informed.
De omwonenden zijn niet separaat geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Geef premie van 4000 euro aan alle inwoners aardbevingsgebied’

MPs asked whether all residents of the Groningen earthquake area should receive a 4,000 euro premium, as proposed by the Groninger Bodem Beweging, and whether this was promised in the earlier administrative agreement. The minister said no such promise exists, that the waardevermeerdering scheme covers only homeowners, and that the National Coordinator is reviewing all schemes, with the current scheme reopened retroactively for damage cases outside the 11 municipalities.
The administrative agreement 'Trust in Recovery and Recovery of Trust' provides that homeowners will be offered a value-increasing package.
In het bestuursakkoord «Vertrouwen op Herstel en Herstel van Vertrouwen» is afgesproken dat aan woningeigenaren een waardeverhogend pakket beschikbaar wordt gesteld
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jan Vos over personen die wedstrijdinformatie doorspelen via de telefoon vanaf voetbaltribunes

MPs asked whether people relaying match statistics by phone from football stands are a growing problem, what powers clubs have to remove them, and whether gambling restrictions are needed. The minister answered that clubs set house rules and can remove people for misconduct or nuisance, that there is no increase in complaints, and that the gambling questions are addressed in a separate bill answer.
It is up to the clubs themselves to determine the level of nuisance.
Het is aan de clubs zelf om de mate van overlast te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over nieuw rekenmodel om de verspreiding van Q-koorts te voorspellen

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked whether a new weather-based model predicting Q-fever spread is ready for use in an outbreak, how much further development is needed, including for other zoonoses, and whether the government will support it. The minister replied that the model can map exposure but cannot yet compute infection risk without emission data, that it can be extended to other airborne pathogens over one to two years per pathogen, and that RIVM will continue the work.
The RIVM has in recent years built up expertise in modelling the spread of airborne pathogens.
Het RIVM heeft de afgelopen jaren expertise opgebouwd in het modelleren van de verspreiding van luchtoverdraagbare ziekteverwekkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jans Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de toepassing van fracking bij gaswinning in Saaksum

MPs Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about NAM's plan to use fracking to recover remaining gas near Saaksum, the risks, alternatives and consultation with local authorities. The minister answered that fracking here is a routine, safety-checked stimulation within the existing plan, that SodM reviews the risk documents before work starts, that no alternative exists for this rock type, and that NAM has consulted local authorities, but declined to ask NAM to refrain.
However, regarding the upcoming work, I see no reason and no possibility to ask NAM not to carry it out.
Ten aanzien van de aanstaande werkzaamheden zie ik echter geen reden en geen mogelijkheid om NAM te verzoeken deze niet uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Van Dekken over het krimpbeleid in Oost-Groningen

Two MPs asked the minister whether the absence of joint population-decline (krimp) policy in East Groningen is a missed opportunity and what support the central government has given the municipalities there. The minister answers that primary responsibility lies with the municipalities and province, that a new integrated implementation plan is being prepared, and that central support has been provided through existing agreements and knowledge-sharing without any financial measures.
First, I would point out that responsibility for population-decline policy in East Groningen lies primarily with the relevant municipalities, in cooperation with the province.
Allereerst wil ik erop wijzen dat de verantwoordelijkheid voor het krimpbeleid in Oost-Groningen primair berust bij de desbetreffende gemeenten, in samenwerking met de provincie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht over een ingestorte boerderij in Bedum

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs what steps had been taken in the Bedum farmhouse collapse case, why the counter-expertise took so long, and whether NAM's lack of communication and support for residents was adequate. The minister declined to comment on the individual case in detail, described the procedural steps and the municipality's coordinating role, acknowledged that long silences are undesirable, and asked the National Coordinator Groningen to examine the adequacy of support for residents.
In general I am reluctant to respond to individual cases.
Ten algemene ben ik terughoudend met het reageren op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de fair play competitie voor jonge voetballertjes

An MP asked the ministers of Health and Justice about the KNVB's fair play youth football competition without referees and with parents kept at a distance, and whether it could be rolled out nationally. The minister replied that she supports the KNVB initiative and the Veiliger Sportklimaat action plan, leaving scaling-up to sport itself while sports clubs are linked to partners in a broader chain approach.
I therefore support the KNVB in continuing this process.
Ik steun de KNVB dan ook in het doorzetten van dit traject.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Van Laar en Rebel over het bericht 'Afrikaanse voetballers verhandeld in Azië'

PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about a BBC report on African footballers trafficked to Asia, including estimates of victims, Dutch signals, and EU/FIFA enforcement. Minister Schippers answered that the report alone gives no basis for judgment, that FIFA is already acting, that FIFA transfer rules and KNVB policy are in place, and that no Dutch intervention is warranted.
Additional research into the numbers is therefore, in my judgment, not necessary.
Aanvullend onderzoek naar aantallen is naar mijn oordeel dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over de invoering van een tropenrooster voor het vervoer van slachtdieren

Two MPs asked whether the food safety authority NVWA should introduce a night inspection service and an automatic heat-related schedule for transporting slaughter animals, and whether the 30°C transport temperature limit should be lowered. The state secretary replied that the NVWA applied an extended 'tropenrooster' during the July 2015 heatwave, that it will do so again in future hot periods, and that a practical regulation is being developed with the sector, without committing to a specific automatic trigger or temperature.
The NVWA will introduce a tropical schedule in future periods of exceptionally hot weather.
De NVWA zal bij toekomstige periodes van bijzonder warm weer een tropenrooster in werking laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het niet ingrijpen van de politie bij het zwanendriften

An MP asked the state secretary and minister why police do not intervene in swan-driving (zwanendriften), including whether the ministry's exemption was withdrawn and whether police should enforce and prosecute. The government answered that swan-driving is currently legal, the ring-obligation exemptions were withdrawn on 7 May 2015, a criminal investigation led to prosecution and pending court cases, and it sees no reason to deploy other police units or indications of corruption.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders, Jacobi en Van Dekken over mogelijke schade door zoutwinning aan de flora en fauna van werelderfgoed de Waddenzee

Three PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how she responds to a study by environmental groups showing the Wadden Sea seabed could subside from salt extraction, harming birds' feeding and the World Heritage site, and why it conflicts with the industry consultant's findings. The State Secretary declined to give a substantive response, citing the ongoing appeal before the Council of State's administrative law division, and promised to inform the House after that ruling.
In light of this, I do not wish to give a substantive response to the mentioned research report at this time.
In dit licht wil ik nu geen inhoudelijke reactie geven op het genoemde onderzoeksrapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over verzwegen signalen van corruptie rondom het Holland-Belgium Bid

An MP asked the ministers whether bid organisers should have withdrawn from the Holland-Belgium World Cup bid after corruption signals, how much public money was spent, and who is responsible. The minister answered that the bid cost about 10.5 million euros with about 2.8 million from the state, that the bid was the responsibility of the two football associations and FIFA, and that the US and Swiss investigations must be awaited before any follow-up steps are considered.
Media reports show that US and Swiss authorities are currently investigating, among other things, the bidding procedures for 2018 and 2022.
Uit mediaberichten blijkt dat op dit moment door de Amerikaanse en Zwitserse autoriteiten onderzoek wordt gedaan naar onder meer de bidprocedures van 2018 en 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over het bericht 'Bewijs voor onderbetaling bouwvakkers aan Sontbrug'

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of underpayment of construction workers at Sontbrug and Groningen Forum, and about the role of the Labour Inspectorate and contracting authorities under the new anti-sham-construction law. The minister answered that the Inspectorate runs an average eight-month investigation process on union requests, that contracting authorities are expected to address misconduct through contracts, and that a civil procedure may follow for the Groningen case.
My ministry will do what is necessary to support them in this.
Mijn ministerie zal het nodige doen om hen daarbij te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Van Dekken over het minder uitbetalen voor het gebruik van online muziek aan artiesten

MPs Oosenbrug and Van Dekken asked why Buma/Stemra pays composers and lyricists less for online music streams and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary acknowledged the imbalance, blamed unlicensed competition and costly rights identification, and pointed to the forthcoming CRM implementation bill, a campaign and a planned congress.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Van Dekken over het in vaste dienst nemen van payrollers door DUO

Two MPs asked the ministers whether DUO's decision to end payroll contracts for 19 workers, who will remain employed by Randstad Payroll Solutions, was reasonable and consistent with the Wwz, and how it fits the motion on regional employment. The ministers confirmed the contracts are ended, cited DUO's digitisation and budget cuts, said DUO will help with redeployment, and promised a regional employment overview in the autumn.
Randstad Payroll Solutions will ensure new work for these employees.
Randstad Payroll Solutions zal zorgen voor nieuw werk voor deze medewerkers
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over berichten over mogelijk Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij de FIFA omkopingszaak

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether reports of possible Dutch involvement in the FIFA bribery case, including money allegedly parked in a Dutch shell company and an ex-Nike director, indicate criminal offences in the Netherlands and what the KNVB is investigating about Nike's sponsorship of the national team. The minister confirmed the reports, declined to say whether the Public Prosecution Service is investigating, said the KNVB's inquiry is outside government knowledge, and agreed that the KNVB should inform the prosecutor if there are signs of criminal offences.
The Public Prosecution Service (OM) cannot make statements about whether or not it is investigating a matter.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) kan geen mededelingen doen over waar het wel of geen onderzoek naar doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Bruins Slot over het bericht “Matchfixing in amateurvoetbal aan orde van de dag”

MPs Van Dekken and Bruins Slot asked the government about match-fixing in amateur football, including preventive measures, disciplinary and criminal tools, and reporting to the KNVB. Minister Schippers answered that the KNVB and NOC*NSF run education and reporting channels, a national platform coordinates enforcement, and the OM takes signals seriously but intervenes only when there are sufficient grounds.
Match-fixing can only be combated through close cooperation between the sports, gambling and investigation and prosecution sectors.
Matchfixing kan alleen worden bestreden door nauwe samenwerking tussen de sectoren sport, kansspel en opsporing en vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over het toegenomen antibioticagebruik bij kippen en de antibioticadoelstelling

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked about the rise in antibiotic use in broiler chickens, its threat to the 70% reduction target for end-2015, and what measures will be taken against poultry farms with high use. The Staatssecretaris acknowledges the rise, attributes it possibly to later treatment at higher weight, announces sector measures and says the 70% target remains but will be hard to reach.
Antibiotic use in the four major livestock sectors (including broiler chickens) fell by 4% in 2014 compared with 2013.
