Het antibioticumgebruik in de vier grote veehouderijsectoren (inclusief vleeskuikens) is in 2014 gedaald met 4% ten opzichte van 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘CdK haalt ongemeen fel uit naar de NAM’

PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the Groningen Commissioner of the King criticised NAM's slow handling of complex earthquake damage claims, including a case in Nieuwolda where work stopped despite safety concerns. The Minister declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to the damage protocol, the transfer of new claims to the Centrum Veilig Wonen, and agreements with NAM to finish complex cases by year-end.
As Minister, it is not appropriate for me to respond to individual cases.
Als Minister past het mij niet om op individuele gevallen te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Van Dekken over het gebruik van een nekbreekapparaat om ganzen te doden

MPs Leenders and Van Dekken asked whether a neck-breaking device used in Gelderland to kill geese is permitted under Dutch and EU rules, whether it was properly tested, and whether its use should be banned. The state secretary answered that the device is not on the approved list but provinces may deviate if no unnecessary suffering is caused, that testing is the province's responsibility, that the matter is under court appeal so no judgement will be given, and that the unit has voluntarily paused its use.
How this device was assessed and/or tested is the responsibility of the province.
Op welke wijze dit apparaat is beoordeeld en/of getest, is de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over de rechtszaak van de Nederlandse Varkenshouders Vakbond (NVV) tegen de provincie Noord-Brabant

Two MPs asked the state secretary about the NVV pig farmers' union lawsuit against the province of Noord-Brabant over its livestock sustainability score, and about related policy such as the Brabant law and the stopper scheme. The state secretary said the NVV must make its own choices, that a sustainable pig sector transition is needed, and that the Crisis- en herstelwet experiment for Brabant gives the province a firmer legal basis; several answers point to ongoing talks and a future bill.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Dekken over de voortdurende schending van arbeidsrechten bij de voorbereidingen voor het WK voetbal in Qatar

MPs Servaes and Van Dekken asked the government about continued labour rights abuses of migrant workers in Qatar linked to World Cup preparations, including Amnesty's findings, journalist detentions, union rights, Dutch company monitoring and FIFA corruption. The Minister answered that the government shares concerns, sees early steps by Qatar, pressed for ratification of ILO conventions 87 and 98, and engages bilaterally, through the EU, with business and the NCP, while declining to pre-judge ongoing FIFA investigations.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to anticipate the various investigations currently being conducted by the Swiss and American authorities.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun vooruit te lopen op de verschillende onderzoeken door de Zwitserse en Amerikaanse autoriteiten die momenteel lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Wolbert en Leenders over de gezondheidsrisico’s van de intensieve veehouderij

MPs asked the ministers why GPs in Reusel-De Mierden warn of rising resistant-bacteria infections in livestock farmers when RIVM data do not show it, whether data submission should be made mandatory, and whether the GGD study will be shared. The minister replied that RIVM data reflect local trends adequately, that laboratory participation is good and all relevant institutions will be connected by end 2015, that a letter on antibiotic resistance will follow before summer, and that the GGD will not publish a report.
The GGD Brabant-Zuidoost has indicated that it will not publish a report.
De GGD Brabant-Zuidoost heeft aangegeven dat zij geen rapport zullen uitbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de gezondheidsklachten bij mensen die in de buurt van stallen en boerderijen wonen

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked whether the 2015 NIVEL/IRAS findings on health complaints near livestock farms, and the lack of firm conclusions in the 2012 Health Council report, meant the government would set distance criteria or other health norms. The state secretary answered that evidence is still insufficient, pointed to the ongoing RIVM VGO study due in 2016 and the Wgv odour framework, and said action would be considered after that study.
After this study is completed in 2016, it will be examined whether additional measures regarding public health aspects are needed.
Na afronding van dit onderzoek in 2016, zal worden bezien of aanvullende maatregelen in relatie tot volksgezondheidsaspecten aan de orde zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Wolbert en Leenders over het bericht dat de ingrijpende gevolgen van Q-koorts onderschat worden

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the health consequences of Q-fever, including chronic patients who may be overlooked, are being underestimated, and whether doctors' training, compensation and a general fund for future zoonosis outbreaks will be pursued. The Minister of Health answered that Q-fever remains serious, that Q-support and professional training will address recognition, rejected direct state compensation while promising to review arguments from patient groups, and saw no need for a general zoonosis fund.
I will of course carefully examine whether there are indeed more or different insights that could change the position.
Ik zal uiteraard zorgvuldig bezien of er inderdaad meer of andere inzichten zijn die het standpunt kunnen wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Van Dekken over zieke rashonden en het Fairfok-keurmerk

MPs Van Gerven and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs why the Fairfok plan of the Dutch kennel club would succeed where earlier agreements failed, and about guarantees, inbreeding, DNA testing, breed standards and enforcement of the animal welfare breeding ban. The State Secretary answered that the plan is ambitious and broadly supported, that targets are reducing sick dogs to 25% by 2019 and 10% by 2024, that no guarantee of health can be given, and that enforcement of article 3.4 has started.

How far guarantees about the absence of hereditary conditions can be given when buying a Fairfok puppy will have to become clear in the elaboration of the Fairfok project plan by the Raad van Beheer and the other organisations involved.

In hoeverre garanties over afwezigheid van erfelijke aandoeningen bij aankoop van een Fairfok-pup kunnen worden gegeven, zal in de uitwerking van het projectplan «Fairfok» door Raad van Beheer en de andere betrokken organisaties moeten gaan blijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de waardedaling van woningen door aardbevingen

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a VU study finding house values drop 1.2 to 1.9 percent per earthquake above 2.2 on the Richter scale, and about the adequacy of the compensation scheme and its trust and complexity. The minister disputes the VU finding based on Ortec Finance studies, describes the compensation scheme and planned market measures, and promises to pass the findings to the National Coordinator Groningen.
I will bring the outcomes of this study and of the study commissioned by the Dialogue Table to the attention of the National Coordinator Groningen.
Ik zal de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek en het onderzoek dat gedaan wordt in opdracht van de Dialoogtafel onder de aandacht brengen van de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het herstel van aardbevingsschade in Groningen

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM and CVW control contractor choice for earthquake damage repair in Groningen, and how the government responds to criticism of CVW's expert assessments and WOZ valuations. The minister answered that residents can choose among three options including their own contractor, that the procedure protects choice and counter-expertise, and that WOZ valuation is a municipal responsibility.
The Supervisory Committee of CVW oversees the proper execution of CVW's work.
De Commissie van Toezicht van CVW ziet toe op een gedegen uitvoering van de werkzaamheden door CVW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de impact van aardbevingsschade in Groningen

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about earthquake damage in Groningen, including whether induced quakes are comparable in impact to Southern European quakes and the safety of primary schools such as CBS De Regenboog in Bedum. The minister replied that induced quakes have a different impact than natural ones, that shake-maps will be published after the new seismic network is operational in summer 2015, and that school buildings are being inspected and reinforced by NAM, with a final report on the Bedum school expected in a few weeks.
Yes. With the new seismological network in Groningen, currently being built, it will become possible to make ground acceleration visible directly after an earthquake in the form of shake-maps.

Ja. Met het nieuwe seismologische netwerk in Groningen, dat op dit moment wordt opgebouwd, wordt het mogelijk om ook de grondversnelling direct na de beving inzichtelijk te maken in de vorm van «shake-maps».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de aardbevingsbestendigheid van het Chemiepark in Delfzijl

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the minister about a 2015 letter from Delfzijl's mayor on earthquake resistance of the Delfzijl chemical park, whether a study was promised in 2013, and whether research has been done and the municipality will be informed. The minister confirms the letter and a working group with a methodology by Deltares and TNO, but says the research is run by individual companies, funded by NAM, takes up to two years, and results will only be shared through the regular permitting process with the municipalities.
I will ask the National Coordinator Groningen to discuss with the parties involved whether, and if so how, the research process can be accelerated.
Ik zal de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen vragen om met de betrokken partijen te bespreken of, en zo ja, hoe het onderzoeksproces versneld kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over een uitbreiding van een nertsenfokkerij in Haps gemeente Cuijk

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about an expansion permit for a mink farm in Haps, and whether new or expanded mink farms can be stopped while the Fur Animal Farming Ban is suspended by court ruling. The government answered that the permit concerns an existing situation without more animals, that the ban cannot currently be enforced pending appeal, and that the Rijk does not track permit applications kept at provincial and municipal level.
I am not aware of how many other permit applications have been submitted for expansion and new mink farms since the court ruling that suspended the law.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel andere vergunningsaanvragen er zijn gedaan voor uitbreiding en nieuwe nertsenfokkerijen sinds de uitspraak van de rechter waarmee de wet buiten werking is gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Groot over Roemeense voetbalfraude

Two MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reports that Dutch letterbox firms facilitated Romanian football transfer fraud, and whether Dutch tax rules and treaties can prevent such structures. The minister said transfer fraud should be tackled, pointed to existing matchfixing platforms and a Niet-Melders project, said tax authorities already share information on football, and argued a source-tax on payments abroad would be disproportionately harmful.
I agree that (transfer) fraud in sport should be tackled.
Ik deel de mening dat (transfer)fraude in de sport aangepakt dient te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over de verkoop van voetbalkaartjes via Marktplaats

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked about the resale of football tickets on Marktplaats, including security risks, price inflation, fraud and the powers of clubs and the KNVB to stop it. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the KNVB can cancel invalid tickets and impose stadium bans, and concludes that further government intervention does not appear necessary for now.
No, this does not appear to be necessary for now.
Nee, dit lijkt vooralsnog niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Nijboer, Van Dekken en Albert de Vries over vestigingsplaatsen voor een kerncentrale

Three PvdA MPs asked whether earthquake risk in Groningen makes the Eemshaven unsuitable as a nuclear plant site and whether it should be dropped from the SEV III energy structure plan. The minister answered that the risk is premature grounds to exclude the site, that Eemshaven remains a safeguarded location, and that it will be reviewed in the second SEV III evaluation in 2016.
This will be considered at the second evaluation of SEV III, in 2016.
Dit zal worden bezien bij de tweede evaluatie van het SEV III, in 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over het rapport met adviezen voor de aanpak van vogelgriep van de Dierenbescherming

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how she views the Dierenbescherming report proposing more animal-friendly bird flu control, and whether she will adopt its recommendations. The State Secretary says progress has been made but many proposals are not feasible in the proposed timeframe, while pointing to ongoing work on vaccines, poultry hygiene scans, transport bans at hatcheries and a review of free-range farms near water.
In summary, the Dierenbescherming proposals are sympathetic but not all feasible, certainly not within the proposed timeline.
Samengevat zijn de voorstellen van de Dierenbescherming sympathiek, maar niet allemaal uitvoerbaar, zeker niet binnen de voorgestelde tijdslijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over de “maffiahandel in puppy’s”

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of mafia-style trafficking of puppies from Eastern Europe, including health risks, protection of veterinarians, possible vet complicity, and steps to stop it. The government answered by referring largely to a separate letter on puppy trade, noting rabies vaccination exemption for puppies was ended, that vets involved can face criminal or disciplinary prosecution, and that threatened vets can report to police.
Where enforcement and supervision reveal that Dutch veterinarians are involved in illegal dog trade, they can be prosecuted under criminal or disciplinary law.
Daar waar bij handhaving en toezicht blijkt dat Nederlandse dierenartsen betrokken zijn bij illegale hondenhandel kunnen zij strafrechtelijk, dan wel tuchtrechtelijk worden vervolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de uitbraak van vogelgriep in Barneveld

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the government about a bird flu outbreak in Barneveld, including preventive culling, animal welfare in culling, the broeder transport ban, and the Wet dieraantallen en volksgezondheid and Brabantwet. The state secretary answered that no preventive culling occurred, that vaccination is not yet a feasible alternative, that the sector must prepare for transport bans, and that the outbreak does not warrant the Brabant law's use in Gelderland.
No animals have been preventively culled on farms surrounding the infected company.
Er zijn geen dieren preventief geruimd op bedrijven rondom het besmette bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Mohandis over de hernieuwde plannen voor experimenten op honden door de Universiteit Maastricht

MPs Van Dekken and Mohandis asked whether Maastricht University's renewed plans for dog experiments on pacemaker research, suspended last year, were reasonable, including the ethics committee's approval and alternatives. The government replied that the research is not yet resumed, an external commission is reviewing the internal approval procedure first, the DEC's approval meets the legal requirements, and no further inquiry is planned.
Maastricht University has indicated that the internal procedures that led to approval of this animal experiment will be evaluated by an external committee.
De Universiteit Maastricht heeft aangegeven dat de interne procedures die hebben geleid tot de goedkeuring van deze dierproef geëvalueerd zullen worden door een externe commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Dekken over het dopingrapport van de UCI (Internationale Wielrenunie)

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the UCI cycling doping report, including the role of government investigative powers, the reporting of doctors to the IGZ, and European coordination. The Minister confirmed the report's findings, explained that criminal investigative powers apply to doping-related offences but not to doping use itself, noted that tuchtrechter referral does not require IGZ reporting, and pointed to existing European anti-doping cooperation.
For taking a case to the disciplinary court, reporting to the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) is not necessary.
Voor een gang naar de tuchtrechter is melding bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Van Dekken over de “toename van antibiotica in water”

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about rising antibiotics in surface water, including whether swimmers could develop resistance and whether drinking water is at risk, and what steps would reduce emissions. The government answered that no research shows low antibiotic concentrations cause resistance in swimmers, that drinking water treatment is effective and meets norms, that residues come from both livestock and human use, and that an integrated approach letter will follow before summer.
No research data are known on the presence of antibiotics specifically in Dutch recreational waters.
Over de aanwezigheid van antibiotica specifiek in Nederlandse recreatiewateren zijn geen onderzoeksgegevens bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Wolbert en Leenders over de gezondheidsrisico’s van de intensieve veehouderij

MPs from the PvdA asked the ministers whether they share concern from Reusel-De Mierden GPs about rising multiresistant infections and requested an overview of infection trends in Noord-Brabant. The minister replied that Brabant infection rates are not higher than elsewhere in the Netherlands, no regional data for Reusel-De Mierden is available, and an integrated antibiotic resistance approach letter will follow before summer.
Separate data for Reusel-De Mierden are currently not available to us.
Aparte gegevens voor Reusel-De Mierden zijn bij ons op dit moment niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over het bericht "Uitzendbureau werkt onderzoek Arbeidsinspectie tegen"

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that a temp agency obstructed an Inspectorate investigation into underpayment at construction projects in Groningen, and about contractor responsibility. The minister answered that clients must ensure lawful supply chains, that the pending Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies adds chain liability, that the agency's SNA certificate was withdrawn, and that the evaluation of self-regulation is expected before summer.
I do not make statements about a specific case.
Over een specifieke casus doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dekken over voetbalgeweld door zichzelf Feyenoord-supporters noemende Nederlanders in Rome

MPs Marcouch and Van Dekken asked about Dutch Feyenoord supporters rioting in Rome, Dutch mayors' powers to impose restrictions for conduct abroad, EU options to deport or ban convicted hooligans, Italian fine enforcement, and Engeland's travel bans. The government answered that mayors may consider foreign conduct under art. 172a Gemeentewet, that EU deportation is limited to genuine threats to public order, that Italy may seek Dutch help on fines after judgments become final, and that it will raise an international stadium ban in EU and Council of Europe fora.
I will ask the European Union and the Council of Europe to pay attention to establishing an international stadium ban and to explore other options to prevent hooligans from causing problems abroad.

Ik vraag binnen de Europese Unie en de Raad van Europa aandacht voor het tot stand brengen van een internationaal stadionverbod en voor het onderzoeken van andere mogelijkheden om te voorkomen dat hooligans in het buitenland voor problemen zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Jacobi en Van Dekken over de gaswinningsplannen op en rond Terschelling

MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Tulip Oil's gas extraction plans near Terschelling, including CO2 content, risks to the island's freshwater supply, use of harmful substances, and how national interest is weighed against nature and water protection. The Minister answered that the CO2 share (about 14%) and the feasibility of reinjection await TNO and Energiebeheer Nederland advice, that risks to freshwater and substances will be assessed in the EIA after permit approval, and that further decisions under the national coordination regime will follow.
I first await these advices before I can address concrete quantities of gas (or CO2).
Ik wacht eerst deze adviezen af, alvorens ik kan ingaan op concrete hoeveelheden gas (of CO 2 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Mei Li Vos over het artikel ‘Tegenslag in strijd tegen matchfixing’

MPs Van Dekken and Mei Li Vos asked about matchfixing risks in the planned legal online sports betting, including how the Kansspelautoriteit (KSA) and justice authorities would detect manipulated matches and obtain information. The State Secretary answered that operators must adopt integrity policies, report high-risk matches, join the national matchfixing platform, and provide information on request or voluntarily, with the KSA able to use existing investigative and licence-withdrawal powers.

Under the proposed Article 34k of the Wok, licence holders are additionally obliged to provide, on their own initiative, information relevant to supervising compliance with the relevant laws, regulations and licence conditions.

Op grond van het voorgestelde artikel 34k Wok worden vergunninghouders daarnaast verplicht eigener beweging informatie te verschaffen die relevant is voor het toezicht op de naleving van de relevante wet- en regelgeving en vergunningvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de langetermijneffecten van Q-koorts

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked about long-term effects of Q fever, including whether the government will settle claims with patients outside court and reach an amicable settlement. The minister acknowledged the health burden, pointed to support via Stichting Q-support and research funding, but stated the state accepts no liability and sees no reason for an amicable settlement.
According to the State, however, there is no question of unlawful conduct as a result of which Q-fever patients have suffered damage.
Volgens de Staat is evenwel geen sprake van onrechtmatig handelen als gevolg waarvan Q-koortspatiënten schade hebben geleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de berichten ‘Amateurclub OFC naar de top dankzij dubieuze geldschieter’ en ‘De bad boys van Young Boys’

An MP asked whether amateur football clubs are protected against criminal influence, match-fixing and money laundering, and whether investigations into OFC's sponsor and into other clubs would be opened. The minister answered that preventive measures and new legislation on doping and gambling are in preparation, that clubs can make their own rules, and that no comment can be made on ongoing criminal investigations.
No statements can be made about the preliminary investigation or about concrete ongoing criminal investigations that are in the investigation phase.
Er kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over het voorbereidend onderzoek dan wel over concrete (lopende) strafrechtelijke onderzoeken die zich in de opsporingsfase bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht “Oefenwedstrijden Nederlandse teams in Spanje mogelijk gefixt”

An MP asked whether Dutch sports teams' friendly matches abroad may have been fixed and about the status of the justice investigation into match-fixing. The Minister replied that the OM continuously reviews signals, cannot disclose ongoing investigations, that five suspects were recently arrested, and that measures against match-fixing are being implemented with the sports sector.
No statements can be made about the preliminary investigation or about concrete ongoing criminal investigations that are in the investigation phase.
Er kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over het voorbereidend onderzoek dan wel over concrete (lopende) strafrechtelijke onderzoeken die zich in de opsporingsfase bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Dekken over de mogelijkheden voor sportverenigingen om te investeren in zonnepanelen

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether sports clubs can contribute to decentralised renewable energy, whether they must pay VAT on solar power that other small consumers do not, and what fiscal incentives could make solar panels or energy saving attractive for them. The minister confirmed the VAT position under EU case law, noted that clubs can deduct input VAT only for taxable supplies, listed existing energy tax schemes, and announced a subsidy scheme for sports clubs effective 1 January 2016.
To implement this motion, I am currently drafting a subsidy scheme together with the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport, which will take effect on 1 January 2016.
Ter uitvoering van deze motie stel ik momenteel samen met de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport een subsidieregeling op die per 1 januari 2016 effectief zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de hulpverlening aan Q-koortspatiënten

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked the minister about support for Q-fever patients, including Q-support's reach, overheads, consultation with patient organisation Q-uestion, future outbreak support, and goat vaccination across the Belgian and German borders. The minister answered that Q-support is reaching more patients, overheads were about 11% in its start-up year, Q-uestion is consulted through structural channels, and that member states set their own Q-fever policy with no EU-wide rules, while the ministry lacks data on foreign farms.
My colleague at Economic Affairs does not have data on companies in Belgium or Germany, only on goat farms in the Netherlands.
Mijn collega van Economische Zaken beschikt niet over gegevens van bedrijven in België of Duitsland, uitsluitend over gegevens van geitenbedrijven in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Dit kan echt niet’

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Groninger residents' case where a family with two children allegedly had been waiting two years in a replacement home, and whether NAM could reopen a valuation despite earlier commitments, and whether such cases belong before the Commission for Exceptional Cases. The minister said the family was not in a replacement home for two years but in its own home, that a temporary home became available in December, that NAM has offered options, and that individual cases are not shared for privacy reasons, while referring to the handover of claims to the CVW and the role of the ombudsman-type raadsman.
Furthermore, as Minister of Economic Affairs I want to be restrained in sharing information about individual cases, for privacy reasons.
Verder wil ik als Minister van Economische Zaken terughoudend zijn met het delen van informatie over individuele gevallen, omwille van de privacy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Kerstens en Servaes over het bericht ‘FIFA: Welzijn arbeiders Qatar niet onze zaak’

PvdA MPs asked whether the government would press the KNVB, the ITUC and FIFA's president to take responsibility for migrant worker conditions building World Cup 2022 stadiums in Qatar. The minister said the government is concerned, raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU, wants FIFA to publish its bid report, and considers the KNVB proactive and the ITUC capable of acting itself, but said it cannot compel FIFA's president to explain publicly.
I note a proactive attitude from the KNVB regarding the position of migrant workers and will remain in discussion with them about it.
Ik constateer een pro-actieve houding van de KNVB over de positie van arbeidsmigranten en blijf hierover met hen in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jan Vos over de Maatlat Duurzame Veehouderij

MPs Van Dekken and Jan Vos asked whether the Maatlat Duurzame Veehouderij (sustainability scale for livestock farming) wrongly excludes energy-saving cooling systems like ECO200 that avoid high-GWP HFCs, and whether manufacturers are preparing for the 2020 HFC ban. The government answered that the scale does not exclude such systems but rates them by function, that ECO200 components were included in the energy theme, and that the new EU F-gas regulation provides sufficient incentive for innovation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht 'Matchfixing stopt niet bij de grens'

An MP from the PvdA asked the ministers of Health and of Justice about matchfixing, betting-related manipulation and the WADA claim that sport is in criminal hands, as well as the status of a national matchfixing platform and convenant. The minister answered that measures are being implemented, that the WADA conclusion is a personal opinion, that the OM cannot say whether it investigates, and that the convenant is still being drafted due to privacy complexities.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de berichtgeving ‘Kabinet: ‘FIFA, geef openheid over de toekenning WK’s

MP Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport what steps would be taken to secure openness from FIFA on the 2018 and 2022 World Cup awards, and whether Netherlands would lead EU work on sports integrity and launch international talks on transparency. The minister replied that the KNVB and the Belgian federation requested the FIFA report, that FIFA says it will publish it without a date, that Netherlands helped put sports integrity and good governance on the EU work plan, and that a ministerial round table on the topic is planned for January 2015.
I want to take up this advice during the Dutch EU presidency in the first half of 2016 and make it a priority theme in the sports field.
Ik wil dit advies oppakken tijdens het Nederlands EU-voorzitterschap in de eerste helft van 2016 en tot prioritair thema maken op sportterrein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Mei Li Vos over het artikel ‘Tegenslag in strijd tegen matchfixing’

MPs Van Dekken and Mei Li Vos asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that UEFA and online betting firms (ESSA) no longer share information on match-fixing and that betting firms may not pass on suspicious patterns. The Minister said he was unaware of the sharing breakdown, declined to judge UEFA's claims, and said the forthcoming remote gambling bill would require betting operators to share information on suspicious patterns, with the Gaming Authority supervising compliance.
In the lower regulations for remote gambling, licence conditions will also be included on sharing information necessary to strengthen the fight against match-fixing.

In de lagere regelgeving voor kansspelen op afstand zullen daarnaast vergunningsvoorwaarden worden opgenomen over het delen van informatie die noodzakelijk is voor versterking van de strijd tegen matchfixing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Van Dekken over doorverkoop van toegangsbewijzen voor concerten

MPs Monasch and Van Dekken asked the ministers about resellers selling concert tickets before official sales start, unusable tickets, and whether this amounts to internet fraud. The government answered that such resale is not per se unlawful but must be clearly disclosed, that consumers and the ACM have remedies, and that a bill criminalising professional internet non-performance is expected in 2015.
We have no insight into the nature and extent of the risk buyers face when purchasing resold entrance tickets.
Wij hebben geen inzicht in de aard en omvang van het risico dat kopers lopen bij de aankoop van doorverkochte toegangskaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kerstens over het onderzoek van Imtech naar fraude bij de bouw van de energiecentrale van Essent in de Eemshaven

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Labour Inspectorate has investigated labour abuses in building the Essent power plant at Eemshaven, whether it has contact with Imtech about the company's fraud probe, and whether it will investigate further. The minister answered that the Inspectorate has no targeted inspections of Essent, has no contact with Imtech, which is a competition matter referred to the ACM, and has no independent role in cao compliance beyond requests from cao parties.
However, no inspections have taken place that were specifically aimed at Essent, because Essent itself was not a responsible party in the chain of clients for the construction.
Er hebben echter geen inspecties plaatsgevonden die specifiek waren gericht op Essent, omdat Essent zelf geen verantwoordelijke partij was in de keten van opdrachtgevers van de bouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de uitbraak van de hoog pathogene variant van vogelgriep in Hekendorp

Two PvdA MPs asked about measures to prevent human infection and spread of highly pathogenic bird flu from the Hekendorp outbreak, signs of human infection, causes, a possible link to Germany, and measures against future zoonotic outbreaks. The government answered by referring to earlier letters on measures and the investigation, stating there are no signs of human infection, and referring to earlier answers on pandemic risk.
For the answer to this question I refer to the answers to questions about the report 'Pandemic from Brabant is possible'.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik naar de antwoorden op vragen over het bericht «Pandemie uit Brabant is mogelijk».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Kerstens en Van Dekken over de misstanden bij de aanleg van de bouw- en infraprojecten voor het WK 2022 in Qatar

MPs Servaes, Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the Foreign Minister about serious labour abuses, including deaths, in preparations for the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, and what the government has done about them. The minister answered that the government remains concerned, raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU, plans a human rights ambassador visit to Qatar in 2015 with a report to parliament, supports the ILO investigation, and has contact with the KNVB without detailing outcomes.
In 2015 a visit by the Human Rights Ambassador to Qatar is envisaged, where labour rights will also be discussed. A report of this visit will be provided to the House of Representatives.
In 2015 wordt een bezoek van de Mensenrechtenambassadeur aan Qatar beoogd waar het onderwerp arbeidsrechten ook besproken zal worden. Van dit bezoek zal verslag worden gedaan aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over het bericht dat op bouwplaatsen van de NAM en Shell mogelijk sprake is van het ontduiken van de cao in de steigerbouwsector

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that collective agreement (cao) evasion may occur in scaffolding construction at NAM and Shell sites, including cao-shopping by temp agencies. The minister said cao compliance is primarily the responsibility of social partners, that SNCU investigations found roughly EUR 1 million in underpayment with recovery payments and a director-liability procedure, that the Inspectorate has received no formal request under article 10, and that a bill on sham constructions with chain liability is forthcoming.
The Labour Inspectorate supports the cao parties in the civil-law enforcement of the cao through compliance investigations.
De Inspectie SZW ondersteunt de cao-partijen bij de civielrechtelijke handhaving van de cao met nalevingsonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kerstens over het bericht van onderbetaling van uitzendkrachten bij bouwprojecten die door de gemeente Groningen zijn aanbesteed

MPs Van Dekken and Kerstens asked the minister whether the Inspectie SZW would investigate reported underpayment of temp workers on Groningen municipal construction projects and whether the municipality should be held accountable as client. The minister replied that cao compliance is primarily for cao parties and the Inspectie can only investigate minimum wage evasion, and promised the forthcoming Wet aanpak schijnconstructies would address underpayment in the chain.
Supervision of compliance with collective labour agreements is primarily a matter for the cao parties.
Toezicht op de naleving van cao’s is in eerste plaats een zaak van cao-partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het sluiten van de metaalafdeling van Synergon

MPs Kerstens, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the State Secretary about the closure of Synergon's metal department, the failed takeover talks, the long uncertainty for staff and possible support for an external investigation. The State Secretary said responsibility for the Wsw lies with the municipalities, so she cannot comment on the company's operations, but pointed to a sector-wide Cedris programme, a provincial independent inquiry and regional funding.
Responsibility for implementing the Wsw is assigned to the municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van de Wsw is belegd bij de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Van Dekken over het ongeval op de spoorwegovergang in Winsum van 14 oktober jongstleden

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary about a fatal accident at the Voslaan level crossing in Winsum and what measures ProRail would take to prevent future accidents. The government answered that talks with the municipality on closing or securing the crossing are ongoing, that a study of 22 crossings in Winsum is underway with concrete measures being costed, and that an evaluation of the non-actively secured crossings and a follow-up approach will be requested from ProRail.
To this end I will ask ProRail to carry out an evaluation in the coming months of the effectiveness of the approach to non-actively secured level crossings in recent years.
Daartoe zal ik ProRail vragen in de komende maanden een evaluatie te doen op de effectiviteit van de aanpak van de niet-actief beveiligde overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht dat er een aardbeving heeft plaatsgevonden bij Froombosch

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about two earthquakes near Froombosch, the historical frequency and magnitude of quakes there, whether seismicity has risen since the Loppersum well closures, and whether damage claims are being handled quickly. The minister confirmed the reports, listed seven earlier quakes above magnitude 1.5, said recent quakes show no change in seismicity, and reported about 400 related damage claims with most light cases resolved within three months.
Contact has already been made with 75% of residents, and appointments for a visit by the damage expert have been made with half of them.
Er is inmiddels met 75% van de bewoners contact geweest en met de helft zijn afspraken gemaakt voor een bezoek van de schade expert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht dat minimaal 33% en mogelijk zelfs 60% van de inwoners van Herpen besmet is met Q-koorts

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked whether the Q-fever investigation in Herpen is too slow, whether screening should be expanded, and about a dissertation on antibody testing. The Minister replies that the research runs within subsidy deadlines, first results show no large group of missed patients, and a single antibody check one year after acute infection is recommended for patients without risk factors.
At the next revision of the LCI Q-fever guideline, this recommendation will be included.
Bij de volgende revisie van de LCI-richtlijn Q-koorts zal deze aanbeveling opgenomen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Ypma over het bericht ‘Kinderen de dupe van slecht georganiseerd zwemonderwijs’

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about reports that children are poorly served by a proliferation of swimming diplomas and that many are insufficiently swim-proficient. The minister disputed the 66% figure, said most children obtain at least one diploma, placed responsibility on parents, and declined to introduce a legally certified swimming diploma.
I have no reason to do so.
Ik heb daar geen reden toe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Nijboer en Hamer over de berichten 'Aardschokken ook een kans' en 'Laat het werk niet weglopen'

MPs Van Dekken, Nijboer and Hamer asked about reports that small Groningen builders are losing repair work to large firms, the labour needed for earthquake-damage repair, and the new facilities company 'Groningen versterkt'. Minister Kamp answered that homeowners freely choose contractors, expects a positive economic impulse, notes labour estimates vary pending the executing organisation, and cannot yet assess the initiative because the framework is not yet set.
However, I cannot currently confirm that these numbers of construction workers are needed.
Ik kan echter op dit moment niet bevestigen dat deze aantallen bouwvakkers nodig zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Kerstens en Van Dekken over het bericht dat Nederlandse bedrijven indirect betrokken zijn bij schendingen van de arbeidsrechten bij de bouw van faciliteiten voor het WK 2022 in Qa

MPs asked whether Dutch banks, pension funds and companies invest in firms accused of labour rights abuses in building Qatar's 2022 World Cup facilities, and what the government will do about it. The government said it lacks such investment data, will raise labour rights in the ILO and OECD frameworks and with Qatar, and reported on sports-human rights steps.
The government does not have this kind of information and therefore cannot make statements about it.
De regering beschikt niet over dit soort informatie en kan derhalve geen uitspraken hierover doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Vos Mei Li over het bericht 'Sporter is straks meer kwijt als gemeente niet oplet'

MPs Van Dekken and Mei Li Vos asked whether the Market and Government Act forces municipalities to pass on full costs of sports facilities to clubs, and whether municipalities can instead designate facilities as services of general economic interest (DAEB) to avoid this. The minister answered that the Act aims to prevent unfair competition, that a DAEB designation is possible but subject to supervisory review, and declined to send municipalities a model DAEB decision, relying instead on information sessions organised with the VSG and VNG.
A municipality can, if in its judgement the general interest opposes passing on the full integral cost, refrain from doing so by qualifying the activity as an activity carried out under a DAEB.

Een gemeente kan, indien het algemeen belang zich naar haar oordeel verzet tegen doorberekening van de integrale kostprijs, hiervan afzien door de activiteit te kwalificeren als een activiteit ter uitvoering van een DAEB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht dat minimaal 33% en mogelijk zelfs 60% van de inwoners van Herpen besmet is met Q-koorts

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked the ministers about reports that 33% to 60% of Herpen residents had Q-fever, the validity of a new test, chronic Q-fever diagnoses, expanding screening, underreporting and livestock farming limits. The minister answered that the GGD study results are due spring 2015 and that screening expansion will await them, while Q-support has started and an evaluation is planned for around September 2014.
I am awaiting the final result of this study and the related conclusions and recommendations before I seek advice on the necessity and usefulness of a more extensive study.
Ik wacht het uiteindelijke resultaat van dit onderzoek en de daarbij behorende conclusies en aanbevelingen af, voordat ik mij laat adviseren over nut en noodzaak van een uitgebreider onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Nijboer en Jan Vos over het bericht ‘Onduidelijkheid over ingestorte boerderij Bedum’

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the collapse of a barn in Bedum, the evacuation of residents, why NAM and the municipality would not explain the cause, and how information on earthquake damage in the area is provided. The minister answered that the municipality commissioned an independent investigation into the cause, that residents were advised to leave on fire brigade advice, that several earlier evacuations were due to combined factors, and that information is shared via official consultations, the Dialoogtafel and NAM communications.
Because there was no clarity about the causes of the collapse at that time, the letter and press release did not go into possible causes, also to prevent speculation.
Omdat er toen geen duidelijkheid was over de oorzaken van de instorting is – ook om speculatie te voorkomen – in de brief en het persbericht niet nader ingegaan op mogelijke oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Hamer en Nijboer over de berichten ‘Mobiliteitscentrum schiet tekort’ en ‘Er zijn juist heel heldere afspraken gemaakt’

MPs Van Dekken, Hamer and Nijboer asked about former Aldel workers at the Delfzijl mobility centre who complain about limited training options, UWV rules, sanctions, age discrimination and sick workers' access to the training fund. The minister answers that training is tailored, the EUR 2,500 cap was agreed as an average, 70 of 340 candidates have found work, and the government sees no evidence of targeted exclusion.
It was agreed that the amount of EUR 2,500 is used as an average available amount for training per candidate rather than as a maximum amount.
Hierbij is afgesproken dat het bedrag van € 2.500 als een gemiddeld beschikbaar bedrag voor scholing per kandidaat wordt gehanteerd in plaats van als maximum bedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Van Dekken over het bericht dat milieuvergunningen voor veehouderijen al jaren op verkeerde geurberekeningen zijn gebaseerd

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked the state secretary about reports that livestock environmental permits were based on flawed odour calculations using the V-Stacks model, and whether this harms residents and the transition to sustainable farming. The state secretary acknowledged the Noord-Brabant study, said discrepancies appear only in specific situations, promised further testing, a model adjustment within months and guidance to municipalities, but disputed the call for a full evaluation of the odour system.
I expect to have an answer within a few weeks on the exact situations in which deviations in the model affect a permit decision and how often those situations occur.

Ik verwacht binnen enkele weken antwoord op de vraag in welke exacte situaties afwijkingen binnen het model gevolgen heeft voor een besluit tot vergunningverlening en hoe vaak die situaties voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht dat twee derde van de dierenartsen meer antibiotica voorschrijft dan de streefwaarde

An MP asks the State Secretary whether she is concerned that two-thirds of veterinarians prescribe more antibiotics than the benchmark target, whether stronger measures are needed, and whether the NVWA sanctions vets based on SDa data. The government answers that the benchmark is a tool for self-improvement by the profession, that existing private improvement trajectories and NVWA risk-based supervision suffice for now, and promises to report new benchmark figures and consider post-2015 reduction targets.
The SDa does not pass data on to the NVWA.
De SDa geeft geen gegevens door aan de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht het bericht ‘onderzoek naar monsterzege’

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about football match-fixing concerns, including the KNVB's referral of the FC Oss–Emmen match to the Public Prosecution Service and the claim that a German prosecutor's reported suspect matches were 'fiction'. The minister answered that the referral led to no further steps, that the KNVB's integrity unit has not triggered any prosecutor-requested investigations, and that information-sharing about the German matter was not authorised.
The report did not lead to any follow-up steps.
De melding heeft niet tot vervolgstappen geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘gaswinning zorgt opnieuw voor een conflict tussen provincie en het Rijk’

MPs Jacobi, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked whether the national government requires water boards to pay half the cost of strengthening dikes in Groningen because of gas-field economic interests, and how the government will limit gas-extraction harm and fund dike reinforcement. The minister denies any such demand, describes the standard 50/40/10 cost split under the flood protection programme and a separate 100 million euro fund for earthquake-proofing vital infrastructure, and says talks with water boards are ongoing.

There is, however, no requirement from the central government that the water board pay half the costs of dikes that receive a stricter standard because of the economic importance of the gas locations and therefore need to be strengthened.

Er is echter geen sprake van een eis van het Rijk dat het waterschap de helft van de kosten betaalt voor dijken die vanwege het economisch belang van de gaslocaties een strengere norm krijgen en daardoor versterkt zouden moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek, Nijboer en van Dekken Milieu over overlast vanwege laagfrequent geluid

MPs Cegerek, Nijboer and van Dekken asked the State Secretary about residents' complaints of low-frequency noise near the NAM gas storage site at Grijpskerk, Zuidhorn. The government answered that studies found no clear cause for the complaints, so no basis remains for targeting a specific source, and it informed the Zuidhorn mayor accordingly.
In this specific case, research has not identified a clear cause for the complaints.
In dit specifieke geval is uit onderzoek geen duidelijke oorzaak voor de klachten naar voren gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht ‘GPS moet dier tijdens transport beschermen’

An MP asked the State Secretary why GPS monitoring of livestock transports is only applied on a sample basis to long journeys, and whether it should be mandatory and extended to domestic transport. The State Secretary said GPS is mandatory for transports over 8 hours, that IBD checks GPS data for about 15% of long transports, that GPS will become mandatory under manure rules, and that industry is asked to include GPS in a quality system.
Within the enforcement of manure regulation, GPS is going to be made mandatory.
In het kader van de handhaving van de mestregelgeving gaat GPS verplicht worden voorgeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Van Dekken over het bericht ‘aangifte tegen hoofdaannemer centrale RWE/Essent’

MPs Hamer and Van Dekken asked the ministers whether the Public Prosecution Service would act on FNV's report that a main contractor at the Eemshaven RWE/Essent plant systematically underpaid subcontractors, and whether other subcontractors should be heard. The minister said a police report and criminal complaint were filed and are being assessed by the prosecutor, and described enforcement measures, a planned liability-for-wages bill and a pending cao-enforcement advisory request.
This complaint is being assessed by the Public Prosecution Service and its outcome cannot be anticipated.
Deze aangifte wordt beoordeeld door het openbaar ministerie en op de uitkomsten daarvan kan niet vooruit worden gelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht ‘Pandemie uit Brabant is mogelijk’

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked the government about reports that a pandemic originating in Brabant is possible, including calls to reduce animal numbers, close farms, and separate pig and poultry farms by a kilometre. The minister answered that current hygiene and early-warning measures are sufficient, that reducing animals or fully closed farms is not the solution, and that the RIVM distance advice did not lead to a policy change.
We are of the view that the current measures are sufficient to keep the chance of an outbreak as small as possible.
Wij zijn van mening dat de huidige maatregelen voldoende zijn om de kans op een uitbraak zo klein mogelijk te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht “Dove zaalvoetballers geplaatst voor Europese Kampioenschappen maar toch thuis blijven door geldgebrek”

MPs Van Dekken and Van Laar asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport why the deaf futsal team qualified for the European Championship could not attend due to lack of funding, and whether the ministry would support it and act structurally. The minister replied that sport bodies decide which programmes get top-sport funding under the 2013-2016 sport agenda, that deaf futsal falls outside this, and that the ministry is in talks with the KNDSB and NOC*NSF.
I regard this as a responsibility of sport, which makes its own decisions, and which I then support.
Ik beschouw dit als een verantwoordelijkheid van de sport, die zelf besluiten neemt en die ik vervolgens ondersteun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Yücel en Kuzu over het niet toelaten van kinderen tot sportverenigingen van op basis van achternamen

MPs asked whether children were refused membership of a Rotterdam football club based on their surname or origin and whether the government would investigate such refusals. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to commission a study of refusal numbers, and said the KNVB had contacted the club and requested a written statement before any further action.
A study into the number of times children are refused on improper grounds is something I will not commission.
Een onderzoek naar het aantal keren dat kinderen op basis van oneigenlijke gronden worden geweigerd, ga ik niet laten uitvoeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, van Dekken en Kerstens over het bericht “Veel misstanden bouw stadions Brazilië”

MPs Servaes, Van Dekken and Kerstens asked the minister about reports of labour violations, safety breaches and intimidation in building World Cup stadiums in Brazil, and whether the government would act, raise it with Brazil, and implement a motion on human rights in sports event awarding. The minister answered that the conclusions are FNV's responsibility, that Brazil is handling labour issues, that no direct talks are planned, and that the sports minister is pursuing human rights in sports awarding via NOC*NSF and a European letter.
The conclusions FNV draws from this research are FNV's own responsibility.
De conclusies die FNV trekt op basis van dit onderzoek zijn voor rekening van FNV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de berichten “Groot deel voetbalgeweld bij risicoclubs” en “Duizend gevallen van extreem fysiek geweld”

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that most violence on and around football pitches occurs at a small number of clubs, and how such clubs can be supported and whether violence reporting can be improved. The minister said the KNVB supports struggling clubs, that a chain approach with KNVB, NOC*NSF, Halt, municipalities and the Justice ministry is being developed, and that the Justice ministry is working to improve the police reporting process.
Currently I am developing with the KNVB, NOC*NSF, Halt, municipalities and the Ministry of Justice and Security a chain approach to further curb excesses at sports clubs.
Op dit moment ontwikkel ik met KNVB, NOC*NSF, Halt, gemeenten en het Ministerie van Veiligheid & Justitie een ketenaanpak om excessen bij sportverenigingen verder terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Matchfixing nog steeds geen prioriteit in Nederland’

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about reports that matchfixing is not a priority in the Netherlands and about organised crime's role, and whether the government would push for a European approach. The minister replied that matchfixing takes several forms, that the OM is examining signals of fraud in football within a preliminary investigation, and that the Netherlands is actively negotiating a Council of Europe convention against matchfixing, with adoption targeted for autumn 2014.
The Netherlands actively participates in the negotiations in the Council of Europe to reach a convention to combat matchfixing.
Nederland neemt pro-actief deel aan de onderhandelingen in de Raad van Europa, om tot een verdrag te komen ter bestrijding van matchfixing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dekken over het tegengaan van internationale voetbalhooliganisme

Two MPs asked the Justice and Security Minister about a new generation of Ajax hooligans shifting violence to international away matches and how to prevent it, including cross-border cooperation. The Minister said football violence abroad is not new, cited existing stadium bans and possible reporting obligations, and promised to raise a travel-ban-style reporting obligation in European fora, but gave no contact with Ajax or Italian authorities.

As I answered in previous written questions, I will shortly raise attention at European level for the possibilities of including a travel ban in the form of a reporting obligation in national regulations.

Antwoord 5 Zoals ik u heb geantwoord op eerdere schriftelijke vragen 2 zal ik op korte termijn in Europees verband aandacht vragen voor de mogelijkheden om in nationale regelgeving een uitreisverbod in de vorm van een meldplicht op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dekken over het tegengaan van internationale voetbalhooligans

MPs Marcouch and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Security and Justice how to curb foreign football hooligans, including entry and exit bans, EU cooperation, and dissolving supporter associations. The minister answered that proposed local measures are ineffective against one-off foreign visitors, that Dutch courts cannot impose exit or entry bans on non-residents, that such matters are for member states and possibly EU-level discussion, and that associations can only be dissolved if their own activities breach public order.
I will raise this at European level.
Ik zal hiervoor in Europees verband aandacht vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over de vestiging van een nieuwe nertsenhouderij in Gemert

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked about a new mink farm in Gemert that appears to expand or relocate mink farming despite the 2013 ban, and about distance rules and whether such expansion is undesirable. The government answered that the relocation is permitted if animal numbers do not increase, that the permit is under appeal, and that the NVWA will check compliance on site.
The NVWA monitors the standards of the Fur Animal Farming Ban Act and will determine whether specific situations fit within the purpose and scope of that Act.
De NVWA controleert de normen uit de Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij en zal constateren of specifieke situaties binnen doel en strekking van de Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Dikkers en Wolbert over de uitbreiding van een melkveebedrijf in Coevorden naar 1.900 koeien

MPs Van Dekken, Dikkers and Wolbert asked the state secretary about a dairy farm expansion in Coevorden to 1,900 cows, its health and environmental impact, consistency with the cabinet's livestock scale position, whether the province can block it, and whether abolishing milk quotas will drive similar expansions. The state secretary answered that environmental permitting is a matter for province and municipality, that a new Wet Dieren provision will let them set health-based limits on livestock size, and that no data exist on the number of farms with expansion plans.
Provinces and municipalities can, under the Spatial Planning Act, for example set a maximum on stable size and impose restrictions on the establishment or expansion of livestock farms.

Provincies en gemeenten kunnen op basis van de Wet ruimtelijke ordening bijvoorbeeld een maximum stellen aan de stalgrootte en beperkingen opleggen aan de vestiging of uitbreiding van veehouderijbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over berichten over matchfixing in Nederland

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about media reports of match-fixing in Dutch professional football, including whether Dutch authorities took German signals seriously and whether crimes could still be proven. The minister declined to say whether the prosecutor investigated the specific cases, citing investigative and privacy interests, rejected the claim that Dutch authorities were slow, and rejected the claim that Dutch matches were proven fixed.
As I have previously indicated to your House, the public prosecution service (OM) cannot make statements about whether or not it is investigating any particular matter.
Antwoord 2 Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven richting uw Kamer 2 kan het openbaar ministerie (OM) geen mededelingen doen over waar het wel of geen onderzoek naar doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over berichten dat Nederland blind zou zijn voor matchfixing

An MP asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about press reports that the Netherlands is blind to match-fixing, including whether a criminal investigation is underway and whether there were signals of fixing in a World Cup qualifier. The minister declined to say whether the prosecution service is investigating specific reports, while stating the research found match-fixing exists in the Netherlands but no large-scale manipulation, and that the prosecution service's preliminary inquiry is ongoing.
As I have previously indicated to your House, the public prosecution service (OM) cannot make statements about whether or not it is investigating particular matters.
Antwoord 2 Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven richting uw Kamer 2 kan het openbaar ministerie (OM) geen mededelingen doen over waar het wel of geen onderzoek naar doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over ziektes bij dieren door mest in stallen

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about animal illnesses caused by manure and ammonia in stables, citing a Wakker Dier study and asking about antibiotic use, housing standards and measures to reduce harm. The State Secretary disputed the study's one-to-one causal links, said no structured comparison of housing systems exists, pointed to farmers' responsibility and existing rules, and listed measures such as a stricter ammonia standard in 2014 and a UDD antibiotic regulation.
The Wakker Dier study is a collection of quotes from various studies.
Het onderzoek van Wakker Dier betreft een verzameling van quotes uit verschillende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Huizing en Van Dekken over betaling van spelersmakelaars

MPs Huizing and Van Dekken asked whether football players rather than clubs should pay player agents, and whether agent intermediation falls under the WAADI labour-intermediary law. The minister answered that only pure labour-contract brokerage falls under WAADI, that the cost ban applies only to those brokerage costs, and that parties may agree who pays other agent services, so no exemption is planned.
To protect the employee, WAADI prohibits charging the costs of labour intermediation to the employee.
Ter bescherming van de werknemer is in de Waadi een verbod opgenomen om de kosten van arbeidsmiddeling in rekening te brengen bij de werknemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de Q-koorts

Two MPs asked the health minister about low recorded Q-fever infections among children and young people, whether doctors are more alert, and the status of the 10 million euro Q-support foundation. The minister answered that under-diagnosis is normal for mild cases, that the epidemic is over, that the foundation was set up and is starting activities, and that an evaluation will be reported around September 2014.
I have committed to evaluating, one year after the foundation starts, whether there are still people the foundation has not helped in the way we intended.
Ik heb u toegezegd dat een jaar nadat de stichting van start is gegaan geëvalueerd zal worden of er nog mensen zijn die door de stichting niet geholpen zijn op de manier waarop wij ze wilden helpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Huizing en Bruins Slot over kickboksen door kinderen

Three MPs asked the health minister about children's kickboxing with head strikes allowed, the need for binding rules across fragmented kickboxing federations, and the quality of instructors. The minister agreed head contact is undesirable, said NOC*NSF will lead a plan for sector-wide rules expected by summer 2014, and said she would advise parents against such training while not yet ruling out a legal fallback.
For this, an impulse from outside is needed.
Daartoe is een impuls van buitenaf nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Van Dekken over aanhoudende overtredingen van het verbod op het verloten van dieren

MPs Ouwehand and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why animals such as horses, ponies, calves and pigeons are still being raffled despite the legal ban, whether enforcement and penalties will be tightened, and how the ban is enforced. The State Secretary acknowledged the violations, said existing tools (compliance orders with penalty payments and criminal action) are sufficient, confirmed repeated administrative action against the Assendelft riding-school owner, and reported five compliance orders and one warning since 2011 but no permanent monitoring of all sites.
I have sufficient possibilities to act against the raffling of animals.
Ik heb voldoende mogelijkheden om tegen het verloten van dieren op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Hamer en Jan Vos over de situatie bij Aldel

MPs Van Dekken, Hamer and Jan Vos asked ministers whether they were aware of the precarious situation at chemical company Aldel in Delfzijl, its importance for regional employment, and what the government would do to keep it afloat and assist workers if jobs were lost. The government referred to an earlier letter for the first four questions and said that, if mass dismissals threatened, the social affairs minister would work with UWV on measures to preserve employment, which is not currently the case.
See my letter of 4 October 2013 with reference DGBI-TOP/13168246, which is attached.
Zie mijn brief van 4 oktober 2013 met kenmerk DGBI-TOP/13168246, welke is bijgevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Van Dekken over de trage uitbetaling van rechthebbenden bij Buma/Stemra

MPs Oosenbrug and Van Dekken asked about artist dissatisfaction with Buma/Stemra's royalty distribution, complaint numbers, reports of Spotify royalties being held too long, and the distribution norms. The Secretary of State answered that only one formal complaint was filed in 24 months, that the legal three-year distribution deadline is met, and that no further action with the oversight college is warranted.
Given that the payouts take place within the statutory deadline, I see no reason to bring the handling of distribution at Buma/Stemra to the attention of the Supervisory Board for Copyright.

Gelet op het feit dat de uitkeringen binnen de gestelde wettelijke termijn plaatsvinden, zie ik geen aanleiding de gang van zaken bij Buma/Stemra met betrekking tot de repartitie onder de aandacht te brengen van het College van Toezicht Auteursrechten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de artikelen ‘de grote voetbalroof’ en ‘onderzoek gewenst naar mensenhandel’

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about press reports on investment funds in football, UEFA's Financial Fair Play, possible match-fixing and human trafficking, and whether an investigation or a ban on such funds should follow. The minister answered that there is no evidence of coercion in these cases, that the sector's own rules (KNVB and UEFA) cover independence, and that no investigation or ban is planned, while a pending prosecution inquiry prevents disclosure on match-fixing.

Because of the possible investigative interest – the preliminary inquiry could lead to a criminal investigation, which is not served by premature disclosure of research data – I cannot make substantive statements on this at this time.

Vanwege het mogelijke opsporingsbelang – het voorbereidend onderzoek kan immers leiden tot een strafrechtelijk onderzoek, dat niet gediend is bij voortijdige openbaarmaking van onderzoeksgegevens – kan ik daarover op dit moment geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Den Haag vindt de klachten over bevingen maar gezeur’

MPs Jan Vos and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a report that The Hague dismisses complaints about earthquakes as nagging, and about the backlog of damage claims from gas extraction in Groningen. The minister replied that NAM has expanded its assessor capacity, that claims are being processed with a target of three months, that the Tcbb and an independent ombudsman have reviewed the process, and that research and communication with local authorities are ongoing.
From the outset it has been clear to me that the increase in the number of earthquakes, and their possible strength, is increasing unrest among residents.
Het is voor mij van het begin af aan helder dat de toename van het aantal aardbevingen, en de mogelijke sterkte ervan, de onrust bij de bewoners doen toenemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dekken en Yücel over het bericht aangaande de handhaving van de antihomowet tijdens de Olympische Spelen van Sotsji in 2014

MPs Dekken and Yücel asked the government whether it would press NOC*NSF and the EU over Russian sports minister statements that the anti-gay law would apply during the Sochi Olympics, and how Dutch athletes would be protected. The government said participants should not be hindered, that the IOC had received written assurances, and that the matter is under ongoing IOC attention, so it saw no reason to instruct NOC*NSF; it also pointed to EU guidelines and a travel advice note.
The cabinet therefore sees no reason to call on NOC*NSF to do so.
Het kabinet ziet dan ook geen reden om het NOC*NSF hiertoe op te roepen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Yücel, Van Dekken en Servaes over berichten inzake de verslechterende mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in aanloop naar de Olympische Spelen van 2014

MPs Yücel, Van Dekken and Servaes asked the government about reports of worsening human rights in Russia ahead of the 2014 Sochi Olympics, including LGBT rights, and what the Netherlands would do about it, and whether personal expression of sexual orientation is compatible with the Olympic Charter. The minister says the Netherlands is concerned, will raise the issue bilaterally and in EU fora including a joint EU position on the anti-homopropaganda law, and that personal expression of sexual orientation is not a political statement and not contrary to the Olympic Charter.

The cabinet will raise the human rights situation in Russia broadly at the autumn Foreign Affairs Council, which will prepare the half-yearly EU-Russia Summit, and promote a joint EU position on the anti-homopropaganda law.
Het kabinet zal in de RBZ in het najaar, die de voorbereiding van de halfjaarlijkse EU-Rusland Top ter hand zal nemen, de mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in brede zin aan de orde stellen

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Mei LiVos (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over doodsbedreigingen door gefrustreerde sportgokkers (ingezonden 12 juli 20

MPs Van Dekken and Mei LiVos asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about death threats against athletes by frustrated sports bettors, and about matchfixing research and enforcement. The minister answered that the matchfixing study will be sent to parliament before the summer recess, declined to comment on a preliminary judicial investigation, and pointed to the new gambling authority and planned policy response.
Regarding a preliminary investigation, I make no statements in the context of the possible interest of criminal investigation.
Over een voorbereidend onderzoek doe ik – in het kader van het mogelijke opsporingsbelang – geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over de dreigende sluiting van de sociale werkplaats in Groningen

MPs Kerstens, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked whether the Secretary of State was aware of reports on the threatened closure of the Groningen sheltered workshop, whether she agreed with the term 'sterfhuisconstructie', and whether a regional-differences motion would be implemented. The Secretary answered yes to awareness, explained that the Participatiewet closes Wsw inflow from 2015 without the state closing workshops, and confirmed regional factors will be weighed in the new budget distribution.
The central government is not closing any sw-bedrijven.
Het Rijk sluit daarbij geen sw-bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kuzu over de beschikbaarheid van het Q-koorts medicijn doxycycline

MPs Van Dekken and Kuzu asked the health minister about the nationwide shortage of the antibiotic doxycycline, which chronic Q-fever patients depend on, and whether supply is restored. The minister confirmed the shortage, explained supply chain causes, reported partial availability from some suppliers, and pointed to a general plan on medicine shortages without a specific patient-level commitment.
My ambition is therefore, where possible, to address medicine shortages through joint efforts of all parties involved.
Mijn ambitie is dan ook daar waar mogelijk geneesmiddelentekorten aan te pakken door een gezamenlijke inspanning van alle betrokken partijen.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken over het bericht «Resistente schimmel verspreidt zich» (ingezonde

Two MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about reports that resistant Aspergillus fungi are spreading, possibly linked to azole fungicides used in pesticides and biocides. The minister acknowledged a possible link, said the risk is limited to high-risk patients, pointed to a reference laboratory and a ministry-commissioned study due in summer 2013, and did not commit to new measures.
The risk to public health is limited to certain risk groups that are especially susceptible to infections.
Het risico voor de volksgezondheid beperkt zich tot bepaalde risicogroepen die in verhoogde mate vatbaar zijn voor infecties.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch en Van Dekken en De Boer over het verdwijnen van de unieke collectie typemachines van de schrijver W.F. Hermans naar het buitenland

MPs asked the minister why W.F. Hermans' typewriter collection was allocated to a Belgian bookshop, whether museum rules leave a gap allowing such export, and what tools exist to keep it in the Netherlands. The minister defended the selection process, said the collection stays accessible in the Dutch-language area, stated that museum self-regulation rather than a gap explains the outcome, promised Erfgoedwet rules on state disposal of heritage, and rejected using the Wet tot behoud van cultuurbezit in this case.
I intend to regulate further, in the Heritage Act, the process by which governments, important owners of collections, dispose of cultural objects.
Ik ben voornemens in de Erfgoedwet het proces van afstoten van cultuurvoorwerpen door overheden, belangrijke eigenaars van collecties, nader te regelen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de vaccinatie van geiten tegen Q-koorts

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about progress on the mandatory Q-fever vaccination of goats by 1 August 2013 and whether non-compliant goat farmers would be sanctioned. The state secretary answered that only 24% of holders had vaccinated by 1 July, and that from 1 August the NVWA will impose enforcement orders, vaccinate animals itself at the owner's cost, and draw up official reports against non-compliant holders.
From 1 August 2013 the NVWA will impose an enforcement order on the holder aimed at restoring compliance, namely vaccinating the animals after all.
Vanaf 1 augustus 2013 zal de NVWA de houder een last onder bestuursdwang opleggen die is gericht op herstel van de overtreding, namelijk het alsnog vaccineren van de dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden vr Van Dekken en Kuzu over het duurder worden van sportbeoefening

Two PvdA MPs asked whether rising sports fees threaten children's and low-income participation in sport and what the government will do. The minister says local authorities are primarily responsible, points to the Sport en Bewegen in de Buurt programme, Sportimpuls, Jeugdsportfonds funding and poverty-policy funds, and commits to discussions with VNG and the Jeugdsportfonds.
Encouraging sport and exercise is primarily a local responsibility.
Het stimuleren van sporten en bewegen is primair een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Hamer over het bericht ‘NOM wil bemiddelaar om PPG te redden’

Two Labour MPs asked the Social Affairs and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that the Northern Development Company (NOM) wanted a mediator to save fibre-optic firm PPG, which faced closure threats amid union action. Minister Asscher answered that PPG management and union FNV Bondgenoten reached a deal through mediation by the Drenthe Commissioner of the King, that the closure threat is lifted, and that the dispute is a private matter so no further government action is needed.
The negotiations between PPG's management and FNV Bondgenoten are primarily a private matter and have since led to a good outcome.
