De onderhandelingen tussen de directie van PPG en FNV Bondgenoten betreffen in eerste aanleg een private aangelegenheid en hebben intussen tot een goede uitkomst geleid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de komst van een mega-melkveebedrijf in Oploo

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and the health minister about a mega dairy farm in Oploo, the public health risks flagged by the GGD report, and whether further Health Council research is needed. The government replied that the municipality has taken the GGD's recommendations into account, adopted a stricter odour distance norm and a monitoring system, and commissioned a 3.4 million euro RIVM study on health effects of livestock farming.
As indicated in the letter of 14 June to your House, I have commissioned additional research into the quantitative health effects of livestock farming
Zoals aangegeven in de brief van 14 juni jl. aan uw Kamer heb ik opdracht gegeven voor het uitvoeren van aanvullend onderzoek naar de kwantitatieve gezondheidseffecten van veehouderijen
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jacobi over het bericht ‘Intensieve veehouderij in Achtkarspelen: een bedreiging voor de volksgezondheid’

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the state secretaries of Economic Affairs and Health about public health concerns over intensive livestock farming in Achtkarspelen, including fine dust, odour, and municipal expansion despite provincial policy. The government said responsibility for expansion lies with the local authority, pointed to the restrictive national policy and provincial interim rules, and committed to a new RIVM study and a possible knowledge platform.
Responsibility for decisions on any expansion lies with the local competent authority.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor beslissingen aangaande de eventuele uitbreiding ligt bij het lokaal bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kuzu over het artikel ‘screen op resistente bacteriën’

MPs Van Dekken and Kuzu asked the health minister whether the Netherlands is sufficiently prepared against emerging resistant bacteria, including ESBL-like ones such as Oxa-48, NDM-1 and KPC, and about periodic screening and new antibiotic development. The minister replied that antibiotic resistance is a government priority, referred to a letter of 2 July 2013 on the policy, and announced expanded surveillance including nationwide ISIS-AR and a molecular monitoring system.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht “inactiviteit bij kinderen”

PvdA MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked the health minister about a TV report on child inactivity, its long-term effects, the performance of sports coaches, and investment in physical education from the PvdA Topsport action plan. The minister acknowledged the concern, said evaluation of sports coaches is still ongoing with results expected end 2013, and pointed to existing programmes and the coalition agreement's ambition for more gym lessons, with OCW to report later.

Given the recent change and the ongoing research, I consider it too early to speak about adjusting the current scheme or to judge the performance of combination officers and neighbourhood sports coaches.

Gezien de recente wijziging en het lopende onderzoek acht ik het daarom te vroeg om te spreken over een aanpassing van de huidige regeling en om te oordelen over de prestaties van combinatiefunctionarissen en buurtsportcoaches.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers en Van Dekken over het bericht dat weidegang niet noodzakelijk is voor weidepremie

MPs Dikkers and Van Dekken asked whether cow grazing is required for the grazing premium and whether the term 'weidemelk' is misleading, and asked for definitions of sustainability labels. The state secretary replied that weidemelk requires grazing (at least 120 days, 6 hours a day), that existing Warenwet rules on misleading labelling suffice, and that no further conditions or talks with companies are needed.
The term 'weidemelk' applies only to milk from cows that actually get grazing, and in practice this is the case.
De term «weidemelk» geldt alleen voor melk van koeien die daadwerkelijk weidegang krijgen, dat is in de praktijk ook het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Dekken over de handelwijze van de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) in de zaak Selten

MPs Dikkers and Van Dekken asked about the NVWA's handling of the Selten meat case, including mislabelling of horse meat as beef, destruction of beef stock, delayed notification after a contaminated horse import, and the EU horse passport system. The government declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, explained labelling rules and the basis for recalling unverifiable meat, and withheld the names of buyers citing privacy law.
In general, and also in this case, we refrain from answering questions about ongoing criminal cases or claims by suspects in ongoing criminal cases.
In het algemeen en ook in deze casus onthouden wij ons van beantwoording van vragen over lopende strafzaken dan wel beweringen van verdachten in lopende strafzaken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Fokke en Jacobi over “overtredingen door veehouderijen met luchtwassers”

MPs Van Dekken, Fokke and Jacobi asked about violations by livestock farms with air scrubbers, including 58% of inspected cases with breaches and 16% serious ones, and their effect on fine-particle and nitrogen calculations, enforcement in Brabant versus other provinces, and sanctions. The state secretary acknowledged the non-compliance, pointed to mandatory electronic monitoring from 2016, said enforcement is delegated to municipalities and provinces without a national register, and promised to take further measures if compliance does not improve.

There is no national system in which the competent authorities under the Wabo record inspections, so no overview of the results of inspections of intensive livestock farms with air scrubbers can be given.

Er is geen landelijk systeem waarin de bevoegde gezagen voor de Wabo de controles registreren, waardoor geen overzicht van de resultaten van controles op intensieve veehouderijen met luchtwassers gegeven kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt  over het falende Nederlandse anti-dopingbeleid

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked ministers about reports that Dutch anti-doping policy is failing, including claims of a doubling of doping laboratories, online doping sales and cross-border cooperation with Belgium. The government answered that the picture is not recognised by the IGZ and the OM, outlined existing EU and national cooperation, announced an inter-ministerial consultation and a symposium, and said it sees no need to revise sports self-regulation for now.
The picture sketched in the broadcast is not recognised by the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) and the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Het in de uitzending geschetste beeld wordt door de Inspectie voor de gezondheidszorg (IGZ) en het openbaar ministerie (OM) niet herkend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Jacobi en Monasch over het bericht ‘Almere nieuwe schaatscentrum’

Three PvdA MPs asked the health minister about reports that Almere would host a new national speed-skating centre, questioning KNSB's commitment to Thialf and the selection criteria. The minister replied that the ministry is not involved in choosing among the three bids, that the KNSB and NOC*NSF make the decision on 15 August 2013, and that she will not intervene.
The Ministry of VWS is not involved in the assessment and choice among the three initiatives.
Het ministerie van VWS is niet betrokken bij de beoordeling en keuze voor één van de drie initiatieven.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Waar is de tiplijn’

MP Van Dekken asked the ministers about a report that no tip line exists for anonymous reports of match-fixing in Dutch football, and about whether a judicial preliminary investigation is needed. The minister answered that the anonymous line Meld Misdaad Anoniem was opened for match-fixing from 1 April 2013, that the KNVB has a tip line, and that the Public Prosecution Service has started a preliminary investigation into fraud in football, which may include the signals raised.
The Public Prosecution Service has started a preliminary investigation into various signals about, in short, fraud in the football sector, including match-fixing.
Het Openbaar Ministerie is begonnen met een voorbereidend onderzoek naar diverse signalen over, kort gezegd, fraude in de voetbalbranche, waaronder matchfixing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert, Jan Vos en Van Dekken over het aardbevingsbestendig maken van de olie- en gasopslag in Groningen

MPs asked whether oil storage in Eemshaven, licensed on older earthquake assumptions, must be made earthquake-proof, whether systematic risk studies cover licensed firms, and whether NAM should pay for upgrades. The government replied that Vopak is still assessing its terminal, that 11 studies including effects of quakes above 3.9 Richter are underway, that NAM will be approached if preventive upgrades are needed, and that COVA can rely on Vopak's licence compliance.
As part of the 11 studies mentioned, the possible surface effects of an earthquake larger than 3.9 Richter are also being examined.
Als onderdeel van de genoemde 11 onderzoeken wordt ook onderzocht wat de mogelijke effecten aan het oppervlak zijn van een aardbeving groter dan 3.9 Richter
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht ‘Kernafval net over de grens’ in het Dagblad van het Noorden van 11 april 2011

Three PvdA MPs asked the economics minister whether plans exist to store nuclear waste in salt domes across the border from Vlagtwedde, and about health, drinking water and consultation with Groningen and Germany. The minister replied that Germany has no concrete site plans yet, only a renewed site search with a committee report due in 2015, and that Dutch policy favours geological disposal while contact with Germany would follow if a border site emerged.
There are no plans in Germany to store radioactive waste just across the border near Vlagtwedde.
Er zijn in Duitsland geen plannen om radioactief afval vlak over de grens bij Vlagtwedde op te slaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Fokke en Kuiken over het niet vernietigen van een bouwvergunning voor een geitenstal in Landerd (Noord-Brabant)

Three PvdA MPs asked why the Crown did not annul the municipality of Landerd's building permit for a goat barn despite the province of Noord-Brabant's request, and whether the expansion should be allowed on public health grounds. The minister replied that no conflict with law or the general interest was found, so annulment under the Constitution's Article 132 could not be applied, and that the decision takes no position on the desirability of the expansion or the provincial building freeze.
In this case it has become clear to me that no conflict with the law or the general interest has been shown.
In deze zaak is het mij duidelijk geworden dat er niet van strijd met het recht of het algemeen belang is gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jacobi over het bericht ‘Vergunning megastal Grubbenvorst geweigerd’

MPs Van Dekken and Jacobi asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about the Council of State's annulment of environmental permits for a large livestock farm in Grubbenvorst, and whether such projects near homes are responsible given health risks, and whether the arrival could be prevented. The state secretary replied that the annulment was on procedural grounds (inadequate notice to interested parties), that other grounds were not reached, and that the Health Council advice and a policy response on farm scale will follow.

The Council of State declared the appeal against this environmental permit well-founded and ruled that the contested decision must be annulled for breach of article 3:12, first paragraph, of the General Administrative Law Act.

De Raad van State heeft het beroep inzake deze milieuvergunning gegrond verklaard en bepaald dat het bestreden besluit wegens strijd met artikel 3:12, eerste lid, van de Awb dient te worden vernietigd.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken over berichten vanuit Oostenrijk met betrekking tot signalen van matchfixing in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers of Health and Justice about reports from Austrian bookmakers flagging suspicious betting on Dutch Eredivisie matches and whether the Dutch matchfixing investigation could use that information. The minister replied that no such Austrian warning system was found to exist, the information came from a UEFA analyst of doubtful relevance, and UEFA's betting fraud system found no irregular betting on the two matches checked.
Inquiries with the Austrian bookmakers' organisation revealed, however, that information about the Eredivisie matches in question was not provided by that organisation.
Navraag bij de Oostenrijkse organisatie van wedkantoren heeft echter geleerd dat informatie over de bedoelde wedstrijden uit de eredivisie niet door deze organisatie is verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over antibioticaresistentie

An MP asked the health minister and economy state secretary about antibiotic resistance, citing a radio warning, the lack of new antibiotic development, and high antibiotic use in livestock farming. The minister acknowledged the threat, pointed to existing and planned national and international measures, and promised letters before the summer recess with further detail.
I will inform you by letter before the summer on how this specific topic will be worked out during the current cabinet period.
Over de uitwerking van dit specifieke onderwerp binnen de huidige kabinetsperiode zal ik u voor de zomer per brief informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Van Dekken over stijgend aantal kinderen dat in armoede opgroeit

Two MPs (PvdA) asked the state secretary about the rising number of children growing up in poverty and what measures the government takes, including ring-fencing poverty funds, regional differences and the municipal participation ordinance. The state secretary answered that poverty policy is mainly a municipal task, listed existing measures, declined to earmark funds, and said the ordinance will be evaluated after two years.
Poverty reduction is primarily a task for municipalities.
Armoedebestrijding is primair een taak voor gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Bruins Slot over matchfixing

MPs Van Dekken and Bruins Slot asked the ministers of Justice and of Health about matchfixing, including Belgian and German approaches, the claim that Dutch enforcement is lax, possible prosecution of Dutch nationals abroad, and the need for special investigative powers or a dedicated unit at the Public Prosecution Service. Minister Opstelten replied that there are no concrete indications of matchfixing in the Netherlands, that investigations will start if signals arise, that a German investigation concerns Dutch suspects and falls under territoriality, and that special powers and a new unit are not currently justified.
There is no question of concrete indications regarding matchfixing in the Netherlands.
Er is geen sprake van concrete aanwijzingen met betrekking tot matchfixing in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over de aanhouding van Willem II fans te Utrecht

Two MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers about the arrest of around 42 Willem II supporters in Utrecht and whether a combi-ticket scheme would have prevented it, plus what legal remedies the supporters had and how this fits the planned Voetbalwet changes. The minister explained the police and municipal reasoning for the arrests, said complaints and objections via a bestuurlijke strafbeschikking were available, and argued a combi-ticket scheme was unlikely to have prevented the incident.
The police surrounded and arrested a large group.
Door de politie werd een grote groep ingesloten en aangehouden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch, Wolbert en Van Dekken over het bericht dat per 1 maart 2013 al banen verdwijnen bij gevangenissen in Ter Apel, Hoogeveen en Veenhuizen

MPs Marcouch, Wolbert and Van Dekken asked the state secretary whether job losses at prisons in Ter Apel, Hoogeveen and Veenhuizen from 1 March 2013 were true and linked to the unpublished Masterplan. The state secretary denied that dozens of jobs were disappearing, said empty capacity is being concentrated for efficiency as a separate operational measure, and gave partial answers on consultation, cells and transfers.
Pending the discussion of the Masterplan in your House, no irreversible steps will be taken.
Vooruitlopend op de bespreking van het Masterplan in uw Kamer zullen er geen onomkeerbare stappen worden gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Van Dekken over het bericht dat Groningen is ontsnapt aan een treinramp met gevaarlijke stoffen

Two Labour MPs asked the state secretary whether a near-accident at Groningen Europapark rail yard in March 2012, where a train carrying dangerous goods was routed onto the wrong track, was serious and what caused it. The state secretary answered that the cause was an incorrect drawing and missing acceptance checks, that ProRail has since added drawing checks and physical tests, and that the Inspectorate continues to monitor, with results expected in autumn 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over de achterstand van Nederland in de strijd tegen matchfixing

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers why the Netherlands lags behind criminal networks in combating match-fixing, including whether football associations can detect it and whether reporters are protected. The minister answered that a study by the ministries started on 23 January 2013, that anonymous reporting is possible, and that protective measures will be considered after the study's results.
For that reason, reporters are given the opportunity to tell their story anonymously within the ministries' study, via a web survey and a telephone reporting option.
Om die reden wordt melders in het kader van het onderzoek van onze ministeries via een webenquête en een telefonische meldingsmogelijkheid de mogelijkheid gegeven om anoniem hun verhaal te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over het vechten voor een schone vechtsport

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked ministers about inadequate medical oversight, instructor quality, criminal links and the need for a sports commission in the martial arts sector. The minister acknowledged problems, reported a RIEC report finding criminal links at nearly half of events, noted municipalities are amending local rules, and said she would consult stakeholders on a commission before the summer recess.
I am willing to invite a number of relevant stakeholders to explore what could be a good and feasible way forward in this matter.
Ik ben bereid een aantal relevante stakeholders uit te nodigen om te verkennen wat in deze een goede en begaanbare weg zou kunnen zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hamer en Van Dekken over het verdwijnen van banen bij Menzis in Groningen

MPs Hamer and Van Dekken asked the minister whether he would act on the dismissal of 175 Menzis staff in Groningen, a region with high unemployment, and why the company targets that region disproportionately. The minister replied that corporate location and staffing decisions are private, that unions and works councils represent employees, and that municipalities and UWV handle local job support, with a social plan already agreed.
The location and personnel policy of individual companies is a private consideration that the cabinet does not get involved in.
Het vestigingsplaats- en personeelsbeleid van individuele bedrijven is een private overweging waar het kabinet niet in stapt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de stijging van het aantal dierproeven

An MP asks the government about the rise in animal experiments reported by the NVWA and related questions on stock animals, violations, and information provision. The state secretary answers that the trend fits a slightly declining long-term pattern, that the government aims to reduce animal testing, and that Dutch reporting is already extensive, with a promised policy letter in March.
I intend to send you a progress letter in mid-March in which I will further address my level of ambition.
Ik zal u in de stand van zaken brief die ik voornemens ben medio maart aan u te doen toekomen nader ingaan op mijn ambitieniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de aanpak omtrent de Q-koorts

An MP asked the health minister about the Q-koorts (Q fever) response, including the gap between infections, illnesses and notifications, whether a separate reporting point is needed, and whether the policy aims to restore trust in government. The minister answered that mandatory notification already covers acute cases, that chronic cases are monitored through existing databases and screening, and that a limited population study in Herpen will be funded, while pointing to earlier letters for the broader aims.
As I recently indicated in answers to questions from MP Van Gerven, I will fund a population study on chronic Q fever in Herpen on an incidental basis.
Zoals ik onlangs in antwoorden op vragen van het lid Van Gerven heb aangegeven zal ik een bevolkingsonderzoek naar chronische Q-koorts in Herpen incidenteel financieren
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Nijboer en Van Dekken inzake de stroomtarieven van aluminiumproducent Aldel

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the electricity tariffs facing aluminium producer Aldel, a German grid-cost exemption for large consumers, and unfair European competition. The minister replied that a Dutch equivalent of the German rule is being studied within the STROOM legislative agenda, that the Commission's state-aid view is awaited, and that a concrete compensation scheme is under consideration.
Because of the redistribution effects, it is important to consider any large-consumer scheme in an integrated way within the broader revision of tariff regulation under the STROOM legislative agenda.

Vanwege de herverdelingseffecten is het van belang een eventuele grootverbruikerregeling integraal te bezien binnen de bredere herziening van de tariefregulering die plaatsvindt binnen de wetgevingsagenda STROOM.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de ontwikkelingen rond het geitenbedrijf in Ambt Delden, en de relatie volksgezondheid en intensieve veehouderij

An MP asks whether a goat farm in Ambt Delden keeping about 1000 goats without proper permit has a valid permit, whether a plan for 5000 goats is pending, and how this fits with the cabinet's position on maximum farm size and public health risks such as Q fever. The state secretary replies that the environmental permit is still under review after public consultation, that the government will issue a policy response on the Health Council advice by 1 March 2013 including on size limits, fine particulate matter and buffer distances, and that vaccination of goats makes elevated Q fever risk for residents unlikely.
The cabinet will give Parliament a policy response to this advice no later than 1 March 2013.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer uiterlijk 1 maart 2013 een beleidsreactie geven op dit advies.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over het gevaar van matchfixing in het Nederlandse voetbal

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Health, Welfare and Sport about the danger of match-fixing in Dutch football, citing a criminologist's claim that police and prosecutors do not take it seriously. The minister denied this, pointed to an ongoing study of match-fixing, noted the new gambling regulator's enforcement, and welcomed the KNVB's own anti-match-fixing plans.
As your House is aware, the Ministries of Health, Welfare and Sport and of Security and Justice are currently commissioning research into the nature and extent of match-fixing in the Netherlands.
Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend is laten de Ministeries van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie momenteel onderzoek doen naar de aard en omvang van matchfixing in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de plannen voor de bouw van een nertsenhouderij nabij Stevensbeek

An MP asked the state secretaries whether a mink farm planned near Stevensbeek, close to a school, an orchard and sports fields, was desirable, and whether they would intervene despite a moratorium and an expected health council advice. The government answered that the municipality is responsible for the environmental permit, that it saw no way to intervene in ongoing permit applications, and that the cabinet's policy response to the health council advice would reach parliament by 1 March 2013.
During that debate I indicated that I see no possibilities to intervene in ongoing permit applications and that this is a municipal responsibility.
Tijdens die behandeling heb ik aangegeven geen mogelijkheden te zien om in te grijpen in lopende vergunningaanvragen en dat het hier een gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid betreft.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Thieme en Van Dekken over financiering van megastallen in het buitenland

MPs Thieme and Van Dekken asked why Dutch public money still indirectly supports megastables abroad, such as Myronivsky Hliboproduct in Ukraine, despite the Ouwehand motion, and demanded an exclusion list for Atradius DSB. The minister replied that export credit insurance is available case by case under IFC performance standards, that a megastable-specific exclusion would not be imposed, and that the government will discuss the link between stable size and animal welfare with colleagues and inform the House.
I will discuss the relationship between stable size and animal welfare with my colleagues at Economic Affairs and will inform the House of this as soon as possible.
Ik zal in overleg met mijn collega’s van Economische Zaken de relatie stalomvang en dierenwelzijn bespreken en zal de Tweede Kamer daar zo spoedig mogelijk over informeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch, Hamer, Van Dekken, Albert de Vries en Wolbert over het bericht dat er gevangenissen in Groningen, Drenthe Zeeland worden gesloten

PvdA MPs asked whether plans to close prisons in Groningen, Drenthe and Zeeland exist, and about the employment, visitor travel and cultural-heritage effects of such closures. The State Secretary replied that no decision has been taken, closures cannot be avoided given budget cuts, a Masterplan on detention capacity will be presented in April 2013, and regional employment and visits will be weighed.

With a view to a careful decision-making process, I have asked the Director-General of DJI to draw up a Masterplan on DJI detention capacity, which will show the consequences of the cuts for cell capacity and staff.

Met het oog op een zorgvuldig besluitvormingsproces heb ik de hoofddirecteur van DJI verzocht om een Masterplan detentiecapaciteit DJI op te stellen, waarin de gevolgen van de ombuigingen voor de celcapaciteit van DJI en het personeel in beeld worden gebracht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de MRSA-bacterie op vleeskuikenboerderijen

An MP asked the health minister and state secretary about MRSA found on broiler farms and in slaughterhouse workers, the NVWA's advice to reduce antibiotic use and change stunning methods, and what measures are planned. The government answered that antibiotic reduction targets and guidance for exposed workers are in place, that further research on ducks and turkeys is commissioned for 2013, and that stunning changes follow EU rules.
That is why measures have been taken against the cause of multi-resistant bacteria.
Daarom zijn er maatregelen ingezet tegen de oorzaak van het voorkomen van multiresistente bacteriën.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over het bericht ‘Chaos troef bij Topklasser FC Chabab; zwart geld, witte lijnen.’

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked the Justice and Health ministers whether a former main sponsor of FC Chabab used the club to launder drug money, whether drug money laundering via football clubs has occurred before, and what will be done about it. Minister Opstelten answered that the investigation concerned drug dealing rather than laundering through the club, that no convictions for laundering via football clubs are known, and that anti-laundering measures and a bill raising penalties are in preparation.

The criminal investigation by the National Public Prosecutor's Office into the former main sponsor of FC Chabab, referred to in the article cited in question 1, did not concern laundering drug money through this club.

Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek van het Landelijk Parket dat plaatsgevonden heeft naar de voormalige hoofdsponsor van FC Chabab en waaraan in het in vraag 1 aangehaalde artikel wordt gerefereerd had geen betrekking op het witwassen van drugsgelden via deze vereniging.
Antwoord vragen Hamer en Van Dekken over het verdwijnen van banen bij Menzis in Groningen

Two MPs (PvdA) asked the minister whether the loss of 165 jobs at Menzis in Groningen, and the concentration of insurer work, is disproportionate for the northern labour market and whether the government will act. The minister acknowledges the impact on affected workers, states that regional labour market policy lies with municipalities and UWV, that location and staffing decisions are a private matter, and that the government sees no evidence the north performs worse, promising only to consult social partners.
The location and staffing policy of individual companies is ultimately a private matter.
Het vestigings- en personeelsbeleid van individuele bedrijven is uiteindelijk een private aangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken over het Europees handelsverbod op cosmetica die getest is op dieren

An MP asked the minister whether the EU ban on trading in cosmetics tested on animals, due to take effect in 2013, would be relaxed, and how the government would defend it. The minister said she opposes postponement, is working for broad member-state support to keep the date, and that no Dutch firms conduct such tests since domestic animal testing for cosmetics is banned.
My aim is to secure the broadest possible support among other member states for keeping the ban's entry date.
Mijn inzet is erop gericht om een zo groot mogelijk draagvlak bij andere lidstaten te verkrijgen voor handhaving van de ingangsdatum van het verbod.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over matchfixing in Nederland

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked about the arrest of Paul R. for handling stolen masterpieces, whether Germany seeks to prosecute him over the Bochum bribery scandal, and whether they should hear him and launch criminal investigation into match-fixing. The minister confirmed the German prosecution and European arrest warrant, said a thorough in-depth study of match-fixing is being commissioned, but no criminal investigation will start because the Netherlands lacks information on possible offences committed here.
Since the Netherlands does not currently have such information, no criminal investigation will be started.
Nu Nederland tot op heden niet over dergelijke informatie beschikt, wordt dan ook geen strafrechtelijk onderzoek gestart.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Dit is een klassiek voorbeeld van kinderhandel» (ingezonden 26 oktober 2012).

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about press reports of child exploitation through agent-controlled youth football transfers, including long contracts and unlicensed agents, and what the KNVB and FIFA have done. The minister replied that football bodies must enforce their own rules, that the KNVB has limited reach over unlicensed agents, that disciplinary cases have often been dropped for lack of evidence, and that discussions are ongoing at EU and FIFA level.
The KNVB has informed me that it is still consulting with stakeholders, including FIFA, to amend the relevant regulations.
De KNVB heeft mij laten weten dat het nog steeds overleg voert met betrokkenen, onder meer met de FIFA, om te komen tot aanpassing van de betreffende regelgeving.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi en Van Dekken over “het feit dat ruim de helft van de Brabantse veeboeren teveel ammoniak uitstoten”

MPs Jacobi and Van Dekken asked why over half of Brabant livestock farms exceed ammonia limits and what this means for Natura 2000 goals, air quality and enforcement. The state secretary says enforcement is the province's responsibility, promises electronic monitoring of scrubbers from 2013, and deems the province's planned enforcement measures sufficient for now while refusing to halt new livestock farms.
As a result, the verifiability and enforceability of scrubbers will improve considerably.
Hierdoor zal de controleerbaarheid en handhaafbaarheid van luchtwassers aanzienlijk verbeteren.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken over het bericht “Nederland is onvoldoende voorbereid op nieuwe uitbraak dier op mens overdraagbare ziektes”

An MP asked whether the Netherlands is unprepared for new zoonotic outbreaks, citing survey findings that doctors and vets cooperate poorly, and asked how cooperation and a One Health approach will be strengthened. The state secretary replied that preparedness has been improved since the Q-fever outbreak through the EmZoo report and a new human-veterinary risk-analysis structure, disputed that the report notes limited doctor knowledge, accepted that the risk of a new zoonosis is real, and pointed to conferences, training and information-sharing as the way to improve cooperation.
I share the view of the majority of the surveyed veterinarians that the chance of an outbreak of a new zoonosis in the Netherlands is real.
Ik deel de opvatting van de meerderheid van de geënquêteerde dierenartsen dat de kans op een uitbraak van een nieuwe zoönose in Nederland reëel is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Van Dekken over de uitwerking van de fusietoets in krimpgebieden

Two PvdA MPs asked the education minister how the merger test (fusietoets) affects schools in shrinking regions that want to merge to safeguard quality. The minister said the test's justification grounds already allow such mergers, declined to soften the test for now pending an interdepartmental study due in spring 2013, and pointed to existing financial compensation for merging primary schools.
This year it will still be considered whether these signals should lead to an adjustment of the policy rule.
Nog dit jaar zal worden bezien of deze signalen zouden moeten leiden tot aanpassing van de beleidsregel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de subsidiëring van de ontwikkeling van een gigastal in Horst aan de Maas

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation how the ministry can claim it informed parliament about innovation subsidies for a gigastable in Horst aan de Maas, and how many such subsidies were granted for mega- and gigastables at home and abroad. The State Secretary points to general budget and annual report channels and the public subsidy database, gives counts of innovation subsidies by province, and reports subsidies abroad without a dedicated mega-stable policy.
I indicated in the broadcast that the House of Representatives is informed in general terms, via the budget and the annual report of the ministry, about subsidy schemes.
Ik heb in de uitzending aangegeven dat de Tweede Kamer in algemene zin via de begroting en het jaarverslag van het ministerie van EL&I wordt geïnformeerd over subsidieregelingen
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Timmermans over het slopen van sloppenwijken voor de Olympische Spelen in Rio de Janeiro

MPs Van Dekken and Timmermans asked whether the displacement of about 8,000 people for the Rio Olympics is acceptable and whether the government will raise it internationally, and what has been done on the NGO/sports-body conduct code motions and FIFA/IOC responsibility. The minister answered that the number cannot be verified, housing is offered, no international raising is planned for now, an EU expert group will report by end 2012, and that FIFA/IOC cannot be held responsible for host governments' choices.
An exact number cannot be determined.
Een exact aantal valt niet te achterhalen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers aangaande aardschokken in Noord-Groningen

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked whether recent earthquakes in Groningen are known, whether they have occurred for years, whether the burden of proof for gas-extraction damage should be reversed, and whether residents will be informed. The minister confirmed the quakes and recurrence, defended the existing claims procedure via NAM and the independent Tcbb as effective, and offered information on causes and damage handling.
I therefore see no reason to amend the procedure.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om de procedure aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dijsselbloem over de (on)veiligheid op en rond het water

Two MPs asked ministers about drowning risk, reduced lifeguard supervision in the Gelderland river area, subsidies to lifeguard organisations and who is responsible for supervision. The state secretary answered that supervision is a local decision, that the ministry funds a regional lifeguard cooperation but not local brigades, and that no supervision requirements will be included in the new Zwemwaterwet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hamer en Van Dekken over "de oneerlijke concurrentie op arbeidsvoorwaarden op de bouwplaatsen in de Eemshaven"

MPs Hamer and Van Dekken asked the minister about alleged underpayment of Romanian workers below the CAO construction wage at Eemshaven construction sites and the limits of inspection and enforcement. The state secretary replied that the Inspectorate SZW found Minimum Wage Act violations at Forklift, that CAO enforcement is primarily the responsibility of the social partners, and pointed to the EU enforcement directive proposal on chain liability while avoiding commitments on new measures.
Enforcement of collective agreements, like their creation, content and compliance, primarily falls under the responsibility of the social partners.
De handhaving van cao's valt – net als de totstandkoming, de inhoud en naleving van cao's – primair onder de verantwoordelijkheid van cao-partijen.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing en Van Dekken over de langstudeerdersboete voor topsporters

MPs Jadnanansing and Van Dekken asked whether the long-student fine deters elite athletes from combining sport with study and whether it should be replaced. Minister Zijlstra rejected this, pointing to existing extra study years, loan options, profiling-fund support and university athlete schemes, and promised few exceptions.
No, I do not share this view.
Nee, ik deel deze mening niet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het artikel “De Slavische slavencontracten” en de handel in jonge voetballers

MP Van Dekken asks the health and sport minister about a newspaper report on exploitative 'slavery contracts' for young footballers and the role of clubs such as Ajax, and whether the KNVB and government should act against agent trade in minors. The minister says FIFA and KNVB rules govern player agents, clubs should consider their social role, the KNVB already monitors agents and sanctions breaches, and she sees no need for further action or research.
I therefore see no reason for further consultation with the KNVB.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding voor nader overleg met de KNVB.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Timmermans over een mogelijke Duitse boycot van het EK voetbal

MPs Van Dekken and Timmermans asked about a possible German boycott of Euro 2012 over the situation of Ukrainian opposition figures, and whether the Netherlands would follow suit by not sending a political delegation. The minister said concerns about the rule of law and Timoshenko's treatment prompted a conditional stance, that Minister Schippers attended the Netherlands-Denmark match after improvements in Timoshenko's detention, and that the government raised the issue with Ukraine at EU level.
The cabinet previously indicated that if Ms Timoshenko's situation did not sufficiently improve, the Netherlands would not send a political-level delegation to Ukraine.
Door het kabinet is eerder aangegeven dat als de situatie van mevrouw Timosjenko niet voldoende zou verbeteren, Nederland niet op politiek niveau naar Oekraïne zou gaan
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch, Van Dekken en Timmermans over homorechten in Oekraïne

MPs Marcouch, Van Dekken and Timmermans asked about the cancelled Kyiv gay pride, a Ukrainian bill criminalising public expression of homosexuality, and whether this should affect Dutch attendance at Euro 2012 matches and the final's location. The government condemned the violence and bill, said Dutch ministers would attend a match with a human rights programme, but rejected moving the final to Poland as impractical.
On 21 May I expressed to the media my disappointment at the cancellation of the Kyiv Pride Parade.
Ik heb op 21 mei jl. tegenover de media mijn teleurstelling uitgesproken over de afgelasting van de Kyiv Pride Parade.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Hazekamp, Van Gerven, Grashoff en Graus over de voortgang van de bouw van megastallen ondanks het nadrukkelijk verzoek van de Tweede Kamer voor een moratorium op de bouw van deze

Five MPs asked the state secretary why construction of mega-stables continues despite a Chamber request for a moratorium, including a municipality's decision to proceed with a Horst aan de Maas project after a health risk assessment. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said the Witveldweg zoning procedure started before the motion so it is not a new application, reiterated restrictive policy, and said a legislative cap on animal numbers would be left to a next cabinet.
There is therefore no question of new applications as referred to in the motion by the members Grashoff and Van Veldhoven.
Er is derhalve geen sprake van nieuwe aanvragen als bedoeld in de motie van de leden Grashoff en Van Veldhoven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jacobi over plofkippen en het Beter Leven Keurmerk

MPs Van Dekken and Jacobi asked the state secretary about the 'plofkip' (fast-growing broiler), antibiotic use, welfare problems, and whether government canteens could switch to Beter Leven chicken. The state secretary largely deferred to retail and industry initiatives, cited pending research on antibiotic use, and said canteen criteria were being updated to encourage more animal-friendly products.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over matchfixing

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked ministers about match-fixing in Finland, reports of exploitation of young foreign players, and whether the government would investigate and take responsibility. The minister answered that she lacks knowledge of Finland, sees no concrete signs of such practices in the Netherlands and no reason for a study, while placing primary responsibility on players and the KNVB, relying on the existing criminal law system.
Because there are no concrete indications that such practices occur in the Netherlands, I also see no reason to start such an investigation.
Omdat er geen concrete aanwijzingen zijn dat dergelijke praktijken zich in Nederland voordoen zie ik ook geen aanleiding om een dergelijk onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Jacobi over de financiering van grote sportevenementen

MPs Van Dekken and Jacobi asked whether the First European Sport for All Games 2014 in Friesland, which TAFISA Nederland requested, could count as a major event for the Olympic 2028 bid and why it is excluded from federal co-funding. Minister Schippers answered that the event is a first edition with no reliable data yet, that it fits the Olympic Plan's grassroots goals but not the top-sport criteria, and that the existing events policy applies until a new cabinet decides.
I have not yet published the development of a new framework for the events policy.
Ik heb de ontwikkeling van een nieuw kader voor het evenementenbeleid (nog) niet uitgebracht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijksma en Van Dekken over het tentenkamp in Ter Apel

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister to respond to calls from Groningen provincial parties to house the asylum seekers in the Ter Apel tent camp, questioning a ban on beds and chairs, medical conditions and whose interests the situation serves. The minister maintained that rejected asylum seekers must return, that the camp situation is untenable for all parties, and that he offered alternative shelter which was refused, while promising to reach agreements with the mayor and protesters.
It is my responsibility to act unambiguously, and to continue to act, towards aliens whose asylum procedures have been concluded.
Het is mijn verantwoordelijkheid om eenduidig te handelen, en te blijven handelen, richting vreemdelingen die uitgeprocedeerd zijn.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Marcouch over homo-acceptatie in het voetbal

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether homo-acceptance in football needs an active action plan, whether the Netherlands lags Germany and England, and whether a national John Blankenstein prize should be introduced. The minister answered that existing measures (the safer sport action plan and the Gay Straight Alliance) suffice, declined to draw up a new football-specific plan, and left initiatives such as a prize to the sports parties themselves.
No, the effort described above is comprehensive and already takes the lead in keeping sport enjoyable for everyone regardless of sexual orientation and countering aggression.
Nee, de hierboven beschreven inzet is veelomvattend en neemt al het voortouw om sport voor iedereen ongeacht geaardheid leuk te houden en agressie tegen te gaan.
Antwoord vragen Bruins Slot en Van Dekken over EU-miljarden naar topclubs

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Dekken asked the health and sport minister about EU-backed bailouts of Spanish football clubs, including debt forgiveness, and related EU and UEFA financial fair play rules. The minister agreed that such debt forgiveness is undesirable, noted UEFA and European Commission cooperation on fair play and state aid rules, and said ECB lending decisions are for individual banks and fall outside her remit.
When granting financial support to professional football organisations, national and local governments in the EU must comply with the state aid rules.
Bij het verlenen van financiële steun aan betaaldvoetbalorganisaties (bvo's) moeten de nationale en lokale overheden in de EU zich houden aan de staatssteunregels.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over der artikelen “De Alpenzwendel. In het spoor van de voetbalmaffia”en “Enveloppen in Huis ter duin. Talloze lijntjes lopen naar Nederland”en matchfixing

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked whether Dutch police and prosecutors had contact with German authorities about match-fixing, whether Interpol and Dutch participation in anti-match-fixing cooperation were adequate, and whether new legislation was needed. The government answered that only a 2009 German mutual legal assistance request concerned a Dutch national, that no Dutch criminal offences were found, that existing criminal law (art. 328ter) suffices, and that prevention is mainly the responsibility of the Dutch football sector and KNVB.
For tackling criminal conduct related to match fixing in our country, the national criminal law system is sufficient.
Voor de aanpak van criminele gedragingen gerelateerd aan match fixing in ons land volstaat het nationale strafrechtelijke stelsel.
Antwoord vragen Bruins Slot en Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Enveloppen in Huis ter Duin. Talloze lijntjes Duitse gokmaffia lopen naar Nederland’

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Dekken asked whether the government will act on reports of Dutch involvement in match fixing and bribery in international football. The minister answers that the sports sector is primarily responsible, that no Dutch criminal offences have been identified so far, and that the government will share knowledge and support prevention at national and EU level.
The sports world is primarily responsible for the integrity of sport and gives substance to this itself.
De sportwereld is primair verantwoordelijk voor de integriteit van de sport en geeft daar ook invulling aan.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Çelik over het verlies van werkgelegenheid in het primair onderwijs als gevolg van daling van leerlingaantallen in het hele land.

MPs Van Dekken and Çelik asked the education minister about job losses in primary education caused by falling pupil numbers, including a union estimate of up to 4,500 dismissals and the effects of cuts to inclusive education. The minister answered that natural teacher outflow largely offsets the decline, that cuts to passend onderwijs will remove about 4,987 fte, and that measures such as longer bekostiging periods and experiments are planned for shrinking regions.
Due to a declining number of pupils, fewer teachers are needed.
Door een dalend aantal leerlingen zijn er minder leraren nodig.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over omkoping en bedrog in het internationale voetbal

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked ministers about match-fixing and betting-syndicate involvement in international football, including risks to Dutch youth players and whether the Dutch authorities acted after German arrests. The minister said the Dutch federation KNVB leads prevention, that no Dutch cases of youth players being approached are known, and that the German case produced no Dutch investigation, while the government will join Council of Europe negotiations on a match-fixing convention.
First and foremost, sport is in the lead and is doing a great deal on this front with various preventive measures.
Eerst en vooral is de sport aan zet en die zetten hier fors op in met verschillende preventieve maatregelen.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het gebruik van bont van wasbeerhondjes in nep-Uggs (ingezonden 7 november 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether counterfeit Uggs made with raccoon dog fur were on the Dutch market and whether measures would be taken against them. The minister could not confirm the scale, pointed to customs seizures and brand-owner tools, and said no additional measures were planned because enforcement does not distinguish by fur type.
I do not intend to take other measures to combat counterfeiting.
Ik ben niet voornemens om andere maatregelen ter bestrijding van namaak te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Van Dekken over een internationale aanpak van voetbalhooligans

MPs Marcouch and Van Dekken asked whether an international approach to football hooliganism exists, whether an international combined-ticket scheme should be introduced, and whether municipalities should be compensated for extra costs. Minister Opstelten answered that EU cooperation and information exchange already exist, that a combined-ticket scheme is impractical, that police deployment figures are given, and that municipalities remain responsible and need no compensation.
Maintaining public order remains the responsibility of mayors under article 172 of the Municipalities Act.
De handhaving van de openbare orde is en blijft een verantwoordelijkheid van de burgemeesters ingevolge artikel 172 van de Gemeentewet.
Antwoord vragen van Van Dekken en Jadnanansing over de langstudeerdersboete voor studerende topsporters.

MPs Van Dekken and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary about the long-study fee's effect on student top athletes, who are often abroad and may fall behind in their studies. The state secretary rejected the concerns, pointing to extra study years, a profileringsfonds for exceptional cases, and institutional top-athlete schemes, and denied that the measure threatens Dutch sporting ambitions.
I am of the view that the number of exceptions to the long-study measure must be very limited.
Ik ben van mening dat het aantal uitzonderingen op de langstudeerdersmaatregel zeer beperkt moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Recourt en Marcouch over het strafrechtelijk afkopen van vervolging na het lastigvallen en bedreigen van een scheidsrechter

MPs asked why three men who harassed and threatened a referee received a 210 euro settlement offer roughly ten months after the incident, and how this fits the government's tough approach to football violence. The minister replied that evidence was insufficient for harassment and threats, that the suspects were offered a 210 euro transaction for theft in association, and that the delay stemmed from further investigation needed after the first report.
For this offence, in line with the applicable guidelines, the Public Prosecution Service offered each of the suspects a transaction proposal of 210 euros.
Het OM heeft voor dit feit – overeenkomstig de daarvoor geldende richtlijnen – aan ieder van de verdachten een transactievoorstel van € 210,– aangeboden.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over matchfixing en het verkopen van de voetbalwedstrijden

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked the ministers about match-fixing in football, criminal bookmakers' influence, and whether the KNVB's concerns warrant investigation. The minister answered that data is insufficient to judge the scale, that the sports sector and betting operators bear primary responsibility for prevention, and that existing criminal law suffices, with no concrete information yet of bribery in the Netherlands.
I do not have hard research data indicating how large the influence of criminal bookmakers in football is.
Ik beschik niet over harde onderzoeksgegevens die aangeven hoe groot de invloed is van criminele gokbazen in het voetbal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grashoff en Van Dekken over de bouw van een megastal bij Vlagtwedde

MPs Grashoff and Van Dekken asked the state secretary about a planned 1,000-cow dairy farm with 800 young cattle near Vlagtwedde, the size relative to a 300 livestock-unit ceiling, whether cows should be kept outdoors, and whether a special law would be needed to prevent such mega-farms. The secretary confirmed the plan, said spatial planning lies mainly with provinces and municipalities, and promised to set a size limit through a forthcoming bill and urge no irreversible steps before the Health Council advice.
Given this trend of large-scale development, I will intervene on the basis of the bill in preparation and set a limit.
Bij deze trend van grootschalige ontwikkeling zal ik op basis van het in voorbereiding zijnde wetsvoorstel ingrijpen en een grens stellen.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Van der Veen over de voorgenomen concentratie van Sanquin en het daardoor dreigende banenverlies

MPs Van Dekken and Van der Veen asked the health minister about Sanquin's planned concentration of activities in Amsterdam and Nijmegen, which would reduce its Groningen blood bank and cost jobs there. The minister said the reorganisation was only tested on safety, efficiency and quality rather than employment, that it aims to save costs, that a social plan is under discussion, and that Groningen will keep key functions with no negative service effects.
A reorganisation plan is not tested by me on operational aspects such as employment.
Een voornemen tot reorganisatie wordt door mij niet getoetst op bedrijfsvoeringsaspecten, zoals werkgelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi en Van Dekken over het hoogwater in Woltersum en andere plaatsen in de de provincies Groningen en Friesland en de roep om de aanleg van een extra gemaal in Lauwersoog

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary why flood-defence weaknesses on the Eemskanaal dike at Woltersum were not fixed earlier, how long reinforcement will take, why the FUGRO report was not accessible, and whether a new pumping station at Lauwersoog will be built. The state secretary replied that the regional water boards are responsible, that work is underway with completion targets, that the FUGRO report is now public, and that the regional water manager decides on the Lauwersoog pumping station.
This is a responsibility of the regional flood defence managers, the water boards Fryslân and Noorderzijlvest.
Dit is een verantwoordelijkheid van de regionale waterkeringbeheerders, de waterschappen Fryslân en Noorderzijlvest.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Van Dekken over de financiële situatie van de Koninklijke Nederlandse Doven Sport Bond

MPs Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the financial position of the Dutch deaf sports federation KNDSB, its membership of NOC*NSF, earmarked funding for deaf sport, exclusion from the Paralympics, and a meeting with the federation. The minister said the KNDSB does not yet meet NOC*NSF membership criteria and that earmarking is partly done via Special Heroes, but declined to earmark budget for deaf sport or to meet the federation, since government policy favours integration into regular sports federations.
For that reason I see no need to enter into discussion with the KNSDB.
Om die reden zie ik geen noodzaak om in gesprek te gaan met de KNSDB.

Vagen van de leden Van Dekken, Jacobi en Van der Veen (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verdwijnen van spoedeisende hulp in het

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Health about the closure of three emergency and maternity departments at the Sionsberg hospital in Dokkum and the regional opposition to it. The government answered that regional access to acute care is secured within 45 minutes through extra ambulance capacity and a helicopter arrangement, that other hospitals can serve the region, and that a hospital availability allowance for 2012 is conditional on an adequate plan.
With these measures, the accessibility of acute care in the region within 45 minutes is secured.
Met deze maatregelen is de bereikbaarheid van de acute zorg in de regio binnen 45 minuten geborgd.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Van Dekken over de vertraging en het nut van een Nationaal Noodnet voor communicatie bij rampen

Marcouch and Van Dekken (PvdA) asked why the Nationaal Noodnet replacement for disaster communication is delayed and whether it is useful. Minister Opstelten answered that migration to the NCV is slower than expected because users are reconsidering, the old network still functions, the NCV has extra functions, and the government will not terminate the KPN contract.

In line with the commitment made during the consultation of 8 February 2012 on the amendment of the Safety Regions Act, I will inform the House further about the management, monitoring and execution of various ICT projects.

Conform de toezegging tijdens het overleg van 8 februari 2012 inzake de wijziging van wet Veiligheidsregio's, in verband met de oprichting van het Instituut Fysieke Veiligheid, zal ik u de Tweede Kamer nader informeren over het beheer de monitoring en de uitvoering van verschillende ICT-projecten.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Recourt en Marcouch (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over «doorgesnoven» en «ladderzatte» hooligans die de benefietwedstrij

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers why about 100 Feyenoord hooligans, some under stadium bans, attended and allegedly disrupted a charity match in Spakenburg and why the riot police were not deployed earlier, and whether the Football Act should bar banned fans from friendly matches. Minister Opstelten answered that the group left without disrupting the event, police lacked validated prior information, the ME was only kept on standby, the Wmbveo already offers tools such as area bans and that the law is being evaluated early, and the club can recover its own damage.
This is also the conclusion from the press release of VV IJsselmeervogels of 12 January 2012.
Dit is ook de conclusie uit de persverklaring van de VV IJsselmeervogels van 12 januari 2012

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het beëindigen van de samenwerking van de anti-corruptiewaakhond Transparency International (TI) met d

MPs Van Dekken and Timmermans asked the health minister about Transparency International ending its cooperation with FIFA and not being admitted to an anti-corruption panel. The minister replied that FIFA is a private Swiss body outside her responsibility, that TI withdrew voluntarily, and that she will not raise the issue internationally, though she pursued an EU expert group on sports governance.
I see no role for myself in this.
Ik zie hier geen rol voor mijzelf in weggelegd.

Vragen van de leden Monasch en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de bezuinigingen bij de Friese woningbouwcorporatie Elkien (ingezonden 15 december 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister of Interior about cuts at housing corporation Elkien, which plans to withdraw from small rural villages due to the proposed levy on housing corporations, and whether this harms the krimp policy and whether talks with corporations and Aedes will follow. The minister answered that Elkien's strategy is a responsible, demographically based choice with a village-visioning project, that the effects are largely compensated nationally, that regional and provincial parties share responsibility, and that talks with several corporations and SEV have already taken place.
Elkien's policy regarding small villages generally fits well with my policy on shrinking areas.
Het beleid van Elkien inzake de kleine kernen verdraagt zich over het algemeen goed met mijn beleid inzake de krimpgebieden.
Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over voetbalrellen in Utrecht (ingezonden 7 december 2011).

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about football riots in Utrecht, the responsibility of supporters, information exchange between police forces, national handling of football violence, and whether the Football Act should be tightened. The minister said the investigation is ongoing, described the existing information-sharing system, defended regional policing of football violence, and announced an early evaluation of the football violence act including area bans and penalties.
I consider it desirable that all police forces take part in the Hooligans in Beeld programme and I will address them on this.
Ik vind het wenselijk dat alle korpsen deel nemen aan het programma Hooligans in Beeld en zal hen hier op aanspreken.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi, Van Dekken en Wolbert (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over meerdere gevallen van vergiftiging roofdieren door malafide jagers (ingezonden 15 n

Three PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about poisonings of predators by unlawful hunters, the penalties involved, the lack of national registration, the role of Staatsbosbeheer and whether a temporary hunting ban in Drenthe would be imposed. The state secretary said the Flora- and faunawet provides enforcement powers and hunting licences can be withdrawn, but could not give a complete figure of cases because there is no national registration, and he rejected a hunting ban.
Because there is no national registration, I am currently examining the possibilities of having all suspected dead animals sent to the Central Veterinary Institute (CVI).
Vanwege het ontbreken van een landelijke registratie bezie ik momenteel de mogelijkheden om alle verdachte dode dieren te laten opsturen naar het Central Veterinary Institute (CVI).

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat bewoners van krimpregio’s minder gezond zijn dan bewoners elders in Nederland (in

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about RIVM findings that residents of shrinking regions rate their health lower and have lower life expectancy and higher cardiovascular mortality. The minister answered that the study is a first exploration, that socioeconomic differences explain part of the gap, that a follow-up study was requested, and pointed to existing krimp experiments and convenants with provinces.
The study is a first exploration of the health situation in shrinking regions in the Netherlands.
Het onderzoek is een eerste verkenning van de gezondheidssituatie in krimpregio's in Nederland.
Vragen van de leden Spekman en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de onderbetaling van schoonmakers bij O2G2 in Groningen (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

Two MPs from the Labour party asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that cleaners at a Groningen company were underpaid and whether the Labour Inspectorate would investigate, and whether the government would set up a collective labour agreement enforcement authority. The minister answered that compliance with collective agreements is a matter for the social partners, that the Inspectorate acts only on a well-founded suspicion requested by the parties, and that the government sees no reason to create a new enforcement authority.
It is not up to the Labour Inspectorate to actively investigate this.
Het is niet aan de Arbeidsinspectie om dit actief te onderzoeken.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de exorbitante vergoedingen aan toezichthouders bij de KNVB (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether KNVB supervisory board members receive excessive fees, including a fixed fee for meetings and free trips, and whether these exceed pay at other supervisory bodies. The minister answers that VWS has no formal role because the KNVB is autonomous and not part of the public or semi-public sector, so she cannot intervene in the board's fees, though the annual report is published.
The KNVB is therefore autonomous in setting the fees of employees and supervisory board members.
De KNVB is dus autonoom in het vaststellen van vergoedingen van medewerkers en toezichthouders.
Vragen van de leden Klijnsma en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de omzet en de rol van poppodia (ingezonden 28 oktober 2011).

Two MPs asked the state secretary about a report that pop venues had fewer visitors but higher revenue, and whether higher ticket prices hurt accessibility, quality and jobs. The secretary said he cannot judge accessibility from this information, that programming is the venues' own responsibility, and that job losses are not known because venues are mainly funded by municipalities.
Because pop venues in the Netherlands are generally subsidised by municipalities and not by the central government, these figures are not known to my ministry.
Omdat poppodia in Nederland over het algemeen gesubsidieerd worden door gemeenten en niet door de rijksoverheid, zijn deze cijfers niet bekend bij mijn ministerie.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het matige enthousiasme onder Amsterdammers over de Olympische Ambitie (ingezonden 13 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about weak public support in Amsterdam for an Olympic bid for 2028, the expected costs of preparing a bid, and sport promotion as part of the Olympic ambition. The minister declined to judge the poll results for now, gave only a partial cost figure (2 million euro reserved from 2012, larger commitments not before 2016), and agreed that sport and exercise promotion matters, pointing to a forthcoming policy framework.
A complete overview of the costs the government will incur in the coming years cannot be given to you now.
Een volledig overzicht van de te maken kosten die de overheid de komende jaren gaat maken kan ik u nu niet geven.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de reactie van OM en politie op rellen door Feyenoordhooligans (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Van Dekken asked the Justice minister why two suspects in the Feyenoord stadium riot were released with summonses before their role was found to be larger, whether they can be re-detained, and whether lifetime stadium bans should be introduced. The minister said both suspects were later taken into custody, one detention was suspended, the prosecution is investigating actively, and he will await the 2012 evaluation of the football violence law before changing it.
Since the criminal investigation into the suspects is still in full swing, I cannot provide any further information at this time.
Aangezien het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar de verdachten nog in volle gang is, kan ik op dit moment geen verdere mededelingen doen.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het alleen inzetten van «animalcops» voor huisdieren (ingezonden 7 o

MPs Kuiken and Van Dekken asked whether the 500 animal cops (dierenpolitie) would be deployed only for pet abuse and not for agricultural animals, and questioned whether this justified such capacity given other priorities. The minister replied that the dierenpolitie focuses mainly on animal abuse and neglect, that inspectorates keep responsibility for farm animals, and that police capacity covers all national priorities with monitoring planned.
On 24 October I sent your House the dierenpolitie memorandum, the animal enforcement cooperation covenant and the animal assistance covenant.
Op 24 oktober zond ik uw Kamer de nota dierenpolitie, het convenant samenwerking dierenhandhaving en het convenant dierenhulpverlening.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de vervuilde en levenloze rivier de Eems (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

MPs Jacobi and Van Dekken ask the state secretary about the polluted, lifeless Ems river, the delay in a recovery plan promised four years earlier, its timing, consultation with Germany, and whether economic activity is being weighed against ecology after Council of State rulings. The state secretary answers that a joint Dutch-German management plan is being worked on for completion around 2013, the plan covers conservation goals rather than an economic outlook, and both economy and ecology are weighed under the existing framework.
The intention is that the IMP for the Ems-Dollard will be adopted in 2013 and that the Natura 2000 management plan with concrete measures for this area will be ready in 2015.
Het is de bedoeling dat in 2013 het IMP voor de Eems-Dollard wordt vastgesteld en dat in 2015 het beheerplan Natura 2000 met de concrete maatregelen voor dit gebied gereed is.
Vragen van de leden Van Dekken , Çelik en Jadnanansing (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een diplomatruc voor gezakte leerlingen (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

MPs asked the education minister why the Inspectorate's investigation into a school's diploma trick for failing pupils was not finished and why she would not announce a law change now. The minister replied that the Inspectorate needed time after the holidays for hearing and counter-hearing, and that she can only judge whether to amend rules once the findings are known.

As I indicated in answer 4 to the previously mentioned parliamentary questions, I can only assess whether and how laws and regulations should be amended on the basis of the outcome of the Inspectorate's investigation.

Zoals ik in antwoord 4 van de reeds eerder genoemde Kamervragen heb aangegeven kan ik pas op basis van de uitkomst van het onderzoek van de Inspectie beoordelen of en op welke wijze wet- en regelgeving moet worden aangepast.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over voetbalclubs die kleuters scouten en willen opleiden (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about football clubs scouting and wanting to train very young children (under 7), and whether KNVB rules should change. The minister said the KNVB and she believe children should stay in their familiar environment, that the KNVB is still deliberating and she awaits its outcome, and that clubs and parents bear primary responsibility for supervision.
I want to await the outcomes of that discussion and deliberation within the KNVB.
Ik wil de uitkomsten van die discussie en beraad binnen de KNVB afwachten.
Vragen van de leden Çelik en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over gevolgen wijziging beleid achterstandsleerlingen (ingezonden 15 september 2011).

Two MPs asked the education minister why rural schools gained little from the 2006 change in the weighted funding scheme for disadvantaged pupils and whether pupil disadvantage has fallen or risen in rural areas. The minister attributed the limited gains to rising parental education levels and a higher funding threshold chosen to avoid spreading money too thinly, and said the plan 'Basis voor presteren' and targeted extra funding for the big cities address the wider problem.
The simplification succeeded and the shift of funds was limited.
De vereenvoudiging is gelukt en de verschuiving van middelen was beperkt.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het aanbieden van schijncontracten aan jonge

MPs Van Dekken and Spekman asked whether football clubs placing young players on payroll as fictitious occupations such as crane operator, via a temp agency, is acceptable and how contracts could better reflect players' real positions. The minister replied that Vitesse denies misregistration, that the temp-agency construction is not contrary to KNVB rules or law, and that regulating it is mainly the sector's responsibility, to be clarified in consultation with KNVB and player organisations.
I consider this mainly a responsibility of the sector itself, i.e. the KNVB and the clubs.
Ik vind dit vooral een verantwoordelijkheid van de sector zelf, i.c. de KNVB en de clubs.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Plasterk (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Financiën over het bericht dat banken nog te weinig doen aan misstanden bij

MPs Van Dekken and Plasterk asked whether banks, as financiers, can and should push for more animal-friendly pig farming after a report that banks do too little about abuses, and whether the minister will engage the banking sector. The state secretary acknowledged banks' social responsibility, pointed to the Eerlijke Bankwijzer dialogue, and said existing talks via the Uitvoeringsagenda Duurzame Veehouderij will address the findings.
Through the Uitvoeringsagenda Duurzame Veehouderij (UDV) I am already in discussion with the banking sector.
Via de Uitvoeringsagenda Duurzame Veehouderij (UDV) ben ik al in gesprek met het bankwezen.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) en Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de aanhoudende meldingen van misstanden bij diertransporten (ingezonden 22

MPs Thieme and Van Dekken asked the state secretary about reported animal welfare abuses on livestock transports by Keus en Mollink, including whether the company's licence should be revoked and whether oversight of transports should return to government hands. The state secretary said the company received a EUR 1,500 administrative fine, that the Hungarian authority certified the transport, that licence suspension was not warranted, and that details on the animal police would follow in October 2011.
On 29 June 2011 the nVWA imposed an administrative fine of EUR 1,500 on the company for not carrying out the transport of these cattle to their destination without delay.
De nVWA heeft op 29 juni 2011 het bedrijf een bestuurlijke boete van € 1 500 opgelegd wegens het niet zonder oponthoud uitvoeren van het transport van deze runderen naar de plaats van bestemming.

Vragen van de leden Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) en Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over pluimveehouders die de komende tien jaar nog snavels van kippen en kalkoen

MPs Thieme and Van Dekken asked why the state secretary extended for ten years the exemption allowing beak trimming and other procedures on poultry, despite the 2001 ban, and whether the sector would be forced to comply. The secretary defended the extension as necessary to prevent feather pecking, reported no enforcement problems, and declined to add enforcement measures or levies, pointing to ongoing research and a plan of action.
The period during which a number of procedures remain permitted originally expired on 1 September 2011 and has been extended by 10 years.
De periode waarbinnen een aantal ingrepen nog is toegestaan liep oorspronkelijk af op 1 september 2011 en is verlengd met 10 jaar.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het lage rendement van de opleiding tot profvoetballer (ingezonden 9 augustus 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the health and sport minister about the low success rate of youth football academies, the age at which children are recruited, effects on schooling, addiction among former players, and whether clubs and the KNVB bear responsibility for supporting dropouts. The minister answered that the KNVB's quality mark and protocols provide aftercare, that academies start at age 11, that no data exist on schooling or addiction outcomes, and that clubs and the KNVB already recognise their responsibility, so no specific agreements are needed.
Against this background I see no reason to make specific agreements with the KNVB in this area.
Ik zie tegen deze achtergrond dan ook geen aanleiding om op dit terrein specifieke afspraken te gaan maken met de KNVB.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de handel in jonge spelers (ingezonden 27 juli 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether clubs sign contracts with footballers under 16, whether this is lawful and protects young players, and whether the government will press for stricter rules on child trade in football. The minister replied that such contracts are legally permissible with parental co-signature, that the KNVB has tightened supervision, and that the government sees the problem as one for the parties involved rather than for national government.
Responsibility for this does not lie with the national government.
De verantwoordelijkheid hiervoor ligt niet bij de rijksoverheid.
