Vragen van de leden Recourt en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat Groningse advocaten zouden frauderen met overheidsgeld (ingezonden 17 augustus 2011).

MPs Recourt and Van Dekken asked the state secretary whether Groningen lawyers defrauded legal aid funds, how it happened, and what action followed. The secretary confirmed two lawyers circumvented the 250-unit cap, roughly 450 files were affected, a criminal complaint and disciplinary complaint were filed, and recovery of an estimated 300,000 to 400,000 euros is underway.
The Council will reclaim the wrongly granted allowances from both lawyers.
De Raad zal de ten onrechte verstrekte vergoedingen terugvorderen van beide advocaten.
Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over overlast van de KLM Luchtvaart School op vliegveld Eelde (ingezonden 6 juli 2011).

MPs Dijksma and Van Dekken asked the state secretary about noise nuisance from KLM Luchtvaart School training aircraft at Eelde airport, and whether its economic importance justifies this, plus why older aircraft are used and what will be done. The state secretary answered that the airport operator has operational agreements with flight schools that keep the airport within its permitted noise space, that the government has no competence to review school plans or fleet choices, and that the airport is trying to reduce avoidable noise through pricing incentives.
In doing so, no actual exceedances have been found in recent years.
Daarbij zijn de afgelopen jaren geen feitelijke overschrijdingen geconstateerd.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat 170 000 kippen zijn omgekomen bij een brand (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

Two MPs asked the state secretary whether the fire killing 170,000 chickens shows that stable fire safety must improve, whether the fire brigade's approach will be followed, which rules will change, and whether the promised action plan will be sent to parliament by September 2011. The state secretary agreed more must be done, said an action plan on stable fire prevention is being finalised with stakeholders, and promised to inform parliament by letter shortly and send the plan soon after.
I expect to be able to send you the action plan soon afterwards.
Het plan van aanpak verwacht ik vervolgens snel aan u toe te kunnen zenden.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over stelselmatige onderbetaling van bouwvakkers bij de Nuon-centrale in de Eemshaven (ingezonden 24 ju

MPs Spekman and Van Dekken asked the state secretary whether the Labour Inspectorate knows about systematic underpayment of construction workers by staffing agencies at the Nuon power plant in Eemshaven, what action it takes, and whether fines are effective. The minister replied that no Wml violations were found, that the matter concerns collective agreement compliance for social partners, and that the Inspectorate's enforcement will be strengthened through higher fines, risk-based inspections and information sharing.
It is up to the social partners to ensure proper compliance and enforcement.
Het is daarbij aan sociale partners om zorg te dragen voor de juiste naleving en handhaving.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat Poolse chauffeurs via nepbedrijven worden ingezet op Nederlandse trajecten (ingezonden 7 j

MPs Spekman and Van Dekken asked the minister whether Polish drivers are used through fake foreign companies to undercut Dutch wages and working conditions, and what can be done. The minister replied that Dutch minimum wage and the sector CAO apply to posted drivers, cited a Roermond court ruling against a transport firm, said no data exist on driver numbers, and pointed to the social partners and the Labour Inspectorate for enforcement.
There is no data on the number of foreign drivers employed by Dutch companies.
Er zijn geen gegevens over het aantal buitenlandse chauffeurs in dienst van Nederlandse bedrijven.

Vragen van de leden Dijkstra (D66) en Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ondeugdelijke kostenramingen WK 2018 en verkeerd informeren van de Kamer (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

MPs Dijkstra and Van Dekken asked the health minister why the Chamber was told the 2018 World Cup would cost at most 300 million euros in fiscal guarantees and police costs of 200 million, when officials had estimated more, and about a planned evaluation. The minister denied the reporting, said estimates were uncertain and communicated with caveats, and promised an evaluation report in September.
The Chamber has consistently been informed of the insights the cabinet had, noting the uncertainties inherent in estimates.
Er is consequent aan de Kamer meegedeeld over welke inzichten het kabinet beschikte onder vermelding van de onzekerheden die nu eenmaal inherent zijn aan schattingen.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het levenslang schorsen door de KNVB van een scheidsrechter. (ingezonden 25 mei 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether the KNVB lifelong-suspended a referee for criticising a disciplinary committee ruling, and whether this violates his freedom of expression. The minister answered that the referee was not suspended for life or struck off, but that the KNVB decided not to deploy him in KNVB matches this season, which it considers a matter for the football association's own disciplinary system.
A well-functioning disciplinary system is the responsibility of a sports federation.
Een goed functionerend tuchtrechtsysteem is de verantwoordelijkheid van een sportbond.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het terugdringen van de Combi-regeling en het verminderen van de politie-inzet bij voetbalwedstrijden (i

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked whether agreements had been made nationally to reduce the Combi-regeling and police deployment at football matches, and about the role of the health minister and the 'Nieuw beleidskader voetbal en veiligheid'. The government confirmed that national partners agreed to reduce combi-cards and that the framework would be sent to parliament, while stating that the health ministry plays only a limited role and that supporter demands on kick-off times and stadium bans are for clubs and local actors rather than the minister to examine.
The framework for policy will be sent to your House this week.
Het kader voor beleid zal deze week aan uw Kamer worden toegezonden.

Vragen van de leden Arib en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over illegale handel in antibiotica (ingezond

MPs Arib and Van Dekken asked the ministers about illegal trade in antibiotics, its health consequences, the scale of the trade, and why Denmark's separation of prescribing and sales is not adopted. The state secretary answered that risks exist, that the nVWA will intensify inspections, that sector reduction agreements are in place with a threat of decoupling if not met, and listed prior advisory reports.
The scale of the illegal trade in unregistered veterinary medicines is not known.
De omvang van de illegale handel in niet-geregistreerde diergeneesmiddelen is niet bekend.

Vragen van het lid Van Dekken en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het artikel «KNVB gaat vechtende speler harder straffen» (ingezonden 18 maa

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked whether violence on football pitches (brawls, attacks on referees) is rising, whether criminal prosecution should complement KNVB sanctions, and whether reporting such incidents should be encouraged. The ministers answered that roughly 25-30 incidents occur per weekend among about 32,500 matches, that incidents are not treated differently from comparable violence off the pitch, that the KNVB requires reporting to police, and that an action plan on safer sport addresses the issue.
On what scale prosecution follows a report of a (violent) incident inside or outside a playing situation on a football pitch is not known.
Op welke schaal vervolging plaatsvindt na het doen van een aangifte van een (gewelds)incident binnen of buiten een spelsituatie op een voetbalveld, is niet bekend.
Vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Spekman (beiden PvdA) en Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over buitenlandse werknemers bij RWE (ingezonden 5 april 2011).

MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported abuses of foreign workers at RWE's Eemshaven power plant site, including long hours, unsafe conditions, unclear contracts, accidents and underpaid Polish workers, and whether inspections and fines occurred and whether the labour inspectorate should be expanded. The minister answered that the inspectorate inspects roughly weekly, recorded 47 enforcement actions, issued fines, investigated accidents and found no underpayment so far, and judged inspection capacity adequate.
The Labour Inspectorate actively supervises compliance with laws and regulations at RWE's energy plant under construction in the Eemshaven.
De Arbeidsinspectie houdt actief toezicht op de naleving van de wet- en regelgeving bij de in aanbouw zijnde energiecentrale van RWE in de Eemshaven.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minster van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de slechte positie van het vrouwenvoetbal in Nederland (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about the poor position of women's football in the Netherlands, including clubs AZ, Willem II and FC Utrecht dropping women's teams and insufficient promotion. The minister answered that responsibility for elite women's football lies with clubs and the KNVB, that FC Utrecht reversed its decision, and that the minister does not intervene.
Responsibility for further developing women's football at the top level lies with the clubs and the KNVB. I do not want to, and cannot, intervene in that.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het verder ontwikkelen van het vrouwenvoetbal op hoog niveau ligt bij de clubs en de KNVB. Daar wil en kan ik niet in treden.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Plasterk (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financiën over de gedwongen winkelnering bij het kopen van tickets voor de Olympische Spelen in Londe

MPs Van Dekken and Plasterk asked whether requiring VISA credit cards for buying Olympic tickets on the London organiser's site was undesirable, whether it abused a monopoly position, and what action the government would take. The minister answered that the payment choice is the organiser's autonomous decision, that Dutch sales via ATP accept other payment methods so no one is forced to get a credit card, and that no action is planned because the responsibility lies with the organising committee.
That is an autonomous choice of this organisation.
Dat is een autonome keuze van deze organisatie.
Vragen van de leden Çelik en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschap over de kaalslag op de scholen in Noord Nederland (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

MPs Çelik and Van Dekken asked the education minister about the consequences of school shrinkage in northern Netherlands, including projected job losses, higher costs of small schools, funding, teacher workload and inspection assessment. The minister answered that shrinkage requires timely regional measures, that job losses are expected but not necessarily forced dismissals, that small schools are compensated through funding instruments, and that the inspectorate judges schools only on quality.
The research will be concluded shortly.

Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het vrijgeven van de voetbal makelaarsmarkt en de gevolgen die dit heeft voor jonge talenten (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether the liberalisation of the football agent market by FIFA endangers young players under 16, and whether current rules protect them and whether new measures are planned. The minister replied that the KNVB agent rules already bar agents from acting for under-16s, that enforcement relies on complaints, and that no new legal or other measures are planned because the matter is largely for self-regulation and the public authorities act only on crimes, tax evasion, labour law or free movement breaches.
In view of the above, I am not considering introducing any new legal or other measures.
Gelet op het bovenstaande overweeg ik geen nieuwe wettelijke of andere maatregelen in te stellen.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de misstanden in de voetbalspelersmakelaarswereld (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about alleged abuses in football agent transfers, including suspected club kickbacks, youth transfers resembling child trafficking, and whether EU-level rules are needed. The minister replies that transfer fees are not kickbacks, the KNVB has an integrity unit investigating two agents, Dutch law applies, and the Commission favours self-regulation with a conference planned for late 2011.
The KNVB does not have access to the international figures on youth transfers.
De KNVB heeft niet de beschikking over de internationale cijfers inzake jeugdtransfers.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de strenge regels die gesteld worden aan bezoekers van voetbalwedstrijden (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the minister about strict rules for football visitors, including a mandatory car-combi ticket in Heerenveen, reports that stadium bans are being overturned by courts, and a new anti-hooliganism approach. The minister answered that the transport measure is a local mayoral decision based on prior incidents, that the KNVB reported only seven court losses in two seasons on stadium bans, and that a Veiligheid en Justitie policy framework and a sports action plan are in preparation.
The Ministry of Security and Justice is working with representatives from the national football and safety steering group on a renewed policy framework titled Football and Safety.
Het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie werkt samen met de vertegenwoordigers uit de landelijke regiegroep voetbal en veiligheid aan een vernieuwd beleids-kader, getiteld Voetbal en Veiligheid.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de aanpak van leegstaande kantoorruimte (ingezonden 13 januari 2

Two MPs asked ministers about the action programme on vacant office space following a May 2010 summit, its status, whether it would be sent to parliament, possible fiscal measures, temporary reuse, and whether government should take the lead. The ministers replied that the programme is ready awaiting formal approval and will be sent to parliament, that the market leads with government providing a platform and removing regulatory barriers.
The action programme is ready and awaits approval by the decision-making bodies of the various organisations. At the end of February the Action Programme will be sent to your House.
Het actieprogramma is gereed en ligt ter goedkeuring bij de besluitvormende organen van de verschillende organisaties. Eind februari wordt het Actieprogramma aan uw Kamer aangeboden.
Vragen van de leden Monasch en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over verplichte winterbanden voor professioneel personenvervoer (ingezonden 10 december 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment why most school, disabled-transport and regional taxi vehicles in the North lack winter tyres, whether the operator may define 'safe', and whether winter tyres should be mandatory. The minister answered that winter tyres are strongly recommended but contracting authorities and operators bear responsibility, and that she opposes making them mandatory.

My policy is not to make winter tyres mandatory, but to put the own responsibility of road users and clients of professional passenger transport first and to strongly advise them to use (or have) winter tyres.

Mijn beleid is om winterbanden niet verplicht te stellen, maar de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van weggebruikers en opdrachtgevers van professioneel personenvervoer voorop te stellen en hen sterk aan te raden winterbanden te (laten) gebruiken.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de maatschappelijke kosten en effecten van de wetgeving tegen langstudeerders (ingezonden 16

MPs Jadnanansing and Van Dekken asked the state secretary whether the costs and societal effects of penalising long-term students were overstated, and whether students and parents would be informed quickly and exceptions made for students with illness or disability. The state secretary rejected the view that societal costs are small, argued the measure fosters a more ambitious study culture, promised early information to students, and announced an extra study year for students with a functional limitation.
I consider it of great importance to inform students, parents and institutions in good time about the forthcoming legislative amendment.
Ik acht het van groot belang studenten, ouders en instellingen tijdig te informeren over de aanstaande wetswijziging.

Vragen van de leden Çelik en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over leerlingen die worden gedwongen te stoppen met hun opleiding vanwege een tekort aan leer-werkplekken (ingezo

Two MPs asked the education minister about roughly 350 vocational students in the north and Overijssel who risked being forced to quit their courses for lack of workplace-training places, and whether such students would be pushed into school-based tracks with little practical time. The minister replied that regional partners had found places for nearly all affected students, that schools keep students structured, and that the existing approach is effective.

From my answer to question 2 it appears to me that the current approach to shortages of workplace-training places – the Stage and Apprenticeship Offensive of the knowledge centres and the regional approach – is effective.
Uit mijn antwoord op vraag 2 blijkt mijns inziens dat de huidige aanpak van tekorten aan bpv-plaatsen – het Stage- en Leerbanenoffensief van de kenniscentra en de regionale aanpak – effectief is.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet voldoen aan aanvullende eisen van de FIFA (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010 2010).

An MP asked the health minister whether the government had rejected additional FIFA demands for the 2018 World Cup bid, why parliament was not informed earlier, and whether other rejected demands exist. The minister replied that FIFA set no demands beyond the government guarantees, only additional questions which were answered in a letter to parliament, and that no other demands exist.
FIFA has not set demands that go beyond the guarantees provided by the government.
De FIFA heeft geen eisen gesteld die aanvullend zijn op de door de overheid verstrekte garanties

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Arib (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de in Den Haag voorgestelde allochtonenstop voor het amateurvoetbal (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

MPs Van Dekken and Arib asked the health minister about a proposed temporary ban on ethnic minority (allochtone) members in Hague amateur football, asking whether it is discriminatory, its effect on youth participation, and what action the government will take on violence in clubs. The minister replied that the plan had been withdrawn, that the problem affects members of all backgrounds, that the government funds anti-violence and refereeing programmes, and that she will decide on further steps after reviewing their results.
The plan for a temporary ban on allochtone members in Hague amateur football, due partly to membership fee arrears, has now been withdrawn.
Het plan voor een tijdelijke allochtonenstop binnen het Haagse amateurvoetbal in verband met ondermeer contributieachterstanden is inmiddels ingetrokken.

Vragen van de leden van Dekken en Çelik (beiden PvdA) aan ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat tientallen scholen in Groningen dreigen te ve

PvdA MPs asked ministers of Education and Interior whether they were aware of reports that dozens of primary schools in Groningen might close, what the consequences would be, and what the Rijk would do. The minister replied that under statutory closure norms no dozens of schools will close in the short term, that on average two schools per year close in Groningen, that boards bear responsibility for school decisions, and that the Rijk will assist via pilots and the Krimpen met Kwaliteit action plan, with a progress report promised for spring 2011.
In spring 2011 the House of Representatives will be informed about the progress of the mentioned action plan.
In het voorjaar van 2011 zal de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd worden over de voortgang van het genoemde actieplan

Vragen van de leden Monasch, Van Dekken en Kuiken (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de brandveiligheid van veestallen (ingezo

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers about the 2010 report on barn fires, its high number of fires and animal deaths, and whether a fire-safety action plan and specific Bouwbesluit requirements would follow. The state secretary replied that he shares concern, that talks with the Dierenbescherming and LTO are ongoing, and that possible follow-up actions will be announced by year-end.
It is expected that you will be informed at the end of this year about possible follow-up actions that should contribute to better and more prevention of barn fires.
Naar verwachting zult u aan het einde van dit jaar worden geïnformeerd over de mogelijke vervolgacties die moeten bijdragen aan het meer en beter voorkomen van brand in stallen.
Vragen van de leden Samsom en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de mogelijkheden voor gasopslag bij Pieterburen (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

Two MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether EDF could obtain a permit for gas storage near Pieterburen, whether this conflicts with protection of ecological and landscape values, how long permit procedures take, and what economic effects would follow. The minister answered that only an exploration permit has been requested so far, outlined the three permit phases (exploration, extraction, storage) with objection and appeal routes, gave timelines of about two years for drilling and 6 to 12 months per permit, and cited an investment of half a billion euro and ten permanent jobs.
All the above-mentioned permits and the national coordination scheme provide for an objection and appeal phase.
Alle bovengenoemde vergunningen en de rijkscoördinatieregeling voorzien in een bezwaar- en beroepfase.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over toekomstige faillissementen van voetbalclubs (ingezonden 8 oktober 2010).

MP Van Dekken asked the health and sport minister about bankruptcies of professional football clubs, their effects on youth academies and grassroots sport, the impact of public broadcasting cuts, and what central government could do. The minister answered that clubs must manage responsibly, that youth training effects are expected to be limited, that broadcasting cuts would not affect clubs before 2013, and that central government has no role in securing youth sport.
The KNVB and the affiliated (amateur) clubs are well able to continue providing the football offering for young people.
De KNVB en de aangesloten (amateur)verenigingen zijn goed in staat voor het voetbalaanbod voor jongeren zorg te blijven dragen.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken , Marcouch en Van Dekken (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de recente brandstichtingen in religieuze gebouwen (ingezonden 30 septe

PvdA MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers about arson attacks on Moluccan churches and a mosque in Groningen, including the background, investigation priority, protection measures, and an action plan to defend freedom of religion. The minister replied that investigations are ongoing with high priority, that protection is the responsibility of local authorities under the existing security framework, that operational details are withheld for security reasons, and that a separate action plan is unnecessary.
The investigations are still in full swing and have high priority.
De onderzoeken zijn nog in volle gang en hebben hoge prioriteit.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken Integratie en de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris van Binn

Two PvdA MPs asked the housing minister and state secretary whether moving krachtwijken funds to shrinking regions was intended, and how much money is actually free to redirect. The government answered that it has always supported funds for both shrinking regions and problem neighbourhoods, that no money is unallocated, and that a review of the corporation levy exemption for shrinking regions is pending.
There is therefore no question of funds that are still unspent or for which no commitments have yet been made.
Er is dus geen sprake van middelen die nog over zijn of waar nog geen verplichtingen voor zijn aangegaan.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Samsom (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht dat de Groningse dijken niet voldoen aan de veiligheidseisen (ingezonden

MPs Van Dekken and Samsom asked whether reports that over a third of Groningen dikes fail safety standards are true, why the 2005 inspections did not reveal this, and whether the priority list of eight weak links must change. The minister explained the six-yearly assessment process culminating in the LRT 2011 report, attributed the expected failures to tougher 2006 hydraulic boundary conditions for Wadden Sea dikes, and stated that new information will not change the priority or sequence of the eight weak links.
The LRT report will contain the assessed test results, and only then will it become clear whether over a third of the Groningen dikes no longer meets the standard.
Het LRT-rapport bevat de beoordeelde toetsresultaten en dan wordt duidelijk of ruim een derde van de Groningse dijken niet meer voldoet aan de norm.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport naar aanleiding van de door de KNVB behaalde winst tijdens het WK Voetbal (ingezonden 3 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about football clubs' financial problems, the KNVB's World Cup profit, and whether government should require financial or youth-training obligations from the football sector and the KNVB. The minister replies that sports bodies are autonomous private organisations, the KNVB made about 3 million euro profit, government invests no specifically in football youth academies, and the KNVB's use of its profit is its own decision.
In the Netherlands sports federations are autonomous private organisations, including the KNVB.
In Nederland zijn sportbonden autonome private organisaties, ook de KNVB.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de behandeling van Portugese werknemers bij de in aanbouw zijnde RWE-centrale in de Eemshaven (ingezonden

MPs Van Dekken and Spekman asked the minister about reports that Portuguese workers at the RWE power plant in Eemshaven were evicted after protesting pay and conditions, and what the government would do to secure their rights. The minister declined to judge the labour dispute, said the Labour Inspectorate is monitoring compliance and has started an investigation into minimum wage payments, and pointed to information provision and a memorandum with Portugal.
If supervision of compliance with laws and regulations by the Labour Inspectorate shows that the laws are being violated, action will be taken against it.
Indien in het kader van het toezicht op de wet- en regelgeving door de Arbeidsinspectie mocht blijken dat de wet- en regelgeving wordt overtreden, zal daartegen worden opgetreden.

The Ministry of SZW therefore does not have the total detected fraud amount and total recovered amount over the past five years, broken down by country where asset investigations were carried out.

There is therefore no estimate possible of the fraud rate among Turkish Dutch or other groups in the Netherlands.

To withdraw or refuse benefits of convicted persons with an outstanding prison sentence, benefit agencies match CJIB files of fugitives from the investigation register against files of benefit recipients.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong en Wilders over het bericht ‘Pensioenfondsen dicht bij korten’

MPs De Jong and Wilders asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether pension funds with large buffers should avoid cuts, and whether a higher discount rate should be used to prevent them. The minister replied that funds lack sufficient buffers, that cuts may be needed in 2020 if finances do not improve, and that he will not raise the discount rate, while pointing to pension reform.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daar ben ik niet toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, De Jong en Helder over het bericht 'Bizar probleem defensie: Schietende jassen'

MPs asked about a report that winter jackets issued to military and police personnel could accidentally fire weapons via loose cords, and about the injury, measures taken, the Inspectorate SZW investigation, and whether the jackets remain in use. The government said the injured soldier has recovered, the Marechaussee banned firing in these jackets, about 4000 soldiers still have them with elastic removal required, the police do not use them, and it announced a plan for a safer defence organisation while withholding the inspectorate's timing and dates.
Making working conditions safer is therefore a top priority for the coming years.
Het veiliger maken van de werkomstandigheden is dan ook topprioriteit voor de komende jaren.
Antwoord op vragen de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en De Jong over “Statushouder Werkloos”

MPs De Graaf, Fritsma and De Jong (PVV) asked the ministers whether refugees with status are poorly educated, whether economic migration has enriched the Netherlands, and whether residence permits of asylum seekers from safe countries should be revoked and an asylum stop introduced. The government answered that refugees are a diverse group, that it pursues activating policy and regional protection, that the IND judges protection needs, and that it will not introduce a full asylum stop in line with international treaties.
However, for status holders, as for Dutch people on social assistance, an activating policy applies that aims at rapid transition to work.
Voor statushouders geldt echter, net als voor Nederlanders in de bijstand, een activerend beleid dat gericht is op snelle uitstroom naar werk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en De Jong over het bericht 'Europees pensioenfonds op rand van de afgrond'

PVV MPs asked the government about a reported EUR 326 million deficit in the European Parliament's voluntary supplementary pension fund, its total EU pension liabilities, and whether the Dutch taxpayer will bear the cost. The minister answered that the fund concerns voluntary pensions accrued before 2009, that the EP itself is responsible for its sustainability, and that the cabinet expects the EP leadership to address it.
It is up to the EP to find a solution to this problem.
Het is aan het EP een oplossing voor deze problematiek te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong, Fritsma, De Graaf, en Wildersover het bericht "Te weinig geld voor bijstandsuitkeringen vluchtelingen”.

PVV MPs asked whether municipalities' welfare shortfalls caused by migrant inflow should be addressed by ending benefits for status holders, requiring ten years' residence before benefit eligibility, and closing borders. The minister replied that benefits are a legal right for all residents below the minimum income, that the shortfall is partly offset by temporary Rijk advances, that existing language-related benefit reductions stay, and that no rule changes are planned.
I see no reason to change the rules in this regard.
Ik zie geen reden om de regels hieromtrent aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Jong over het bericht ‘CPB waarschuwt voor armoedeval door hogere pensioenleeftijd’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the CPB warning that raising the AOW pension age could cause a poverty trap, asking how many people are affected, whether older workers entering unemployment, disability or welfare before retirement were considered, whether the government takes responsibility for insufficient preparation time, and whether it will lower the AOW age to 65. The minister acknowledged the report, defended the phased increase and the IOW bridging benefit, provided inflow figures, and refused to lower the AOW age, citing sustainability costs.
No. This cabinet is for a solid and solidary AOW for current and future generations.
Nee. Dit kabinet is voor een solide en solidaire AOW voor huidige én toekomstige generaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Jong over het bericht 'Den Haag neemt vijftig vluchtelingen in dienst'

An MP asks whether Den Haag's plan to create 50 work-experience places for refugees is scandalous given high unemployment, and whether the municipality's funding should be cut. The minister rejects the criticism, saying statushouders should participate via paid work, that the places are a stepping stone and fall under the municipality's Participatiewet discretion, and that he will not cut the municipal fund.
I do not share your view.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong en Van Dijck over de berichten 'Pensioenfondsen oneerlijk' en 'DNB: Rendement pensioenfondsen te laag om te herstellen'

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary about press reports on pension funds' low returns and DNB's warning of possible pension cuts, questioning why cuts are possible given large fund assets and whether low discount rates distort funding pictures. The state secretary answered that coverage ratios remain below required buffers, the discount rate should not be raised, DNB's warning is part of its supervisory role, and cuts are a last resort under the 2015 framework.
It is the supervisor's task to point pension funds to their responsibilities and to point out the risks for the pension sector as a whole.
Het is de taak van de toezichthouder om pensioenfondsen te wijzen op hun verantwoordelijkheden en te wijzen op de risico's voor de pensioensector als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong, Fritsma en Wilders over 'Meer mensen in de bijstand'

PVV MPs asked whether rising welfare receipt among non-Western migrants, the welfare costs of immigration from Muslim countries, a ten-year residence requirement for social security, and closing borders to asylum seekers are justified. The government confirmed the trend, rejected the cost framing, said a welfare residence requirement would be disproportionate to its goals, and refused an asylum stop as contrary to international obligations.
The cabinet aims for a reasonable balance between preventing a pull effect on the one hand and income protection for those who have been in the Netherlands longer on the other.
Het kabinet streeft naar een redelijk evenwicht tussen het voorkomen van een aanzuigende werking enerzijds en inkomensbescherming voor degenen die al langer in Nederland zijn anderzijds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Jong over het bericht Oost-Europese uitzendkrachten ingezet bij sociale werkbedrijven

An PVV MP asked the State Secretary whether sheltered-work companies hire Eastern European agency workers for jobs meant for people with disabilities, and whether this should stop. The State Secretary answered that the contractor uses foreign temporary workers without targeting that group, accepts their use only exceptionally to meet client deadlines, and said municipalities are responsible for agreements with the sheltered-work companies.
It is up to municipalities to make agreements about this with the sheltered-work companies.
Het is aan gemeenten om daarover afspraken te maken met de sw-bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Jong over het bericht ‘Oost-Europeaan werkt hier voor een hongerloontje'

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of wage pressure and displacement of Dutch workers by Eastern European labour migrants, and whether a work permit requirement should be reintroduced. The minister cites a 2014 SEO study showing displacement in some sectors, describes enforcement measures such as the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies and the enforcement directive, reports the first monitor results, and rejects reintroducing work permits.
I see no reason to revise my views and policy on labour migration.
Ik zie geen reden om mijn mening en beleid over arbeidsmigratie te herzien.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Jong en Helder over het bericht Controle A2 op 23 juli in werking

Two PVV MPs asked whether traffic enforcement should focus on urban roads rather than motorway speed checks, whether the 100 km/h limit on the A2 should be raised, and whether the A2 speed trajectory checks should stop as a revenue measure. The minister replied that speed enforcement on motorways serves safety, air quality and noise goals, that the limit may be raised to 130 km/h at night and evening between Vinkeveen and Maarssen via a forthcoming traffic decision, and that the checks will not be stopped because they were agreed with neighbouring municipalities.
I am therefore not willing to stop this.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid hiermee te stoppen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, De Jong en Wilders over het bericht dat de werkloosheid onder allochtone jongeren dramatische vormen aanneemt

PVV MPs asked the ministers why unemployment among non-Western immigrant youth is so much higher than among Chinese youth, and whether mass immigration of unskilled migrants and work refusal in Rotterdam's port explain it. The minister attributed the gap to cyclical sensitivity, lower education levels and flexible contracts, rejected the claim of mass unskilled immigration and of mass work refusal, gave a welfare figure, and declined to revoke residence permits, saying non-Western migrants are treated like Western ones.
The cabinet does not treat non-Western allochtones differently from Western allochtones
Het kabinet behandelt niet- westerse allochtonen niet anders dan westerse allochtonen
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Jong over het bericht “Treinpersoneel elke week slachtoffer van fysiek geweld”

An MP asked the minister whether train staff are assaulted weekly, requested recent figures on violence in public transport, and asked whether perpetrators should always receive a public transport ban and how often such bans were imposed. The government answered that violence against public-service workers is unacceptable, pointed to existing programmes, aftercare protocols and NS's power to impose transport bans, and referred to earlier letters and a progress report for the figures.
Specifically regarding the number of public transport bans, I refer you to the progress report of the Safe Public Service programme.
Specifiek ten aanzien van het aantal OV-verboden verwijs ik u naar de voortgangsrapportage van het programma Veilige Publieke Taak
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en De Jong over "uitkeringsfraude door niet-westerse allochtonen"

MPs Van Klaveren and De Jong asked the government about the scale of benefit fraud by non-Western immigrants and how foreign property held by benefit recipients is checked. The state secretary answered that fraud policy is not based on origin, described municipal and SVB checks abroad (403 asset investigations in 2011), and declined to start a separate investigation while promising a fuller overview in the third quarter.
We see no reason to start an investigation from our ministries in addition to the work of the municipalities and the SVB
Wij zien geen aanleiding om in aanvulling op bovenstaande werkzaamheden van de gemeenten en de SVB vanuit onze ministeries een onderzoek te starten
Antwoord vragen van de leden Elissen en De Jong over de RET die passagiers afluistert

PVV MPs Elissen and De Jong asked whether Rotterdam's RET tram operator secretly records passenger conversations, on what legal basis, how recordings are used and stored, and whether the minister will investigate. The state secretary answered that the audio question is for the privacy regulator CBP to judge, described RET's access protocol limited to police and justice, and referred back to earlier answers for retention periods and any investigation.
The final judgment on this, however, does not rest with me but with the CBP.
Het uiteindelijke oordeel hierover komt echter niet aan mij toe, maar aan het CBP.
Antwoord vragen De Jong over over het bericht “Bijstandsfraudeurs hebben vrij spel”

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary of Social Affairs whether a claimed 10-20% benefit fraud rate in welfare, and municipalities' alleged underinvestment in fighting it, are accurate, and whether fraud should be harshly prosecuted with full recovery plus fines. The secretary answers that only detected fraud (EUR 119 million, EUR 53 million in welfare) can be measured, that municipalities prefer integrated prevention and administrative enforcement, and announces a bill stripping municipal discretion over recovery, adding interest and fines, and expanding data matching.
The bill contains a broad package of measures. For example, municipalities lose their current policy freedom to decide themselves whether the benefit is recovered after fraud.
Het wetsvoorstel bevat een breed pakket aan maatregelen. Zo vervalt voor gemeenten de huidige beleidsvrijheid om zelf te mogen beoordelen of de bijstandsuitkering na fraude wordt teruggevorderd.
Antwoord vragen Elissen en De Jong over grote problemen op het spoor

MPs Elissen and De Jong asked about union criticism of Keyrail, alleged manipulation of punctuality figures, safety on the Betuweroute, and the relationship between Keyrail and ProRail. The minister says there is no evidence of manipulation, describes the controls and the inspectorate's view that safety is comparable to ProRail's, and promises to keep the interfaces limited and to consider an audit.
ProRail is one of the three shareholders of Keyrail.
ProRail is één van de drie aandeelhouders van Keyrail.
Antwoord vragen De Jong over het bericht ‘Buskaartje te duur door truc NS’

An MP asked the minister whether NS financially disadvantaged bus and train passengers through a financial arrangement with chipkaart operator TLS, whether NS made loans to TLS, whether NS withheld state subsidy, and whether TLS should be dissolved. The minister denied any NS loans to TLS, explained the FENS funding and TLS losses, declined a new investigation citing existing audits, and said the TLS position will be addressed in the permanent chipkaart structure.
I therefore see no reason to investigate NS's conduct and all funds of chipkaart manager TLS.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om onderzoek te doen naar het handelen van NS en naar alle gelden van chipkaartbeheerder TLS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Mos en De Jong over de artikelen ‘Regeringsstad zonder internationale trein’ en ‘Hedwige-conflict kwelt Loodswezen’

PVV MPs De Mos and De Jong asked about a Telegraaf report that Belgium had not ordered the rolling stock needed for the Den Haag-Brussel HSL-Zuid agreement, about a Hedwige polder alternative, and about roughly EUR 9 million in unpaid pilotage deficits owed by Flemish authorities to the Dutch pilotage service. The minister said Belgium had pledged to implement the agreements but NMBS had not ordered the trains, that the Hedwige polder de-polderisation is no longer on the table under the June 2011 decision, and that the pilotage dispute is under binding arbitration, which she will raise with her Flemish counterpart.
In the short term I have a meeting with my Belgian colleague minister Magnette in which the implementation of these agreements will be discussed.
Op korte termijn heb ik een overleg met mijn Belgische collega minister Magnette, waarin de uitvoering van deze afspraken zal worden besproken.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, De Mos en De Jong (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over giftreinen met onbekende ladingen (ingezonden 14 december 2011).

MPs Elissen, De Mos and De Jong asked ministers whether freight trains carrying hazardous substances are reliably documented, whether inspection covers this, and whether the Wob-request by De Pers was fully answered. The minister answered that inspections found 24 violations since February 2011, sanctions were imposed, documentation gaps persist, and inspection will continue closely.
Since February 2011, 24 violations have been identified to date.
Er zijn vanaf februari 2011 tot op heden 24 overtredingen geconstateerd.
Vragen van de leden Van den Besselaar en De Jong (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over gratis fietsen voor werklozen in Rotterdam (ingezonden 13 oktober 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether giving free bicycles to unemployed people in Rotterdam rewards them and who controls such handouts, and whether re-integration funds are being misused. The state secretary replied that the bicycles were given by a re-integration firm from its own funds only to people who had accepted a job, that the alderman considers such extra rewards undesirable and has agreed to consult the firm in advance, and that no re-integration budget is involved.
As the alderman informed the Rotterdam municipal council, the re-integration firm only provided a bicycle to people who had accepted a job.
Zoals de wethouder aan de gemeenteraad van Rotterdam heeft laten weten, heeft het betreffende re-integratiebedrijf alleen een fiets verstrekt aan mensen die een baan hebben aanvaard.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Van den Besselaar en De Jong (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de verschillen in adresgegevens van het UW

PVV MPs asked why UWV and Amsterdam hold different addresses for many benefit recipients, whether bulk data matching and benefit suspension for persons registered as untraceable are planned, and whether GBA address controls are sufficient. The minister said UWV may use correspondence addresses in limited cases, committed to legislation allowing benefit suspension and sharing of divergent addresses with municipalities, and to annual municipal address checks.
I consider it desirable that addresses can be shared between governments because citizens must never make themselves untraceable to the government, whether deliberately or not.
Ik vind het wenselijk dat adressen door overheden aan elkaar kunnen worden doorgegeven omdat burgers zich nooit – opzettelijk of onopzettelijk – onvindbaar mogen maken voor de overheid.

Vragen van de leden De Jong en Van Klaveren (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat allochtone probleemjongeren in Utrecht werkschuw zijn (ingezonden 17 november 201

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about reports that allochtone problem youths in Utrecht are work-shy, questioning the sustainability of the welfare safety net, the spending on reintegration projects, and whether benefits should be stopped and fraud fully recovered. The state secretary agreed that refusing suitable work should lead to benefit withdrawal, noted the Utrecht project was municipally run with limited results so far, and pointed to planned fraud-recovery proposals and existing interest-charging rules.
The cabinet has developed proposals so that, in cases of benefit fraud, wrongly received benefits are fully recovered and a sanction of up to the fraud amount can additionally be imposed.

Het kabinet heeft voorstellen ontwikkeld om in geval van uitkeringsfraude, de onterecht ontvangen uitkeringen geheel terug te vorderen en daarnaast een sanctie op te leggen van maximaal het fraudebedrag.

Vragen van het lid De Jong (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de berichten «Familie fraudeert met uitkeringen en koopt dure auto’s» en «Jaarlijks 8 miljoen euro uitkeringsfraude» (ing

An MP asked the state secretary about press reports of family benefit fraud and about calls to permanently stop benefits and fully recover fraud amounts with interest. The state secretary said fraud should be tackled firmly but that proportionality limits sanctions, so stopping benefits for three months is the ultimate sanction, and that existing rules already cover asset seizure and recovery with interest.

Vragen van de leden De Jong en Van Klaveren (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over fraude bij rijexamen (ingezonden 24 mei 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about fraud at driving theory exams, the number of exams taken with interpreters and their costs, and whether caught fraudsters should be permanently excluded and whether Dutch language should be required. The minister answered that fraud is a criminal matter for the prosecutor and courts, listed interpreter-assisted exam numbers and costs, said language proficiency is not a requirement, and committed to making the extra costs of individual exams with interpreters transparent.
Committing fraud at the theory exam is a criminal offence.
Het plegen van fraude bij het theorie-examen is een strafbaar feit.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en De Jong (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de gratis parkeermogelijkheden in verband met de Ramadan (ingez

Two PVV MPs asked whether Bergen op Zoom opened parking barriers for Ramadan, whether this shows growing Islamic influence, and whether the municipality's costs should be cut from the municipal fund. The minister answered that the free night parking was a temporary trial to equalise city-centre parking rules, not related to Ramadan, and that parking policy is a municipal responsibility.
Parking policy is an autonomous task of the municipality.
Het parkeerbeleid is een autonome taak van de gemeente.
Vragen van de leden De Roon en De Jong (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over een Israelische spoorlijn (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign and infrastructure ministers whether the Netherlands should offer to help complete a Tel Aviv–Jerusalem rail line after Deutsche Bahn withdrew under pressure from activists. Minister Rosenthal said the government knows of the withdrawal but sees no role for the Dutch state in building rail lines in highly developed countries like Israel absent a clear Dutch economic interest.

The government sees no general task for the Dutch government to assist in building rail lines in highly developed countries such as Israel, unless there is a demonstrable economic interest for the Netherlands or Dutch market parties.

De regering ziet in het algemeen geen taak voor de Nederlandse overheid om behulpzaam te zijn bij de aanleg van spoorlijnen in landen met een hoge economische ontwikkeling zoals Israël, tenzij er een aanwijsbaar economisch belang voor Nederland of voor Nederlandse marktpartijen is.
Vragen het lid De Jong (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «Bonus voor uitkeringsgerechtigde die baan vindt» (ingezonden 20 april 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether Breda's municipal job-finding bonuses for welfare recipients and employers, which he said commodify benefits and undermine the social safety net, are acceptable. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for these instruments, that the bonus carries no meaningful misuse risk given the conditions attached, and that individual responsibility remains the starting point.
It is the responsibility of municipalities to implement the WWB/WIJ and to get as many people receiving benefits as possible into regular work.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten om de WWB/WIJ uit te voeren en zoveel mogelijk personen met een uitkering naar regulier werk te laten uitstromen
Vragen van het lid De Jong (PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het tracébesluit A4 Steenbergen (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

An MP asked why the western Steenbergen A4 route was chosen over the eastern variants despite local opposition, and whether residents' constructive proposals should be considered, including during a Council of State appeal. The minister defended the western route as cheaper and better on air quality and regional support, rejected the east-east alternative as not reasonably considerable, and declined to reopen the choice during the appeal.
A more easterly alternative lying east of Steenbergen was however dropped because of the undesirable new severance of areas, including the ecological main structure.
Een meer oostelijk van Steenbergen gelegen alternatief is echter afgevallen vanwege de ongewenste nieuwe doorsnijding van gebieden, waaronder de ecologische hoofdstructuur.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Huizing (VVD), Vermeij (PvdA), De Jong (PVV), Ulenbelt (SP) en Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Financiën over het oproep

MPs asked the state secretary about employers, including Connexxion as self-insurer, summoning former employees with WGA 35-80% disability for medical reassessments, and about the rights, procedures and re-integration duties involved. The state secretary answered that assessment of incapacity is reserved to the UWV, that self-insuring employers may request reassessment but cannot set the percentage themselves, and that he sees no reason for new rules or talks with Connexxion.
The UWV or the self-insuring employer have the possibility to summon a WGA beneficiary.
Het UWV of de eigenrisicodrager hebben de mogelijkheid om een WGA-gerechtigde op te roepen.
Vragen van de leden Elissen en De Jong (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Veiligheid en Justitie over mogelijke onveiligheid op het spoor (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

MPs Elissen and De Jong asked ministers about cable theft endangering rail safety, whether ProRail and NS report all signals passed at danger (STS-passages) to the inspectorate, and whether the inspectorate has enough capacity. The minister answered that all STS-passages are reported, the inspectorate has sufficient capacity, rail safety is a priority, and ATB-Vv performs as a safety net, promising an evaluation to parliament in Q2 2011.
All incidents are reported to the IVW.
Alle incidenten worden aan de IVW gemeld.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Fritsma en De Jong (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het bericht dat de werkloosheid onder niet-westerse alloch

PVV MPs asked the government about rising unemployment among non-Western immigrants in 2010, including whether immigrants should wait ten years before claiming welfare and whether continued immigration of low-skilled workers worsens the problem. The minister replied that stricter migration and welfare rules are being examined, attributed the unemployment rise to the cyclical and temporary-job structure of the labour market, and cited research indicating that the causes are cumulative factors rather than work ethic.
In line with the coalition agreement, it is being examined to what extent tightening migration policy is possible and what this means for access to our social provisions.
Overeenkomstig het regeerakkoord, wordt bezien in hoeverre aanscherping van het (arbeids)migratiebeleid mogelijk is en wat dit betekent voor de toegang tot onze sociale voorzieningen.

Vragen van de leden Helder en de Jong (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat buschauffeurs van Connexxion in Flevoland noodgedwongen het werk neerleg

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Environment and of Security and Justice about a Connexxion bus driver work stoppage in Flevoland caused by rising violence, and about a proposed lifetime bus ban. The minister replied that Connexxion is taking measures with local partners, that a travel ban already exists and an automatic criminal penalty is pending legislation, that a lifetime ban is disproportionate, and that extra enforcement officers are being deployed.
However, I regard a lifetime bus ban as disproportionate and therefore not very realistic.
Een levenslang busverbod beschouw ik echter als disproportioneel en daarmee weinig realistisch.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en De Jong (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Infrastructuur en Milieu, over het niet mogen gebruiken van busbanen door ambulances (ingezonden 2

Two PVV MPs asked why ambulances in Zuid-Holland may not use bus lanes outside emergencies, and whether the law should be changed so ambulances can drive and stop anywhere. The ministers answered that emergency vehicles already have wider access than taxis, that provinces can grant exemptions for bus lanes, and that they see no need to change the law or centralise this power.
No. The current legislation is sufficient.
Vragen van het lid De Jong (PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over strooizout op rantsoen (ingezonden 15 december 2010).

An MP from the PVV asks the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about salt shortages, the adequacy of Rijkswaterstaat's stockpile, the causes of ice on motorways in December 2010, and economic damage from winter weather. The minister replies that the stockpile was raised to 90,000 tonnes with contractual top-up rights, that extra salt is being bought, that the icing could not have been prevented, and that winter weather is a normal condition for the economy.

Rijkswaterstaat is buying extra salt on the national and international market, not only to keep its own stocks at the required level but also for supply to the decentralised road managers who are short of salt.

Rijkswaterstaat koopt op de nationale en internationale markt extra zout in, niet alleen om de eigen voorraden op peil te houden maar ook voor doorlevering aan de decentrale wegbeheerders die met een tekort kampen.

Vragen van het lid de Jong (PVV) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de gemeente Utrecht de scriptie «Een evaluatie van de Wet Investeren in Jongeren (WIJ) bij het jongerenloket in U

An MP asked the minister whether Utrecht municipality suppressed a thesis evaluating the WIJ youth employment law's youth desk as chaotic, and whether criminal youths and wasted public money resulted. The state secretary replied that the report was wrongly described, that municipalities are responsible for WIJ implementation, that the council has the oversight role, and that an evaluation of the WIJ will be sent to parliament before 1 October 2011.
Municipalities are responsible for the quality of the implementation of the WIJ.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de uitvoering van de WIJ.

Vragen van het lid De Jong (PVV) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat 149 werkgevers de regels van de deeltijd-WW aan hun laars hebben gelapt. Waardoor 400 mensen zijn ontslagen ondan

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that 149 employers misused the part-time unemployment benefit (deeltijd-WW) scheme and dismissed around 400 staff, and asks whether fines, recovery and control costs should apply, plus how many were dismissed and what support was given. The minister says fraud-based fines already exist, that dismissal after the scheme is not unlawful but triggers a reimbursement duty for UWV benefit costs within 13 weeks, and that some figures and reintegration efforts are not registered.
Compensation that employers give to employees in the context of a dismissal is not registered.
Tegemoetkomingen die werkgevers in het kader van een ontslag aan werknemers doen, worden niet geregistreerd.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Fritsma en De Jong (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor wonen, wijken en integratie over werkloosheid onder allochtone jongeren (ingezonden 13 juli 2

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration about a report that one in four young people of foreign origin has no job, asking how this fits the Investing in Youth Act, whether mass immigration of unskilled migrants contributes, and whether work ethic differences play a role. The minister answered that the Act's effects will only be visible from Q3 2010, rejected the immigration premise, and cited surveys finding employers see no meaningful work-ethic gap.
Reducing unemployment among young people of foreign origin has the attention of this cabinet.
Het terugdringen van de werkloosheid onder allochtone jongeren heeft de aandacht van dit kabinet.

Vragen van het lid de Jong (PVV) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat bij een grootschalige controle in de Utrechtse wijk Ondiep ruim 7 miljoen euro aan fraude aan het licht is gekome

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reported large-scale benefit fraud of over 7 million euro in Utrecht's Ondiep district, asking how long it has lasted, whether the full sum should be recovered, and whether intervention teams should expand. The minister answers that the amounts are preliminary, describes the risk-based checks and recovery procedures, and points to the enforcement programme and planned reporting.

Vragen van het lid Van der Werf (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Economische Zaken Innovatie en Landbouw over olie- en gaslekkages vanaf olieplatforms (ingezonden 11 juli 2011

An MP asked the government about oil and gas leaks from North Sea platforms reported by The Guardian, whether the Netherlands is informed, and whether incident reporting and safety standards are adequate. The minister answered that the information was not new, that SodM already receives mandatory leak reports and publishes annual data, that existing industry and international cooperation suffices, and that no new EU reporting rule is needed.
For the Dutch part of the North Sea, oil and gas leaks must always be reported to SodM under the Mining Decree.
Voor het Nederlandse deel van de Noordzee geldt dat olie- en gaslekkages altijd behoren te worden gemeld aan SodM op grond van het Mijnbouwbesluit
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van de Werf (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over muziekverenigingen, die massaal hun ANBI-status kwijtraken (ingezonden 14 juli 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the mass loss of ANBI status by music associations after the Tax Office re-tested them under the stricter 90% public-benefit criterion, and whether symphony orchestras receive different treatment. The State Secretary answered that the policy is statutory interpretation, that roughly 10% of music associations still qualify, that individual reviewable decisions will follow, and that a horizontal supervision role for music federations is not feasible because ANBI status will be an exception.

Music associations that, after assessing the responses, the ANBI team considers no longer qualify will receive a reasoned written pre-notice, followed by a withdrawal decision open to objection and appeal.

De muziekverenigingen die na de beoordeling van de ontvangen reacties naar de mening van het ANBI-team niet meer kwalificeren, ontvangen schriftelijk een gemotiveerde vooraankondiging, gevolgd door een voor bezwaar en beroep vatbare intrekkingsbeschikking.
Vragen van het lid Van der Werf (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de joint venture tussen Gazprom en RWE (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether the government had responded to a possible RWE-Gazprom joint venture giving Gazprom influence over Dutch Essent plants, whether Dutch rules protect against Russian state interference, whether Gazprom must comply with EU unbundling rules, and whether a Gazprom stake in Borssele nuclear plant needs ministerial approval. The minister answered that talks were at an early stage, that existing market rules and a planned screening provision for changes of control apply, that Gazprom must follow EU and national rules within the EU, and that the minister can block a transfer of Borssele shares if public interests are endangered.

Vragen van het lid Van der Werf (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over lekkage in de pijplijn van boorplatform Gannet Alpha van Shell in het Britse deel van de Noordzee (ingezonden 17 aug

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Shell pipeline leak at the Gannet Alpha platform in the UK sector of the North Sea, including why it was reported late, the spill volume, repairs, and whether Dutch pipelines should be inspected. The minister answered that Shell reported to the UK government within four hours, Dutch rules require immediate reporting to SodM, about 218 tonnes spilled with no oil reaching the Dutch shelf, and that SodM will decide on a specific inspection project after the UK investigation.
As long as the investigation is not concluded and the cause of the leak is not known, I cannot yet say whether the Dutch oil pipeline network requires further investigation.
Zolang het onderzoek niet is afgerond en de oorzaak van de lekkage nog niet bekend is, kan ik nog niet zeggen of het Nederlandse oliepijpleidingennet nader onderzoek behoeft.

CDA MPs asked the state secretary about working conditions and fatal accidents at the RWE power plant construction site in the Eemshaven, including whether the Labour Inspectorate investigated. The state secretary answered that ten reportable accidents, one fatal, occurred, that the Inspectorate found violations and took enforcement action, and that weekly inspections continue.
Every week the Labour Inspectorate carries out inspections at RWE.
Wekelijks voert de Arbeidsinspectie controles uit bij RWE.
Vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Haverkamp (beiden CDA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de veiligheid van rangeerterreinen (ingezonden 11 juli 2011).

MPs Van der Werf and Haverkamp (CDA) asked about safety at rail marshalling yards after an Inspectorate study found that dangerous goods on trains were often unidentified, and about violations by carriers and ProRail's role. The minister acknowledged the findings, said sanctions are being imposed and ProRail has adopted an improved information procedure, but declined to send a cabinet response and only promised to forward the report.
I will send the investigation report, including the actions already underway, to the House before 13 September.
Ik zal het onderzoeksrapport inclusief de al lopende acties voor 13 september aan de Kamer toesturen.
Vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Financiën en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over kunstbeurzen (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

MPs Van der Werf and Omtzigt asked about the customs guarantee for art fairs such as TEFAF, including whether the guarantee had tripled and whether it had ever been called upon. The government denied any increase in import guarantees, explained the VAT change and customs presence at the fair, and offered consultation with the fair organisers.
Customs is willing to consult with the fair organisation and the forwarders involved to jointly seek a comprehensive solution to this issue for coming years.

in the proposed article 218a, first paragraph, the phrase 'on condition that the disclosure cannot be traced to them' is deleted
vervalt in het voorgestelde artikel 218a, eerste lid, de zinsnede: onder voorwaarde dat de verstrekking niet tot hen kan worden herleid
Amendement van het lid Van Nispen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 16 over het vervallen van de voorwaarde van herleidbaarheid
Replaces the proviso that a source-protection disclosure must not be traceable to the source, removing a condition on the Code of Criminal Procedure article 218a.
in article 218a, first paragraph, the phrase: on condition that the disclosure cannot be traced back to them, lapses.
vervalt in artikel 218a, eerste lid, de zinsnede: onder voorwaarde dat de verstrekking niet tot hen kan worden herleid.
Motie van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Bisschop over de verantwoordelijkheid voor de laadapparatuur
Asks the government to remove the grid operator's permission to offer charging equipment from the Energy Act and reconsider it in the AMvB.
requests the government to delete from Energy Act 1.0 the permission for the grid company to operate charging equipment as an activity
verzoekt de regering om, in Energiewet 1.0 de toestemming voor het netwerkbedrijf om laadapparatuur als activiteit uit te voeren te schrappen uit de wet
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Jetten c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 19 over het afschaffen van de gasaansluitplicht

Replaces an amendment so that municipal executives can designate areas where new gas connections are barred or limited, with the ACM keeping a register, shifting connection decisions toward local government.
This amendment ensures that this ambition can also be carried out in practice.
Dit amendement regelt dat deze ambitie ook in de praktijk uitgevoerd kan worden.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Jetten c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 23 over het afschaffen van de gasaansluitplicht
Amends the Gas Act so municipalities can designate areas where new buildings need not connect to the gas grid and where no new gas connections are made, with ACM keeping a register.
To make the Netherlands gas-free it is very important that this obligation lapses and that heat supply decisions are decentralised as much as possible
Om Nederland gasvrij te maken is het van groot belang dat deze plicht komt te vervallen en dat de besluitvorming over de warmtevoorziening zo veel mogelijk decentraal wordt belegd.
Amendement van het lid Jetten c.s. over het afschaffen van de gasaansluitplicht
Amends the Gas Act so municipalities can designate areas where new buildings need not be connected to the gas grid, with a ministerial rule-making power and ACM registry.
Removing the gas connection obligation in designated areas, so that these areas become entirely gas-free, is an example of this.
Het laten vervallen van de gasaansluitplicht in aangewezen gebieden, zodat deze gebieden geheel gasloos worden, is daar een voorbeeld van.
Motie van het lid Moorlag c.s. over werven van technici en vakmensen
Asks the government to include in the climate and energy agreement arrangements for training, retraining and recruiting technicians and skilled workers for the energy transition.
noting that the energy transition, including making the housing stock energy neutral, requires large numbers of technicians and skilled workers
constaterende dat de energietransitie, waaronder het energieneutraal maken van de woningvoorraad, grote aantallen technici en vakmensen vraagt
Motie van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius c.s. over inventariseren van belemmeringen bij innovaties
Asks the government to inventory regulatory obstacles to innovation via a digital platform and report to the House in 2018.
requests the government, via a digital platform, to inventory the bottlenecks and obstacles regarding innovations and to inform the House in 2018
verzoekt de regering, via een digitaal platform de knelpunten en belemmeringen met betrekking tot innovaties te inventariseren en de Kamer in 2018 te informeren
Motie van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Agnes Mulder over energieprijzen voor grootverbruikers binnen Noordwest-Europa
Asks the government to re-examine a comparison of energy prices for large consumers in Northwest Europe and inform the House of the results.
requests the government to re-examine that study and inform the House of Representatives of the outcomes
verzoekt de regering, dat onderzoek te herijken en de Tweede Kamer over de uitkomsten te informeren
Motie van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Jetten over meer transparantie in de Nationale Energieverkenning
Asks the government to provide more transparency and clarity in the annual National Energy Outlook on energy consumption figures and the rise in levies added to energy prices.
requests the government to provide more transparency and clarity in the annual National Energy Outlook about the figures on energy consumption and the rise in levies

verzoekt de regering, in de jaarlijkse Nationale Energieverkenning meer transparantie en duidelijkheid te verschaffen over de cijfers ten aanzien van het energieverbruik en de stijging van de heffingen
Motie van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius c.s. over een transparante effectiviteitsmeting inzake het programma Aanpak schijnconstructies en cao-naleving
Asks the government to set up a transparent effectiveness measurement for the programme against sham constructions and collective agreement compliance.
requests the government to set up a transparent effectiveness measurement so the programme's progress can be monitored
verzoekt de regering, een transparante effectiviteitsmeting in te stellen zodat gemonitord kan worden hoe het programma verloopt
Motie van het lid Raemakers c.s. over voor de SZW-begrotingsbehandeling de Kamer informeren over de UWV-kandidatenverkenner
Asks the government to inform the Chamber, before the SZW budget debate, about the status of releasing the UWV candidate-explorer application to municipalities and its use.
requests the government, before the budget debate for Social Affairs and Employment, to inform the Chamber about the state of affairs
verzoekt de regering, voor de begrotingsbehandeling van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid de Kamer te informeren over de stand van zaken
Motie van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius c.s. over in volgende jaarverslagen ook duidelijk aangeven wat niet goed ging
Asks that future annual reports clearly state what went wrong, lessons learned, and how this leads to policy changes.
requests the government, in future annual reports, to also clearly state what did not go well
verzoekt de regering, in volgende jaarverslagen ook duidelijk aan te geven wat niet goed ging
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over de gepresenteerde Agenda voor Werkend Nederland

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Aartsen asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Agenda for Working Netherlands, covering middle incomes, the work-pays-more norm, marginal tax pressure, childcare costs, self-employed workers and the reachability of government services. The minister replied that the agenda is organised by policy domain, that existing and planned measures support middle incomes, and that many questions depend on case-by-case assessment or future decisions.
However, the cabinet does not follow a norm that workers always end up better off than non-workers.
Het kabinet volgt echter geen norm dat werkenden er altijd meer op vooruitgaan dan niet-werkenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over de 'Reactie van de Kamer van Koophandel (KVK) op de petitie de Goede Zaak over privacy'

Two VVD MPs asked why the government is consulting on privacy of home addresses in the Trade Register rather than simply implementing their motion to shield residential addresses from public view, and whether the consultation scope and timeline are adequate. The state secretary answered that full implementation is not possible under EU law and Wwft obligations, that the motion is only partly feasible, that a broad consultation will explore all interests, and that a first indication of solutions is expected before the summer recess.
The motion cannot, as stated, be implemented in full because that is not (fully) possible.
De motie kan, zoals gezegd, niet onverkort worden uitgevoerd omdat dat niet (volledig) mogelijk is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'School duwt kinderen ongevraagd uit de kast'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister how he assesses reports that the Gomarus school in Gorinchem pressured LGBTI pupils to come out and detained them, and whether this conflicts with the Dutch school safety and citizenship duties. The minister called the reports unacceptable, said the Inspectorate is investigating with results expected by summer 2021, and declined to pre-empt that investigation, while noting that schools may hold a traditional marriage view provided the school culture meets the basic values.
The Inspectorate is examining the extent to which the school safeguards pupils' safety and whether legal requirements such as the citizenship duty and the Social Safety at School Act are met.
De inspectie onderzoekt in hoeverre de school de veiligheid van leerlingen waarborgt en of aan wettelijke eisen als de burgerschapsopdracht en de Wet sociale veiligheid wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Nieuw anti-misdaadteam wekt wrevel bij de politie'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that a new multidisciplinary anti-crime team (MIT) was causing resentment in the police, including its rationale, its relation to existing units, staffing, budget and risks to other services. The minister answered that the MIT complements existing services, is funded structurally, is being built in phases, and that work will continue without pausing the rollout.
I will keep your House informed of the progress of building the MIT in my regular letters on the approach to undermining crime.
Ik zal uw Kamer op de hoogte blijven houden van de voortgang van de bouw van het MIT in mijn reguliere brieven over de aanpak ondermijning.
