Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, El Yassini en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Journalisten aangevallen bij kerkdiensten Urk en Krimpen: ‘Dit is een aantasting van de rechtsstaat''

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Security minister about attacks on journalists at church services on Urk and in Krimpen aan den IJssel, police and prosecution handling, PersVeilig complaint figures, the 200% sentencing uplift for violence against journalists, a team for threatened journalists, support for freelance journalists, and COVID-era church gatherings. The minister answered in detail, stating that suspects were processed with proces-verbaal, that the police and local tripartite were responsible for risk assessment, and that research on violence against journalists and taskforce options were underway.
In the first 3 months of 2021, journalists reported threats, assault and intimidation to the PersVeilig reporting point 73 times.
Journalisten hebben in de eerste 3 maanden van 2021 73 keer melding gemaakt van bedreiging, mishandeling en intimidatie bij (het meldpunt) PersVeilig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Weverling over het bericht 'Politiehonden in opleiding nog steeds mishandeld'

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Weverling asked about media reports of mistreatment of police dogs in training at a private KNPV club, including contracts, sanctions and reporting duties. The minister said police are examining whether criminal investigation is warranted, that the problem does not appear structural, and promised tighter contract penalties and no further purchases from trainers convicted of animal cruelty, but said a ban on keeping animals cannot apply to the KNPV as an umbrella body.
Based on this broadcast, the police, on the instruction of the Public Prosecution Service, are examining whether there are grounds for a criminal investigation.
Op grond van deze uitzending wordt door de politie, in opdracht van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM), onderzocht of er aanknopingspunten zijn voor een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het stopzetten van de samenwerking met AMBER Alert

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister about the cost, performance, tendering and legal basis of the AMBER Alert contract with Netpresenter, and why the child-missing alert function is being moved into Burgernet. The minister answered that the roughly 1.1 million euro yearly contract was unlawful to extend, the tender was postponed by litigation, and integration into Burgernet was chosen for control, privacy and efficiency reasons, with a one-off 200,000 euro investment.
The police have commissioned the supplier of the Burgernet system to integrate the missing-child alert function into Burgernet.
De politie heeft aan de leverancier van het Burgernetsysteem opdracht verstrekt voor de integratie van de functionaliteit vermist-kind-alertering bij Burgernet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Lodders over het bericht 'Vrees voor Chinese spionage via douanescanners in haven Rotterdam'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reports of Chinese espionage risks from Nuctech X-ray scanners used by Dutch customs at Rotterdam port, airports and distribution centres. The government confirmed the deployment, said risk assessments are case-by-case with an external security audit underway, and stated it would consider proportionate measures without committing to halting use of the scanners.
No public statements are made about the knowledge level of the Intelligence and Security Services.
Over het kennisniveau van de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Geheime ‘Turkije analyse’ NCTV lekt uit: grote rol Erdogan bij opkomst salafisme in Nederland'

MPs Becker and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked the government about a leaked confidential NCTV analysis linking Erdogan to the rise of salafism in the Netherlands, and about follow-up on related motions. The Minister declined to discuss the draft analysis's contents, referred to existing policy and a forthcoming final analysis, and answered the remaining questions largely by pointing to ongoing work and existing frameworks.
At this moment I cannot address the questions posed by your House about the content of the draft analysis.
Ik kan op dit moment niet ingaan op door uw Kamer gestelde vragen over de inhoud van de conceptanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Justitie deelt kritieke informatie over hacks niet met bedrijven’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about reports that the NCSC does not share critical threat information about cyberattacks with companies, and about the legal basis, OKTT status for the Digital Trust Center, and possible contact with the UK. The Minister acknowledges the problem, says a bill amending the Wbni is being prepared for consultation around summer, and says the DTC will be designated as an OKTT after further steps.
I am therefore working on a bill to ensure that more of the aforementioned data can reach those other providers.
Ik werk daarom aan een wetsvoorstel om ervoor te zorgen dat meer van de hiervoor genoemde gegevens bij die andere aanbieders terecht kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Buitenweg over het onderzoek naar taakdifferentiatie bij de brandweer

Two MPs (Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Buitenweg) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the consequences of task differentiation in the fire service, including effects on volunteers and whether EU working-time and part-time rules can be met. The minister answered that consequences were analysed for all 25 safety regions, that task differentiation is feasible but needs organisational change, and that volunteer status will be preserved while EU compliance steps will be taken.
I consider it necessary that the safety regions, as employers of fire service personnel, quickly take concrete steps to arrange that.
Ik vind het noodzakelijk dat de veiligheidsregio’s als werkgevers van het brandweerpersoneel snel concrete stappen zetten om dat te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Regterschot over de Kamerbrief 'Aanpak personen met verward gedrag, street-triage, GGZ- triage en passend vervoer'

Two VVD MPs asked whether the minister's letter on street triage and care for people with confused behaviour properly fulfilled a unanimously adopted motion calling for street triage pilots in the municipalities with the most reports, and why the Twente pilot only offered care for limited hours. The minister says the motion is being honoured through pilots in Amsterdam and a follow-up ZonMw programme, promising a further letter with the State Secretary of VWS before April 2021.
My intention was indeed to honour your motion with this.
Mijn intentie was inderdaad om uw motie hiermee gestand te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Huisartsen 'niet onder de indruk' van brief Viruswaarheid'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about threats to doctors at their home addresses by the Viruswaarheid group, whether a criminal complaint was filed, and how the motion to shield private addresses in public registers is being implemented. The minister said no complaint is known, the Chamber of Commerce cannot refuse to supply addresses, and a Trade Register amendment to hide residential addresses will be sent for advice shortly, with a further update before the summer recess.

The shielding of registered residential addresses will be implemented through an amendment to the Trade Register Decree, which will shortly be submitted for advice to the Dutch Data Protection Authority and then to the Council of State.

De afscherming van als zodanig geregistreerde woonadressen wordt geëffectueerd door een wijziging in het Handelsregisterbesluit die op korte termijn voor advies wordt voorgelegd aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens en vervolgens aan de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'veroordeelde oorlogsmisdadigers kunnen mogelijk asiel krijgen'

MPs Becker and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether a Raad van State ruling of December 2020 lets people excluded under Article 1F (war crimes) obtain asylum in the Netherlands, and whether they could gain residence via family ties to an EU citizen in another member state. The Secretary of State answered that the ruling concerns entry bans and public-order risk rather than asylum, that 1F exclusion from asylum remains unchanged, and that no legislative change is needed.
The Council of State ruling brings no change to the existing laws and regulations or their interpretation, nor to the 1F policy.
De uitspraak van de Raad van State brengt geen verandering in (de uitleg van) bestaande wet- en regelgeving, ook niet in het 1F-beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Ministerie OCW heeft geen geld voor herkomstonderzoek naziroofkunst’

MPs El Yassini and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked the minister why there is no money for provenance research into Nazi-looted art and whether she will fund it, after a report on restitution policy. The minister confirmed there is currently no extra budget for the advised research into the NK collection, said she will address funding and implementation in her policy response in spring 2021, and committed to that response.
It is correct that no extra money is currently reserved for additional research into the NK collection, in addition to the structural expenditure in my budget.
Het klopt dat er momenteel geen extra geld gereserveerd is voor additioneel onderzoek naar de NK-collectie, in aanvulling op de structurele uitgaven op mijn begroting
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ''Illegale pokeravonden in de voetbalkantine: 'Dan is dus je hele club naar de Filistijnen''

MPs Heerema and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked how the government will tackle criminal interference in amateur sports clubs and what steps it will take. The minister answers that a broad study confirmed such interference, points to existing cooperation (RIEC's, awareness campaigns, planned guidance and local sports agreements) and says criminal law is a last resort, while not answering question 8 about the committee meeting.
I therefore want to examine whether additional information campaigns could play a role here.
Ik wil dan ook bezien of extra voorlichting hier een rol kan spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Lachen om vuurwerkverbod: Wij knallen gewoon door’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Ziengs asked the Justice Minister about illegal fireworks sales and use during the COVID-era fireworks ban, including arrests, prosecution, online trade, border controls and police equipment. Minister Grapperhaus answered in detail on prosecution guidelines, Halt referrals, online policing and police preparations, without new structural commitments.
No statements can be made about which routes these are.
Over welke routes dit zijn kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Steen door de ruit en dreigbrief Molukse wijk in Elst'

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about reports of a stone through a window and a threatening letter in a Moluccan neighbourhood in Elst, and about the allocation policy giving Moluccans priority for housing in such neighbourhoods. The government explained the historical basis of the arrangements, said they exist in about 45 municipalities, denied that tensions are a recurring pattern, and said it sees no reason to revisit the agreement.
Apart from the incidents reported by the Gelderlander and the NOS, I am not aware of any signals so far that give cause to revisit this agreement.
Buiten de incidenten waarvan de Gelderlander en de NOS melding hebben gemaakt, zijn mij vooralsnog geen signalen bekend die aanleiding geven tot een herijking van deze afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Bolkestein over het bericht 'Nieuwe drug 3-MMC duikt op in Zeeland'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers about the new drug 3-MMC, its users, legal status, precursors, production, and government response. The minister answered that use data are limited but rising, 3-MMC is still legal and sold online, a NPS bill will ban it, and the CAM will review evidence and consider next steps.
Once the cathinones fall under the Opium Act, production of and trade in 3-MMC will be illegal.
Zodra de cathinonen onder de Opiumwet vallen zal productie van en handel in 3-MMC illegaal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Staatsvijand Nr.1’

A Minister's written answers to MP Yeşilgöz-Zegerius's questions about the documentary 'Staatsvijand Nr. 1' on terrorist Samir A., covering the effectiveness of deradicalisation tracks, the numbers in such tracks, intelligence services' handling of individuals, terrorism financing and hawala banking, and public alertness. The government answers substantively on numbers and monitoring, but declines to comment on the specific case and on intelligence-service decisions, citing security and source protection.
I obviously cannot go into this specific case or the statements of the person concerned.
Ik kan uiteraard niet ingaan op deze specifieke casus of de uitlatingen van de betrokkene.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over het bericht Providers gaan bedrijven waarschuwen voor beveiligingslekken'

MPs Yesilgoz-Zegerius and Aartsen asked whether the NBIP, designated as an OKTT, can receive threat information from the NCSC and why the Digital Trust Center cannot yet do so for non-vital businesses. The government answers that NCSC can already share threat information with NBIP within legal limits, that a DTC designation is being prepared with a target start early next year, and that a WODC study on the landelijk dekkend stelsel has been commissioned.
The Ministry of EZK is working on the preparatory work for this. The aim is for this new service to start early next year.
Het Ministerie van EZK is bezig met de voorbereidende werkzaamheden hiervoor. Het streven is dat deze nieuwe dienstverlening begin volgend jaar kan starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Doneeractie voor Mani die leven redt, maar zelf opdraait voor de kosten’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Van Nispen asked why a citizen who rescued someone in a cardiac arrest was left with a large bill for damages, and what the government would do about burgerhulpverleners' losses and insurers. The minister answered with statistics on civilian rescuers, said police and ambulance arrival times are not tracked for this specific situation, and noted that Utrecht municipality is working to compensate the rescuer, while stating that Slachtofferhulp is not the right route.
On the mayor's instruction, a solution is being examined in consultation with Mr Chawoshey to compensate him for the costs incurred.
In opdracht van de burgemeester wordt er in overleg met de heer Chawoshey gekeken naar een oplossing om hem te compenseren in de gemaakte kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Woedeaanval terrorismeverdachte leidt tot 30.000 euro schade in gevangenis’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked about a terror suspect's rampage causing about 30,000 euro damage at PI Vught, whether he should pay for it, incident counts, disciplinary sanctions, and whether complaints were filed against him and Mohammed Bouyeri. The minister confirmed the facts, said the suspect should bear the damage, gave incident and sanction figures, and said a complaint was filed against the suspect but not against Bouyeri given his limited role.
In the first eight months of 2020, 318 incidents took place within PI Vught that led to disciplinary sanctions.
In de eerste acht maanden van 2020 hebben binnen de PI Vught 318 incidenten plaatsgevonden die hebben geleid tot disciplinaire straffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Geheim telefoonverkeer legt ernstige corruptie bij politie bloot’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of serious corruption in the police revealed through EncroChat investigations, including whether the minister knew of police concerns, what is being done, and how screening is being tightened. The minister confirmed being informed by the prosecution service, described a special anti-corruption team and integrity measures such as the screening bill and LaaS logging, but declined to give details on ongoing investigations.
I cannot provide further information on this, as it concerns an ongoing investigation.
Ik kan geen nadere mededelingen doen hierover, omdat het een lopend onderzoek betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en El Yassini over het bericht ‘Omroepen voor het karretje misdaad’

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Media ministers about reports that broadcasters serve criminals, including the OM's reaction to the series Cannabis, a police officer being discredited, a secretly recorded prosecutor-lawyer call, and payments to a convicted drug trafficker. The minister declined to comment on the ongoing case, referred to the OM for its own view, pointed to tightened NPO payment rules, and stated that the broadcaster said no payment was made to the drug trafficker.
Moreover, it is not appropriate for me to make substantive statements about an ongoing criminal case.
Daarnaast past het mij niet inhoudelijke mededelingen over een lopende strafzaak te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Koerden gaan Syrische vrouwen en kinderen vrijlaten uit Al Hol kamp'

MPs Koopmans and Yesilgoz-Zegerius asked about reports that Kurdish authorities would release Syrian women and children from Al Hol camp, and about the handling of Dutch jihadist returnees, including local prosecution, citizenship revocation, and repatriation. The ministers answered that about 40 Dutch fighters remain in Syria, outlined prosecution options in the region and in the Netherlands, and committed to informing parliament before any repatriation decisions.
The cabinet will involve the House in advance, in line with the motion, if there are plans to bring back Syria fighters or their wives or children.
Het kabinet zal de de Kamer conform de motie vooraf betrekken als er voornemens zijn ten aanzien van terughalen van Syriëgangers, hun vrouwen of kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de documentaire ´De Kroongetuigeadvocaat´

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the documentary on the crown witness lawyer, including the timing of the crown witness deal, the threat assessment and evaluation after the murder of the witness's brother, protection measures, and whether lawyers can see their own threat analyses. The minister answered that protection measures were in place before the presentation, that threat analyses are classified and not shared with the protected person, but that protected persons are informed in general terms, and that structural reinforcement of the protection system is underway.
Because of the classification level, the origin and the major risks linked to disclosure, the threat analysis is not shared with the person concerned and it is not desirable to do so in the future.

Vanwege het niveau van rubricering alsmede de herkomst en grote risico´s die samenhangen met openbaarmaking daarvan wordt de dreigingsanalyse niet gedeeld met de betrokkene en is het niet wenselijk om dat in de toekomst wel te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Van Wijngaarden het bericht het bericht ‘Ik ben een schim geworden omdat het OM zo nodig die deal moest sluiten’

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about a newspaper report in which the brother of a crown witness, an innocent person, complained of inadequate protection and a lack of insight into threat assessments. The Minister acknowledged repeated complaints, said threat analyses are classified and cannot be disclosed, admitted the murder of a relative was not foreseen and an internal evaluation led to improvements, and committed to further structural investment and a report before the budget debate.
Given the sensitivity of this information, these threat analyses have been classified at the state secret confidential level and higher.
Gezien de gevoeligheid van deze informatie zijn deze dreigingsanalyses gerubriceerd tot het niveau van staatsgeheim confidentieel en hoger
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Tilburger met drugs en inbrekersspullen na wilde achtervolging twee agenten meegesleurd’

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about a case where police officers were dragged by a suspect, and about the number of assaults on public-facing workers and the definition and use of expedited (snelrecht) criminal procedure. The minister provides counts of assaults on public-task workers, explains that snelrecht is not registered uniformly and no national definition exists, and states that eligibility is decided case by case.
The judiciary's systems do not routinely record whether a case was handled under expedited procedure.
In de rechtspraaksystemen wordt niet standaard geregistreerd of een zaak met toepassing van snelrecht is behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'WhatsApp-fraude explodeert: 'Ik snap niet hoe ik erin ben getrapt''

MPs Van der Linde and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked about the rise of WhatsApp 'friend in need' fraud, its scale, perpetrators, bank liability, prevention and FIU information. The minister replied that reports have surged since 2019 but exact numbers are unknown, outlined prevention campaigns, bank security rules and new financial investigation tools, and said banks are generally not liable for authorised payments.
The exact scale of 'friend in need' fraud is not known, because not all victims report to the police, their bank or the Fraud Helpdesk.

De exacte omvang van hulpvraagfraude (ook wel vriend-in-nood-fraude genoemd), is niet bekend, omdat niet alle slachtoffers aangifte doen bij de politie of een melding maken bij hun bank of de Fraudehelpdesk (FHD).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over het bericht 'Na corona komt het foute geld'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers how the government protects businesses weakened by COVID-19 against criminal 'foute helpers' and dirty money, and what has been done after a RIEC survey found about 10 percent of entrepreneurs had been approached by an unknown investor. Minister Grapperhaus replied that awareness campaigns, public-private platforms and the Actieprogramma Veilig Ondernemen are under way, that EU-level work is being pursued, and that the topic will be raised at the December JBZ Council, but the answer was late and gives no concrete new legislative or oversight measures.
I acknowledge that as a result of the coronavirus pandemic, the risks of abuse by criminals towards businesses are increasing.
Ik onderken dat als gevolg van de coronapandemie risico’s van misbruik door criminelen richting het bedrijfsleven toenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'New forms of terrorism inspired by conspiracy theories may emerge after pandemic, warns EU counter-terror chief'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the EU counter-terrorism coordinator's warning about possible new conspiracy-inspired terrorism applies to the Netherlands, and what the government is doing about it. The minister answered that such phenomena do not currently amount to a new form of terrorism in the Netherlands, that they are monitored and included in threat assessments where relevant, and that no specific measures are currently deemed necessary.
At present no terrorism is observed within the so-called new phenomena, and there is therefore no reason to take specific measures.
Op dit moment wordt er binnen de zogenoemde nieuwe fenomenen geen terrorisme waargenomen en is er derhalve geen aanleiding om specifieke maatregelen te nemen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de persverklaring van Hizb ut Tharir dat vervolging voor de aanbeveling tot vrouwenbesnijdenis een poging zou zijn om moslims te criminaliseren

MPs Becker and Yesilgoz-Zegerius asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a Hizb ut Tahrir press statement calling prosecution for recommending female genital mutilation an attempt to criminalise Muslims, and asked whether the government would act against the group, ban it, or have the task force examine it. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the statement is unacceptable, that FGM is criminal and prosecuted, that Hizb ut Tahrir is a radical movement not calling for violence but he sees no reason for further measures now, that a dissolution bill is before parliament, and that the task force will monitor developments.
I currently see no reason to take further measures against the organisation.
Ik zie momenteel geen aanleiding nadere maatregelen te treffen tegen de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘‘Ga naar Holland’ is trending als homofobe sneer in Turkije’

Two MPs (Becker and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, VVD) asked the ministers about a Turkish religious official's remarks linking homosexuality to population decline, the hashtag campaign that followed, threats, and Diyanet's influence in Dutch mosques. The minister condemned the remarks, said no criminal complaint was filed, referred to existing integration, monitoring and diaspora-policy measures, and declined to change those measures on the basis of this single statement.
A single statement by Mr Erbas in Turkey, however reprehensible, is not for the cabinet a reason to revise this approach at this moment.
Een enkele uitspraak van de heer Erbas in Turkije, hoe verwerpelijk dan ook, vormt voor het kabinet geen aanleiding om deze aanpak op dit moment te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Lodders over het bericht ‘Nederland internationaal onder vuur om drugshandel per post’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Lodders asked about reports that Dutch dealers send about 9,000 drug parcels a month abroad, and about the scale, destinations and controls on outbound postal drug shipments. The Minister answered with seizure figures from 2017 to 2020, stated the 9,000 figure was an extrapolation from a pilot that warrants caution, noted no national statistics on drug parcels intercepted abroad, and said that customs can open parcels without a rechter-commissaris but that reform of the Strafvordering will simplify this and that the government is engaging in international efforts.

After the modernisation of the Code of Criminal Procedure, investigating officers will be empowered to seize postal parcels independently and then open the parcel and inspect its contents, without needing authorisation from the rechter-commissaris.

Na de modernisering van het wetboek van Strafvordering zullen opsporingsambtenaren bevoegd worden om zelfstandig postpakketten in beslag te nemen en om het postpakket vervolgens te openen en kennis te nemen van de inhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat een agent vervolging wil afdwingen van man die hem bedreigde met fysiek geweld

Members Van Wijngaarden and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius (VVD) asked whether the Public Prosecution Service was right to drop a case where a police officer sought prosecution of a man who threatened him with violence, and about protection and reporting of violence against police. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the OM judged the threat did not qualify under the relevant offences, that agents are encouraged to report incidents, and that the bill extending the community-service prohibition is on track.
On this individual case, which is now before the judge, I cannot go into further detail.
Op deze individuele casus, die thans aan de rechter is voorgelegd, kan ik verder niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Politievrijwilligers woedend om schrappen opleidingen’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police academy training for volunteer police officers would not start in 2020 or 2021 and that the volunteers' organisation feared losing specialist volunteers. The Minister answered that 168 new volunteers start a part-time course in 2020–2021, that a new step-up training from level 2 to level 4 will be developed and that the volunteer training will be aligned with the new basic police training from 2022, while acknowledging fewer places than foreseen due to prioritising recruit training.
Unfortunately, fewer training places for police volunteers have in total been made available than previously foreseen.
Helaas zijn er in totaal wel minder opleidingsplaatsen voor politievrijwilligers beschikbaar gesteld dan eerder voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Hoe een PGP-hack narcostaat Nederland feilloos blootlegt’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a report on the PGP/Encro hack exposing Dutch drug trafficking, asking about seized criminal cash, police cyber capacity, prosecution capacity, reliance on volunteers and international cooperation. The minister answered that he cannot comment on individual cases, pointed to a June 2020 letter and a planned autumn study on drug producers, cited 120 FTE in high-tech crime teams, said analysing decrypted messages needs more work, and promised only to examine information-sharing bottlenecks with partners.
As you know, I cannot comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet, kan ik mij over individuele zaken niet uitlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Terreurverdachte werkte vlak voor arrestatie met kwetsbare jongeren’

MPs Wörsdörfer and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked how a terror suspect convicted of a terrorism offence could work in three youth care institutions under a false identity, and about screening, information sharing and oversight of care staff. The minister answered that the screening failure cannot be fully reconstructed, that VOG responsibility lies with employers and staffing agencies, that the IGJ found no irregularities in recent visits, and that a criminal investigation and the WODC study will inform future screening policy.
Unfortunately, it can no longer be established why this went wrong at the staffing agency or at the three institutions in 2018.
Het is helaas niet meer na te gaan waarom dat bij het uitzendbureau of bij de drie instellingen in 2018 verkeerd is gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Je bent niet altijd een held als je een misdaad meldt’ en het bericht dat Arie den Dekker inmiddels is overleden

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the government protects a civilian witness who reported a murder and was later killed, and what protocols and witness-protection measures apply. The minister expressed sympathy, declined to comment on the individual case pending an independent inquiry and an Inspectorate orientation, described general witness-protection rules, and announced reforms to the protection system.
Pending the outcome of the announced independent inquiry and the orientation, it is not appropriate for me to make substantive statements about this case.
In afwachting van de uitkomsten van het aangekondigd onafhankelijk onderzoek en de oriëntatie past het mij niet om inhoudelijke uitspraken te doen over deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Spionnen op de loer: “vooral China aast op vaccinkennis”’

MPs Wiersma and Yesilgoz-Zegerius asked whether signals of Chinese digital espionage against vaccine research institutes were known, what was being done, and whether a broader knowledge-security framework was coming. The government answered that digital espionage by state actors is a persistent threat, that institutions bear primary responsibility for their own security, that a fast-track bill lets the NCSC assist vaccine research centres, and that a broad knowledge-security regulation and new consultations with institutions are in preparation with reports promised in autumn.
However, no concrete statements are made publicly about specific case matters.
In het openbaar worden echter geen concrete uitspraken gedaan over specifieke casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Onderzoek: dreiging door extreme afsplitsing van IS’

MPs Yesilgoz-Zegerius and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report on the Hazimi movement, a jihadist offshoot of IS with an estimated 100 Dutch followers, including its threat level, the number of former IS members involved, local government handling, online activity, and future coverage in the threat assessment. The minister answered that Hazimi followers are more sectarian but not more violent than IS-oriented jihadists, numbers are stable at a few dozen, local care-based approaches apply, online activity is monitored, and the DTN will address the movement if developments warrant.
I cannot make statements about individual persons.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over individuele personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Van der Graaf inzake het bericht ‘Ruit ingeslagen bij restaurant HaCarmel: ‘Het begint bijna gewoon te worden’'

MPs Yesilgoz-Zegerius and Van der Graaf asked about repeated antisemitic vandalism at restaurant HaCarmel, the recidivism assessment of the suspect, the 100-metre exclusion zone and police enforcement. Minister Grapperhaus gave a detailed incident overview and described court and police handling, but declined a substantive judgement on the 8 May 2020 case because criminal investigation is ongoing.
Because the criminal investigation into the incident of 8 May 2020 is still ongoing, I refrain from giving a substantive judgement on this case.
Omdat het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar het incident op 8 mei 2020 nog loopt, onthoud ik mij van een inhoudelijk oordeel over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Macron gaat buitenlandse imams weren’

MPs Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Heerema asked the government about France's plan to restrict foreign imams, about radical religious influence in Dutch neighbourhoods, closing institutions, foreign-trained imams, an imam certification system, an imam training programme, informal education oversight and French-language rules in schools. The minister answered that the government will act against antidemocratic conduct without targeting any religion, points to a taskforce and a bill on dissolving legal persons, and promises an exploratory report on informal education before summer.
Due to signals of possible antidemocratic or intolerant elements within a number of organisations offering informal education, I have announced a broad exploration.
Vanwege signalen van mogelijke antidemocratische of onverdraagzame elementen binnen een aantal organisaties die informele scholing aanbieden, heb ik een brede verkenning aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Politie luidt noodklok over toename crystalmethlabs’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about rising crystal meth lab busts, the sources and destination markets, Mexican cartel involvement, and measures against Dutch enablers and designer drugs. The minister gave detailed figures on labs and seizures, said location data could harm investigations, and outlined enforcement, prevention and a forthcoming bill banning groups of new psychoactive substances.
The police indicate that making public the locations where production sites were dismantled could harm the investigative interest.
De politie geeft aan dat het inzichtelijk maken van de locaties waar productieplaatsen zijn opgerold het opsporingsbelang kan schaden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het rapport "Digitalisering aan de grens; Cybersecurity van het grenstoezicht door de Koninklijke Marechaussee op Schiphol" van de Algemene Rekenkamer (20

Two VVD MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers about the Court of Audit's report on cybersecurity of border control at Schiphol, covering approval procedures, security testing, critical systems, crisis exercises and transfer of the self-service system to Schiphol. The government answered that approvals and added security measures are underway with full implementation expected by end 2020, that annual testing is not feasible given staffing, that not all critical systems are yet connected to the SOC, that an exercise and an update of guidelines will follow, and that the Chamber will be informed before any transfer of the self-service system.
The cabinet will inform the Chamber further about the intended decision and the conditions under which it takes place before the transfer takes place.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer nader informeren over het voorgenomen besluit en de voorwaarden waaronder dit gebeurt voordat overdracht plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz–Zegerius over het bericht ‘Zussen kroongetuige Nabil B. halen uit: ‘Arrestatie Taghi voor ons te laat’

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the family of crown witness Nabil B. had a security plan before testimony and after his brother's murder, and whether crown-witness protection rules should be professionalised. The Minister replied that security measures were taken for family members as needed, that operational details cannot be disclosed for their safety, and that a working group is exploring broader crown-witness arrangements to be reported by Q3 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Politie waarschuwt voor vals geld met carnaval, mogelijk via AliExpress gekocht'

MPs Aartsen and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked about police warnings on counterfeit 50-euro notes possibly bought via AliExpress, and what is being done about such platforms and fraud. The minister answers that counterfeit sales are illegal and monitored by customs, police and DNB, that DNB has asked several Dutch parties to stop offering unauthorised reproductions, that a meeting with Alibaba is pending, and that public information already exists so no extra campaign is planned.
I therefore cannot report (monthly) on the offer on an individual platform.
Ik kan daarom niet (maandelijks) rapporteren over het aanbod op een individueel platform.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Lodders over het bericht ‘Boeren in Bladel krijgen massaal drugsbrieven: ‘Mijn cliënt zoekt ruimte voor hennepplanten”

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Lodders asked about fake drug-crime letters sent to farmers in Bladel and whether similar letters circulate elsewhere, and about reporting channels and vacant farm buildings. The minister says the letters were part of a municipal awareness campaign, that similar initiatives exist nationwide, and that reporting is possible via police and Meld Misdaad Anoniem, while promising to inform parliament on the broader offensive later.
A clear picture of the precise extent is lacking, but it can be assumed that such practices occur throughout the country.
Een duidelijk en helder beeld over de precieze omvang ontbreekt, maar aangenomen kan worden dat dit soort praktijken in het hele land voorkomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de beantwoording tijdens het mondelinge vragenuur van dinsdag 18 februari 2020 over het bericht ‘Meeste antisemitische incidenten in Nederland in dertig ja

MPs Yesilgoz-Zegerius and Segers asked the Justice Minister to explain his remarks in parliament that a 2019 Albert Cuyp market stabbing and the 2017 HaCarmel restaurant vandalism were antisemitic/terrorist-related, despite prosecutors and courts finding no discriminatory or terrorist motive. The minister answered that he meant to keep open the possibility of an antisemitic motive, that the word 'aanslag' expressed victims' feelings, and outlined measures such as the Jewish police network and the prosecution's expertise centre to improve recognition of antisemitism.
I made my statement in answer to a question from MP Van Dijk, who asked how I would ensure that every report of antisemitism would be taken seriously.
Ik deed mijn uitspraak in antwoord op een vraag van het Kamerlid Van Dijk, die vroeg hoe ik ervoor ging zorgen dat elke melding van antisemitisme serieus zou worden opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Ondernemers durven politie niet in te schakelen en zwijgen over afpersing‘

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Aartsen asked about reports that entrepreneurs do not report extortion to police, including how many reported cases and advice-line contacts exist and what will be done to raise reporting and protection. Minister Grapperhaus answered with registration figures, advice-line statistics, outreach efforts and a promise to inform the Chamber further on a public-private approach.
I am consulting with partners on how reports from entrepreneurs can be handled in an accessible and safe way.
Ik ga met partners in overleg over hoe meldingen van ondernemers op een toegankelijke en veilige manier kunnen worden opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Den Boer over het bericht ‘Vrijwillig werken bij politie is ook al niet de oplossing’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Den Boer asked the Justice Minister about police volunteers: whether they are used to avoid displacing regular officers, how many there are, whether there is a central competence register, training and waiting lists, and the ideal balance. The Minister answered that volunteers are a valuable addition, that they must not be used to cover capacity shortages, that a Toetsingscommissie monitors displacement, and that the force is working on a national competence portal and expanded training, while providing the figures requested.
However, it is not intended that volunteers be deployed to cover capacity shortages.
Het is evenwel niet de bedoeling dat vrijwilligers worden ingezet om capaciteitstekorten op te vangen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Becker over het bericht ‘Cartoonist Ruben L. Oppenheimer: “Ik radicaal? Ik hecht aan mijn vrijheid” en het bericht ‘Cartoonisten: “We zijn kanonnenvoer op de eerste ri

Two VVD MPs asked the government about threats against cartoonist Ruben Oppenheimer, apparent foreign pressure from Turkey and China, and whether the state will investigate undue foreign influence. The Minister of Justice and Security replied that the reports were noted, that the police are investigating his complaints, that press freedom is protected under the Constitution and existing protocols, and that the government opposes foreign interference but sees no direct link between a Turkish block and threats in the Netherlands.
Mr. Oppenheimer's complaints are known and under investigation by the police.
De aangiften van de heer Oppenheimer zijn bekend en bij de politie in onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Geschiedenisles over de Holocaust op een diverse school: ‘soms lastige vragen’

Two VVD MPs asked the education minister about a report that teaching the Holocaust in diverse schools is sometimes difficult, whether the mandatory Holocaust curriculum is taught everywhere, and how teachers are supported. The minister answered that schools are obliged to teach the Holocaust but decide how, that the inspectorate does not monitor every school, that teachers can use School and Veiligheid training, and that the citizenship bill does not regulate content.
It is important that every pupil learns about the atrocities that took place during the Second World War.
Het is van belang dat elke leerling leert over de verschrikkingen die in de Tweede Wereldoorlog hebben plaatsgevonden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Ziengs over de berichten ‘Trein stilgezet vanwege vrouw met nikab, politie geeft weer geen boete’ en ‘Conducteur aan schandpaal door nikabfans'

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers how the NS and police handled a train stopped for a woman wearing a niqab who was not fined, whether the conductor was supported, and whether action was taken against online harassment of the conductor. The government defended the professionals' discretion, said the police acted in line with agreed procedures, condemned the social media campaign against the conductor, and noted that the NS reported no other incidents since the ban took effect.
It is for the police and the Public Prosecution Service to decide what criminal follow-up is given to a violation.
Het is aan politie en Openbaar Ministerie om te bepalen welk strafrechtelijk vervolg aan een overtreding wordt gegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Nijkerken-de Haan en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘schorsing om herkenbare leerlingen in bescherming te nemen’ en ‘drie jongens opgepakt voor mishandeling Gorinchem’

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Education ministers why students filmed in a violent assault in Gorinchem were suspended rather than arrested, whether the schools protected perpetrators, and whether parents should lose child benefit, plus questions on youth gangs and the number of suspects. The minister answered that police arrested fourteen suspects under sixteen, all six incidents were reported, suspensions were to protect school calm, child benefit cannot be cut for under-sixteens, no national overview of youth gangs exists, and he will report on administrative approaches to street terror before the recess.
Due to the ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot make further statements about this case.
In verband met het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de artikelen ‘Doe iets, anders is het wachten op de volgende dode’ en ‘We laten verwarde personen te lang vrijlopen’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about newspaper reports on dangerous incidents involving confused persons, the lessons drawn, implementation of the person-centred approach, information sharing, a 24/7 hotline, mayors' emergency powers, rising incident numbers, police workload and whether a national approach is possible. The government answered that the approach is being implemented regionally, that the Wvggz and new privacy guidance improve information sharing, that a national hotline is expected in spring 2020, and that local tailoring rather than a single national approach is preferred.
The national reporting number is expected to be ready in spring 2020.
7 , zal het landelijk meldnummer naar verwachting in het voorjaar van 2020 gereed zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘70 amateurvoetbalclubs zien signalen van criminaliteit op de vereniging’

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that 70 amateur football clubs see signs of criminal interference, and what action is planned. The minister acknowledged the signals as worrying, announced a joint investigation with the Health and Sport Minister into criminal interference in sports clubs, and pointed to prevention measures such as governance coaching and the Code Goed Bestuur.
Together with the Minister for Medical Care and Sport, I am going to conduct research into the interference of criminals in sports associations.
Samen met de Minister van Medische Zorg en Sport ga ik onderzoek doen naar de inmenging van criminelen bij sportverenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Drugskartel waste opbrengsten wit: Nederlandse banken hadden moeten ingrijpen’

MPs Van der Linde and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether simple loanback money-laundering constructions are a serious problem, how often they occur, whether authorities have enough capacity, and how cooperation with the prosecution service and gatekeepers can improve. The ministers answered that the scale of money laundering is hard to pin down, that loanback constructions are a known phenomenon without data on their share, and pointed to the anti-money-laundering action plan, public-private cooperation pilots, extra funding and a new multidisciplinary intervention team.
The exact scale of money laundering flows through the Netherlands cannot be determined definitively.
De exacte omvang van witwasstromen door Nederland is niet definitief vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Bosman over het bericht ‘Aboutaleb: kapotte drugsscanners Curaçao gevaarlijk voor Nederland'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports that most drug scanners at Curaçao's port and airport have been broken for years, and what this means for drug flows to the Netherlands. The minister answered that the port scanners have been defective for about two years, that the airport has a working but not fully deployable body scanner, that Schiphol keeps 100% checks on passengers from Curaçao, and that the issue will be raised at the January 2020 Justice Four-Party Consultation, and provided seizure statistics from 2015 to 2019.
The Curaçao authorities state they cannot share operational information about when the scanner is or is not deployed and the reasons for this.
Tevens geven Curaçaose autoriteiten aan geen operationele informatie te kunnen delen over wanneer de scanner al dan niet wordt ingezet en wat de redenen daarvan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Protestmars in Beverwijk om geweld jongerenbende’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Van Wijngaarden asked the Justice Minister about the Pilotenbende, a group of 60 to 80 youths causing vandalism, threats and intimidation in Beverwijk, and about police and municipal capacity to tackle it. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the municipality and police have used cameras, an assembly ban, area bans and prosecutions, that the problem is decreasing but not over, that the matter is a local responsibility, and that ministry-municipality consultation on further help is ongoing.

Although this is a local responsibility of the local triangle, consultation is already taking place between the Ministry of Justice and Security and the municipality of Beverwijk on help with the further approach.

Hoewel het hier om een lokale verantwoordelijkheid gaat van de lokale driehoek, vindt er reeds overleg plaats tussen het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en de gemeente Beverwijk over hulp bij de verdere aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Supersnelle politie-Audi’s staan stil’

MPs Dijkstra and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether police Audis bought to pursue criminals are largely idle for months due to a training backlog of 200 officers, and whether the minister was informed. Minister Grapperhaus denied the idle-fleet claim, said all vehicles are in regular use, that no 200-officer waiting list exists, and that the korpschef is responsible for operations.
The quality of business operations is the primary responsibility of the chief of police. That is why I was not informed about this subject.
De kwaliteit van de bedrijfsvoering is een eerste verantwoordelijkheid van de korpschef. Daarom ben ik over dit onderwerp niet geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Extra uitstoot door afscheid kernenergie’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about IEA warnings that phasing out nuclear power could add emissions, alternatives to nuclear for reliable supply, and how to stimulate new plants. The minister answered that phase-out without replacement would raise CO2 emissions, listed alternative low-carbon sources, said new plants are a market initiative, and noted the Borssele plant is licensed to 2034.
Before 2030, no new nuclear power plant is expected to become operational in the Netherlands.
Voor 2030 wordt er in Nederland naar verwachting geen nieuwe kerncentrale operationeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Tielen en El Yassini over het bericht ‘TU Eindhoven stelt wetenschappelijke vacatures alleen open voor vrouwen’

MPs of the VVD asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether TU Eindhoven opening scientific vacancies only to women is a form of discrimination contrary to the Constitution, and about the underlying figures. The Minister answered that the policy is a permissible form of preferential policy, that vacancies open to men after six months without a suitable candidate, that the Equal Treatment Commission (College voor de Rechten van de Mens) rather than the Minister would judge legality, and that the policy does not affect other forms of diversity.
It is not for me to assess whether this TU/e policy complies with all the strict rules on preferential policy.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of dit beleid van de TU/e aan alle strenge regels rond voorkeursbeleid voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Becker over het bericht ‘Blauwe Moskee biedt podium aan radicale prediker’

Two VVD MPs asked the government whether it could bar a Dutch-national hate preacher from speaking at the Blue Mosque in Amsterdam, whether his hateful statements could be prosecuted or sanctioned, and how the Blue Mosque could be sanctioned for hosting him. The Minister of Justice replied that Dutch nationals cannot be excluded from the Netherlands, that the government relies on a three-track approach with municipalities, that the Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution, and that a bill to expand the ban on radical organisations is being prepared.
In general, it is not possible to exclude Dutch citizens from the Netherlands.
In het algemeen geldt dat het niet mogelijk is Nederlandse staatsburgers te weren uit Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, en Dik-Faber over het artikel ‘Gedupeerden gaswinning moeten twee keer zo lang wachten op afhandeling schade’

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report that Groningen gas-damage claimants face a total wait of about 30 months, as the TCMG postponed its decision deadline by fifteen months. The Minister acknowledged the delay, attributed it to a backlog inherited by the TCMG, and announced a one-off stuwmeer scheme offering a fixed compensation of 5,000 euro to all claims received up to 12 June 2019, with variable compensation up to 11,000 euro for claims from 1 January 2019.
I have decided to enable the TCMG to apply the fixed compensation of 5,000 euro from the stuwmeer scheme to all applications received by the TCMG up to and including 12 June 2019.
Ik heb besloten het de TCMG mogelijk te maken de vaste vergoeding van € 5.000,– uit de stuwmeerregeling te laten gelden voor alle aanvragen die door de TCMG zijn ontvangen tot en met 12 juni 2019
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Tielen over de berichten 'Bij hoogleraar B. moesten de vrouwen hakken dragen' en 'Van seksueel wangedrag tot sabotage van je onderzoek'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Education and Justice about press reports of harassment and an unsafe culture at the University of Amsterdam law faculty and academia more broadly. Minister Van Engelshoven answered that the UvA has taken steps such as external investigation, interim management, a review of confidential advisers and a planned ombudsman, while stating that a broader cultural change across academia is needed.
I will examine together with the LNVH and the VSNU which further steps can be taken.
Ik zal samen met het LNVH en de VSNU bekijken welke stappen er verder genomen kunnen worden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Remco Dijkstra en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht in de Telegraaf “kleine visser zit klem”

MPs asked the government about reports that small fishers are squeezed by offshore wind farms, including access rules, fines for approaching turbines, and the progress of a Noordzee future perspective. The minister answered that the ministries share responsibility, that no record was kept of a meeting with fishers, that wind farms were opened to vessels up to 24 metres from May 2018 under conditions, and that a Noordzee agreement process and a fishing-sector perspective are underway, with evaluation in 2020.
No report was made of the meeting referred to.
Van het gesprek waarnaar wordt verwezen is geen verslag gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Schimmigheid klimaattafels baart MKB zorgen’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that the climate roundtables raise concerns among SMEs, and whether the energy transition is affordable, whether the government will consult SMEs about shifting the sustainable energy surcharge (ODE) to large industry, and whether SMEs can be supported in energy-saving measures. The minister answered that the government aims for an affordable transition, will show the effects of the ODE shift on SMEs before the bill this summer, and will assess the broader impact of the Klimaatakkoord on SMEs and inform the House in the second half of 2019.
Once this overview is ready it will be shared with MKB-Nederland and the House of Representatives.
Zodra dit overzicht gereed is zal het worden gedeeld met MKB-Nederland en de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de informele Transportraad van 26-27 maart 2019

MPs Dijkstra and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether the EU heavy-duty and car CO2 standards adopted at the March 2019 informal Transport Council count toward the 7.3 Mton mobility target, and why NEV 2017 already assumed some of these standards. The Staatssecretaris answered that the heavy-vehicle standards contribute 0.9-1.4 Mton, explained the NEV 2017 assumptions, and said the new standards will be included in the KEV 2019.
The tightened CO2 standards for passenger, light commercial and heavy vehicles will also be included in the Climate and Energy Outlook (KEV) of 2019.
De aangescherpte CO 2 -normen voor personen-, bestel- en vrachtauto's zullen ook in de Klimaat- en Energieverkenning (KEV) van 2019 worden meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat COC wil dat Nederland Amerikaanse haatprediker weert

VVD MPs Azmani and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether the US preacher Steve Anderson, who has made hateful statements about LGBT people, could be barred from the Netherlands, whether Dutch authorities could prevent his public appearances, and whether the EU could jointly blacklist such preachers. The government referred the core questions to earlier answers, said the EU partner states had been informed at official level, and said it will keep raising the issue in the EU ministers' group on extremist speakers.
I refer you for these questions to the answers to the questions from MPs Van den Hul, Kuiken and Ploumen (PvdA) on refusing a hate preacher entry to the Netherlands.
Ik verwijs u voor deze vragen naar de beantwoording van de vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kuiken en Ploumen (PvdA) over de toegang weigeren van een haatprediker tot Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Ondernemer zwicht voor bedreigingen en stapt uit windmolenproject De Monden’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Justice about a report that an entrepreneur withdrew from the De Monden wind farm after threats, asking about condemnation, prosecution, NCTV classification, victim support and lessons learned. The government condemned threats, said a police and prosecution investigation is ongoing, and gave limited operational detail while noting a very small group breaks the law.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service are currently conducting a criminal investigation, so I cannot go into the substance of the case.
Politie en OM doen momenteel strafrechtelijk onderzoek, waardoor ik inhoudelijk niet op de zaak kan ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Rudmer Heerema en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘ADO supporters bekladden Amsterdam’

MPs from the VVD asked the government about reports that ADO Den Haag supporters defaced Amsterdam monuments, including the Dokwerker, with anti-Jewish slogans, asking about arrests, club responsibility, and nationwide stadium bans. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that a complaint is under review by the Public Prosecution Service, that the KNVB and clubs can impose stadium bans as a private-law measure, and that he will discuss antisemitism in football with the KNVB.
In the interest of the investigation, I cannot make further statements about the investigation.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de Daglichtkas

MPs Weverling and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked why the award-winning Daglichtkas solar-thermal greenhouse technology was excluded from SDE+ support, what consultation with the horticulture sector preceded this, and what the consequences are for innovation and the energy transition. The minister explains that the technology was removed from the solar-thermal category since 2018 because of overstimulation risk, that the sector was consulted on the definition, and that the effects are limited but he will consider it when designing SDE++ 2020.
In my preparations for designing SDE++ 2020, I will take the application of solar thermal in greenhouses as a specific point of attention.
In mijn voorbereidingen voor de vormgeving van de SDE++ 2020 zal ik de toepassing van zonthermie in kassen als specifiek aandachtspunt meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Agnes Mulder over de ramingen en beleidsinformatie aangeleverd door het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving (PBL)

Two MPs (Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Mulder) asked about discrepancies between PBL energy projections (NEV 2017, updated analysis) and CBS consumption figures, PBL forecasting accuracy, model transparency and uncertainty margins. The minister answered that the gaps stem from differing assumptions, that the government does not doubt PBL's information, that PBL publishes its models and uncertainty ranges, and that he is working with PBL, CBS and NIBUD to improve communication about household energy bills.
I share the importance of public and verifiable models.
Ik deel het belang van openbare en toetsbare modellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Ziengs en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Planbureau rommelt’

VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the PBL environmental agency's published claims about meat, climate and nitrogen emissions were accurate, and whether policy had been based on flawed PBL data. The government answered that PBL's independence and quality are safeguarded, that the 25-40% reduction concerns agriculture-related emissions only, and that it knows of no cases where policy was based on incorrect PBL data.
In my view, the above sufficiently safeguards independence and quality now and in the future.
Het bovenstaande waarborgt in mijn ogen nu en in de toekomst voldoende de onafhankelijkheid en kwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het nieuwsbericht ‘Leerkracht geschorst na ‘beledigen profeet’

MPs Heerema and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked why a Hoofddorp technical instructor was suspended after allegedly insulting the prophet Mohammed, whether this falls under free speech, and what sanctions could follow if complaints were false. Minister Slob answered that the suspension is a personnel matter between employer and employee, that the Inspectorate found an open school climate, and that he will not intervene in the pending appeal hearing or speculate on its outcome.
It is important that this committee can do its work undisturbed and carefully. I therefore do not wish to speculate about a possible ruling.
Het is belangrijk dat deze commissie ongestoord en zorgvuldig haar werk kan doen. Ik wil daarom niet speculeren over een mogelijke uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Universiteit Utrecht is te wit'

MPs from the VVD asked whether Utrecht University's diversity policy is compatible with rule-of-law values after reports that men and women were seated separately at a student society lecture, and whether the university has rules to exclude events conflicting with those values. The minister answered that the society said seating was free, that gender equality is a core value, that the university's Code of Conduct prohibits discrimination and forced segregation, and that she sees no reason for further action.
Utrecht University has a Code of Conduct that describes the values guiding work and study at the university.
De Universiteit Utrecht heeft een Code of Conduct die de waarden beschrijft die richting geven aan het werken en studeren aan de universiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Dik-Faber, Sienot en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de metingen van het KNMI in de Groninger bodem niet kloppen

Four MPs asked the minister about reports that KNMI seismic acceleration measurements in Groningen were miscalibrated, covering the cause, when officials and SodM were informed, effects on hazard maps and damage assessment, and whether trust and oversight are affected. The minister answered in detail on the timeline and the KNMI error, said data are usable after correction, and committed to an SodM audit and an evaluation of KNMI's internal processes.
SodM is having an independent audit carried out on the quality of the KNMI's measured ground accelerations.
SodM laat een onafhankelijke audit uitvoeren op de kwaliteit van de gemeten grondversnellingen van het KNMI.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Van den Hul, Krol en Özütok over de Nederlandse versie van de Nashville-verklaring

MPs from several parties asked the government about the Dutch version of the Nashville Statement, its signing by a military chaplain and MPs, the Vrije Universiteit's response, effects on LGBTI youth, and biblical passages. The minister distanced the government from the statement, said courts and prosecutors will decide on complaints, and declined to comment on biblical interpretation or engage signatories.
As long as these matters are under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service and/or the court, it is not appropriate for the cabinet to make statements about them.
Zolang deze zaken ter beoordeling liggen bij het OM en/of de rechter ligt het niet in de rede dat het kabinet daarover uitspraken doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Agnes Mulder, Sienot en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Ministerie erkent blunder met energierekening: Tweede Kamer boos’

MPs from VVD, D66, ChristenUnie and CDA asked why the government had used outdated 2017 PBL projections of household energy bills, which underestimated rising prices, and what the consequences are for the 2019 budget, koopkracht and the Klimaatakkoord analysis. Minister Wiebes acknowledges the government should have been less categorical and that the PBL did not update its outlook in 2018, attributes the price rise to market developments and existing policy, and promises a new PBL estimate within weeks.
The cabinet should have been less categorical at the end of last year and should have stressed more that this was a 2017 estimate.
Het kabinet had zich eind vorig jaar minder stellig moeten uitlaten en meer moeten benadrukken dat het hier ging om een raming uit 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Sienot over het bericht 'Zakt het warmtetarief als het losgekoppeld wordt van gas?'

Two MPs asked the minister whether heat tariffs rise with gas prices, whether decoupling them from gas would lower prices, and what alternatives exist. The minister answered that tariffs are capped by a gas reference but not mandatory, that decoupling would likely raise prices on average for now, and that no clear alternative has been identified yet, with further study planned in the Warmtewet 2.0 process.
As part of preparing the next amendment of the Heat Act, I am having possible alternatives to the gas reference mapped out.
In het kader van de voorbereiding van de volgende wijziging van de Warmtewet laat ik mogelijke alternatieven voor de gasreferentie in kaart brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over de berichten "Nederland gaat gewetensvol om met roofkunst" en "Twijfel over teruggave is verwerpelijk"

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Aartsen asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the restitution of Nazi-looted art and the balancing of emotional interests and museum interests in the Restitutions Committee's advice. The minister answered that the ample reasonableness-and-fairness framework is consistent with the Washington Principles, that victims' interests should come first, and that restitution is advised when rightful ownership and looting are clearly established.
In 2020 the policy will be evaluated again.
In 2020 wordt het beleid weer geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Bowi van #SorryJohan doet stap terug: 'Je krijgt veel stront over je heen'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about threats against the initiator of the #SorryJohan campaign and how to promote LHBT acceptance in sport and football, and asked her to work with the Justice Minister on tracing the threateners. The minister condemned all threats, pointed to the Alliantie Gelijkspelen, Sportakkoord and KNVB cooperation, and declined to comment on individual investigations.
On individual cases of threats and investigations by the Public Prosecution Service, I cannot make any statements.
Over individuele gevallen van bedreiging en onderzoeken door het Openbaar Ministerie, kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over stimuleringsmaatregelen voor zonnecel-dakpannen

MPs Moorlag and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked which subsidies, tax reductions and other incentives exist for solar-roof tiles beyond VAT recovery, and whether such incentives apply to them. The minister replied that the SDE+, net metering and innovation schemes apply, and that he knows of no obstacles to incentivising solar tiles.
As far as I am aware, there are no obstacles to incentivising solar energy from roof tiles under the various incentive measures.
Voor zover ik weet zijn er geen belemmeringen voor de stimulering van zonne-energie uit dakpannen in de verschillende stimuleringsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Veldman over het bericht ‘Daar gaan de miljarden’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether neighbouring countries are attracting more foreign investment because of Dutch climate policy, and how carbon-leakage and competitiveness risks would be prevented. The Minister replied that Dutch investment performance is above average in Europe, that INEOS cited pipeline connections rather than climate policy, and that a level-playing-field test and PBL/CPB analysis of the draft Climate Agreement are pending.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Hoe minder kernenergie, hoe groter de opwarming'

VVD MPs Dijkhoff and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked the minister about claims that nuclear power is needed for climate targets, its place in the climate table process, the HAW report, costs, waste and the role of nuclear in Dutch policy. The minister answered that nuclear can be a cost-effective low-carbon option under current rules, that no new plant is realistic before 2030 and that no nuclear permit applications have been filed.
The Climate Agreement process is organised so that it is up to the parties at the sector tables to examine together which options can fill the CO2 reduction task.
Het proces rondom het Klimaatakkoord is zo ingericht dat het aan de partijen aan de sectortafels is om met elkaar te bekijken welke opties invulling kunnen geven aan de CO 2 -reductieopgave.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Hoe energiebedrijven miljoenen stelen van klanten stadsverwarming'

MPs Yesilgöz-Zegerius (VVD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a news report claiming heat suppliers overcharge district heating customers, questioning how the maximum 'no more than otherwise' tariff is calculated (boiler, service contract, warmtewisselaar costs and gas supplier benchmark). The minister answered that the calculation uses average, not expensive, boilers and service contracts, that the benchmark will shift to the 10 largest gas suppliers from 2020, that the ACM sets the tariff annually, and that splitting supply and network management is being studied for the Warmtewet 2.0.
Once this study is completed, I will inform the House about it.
Zodra dit onderzoek is afgerond, zal ik de Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Van Oosten over het bericht ‘Jongeren veroordeeld voor geweld tegen homo’s Dordrecht’

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that youths were convicted for violence against gay people in Dordrecht, the gap between roughly 1,300 yearly reports and very few convictions, how many cases reach the prosecutor and lead to prosecution, possibilities to increase prosecutions, and when insults like 'kankerhomo' count as anti-gay discrimination. The minister answered with 2017 statistics, explained why reports fall away before prosecution, pointed to an forthcoming LHBTI safety action plan, and described the legal test for discriminatory insults.
Together with the Minister of Education, Culture and Science, I will send a Safety Action Plan for LHBTI to your House in the first quarter of 2019.
Samen met de Minister van OCW zal ik in het eerste kwartaal van 2019 een Actieplan Veiligheid LHBTI aan uw Kamer zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over de veiligheid van slimme gasmeters

The VVD MP Yesilgöz-Zegerius asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the safety of smart gas meters, including whether unsafe meters remain in use, how they will be replaced, and whether SodM should get enforcement powers. The minister confirmed that about 1,745 meters with too-short threads remain, that replacement is underway with SodM oversight, and that SodM gains enforcement powers on 1 January 2019.

Through the amendment of the Gas Act in the Energy Transition Progress Act (wet VET), SodM receives broader enforcement powers from 1 January 2019, including the power to impose a binding order subject to a penalty on the network operator.

SodM krijgt door de wijziging van de Gaswet in de wet Voortgang Energie Transitie (wet VET) per 1 januari 2019 ruimere bevoegdheden om handhavend op te treden, waaronder ook het opleggen van een last onder dwangsom aan de netbeheerder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Veldman over de aangekondigde bouw van een scale-up staalfabriek in India door Tata Steel

MPs Yesilgöz-Zegerius and Veldman asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why Tata Steel is building a scale-up steel plant in India rather than IJmuiden, and what this means for jobs, the climate agreement and carbon leakage. The minister answered that the India plant is a necessary step for the HIsarna technology, that no commitment to build it in the Netherlands existed, and that there are no job or leakage effects.
No commitment was made that the HIsarna scale-up plant would be built in the Netherlands.
Er is geen toezegging gedaan dat de scale-up fabriek voor HIsarna in Nederland gebouwd zou worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het inschrijven bij de gemeente Amsterdam

MPs Van Gent and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the refusal to register a child born abroad to two fathers in Amsterdam, whether Dutch law requires a mother on the birth certificate, and whether the Staatscommissie's review of parenthood addresses the issue. The minister explained that foreign birth certificates are refused recognition when they conflict with Dutch public order, that the mother-on-certificate principle is treated as fundamental, and that the government's response to the Staatscommissie's proposals and related studies will follow in early 2019.
A child must, where possible, be enabled through the birth certificate to know its maternal descent.
Een kind moet, indien mogelijk, aan de hand van de geboorteakte in staat worden gesteld zijn afstamming van moederszijde te kennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het feit dat zonnepanelen meegenomen worden in de onroerendezaakbelasting

MPs Lodders and Yesilgöz-Zegerius asked whether solar panels, which owners could remove when moving, count toward the WOZ value and property tax, how many owners pay more, and how this fits the government's sustainability goals. The State Secretary confirmed that panels are generally included as fixed parts of the property, estimated the added tax at roughly 5 to 10 euro per year, and said the tax system will be reviewed through the Climate Agreement and the interbestuurlijk programma before a final position is taken.
There is no overview available of how municipalities handle the valuation of solar panels and whether or not they use the exception provision in the Municipalities Act.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van hoe gemeenten omgaan met de waardering van zonnepanelen en of zij al dan niet gebruik maken van de uitzonderingsbepaling in de Gemeentewet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘NCTV: Windmolenhaters radicaliseren, boeren gesaboteerd’

MPs Yesilgöz-Zegerius and Laan-Geselschap asked about reports that opponents of wind turbines are radicalising, including threats, intimidation and sabotage, and what protection and data exist. The minister condemns such acts, says individuals and employers are first responsible for their own safety, notes police do not record windmill-related offences separately, and cites the DTN 48 threat assessment.
Offences committed in relation to windmills are not registered by the police under a separate code.
Delicten die worden gepleegd in relatie tot windmolens worden door de politie niet geregistreerd onder een aparte code.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het verhuren van dakruimte voor zonnepanelen

MPs asked whether mortgage lenders' ban on subletting blocks business owners from leasing roof space for solar panels, and whether government will intervene.
