The minister says lenders may set conditions, that the banking association has drafted a model deed to ease such leases, that existing subsidies suffice and that the matter is a private contractual relationship where government will not intervene.
There is no reason for the government to intervene in this contractual relationship.
Er is geen aanleiding voor de overheid om in te grijpen in deze contractuele relatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Anne Mulder over het bericht 'Romanian PM clashes with Commission over rule of law'

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Romanian PM Dăncilă's criticism of the EU Cooperation and Verification Mechanism on rule of law and the upcoming referendum redefining marriage in the constitution. The minister said the CVM remains necessary until Romania's reforms are irreversible, expressed concern that the referendum could discriminate against LGBTI people, and reported raising Dutch concerns during his visit to Romania.
The CVM makes an important contribution here and should therefore be maintained until the CIE recommendations are sustainable and irreversible.
Het CVM levert hier een belangrijke bijdrage aan en dient derhalve behouden te blijven totdat de CIE-aanbevelingen duurzaam en onomkeerbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Openbaar Ministerie luistert journalist af in moordzaak broer kroongetuige'

MPs Van Oosten and Yesilgöz-Zegerius asked whether the Public Prosecution Service secretly recorded a journalist in the murder investigation of a crown witness's brother, and what safeguards exist. The Minister acknowledged the recording was ordered with rechter-commissaris authorisation, was never listened to, and was destroyed, admitting internal review was missed; he pointed to the press source-protection bill and revised directive as reforms.

Prior to the order concerning this measure, the required internal review did not take place, and the OM considered that in this specific case the recording was an impermissible infringement on journalists' source protection.

Voorafgaand aan het bevel ten aanzien van dit middel heeft niet de vereiste interne toetsing plaatsgevonden en het OM was van oordeel dat in dit specifieke geval de opname een ontoelaatbare inbreuk was op de bronbescherming van journalisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Yesilgöz-Zegerius  over het bericht 'Wijkagent: 'Haal dat bord met Joodse huizen weg''

MPs Rutte and Yesilgöz asked whether a neighbourhood police officer in Amsterdam asked a business to remove a sign reading 'Open Joodse huizen', how police advise on Jewish and other religious symbols, and how they tackle antisemitism. The minister says police discussed security scenarios with the business, including removal of the sign as one option, outlines existing anti-discrimination screening and networks, and sees no current growth in antisemitism.
In this case the police considered security with the business, discussing various scenarios openly.
In onderhavige casus heeft de politie meegedacht met de ondernemer over de veiligheid, waarbij verschillende scenario's in openheid zijn besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht “Bestaand aardgasnet kan 30% waterstof aan?”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report that the existing gas grid could handle 30% hydrogen blending, and about the feasibility, timing, costs and safety of hydrogen blending as a way to reduce Groningen gas dependence and CO2 emissions. The minister answered that current regulation allows only very small hydrogen shares, that safety issues for appliances make blending impractical now, that large-scale hydrogen use is not expected before 2030, and that the government has no cost insight, leaving that to market parties.
I currently have no insight into the costs.
Ik heb momenteel geen inzicht in de kosten.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht: ‘Basisschool wil geen homorol in eindmusical vanwege geloof leerling’

MPs Heerema and Yesilgöz-Zegerius (VVD) asked whether a Hengelo primary school's ban on same-sex roles in the final musical, reportedly due to a Jehovah's Witness pupil's faith, was consistent with the attainment targets on sexual diversity. The minister answered that schools have discretion within the attainment targets, that she would not assess this individual case, and that the school is itself holding a dialogue on the issue.
It is not for me to assess the school principal's conduct in this individual case.
Het is niet aan mij om de handelwijze van de schoolleider in deze individuele casus te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Remco Dijkstra over het stroomnetwerk rond Haarlemmermeer

MPs Yesilgöz-Zegerius and Dijkstra (VVD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about electricity capacity shortages around Haarlemmermeer and the 29 April 2018 power outage at Schiphol. Minister Wiebes answered that grid expansion is underway, referred to earlier answers on several questions, said the Schiphol outage report is pending, and denied a causal link between capacity shortages and the Amsterdam outages.
I will not go into causes and consequences ahead of the final outcomes of this investigation.
Ik ga niet in op oorzaken en gevolgen vooruitlopend op de definitieve uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Yesilgöz-Zegerius inzake het bericht 'Haven wil CO2 duurder maken'

MPs Dijkstra and Yesilgöz-Zegerius asked whether a Northwest-European minimum CO2 price proposed by the Port of Rotterdam is realistic, how to avoid a Dutch go-it-alone, what investments a €50-70 price would bring, and how to keep chemical industry and the port competitive in the energy transition. The minister answered that the government seeks Northwest-European cooperation and flanking policy, is still studying a minimum CO2 price within the national Klimaatakkoord process, and has sector tables examining industrial investment projects.
The cabinet explicitly seeks cooperation with like-minded Northwest European countries.
Het kabinet zoekt nadrukkelijk samenwerking met gelijkgezinde Noordwest-Europese landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz, Dik-Faber, Jetten en Agnes Mulder over het vertrek van de NCG

MPs asked about the role of the National Coordinator Groningen (NCG) after its director Alders resigned, covering its remit, houses inspected and reinforced, the shift of damage handling to an independent commission, funding, timelines for reinforcing 2,500 homes, and continuity of the programme. The minister answered in detail, stating the NCG no longer handles damage claims, that reinforcement decisions should be made independently of NAM with advice from the Mijnraad, and that continuity is being secured.
Because of these developments, the NCG no longer has a role in damage handling.
Vanwege deze ontwikkelingen heeft de NCG geen rol meer in de schadeafhandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Joods restaurant weer belaagd'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister whether police found no anti-Jewish motive behind repeated vandalism of a Jewish restaurant in Amsterdam, how such cases are investigated and registered, and what protection is provided. The minister replied that the investigation is ongoing, no suspect has been arrested, the prosecutor (OM) decides whether discrimination is involved, and referred to existing anti-discrimination policy and protection measures.
As is known to your House, I cannot make statements about individual criminal cases during the investigation.
Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend, kan ik gedurende het onderzoek geen mededelingen doen over individuele strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat de oudejaarsconference van BNNVARA subsidie heeft ontvangen

MPs Laan-Geselschap and Yesilgöz-Zegerius asked whether BNNVARA's New Year's Eve cabaret show received subsidy from the CoBO Fund on top of public broadcasting funding, and whether this was justified and transparent. Minister Slob answered that CoBO's contribution comes from the public broadcaster's own programme funds, that the decision is independent, that costs are capped at 20% and that the government committed to annual budget transparency reporting by the NPO.
I have no opinion on the CoBO board's decision to make a contribution to BNNVARA's New Year's Eve conference.
Over het besluit van CoBO om een bijdrage te geven aan de Oudejaarsconference van BNNVARA heb ik geen oordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat geld verdienen aan CO2 kan en ook nog goed is voor het milieu

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether legal barriers hinder reuse of CO2 and whether the government will remove them. The minister answered that no barriers are known for CO2 use in building materials, pointed to the Klimaat- en Energieakkoord and the 'Ruimte in Regels' programme, and expressed enthusiasm for CO2 reuse as an emissions-reduction option.
In the case of reuse of CO2 in building materials, as described in the article referred to, I am not aware of any barriers.
In het geval van het hergebruik van CO 2 in bouwmaterialen, zoals beschreven in het artikel waaraan gerefereerd wordt, zijn mij geen belemmeringen bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat miljoenen aan hulpgelden ebola-crisis zijn verdwenen

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether millions in Ebola relief funds, including Red Cross money, had disappeared through fraud and what would be done. The minister answered that about 6 million Swiss francs via the IFRC was lost or misused, that only about 27,000 euros of Dutch donations was improperly spent, that IFRC has tightened controls and will pursue recovery, and that misuse will not be tolerated.
The ministry has a zero-tolerance policy regarding embezzlement.
Het ministerie heeft een zero-tolerance beleid met betrekking tot malversaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat de blokkade bij Jemen volgens de VN catastrofale gevolgen heeft

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Saudi-led blockade of Yemen, which the UN says threatens famine, a cholera crisis and humanitarian aid delivery. The minister confirms the severe humanitarian impact, describes Dutch aid of about 23 million euros and EU advocacy, and says the Panel of Experts report on the blockade's legality is due at the end of December.
The Netherlands will continue to closely follow developments and is in frequent contact with humanitarian organisations about the impact of the Saudi blockade.
Nederland zal de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet blijven volgen en heeft veelvuldig contact met humanitaire organisaties over de impact van de Saoedische blokkade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over de benoeming van de Zimbabwaanse president Robert Mugabe door de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie (WHO) tot 'goodwill ambassador'

An MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the WHO's appointment of Zimbabwean president Robert Mugabe as goodwill ambassador, its purpose, rationale and formal status, and what the government will do. The minister answers that the appointment was withdrawn after Dutch protest, that the WHO gave no reasons or formal mandate, and that no further measures are needed beyond monitoring the WHO.
No, the WHO has not provided further information on this.
Nee, de WHO heeft hier geen nadere informatie over verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over hoge reiskosten binnen de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that the WHO spent about 200 million USD on travel in 2016, exceeding spending on AIDS, malaria and TB, and about luxury travel by staff. The minister confirmed the figures, said most travel costs relate to external experts and member-state representatives, defended the comparison with other agencies as not like-for-like, and said the Netherlands will keep pressing the WHO for cost efficiency without changing its WHO funding policy.
The Netherlands will continue to hold the WHO to account on this and urge it to achieve greater cost efficiency.
Nederland zal de WHO hierop blijven aanspreken en de WHO aansporen om grotere kostenefficiëntie te bewerkstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat Israël een Nederlands ontwikkelingsproject heeft gesloopt

Two VVD MPs asked whether Dutch development projects in Israeli-controlled Area C without permits fit Dutch policy, and whether the embassy notified Israeli authorities that the Dutch-funded project was seized. The government answered that Israel rarely issues permits, that it need not disclose donors, that the seizure lacked a prior stop-work order, and that it will leave coordination to implementing agencies without announcing a change.
As long as there is no fundamental change in the permit system, the cabinet will leave it to the implementing organisations to decide the extent to which they coordinate with the Israeli authorities.

Zolang er geen fundamentele verandering in het vergunningstelsel komt, zal het kabinet het aan de uitvoerende organisaties laten om te bepalen in welke mate zij wel of niet coördineren met de Israëlische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over de vluchtelingencrisis in Oeganda

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether donor countries were failing to meet their pledges for South Sudanese refugees in Uganda, and what Dutch support would be provided. The minister answered that donors pledged USD 358 million at the Solidarity Summit, that the Netherlands committed EUR 5.5 million for refugees and host communities, and that the government will keep pressing other donors to disburse their pledges.
The cabinet is willing to do so and has decided to contribute EUR 5.5 million to sustainable, integrated solutions for the reception and protection of refugees and their host communities.
Het kabinet is hiertoe bereid en heeft besloten om EUR 5,5 miljoen bij te dragen aan duurzame, geïntegreerde oplossingen voor de opvang en bescherming van vluchtelingen en hun gastgemeenschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over de website 'Alt Rechts' (altrechts.com) waar opgeroepen wordt om personen en organisaties op te geven die zich 'volksvijandig' zouden opstellen

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the website Alt Rechts, which listed Jews and 'enemies of the people' and allegedly incited discrimination, and whether complaints and prosecution were possible. The minister confirmed the site was taken offline, that a criminal investigation led by the Oost-Nederland prosecutor's office is underway, that no complaints had been filed, and set out the maximum penalties for discrimination, incitement, defamation and slander.
This will have to become clear from the criminal investigation being carried out under the direction of the Oost-Nederland prosecutor's office.
Dit zal moeten blijken uit het strafrechtelijk onderzoek dat wordt uitgevoerd onder leiding van het parket Oost-Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgoz-Zegerius over het bericht dat in het concept Jaarplan TV 2018 door de NPO opgenomen is dat de berichtgeving rond Nederlanders van niet-westerse afkomst niet problematiserend mag zi

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the NPO's draft 2018 plan, which aims for positive portrayal of Dutch people of non-Western origin, abandons journalistic objectivity and whether the NPO should be asked to discuss this. The State Secretary confirmed the NPO's duty to give balanced, objective coverage, said the NPO was reminded of this, and noted that the NPO accounts for its programming annually in its Terugblik, leaving parliament to assess afterwards.
Following your questions, I have once again pointed this out to the public broadcaster.
Naar aanleiding van uw vragen heb ik de publieke omroep hier nogmaals op gewezen.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat afgedankte Ierse racepaarden in snacks terechtkomen

An MP asked the ministers about research showing retired Irish racehorses entering the food chain in the Netherlands through identity fraud, and about inspection, traceability and slaughterhouse oversight. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging fraud risks, stating that an NVWA investigation of the horse supply chain is underway, and committing to tighter rules and intensified transport supervision.
The NVWA is currently investigating where the greatest fraud risks lie within the horse supply chain.
De NVWA onderzoekt op dit moment waar de grootste frauderisico's liggen binnen de paardenketen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over een verklaring van nationale politiehoofden die betrekking heeft op end-to-end- encryptie

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked the Justice Minister about a European police chiefs' call to weaken end-to-end encryption and how it relates to rulings by the ECtHR, CJEU and EDPB. The minister answered that the government keeps its existing position supporting end-to-end encryption, that lawful access should be sought through European cooperation, and that the rulings are not inconsistent with that position.
That position is not up for discussion here.
3 Dit standpunt staat hier niet ter discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en De Hoop over onveiligheidsgevoelens van vrouwen in de openbare ruimte.

MPs Mutluer and De Hoop asked ministers about high levels of feeling unsafe among women in public space and on public transport, and what measures are taken. The minister acknowledges the problem, cites Veiligheidsmonitor data, says public transport partners are responsible and will act, and promises further engagement and evaluation without firm new commitments.
I call on the parties involved to take up their role in this and, where necessary, to come up with additional measures.
Ik vraag de betrokken partijen om hierin hun rol te pakken en waar noodzakelijk te komen met aanvullende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Als model gelokt, voor de camera misbruikt’

The CDA MP Krul asked the Justice Minister about a Volkskrant report that a recruiter brought hundreds of Eastern European women into illegal porn and prostitution over 20 years without prosecution, and why an earlier government exploration found no signs of abuse in the Dutch porn industry. The minister said signals of trafficking are always followed up by police and prosecutors, declined to comment on individual cases, explained the limits of the earlier exploration, and committed to a WODC study into abuses in the Dutch porn industry.
However, it is not possible for me as Minister to respond to specific questions concerning information about individual criminal cases.
Het is voor mij als Minister echter niet mogelijk om in te gaan op specifieke vragen die zien op informatie over individuele strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de inval van overheidsdiensten bij een brievenbusfirma in Amersfoort

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about a raid on a letterbox-company address in Amersfoort, where hundreds of companies were registered, and how such fraud risks are overseen. The government answered that registration of many companies at one address is legal but can signal fraud, that no single authority supervises this, and that it will conduct a problem exploration of the system, reporting around mid-2025, while pointing to various existing and planned measures.
As your House knows, I cannot and will not go into individual case matters.
Zoals uw Kamer weet kan en zal ik niet ingaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Boswijk over het bericht ‘Als de politie alle Amsterdamse taxi’s aan de kant zet, dan heb je de grootste drugsvangst ooit’

MPs Krul and Boswijk asked the ministers about a report that police could seize large drug shipments if they stopped Amsterdam taxis, and about criminality in the taxi sector, vetting, enforcement and possible law changes. The minister answered that police do monitor taxi-linked crime through checks and investigations, that vetting and licensing rules apply, and that the sector's criminality will be addressed through partner-based measures and a review of the Wp2000 without committing to a specific legal change.
The Wp2000 is intended to safeguard the quality of taxi transport in the Netherlands.
De Wp2000 is bedoeld om de kwaliteit van het taxivervoer in Nederland te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić en Teunissen inzake het toepassen van de Wet aanpak dierenmishandeling

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked whether the Animal Mistreatment Act's new powers (lifetime keeping bans, NVWA business closures, prosecutor conduct orders, RVO educational measures) are being used, how often, and about a suspected pig farm case in Twente. The government confirmed the powers exist, reported very few imposed measures, said the educational measure cannot yet be applied, and declined to comment on the individual farm inspection.
The NVWA does not make statements about its inspection findings at individual companies.
De NVWA doet geen uitspraken over haar inspectiebevindingen bij individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over politiek gemotiveerd geweld

An FVD MP asked the Justice Minister for a list of all publicly known incidents since 2020 of physical political violence against members of parliament or cabinet. The minister replied that no such overview exists, that threats are tracked by the Den Haag prosecutor's team but physical violence cases are handled by the local district, and that protection is the responsibility of security authorities and the NCTV.
No overview is available of incidents since 1 January 2020 involving political (motivated) violence against members of the First or Second Chamber or members of the cabinet.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van incidenten sinds 1 januari 2020 waarbij sprake is van politiek (gemotiveerd) geweld gericht tegen leden van de Eerste of Tweede Kamer of leden van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Teunissen over het gebruik van dwangmiddelen bij begeleide terugkeer

MPs Koekkoek and Teunissen asked about the use of restraints (body cuffs, tie wraps) and force during forced returns, including a May 2024 Dublin transfer to Bulgaria, medical incidents, oversight and whether an independent inquiry is needed. The minister answered that restraints were justified by a prior risk assessment, that oversight by the Public Prosecution Service and the Inspectorate exists, and that no independent investigation is warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service supervises the use of restraint aids for removal and the use of force.
Het Openbaar Ministerie houdt toezicht op de inzet van hulpmiddelen ten behoeve van uitzetting en op het gebruik van geweld.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Ellian over het voorkomen van een moordaanslag op een Iraanse dissident in Nederland

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports of an Iranian plot to assassinate a dissident in the Netherlands, the government's earlier denial of involvement in the Vidal-Quadra case, Iran's use of criminal networks, risks to Iranian dissidents, and listing the IRGC on the EU terror list. The minister answered that the Dutch authorities were not involved in the Spanish case, that an ongoing criminal investigation limits detail, that the government opposes foreign interference and uses a three-track approach, and that there is no EU consensus yet on listing the IRGC.
I cannot go further into the details of an ongoing criminal investigation because this could harm the ongoing investigation.
Ik kan niet verder ingaan op de details van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek omdat dit het lopende onderzoek zou kunnen schaden.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Universiteit: anderhalf miljoen euro schade na studentenprotesten’

MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the Justice and Security Minister about damage and arrests following student protests at universities, and how damage can be recovered from individual rioters. The minister says damage at the University of Amsterdam is estimated at 1.5 million euros, arrests are only available for Amsterdam (about 200 people), snelrecht is used where possible, and recovery is possible via insurers, civil or criminal (victim joinder) routes, with a review of a national compensation fund ongoing.
It is not possible to provide reliable national figures on the number of people arrested or prosecuted following the riots at universities.
Het is niet mogelijk om betrouwbare landelijke cijfers te geven van het aantal aangehouden of vervolgde personen naar aanleiding van de rellen bij de universiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over grensoverschrijdend gedrag op het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how she would respond to a union survey showing widespread bullying, intimidation and discrimination at the ministry, and what concrete steps would improve staff safety. The minister acknowledged the findings, argued internal surveys show a more positive picture, listed existing measures and said the recommendations would be discussed with unions and acted upon.
I have taken note of the report arising from the FNV survey on social safety at the Ministry of Justice and Security.
Ik heb kennis genomen van het rapport naar aanleiding van de FNV Enquête naar sociale veiligheid bij het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans, Diederik van Dijk en Tuinman over het bericht dat de Europese coördinator van het in Duitsland verboden Samidoun, genaamd Mohammed Khatib, op 10 juni 2024 komt spreken op de Radb

MPs Eerdmans, Diederik van Dijk and Tuinman asked whether the government would engage Germany on Samidoun's Radboud University talk, bar the speaker from entry, ban the organisation, and push for EU terrorist listing. The minister answered that the government will talk with Germany, that the universities bear responsibility for event conditions, that the entry ban law does not allow refusing entry, and that listing is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service and the Foreign Ministry, with the motion being investigated.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to consider whether there are grounds to ban an organisation, not for the cabinet.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te bezien of er redenen zijn waarom een organisatie verboden moet worden, niet aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Mohandis over het bericht 'Incassobedrijf gebruikt AI om kwetsbare schuldenaar te spotten: 'Kan bizarre situaties opleveren''

MPs Kathmann and Mohandis asked about reports that debt collector Intrum uses AI to scan correspondence of vulnerable debtors, raising risks of discrimination, privacy breaches and lack of transparency. The minister acknowledged the risks, said the government cannot guarantee AI use is optional for consumers, and pointed to existing GDPR and WKI rules and the forthcoming EU AI Act, while stating the details of Intrum's practices are not yet known and a meeting with Intrum is planned.
From the article, the precise methods or working practices of Intrum are not clear to me.
Uit het artikel worden de precieze methoden of werkwijzen van Intrum mij niet duidelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber-van de Klashorst, Vlottes, Boon en Markuszower over de 'Stichting Plant een Olijfboom'

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about the Stichting Plant een Olijfboom, whose staff allegedly praised the 7 October attack, questioning its ANBI charity status, missing financial reporting, possible funding of Hamas, and calls for an FIOD investigation or a ban. The minister condemned such statements but said the ANBI public-benefit test is neutral and non-prosecutable conduct is no ground for revocation, that financial publication gaps are usually remedied, that tax secrecy prevents comment on the individual organisation, and that dissolution/banning under Article 2:20 BW is for the Public Prosecution Service and the court.
The Tax Authority is bound by the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act and therefore cannot provide further information about individual institutions.
De Belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen en kan daarom geen nadere informatie verstrekken over individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over “recente berichtgeving rond haatimams in Nederland”

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Justice about reports of hate-preaching imams in the Netherlands, including whether prosecution is underway, whether residence permits can be revoked, funding transparency of Ar-Rahmah, and whether municipalities can prevent such speakers. The government answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, that prosecution is for the OM to decide, that revocation is possible only under strict proportionality rules, and that legislation on transparency and informal education oversight is in preparation.
For this reason, it is not appropriate for us as Ministers of Social Affairs and Employment and of Justice and Security to address investigations into individual cases.
Daarom past het ons als Ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Justitie en Veiligheid niet om in te gaan op onderzoeken naar individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over het falend arrestantenvervoer in de Achterhoek

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the failing prisoner transport service in the Achterhoek, the closure of the Doetinchem detention complex, police capacity shortfalls in Oost-Nederland, and a fair police staffing allocation key. The minister replied that the transport service was of limited added value, was being dissolved with its staff redirected to local police teams, that a new staffing allocation system is being developed with results expected at year-end, and that police capacity is under pressure nationwide.
The local authority, on the police's proposal, decided to dissolve the prisoner transport service.
Het lokale gezag heeft op voorstel van de politie daarop besloten om de vervoersdienst voor arrestanten op te heffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Westerveld over het onterecht verwijderen van foto’s en video’s van mensen met een zichtbare beperking

MPs Kathmann and Westerveld asked whether large platforms like Facebook may remove photos and videos of people with visible disabilities and whether this breaches Dutch and EU rules, and what remedies exist. The government answered that DSA transparency and appeal duties and the Dutch equal-treatment law (Wgbh/cz) prohibit disability discrimination by platforms, pointed to complaint routes via platforms, the ACM and the College voor de rechten van de mens, and said it is exploring a dispute-settlement body and a knowledge centre.
On the case you mention I have not received any signals.
Over het door u genoemde geval heb ik geen signalen ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathman over het bericht ‘Geheime afmeldcodes van duizenden alarmsystemen opvraagbaar door softwarefout’

MP Kathmann asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a software flaw that exposed secret deactivation codes of thousands of alarm systems run by SMC and Securitas, including which government and vital organisations were affected and what steps were taken. The minister answered that the NCSC judged the impact limited, that the companies had taken remedial measures and found no evidence of misuse, and that the NCSC issued no general advisory.
SMC and Securitas are themselves responsible for informing their customers about the leak.
SMC en Securitas zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het informeren van hun klanten over het lek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber-van de Klashorst en Van Meetelen over de rellen en racistische leuzen gericht naar kermisexploitanten in Emmeloord

MPs Van Meetelen and Faber-van de Klashorst asked about riots, vandalism and racist chants aimed at fairground operators in Emmeloord, including whether closing hours and costs should fall on the operators, and what prosecution follows. The Minister says municipalities are equipped to handle such disorder, leaves the local measures and prosecution to the mayor and Openbaar Ministerie, and notes that victims can pursue civil claims or request partial restitution of the pitch fee.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide how it follows up on this.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te bepalen hoe zij hier opvolging aan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aardema en Faber-van de Klashorst  over het politieoptreden bij de Pro Palestina demonstratie in Amsterdam van week 19

MPs Aardema and Faber-van de Klashorst asked the Minister of Justice and Security why police did not intervene promptly at the Pro-Palestine demonstration in Amsterdam in week 19, covering masked protesters, violence, the length of the occupation, arrests, costs, intelligence investigation and funding. The minister answered most questions by referring to the Amsterdam mayor's letter to the municipal council, stating that the public order responsibility lies with local authorities, and gave substantive answers only on intelligence limits and on the Wtmo transparency bill.
Responsibility for facilitating and protecting the right to demonstrate rests with local authorities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het faciliteren en beschermen van het demonstratierecht is belegd bij het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Collega’s noodlottig gestorven agent vol onbegrip: 'Waarom mag Robert-Jan niet op politie-monument?''

An MP asked why a police officer who died during a mandatory team-building day, and a covert agent, were refused inclusion on the national police memorial, and questioned the independence of the foundation running it. The Minister explains that the independent foundation board decides admissions under its statutes and regulations, that the memorial is funded via the police budget, and that the current chief will re-engage with the board on a fitting solution.
Under the regulations the board can make that decision independently. Neither the chief of police nor I as Minister can influence this decision-making.
Op basis van het reglement kan het bestuur dat besluit onafhankelijk nemen. Noch de korpschef, noch ik als Minister, kan deze besluitvorming beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over extreemrechtse memes

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the impact of far-right memes on society and young people, the police's capacity to recognise them, the role of platforms and the ATKM, and whether an awareness campaign is planned. The Minister answers that memes are a radicalisation vehicle, outlines strengthening of digital resilience, the Versterkte Aanpak Online and existing removal powers, and promises further steps but no concrete new measures beyond exploring a campaign.
The cabinet is working on a Strengthened Online Approach (VAO) regarding extremist and terrorist content.
Het kabinet werkt aan een Versterkte Aanpak Online (VAO) inzake extremistische en terroristische content.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over het bericht 'Advocaat vraagt om getuigenis van Dick Schoof in zaak van NCTV-medewerker'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether a former NCTV analyst was allowed to store state-secret information on personal data carriers, who approved this, and what the consequences are for the reliability of NCTV analyses. The minister declined to give substance because criminal and Auditdienst Rijk investigations are ongoing, and stated that NCTV analyses follow a validation process and are not shared without the originator's consent.
As soon as the investigations allow it, I will share more information with you.
Zodra de onderzoeken dat toestaan, zal ik meer informatie met u delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over bangalijsten op Telegram

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about bangalijsten (lists of men to be intimidated) spread on Telegram, including whether prosecutors can order takedowns and whether Telegram can be prosecuted under the doxing offence. The minister answered that Telegram is hard to reach, prosecutors can use the rechter-commissaris-authorised takedown power but must weigh feasibility and it requires an international legal assistance request, and the criminal investigation is ongoing.
Using this power first requires an assessment of whether the applicable conditions can be met.
Inzet van deze bevoegdheid vraagt in eerste instantie een weging of aan de daarvoor geldende voorwaarden kan worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘luchtalarm verdwijnt eind volgend jaar en wordt vervangen door NL-Alert’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the air-raid siren system (WAS) is being replaced by NL-Alert, citing risks to coverage, cyber vulnerability and the warnings of regional safety boards. The minister answered that the WAS is end-of-life and costly, that NL-Alert has far wider reach, and that two studies are underway, with local tailoring offered for high-risk locations.
Partly in response to the Eerdmans motion, two studies have been commissioned.
Mede naar aanleiding van de motie Eerdmans zijn er twee onderzoeken uitgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Ouwehand, Teunissen en Tseggai over het bericht ' Yeşilgöz haalt uit naar Tim Hofman na X-bericht over ME'

MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether her social media post questioning journalist Tim Hofman about police treatment of ME (riot police) demonstrators harmed press freedom and journalist safety, and whether she would retract it. The minister answered that press freedom is a great good, that her post was a counter-question about possible police incidents and did not limit press freedom, and that any alleged improper police conduct is investigated.

I also indicated in my post that if there were questions about, or if there were improper conduct by the police, an investigation is always conducted and appropriate measures are taken where necessary.

Ik heb in mijn bericht ook aangegeven dat wanneer er vragen zouden zijn over, of sprake zou zijn van onjuist handelen van de politie, daar altijd onderzoek naar wordt gedaan en waar nodig passende maatregelen worden getroffen.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Paternotte en Sneller over de Twintigste Penning in Emmer–Compascuum

MPs Paternotte and Sneller asked about the twentieth penny, a perpetual erfpacht condition requiring 5% of sale value to be paid to the bare owner in Emmer-Compascuum, including its legal basis, market effects, possible abolition like the thirteenth penny, other support for residents, and similar arrangements elsewhere. The minister answered that the condition rests on the Burgerlijk Wetboek and acquired rights, sees no market distortion, rejects legislative abolition as impractical given EVRM compensation duties, and treats the matter as a private civil-law issue with no government advisory role.
This concerns a matter between the private bare owner(s) and private erfpachters over a possible adjustment of the erfpacht conditions.
Het gaat hier om een zaak tussen de particuliere bloot-eigenaar(s) en de particuliere erfpachters over een eventuele aanpassing van de erfpachtvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht ‘IND hield lage cijfers over ‘nareis op nareis’ vlak na val kabinet achter’

An MP (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether she knew of a report that the IND held back low figures on family reunification follow-up ('nareis op nareis') just after the cabinet fell, and asked for a full factual account, all internal communications and memos, and certainty that the ministry's top was not informed. The government answered that it cannot provide all documents due to their breadth and lack of time limit, points to a process sketch and ongoing Woo requests, and says it cannot categorically rule out information reaching the top but concludes from the process sketch that it did not.
The request for documents is extensive and not limited in time. It has not been possible to meet it.
Het gedane verzoek naar documenten is omvangrijk en niet in tijd afgebakend. Het is niet gelukt om daar in te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat de IND in de zomer al beschikte over cijfers inzake gestapelde nareis

MP Piri asked the Justice Minister and State Secretary about reports that the IND had preliminary figures on stacked family reunification in summer 2023, probing who knew what and when, and why the August 2023 draft note was only sent to parliament after the European elections. The government largely refers to an attached process sketch, declines to name officials, says the former secretary-general was not informed of the draft, and states the draft was only found to fall within the request scope after the February 2024 request.
Sharing the names of officials and their functions is not compatible with ministerial responsibility.
Het delen van namen van ambtenaren en functies van ambtenaren past niet bij de ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldkamp over het artikel 'IND hield lage ‘nareis op nareis’-cijfers maandenlang achter'

Veldkamp (NSC) asks whether the IND withheld low 'nareis op nareis' figures for months and whether a draft memo on the matter reached the Minister or State Secretary of Justice and Security between July and October 2023. The government answers that the draft note did not reach either of them, based on the process sketch, and confirms the earlier letter.
Based on the information presented in the process sketch, we conclude that this is not the case.
Op basis van de in de processchets weergeven informatie komen wij tot de conclusie dat dat niet het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Kostic´ over het gebruik van onnodig geweld tegen vreedzame klimaatdemonstranten

MPs Teunissen and Kostić asked the Minister of Justice and Security about alleged excessive police force against peaceful climate protesters, including a broken elbow and alleged sexual touching, and about press freedom, UN criticism and the right to protest. The Minister declined to comment on individual cases, stated that force is a last resort governed by strict rules and oversight by the public prosecutor and courts, and announced an independent study into protests that push legal boundaries.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals u weet kan ik niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht ‘Abdessadak krijgt klappen van mannen die agenten blijken te zijn: ‘Ik viel flauw vanwege de hoofdpijn’

Ten MPs' written questions (El Abassi) asked the Justice Minister about police conduct toward a citizen who filmed plain-clothes officers and was struck, covering identification duties, phone data access, footage access and proportionality of force. The minister declined to comment on the individual case under investigation, stated the general legal framework, and pointed to complaint and investigation procedures.
As you know, I cannot go into this individual case, which is moreover still under investigation.
Zoals u weet kan ik niet ingaan op dit individuele geval, waarnaar bovendien op dit moment nog onderzoek loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Tielen over de bijschrijfplicht in de horeca

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Tielen asked about the mandatory listing (bijschrijfplicht) of day managers in hospitality licences, including its purpose, costs, screening tools and municipal practice. The Minister answered that the requirement is kept for hospitality businesses under the Alcohol Act, that the Bibob and good-conduct checks justify it, and that the government is still consulting municipalities and KHN on administrative burden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Van Nispen over alarmpistolen die door jongeren worden omgebouwd tot dodelijke vuurwapens

MPs Mutluer and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about youths converting alarm pistols into lethal firearms, including conviction figures, social media sales, youth motives, and cross-border and platform enforcement. The minister answered that 265 of 1,721 weapons convictions in 2023 involved minors, announced a youth weapons action plan review and a National Firearms Focal Point, and said Telegram's DSA obligations and cross-border enforcement would be pursued.
The Judiciary's registration systems cannot search specifically for convictions for selling or possessing an alarm pistol.
In de registratiesystemen van de Rechtspraak kan niet specifiek gezocht worden op veroordelingen voor het verkopen of bezitten van een alarmpistool.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Faber-van de Klashorst over heenzenden jeugdige criminelen na mishandelen conducteur

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether two 13- and 14-year-olds who assaulted a conductor and were released had prior police contacts, convictions, what supervision they received, and what measures apply to their parents. The minister declined to give details on the case and the youths' records for investigative and privacy reasons, but explained the legal framework for involving parents and the grounds for parental authority measures.
I cannot, while the investigation is ongoing, make any statements about a criminal case.
Ik kan, lopende het onderzoek, geen uitspraken doen over een strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de aanpak van recidive bij verkeersovertredingen

An MP asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers how serious recidivism in traffic offences under the administrative enforcement law could be tackled sooner and more strictly, including higher fines, driving bans and criminal-law routes. The minister acknowledged the link between repeat offences and accidents, said the WODC evaluation is ongoing with results expected in 2025, and stated that higher fines or driving bans for recidivists are currently not legally possible under that law.
Depending on the outcomes of this evaluation, follow-up steps must be determined regarding the implementation of the Administrative Enforcement of Traffic Rules Act.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van deze evaluatie moeten vervolgstappen worden bepaald ten aanzien van (de uitvoering) van de Wet administratiefrechtelijke handhaving verkeersvoorschriften.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Veldkamp over het informatieverzoek inzake de coördinator nationale aanpak overlast

MPs Podt and Veldkamp asked why the ministry bypassed tendering for Snel Beveiliging Nodig's mobile supervision teams, why the Chamber was not informed, and about the coordinator's project plan, budget and evaluations. The government admits tendering was skipped due to urgent need, says the Chamber was informed later, and defends the pilot evaluation and monitoring arrangements.
The Chamber was not informed promptly about deviating from the tendering rules, because it is customary to inform the Chamber of this in the financial accountability.
Over het afwijken van de aanbestedingsregels is uw Kamer niet terstond geïnformeerd, omdat het gebruikelijk is uw Kamer daarover te informeren bij de financiële verantwoording.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Faber-van der Klashorst over de strafeis van het OM tegen de verdachten van de mishandeling van een NS-conducteur op het station in Schagen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about the six-month prosecution demand (three suspended) against two Eritrean men who attacked a railway conductor in Schagen, and whether the prosecution guideline allowing such low demands should be reviewed by WODC. The minister called the attack unacceptable, explained how prosecution guidelines work and why she sees no reason for the requested study, though a WODC study on sentencing for crimes against public-task workers is underway with results expected before summer 2024.
The numerical overview of prosecution demands and sentences imposed by judges, requested during the budget debate, unfortunately cannot be provided.
Het tijdens de begrotingsbehandeling gevraagde cijfermatig overzicht van de door het OM geëiste straffen en de door de rechter opgelegde straffen kan ik helaas niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Krul en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Minstens 172 mensen overleden door het innemen van zelfdodingspoeder middel X’

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, CDA and BBB asked the government how it will protect vulnerable people from suicide powder Middel X, given a study finding at least 172 deaths and 70% with a psychiatric history, and why the substance is not banned. The minister says access is limited via an industry code, that a ban is legally complicated and of limited effect, and that additional forensic powers and follow-up research are planned.
A change to the Burial and Cremation Act is currently being prepared, giving forensic physicians more powers to conduct further investigation.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een wijziging van de Wet op de lijkbezorging (Wlb), waarbij de forensisch arts meer bevoegdheden krijgt om nader onderzoek te doen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aardema over de leegloop bij de recherche

An MP asked the Justice Minister about staff shortages and outflow in the criminal investigation (recherche) branch of the police, including training and lateral-entry routes. The minister confirmed the shortage, described training and intake options, and pointed to the police labour market strategy and past capacity increases.
At present we are dealing with understaffing in investigation, so those choices must be sharpened.
Op dit moment hebben we te maken met onderbezetting in de opsporing, waardoor die keuzes scherp gemaakt moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het het lid Eerdmans over ‘de (cyber)veiligheid van Nederlandse offshore olie- en gasplatforms’

An MP asked about threats to Dutch offshore oil and gas platforms and offshore wind parks, the security measures taken, international cooperation, and cyber risks. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the threat is documented in intelligence reports, outlined sector rules, vital-infrastructure designation, NIS2 and CER implementation, and cooperation with other states, while declining to discuss individual incidents for security reasons.
For security reasons I cannot go into individual cases.
Vanwege veiligheidsredenen kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Teunissen over het artikel 'Nederland vormt belangrijke spil in illegale handel bedreigde diersoorten'

MPs Eerdmans and Teunissen asked the ministers how the government responds to a SPOTS/IUCN/Bears in Mind/ELI report that the Netherlands is a hub for illegal trade in endangered species used in traditional Chinese medicine, and what enforcement steps follow. The government answered that one suspect has been arrested by the NVWA investigation service, that enforcement is ongoing, that budgets and capacity are constrained but not quantified, and that it will pursue EU and international coordination while declining to give operational details of ongoing investigations.
In the interest of the investigation, the NVWA-IOD does not make statements about ongoing investigations.
In het belang van de opsporing doet de NVWA-IOD geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Lahlah, El Abassi en Palmen over mankementen in het huidige boetesysteem in Nederland

MPs Van Nispen, Lahlah, El Abassi and Palmen asked the Justice Minister about problems in the Dutch traffic fine system, including imprisonment for unpaid fines (gijzeling), debt, child welfare effects, insurance fines, proportionality of escalating reminders, and the possibility of income-dependent fines. The Minister answered that gijzeling is subject to judicial review and that payment arrangements exist, but declined to adopt income-based fines, a 30% reduction, or a maximum of 150 euro, citing costs and burden on the criminal justice chain, while promising a WODC evaluation and a ministry study on escalation.
We cannot entirely rule out that children were placed out of home at the time because their parent was imprisoned for non-payment.
Wij kunnen niet geheel uitsluiten dat kinderen destijds uit huis zijn geplaatst doordat hun ouder werd gegijzeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over het onderzoek naar georganiseerd sadistisch misbruik van minderjarigen

An MP from FVD asked the Justice Minister about the independence and composition of the Hendriks commission on organised sadistic abuse of minors, the police investigation into the Argos broadcasts, the removal of those broadcasts, and the commission's costs and methods. The minister defended the commission's independence and composition, declined to share the police investigation results or to fund new research, and gave brief answers to several questions.
I am not willing to share the outcomes of the TBKK-LE investigation with your House.
Ik ben niet bereid de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van het TBKK-LE met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Honderden miljoenen aan WMO-fraude: 'Zorgcrimineel heeft vrij spel''

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van den Hil asked about a report claiming hundreds of millions in Wmo care fraud, how municipalities supervise providers and pgb spending, screening, Bibob checks, RIEC cooperation, data sharing and Wmo supervision quality. The State Secretary disputes the amounts, says fraud cannot be reliably measured, outlines municipal responsibilities and tools, and points to forthcoming legislation (Wbsrz, Wmo amendment) and a stimulation programme.

I am currently preparing an amendment to the Wmo that sets out further frameworks for the organisation of Wmo supervision, the independent functioning of the supervisor and transparency in supervision, such as publication of supervisory reports.

Momenteel bereid ik een wijziging van de Wmo voor waarin nadere kaders worden gesteld voor de inrichting van het Wmo-toezicht, het onafhankelijk functioneren van de toezichthouder en transparantie in het toezicht, zoals de openbaarmaking van toezichtrapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het falende communicatiesysteem voor medische noodhulp in Overijssel

An MP asked the ministers whether the new communication system for emergency medical care in Overijssel, which makes ambulances and trauma helicopters unreachable, is acceptable, how many incidents occurred, and why the decentralised system was chosen and not acted on earlier. The minister answered that the IGJ received only two PTT complaints and no incident reports, that the regional ambulance service chose the app, and that a kwartiermaker is working on the broader missiekritische communicatie problem.
Recently, no reports about PTT have been received by the IGJ.
Recent zijn er geen meldingen bij de IGJ over PTT binnengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Krul over het bericht 'Zijn rechtszaken over misbruik straks niet meer openbaar?'

MPs Boswijk and Krul asked whether victims of sexual offences, including minors, can have criminal hearings held behind closed doors, and whether the rules should be extended in light of a Belgian proposal. The minister confirmed judges may order closed-door hearings on request, that no figures exist on how often this is granted, and that existing rules suffice, so no change is planned.
Neither the Public Prosecution Service nor the judiciary has figures available on the number of granted requests.
Zowel bij het Openbaar Ministerie als bij de rechterlijke macht zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal toegewezen verzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht 'Inruim 400 woonwijken ligt tot 10.000 kilo vuurwerk opgeslagen: 'Dat is 400 keer heel gevaarlijk''

MP Van Nispen asked about reports that up to 10,000 kg of fireworks are stored in about 400 residential neighbourhoods, and about the Twente report on fireworks disasters, brigade firefighting instructions, and whether storage in residential areas should be banned. The government answers that storage rules (sprinklers, fire walls, 8-metre distance) apply, that a joint cabinet response to the Twente report is in preparation, that evacuation is now the priority in fireworks fires, and that it will inform parliament before the summer recess on whether rules should be tightened.
Parliament will be informed about this before the summer recess.
Uw Kamer wordt hier voor het zomerreces over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet whether its 2030 targets (housing, social rental share, insulation, affordable rent quotas) were still achievable. The minister answered that progress is on track for most targets, with some delays in housing and insulation of rental homes, and promised further reporting.
For the National Insulation Programme the targets are not out of sight.
Voor het Nationaal Isolatieprogramma zijn de doelstellingen niet uit beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over een conferentie door Hizb ut Tharir in Nederland

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked about a March 2024 Hizb ut-Tahrir conference in Amsterdam, its extremist character, visa refusals, the possibility of banning the organisation, and the status of the government's problematic-conduct taskforce. The minister answered that speech crimes can be reported and prosecuted by the police and Openbaar Ministerie, that the AIVD rates the threat as low, that banning is for the prosecutor to decide, and that the taskforce has no legal basis for sharing case information.
The Openbaar Ministerie can ask the court to prohibit and dissolve an organisation under article 2:20 of the Civil Code.
Het Openbaar Ministerie kan de rechter verzoeken een organisatie te verbieden en ontbinden op grond van artikel 2:20 Burgerlijk Wetboek
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah en Chakor over verbieden van hoofddoekjes en andere religieuze uitingen bij boa’s

MPs Lahlah and Chakor asked whether a national ban on headscarves and other religious symbols for municipal enforcement officers (boa's) conflicts with municipal autonomy and the Code of Interadministrative Relations, and whether the Council of State should advise. The Minister said municipalities have not followed the neutrality guideline since November 2023, so a statutory basis will be sought, while noting no boa is known to wear religious symbols.
That is why I feel compelled to enshrine the neutrality requirement in legislation or regulation, as a majority of the House has requested.
Daarom zie ik mij genoodzaakt om de eis van neutraliteit in wet- of regelgeving vast te leggen, zoals een meerderheid van Uw Kamer heeft verzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over de roep in Amsterdam om het weren van een Samidoun kopstuk

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen asked the ministers about Samidoun, its alleged links to the PFLP, possible bans, prosecution, funding scrutiny and whether a speaker could be barred in Amsterdam. The Minister of Justice answered that Samidoun is not currently under organisation-level investigation, that banning or listing decisions rest with the prosecutor, the Foreign Minister and the EU, and that individual cases and intelligence cannot be discussed, while pointing to a pending transparency bill and a forthcoming extremism strategy.

In this respect, as Minister of Justice and Security, I do not, given the confidentiality, make statements about information pictures and investigations by investigative, intelligence and security services.

Hierbij geldt dat ik als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid gezien de vertrouwelijkheid geen uitspraken doe over informatiebeelden en onderzoeken van opsporings-, inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het afgelasten van concerten van het Jerusalem Quartet

An MP asked the State Secretary for Culture why the Concertgebouw cancelled Jerusalem Quartet concerts over safety concerns, and whether this threatens artistic freedom and was discussed with the sector. The State Secretary regretted the cancellation, said cultural institutions are responsible for their own programming and safety, reported no direct contact with the Concertgebouw beforehand, and committed to exploring with the sector how to prevent future cancellations.
Using this case, I will explore with the sector how we can prevent a situation from arising again in which an organisation feels compelled to cancel an activity due to threats.

De komende tijd zal ik aan de hand van deze casus met de sector verkennen hoe we kunnen voorkomen dat zich opnieuw een situatie voordoet waarin een organisatie zich genoodzaakt ziet een activiteit te annuleren vanwege dreiging.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Krul, Diederik van Dijk en Boon over de berichten 'Staatssecretaris: begrip voor uitstel concerten Israëlische groep' en 'Driehoek wist niets van het besluit over afgelastin

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary for culture how the government will ensure artists can perform safely regardless of origin, and why she showed understanding for Het Concertgebouw cancelling Jerusalem Quartet concerts without consulting the local security triangle. The answers say the cancellation was a security-based decision by the venue, that the state secretary understood it as an exception, that a general guidance document is being prepared with the sector, and that a concert date is being sought.
However, Het Concertgebouw itself made the decision to cancel this concert before advice had been given by the security triangle.
Het Concertgebouw heeft echter zelf de beslissing genomen om dit concert af te gelasten voordat er een advies vanuit de driehoek was gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Peter de Groot  over het bericht 'Pandeigenaren zijn vernielingen door krakers zat: ‘Met een moker heb ik de deur ingebeukt’'

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Interior ministers about squatting, including whether the 2022 anti-squatting law works, how many squats have been evacuated, whether squatting equals theft, and whether online calls to squat amount to incitement. The minister answered that the law's effectiveness will be assessed in an evaluation due in 2025, that existing criminal tools suffice for now, and that prosecution and courts decide on incitement.
Legislation works as a norm and provides a basis for action.
Wetgeving werkt normerend en biedt een grondslag om op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to state, for each 2030 target, whether it is still achievable, including nitrogen halving and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that nitrogen deposition targets are out of reach due to revised critical deposition values, and that organic farmland is growing steadily but a large gap remains, with extra funding reserved.
The nitrogen targets are currently out of reach.
De stikstofdoelen liggen op dit moment buiten bereik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked about progress toward the cabinet's 2030 targets on poverty and debt, and whether current measures suffice. The minister answers that poverty and child poverty targets will not be met without additional policy per the CPB forecast, while the debt target shows a slight rise with no CBS forecast, and commits to informing parliament in early June.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the cabinet whether four education and research targets (zero truant children, 3% R&D spending, fewer than 18,000 early school leavers by 2026, and basic skills by 2028) remain achievable and why. The Minister answered that the targets are not hopeless, described the measures taken, and acknowledged that R&D spending (2.30% of GDP) and truancy figures are behind track, without changing the cabinet's commitments.
The picture that the targets under K, Q, U and V have become hopelessly out of reach is not one we recognise.
Het beeld dat de genoemde doelstellingen onder K, Q, U en V hopeloos uit beeld zijn geraakt herkennen wij niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Brekelmans en Michon-Derkzen over de rellen in Den Haag tussen groepen Eritreers

MPs Becker, Brekelmans and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked the Justice Minister about violent clashes in The Hague between Eritrean groups, the handling of perpetrators, residence-permit consequences, and foreign interference by the Eritrean regime. The minister answered that the matter is under criminal investigation, outlined existing legal grounds for revoking permits, and said the government has taken diplomatic steps and is developing a complaints point for victims of foreign interference.
Since this is still an ongoing investigation, no further substantive information can be provided.
Nu het nog een lopend onderzoek betreft kunnen geen nadere inhoudelijke mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Veldkamp over gewelddadigheden binnen de Eritrese gemeenschap in Nederland

MPs Kahraman and Veldkamp asked the Justice Minister about violence within the Eritrean community in the Netherlands, including whether the government knows the groups involved, whether they are linked to the Eritrean regime, whether violent organisations can be banned, and whether involvement should affect residence status. The minister answered that investigations are ongoing and details of suspects and group membership cannot be disclosed, that the government has no signals of regime direction, that the Public Prosecution Service could petition for a ban under civil law, and that existing residence rules are already strict.
I cannot make substantive statements about an ongoing criminal investigation.
Ik kan geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen over een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over de beïnvloeding van de Eritrese diaspora door de Eritrese regering

MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked whether the Eritrean government influences its diaspora in the Netherlands, what measures will prevent this, and whether a new investigation is planned. The minister answers that the evidence of pressure is mixed, that the OBI approach and earlier measures remain in place, that diaspora taxation cannot be banned under current law, and that no new investigation is planned beyond the earlier study.
The cabinet acknowledges that the social pressure Eritreans in the Netherlands apparently experience cannot be ignored.
Het kabinet erkent dat de sociale druk die Eritreeërs in Nederland kennelijk ervaren niet kan worden genegeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current progress on 19 government targets for 2030 and beyond, with concrete figures per target. The answer, limited to the target of 50% less raw material use, says the government is replacing that target with a new set of national circular-economy goals and that PBL will monitor progress in its next report in 2025.
In the National Circular Economy Programme 2023–2030 it was announced that the target of using 50% fewer abiotic raw materials by 2030 will be replaced by a set of overarching national goals.

In het Nationaal Programma Circulaire Economie (NPCE) 2023–2030 ... is aangekondigd dat de doelstelling om in 2030 50% minder abiotische grondstoffen te gebruiken, vervangen zal worden door een set aan overkoepelende doelen op nationaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to report progress on its 2030 targets, including 100% clean water by 2027 under the EU Water Framework Directive. The minister answered only that sub-question, stating that roughly three-quarters of about 100,000 water-body targets are currently met, that many planned measures risk not being completed by 2027, and that a progress update will come before a June debate and an evaluation at year end.
In the run-up to the Water committee debate of 25 June, the House will receive an update on the progress of the KRW impulse programme.
In aanloop naar het Commissiedebat Water van 25 juni ontvangt de Kamer een update over de voortgang van het KRW-impulsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government for the progress on its 2030 targets for CO2 reduction and R&D spending, citing reports that the targets were out of reach. The ministers answer that the 55-60% CO2 target is within reach given PBL projections of 46-57% plus further measures, and that the 3% GDP R&D target is ambitious, with uncertainty from the paused National Growth Fund.

The PBL indicates that the expected greenhouse gas emission reduction in the Netherlands in 2030, based on the policy on the agenda for which an effect estimate could be made, comes to about 46–57% compared with 1990.

Het PBL geeft aan dat de verwachte broeikasgasemissiereductie in Nederland in 2030 op basis van het geagendeerde beleid, waarvoor een effectschatting kon worden gemaakt, uitkomt op circa 46–57% ten opzichte van 1990.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Flach over het bericht 'Halsema wilde Extinction Rebellion bij blokkade A10 'zoveel mogelijk tegemoet komen''

MPs Diederik van Dijk and Flach asked whether the Amsterdam mayor's tolerance of a banned Extinction Rebellion motorway blockade on the A10, and the prosecution policy of not pursuing single Wom offences, weakens enforcement of the law. The ministers answered that the mayor has primary responsibility for demonstration rules, that the public prosecutor decides on prosecution case by case, that six demonstrators received 200 euro penalties, and that the ministry will address the legal framework in a letter on the right to demonstrate.
We take this responsibility seriously and have therefore reported to your House extensively on it in the letter on the right to demonstrate that you recently received.
Wij nemen deze verantwoordelijkheid serieus en hebben uw Kamer hier dan ook uitgebreid over bericht in de Kamerbrief over het demonstratierecht die u onlangs heeft ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Oud-NCTV-chef Schoof werd gewaarschuwd dat burgers online volgen via nepaccounts waarschijnlijk niet mocht'

MPs Six Dijkstra and Van Nispen asked whether the NCTV knowingly continued internet monitoring via fake accounts without a legal basis, and why documents were released only after a court order. The minister denies the NCTV acted unlawfully, says the legal view was long held to be defensible, admits the Woo deadline was overrun, and points to new supervision under the 2023 coordination act.
It is not good that the statutory period within which documents should be provided has been exceeded.
Het is niet goed dat de wettelijke termijn waarbinnen stukken behoren te worden verstrekt is overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Politie vindt steeds vaker met AI gemaakte kinderporno: groot probleem’

An MP asked the ministers how far AI-generated child sexual abuse material is increasing, whether platforms and tech firms should remove it, what the EU AI and Digital Services Acts and the Dutch bill on administrative action against online CSAM contribute, and how police handle AI-enabled extortion of young people. The government answered that AI-generated CSAM is punishable and rising but still a small share, that detection and tracing remain hard, and pointed to the DSA, AI Act, the pending bill and reporting facilities.
Although no exact figures are available because the total number of images is not recorded, the TBKK indicates that an increase in AI-generated material is observed.

Hoewel er geen exacte cijfers beschikbaar zijn omdat het totaal aantal afbeeldingen niet wordt geregistreerd, geeft het Team ter bestrijding van Kinderpornografie en Kindersekstoerisme (TBKK) aan dat er wel een toename van AI-gegenereerd materiaal wordt waargenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current status of its 2030 targets, including halving road deaths. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management answers only the road-casualty sub-question: the target is likely too ambitious, the cabinet keeps existing measures and will examine an extra step, with results expected mid-2024.
For question 2, under e, you will receive a separate answer from me shortly.
Voor vraag 2, onder e, zult u op korte termijn een separaat antwoord van mij ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen zoals in deze vragen geformuleerd onder i, j, r, s en t

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government about progress on cabinet targets for 2030 and 2040, including zero homelessness, zero youth in closed youth care, reducing health inequalities and reducing overweight. The State Secretary replied that targets are ambitious but progress is partial: homelessness and overweight targets are unlikely to be met without intensified measures, closed placements have fallen but zero is not yet reached, and the health-inequality mission has no quantitative forecast yet.
The calculation shows that the agreements do contribute to fewer people with overweight, but with the actions from the NPA introduced in recent years the ambitions for 2040 will not be achieved.

De doorrekening laat zien dat de afspraken weliswaar bijdragen aan minder mensen die overgewicht hebben, maar met de acties uit het NPA die de afgelopen jaren zijn ingevoerd worden de ambities voor 2040 niet bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het online gebiedsverbod

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether she accepts that a court ruled a municipal ban on online expression unconstitutional yet the Amsterdam mayor imposed one anyway, and whether she will propose national legislation on online incitement. The minister declined to judge the mayor's emergency power, noting the cases differ and are for the council or court, and promised a policy response to parliament by May.
The mayor of Amsterdam informed me that she has used her emergency order power under Article 175 of the Municipalities Act.
De burgemeester van Amsterdam heeft mij laten weten dat zij gebruik heeft gemaakt van haar noodbevelsbevoegdheid op grond van artikel 175 van de Gemeentewet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veltman over bevoegdheden van gemeenten en provincies voor het verbeteren van verkeersveiligheid

MP Veltman asked whether the government supports giving municipalities and provinces their own powers to buy and place speed cameras, and whether boa's (special investigating officers) can enforce speeding and alcohol checks. The Minister answered that the proposal needs further study, lists existing municipal options and the planned expansion of cameras, but rejects municipal camera ownership and boa enforcement of speeding and alcohol offences, citing criminal-justice capacity and governance concerns.
In addition, we will shortly invite the parties involved in traffic enforcement to discuss the concerns and proposals as shared with us in the proposal.
Daarnaast nodigen wij de betrokken partijen bij verkeershandhaving binnenkort uit om in gesprek te gaan over de zorgen en voorstellen zoals deze in de propositie met ons zijn gedeeld.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Uitermark over de artikelen 'Onrust binnen het OM over aanpak van overlastgevende asielzoekers, die een boete betalen middels een celstraf” en 'Met zijn lik-op-stukbeleid zoekt het OM opnie

An MP asked the Justice Minister about press reports that the Public Prosecution Service issued a working instruction letting prosecutors use fines with pre-trial detention set-off against asylum seekers committing minor offences, raising concerns about unlawful detention and political motives. The Minister answered that the instruction was a non-binding route map, the set-off instrument has not been applied because systems are not ready, the detention length depends only on investigative interest, and work on the instrument as a general option is ongoing.
The length of the pre-trial detention is therefore determined solely by the investigative interest and not by the (desired) height of the fine.
De lengte van de inverzekeringstelling wordt dus uitsluitend bepaald door het onderzoeksbelang en niet door de (gewenste) hoogte van de geldboete.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Faber-van der Klashorst over XR en Greta Thunberg

An MP of the PVV asked the Minister of Justice about Extinction Rebellion road blockades in The Hague involving Greta Thunberg, whether the Public Prosecution Service was right that a road blockade cannot lead to pre-trial detention, and whether the OM's knowledge is adequate. The Minister declined to comment on individual cases, explained that the Wom offence is only an infringement so pre-trial detention is not possible, that article 162 Sr is a crime requiring danger to traffic and assessed case by case by the OM, and said she has no concern about OM knowledge.
As Minister of Justice and Security, it is not appropriate for me to comment on individual cases.
Het past mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid niet om in te gaan op individuele casuïstiek.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de documentaire ‘Jehovah – Van God Los’ over seksueel misbruik in de gemeenschap van Jehovah’s Getuigen, harde uitsluiting uit de gemeenschap en zelfs suïcides

An MP asked the Ministers about a documentary on sexual abuse, shunning and suicides within Jehovah's Witnesses, asking about internal handling of abuse reports, the confidentiality of internal records, the ANBI status of religious organisations, and whether shunning should be criminalised.
