The government answered that victims must be able to report to Dutch authorities, that privacy rules apply to the community's records, that the ANBI rules are neutral but the government can speak out, that a helpline platform and further research are planned, and that criminalising exclusion is not appropriate.
Regardless of the internal procedures of a religious community, victims must in all cases have the possibility to report crimes within the Dutch legal system.
Ongeacht de interne procedures van een religieuze gemeenschap, moeten slachtoffers in alle gevallen de mogelijkheid hebben om binnen het Nederlandse rechtssysteem aangifte te doen van misdrijven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht dat een ME'er in Arnhem zijn taak niet wilde uitvoeren vanwege zijn religie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether it is acceptable that riot police officers may selectively refuse assignments for religious reasons, and what traumatic experiences were meant in an earlier answer. The minister answered that such assignments are carried out under the authority of management, that dilemmas can be discussed with supervisors who may re-roster staff, and that no figures exist on how often this occurs, though the police describe it as exceptional.
No figures are known on this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Veldkamp, Van Nispen en Koekkoek over gestapelde gezinshereniging

MPs Piri, Veldkamp, Van Nispen and Koekkoek asked the Minister of Justice and Security why she claimed thousands of people were affected by chained family reunification (nareis-op-nareis), given IND's uncertainty and expert signals of a marginal phenomenon, and how this squares with the cabinet's fall. The Minister answered that her conclusion rested on general family reunification figures and IND's Stand van de uitvoering 2023, that the law leaves room for misuse, that a broad migration package could not be agreed and the change is left to a next cabinet.
I concluded, based on the general figures on family reunification plus the total inflow figures and the IND's Stand van de uitvoering, that chained family reunification is a problem.
Ik heb op basis van de algemene cijfers over nareis plus de totale instroom cijfers en de Stand van de uitvoering 5 van de IND geconcludeerd dat nareis op nareis een knelpunt is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Politie pakt waker op bij abortuskliniek’

An SGP MP asked the ministers whether a single-person protest outside an abortion clinic, which led to a six-hour detention, was lawful and protected by freedom of expression, and what municipalities are told about such protests. The minister answered that the police act under local authority, that single-person protests fall under Article 7 of the Constitution rather than the Wom, that content cannot justify a ban though municipalities may set form rules, and that only courts can judge the lawfulness of local restrictions.
It is not for me or the Minister of Justice and Security to intervene in individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij of aan de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om te treden in individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul, Diederik van Dijk en Jansen over het bericht 'Coffeeshops Tilburg en Breda mogen meer legale cannabisvoorraad in huis hebben: ‘genoeg voor een week’'

Four MPs asked whether the government had decided to raise the legal cannabis stock limit for coffeeshops in Tilburg and Breda beyond one week's supply, and why parliament learned of it only through the media. The minister replied that the 500-gram local limit was dropped after burgemeesters found it unworkable, that the change was previously announced in parliament, and that police and prosecutors raised no objections though they suggested a fixed weight.
Question 3: Why must the House learn from the media that the government is dropping a uniform norm altogether
Vraag 3 Waarom moet de Kamer in de media vernemen dat de regering een uniforme norm in het geheel loslaat
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Diederik van Dijk en Dijk over de interactieve tablettour van het Nationaal Holocaustmuseum voor groepen leerlingen uit het voortgezet onderwijs

Three MPs asked whether the government recognises the value of school visits to the Holocaust Museum, whether it will push all secondary pupils to visit, and whether free museum admission for all Dutch citizens will be explored. The government agrees Holocaust education matters, says schools must take the initiative, points to existing school funding and a forthcoming national Holocaust education plan, and leaves museum pricing to the museum itself.
However, it is up to schools themselves to take the initiative here and to look at which activity fits the school and target group.
Het is echter aan scholen zelf om hier initiatief toe te nemen en te kijken welke activiteit past bij de school en doelgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller Waterstaat over het bericht '65 miljoen euro schade door ontplofte lachgascilinders, kabinet overweegt compensatie'

An MP asked the government about explosions at waste processors caused by discarded nitrous oxide cylinders, the resulting 65 million euro in damage, and whether the state will compensate waste companies and municipalities. The government says the explosions stem from illegal disposal, that a direct national compensation is not appropriate and not feasible, and that it will inform the House separately while exploring producer responsibility options.
The cabinet has indicated it is willing to explore whether a financial contribution is possible for measures that help mitigate the risks in the waste sector.

Het kabinet heeft aangegeven bereid te zijn te verkennen of een financiële tegemoetkoming mogelijk is voor het treffen van maatregelen die bijdragen aan het mitigeren van de risico's in de afvalbranche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het artikel 'Serious security breach hits EU police agency'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that sensitive personnel files and communications of Europol top officials disappeared from a secured storage room at Europol's The Hague headquarters, and when the government became aware of it. The minister regrets the incident, says Europol has started a security investigation due to finish in 2024 and HR process improvements, while stating operational information was never affected.
The disappearance of the files containing personal information of Europol top officials is an internal matter.
Antwoord 4 Het verdwijnen van de bestanden met persoonlijk informatie van topfunctionarissen van Europol is een interne aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘Geen straf voor mannen die zich vastlijmden bij 'Meisje met de parel'

An MP from the SGP asked the State Secretary for Culture and the Minister of Justice about a court ruling that imposed no penalty on men who glued themselves to the Girl with a Pearl Earring, and about museum costs, protection and whether a special offence is needed. The government condemned the vandalism, noted the court found it criminal, said the museum bore no lost revenue, and declined to review protection or create a new offence.
Museums, however, do not make public the security measures they take for security reasons.
Musea maken de veiligheidsmaatregelen die zij treffen om veiligheidsredenen echter niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Martens-America over het bericht ‘Geen straf voor milieuactivisten die Meisje met de parel besmeurden: te ingrijpend, zegt hof'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Culture ministers about a court ruling that convicted climate activists for defacing the Girl with a Pearl Earring without imposing punishment, and about related questions on sentencing statistics, compensation for pre-trial detention, the chilling effect on free expression, cassation, museum damage costs, heritage protection, sentencing guidelines and demonstration law. The minister answered that the court found the act punishable, gave statistics on verdicts without sentence, said compensation is for the court to decide, that the prosecution did not appeal, and that existing safety protocols and sector talks are sufficient, promising only a forthcoming letter on demonstrations.
The Public Prosecution Service has not lodged an appeal in cassation.
Het OM heeft geen cassatie ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Palmen  over antisemitisme

MPs Omtzigt and Palmen asked the Justice Minister for a list of all antisemitic incidents over four weeks, the concrete actions taken and the number of people fined, arrested or prosecuted, and for answers within a week. The minister gave partial counts from anti-discrimination bodies and the College voor de Rechten van de Mens, said a full case-level overview would be disproportionate to produce now, and referred the request for incident overviews to CIDI.
The full overview requested, with the manner of follow-up, requires case-level research.
Het door u gevraagde volledige overzicht met de wijze van opvolging vergt onderzoek op zaaksniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over jihadistische illegalen in Nederland en de reactie van het kabinet op eerdere vragen hierover

An MP from JA21 asked the government about jihadist illegal residents in the Netherlands, including whether they are being actively tracked, how many failed asylum seekers with jihadist sympathies left with unknown destination, and why a promised letter and national monitoring pilot were delayed. The Justice Minister answered that the letter was sent on 11 March 2024, that data on these groups cannot be automatically extracted, that about 15 denaturalised terrorism convicts are at liberty with some supervision measures, and that a national return coordination pilot starts within weeks.
The number of rejected asylum seekers with jihadist sympathies who pose a threat to national security cannot be automatically derived from the DT&V systems.
Het aantal uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers met jihadistische sympathieën dat een dreiging vormt voor de nationale veiligheid kan niet automatisch aan de systemen van DT&V te worden ontleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Verzorgingshuis laat stervende patiënt (87) niet meer eten, verpleger kan het niet verkroppen en gaat in de fout’

An SGP MP asked ministers about a reported case in which a nursing home stopped feeding a dying 87-year-old patient, a nurse broke with protocol, and whether refusal of feeding is legally protected. The ministers answered that the OM and IGJ investigations are pending, the patient's right to voluntarily stop eating and drinking is grounded in self-determination, conscientious objections are governed by professional codes, and the assessment of sanctions is for competent bodies.
Pending the ruling of the Supreme Court, the OM's investigation is at a standstill.
In afwachting van de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad ligt het onderzoek van het OM stil.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over de berichten 'Recordaantal meldingen van personen met verward gedrag in 2023' en 'Duizenden kwetsbaren wachten op plek beschermd wonen'

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of health and justice about rising reports of people with confused behaviour reaching police and about waiting lists for protected housing, asking whether ggz shortages and funding cuts cause these trends. The minister answered all 14 questions in substance, rejecting a causal link to ggz capacity and maximum waiting times, while acknowledging long waits and listing existing programmes.

I do not have data on how many homeless people who come into contact with the police over confused behaviour are on a waiting list for protected housing or have previously been admitted to a ggz institution.

Ik beschik niet over gegevens over hoeveel mensen die dakloos zijn en in aanraking komen met politie vanwege verward gedrag, op een wachtlijst voor beschermd wonen staan of eerder opgenomen zijn geweest in een ggz-instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber-van de Klashorst en Aardema over pro-Palestina demonstratie plaats in Amsterdam

MPs Faber-van de Klashorst and Aardema asked whether the government would prosecute or act against a GroenLinks politician who displayed the slogan 'viva viva INTIFADA' at a pro-Palestinian demonstration in Amsterdam. The Minister said the slogan is condemnable, that prosecution is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, that police did not notice it during the event, and that no complaint or criminal investigation has been started.

Assessing whether a criminal offence may have occurred in an individual case is primarily the responsibility of the Public Prosecution Service and, if the case is brought before the court, ultimately reserved for the judge.

De beoordeling of er mogelijk sprake is van een strafbaar feit in een individueel geval is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van het Openbaar Ministerie en – mits de zaak wordt aangebracht bij de rechtbank – uiteindelijk is die beoordeling voorbehouden aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Klaver, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over Russische desinformatiecampagnes

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about Russian disinformation campaigns, including Czech intelligence reports that Voice of Europe served as a conduit for Russian payments to Dutch politicians, and whether the Czech government was asked to share that information and whether further investigation and capacity investment are planned. The answer declines to answer in writing and asks that the questions be put orally in the plenary debate instead.
I request that you put the questions orally during the debate on the report that, according to the Czech secret service, Russia paid cash to Dutch and European politicians
Ik verzoek u de vragen mondeling te stellen tijdens het debat over het bericht dat volgens de Tsjechische geheime dienst Rusland cash betaalde aan Nederlandse en Europese politici
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over ‘de gebrekkige nazorg zoals PTSS behandeling bij de politie’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about inadequate aftercare and PTSD treatment for firefighters, including the lack of insight into PTSD cases, the classification of PTSD as occupational illness, costs and salary deductions for affected firefighters, and whether the government will act. The Minister acknowledges there is no good overview of firefighters with PTSD, says the employer responsibility lies with the 25 safety regions, reports discussions in the Veiligheidsberaad and that a model PTSD scheme is being developed, and promises to keep monitoring and inform parliament.
I agree with you that there is currently no good insight into the number of firefighters with PTSD in the Netherlands.
Met u constateer ik dat er momenteel geen goed zicht is op het aantal brandweermensen met PTSS in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Mutluer over de het bericht ‘dat bij de brandweer PTSS niet wordt herkend als beroepsziekte, in tegenstelling tot bij defensie en politie’

MPs Boswijk and Mutluer asked whether PTSS is recognised as an occupational disease for firefighters, unlike for defence and police, and about support, data and insurance. The minister answered that PTSS is not nationally recognised for firefighters because fire service employers are the 25 safety regions, that a national model scheme is being prepared, and that she will keep discussing the matter with the regions.
There is currently no good view of the number of firefighters with PTSS in the Netherlands.
Er is op dit moment geen goed zicht op het aantal brandweermensen met PTSS in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian uitlevering door de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten

An MP asks the Justice Minister about extradition requests to the UAE, the time needed for decisions, and steps taken after a motion that extradition treaties not become paper tigers. The minister declines to comment on individual cases, says extradition requests have risen since the treaty entered into force, and describes ongoing consultations with the UAE and other central authorities.
I cannot comment on individual ongoing procedures.
Over individuele lopende procedures kan ik mij niet uitlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de publicatie van De Andere Krant ‘Werkte Bellingcat samen met NCTV voor aanval op MH17-journalisten?’

An FVD MP asked the Justice and Security Minister whether the NCTV or other Dutch government bodies collaborated with Bellingcat on an article about the Bonanza Media project, and about Bellingcat's ANBI status, lottery donations and US funding. The minister denied any commissioning, contribution, or structural contact, said the NCTV only prepared a press line, and saw no reason to doubt the desirability of contact with Bellingcat.
Bellingcat did not provide the article to the NCTV for review before publication, and as far as I am aware not to any other government body either.
Bellingcat heeft het artikel voor publicatie niet ter inzage gegeven aan de NCTV en voor zover mij bekend ook niet aan een andere overheidsinstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de banden tussen de Mocro Mafia en het Iraanse regime

The VVD MP Ellian asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether Dutch authorities are investigating links between the Mocro Maffia and the Iranian regime, including reports on the attack on Alejo Vidal-Quadras and the proposal to list the IRGC as a terrorist organisation. The minister answered that Dutch investigators are not involved in the Spanish inquiry, do not actively pursue such links, will not comment on intelligence work, and that the government supports listing the IRGC but lacks the legal basis and EU consensus so far.

Moreover, as a general matter, should mutual legal assistance requests have been exchanged, it is not appropriate for me as Minister to provide information from an ongoing investigation in another country.

Overigens geldt hier in het algemeen dat, in een geval er over en weer rechtshulpverzoeken zouden zijn uitgegaan, het mij als Minister niet past om informatie te verstrekken uit een lopend onderzoek van een ander land.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over geblokkeerde bankrekeningen van Nederlandse burgers, onder wie veel jongeren

An MP asks the Finance and Justice ministers about bank accounts of citizens, many young people, being blocked, often under anti-money-laundering rules, and about whether legal protection and oversight are adequate. The minister acknowledges signals, says no figures are kept on blocked accounts, explains the grounds for blocking and the complaint routes (bank complaint procedure, Kifid, courts), and promises to ask the banks and Betaalvereniging to record blocking data better.
I do not have figures on the number of blocked accounts, the specific number of young people whose payment account has been (or was) blocked, and the reasons why these accounts were blocked.

Ik beschik niet over cijfers van het aantal geblokkeerde rekeningen, het specifieke aantal jongeren waarvan de betaalrekening geblokkeerd is (geweest) en de redenen waarom deze rekeningen dan geblokkeerd zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Miljoenen drugsadvertenties op Telegram, platform laat handel ongemoeid’ en het bericht ‘Telegramdealers: 'De straten hebben rust, zoals jullie wilden'

MP Krul (CDA) asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports that drug dealers openly advertise and operate on Telegram, and about Telegram's failure to cooperate with police and prosecutors and whether it can be compelled or blocked. The minister answered that Telegram's cooperation is lacking, that Telegram has no Dutch or EU establishment (it has a legal representative in Belgium under the DSA), that blocking channels is only possible in limited cases and depends on Telegram's cooperation, and that enforcement options and DSA oversight are being developed, with the DSA implementing law to follow later.
I will inform the House in a subsequent progress letter about the concrete proposals to better enforce the sale of drugs via online channels.
Ik zal uw Kamer in een volgende voortgangsbrief nader informeren over de concrete voorstellen om beter te kunnen handhaven op de verkoop van drugs via online kanalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann inzake exposegroepen en doxing op Telegram

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about exposure and doxing groups on Telegram, including whether such groups should be removed, how the Digital Services Act applies to Telegram and what enforcement tools exist. The Minister answered that platforms bear primary responsibility, that Telegram has no Dutch representative so Dutch enforcement is limited, that the DSA enforcement belongs to Belgian and EU regulators, and that police and prosecutors have tools such as orders to make data inaccessible, but made no commitment to contact Telegram's representative or to ban the app.
I cannot make further statements about ongoing cases.
Over lopende zaken kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Samidoun-kopstuk naar Amsterdam: club riep op ’Europa te verslaan met kalasjnikovs, raketten en kogels’’

An SGP MP asked the Justice Minister whether a PFLP-linked Samidoun speaker, reportedly calling to defeat Europe with weapons, could be barred from entry or from operating in Amsterdam, and whether the Samidoun organisation could be banned. The government answered that the IND found insufficient grounds to exclude him under current criteria, that local authorities saw no basis for a area ban, and that a Dutch ban would be a matter for the Public Prosecution Service, not the cabinet.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service, not the cabinet, to decide whether there is cause in this case to make such a request.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie, niet aan het kabinet, om zich uit te spreken over de vraag of er in casu aanleiding bestaat om een dergelijk verzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over de Russische desinformatiecampagne via sociale media in Duitsland

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about a reported Russian disinformation campaign on X in Germany and whether similar campaigns target the Netherlands, including the adequacy of Dutch law, the EU Digital Services Act and platform responsibility. The minister acknowledged foreign interference risks, said no concrete Dutch cases were identified in the election, pointed to EU and NATO information sharing, announced a review of whole-of-government disinformation policy, and noted the European Commission opened a formal DSA procedure against X.

In its letter of 9 November 2023 the cabinet already announced it would examine whether, and if so how, the whole-of-government approach to disinformation about the core democratic processes should be strengthened.

In de brief 9 november 2023 heeft het kabinet daarom al aangekondigd te onderzoeken of, en zo ja hoe, de Rijksbrede aanpak van desinformatie over de kernprocessen van de democratie versterkt moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Roep in Amsterdam om weren Samidoun kopstuk'

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked whether Amsterdam or the national government can ban Samidoun-linked speaker Mohamed al Khatib from events in the Netherlands, given his alleged membership of a banned terrorist organisation. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the IND found insufficient grounds for exclusion, that local authorities cannot impose a ban on the closed event, and that the government will keep monitoring the risks.

On the basis of the available information, there is insufficient ground in this case to conclude that the person's individual conduct constitutes a genuine, present and sufficiently serious threat to a fundamental interest of society.

Op basis van de beschikbare informatie is er in deze zaak onvoldoende grond om te concluderen dat het persoonlijk gedrag van betrokkene een werkelijke, actuele en voldoende ernstige bedreiging voor een fundamenteel belang van de samenleving vormt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Koekoek over het niet op tijd invoeren van de Uitvoeringswet digitaledienstenverordening (DSA)

MPs Kathmann and Koekkoek asked why the Dutch Digital Services Act implementation law (Uitvoeringswet DSA) was not in force by the EU deadline, what legal powers the ACM has meanwhile, and how to avoid future delays. The minister answered that the 15-month deadline was too short for a formal law, that the ACM was provisionally designated by ministerial order, that the bill would be submitted around March 2024, and that the Commission alone supervises very large platforms.
The bill itself contains no further rules that intermediary service providers must comply with.
Het wetsvoorstel zelf bevat geen nadere regels waar aanbieders van tussenhandeldiensten zich aan moeten houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het nieuws dat er miljoenen euro's extra nodig zijn om de brandweer in Noord-Holland Noord overeind te houden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the Noord-Holland Noord safety region needs several million euros more to keep fire brigade capacity adequate, and whether staffing and safety are at risk. The minister said the safety board is free to allocate its funds within legal frameworks, that municipalities are responsible for providing resources, that staffing is currently still responsible but under pressure, and that volunteer recruitment is primarily a regional responsibility.
The board of the safety region is free to spend these funds at its own discretion provided current regulations are complied with.
Het bestuur van de veiligheidsregio is vrij deze middelen naar eigen inzicht te besteden mits aan vigerende regelgeving wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over het artikel 'Veiligheidsregio gebruikte jarenlang Chinese apparatuur ondanks spionagerisico’s'

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether Dutch safety regions used Chinese network equipment despite espionage risks and whether they will map this. The minister said there is no complete overview, leaves risk assessment to the regions' boards, and promised to discuss the matter with the regions.
No. I do not have a complete picture of which network equipment is used by safety regions.
Nee. Ik heb geen volledig zicht op welke netwerkapparatuur wordt gebruikt door veiligheidsregio’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over de Kamerbrief over de inzet voor de jaarlijkse Vergadering van verdragspartijen van het Statuut van Rome

MP Brekelmans asked the government about its stance on possibly amending Article 15bis of the Rome Statute to extend ICC jurisdiction over the crime of aggression, including risks to relations with the US, interaction with Article 8bis(2)(f), and the Responsibility to Protect. Minister Bruins Slot answered that the Dutch position is unchanged, that the government will assess in 2024 whether to propose an amendment with like-minded partners, and that it will inform parliament before any formal diplomatic step.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Aantal tbs’ers wéér gestegen, maar geen plek in klinieken: krijgen enorme bedragen uitgekeerd.'

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about reports that the number of tbs patients rose while clinic places stayed short, and that the state pays compensation to those held in prisons while waiting. Minister Weerwind answers in detail with waiting-time and payout figures, acknowledges staff shortages and capacity strain, and says he has asked WODC to study the effects of prison detention on tbs treatment, but gives no firm capacity commitments.
I have therefore asked the Research and Documentation Centre (WODC) to carry out research into this.
Ik heb daarom het Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek- en Datacentrum (WODC) gevraagd hier een onderzoek naar uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het schrappen van verkrachting uit Europese wetgeving over gendergerelateerd geweld

An MP asked the Justice Minister why the Netherlands opposes including rape in EU rules on gender-based violence, while other member states support it and the Netherlands passed a broader sexual offences law. The minister answered that the Netherlands follows the Legal Service's advice on EU competence and legal risk, that the directive still strengthens victim protection, and that the position will not be revised.
The majority of member states, including the Netherlands, do not want to accept the legal risks connected to EU harmonisation of the criminalisation in question.
De meerderheid van de lidstaten, waaronder Nederland, wil de juridische risico's die verbonden zijn aan de EU-harmonisatie van de genoemde strafbaarstelling niet accepteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Abassi en Ergin over het NOS-bericht “Problemen op werk door uitspraken over Gaza-Israël, soms zelfs ontslag"

MPs El Abassi and Ergin asked ministers about a NOS report on employees facing problems at work, even dismissal, over pro-Palestinian statements, asking whether civil servants can be ordered to remove online posts, whether dismissal for such posts is justified, what they will do about reported unsafe workplaces, whether a national reporting point will be set up, and whether a DJI employee was dismissed on the spot for sharing a video. The minister answered that civil servants have free speech subject to limits in the Ambtenarenwet, that dismissal is a matter for courts and the employer, that the government will strengthen workplace safety and consider mandatory codes and complaint procedures, but declined to create a national reporting point and declined to comment on individual cases.
This concerns a matter between an employer and an employee. As is customary, individual cases are not discussed.
Dit betreft een aangelegenheid tussen een werkgever en een medewerker. Zoals gebruikelijk wordt er niet ingegaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht ‘dat de politie experimenteert met gezichtsherkenning, maar wetgeving ontbreekt’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police experimentation with facial recognition in the absence of clear legislation, including the police deployment framework, its external involvement, the Dutch Data Protection Authority's view on the legal basis, and the approval of the FaceF1nder software in a specific case. The minister replied that the police framework was shared with parliament, that the legal basis exists in the Police Act and the Police Data Act, that the internal review committee decides independently but the competent authority makes the final call, and that a possible explicit basis in the Code of Criminal Procedure depends on the final EU AI Regulation.
It is however possible to include an explicit basis for the power to use facial recognition technology in the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Het is wel mogelijk om voor de bevoegdheid om gebruik te maken van gezichtsherkenningstechnologie een expliciete grondslag op te nemen in het Wetboek van Strafvordering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber- Van de Klashorst en Deen over de berichtgeving ‘Aboutaleb wil minder communicatie over geweldsexplosie Rotterdam'

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the Rotterdam mayor, by reducing active communication about violent incidents, endangers citizens' safety and fails in his duty, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister replied that communication is a matter for local authorities and the municipal council, that the minister will not interfere in local decision-making, but that the topic is discussed regularly with partners and action will be taken if warranted.
The Rotterdam municipal council is therefore the appropriate place for the debate on communication about incidents involving explosives.
De gemeenteraad van Rotterdam is derhalve de aangewezen plek voor het debat over communicatie over incidenten met explosieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber-van de Klashorst en Vondeling over een moeder die voor gerechtigheid vecht na de dood van haar zoon

MPs Vondeling and Faber-van de Klashorst asked about the case of a 22-year-old killed by a driver who was speeding and under the influence, including why he was released from pre-trial detention, why the hearing took 14 months, whether sentences are too low, and whether friends of victims should get speaking rights in court. The Minister declined to comment on the pending case, pointed to 2020 tougher traffic-offence laws, ongoing reforms on driving bans and drink-driving, and said speaking rights for close friends will be considered in the new Code of Criminal Procedure.
No statements will be made about the present case, as it is still before the judge, and any investigation results are subject to the judge's assessment.
Over de onderhavige zaak worden geen mededelingen gedaan, nu deze nog onder de rechter is, en eventuele onderzoeksresultaten aan het oordeel van de rechter onderworpen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Sneller over ‘Quantumproof encryptie’

MP Sneller (D66) asked the government about the risks quantum computers pose to encryption, how Dutch law compares to the US quantum-safe migration mandate, what support organisations receive, and what research is underway. State Secretary Van Huffelen answered that the government is preparing a cross-government quantum-safe cryptography programme and guidance, but that no equivalent binding US-style migration obligation exists in the Netherlands, relying instead on existing EU and national cybersecurity rules.
Starting preparations now is therefore necessary in order to spread risks, effort and costs.
Nu beginnen met voorbereiden is dan ook noodzakelijk om risico's, inspanning en kosten te kunnen spreiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel ‘Baasje van ‘barbaarse’ bijthond lijkt van aardbodem verdwenen’

An MP asked the ministers whether the owner of a dog that killed a small dog, and who was ordered by a civil court to pay compensation but cannot be found, will be tracked down, and about dog-bite registration, a national reporting point and mandatory dog-owner courses. The minister answered that the case is civil rather than criminal, that enforcement runs through a bailiff, that a national reporting point is planned, and that the detailed bite-prevention measures will be sent to parliament after the summer.
The Judiciary does not keep figures on cases in which owners of a biting dog fail to comply with a court judgment.
Antwoord 4 De Rechtspraak houdt geen cijfers bij over zaken waarbij eigenaren van een bijthond het vonnis van de rechter niet nakomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema, Claassen, Faber-van de Klashorst en Aardema over het toenemend geweld tegen zorgverleners

PVV MPs asked the health and justice ministers about rising violence against care workers, including reporting of assaults, sentencing, protective equipment costs, a ban on community sentences, mandatory anti-aggression courses and refusing treatment of violent patients. The minister answered at length, citing ongoing consultations, regional meetings and a pending sentencing study, while declining to give several figures or a cost overview.
No, I do not have an overview of this at my disposal.
Nee, ik heb hier geen overzicht van tot mijn beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Grinwis en Bikker over het bericht ‘NS verbiedt christelijke jongeren flyers uit te delen op Utrecht Centraal: ‘Dit is propaganda’’

Three ChristenUnie MPs asked whether NS's ban on Christian youths handing out evangelism flyers at Utrecht Centraal, which NS called propaganda, restricts religious and expression freedom, and why pro-Palestine demonstrations there were not stopped. The minister replied that NS and ProRail may enforce station house rules requiring permission for distributing texts regardless of content, that the assessment belongs to NS and local authorities, and that he will not comment on their earlier decisions.
It is not for me to enter into the assessment that NS security and service staff made on site.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de afweging die de veiligheid- en servicemedewerkers van NS ter plaatse hebben gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Temmink over de lobby-activiteiten van oud-bewindspersonen bij de IND

MPs Marijnissen and Temmink asked about IND lobbying meetings with former ministers Verdonk and Teeven on Indonesian nurse visas, whether procedures changed, the ministry's whistleblower cases, ministers' agenda transparency, and a lobby register. The government answered that the IND's decision was based on rules and not affected by the meetings, that no procedures were changed, and that agenda publication will be improved while a lobby register is deferred pending research.
The cabinet recognises the importance of transparent representation of interests.
Het kabinet onderkent het belang van transparante belangenvertegenwoordiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Hoe een schaduwteam van Yeşilgöz een omstreden asielaanpak doorvoerde’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about an NRC report on a 'shadow team' that shaped the asylum approach to nuisance-causing asylum seekers, raising concerns about ethnic profiling, unclear definitions of nuisance, pressure on the Public Prosecution Service, and procurement rules. The Minister denies ethnic profiling is permitted or occurred, says the Public Prosecution Service acts independently, defends the approach as operating within existing law, and declines to publish the internal documents directly, referring to a separate information request response.
By letter of 1 March, the request for information from MP Podt on this matter has been carried out.
Bij brief van 1 maart jl. is er uitvoering gegeven aan het Informatieverzoek van lid Podt hieromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht dat een ME’er in Arnhem zijn taak niet wilde uitvoeren vanwege zijn religie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether it is unacceptable that a riot police officer refused a duty at Arnhem for religious reasons, and what will be done to ensure officers serve the law over personal beliefs. The minister answered that officers must act neutrally under the chain of command, that dilemmas can be discussed with supervisors and reassignment considered, and that the Beroepscode and training already address this.
Employees carry out their tasks subordinate to the competent authority.
Medewerkers voeren hun taak uit ondergeschikt aan het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Westerveld over het bericht 'Tom Klaassen belandde in een ‘zorgvacuüm’ en stierf terwijl nog overlegd werd wie hem moest helpen'

MPs Dijk and Westerveld asked about the lack of care for complex psychiatric patients with addiction, the removal of facilities, palliative care as a suggested solution, a confidential mental health report, and funding. The Minister acknowledges gaps in integrated treatment but disputes many claims, points to existing programmes, rejects palliative care as a substitute for shortfalls, and says the NZa will be asked to look at funding again later.
No national data is collected on the local supply of the various types of shelter places and facilities for people with addiction problems.
Over het lokale aanbod van de verschillende soorten opvangplekken en voorzieningen voor mensen met verslavingsproblematiek wordt geen landelijke data verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de uitzending ‘Vape-industrie heeft lak aan overheid’ van De Hofbar op 23 januari jl.

An MP asks the government about flavoured vapes still being sold despite the flavour ban since 1 January 2024, weak NVWA enforcement, banned vape accessories, and a licensing scheme for tobacco outlets. The state secretary rejects claims of no enforcement, describes NVWA checks at producers and retailers, announces stronger enforcement powers and higher fines, and says the licensing question is addressed by the existing plan to reduce outlets by 2032.
I intend to give the NVWA additional enforcement powers so it can enforce more efficiently.
Ik ben van plan de NVWA extra handhavingsbevoegdheden te geven om zo efficiënter te kunnen handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice concerns about the winning parties, and whether such meetings are compatible with civil service neutrality. The government answered that the meetings were regular discussions of the election outcome, denied that working attitudes changed, declined to say how many staff attended, and said no similar meetings are planned.
No, it is not recorded how many staff members took part in regular staff meetings and consultations on the election outcome during the day.
Nee, er wordt niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers gedurende de dag in reguliere staven en overleggen over de verkiezingsuitslag hebben gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de afgelasting van diverse Sinterklaasintochten

An MP asked ministers whether the cancellation of Sinterklaas parades in Enter and Rijswijk due to threatened protests by KOZP and Extinction Rebellion should be prevented, whether such groups receive subsidies, and how they can be dealt with. The minister answered that the groups may protest peacefully under freedom of assembly, that local mayors can restrict demonstrations when necessary, and that no state funds were received by these groups at the latest reference date, while declining any ministerial role in restricting association rights.
KOZP and Extinction Rebellion, like any other organisation, have the right to freedom of association.
KOZP en Extinction Rebellion hebben net als iedere andere organisatie recht op vrijheid van vereniging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice their feelings about the outcome, whether this places civil servants who voted for winning parties in an awkward position, and whether such meetings will be held again. The VWS minister answered that discussions about what the result means for policy work took place, that attendance was not recorded, that civil servants must remain politically neutral, and that the ministry values an open and safe working climate.
It was not recorded how many employees were present.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government confirmed that BZK held two meetings to interpret the result, stated civil servants must remain politically neutral, and said such sessions fit an open workplace culture without committing to avoid them in future.
Civil servants have a supporting, advisory and executing role, in which they are expected, on the basis of professionalism, to advise objectively.
Ambtenaren hebben hierbij een ondersteunende, adviserende en uitvoerende rol, waarin zij op basis van professionaliteit worden geacht om objectief te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether the Ministry of Defence organised meetings for officials after the November 2023 election, including whether such meetings put civil servants in a difficult position and whether they will be repeated. The minister answered that no departmental, DG or directorate-level meetings were held, only regular discussions of the election result, and that a safe working environment and political neutrality of officials are important.
No meetings were organised at the Ministry of Defence at departmental, directorate-general or directorate level following the election result.
Op het Ministerie van Defensie zijn geen bijeenkomsten georganiseerd op departementaal, dan wel op directoraat-generaal of directieniveau naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether civil servants were gathered after the November 2023 election to voice concerns about winning parties, and whether such meetings would recur. The minister replied that no formal meetings were held, only routine discussions on the election result, and that civil servants should be free to share reflections while staying politically neutral.
No formal meetings were organised by the ministry or at Directorate-General level.
Er zijn geen formele bijeenkomsten georganiseerd door het ministerie of op DG-niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings for civil servants after the November 2023 election result, what they were for, and whether such gatherings undermine civil servant neutrality. The minister confirmed meetings were held to reflect on the result, said staff were encouraged to share views without restriction, declined to give attendance numbers, and said such meetings may be repeated after a new coalition agreement.
It was not recorded how many colleagues attended the various meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel collega's de verschillende bijeenkomsten hebben bijgewoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election results, what their purpose was, whether staff could voice how their working approach would change, and whether such meetings threaten civil servants' neutrality. The Minister of Social Affairs replied that the ministry held an online briefing on the election outcome for all staff, with no interactive input, plus internal directorate discussions, that such briefings are standard after elections and planned after the coalition agreement, and that civil servants remain politically neutral.
Because many employees watched the online presentation together on one screen, it cannot be determined exactly how many employees attended.
Omdat veel medewerkers de online presentatie samen op een scherm hebben bekeken, is niet exact te achterhalen hoeveel medewerkers hierbij aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether OCW held internal meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome and how this affects their neutrality. The minister confirmed a departmental meeting and several directorate meetings focused on the implications of the results and the primacy of politics, stating civil servants remain politically neutral and that such reflection is part of their work.
It is important that civil servants remain politically neutral in their work.
Het is belangrijk dat ambtenaren politiek neutraal zijn en blijven in hun werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, whether staff could voice how the result changed their work, and whether such meetings threaten civil service neutrality. The minister replied that no formal meetings were organised, only informal discussions in some units, that such open dialogue fits a safe working climate, and that civil servants remain politically neutral and execute decisions made by ministers.
There is no insight into how many people participated.
Er is geen zicht op hoeveel personen deelnamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether they held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, what was discussed, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The Minister of LNV answered that meetings were held to anticipate policy implications, that no restrictions were placed on input, and that such meetings remain acceptable, while stressing civil servant political neutrality.
It was not recorded how many civil servants attended the meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel ambtenaren bij de bijeenkomsten aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the election result, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government answered that such discussions took place only within existing regular meetings, that no separate meetings are planned, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
This is not possible; no overviews are kept of how many and which employees attended which meetings.
Dit is niet mogelijk, er worden geen overzichten bijgehouden van hoeveel en welke medewerkers er bij welke overleggen aanwezig zijn geweest
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van     22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether civil servants were invited to meetings after the November 2023 election about how their working conditions might change under a new coalition, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The government answered that no departmental meetings were held beyond regular discussions of the election, that it does not rule out future meetings about election outcomes, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
No, I do not rule out that in the future meetings will take place where the outcome of elections is discussed.
Nee, ik sluit niet uit dat in de toekomst bijeenkomsten plaatsvinden waar over de uitkomst van verkiezingen wordt gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een oplichter die meerdere malen met succes vrouwen heeft opgelicht en niet te stoppen lijkt

MP Van Nispen asked the ministers why a suspected romance fraudster who defrauded several women keeps operating, whether the civil route is realistic for victims, and what can be done to stop him. The government answered that it cannot comment on individual cases, that victims can always report to the police and pursue civil claims, and that it is working on lowering court fees and on fraud prevention and the role of notaries and guardianship bodies.
Let me first state that I do not comment on individual cases.
Laat ik vooropstellen dat ik geen uitspraken doe over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het maken van procesafspraken met criminele kopstukken

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the Public Prosecution Service made process agreements with a major drug trafficker, questioning whether such deals are appropriate, whether OFAC-listed persons should be eligible, whether a legal limit should apply, and how prison sentences and detention regimes are guaranteed. The Minister defended the agreements as effective for complex cases, said the Public Prosecution Service weighs the nature of the offence and the suspect, noted the courts retain independent review, and said a statutory framework is being prepared without committing to new limits.
The court has an independent responsibility for the outcome of the criminal case.
De rechter heeft een zelfstandige verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitkomst van de strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de demonstratie door Extinction Rebellion op de Ring A10 bij Amsterdam

An MP from JA21 asked the Justice Minister whether the police would facilitate an Extinction Rebellion blockade of the A10 ring road in Amsterdam, which the mayor had banned, and whether police would prevent it. The minister answered that the blockade violated the mayor's restriction and counted as an offence, but declined to commit to police action or extra capacity, saying the mayor and public prosecutor are responsible for police operations.
I cannot and will not make these commitments because the mayor and the public prosecutor are responsible for police operations.
Deze toezeggingen kan en zal ik niet doen omdat de burgemeester en de officier van justitie verantwoordelijk zijn voor het politieoptreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Helder over het bericht 'Kwam agent Robert-Jan om het leven bij politiewerk? Nee, zegt stichting (en dus komt zijn naam niet op monument)'

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security why police officer Robert-Jan Hartman's name is not on the national police memorial, despite the chief constable's request. The Minister answered that the foundation's independent board decides on inclusion, that it judged the team-building activity was not 'in the line of duty', and that the Minister has no power to decide, though she understands the families' wish.
The decision to also include his name in the Tuin van Bezinning, however, is not for me, nor for the chief constable.
Het besluit om zijn naam ook op te nemen in de Tuin van Bezinning is echter niet aan mij, noch aan de korpschef.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Temmink en Van Nispen over het feit dat het niet noodgevallen nummer van de Brandweer in handen is van een commerciële partij

MPs Temmink and Van Nispen asked why the non-emergency fire brigade number 0900-0904 is operated by a commercial party, why callers pay per-minute fees, and why it is not free like the Marechaussee number. The minister answered that KPN is not the owner but a platform provider, the number is managed by the Landelijke Meldkamer Samenwerking, service fees partly cover costs without profit, and cost estimates for free numbers were not provided.
The number 0900-0904 is not in the hands of a commercial party, but is managed by the Landelijke Meldkamer Samenwerking (LMS).
Het nummer 0900-0904 is niet in handen van een commerciële partij, maar in beheer bij de Landelijke Meldkamer Samenwerking (LMS).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Viruswaarheid

An MP (Van Haga) asked the Justice and Interior ministers about intelligence monitoring of the Viruswaarheid group, police data collection, withheld court evidence, and alleged political prosecution of activist Engel. The minister answered that monitoring of Viruswaarheid was denied or not confirmed, that intelligence services do not comment on their methods, that withholding of case documents is governed by procedure, and rejected claims of political motivation and misconduct.
In general terms I can state that article 34 of the Code of Criminal Procedure applies to the addition of documents.
In algemene zin kan ik aangeven dat op het voegen van stukken artikel 34 van het Wetboek van Strafvordering van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Piri over het uitleveringsverdrag dat Nederland heeft gesloten met Marokko

MPs Mutluer and Piri asked the Justice Minister about the extradition treaty with Morocco, including its scope, the reliability of Moroccan justice, and safeguards for journalists and activists. The Minister explained the treaty extends extradition beyond multilateral-treaty offences to any offence with a sentence of at least one year, that political-offence refusal grounds apply, and that human rights assessments were made, but declined to give a judgement on Moroccan courts or offer blanket guarantees.
I refrain from giving a judgement on the Moroccan judiciary.
Ik onthoud mij van een oordeel over de Marokkaanse rechtspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht 'Politie wil meer autowrakken optakelen om misdrijven op te lossen'

An MP asked whether recovering sunken cars could help solve crimes, why such wrecks are not always recovered given costs, and whether police and Rijkswaterstaat should coordinate on this. The minister agreed recovery can yield leads, said the number of wrecks yielding criminal evidence is unknown, and explained that waterway managers prioritise navigation safety while police decide case by case, with cooperation talks ongoing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht ‘Gemeente in gesprek met ministerie over aanvullende tegemoetkoming gedupeerden waterramp’

An MP asks the Justice and Security minister about unreimbursed residual and consequential flood damage in Zuid-Limburg, the motion on 'schrijnende situaties', and why only a narrow group qualifies for a one-off payment. The minister says a regulation for one-off payments to those in financial distress is being drafted, that about 200 victims are expected to qualify, and that the Quick scan figures did not reserve money for compensation.
Once the decision-making has taken place, I will inform your House.
Zodra de besluitvorming heeft plaatsgevonden zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Wassenberg over de illegale handel in traditionele medicijnen, gemaakt van bedreigde en beschermde dier- en plantsoorten

MPs Van Esch and Wassenberg asked ministers about illegal trade in traditional medicines made from endangered species such as tiger, rhino, pangolin and leopard, including the EIA findings, WHO engagement, and a RIVM report on herbal products. The government acknowledges the threat to biodiversity, points to CITES and EU enforcement and demand-reduction efforts, and promises an awareness campaign with an update to Parliament in mid-2024.
I will inform your House further in mid-2024 about the progress and initiatives.
Ik zal uw Kamer halverwege 2024 verder informeren over de vorderingen en initiatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Helder en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Australische haatprediker ongemoeid naar Utrecht: terreurdaden Hamas ’een opsteker’'

MPs asked whether the government will prevent extremist preacher Mohamed Hoblos from spreading his message online after being denied physical entry to a Utrecht event, and why the venue and mayor could not stop it. The government answered that an online approach is being developed, that terrorist content can be removed, and that under existing law a mayor can only ban a speaker in concrete and serious threat cases, while the organiser and Jaarbeurs assured the speaker would not speak.

Through various pillars, such as dialogue with the internet sector, the local approach and an ambitious international effort, the Minister of Justice and Security is making every possible effort in this regard, nationally and internationally.

Via diverse pijlers, zoals een dialoog met de internetsector, de lokale aanpak en een ambitieuze internationale inzet spant de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid zich hier, nationaal en internationaal, zo maximaal mogelijk voor in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Helder, Michon-Derkzen, Bontenbal over het bericht ‘Australische haatprediker ongemoeid naar Utrecht: terreurdaden Hamas ’een opsteker’’

MPs asked the Justice Minister whether an Australian extremist preacher planning to speak in Utrecht could be barred from entry, and what would stop him operating elsewhere in the Netherlands. The government answered that it acts against speakers who incite hatred or violence, that the preacher is flagged in the Schengen SIS system for refusal of entry, and that the municipality and services cooperated to prevent him getting a platform.
This refusal of entry applies, in line with the Schengen Borders Code, to all other Schengen member states as well.
Deze toegangsweigering geldt, in lijn met de Schengengrenscode, ook voor alle andere Schengen lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Duitse regeringspartij: Antisemieten mogen geen Duitser worden’

An SGP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Netherlands should adopt a German proposal to bar antisemitic migrants from naturalisation and revoke citizenship for antisemitic offences. The State Secretary answered that existing rules already allow refusal of naturalisation and revocation on public-order grounds, that revocation grounds are limited by law, and saw no reason to contact Germany or explore a similar proposal further.
I see no reason to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over designerdrugs die teruggegeven moeten worden aan de eigenaar

An MP asked the Justice Minister why about 1,100 kg of designer drugs seized in Zaanstad had to be returned to their owner because the substances fall outside the Opium Act, and what legal options exist. The minister agreed this is undesirable, pointed to the pending NPS bill (a generic list IA) as the remedy, and stated that current law offers no criminal or administrative enforcement tools.
A complete overview of NPS that remain with the owner/possessor cannot be obtained, because NPS are not punishable conduct if the substance is not listed on list I or list II of the Opium Act.

Een totaal overzicht van NPS dat bij de eigenaar/bezitter blijft, is niet te achterhalen, omdat NPS geen strafbare gedragingen betreffen als de betreffende stof niet op lijst I of lijst II bij de Opiumwet staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de NPO Radio 1-podcast ‘Het Misdaadbureau’ van Omroep WNL over gerechtelijke dwalingen

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a podcast reporting 12 Dutch wrongful convictions among 110 in Europe, whether the Dutch herziening threshold is too strict, and whether US-style joint prosecutor-defence investigation teams should be adopted. The minister answered that wrongful convictions are rare and the Dutch system is sound, that the 2012 reform already broadened the novum criterion and that further widening would create a fourth instance, and that existing pre-review investigation powers already suffice without a US-style model.
A further widening of the novum criterion would not do justice to the exceptional nature of the extraordinary remedy of revision and would in effect create a fourth appeal instance.

Een verdere uitbreiding van het novumcriterium doet geen recht aan het uitzonderlijke karakter van het buitengewoon rechtsmiddel herziening en zou feitelijk betekenen dat een vierde beroepsinstantie wordt gecreëerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Ellian en Sneller over zorgen over de uitwerking van een Kamerbreed aangenomen motie voor de aanbesteding van tolkendiensten in Nederland en de grote zorgen over de toekomst va

Three MPs from SP, VVD and D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about concerns that the implementation of a House-adopted motion on tolk tenders (removing travel costs and raising the registration tariff by 15 euro) could leave court interpreters worse off. The Minister answered that the tariff increase is meant to compensate interpreters, that pay will be monitored, and that a full assessment of hourly rates will follow later.
Once service provision is fully implemented and the relevant data are available, the fees that intermediaries pay to self-employed interpreters will become transparent.
Zodra dienstverlening volledig is geïmplementeerd en de gegevens hierover beschikbaar zijn, worden de vergoedingen, die intermediairs aan zelfstandig ondernemende tolken betalen, inzichtelijk.
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Sneller, Michon-Derkzen, Kuik, Mutluer en Temmink over agressie en geweld tegen beroepsgroepen met een publieke functie

MPs from D66, VVD, CDA, GroenLinks-PvdA and SP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reporting, prosecution, sentencing and prevention of aggression and violence against public-service workers. The minister answers that reporting should be made mandatory in practice through employer norms, that no reliable national picture exists, and that existing protocols, WODC research and Weerbaar Bestuur initiatives are being used, while leaving primary employer responsibility with organisations.
A reliable national picture of aggression and violence against officials with a public task is lacking.
Een betrouwbaar landelijk beeld van agressie en geweld tegen functionarissen met een publieke taak ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ellian over antisemitisme in Nederland

MPs Bikker and Ellian asked about rising antisemitism in the Netherlands after the Hamas attack on Israel, including Jewish pupils' safety, reporting channels and EU cooperation. The minister answered that the government is in close contact with the Jewish community, that the NCAB and police monitor the situation, and that schools are encouraged to hold dialogue, though the answers largely restate existing policy and do not give concrete numbers or new measures.
I have tried to comply with your request. However, gathering the necessary data took some time.
Ik heb getracht aan uw verzoek te voldoen. Met het verzamelen van de benodigde gegevens ging echter enige tijd gemoeid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over antisemitisme,

An SGP MP asked the Justice Minister about rising fear among Jewish communities, school closures in Amsterdam, and whether the right to demonstrate should be restricted when antisemitic slogans are chanted at pro-Palestinian protests. The minister answered that security measures are considered adequate, that existing criminal law suffices, that demonstration licensing is a local responsibility, and that she remains in discussion with the Interior Minister.
Facilitating and regulating demonstrations is a local responsibility.
Het faciliteren en reguleren van demonstraties is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over OV-geweld

An MP asks the government about violence on public transport, including tougher penalties, a lifetime transport ban, conductors on risk lines, the migration background of perpetrators, and expulsion or loss of Dutch nationality for offenders. The State Secretary replies that action is underway through a joint action programme, that penalties and transport bans are already governed by existing rules, that ethnicity of suspects cannot be registered so the requested overview is not provided, and that asylum and nationality measures are limited by law.

It is not possible to retrieve from police systems an overview of violent incidents on public transport with the background of the suspects, because the police are not allowed to register the ethnicity of the suspect.

Het is niet mogelijk om een overzicht van geweldsincidenten in het OV met daarbij de achtergrond van de verdachten uit de politiesystemen op te halen, omdat Politie de etniciteit van de verdachte niet mag registreren.
Antwoord op vragen van het van het lid Beckerman over het artikel 'Agenten willen meer aandacht voor milieu: ‘Delicten met de meeste doden krijgen geen prioriteit.’'

MP Beckerman asked the ministers of Justice and Infrastructure about a police manifesto urging more priority for environmental crime and whether 'ecocide' should be made a crime. The government answered that prosecution priorities are set by the Public Prosecution Service, pointed to extra investment in environmental enforcement capacity, and said the revised EU environmental crime directive will be implemented, with a ecocide-like aggravating ground expected in a bill after 2024.
It is unacceptable that companies knowingly violate environmental laws. These companies must be tackled.
Het is onacceptabel dat bedrijven willens en wetens milieuwetten overtreden. Deze bedrijven moeten aangepakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de rechtspositie van slachtoffers van (relationeel) geweld

An MP asked the Ministers of Justice and Health about victims of intimate terror, including forced contact with abusers in custody and visitation cases, the priority given to offenders' family life over victims' safety, femicide urgency, near-fatal incidents, protection measures, sentencing, specialised centres, and whether to investigate victims' legal position. The ministers answered that the family judge weighs safety risks case by case, that the advisory body RSJ will report in 2024, that a femicide action plan will follow in spring 2024, and that the current criminal law and victims' rights are adequate, so no sentencing increase or new investigation is planned.
In an individual case it will be examined whether the right to safety can be sufficiently guaranteed while at the same time giving the right to contact with both parents the best possible effect.

In een individuele casus zal worden bekeken of het recht op veiligheid voldoende kan worden gewaarborgd terwijl tegelijkertijd zo goed mogelijk invulling wordt gegeven aan het recht op contact met beide ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over ‘het gebrek aan landelijke registratie van bijtincidenten door honden en het gebrek aan landelijk beleid om die bijtincidenten terug te brengen’

An MP asked the ministers about the lack of national registration of dog bite incidents and the absence of national policy to reduce them, following serious attacks. The government acknowledges that no complete registration exists, admits only about 50 of 342 municipalities report to the Landelijk Honden Dossier, and promises to investigate broader incident registration and owner-related risk factors, with a separate letter to follow.
That is why I intend to investigate how dog bite incidents can also be brought into view where no supervisors are involved.
Daarom ben ik voornemens te onderzoeken hoe ook bijtincidenten in beeld gebracht kunnen worden waar geen toezichthouders bij betrokken worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het rapport van Inspectie JenV politieoptreden KOZP Staphorst

An MP asked the Justice Minister about police handling of the Kick Out Zwarte Piet demonstration in Staphorst, including failures to protect demonstrators and observers, whether the police treated rioters as counter-demonstrators, and what will change for future demonstrations. The minister said the police accept the Inspectorate's criticism, that the decision to end the demonstration rested with the mayor, that four suspects will face court, and that existing guidance will be applied and a knowledge bank developed.
I endorse, like the police, the conclusions of the report that the police did not act decisively and adequately in protecting the KOZP demonstrators and Amnesty International observers.

Ik onderschrijf, eveneens als politie, de conclusies van het rapport die aangeven dat de politie niet doortastend en adequaat heeft opgetreden bij de bescherming van de demonstranten van KOZP en de waarnemers van Amnesty International
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘De schrik zit erin bij moslims in Culemborg: ‘We willen extra beveiliging’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that Muslims in Culemborg feel unsafe after a mosque's windows were smashed and whether mosque security should be funded and tightened. The minister condemned the attack, but said mosque security is a local responsibility, no extra national funding is planned, and the earlier motion on mosque security practices has been considered fulfilled.
At this moment there is no reason to finance additional general security measures.
Op dit moment is er geen aanleiding om extra algemene beveiligingsmaatregelen te financieren.
Antwoord op vVragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het rapport van Inspectie JenV m.b.t het politieoptreden in aanloop naar de demonstratie van KOZP in Staphorst(BIJ1)

An MP asked the Justice Minister how the government views the Inspectorate's report on police conduct at the Staphorst Kick Out Zwarte Piet demonstration, including whether officers should be sanctioned, whether disciplinary investigations were opened, and whether extreme-right attitudes in the police were examined. The minister endorsed the report's conclusions, said the police acknowledged errors, stated that four people will be prosecuted, and said no disciplinary investigation was started while citing existing conduct rules and neutrality codes.
I endorse, just like the chief of police, the conclusions of the report.
Ik onderschrijf, net zoals de korpschef, de conclusies van het rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Haga over het belagen van eenPowned verslaggever

MP Van Haga asked the Justice Minister whether the government would act on police inaction when a PowNed reporter and cameraman were harassed at an Arnhem counter-demonstration, and how perpetrators would be pursued and demonstrators made identifiable. The minister condemned attacks on journalists, described police de-escalation and the Protocol PersVeilig, and said the prosecution approach and an evaluation of the protocol are ongoing, while stating that masks should not be banned by default.
The Public Prosecution Service applies a tough-on-crime approach as much as possible in cases where criminal offences have been committed.
Het Openbaar Ministerie past zoveel mogelijk lik-op-stukbeleid toe bij zaken waarin strafbare feiten zijn gepleegd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de ANBI-status van Extinction Rebellion

An MP from JA21 asked whether Extinction Rebellion's ANBI tax status, and the disclosure of tax benefits, should be revoked after unlawful protest actions and whether the group should be banned under the Civil Code. The Secretary of State answered that tax confidentiality prevents disclosure about individual organisations, that ANBI status is tested neutrally and can be revoked only through the integrity test or a court ban, and that the Public Prosecution Service decides on any court ban.
The Tax Administration is bound by the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act and therefore cannot provide further information about individual organisations.

De Belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) en kan daarom geen nadere informatie verstrekken over individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Lage straf uithalers: mag dat wel?’

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether a Rotterdam judge may create an alternative sentencing project (STMK) that departs from the Code of Criminal Procedure, and whether it undermines deterrence and insults police and prosecutors, citing critical appellate ruling. The minister answers that judges may experiment within legal frameworks, defends the STMK as same legal basis with more focus on accountability and recidivism, disputes the deterrence claim, and promises the issue will be covered in an autumn letter.
The judge is free to dispose of criminal cases within the legal frameworks in a manner that does justice to the case.
Het staat de rechter vrij om binnen de wettelijke kaders strafzaken af te doen op een wijze die recht doet aan de strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over artikel 12 procedure

The PVV MP Markuszower asks the Minister of Justice and Security what has been done with recommendations on elder abuse recognition in police training and judicial education, and why a public prosecutor did not recognise financial abuse and sought a bewilligingsprocedure against a court-ordered investigation. The Minister says the recommendations are unclear, describes general police and judicial training on recognising vulnerable persons and domestic violence, and declines to comment on the individual case because it is pending before the court.
It does not befit me as Minister of Justice and Security to make statements about individual cases, all the more so while the judgment is still reserved for the court.
Het past mij niet als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om uitspraken te doen over individuele zaken, te meer zolang het oordeel hierin nog is voorbehouden aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Hof geeft uithalers van drugscontainers taakstraf in plaats van cel'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a court ruling that gave drug-container 'uithalers' community service instead of prison, and whether this undermines the uithalerswet, with questions on arrest and prosecution figures, comparison with other EU states, and whether the law should be tightened. The minister answered that courts judge case by case, that the law has deterrent and investigative value, that numbers and sentences are reported, and that a comparative study will depend on consultations with the criminal justice partners.
In the upcoming half-yearly letter on organised and undermining crime I will explain how I am implementing this motion.
In de aankomende halfjaarbrief georganiseerde en ondermijnende criminaliteit licht ik toe hoe ik uitvoering geef aan deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Mutluer en Piri over de aanhouding van medewerkers van NCTV en politie vanwege het lekken van staatsgeheime informatie

MPs Sneller, Mutluer and Piri asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the arrest of NCTV and police staff for allegedly leaking state secret information, including risks to people, critical infrastructure, timing of an investigation, and foreign contacts. The minister declined to give operational details pending criminal and Auditdienst Rijk investigations, said no signals currently show acute risk to critical infrastructure, and promised to inform parliament once the investigation concludes.
In the interest of those investigations, and given the risk of harm if sensitive or classified information reaches third parties prematurely, no additional information can be provided at this time.

In het belang van die onderzoeken en gelet op het afbreukrisico indien voortijdig gevoelige of gerubriceerde informatie bij derden terechtkomt, kan er op dit moment geen aanvullende informatie worden gegeven.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht over de achtergrond van een aangehouden NCTV-medewerker

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that an NCTV employee arrested for allegedly leaking state secrets had earlier security concerns, Moroccan ties and a dual role with the police. The minister declined to give substantive information on the ongoing criminal case and the ADR audit, citing investigation interests, and only referred to the existing vetting rules and promised to share more when the investigations allow.
