In the interest of those investigations and given the risk of harm if sensitive or classified information reaches third parties prematurely, no additional information can be provided at this time.

In het belang van die onderzoeken en gelet op het afbreukrisico indien voortijdig gevoelige of gerubriceerde informatie bij derden terechtkomt, kan er op dit moment geen aanvullende informatie worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Tot hoever kan XR gaan met snelwegblokkades?’

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about Extinction Rebellion motorway blockades and whether the Public Prosecution Service (OM) was right not to prosecute arrested protesters under the Public Assemblies Act, given the disruption to police capacity. The minister answered that the OM decides prosecution independently, that arrests and registration were made, that registration was dropped due to disproportionate capacity strain, and that the local triangle handles demonstrations.
The OM has decided not to prosecute persons arrested for violating the Public Assemblies Act.
Het OM heeft besloten om geen strafvervolging in te stellen tegen personen die zijn aangehouden voor overtreding van de Wet openbare manifestaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten 'Explosie bij woning Slotermeer: voordeur en ramen beschadigd' en 'Onrust om bommen bij burgemeesters'

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the rising number of explosions at homes and businesses, the call from mayors to change privacy rules to share information, the shortage of neighbourhood police, the effect of police capacity on arms trafficking and illegal fireworks. The Minister answers that privacy law does not itself block information sharing, points to existing legal bases and an upcoming bill, acknowledges capacity pressures and promises no concrete new step beyond ongoing efforts, and admits the answer is late.
Privacy legislation in itself does not stand in the way of exchanging information.
De privacywetgeving staat op zichzelf niet in de weg aan het uitwisselen van informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het toenemende aantal explosies, welke meestal drugsgerelateerd zijn

Van Haga asked the Justice and Defence ministers about the rising number of explosions, mostly drug-related, including how many occurred in 2023, what the government will do to stop them, whether the underworld controls some neighbourhoods, and whether the army should patrol high-risk areas given police shortages. The Minister reports an increase in incidents, gives a 2023 overview, describes prevention and international efforts, denies that authorities have lost control, and says military patrols are not currently needed.
On the basis of these figures it is not possible to establish a direct link between these explosions and drug or gang wars.
Het is op basis van deze cijfers niet mogelijk om een direct verband te leggen tussen deze explosies en drugs- of bendeoorlogen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het afluisteren van journalisten van De Correspondent bij een gesprek met verdachten van de mondkapjesdeal door het OM en het voor de rechterdagen van Relief Goods Alliance do

An MP asks how the Public Prosecution Service could legally bug a meeting where Correspondent journalists spoke with suspects in the face-mask deal, why the State is suing Relief Goods Alliance without disclosing the summons, and what happened to the recordings. The Minister says the surveillance was a lawful special investigative power on suspects with incidental capture of journalists, that the courts will judge, that the summons is withheld due to ongoing litigation, and that the recordings are part of the criminal file.
Ultimately it is for the court to determine whether the Public Prosecution Service made the right considerations and applied the Directive properly.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechter om te bepalen of het OM de juiste afwegingen heeft gemaakt en de Aanwijzing goed heeft toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over ‘de blijvend lange doorlooptijden bij zedenzaken’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why case processing times in sexual offence cases remain long, whether they have decreased since earlier answers, how many extra FTEs were recruited under the Klaver motion, what more is needed to meet the six-month norm, and whether the Action Plan has reduced processing times. The minister reported modest improvements in 2022 against the chain norms, a 3.8 FTE vacancy gap, a complex plan to address the problem, and expected effects from 2024 onward, referring to a forthcoming police half-year report for staffing figures.
Improving processing times is a complex matter.
Het verbeteren van de doorlooptijden is een complexe aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Sjoerdsma over de beantwoording van vragen

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the ministers to convey appreciation to civil servants for timely, careful answers to parliamentary questions. The Prime Minister answered yes, a brief acknowledgement with no substantive commitment.
Are you willing to convey great appreciation to your civil servants for answering all written, factual and oral questions that the questioner has asked in recent years
Bent u bereid de grote waardering over te brengen aan uw ambtenaren voor de beantwoording van alle schriftelijke, feitelijk en mondelinge vragen die vragensteller de afgelopen jaren stelde
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Piri over huwelijksdwang of achterlating in het buitenland

Two MPs asked ministers about forced marriage and abandonment of girls abroad, including BRP deregistration, prevalence data, residence and nationality recovery, legal aid and feminist foreign policy. The government answered that precise prevalence data are lacking, outlined existing registration and reporting rules, pointed to planned research and measures, and described routes for recovering residence status and nationality.
Precise and reliable figures on the extent of forced marriage in the Netherlands are lacking.
Precieze en betrouwbare cijfers over de omvang van huwelijksdwang in Nederland ontbreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Ellemeet over een uitzending van Argos over de dood van Sammy Baker

MPs Mutluer and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Justice and Security about an Argos broadcast on the death of Sammy Baker, the adequacy of the handling framework for people with confused behaviour, and whether the treatment of fatal incidents involving police should be investigated. The Minister said the Public Prosecution Service sees no reason to revisit its earlier decision not to prosecute (self-defence), that the framework gives no powers to arrest, that she will not assess the lawfulness of force and sees no need for a new study, and referred to existing measures for a cross-domain approach.
It is then up to other authorities – where appropriate the judge – to assess whether the use of force was lawful or not.
Het is daarna aan andere autoriteiten – in voorkomende gevallen de rechter – om te beoordelen of er wel of niet sprake is van een rechtmatige geweldsaanwending.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over ‘dreigende bezuinigingen bij de politie’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about looming police budget cuts, including a 19 million euro efficiency target, and whether the government's promise of no police cuts in 2024 holds. The minister answered that the police expect to absorb the 2024 target through one-off windfalls, that cuts may follow in later years under the 'kiezen op korpsniveau' process, and that the target is part of the government-wide budget cover.
In 2024 the police will not implement specific cost-cutting measures.
In 2024 zal de politie geen specifieke bezuinigingsmaatregelen doorvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de situatie met betrekking tot de vermoorde snackbareigenaar

An MP asks the government why the widow of a murdered snack-bar owner receives no state help, which pushes successful entrepreneurs onto welfare, and whether rules will change. The Minister replies that existing schemes (Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven, Bbz, Anw, victim compensation and advance payment) already cover such cases, sees no reason to change the rules, and declines to share the crowdfunding campaign.
Therefore I see no reason to amend the rules.
Ik zie derhalve geen reden om de regels aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Een nieuwe fase in de drugscriminaliteit’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about explosions at homes and business premises linked to drug-related gang violence, particularly in Groningen, and about police capacity and drug-use drivers. The Minister confirmed the figures, called the explosions unacceptable, pointed to structural factors in Groningen, said police capacity is under pressure nationwide, and described an integrated anti-drug-crime approach and prevention efforts, without answering questions on the specific incidents, which are under investigation.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service are investigating these incidents. It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to comment on these incidents.
Politie en OM onderzoeken deze incidenten. Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om in te gaan op deze incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rahimi en Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Experts sabelen overheid neer om belangrijke websites als DigiD: ‘Pas nu domeinnaam aan’

Two MPs from the VVD asked the government about calls to move key government websites such as DigiD to a uniform .gov or .overheid domain to counter cybercrime and phishing. The State Secretary answered that a national top-level domain is not possible for now, that a second-level domain such as overheid.nl or gov.nl is being worked on with an implementation approach to follow, and that such a change alone will not prevent cybercrime.
An implementation approach for a single extension is currently being worked on.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een implementatie-aanpak voor één extensie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Werf en Sahla over weren van drugscriminelen uit het zorgdomein

MPs Sneller, Van der Werf and Sahla asked whether drug criminals who own care and staffing agencies (e.g. Ultracare, supplying youth care in Friesland) can be kept out of the care sector, and about Bibob screening and oversight by Justis. The Minister acknowledges the risk, reports that about 5,750 care providers nationwide are owned by persons with convictions, says individual cases cannot be discussed, and points to ongoing Bibob reforms, a planned evaluation from early 2024 and talks with RIEC's and VNG on stronger anti-fraud action.
As Minister of Justice and Security, I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid niet ingaan op individuele zaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Temmink, Van Raan en Van Baarle over het bericht 'Tien camera’s per vierkante kilometer in database politie: ‘Onbespied over straat kan bijna niet meer’' en de uitzending

MPs from D66, SP, PvdD and DENK asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that private cameras registered with the police (Camera in Beeld) are growing, whether footage from unregistered private cameras, doorbell cameras and cameras pointed at public roads is lawful and usable, and whether this amounts to a nationwide surveillance network. The Minister answered that police may demand footage under article 126nda Sv for offences carrying four years or more, that misaligned cameras are a concern, that a nationwide network is undesirable, and that courts decide whether unlawfully obtained footage is admissible.
I therefore consider it important that camera owners continue to be reminded that they must adjust their cameras in line with the rules of the General Data Protection Regulation.
Ik acht het derhalve van belang dat camera-eigenaren er blijvend op worden gewezen dat zij hun camera moeten afstellen volgens de regels van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Kat en Van der Laan over influencers die jongeren in de armen van oplichters lokken

D66 MPs asked how young people can be protected from influencers who lure them into scams around match-fixing sports betting, including crypto flows, gambling-addiction protection, advertising oversight and cross-border enforcement. The minister answered that prevention campaigns, platform obligations and existing regulators (Ksa, ACM, AFM, Commissariaat voor de Media) cover the issue, and promised a campaign, a ministry review of labelling edited ads and a werkagenda by year-end.
As previously promised, the House will receive the work agenda by the end of this year, setting out ongoing and future activities on addiction prevention.
Zoals eerder toegezegd ontvangt de Kamer eind dit jaar de werkagenda waarin lopende en toekomstige activiteiten op het gebied van verslavingspreventie een plek krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over recherchebureaus die zonder vergunning onderzoek doen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why private investigation agencies were allowed to keep working without a valid licence after their renewals were delayed by Justis backlogs, and whether this was lawful and what happens to information gathered. The Minister answered that Justis issued a tolerance declaration for around 20 agencies, that it was justified by Justis's own delays, that the agencies could rely on it, and that the gap was later covered by an explicit licence.
The arrangement put in place was considered justified under the circumstances.
De getroffen voorziening is onder de gegeven omstandigheden verantwoord geacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Tot in de dood tweederangs” en de column van John van den Heuvel “Menselijkheid kost geen miljoenen euro’s

MP Helder asked the Minister of Justice and Security why police officer Ferry Bakx, killed in the Caribbean Netherlands, is excluded from the national Tuin van Bezinning memorial, whether the rules should be changed, and whether his mother can lay a white rose there. The minister answered that a foundation's statutes limit admission to officers of the national police, that a 2021 hardship clause allowed an exception, and that his name will be added at the June 2024 commemoration.
At the next commemoration, in June 2024, his name will be added.
Bij de eerstvolgende herdenking, in juni 2024, zal zijn naam worden bijgeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wuite over het artikel 'Tweederangs tot in de dood'

Wuite (D66) asked why the Tuin van Bezinning memorial for fallen police officers excluded Caribbean Netherlands police, such as Ferry Bakx, and whether this distinction would be lifted. The minister explained the eligibility rule, said a 2021 hardship clause allowed an exception for Bakx, and committed to adding his name at the June 2024 commemoration and raising the issue at the January 2024 Justice Quadripartite Consultation.
At the next commemoration, in June 2024, his name will be added.
Bij de eerstvolgende herdenking, in juni 2024, zal zijn naam worden bijgeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de cijfers van het aantal agressie-en geweldsincidenten in de jeugdgevangenissen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security for figures on aggression and violence incidents in Dutch youth detention institutions from 2020 to August 2023, broken down by type, plus an analysis of the figures and whether earlier measures worked. The Minister provided tables showing incident counts per institution, noted that 2023 figures are preliminary and the years are not directly comparable, and stated that staffing measures offer prospects though the staffing problem persists and monitoring will continue.
DJI does everything it can to prevent violent incidents.
DJI doet er alles aan om geweldsincidenten te voorkomen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Sneller over statiegeld op lachgascilinders en het bericht “Maat is vol: afvalverzamelaars gaan ‘levensgevaarlijke’ lachgas cilinders terugsturen”

MPs Hagen and Sneller asked about dangerous nitrous oxide cylinders ending up in waste processing after the nitrous oxide ban, financial damage, responsibility, and collection measures. The government answered that the damage stems from illegal dumping by individuals, that it will explore possible financial support, and that it is working with the waste sector and ministries on collection points, storage capacity and enforcement.
The central government is willing to explore whether a financial contribution is possible, using existing schemes or not, for measures that help mitigate risks in the waste sector.

Het Rijk is wel bereid te verkennen of een financiële tegemoetkoming mogelijk is, al dan niet gebruikmakend van bestaande regelingen, voor het treffen van maatregelen die bijdragen aan het mitigeren van de risico's in de afvalbranche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Na tientallen vrouwen, willen nu ook IS-mannen terugkeren naar Nederland'

The MP asks whether the 25 male foreign fighters held in Syrian Kurdish camps have been prosecuted, their dual nationality and entry dates, whether Dutch nationals face cases, how evidence is secured, whether tougher sentences and GVM measures will be sought, and whether the House will be consulted on repatriations. The minister answers that most detainees have not yet been prosecuted, some were convicted in absentia, dual nationality is partly relevant, a bill raising the maximum sentence for terrorist participation is planned, the House is informed of repatriation decisions, and GVM requests are for prosecutors and courts to decide without a registered count.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over bezorgdheid en onzekerheid bij de inbeslagname van een bejaarde pony

An MP asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about the seizure of an elderly pony, the delayed return after a court ruling, and whether owners should be better informed. The Justice Minister declined to discuss the ongoing case, said the public prosecutor should act promptly on court rulings, and noted talks with the prosecution about separate rules for seized animals.
In the interest of the ongoing investigation and to prevent influence on the public prosecution service and/or the judiciary, I cannot, as usual, make substantive statements on ongoing cases.

In het belang van het lopende onderzoek en teneinde beïnvloeding van het openbaar ministerie en/of de rechterlijke macht te voorkomen, kan ik over lopende zaken, zoals gebruikelijk, geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Temmink over het Risicotaxatie Instrument Geweld (RTI-G)

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether police used the RTI-G risk algorithm to profile citizens for future violence, including whether it scored people by Antillean, Moroccan or Somali background, whether a privacy impact assessment exists, and whether flagged people were searched or stopped. The minister confirmed use, said the tool was never used alone and always involved human interpretation, that ethnicity was removed in 2017, and that police have since stopped using RTI-G because its necessity and quality could not be substantiated.
Because the usefulness, necessity and quality of this could not be sufficiently substantiated, the police stopped using RTI-G.
Omdat nut, noodzaak en kwaliteit hiervan onvoldoende te onderbouwen zijn, heeft de politie het gebruik van RTI-G gestopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het voorspellend algoritme van de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the police predictive algorithm RTI-G, its effectiveness, discrimination risks, lack of appeal for citizens and whether it would be suspended. The minister answered that the police have stopped using RTI-G, that it was not self-learning, that ethnicity was removed in 2017, and that individuals cannot generally contest police tools during investigations except in court.
Individuals cannot always resist or defend themselves against the police use of a specific instrument.
Personen kunnen zich niet altijd verzetten of verdedigen tegen de inzet van een specifiek middel door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Slootweg over het bericht 'Telegram treedt niet effectief op tegen op grote schaal delen van contactgegevens en naaktfoto’s van vrouwen'

MPs Kuik and Slootweg (CDA) asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the government will act against Telegram's failure to curb mass sharing of women's contact details and nude photos in exposure groups, including whether police and prosecutors can block such groups, identify account holders, protect minors, and whether fines like Germany's should apply. The minister answered that the government takes it seriously, is pressing platforms via the DSA and other EU instruments and a public-private partnership, notes that identifying anonymous posters and acting against Telegram are hard legally and technically, and says Dutch law (WBAOKM) only covers child sexual abuse material.
The cabinet is increasing efforts to hold these parties to their responsibilities, partly through new legislative instruments.
Het kabinet verhoogt de inspanningen om deze partijen op hun verantwoordelijkheden te wijzen, deels met behulp van nieuwe wetgevende instrumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over een Nederlander die vast zit in Spanje vanwege een ongegronde plaatsing op een lijst

An MP from DENK asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about a Dutch citizen detained in Spain on a terrorism-related listing that Dutch authorities said did not stem from any Dutch suspicion, asking why Spain held this information, how data sharing and signalling work, and what consular help was given. The ministers declined to discuss the individual case in detail, citing ongoing proceedings, privacy rules and Spain's sovereignty, stated that the man was not suspected or signalled in the Netherlands, described consular support and contacts with Spanish authorities, and noted he has since been expelled and returned to the Netherlands.
The case of the person concerned is currently before the court.
De zaak van betrokkene is op dit moment onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Piri over de detentie van een Nederlander in Spanje

MPs Mutluer and Piri asked about the detention in Spain of a Dutch national from Tilburg, whether the Netherlands was involved, whether he was flagged for terrorism, and whether a 'white list' should be created. The ministers declined detailed comment citing the pending case and privacy rules, stated the Netherlands had no link to the Spanish grounds for arrest, noted he had since been returned to the Netherlands, and rejected a generic white list as unsuitable.
The case of the person concerned is currently before the court.
De zaak van betrokkene is op dit moment onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de Nederlandse man die al twee maanden om onduidelijke redenen vast zit in een Spaanse cel, in aanvulling op de vragen het lid Van Baarle

An MP asked why a Dutch man not suspected of any crime in the Netherlands has been held in a Spanish prison for two months, and whether Dutch-shared information caused it. The ministers declined to discuss the case substantively, citing the pending court proceedings and privacy rules, but said Dutch police and prosecutors confirmed he is not wanted in the Netherlands and that consular contact and information sharing with his lawyer have taken place.
The case of the person concerned is currently before the court.
De zaak van betrokkene is op dit moment onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over het toenemend wantrouwen in de overheid onder jongeren

An MP asks several ministers about growing distrust of government among young people, its link to conspiracy theories and anti-institutional extremism, and how prevention of polarisation and radicalisation is organised. The Minister answers that youth distrust is a concern, outlines existing prevention efforts and coordination between ministries, and announces ongoing work such as a new training on anti-institutional extremism.
It is part of a healthy democracy that people can voice criticism of the government.
Het hoort bij een gezonde democratie dat mensen kritiek kunnen uiten op de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Mutluer over de onterechte verdenking van aanwezigheid bij een klimaatprotest op luchthaven Schiphol

MPs Ellemeet and Mutluer asked how the Public Prosecution Service and Marechaussee identified about 400 climate protesters detained at Schiphol in November 2022, after some of the 176 warning letters went to people who were not present, and whether this was careful conduct. The minister explains that photos were matched using social media, open sources and a facial recognition program under art. 55c Sv, that eight people received apology letters, and that an internal review is ongoing with commitments to remove wrongly processed data and learn lessons.
In a number of cases it later turned out that the identification was incorrect.
Bij een aantal personen bleek achteraf sprake te zijn van een onjuiste identificatie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel ‘Wat weegt zwaarder: demonstratierecht of leerplicht? ‘Niet de bedoeling iedere vrijdag vrij te geven’ en het artikel ‘Wegblijven van school om deel te nemen aan k

An MP asks the Education Minister whether pupils may skip school to attend climate demonstrations, whether a school's active promotion of a demonstration undermines compulsory schooling, and how schools' neutrality and missed tests are handled. The minister answers that truancy is never allowed for any reason, attendance may be part of the curriculum subject to works council approval, schools' neutrality is not necessarily compromised, and the Inspectorate can intervene if a school cannot justify its decisions.
Truancy, for whatever reason, is not permitted.
Spijbelen, om wat voor reden dan ook, is niet geoorloofd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Temmink over waarschuwingsbrieven van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en de onwenselijkheid van omdraaiing van de bewijslast in het strafrecht

MPs Sneller and Temmink asked about 176 warning letters sent by the Public Prosecution Service to people allegedly present at the November 2022 Schiphol climate protest, identified partly via facial recognition, and whether the subsequent interviews reversed the burden of proof. The minister answered that the letters have no formal legal status, that some identifications were wrong and apologies were sent, that people were treated as 'betrokkenen' rather than suspects, and that data of wrongly identified persons will be deleted while further investigation and evaluation are ongoing.
The warning letter has no formal legal status and therefore does not lead to registration in the criminal records.
De waarschuwingsbrief heeft geen formele juridische status en leidt dus ook niet tot vermelding op de justitiële documentatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de aanhoudende onveiligheid in Budel en Maarheeze

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about persistent nuisance and crime by asylum seekers in Budel and Maarheeze, including shops hiring volunteers and removing benches, and whether the government accepts that residents must protect their own safety. The Staatssecretaris answered that a team of four mobile inspectors, faster processing of low-chance asylum applications and municipal camera funding are being deployed, that police rather than volunteers should enforce order, and that the COA will publish 2023 incident figures only in 2024, while rejecting the claim that policy has failed.
The COA publishes an annual incident overview at location level.
Het COA publiceert jaarlijks een incidentenoverzicht op locatieniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Aartsen en Erkens over het bericht ‘Drugsmaffia biedt ‘hulp’ aan Limburgse horecaondernemers die sinds de watersnood problemen hebben’

Three VVD MPs asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that drug gangs were offering 'help' to Limburg hospitality businesses struggling after the 2021 floods, covering compensation, prevention, RIEC analysis, information sharing and cross-border criminal approaches. The minister answered that affected hospitality entrepreneurs awaited no pending compensation decision, described existing prevention campaigns and cooperation, and said no specific sector analysis or concrete RIEC signals existed.
Yes, the report is known to me.
Ja, het bericht is mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht ‘Drugsmaffia biedt ‘hulp’ aan Limburgse horecaondernemers die sinds de watersnood problemen hebben’

An MP asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers whether criminals offering help to flood-hit Limburg hospitality entrepreneurs was known, and what support the state provides. The minister answered that the matter is known, outlined prevention efforts and compensation schemes (Wts, provincial omzetderving scheme with a second opening), and said the state would keep working on resilience against organised crime.
Progress will be reported to the House on a regular basis in the half-yearly letter on the approach to organised, undermining crime and in reports on the progress of handling Wts claims.

Over de voortgang wordt de Kamer op regelmatige basis geïnformeerd in de halfjaarbrief aanpak georganiseerde, ondermijnende criminaliteit en in rapportages over de voortgang van de afhandeling van de Wts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over politieke processen die beperkte OM-capaciteit opsouperen

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether limited Public Prosecution Service capacity is being drained by political prosecutions (Wilders, De Mos, Van Meijeren), leaving cases like animal cruelty and fraud unpursued, and whether appeals against full acquittals conflict with ne bis in idem. The minister rejects the premise that these are political prosecutions, says the OM independently sets priorities, and defends the appeal in the De Mos case as serving restoration, control and legal-unity functions.
I do not agree with this view.
In deze mening kan ik mij niet vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de haatactie van Pegida in Den Haag

An MP asked ministers whether they condemn Pegida's planned Koran-burning action in The Hague, whether they would press the mayor to ban it, and how it affects relations with Turkey. The government called the act provocative but said freedom of expression is a fundamental right, that the mayor is responsible for demonstrations under the Wom, and that Turkey was raised in bilateral talks.
The Public Demonstrations Act (Wom) places responsibility for facilitating demonstrations with local authorities.
De Wet openbare manifestaties (Wom) legt de verantwoordelijkheid voor het faciliteren van demonstraties bij het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over directe en indirecte lozingen en/of afvalinjecties onder de Waddenzee

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether wastewater from gas and oil extraction near the Wadden Sea, including injection at Borgsweer and Ameland-Westgat, could reach the Natura 2000 area, and whether the operator's classification of cadmium and other substances as less hazardous was acceptable. The Secretary of State answered that migration beneath the Wadden Sea cannot be excluded but poses no realistic contamination risk due to thick impermeable layers, and that produced water may contain hazardous substances, to be tested by the license holder under existing waste rules.
I cannot rule out that wastewater released in the production of oil and gas contains hazardous substances.
Ik kan niet uitsluiten dat afvalwater dat vrijkomt bij de productie van olie en gas gevaarlijke stoffen bevat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de onwenselijke inzet en dieronvriendelijke training van politiehonden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Justice and Agriculture ministers about police dog training methods, the KNPV's role, and whether police dogs should be restricted from indoor, child and non-violent use. The minister answers that stun-collar and stick exercises have been removed from certification, that police buy dogs from private trainers and cut ties with trainers who mistreat animals, and that existing rules are sufficient.
I do not share the concerns about the lack of rules.
De zorgen over het gebrek aan regels deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de berichtgeving betreffende Lysander de R. die de dienst uitmaakte in de gevangenis en de motorclub MC Hardliners

An MP asked the ministers about reports that prisoner Lysander de R. enjoyed privileges and led the MC Hardliners from prison despite internal staff reports, and why he was not moved to a stricter regime or the club banned earlier. The minister declined to discuss individual cases, described general selection and transfer procedures, and said the OM has now filed for a ban on the club.
I do not go into the situation regarding individual detainees.
Ik ga niet in op de situatie rondom individuele gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de zaak Willem Engel

Member Van Haga asked the ministers about the Willem Engel case, including alleged prosecution influence on a VOG decision, a GRIP registration, monitoring and a media campaign against Engel and Viruswaarheid, and the minister's public statements. The minister denied OM instructions and media campaigns, declined to discuss individual cases, and stated that intelligence services do not comment on their work.
As I also indicated in the earlier answer, I cannot make statements about specific VOG applications.
Zoals ik in de eerdere beantwoording ook aangaf, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over specifieke VOG-aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het toenemend aantal explosies

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether the rising number of explosions is caused by drug gang feuds and what measures, including financial support for municipalities, will be taken. The minister answers that police and prosecutors cannot yet say whether gang feuds are the cause, that additional measures will be considered if so, and that the existing broad anti-organised-crime approach will be continued and reinforced.

Should it turn out that most explosions are indeed the result of feuds between drug gangs, I will, together with relevant partners including the police and the Public Prosecution Service, consider which additional measures are needed.

Mocht blijken dat inderdaad de meeste explosies het gevolg zijn van ruzies tussen drugsbendes, dan zal ik samen met betrokken partners, waaronder de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie, bezien welke aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de Nederlandse positie ten aanzien van de SLAPP-richtlijn

MP Sjoerdsma asks why the Netherlands supports keeping domestic SLAPPs outside the EU directive, why the directive's protection is weaker than the Commission recommendation, and whether the narrow early-dismissal mechanism and the omission of a damages provision weaken protection for journalists. Minister Weerwind replies that Dutch procedural law already offers remedies against abusive suits, that the Council position improves early dismissal, and that a general liability regime makes a specific damages provision unnecessary.

For the situation in the Netherlands, the cabinet is of the view that Dutch procedural law provides sufficient safeguards to protect journalists and human rights defenders against SLAPPs at national level.

Voor de situatie in Nederland is het kabinet van mening dat het Nederlandse procesrecht voldoende waarborgen biedt ter bescherming van journalisten en mensenrechtenverdedigers tegen SLAPPs op nationaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over afkalvende bestaanszekerheid voor mensen met publieke beroepen door kostenstijgingen en loonbeslag

An MP from the PvdA asked several ministers about falling financial security among care and public-sector workers, including reports that many skip doctor or dentist visits and that some have wage garnishments. The government answered that it lacks sector-specific garnishment data, that such garnishments are not shown to be more common in the public sector, and pointed to existing debt-relief measures and the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet, with no change to the exempt amount planned.

The cabinet does not have figures on wage garnishment in (subsectors of) care and cannot say whether the share of employees with a wage garnishment among district nurses and nursing home staff is larger than among other occupational groups or branches within care.

Het kabinet beschikt niet over cijfers over loonbeslag in (subsectoren van) de zorg en kan dus ook niet zeggen of het percentage medewerkers met loonbeslag onder wijkverpleegkundigen en zorgpersoneel in verpleeghuizen groter is dan onder andere beroepsgroepen dan wel branches binnen de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over een actieve sekte in Zeeland waar mensen worden misleid en waar miljoenen euro’s omgaan

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about an active cult in Zeeland (Maerloo) whose members give up personal assets, and about the lack of a reporting point for cult victims and the limited police capacity on sects. The Minister says the matter is known, that prosecution is for police and the public prosecutor and cannot be discussed, that a reporting point is not chosen and victim help is being explored within existing structures, with information due by year end.
Insofar as this question aims to inquire about any criminal measures taken or being taken against (members of) Maerloo, I note that I cannot and may not comment on this.

Voor zover met deze vraagstelling wordt beoogd te informeren naar eventuele strafrechtelijke maatregelen die zijn/worden getroffen jegens (leden van) Maerloo, merk ik op dat ik mij hierover niet kan en mag uitlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de lid Van Houwelingen over 'politieboot Pride 2023'

An FvD MP asked the Justice Minister whether police officers in uniform flying the rainbow Pride flag on a police boat at Amsterdam's 2023 Canal Parade conflicts with the constitutional principle of ideological neutrality of civil servants. The minister answered that the presence expresses that the police are for everyone, that uniforms follow ministerial rules, that Pride flags symbolise inclusion, and that the answers could not be given within three weeks.
Police participation in a Pride boat expresses that the police are there for everyone and that there is room within the police for everyone.
Het meevaren van de politie op een Pride -boot geeft uitdrukking aan het feit dat de politie er voor iedereen is en dat binnen de politie er ruimte voor iedereen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Warmerdam en Van der Werf over het NOS artikel 'Met steun van Nederland wankelt nieuwe EU-wet voor vrouwenrechten'

MPs Warmerdam and Van der Werf asked the government whether the Netherlands opposed parts of the EU directive on violence against women, including the rape harmonisation article, and why. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports the directive overall, opposed article 5 on rape harmonisation on legal-basis grounds following the Council Legal Service advice, and that the Dutch Wet seksuele misdrijven offers broader protection.
To protect the confidentiality of the negotiations, it is not customary to go into the individual positions of other member states in the negotiations.
Om de vertrouwelijkheid van de onderhandelingen te beschermen is het niet gebruikelijk om in te gaan op de individuele posities van andere lidstaten in de onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het schieten met een pistool en mitrailleur op een foto van mijn hoofd

The MP Wilders asks whether the government is aware of a video showing a threat against him, whether the AIVD and NCTV were informed, what steps are taken to trace the perpetrator, and whether diplomatic measures will be taken if the video comes from Pakistan. The minister condemns the threat, declines to comment on intelligence and protection matters or on the individual investigation, and says the Pakistani ambassador would be informed of concerns and that a legal assistance request is possible.
As Minister of Justice and Security, I cannot go into individual cases, in order to prevent political interference.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken, dit om politieke bemoeienis te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Wassenberg over de aanpak van illegale handel in beschermde plant- en diersoorten of producten ervan

MPs Van Esch and Wassenberg asked the government about the illegal trade in protected wildlife, its links to zoonotic disease and other crime, enforcement gaps, and the EU Action Plan. The minister answered that the government recognises the problem, cites enforcement and coordination arrangements, and commits to a consumer awareness campaign and national follow-up to the EU plan, without changing criminal penalties.
I will send your House an overview of the Dutch efforts on the revised action plan later this year once it is ready.
Ik zal uw Kamer later dit jaar een overzicht van de Nederlandse inzet op het herziene actieplan toesturen zodra dit gereed is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Ontslagen bij de Zeeuwse politie na grensoverschrijdend gedrag’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of discriminatory and boundary-crossing conduct by Zeeland police officers, including whether supervisors were aware and why two officers received conditional dismissal and were reassigned to armed posts. The minister answered that leadership acted once the conduct surfaced, supervisors were not involved, and the officers' conditional dismissal, probation and supervision were considered sufficient safeguards.
Based on the investigation, it appeared that supervisors were not part of this boundary-crossing conduct and were also not aware of it.
Op basis van het onderzoek is gebleken dat leidinggevenden geen onderdeel waren van dit grensoverschrijdende gedrag en hiervan ook niet op de hoogte waren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Temmink en Van Nispen over de lobbyactiviteiten van de fabrikant van de taser

MPs Temmink and Van Nispen asked whether police officers were invited to a Axon (taser maker) roadshow with gifts and meals, how new police equipment is procured, and whether the term 'excited delirium' is scientifically grounded. The Minister says the roadshow page was removed, no police invitations were found, procurement is demand-led under police purchasing policy, and it is not for the Minister to research the medical diagnosis.
As far as can be checked, it has not appeared that police officers were invited to this roadshow.
Voor zover dat nagegaan kan worden is niet gebleken dat voor deze roadshow politiefunctionarissen zouden zijn uitgenodigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over de noodmelding van NL-Alert in Noord-Holland op 5 juli 2023

An MP asked the Justice minister why the 5 July 2023 NL-Alert emergency message for Noord-Holland pointed to Twitter for updates, which not everyone can access, and whether info should not depend on one tech platform. The minister replied that mayors and safety regions are responsible for local alerts, the national government does not review them, and she will check with the safety regions whether the guidance framework needs changing.
In times of disasters or crisis, it is the mayor who is responsible for alerting and informing citizens.
In tijden van rampen of crisis is het de burgemeester die de verantwoordelijkheid heeft voor het alarmeren en informeren van burgers
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat, Sneller en Van Weyenberg over het piramidespel van IM Academy en Finfluencers

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers of Justice, Finance and Economic Affairs about the IM Academy pyramid scheme, its recruitment of young people, and the regulation of finfluencers. The government said the supervisors (Ksa, ACM, AFM) are responsible, explained existing rules and enforcement tools, and said it sees no need for major new rules beyond pressing for stronger European investor protection.
The supervisory authorities are independent in their supervision and make no statements about ongoing or possible future investigations.
De toezichthouders zijn onafhankelijk in hun toezicht en doen geen mededelingen over lopende of eventueel te starten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over kinderen en drugscriminaliteit

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about drug-related problems among children, referring to a news report on Hollands Kroon, and whether preventive and integrated approaches should be extended to more municipalities. The minister answers that the Preventie met gezag approach is being extended to 27 municipalities selected on data, that smaller municipalities such as Hollands Kroon do not qualify for the area-based approach but get a flexible approach, and that integrated cooperation among organisations is pursued.
For that reason, the area-based Preventie met gezag approach is being extended to 27 municipalities.
Daarom wordt de gebiedsgerichte aanpak Preventie met gezag uitgebreid naar 27 gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Man overleed nadat de politie hem taserde, Rijksrecherche doet onderzoek’

MP Azarkan asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a man who died after police used a taser, with questions on taser safety, handling of people with confused behaviour, family information, and the justification for force and the 2023 incident. The minister expressed sympathy, said the Rijksrecherche is investigating under the Openbaar Ministerie and declined to comment on the case while the investigation runs, while defending taser use as de-escalating and pointing to ongoing health monitoring and a planned evaluation of force instruments by 2025.
Because the investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make further statements about it.
Omdat het onderzoek nog loopt, kan ik hier geen verdere uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht 'Omstreden moskee-infiltrant gaat bij politie aan de slag met discriminatie en uitsluiting: 'Zorgwekkend''

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that a controversial mosque infiltrator was hired by the police as programme manager for racism and discrimination, and whether this appointment is appropriate and should be reversed. The minister answered that the police leadership judged the hire acceptable, that the person's work as external project leader is valued, and that appointments are the police's responsibility, so the minister does not intervene in individual cases.
It is not for me to intervene in individual cases.
Het is daarbij niet aan mij om te treden in individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de aanpak van Russische oligarchen in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Justice ministers why Russian oligarchs' Dutch assets, including VS Energy's operations, remain active and unconfiscated despite sanctions, and what the government is doing about confiscation and Ukrainian legal assistance requests. The minister replied that individual cases cannot be discussed, that confiscation is possible only through criminal-law titles, that legal assistance requests are assessed under treaties, and that Parliament will be updated after the summer.
The cabinet cannot go into individual case matters.
Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Kuik over het bericht 'WhatsApp en Signal dreigen VK te verlaten vanwege breken encryptie' van AG Connect

MPs Slootweg and Kuik asked the State Secretary and Minister of Justice and Security about reports that WhatsApp and Signal might leave the UK over encryption-breaking provisions in the Online Safety Bill, and whether scanning messaging apps for child abuse material should outweigh encryption. The Minister answered that the UK bill is still pending, that the EU CSAM regulation is under negotiation, that the government supports no proposal making end-to-end encryption impossible in line with the Van Raan motion, and that client-side scanning is being considered within those limits.
The Netherlands does not support European proposals that make end-to-end encryption impossible, in line with the motion-Van Raan adopted by the House of Representatives.
Nederland steunt geen Europese voorstellen die end-to-end encryptie onmogelijk maken, in lijn met de door uw Kamer aangenomen motie-Van Raan c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Aartsen over het bericht 'Rondtrekkende bendes vaker betrokken bij diefstallen in Nederland'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Aartsen asked the Justice Minister about reports that travelling criminal gangs are increasingly involved in thefts, including the share of non-Dutch suspects, cooperation with European and non-European countries, the Taskforce Mobiel Banditisme, Europol's role and prevention measures. The minister answered in detail that suspect data is limited, that a 25 percent figure applies only to cases where a suspect is identified, that existing cooperation and information-sharing mechanisms are adequate, and that the mobile banditry approach is now embedded in the Actieprogramma Veilig Ondernemen.
Yes, I will also address the progress of the approach to mobile banditry in the next half-yearly report.
Ja, ik zal in het volgende halfjaarbericht ook ingaan op de voortgang van de aanpak van mobiel banditisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Der Werf over het bericht ‘integriteit is bij de politie geen prioriteit, blijkt uit onderzoek’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how she views research suggesting integrity has low priority within the police and how this relates to recent integrity violations. The minister answered that integrity is a core value, describes existing instruments and recent measures such as the new screening act and an integrity portfolio holder, but gave only general responses without committing to new concrete steps.
Integrity is one of the four core values of the police and the police leadership takes various measures to promote an ethical work climate.
Integriteit is één van de vier kernwaarden van de politie en de korpsleiding neemt diverse maatregelen ter bevordering van een ethisch werkklimaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over criminele uitbuiting van basisscholieren

An MP asked the Justice Minister about criminals recruiting primary school pupils for crime and whether this constitutes human trafficking under Article 273f, and whether the non-punishment principle for victims should be codified. The government answered that recruitment of pupils is being monitored with prevention tools, a victim helpline pilot and a reporting duty for schools, that trafficking requires the conditions of Article 273f to be met, and that the non-punishment principle is already applied through prosecutorial discretion and court practice without a separate statutory provision.
Anchoring this in an explicit statutory provision alongside the already extensive set of instruments is not considered advisable, precisely because of the variety of cases.
Verankering in een expliciete, wettelijke bepaling naast dit reeds uitgebreide instrumentarium wordt – juist vanwege de variëteit aan gevallen – niet opportuun geacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over de stichting de Vrienden van XR

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Idsinga asked about the Stichting Vrienden van XR, its alleged role funnelling money to Extinction Rebellion, government subsidies to related organisations, its ANBI status, and civil liability for disruptive actions. The Minister answered that the government has no subsidy relationship with XR or the foundation, that ANBI status is assessed neutrally by the tax authority, and that civil liability for unlawful acts is for courts to decide.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to assess such statements.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om hier in de beoordeling te treden van dergelijke uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over nieuwe Europese wetgeving die de zoektocht naar vermiste kinderen bemoeilijkt

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the EU AI Act's effect on searching for missing children, including the question of whether it could be blocked in Brussels and whether the Amber Alert model should be used across Europe. The minister said the government opposes a total ban on real-time facial recognition and will seek narrow exceptions, will pursue a balanced text with other member states, and that cross-border child alerts must go through formal channels.
The cabinet will, in close cooperation with other member states and the Council presidency, work hard in the coming period for a balanced text
Het kabinet zal zich de komende tijd in nauwe samenwerkingen met andere lidstaten en het voorzitterschap van de Raad hard maken voor een gebalanceerde tekst
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Boerenorganisatie LTO wil dat dierenextremisten worden gestraft: 'Bijna elke dag insluipingen''

MPs Van Campen and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked about reports that farm organisation LTO wants animal-rights extremists punished for stable occupations and break-ins, and whether current law and police registration are adequate. The Minister of Justice answered that existing offences (trespass and unlawful entry) can be prosecuted, that a separate police classification for such incidents is currently undesirable, and that follow-up steps such as talks with the sector and a review of earlier agreements are being considered.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht ‘Hells Angels zijn niet te stoppen, ze zijn het voor altijd’

An MP asks the Justice Minister how visible Hells Angels colors still circulate in public space, how enforcement and monitoring of continuation under other names work, and whether the instruments remain adequate after the Supreme Court colors ruling. The minister replies that local partners enforce and monitor, about 15 related court cases are pending, no figures on colors enforcement exist, the new instruments have not yet been used, and an evaluation is expected in spring 2024.
Exact figures on enforcement cannot be retrieved from the registration systems.
Exacte cijfers over de handhaving zijn in de registratiesystemen niet te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over een agent die veroordeeld is voor racistische belediging en een functie krijgt bij de vreemdelingenpolitie

Two SP MPs asked the Justice Minister why a police officer convicted of racist insults was set to take a temporary post at the aliens police, and whether the case was handled adequately. The minister answered that the appointment has since been reconsidered and deemed unsuitable, that the disciplinary and criminal sanctions were applied, and that no specific measures for the Rotterdam force are currently seen as necessary.
I cannot go into individual cases that are before the judge.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken die onder de rechter zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de agent die veroordeeld is voor racisme en nu leidinggevende wordt bij de vreemdelingenpolitie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a police officer convicted for racist insults who was set to take a leadership role at the immigration police, and whether such promotions occur elsewhere and how police norms are enforced. The minister answered that the appointment was withdrawn, that the officer was already sanctioned, that no separate figures on similar cases are kept, and that the police are working on a uniform approach to discrimination and racism.
No separate figures are kept on this.
Hierover worden geen aparte cijfers bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Krul en Boswijk over de beveiliging van luchthaven Schiphol

Three CDA MPs asked ministers how Schiphol's access controls fail when former staff keep passes, uniforms and radios, and who is responsible for fixing this. The government calls the situation unacceptable, says Royal Schiphol Group and employers hold responsibility, and lists audits, sanctions and an automatic alarm as steps taken.
Royal Schiphol Group further intensifies supervision of correct implementation by carrying out random audits of employers.
Royal Schiphol Group intensiveert verder het toezicht op de correcte uitvoering door steekproefsgewijs audits uit te voeren op werkgevers
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Van Haga over websites met kindermisbruik op Nederlandse servers

An MP asked the ministers whether they knew of a rise in child sexual abuse websites hosted on Dutch servers, what action was taken, who owns the servers, and how such content is enforced against. The government answered that the Dutch share has actually fallen, outlined self-regulation with hosting providers and the planned ATKM enforcement authority, and said precise ownership and perpetrator data are unavailable.
We do not have a complete overview by nationality and ownership.
Een totaal overzicht naar nationaliteit en eigenaarschap hebben wij niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Slootweg over het bericht aantal getroffen websites met ernstig kindermisbruik in twee jaar tijd verdubbeld

CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister about a report that websites with severe child sexual abuse material doubled in two years, and why many are hosted on Dutch servers, what measures will be taken, and how encryption affects detection. The minister agreed the trend is worrying, pointed to voluntary takedown codes and a planned regulator (ATKM) with enforcement powers, and said encrypted communication makes investigation difficult while promising continued cooperation with the sector.
No figures are known for 2022 on sanctioning websites.
Over 2022 zijn geen cijfers bekend van het sanctioneren van websites.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht aantal getroffen websites met ernstig kindermisbruik in twee jaar tijd verdubbeld

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report that websites containing serious child sexual abuse material doubled over two years, and about Dutch hosting providers involved, cooperation with the IWF and hosters, and the timing of the bill on administrative enforcement. The minister answered that the Netherlands' share of such material fell from 41% to 32%, described the self-regulation regime and the planned ATKM authority, and committed to sending the bill to parliament, which was done on 12 June.
I sent the bill on administrative enforcement against online child pornography to your House on 12 June.
Ik heb het wetsvoorstel bestuursrechtelijke aanpak online kinderpornografisch materiaal op 12 juni jl. naar uw Kamer verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het aantal geweldsincidenten bij politie-inzet is gestegen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the reported rise in police use-of-force incidents, including the link to shorter police training, staffing shortages, public discontent, de-escalation, registration quality and registration of protest-related force. The minister answered that no complete explanation can yet be given, that the police plan an analysis, found no evidence linking the training change or staffing to the rise, and that existing sanctions and registration are considered adequate, though no protest-specific registration will be introduced.
To gain insight into the background and motives of officers for using force, qualitative research would be necessary.
Om inzicht te krijgen in de achtergrond en beweegredenen van agenten om geweld toe te passen, zou een kwalitatief onderzoek noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over toename geweld bij de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the reported rise in police use of force in 2022, including non-professional or wrongful force, and whether this is linked to rising violence against police and to people with confused behaviour. The minister answered that the figures on police force and on violence against officers cannot be directly compared, that the police plan a study to explain the figures, and that the 13% share of non-professional uses of force reflects normal fluctuation that cannot yet show a trend.
Out of the general wish to be able to explain the GDPA figures and to identify possible links, the police intend to commission a study.
Vanuit de algemene wens om duiding te kunnen geven aan de GDPA cijfers en eventuele verbanden te kunnen leggen, is de politie voornemens een onderzoek te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Speciaal politiekorps voor haven Antwerpen’

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report on a new special police force for the Antwerp port, the role of drug runners, prosecution options, and the risk of displacement to Rotterdam. The minister answered that existing tools and a funded Rotterdam port programme address these issues, that cooperation with Belgium is ongoing, and that corruption is tackled through an integrated public-private approach.

I am convinced that with this approach, which will continue to demand much of us in the coming years, we are taking significant steps to reduce drug smuggling through the port of Rotterdam and other logistics hubs.

Ik ben ervan overtuigd dat we met deze aanpak, die de komende jaren veel van ons zal blijven vragen, significante stappen zetten in het terugdringen van drugssmokkel via de haven van Rotterdam en andere logistieke knooppunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Boswijk over het bericht ‘Het geheim van Brabant: hoe criminelen azen op boerenstallen’

The CDA MPs Kuik and Boswijk asked whether the voluntary livestock buy-out scheme accounts for the risk that criminals use vacated farm buildings for drug production and whether farmers can be protected and helped. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that demolition obligations and supervision by municipalities limit this risk, that farmers can report suspected criminal use to the police, and that a national resilience approach and a possible 'flying brigade' for drug waste are being explored, with updates promised later this autumn.
Supervision of timely demolition of the production capacity lies with the municipalities, which are informed about who has applied for a subsidy.
Toezicht op tijdige sloop van de productiecapaciteit ligt bij gemeenten, die geïnformeerd worden over wie een subsidie heeft aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Joodse student voelt zich onveilig’

An SGP MP asked ministers about a Jewish student feeling unsafe, a 'Israeli Apartheid Week' at the University of Groningen, a moderator's ties to a pro-Palestine group, BDS, and recording antisemitic incidents. The government condemned antisemitism, said universities must allow controversial views within legal limits while ensuring safe environments, and referred prosecution decisions to the prosecutor and courts.
In individual cases it is for the public prosecutor to assess whether there is discrimination or criminal liability under the articles of the Criminal Code.
Het is in individuele gevallen aan het openbaar ministerie om te beoordelen of er sprake is van discriminatie, c.q. strafbaarheid op grond van de artikelen in het Wetboek van Strafrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Sneller over het persbericht van het Openbaar Ministerie ‘Nieuw college, nieuwe accenten‘

MPs Van der Werf and Sneller asked the Justice Minister about the Public Prosecution Service's announcement that it will focus less on crime prevention, asking about its reasons, effects on prevention programmes, and the coalition agreement. The minister said the OM remains committed to prevention, that the shift is about focusing on core enforcement and faster case handling, and that the coalition agreement commitments will be implemented.
The OM has assured me that the agreements made in the context of the Coalition Agreement are simply being implemented.
Het OM heeft mij verzekerd dat de afspraken die in het kader van het Coalitieakkoord zijn gemaakt gewoon worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de AH-steker uit Den Haag

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a suspect's prior history of violence, earlier complaints on Curaçao, and whether cuts to mental health care explain the rise in confused persons on the street. The minister declined to give details beyond an earlier letter, pointing to a criminal investigation and an Inspectorate inquiry, argued the registration rise may not reflect a real increase, and said curative mental health spending rose rather than fell.
At this moment it is not possible to provide more information than contained in the letter with which I informed your House last Thursday about this terrible incident.
Op dit moment is het niet mogelijk om meer informatie te verstrekken dan opgenomen in de brief waarmee ik uw Kamer afgelopen donderdag over dit verschrikkelijke incident informeerde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Van Nispen over de sekte La Luz Del Mundo

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about the La Luz Del Mundo sect, its Den Haag presence, victim support, a central reporting point and a Belgian knowledge centre. The minister answered that police have no information warranting criminal action, that victims can be supported by existing services, and that a broader review of victim help and a reporting point is pending in a separate letter.
I refer you to the aforementioned letter of 30 June.
Ik verwijs u naar voornoemde brief van 30 juni.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘’Ene na het andere geldwisselkantoor gesloten na explosies: wat is er gaande bij Suri-Change?’’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about municipalities closing nine Suri-Change money exchange locations after explosions and possible criminal links, plus DNB supervision of money transfer organisations, information sharing between municipalities, and the role of mayors and RIECs. The minister declined to comment on the specific company or ongoing investigations, described DNB's risk-based supervision and the sector's integrity challenges, and outlined limited Bibob-based information sharing and the mayor's role in tackling criminal money flows.
I cannot make statements about individual cases or ongoing investigations.
Over individuele casussen of lopende onderzoeken kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over “het bericht ongeveer 2,2 miljoen mensen vorig jaar getroffen door cybercriminaliteit”

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the government responds to reports of 2.2 million cybercrime victims, ransomware payments, data breaches in government, reporting rates, and the MiND discrimination reporting point. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, pointed to existing strategies, prevention and reporting measures, rejected a ransom fund and paying ransoms, and promised to improve the MiND point's visibility.
Uitstel beantwoording vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Speciaal politiekorps voor haven Antwerpen’

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Minister of Justice and Security ten questions about a special police unit for the port of Antwerp, drug mules, corruption in Rotterdam port and cooperation between Dutch and Belgian port police. The government's response is only a notice that the answers will be delayed because not all necessary information has been received yet, and it promises answers as soon as possible.
because not all necessary information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen. Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Bushoff over long covid bij de politie

MPs Mutluer and Bushoff asked about long COVID among police officers, including numbers reporting, sick-leave impact, whether it is treated as an occupational illness, and support measures. The minister answered that 378 police staff with post-COVID complaints are registered with the company doctor, that police treat COVID infection as an accident at work under conditions, and that general national post-COVID measures are in place.
From the standpoint of medical confidentiality, it is not known to what extent these colleagues are absent from work as a result of their post-COVID-19 complaints.
Uit het oogpunt van medische geheimhouding is niet bekend in welke mate deze collega's verzuimen als gevolg van hun post- COVID-19 klachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een onterecht veroordeelde man opnieuw achter de tralies is beland mede door toedoen van de Nederlandse overheid

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the Dutch state contributed to a wrongly convicted man being re-jailed in Spain after a pardon was granted, and what the state would do to free him and compensate him. The minister declined to discuss the individual case on privacy grounds, referred to general procedures for pardons and information-sharing with foreign authorities, and said the handling would be reviewed if found inadequate.
I cannot provide you with detailed information on this without going into the particulars of the individual case.
Ik kan u hierover geen gedetailleerde informatie verschaffen zonder in te gaan op de bijzonderheden van de individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over politiegeweld jegens een vreedzame demonstratie in de crisisopvang

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police violence, including batons and dogs, against a peaceful gathering at a crisis shelter in Zuidbroek, and whether the response respected the right to demonstrate, phone seizures, aftercare for victims, consequences for officers and an evaluation. The minister said the government cannot judge the incident from fragmentary footage, that police may use force only as a last resort subject to proportionality checks and reporting, that no phone seizure appears in police systems but complaints can be filed, and that the incident will not be formally evaluated though a police-COA conversation will take place.

It is not for me to assess, on the basis of fragmentary footage, which means of force the police did or did not deploy during a given operation and whether the force used was proportionate, subsidiary, reasonable and effective.

Het is niet aan mij om op basis van gefragmenteerde beelden te beoordelen welke geweldmiddelen de politie wel of niet bij een bepaald optreden inzet en of het gebruikte geweld tijdens dat optreden proportioneel, subsidiair, redelijk en doelmatig is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over directe en indirecte lozingen en/of afvalinjecties onder de Waddenzee

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked about direct and indirect discharges and waste injection of oil and gas production water under the Wadden Sea, including legal storage duties, alternatives, and whether NAM could be denied new permits if prosecuted. The state secretary answered that no waste is injected under the Wadden Sea, that reporting on production water exists, and that he cannot anticipate prosecution consequences for future permit decisions.
I cannot anticipate a possible prosecution of NAM and its possible consequences for future permit granting.
Ik kan niet vooruitlopen op een mogelijke vervolging van NAM en de eventuele gevolgen daarvan voor toekomstige vergunningverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het nieuws dat de Binnenlandse Veiligheidsdienst jarenlang illegaal advocaten en academici bespioneerde

Left-wing SP MPs asked the Interior Minister about reports that the BVD illegally surveilled lawyers and academics, including Bakker Schut and people around him, and whether this resembled police-state methods and was a criminalisation of a lawyer. The minister replied that the 1970s investigations took place under a much thinner legal framework, that the RAF terrorism context applied, that today's stricter safeguards for lawyers (court authorisation, CTIVD oversight) are in place, and that the AIVD cannot publicly discuss the specific operational case.
Finally, I cannot publicly discuss the intelligence investigations of the AIVD and its predecessors.
Ik kan, ten slotte, in het openbaar niet ingaan op de inlichtingenonderzoeken van de AIVD en diens voorgangers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Boer Erik Jan doelwit criminele bendes:” Ze hebben alles gesloopt”

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van Campen (VVD) asked whether GPS theft from farm vehicles by organised, mostly Eastern European gangs is rising, where it occurs, what police and the ministers are doing about it, and how agricultural areas are protected against criminal takeover. The government answered that GPS thefts have risen slightly, concentrated in four regions, and described police prevention, cross-border information exchange, registration databases and ongoing public-private cooperation, while stating these thefts do not qualify as high impact crimes.
In 2023, up to 30 May, around 50 reports or complaints were received of GPS theft from barns, stables or a farmyard.
In 2023 zijn er tot 30 mei ongeveer 50 meldingen of aangiftes ontvangen van diefstal van GPS uit schuren, stallen of van een erf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over drugsgebruik in gevangenissen

Member Kuik (CDA) asked the Justice and Health ministers about suspected widespread Spice use in Ter Apel prison, its health risks and detectability, sanctions for smuggling, addiction care, and measures to stop smuggling. Minister Weerwind answered that smuggling and use are punishable, detection is difficult and under study with new technology, no confirmed Spice deaths are known, and DJI is expanding information and reviewing foreign approaches, though no additional mortality testing is planned.
In addition, DJI also focuses on prevention of use and information provision.
Daarnaast zet DJI ook in op preventie van gebruik en voorlichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Kathmann over online identiteitsfraude

MPs Mutluer and Kathmann asked about online identity fraude, including its prevalence, links to data hacks, who bears the burden of proof for disputed contracts, and whether businesses should verify customer identities. The minister answered that no central figures exist, pointed to CMI and Fraudemonitor data, stated the trader bears the burden of proof, and said verification is a business responsibility while promising a letter on the Energy Act.
Article 150 of the Code of Civil Procedure provides that the party relying on legal consequences of facts or rights it asserts bears the burden of proving them.
Artikel 150 van de Wet van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering stelt dat de partij die zich beroept op rechtsgevolgen van door haar gestelde feiten of rechten, de bewijslast daarvan draagt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Verkuijlen over het artikel 'Zorgen om online bedreigingen leerlingen: ’Doet een beetje denken aan de kogelbrief’'

MPs Paul and Verkuijlen asked the ministers about online threats against pupils and schools, including how often they occur, how schools should respond, and whether perpetrators are caught. Minister Wiersma answers that no national trend data exists, points to a planned incident-reporting duty in a forthcoming bill, and describes existing protocols and support organisations, without committing to new structural oversight measures.
There is no national picture of how often these kinds of threats occur.
Er is geen landelijk beeld hoe vaak dit soort bedreigingen voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over ‘het bestrijden van beroepsvandalen van Extinction Rebellion’

An MP asked the Justice Minister how to deal with Extinction Rebellion protests that block roads and disrupt public order, including whether the Overlastwet, group bans, damages recovery, subsidies and dialogue with the group could be used. The minister replied that demonstrations should be facilitated, that the mayor may restrict them only for health, traffic or public order reasons, that the Overlastwet does not apply to demonstrations, that damages can be recovered through civil or criminal routes, that no government subsidy was given, and that the minister does not talk with demonstration organisers.
The right to demonstrate is a great good, but the right to protest is not a licence to commit criminal offences.
Het demonstratierecht is een groot goed, echter het recht op betoging is geen vrijbrief voor het plegen van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Haga over de zaak De Mos

MPs Wilders and Van Haga asked the Justice Minister about the De Mos corruption case, which they say has politically paralysed The Hague after the Rotterdam court acquitted most suspects, and whether the minister would use her instruction power to halt the case. The minister answered that the prosecution service decides independently, that the case's length reflects its complexity, and that she will not use her instruction power, since ministerial interference in individual criminal cases must be avoided.
I am not willing to use my special instruction power, as referred to in articles 127 and 128 of the Judicial Organisation Act.
Los daarvan, ben ik niet bereid gebruik te maken van mijn bijzondere aanwijzingsbevoegdheid, zoals bedoeld in artikelen 127 en 128 van de Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Zelfbenoemde salafistenpolitie zaait angst in moskeeën: moslims met verkeerd geloof aan schandpaal genageld; AIVD en NCTV waarschuwen: salafistis

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about the salafist 'self-appointed police' in mosques and whether intelligence and counterterrorism gaps, imam recruitment from abroad, and information-sharing need tightening. The government answered at length: it says the NCTV lacks a legal basis to process personal data from social media, the bill on casus consultations is needed, soft signals cannot be shared with foreign countries under current law, and it is working on an imam training route and transparency rules, while declining a single legal definition of problematic behaviour.
The NCTV currently has no legal basis for processing personal data and therefore cannot consult social media sources, resulting in a more limited view.
