De NCTV heeft op dit moment geen grondslag voor het verwerken van persoonsgegevens, en kan derhalve geen sociale media-bronnen raadplegen en heeft dus ook beperkter zicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Aboutaleb stopt met dwangsom mesbezit’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a court ruling that blocked Rotterdam's use of an administrative order under penalty (last onder dwangsom) against knife possession, and whether the government would create a legal basis for mayors to impose such orders and what measures it would take against youth knife carrying. The minister answered that the instrument can be useful but depends on local circumstances and an APV provision, which is a municipal matter, and summarised the Actieplan Wapens en Jongeren and follow-up evaluation steps.
However, it depends on the nature and extent of the local problem whether a provision in the municipal general local regulation (APV) supplementing the Weapons and Ammunition Act is needed.
Het is echter afhankelijk van de aard en omvang van de lokale problematiek of een bepaling in de Algemene plaatselijke verordening (APV) als aanvulling op de Wet wapens en munitie (WWM) nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de onduidelijkheid voor VvE’s om digitaal officiële vergaderingen te beleggen

An MP asked about uncertainty for VvEs (homeowners' associations) over holding digital meetings, the status of the consultation on the digital general meeting law, and debt-collection practices by state agencies that may breach subsistence minimums. The minister answered that the digital meeting law is pending, that agencies will improve communication and criteria for bespoke payment arrangements, and that a uniform subsistence norm and possible legislation are being explored.
I want to examine whether it is possible to safeguard the subsistence minimum based on the attachment-free amount or the free amount.
Ik wil onderzoeken of het mogelijk is om het bestaansminimum te borgen op basis van de beslagvrije voet of het vrij te laten bedrag.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Bikker over de uitzending van Het Misdaadbureau waarin wordt gesproken over het project 'Onder mijn Ogen' dat wordt gebruikt op een aantal mbo-scholen in Noord-Brabant

MPs Kuik and Bikker asked about a broadcast on the 'Onder mijn Ogen' game used at Brabant vocational schools to spot criminal exploitation, and about data, teacher training, reporting duties and prevention. The Minister answered that no national picture exists, that schools bear safety duties while lacking investigative tasks, that the game is being evaluated and may be funded one more year, and that a reporting duty for serious incidents is being prepared for 2025.
At present there is no (total) picture of the number of signals or of the way and extent to which pupils and students are recruited by criminals.
Op dit moment bestaat er geen (totaal)beeld van het aantal signalen of op welke manier en in welke omvang scholieren en studenten worden geronseld door criminelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over antisemitische incidenten en bedreigingen in Limburg

An MP asked the Justice Minister about antisemitic threats against a Jewish teenager in Limburg, including why police did not record a complaint or treat the incidents as antisemitic. The minister said police acted quickly with school and family talks and expert input, that the complainant chose not to file a report for now, and that schools have statutory duties to ensure safety for all pupils.
The complainant told the police they currently see no reason to file a report, but this can always be done at a later moment.
De melder heeft bij de politie aangegeven daarom vooralsnog geen aanleiding te zien om aangifte te doen, maar dat kan altijd alsnog op een later moment.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Sjoerdsma en Hammelburg over de petitie van Yezidi-vrouwen

MPs Van der Werf, Sjoerdsma and Hammelburg (D66) asked the Justice, Foreign Affairs and Development ministers about justice and support for the Yezidi community, including aid in camps, missing Yezidis, evidence gathering with UNITAD, a Joint Investigation Team and the petition by Yezidi women. The government answered that it funds psychosocial aid, the Yezidi Survivors Law implementation and UNITAD, that it cannot verify figures or conditions in Al Hol, and that cooperation agreements and expertise contributions are still being explored.
It is not possible for the cabinet to determine how many Yezidis are staying in the Al Hol camp.
Het is voor het kabinet niet mogelijk om vast te stellen hoeveel Yezidi’s verblijven in kamp Al Hol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over toenemende stroperij

MPs Vestering and Wassenberg asked whether poaching of hares and roe deer is increasing due to reduced enforcement, and what the government will do about it. The minister says the scale and trend of poaching cannot be determined, announces extra police and prosecution capacity and additional green wardens, and keeps the current hunting regime for hares in place for the 2023/2024 season.
On the basis of the available information it is therefore not possible to conclude what the scale and trend of wildlife poaching is.
Het is op basis van de beschikbare informatie daarom niet mogelijk om te concluderen wat de omvang en trend is van wildstroperij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over betalingen aan de Rutgers Stichting.

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how much the ministry paid the Rutgers Stichting between 2016 and 2022 and for what services. The minister answered that an exact overview of individual payments could not be produced, that at least €305,110 was transferred, and described payments for WODC research and for behavioural interventions such as So-Cool.
It has not proven possible to obtain an exact overview of all individual payments from the systems for this period.
Het is niet mogelijk gebleken om over deze periode een exact overzicht van alle individuele betalingen uit de systemen te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Wassenberg over ‘de grootschalige verzameling van data over demonstranten door de politie’

MPs Teunissen and Wassenberg asked whether police mass-query personal data of demonstrators in the BRP population register, and whether this is proportionate and lawful. The minister answers that such queries are used for risk assessment and only when necessary and proportionate under the Wet politiegegevens, that internal training exists, and that no supervisory referral to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is planned.

Under article 3.2 of the Wet basisregistratie personen, the police have been issued an authorisation decision allowing them to obtain data from the BRP for performing their duties under article 3 of the Police Act 2012.

Op grond van artikel 3.2 Wet basisregistratie personen is aan de politie een autorisatiebesluit afgegeven waarin wordt bepaald dat de politie voor de uitvoering van artikel 3 Politiewet 2012 gegevens uit de BRP mag verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over ‘de grootschalige verzameling van data over demonstranten door de politie’

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister about police collecting large-scale personal data on demonstrators, its legal basis, proportionality, and privacy oversight. The minister defended the practice as necessary for managing demonstrations and proportionate, refused to give case-level detail or provide demonstrator-group statistics, and declined to request an Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens review.
It is not possible to give the House insight into the queries, because these concern personal data of individuals.
Het is niet mogelijk om de Kamer inzage te geven in de bevragingen, omdat dit persoonsgegevens van individuen betreffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over drugs per post

An MP asked the Justice and Finance ministers about drugs sent by post, including a joint police-customs team, cooperation with post and courier firms, an e-learning and a barrier model, and possible liability for companies. The government reports a new joint team (HARP), no registration of seized hard drugs per company, a barrier model ready, no need now for corporate criminal liability, and country data on seizures.
No, that is not known because no registration takes place per courier company.
Nee, dat is niet bekend omdat er geen registratie plaatsvindt per koeriersbedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het intrekken van tolkendiensten en het werven van tolken in België om in Nederland te gaan werken

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the OM cancelling interpreter assignments, the recruitment of Belgian interpreters by Global Talk, and related pay and register issues. The Minister answered that cancellations stem from excessive travel distances and efficiency, denied selective treatment, and promised monitoring and contract changes but no concrete new action on pay beyond waiting for a vertaaltarief study.
Enquiries with the OM show that its systems cannot establish how many of the interpreter assignments provided by the CVOM interpreter bureau were withdrawn in a given period.

Uit navraag bij het OM blijkt dat uit de systemen van het OM niet te herleiden is hoeveel van de door het tolkenbureau van Centrale Verwerking Openbaar Ministerie verstrekte tolkdiensten er in een bepaalde periode zijn ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Werf en Wuite over het niet tenuitvoerleggen van gevangenisstraffen op Sint Maarten

Dutch MPs asked why at least 136 convicted persons on Sint Maarten were not serving prison sentences due to lack of detention capacity, and about the effects on rule of law, investment imbalance and a new prison. The government answered that prison administration is a national responsibility of Sint Maarten, outlined Dutch funding and the UNOPS new-prison project (target 2028), and described temporary transfers of detainees to the Netherlands while declining to give the size of the shortage.
Prison administration is a matter for the constituent country.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de gebrekkige zorg op crisisnoodopvanglocaties

An MP asks the State Secretary about poor medical care at crisis emergency shelters for asylum seekers, including reported profit-driven staffing by Arts & Specialist, missing equipment and the lack of an electronic patient file. The State Secretary answers that medical access is generally well secured, that costs are confidential under the contract, that no electronic patient file offer was accepted, and that measures are being discussed with COA and the IGJ.
Information about prices falls under the confidentiality of the contract.
Informatie over prijzen valt binnen de vertrouwelijkheid van het contract.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ellian over het bericht 'OM gaat ‘schokkend’ Hamas-filmpje bij De Kuip onderzoeken, CIDI doet aangifte'

MPs Ellian and Bikker asked about antisemitic chants at the Feyenoord-Ajax match and why stadium police and the club did not intervene immediately. The government condemns the chants, says the Public Prosecution Service is investigating and the club is cooperating, and promises to discuss stricter anti-discrimination measures with the KNVB.
No statements can be made about ongoing or newly initiated investigations.
Er kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan over lopende of nieuw op te starten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Five MPs asked the government about progress toward its 2030 targets, including a halving of nitrogen emissions and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that the nitrogen target is set as deposition thresholds rather than halving, that the latest projection shows only 43% of nature area meeting the norm with a risk of missing the target, and that a new projection will follow in late 2023 with additional measures and a 15% organic farmland plan under monitoring.
The cabinet indicated in 2021 that it wanted to respond to the call.
Het kabinet heeft in 2021 aangegeven gehoor te willen geven aan de oproep.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Nijboer over de registratie van fraudeurs door verzekeraars naar aanleiding van het bericht 'Nederlandse verzekeraars spelen voor aanklager en rechter tegelijk'

MPs Mutluer and Nijboer asked whether insurers may keep their own lists of fraudsters, how insured persons learn of their registration and can object, how often Kifid upheld complaints, whether insurers should report fraud to prosecutors rather than register it, and whether stronger rules are needed. Minister Kaag answers that insurers may register under the PIFI protocol approved by the Dutch data protection authority, that complaints are upheld in about 17-21% of cases, that reporting to prosecutors is decided case by case on proportionality, and that no stricter rules are needed.
Kifid does not have such (reliable) information on the number of complaints from data subjects for the years 2018, 2019 and 2020.
Kifid beschikt niet over dergelijke (betrouwbare) informatie over het aantal klachten van betrokkenen voor de jaren 2018, 2019 en 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het artikel 'Terreurverdachten na foute grappen'

Wilders asked the Justice Minister about a news report on terror suspects released after making offensive jokes, including a remark about beheading him, and why the prosecutor did not appeal the acquittal. The minister condemned the remarks, explained the prosecution service had found the verdict well-reasoned and did not appeal, rejected the claim of failure, and declined to discuss individual security consequences.

The Public Prosecution Service informed me that after extensive study of the judgment no appeal will be lodged, because according to the Public Prosecution Service the court's judgment is well reasoned and in line with established case law.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij gemeld dat na uitgebreide bestudering van het vonnis er geen hoger beroep wordt ingesteld, omdat het vonnis van de rechtbank volgens het Openbaar Ministerie goed gemotiveerd is en in lijn is met vaststaande jurisprudentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over demonstraties door Extinction Rebellion

An MP asked the Justice Minister about mass Extinction Rebellion protests at Schiphol, the A12 and Eindhoven Airport, including identification of detainees, use of expedited procedure, prosecution for incitement, and whether the legal framework on protest should be tightened. The minister answered that identification and prosecution are ongoing, that expedited justice was not applied, that the right to demonstrate is protected but not a licence for crime, and that a letter on the Wet openbare manifestaties will follow before summer.
The right to demonstrate, as protected nationally and internationally, I consider a great good.
Het recht op betoging, zoals nationaal en internationaal beschermd, acht ik een groot goed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Russische hackers trainen voor aanvallen op kritieke infrastructuur'

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister about reports that Russian hackers train for attacks on critical infrastructure, the Scan-V and Crystal-2V tools, the reinforced vital infrastructure approach, supply-chain attacks, and cyber exercises. The minister acknowledged the threat, pointed to the forthcoming Aanpak vitaal and NIS2 implementation, and described existing exercises (ISIDOOR, national crisis plan) with a commitment to inform parliament before summer.
The cabinet is currently working on a reinforced approach to protecting vital infrastructure (Aanpak vitaal), and parliament will be informed in more detail before the summer.
Momenteel werkt het kabinet aan een versterkte aanpak voor de bescherming van de vitale infrastructuur (Aanpak vitaal). Hier wordt uw Kamer voor de zomer nader over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg, Van Esch en Vestering over natuurherstel na drugsdumpingen

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked ministers how the costs of clearing drug waste dumped in nature are allocated, whether landowners must replant trees and bear restoration costs, and whether nature restoration is funded. The government answered that polluters should pay where possible, that a subsidy scheme capped at 200,000 euro compensates innocent owners, that restoration is covered only if linked to soil remediation, and that the new scheme under discussion does not exclude restoration.
There are no plans to exclude nature restoration from the new national scheme.
Er zijn echter geen plannen om in de nieuwe Rijksregeling natuurherstel uit te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Sneller over statiegeld en lachgascilinders

MPs Hagen and Sneller asked the government about the delayed deck-deposit (statiegeld) scheme on cans, risks of drinks cartons and plastic bottles, batteries in household waste, and fire and explosion risks from nitrous oxide cylinders at waste processors. The state secretary answered that the government will report to parliament on the deposit scheme in 2024, that it is monitoring substitution toward cartons and considering a recycling target, that battery fires are being tackled via a taskforce, and that it is working with partners on a practical solution for nitrous oxide cylinders, while rejecting a deposit system for them.
As provided in art. 16 of the Packaging Management Decree, I will send the House of Representatives a report in 2024 on the effectiveness and effects of deposit on beverage packaging.
Zoals bepaald in art. 16 van het Besluit beheer verpakkingen zal ik in 2024 de Tweede Kamer een verslag toesturen over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van statiegeld op drankverpakkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Sneller over het bericht ‘Journalist Ana van Es werd opgeroepen om te getuigen. ‘Dit schrikt bronnen af’, zegt haar advocaat'

D66 MPs asked whether summoning journalist Ana van Es as a witness, and the resulting risk to source protection, is acceptable under the Wet bronbescherming in strafzaken. The ministers said they cannot comment on individual criminal cases, pointed to the law's safeguards and its evaluation, and stated that journalists may refuse to answer questions about sources even when summoned.
It is not for me to comment on individual criminal cases.
Het is niet aan mij om in te gaan op individuele strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het weerbaar maken van onze democratie tegen heimelijke (politieke) beïnvloeding

MPs Sneller and Dekker-Abdulaziz asked the ministers about dark money, transparency of advertising and campaign financing, foreign donations to Dutch NGOs, and possible foreign influence on elections. The ministers answered that transparency is being strengthened through the EU political advertising regulation, the Wtmo bill and the Wfpp, but that many issues are still under negotiation or fall under other levels of government.
The cabinet is committed to further increasing this transparency.
Het kabinet zet zich ervoor in om deze transparantie verder te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de intimidatie door criminelen van poortwachters bij het melden van ongebruikelijke transacties

An MP asks the Justice Minister about intimidation of gatekeepers (notaries, accountants, estate agents) who report unusual transactions, and whether reporters can be anonymised in criminal files as urged by a motion. The minister answers that existing safeguards exist, an extra measure was added, full anonymisation of reporting institutions is not possible because of transparency and traceability of evidence, and further consultations and measures will follow.
Standard anonymisation of the name of the reporting institution is not possible, as this may compromise the transparency and traceability of the evidence.
Het standaard anonimiseren van de naam van de meldende instantie is niet mogelijk, gezien dit de transparantie en de herleidbaarheid van het bewijs in het geding kan brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het aansteker incident tijdens de wedstrijd Feyenoord-Ajax

MP Van Haga asked the Justice Minister about a lighter-throwing incident at the Feyenoord-Ajax match, whether football vandalism is rising, why proposals from a 2012 initiative note were not implemented, and what is being done on higher penalties, stadium and area bans, travel restrictions for hooligans, fines, and broader use of the Football Act. The minister answered that measures are continuously tightened, that the existing toolkit is being applied more strictly, and that a stronger criminal-law role and a Dutch-English model are being explored, while rejecting some proposals as disproportionate.
Only after the end of the football season will all figures be published that answer this question.
Pas na afloop van het voetbalseizoen worden alle cijfers gepubliceerd die antwoord geven op deze vraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over stadionverboden en geweld tegen voetbalspelers

MP Westerveld asked the Minister of Justice and Security how stadium bans can be enforced without a reporting obligation, how they are enforced, why bans are not nationwide, when reporting obligations apply, and how supporters who threw objects at a cup match will be sanctioned. The minister answered that stadium bans are enforced via ticketing controls, camera surveillance and a KNVB taskforce, that reporting obligations are a local mayoral or prosecutorial matter needing case-by-case assessment, and that about 1,747 people currently hold nationwide bans.
Unfortunately, no figures are available for this.
Helaas zijn hiervan geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het Algemeen Dagblad artikel van 16 april ‘Waarom Brabant broeinest is voor criminelen: ‘Gaat niet om geografische ligging’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether she knows that Brabant's rural areas are a haven for drug criminals, whether she will set up a dedicated team to patrol rural areas, and whether she will raise reporting by residents. The minister said enforcement is spread across regions by agreed allocation and local authorities decide deployment, pointing to pilots, RIEC initiatives and a rural trust person, without committing to a new dedicated team.
It is then up to the local authorities, the mayors and public prosecutors, to decide how the (additional) capacity is deployed.
Het is vervolgens aan het lokaal gezag, de burgemeesters en officieren van justitie, om te bepalen hoe de (additionele) capaciteit wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Mutluer, Teunissen, Sylvana Simons en Ellemeet over het bericht 'politie keek heimelijk mee in chatgroepen van Extinction Rebellion'

MPs asked the Justice Minister whether police secretly monitored Extinction Rebellion chat groups, under which legal powers, and how this relates to the right to demonstrate. The Minister declined to comment on the specific case pending a court ruling, described general police information-gathering powers, and said the proportionality assessment lies with the police and the mayor.
I cannot address this specific question because the court is still considering the case concerning the suspicion of incitement.
Op deze concrete vraag kan ik niet ingaan omdat de rechter zich nog buigt over de zaak betreffende de verdenking wegens opruiing.
Antwoord op vragen van de lid Dekker-Abulaziz over het bericht dat 'de politie meekeek in chatgroepen van Extinction Rebellion'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police secretly monitored Extinction Rebellion chat groups, whether this method is common at demonstrations, how Amnesty's criticism is answered, and whether the measure is effective, proportionate and subject to ministerial notification. The minister confirmed the reports, said online monitoring is used where serious public order disruption or crimes are expected within legal limits, and stated that proportionality assessments and the decision rest with police and the competent authority (mayor or public prosecutor), with internal work instructions not public.
This assessment is not made by me, but by the police under the responsibility of the competent authority.
Deze afweging wordt niet door mij gemaakt, maar door de politie onder verantwoordelijkheid van het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Hagen over de aanpak van milieucriminaliteit

MPs Sneller and Hagen asked how the government will tackle environmental crime, including whether non-conviction transactions are sufficiently deterrent, the Court of Audit's findings on inspection, repeat offenders, and implementation of earlier motions. The Minister answers that a sentencing study will be commissioned, a compliance-based transaction modality is planned, and the motions will be followed up through the IBP VTH programme, while several answers defer to other bodies or to later letters.
The Ministry of Justice and Security will commission scientific research into the current way of sentencing and its effectiveness in environmental offences.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid zal opdracht geven voor een wetenschappelijk onderzoek naar de huidige wijze van straffen en de effectiviteit daarvan bij milieufeiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen inzake de betrokkenheid van het Ministerie van J&V en de DJI bij de zaak Engel

Rep. Van Haga asks the Ministers of Legal Protection and Justice & Security why the OM shared a summons with Justis, why a VOG decision was taken on 23 March 2022, why access to a prison was refused, and about the Engel case and NCTV involvement. The ministers answer that the VOG process and information requests follow fixed procedure, that no political instruction occurred, that no access was refused, and that information about an ongoing criminal case is withheld in the interest of the State and privacy.
Beyond being informed about this case, she has no other involvement in this case.
Naast dat zij geïnformeerd is in deze zaak heeft zij verder geen betrokkenheid bij deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de aanpak van pinpasfraude

MP Eerdmans asked the government about losses from pin card fraud, prosecution rates, and whether it would explore technical fixes such as ATMs refusing cash at low recognisability. The minister (Finance, on behalf of Justice) reported losses of 2.7 million euro in 2022, gave prosecution counts for payment fraud generally, and said pin card fraud is being addressed in the MOB working group and an integrated online fraud plan rather than through ATM changes.

The figures on the investigation of pin card fraud are part of the overall figures on fraud cases involving payment products and are published biennially by the Public Prosecution Service in the Fraud Monitor.

De cijfers over de opsporing van pinpasfraude zijn onderdeel van de totale cijfers met betrekking tot fraudezaken met betaalproducten en worden door het Openbaar Ministerie tweejaarlijks in de Fraudemonitor gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Six opposition MPs asked the cabinet for the latest 2030 forecasts on its policy targets, including road-death halving, and whether each target will be met. The minister answers only the road-safety item, citing SWOV research that halving serious injuries is likely too ambitious, and gives no answers on the other targets, apologising for the delay.
Unfortunately it has not been possible to answer within the three-week period.
Helaas is het niet gelukt om de beantwoording binnen de termijn van drie weken te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitgaven van het ministerie aan ‘anonieme bedrijven’

The MP asks why the Justice ministry's spending on 'anonymous companies' rose sharply from about 210 thousand euro in 2018 to about 238 million euro in 2021. The minister confirms the figures and attributes the rise to the GDPR, which led payments to identifiable individuals such as interpreters and experts to be published as anonymous from mid-2018.
After the introduction of the GDPR in mid-2018, all procurement spending on identifiable persons was published as 'anonymous'.
Na de invoering van de AVG, medio 2018, zijn alle inkoopuitgaven aan herkenbare personen als «anoniem» gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Campen en Michon-Derkzen over bescherming van boeren tegen drugscriminaliteit en het tegengaan van ondermijning in het buitengebied.

Two VVD MPs asked how farmers can be protected against drug crime and undermining activity in rural areas, including whether a Brabant model rental contract could be rolled out nationally and how it relates to mayors' powers under Article 13b of the Opium Act. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the risk is real nationwide, describes existing pilots and a model contract, says municipalities should decide how to apply it, and declines to consult the VNG and IPO.
As Minister of Justice and Security, I want to encourage such initiatives and take them further.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid wil ik dergelijke initiatieven stimuleren en verder brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het toegankelijker maken van aangifte bij partnergeweld en het voorkomen van femicide

An MP asked the government about making reporting of partner violence easier, preventing femicide, training professionals, and reviewing police and support practices. The State Secretary answered that training and knowledge-sharing are being developed, an Inspectorate study of ex-partner stalking is underway, and a broader programme on gender-related violence is being prepared.
The Inspectorate of Justice and Security is currently investigating the approach to (ex-)partner stalking by the police, Public Prosecution Service, Veilig Thuis and probation.
Op dit moment doet de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid (IJenV) onderzoek naar de aanpak bij (ex-)partnerstalking door politie, Openbaar Ministerie, Veilig Thuis en reclassering.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Weinig agenten en geen vertrouwen. Platteland van Groningen een snoepwinkel voor criminelen. Zelfs met een trekker ontsnap je makkelijk’’ en het bericht ‘Drughandel i

MP Kuik (CDA) asks the Justice Minister about reports of thin police presence and low trust in rural Groningen that let drug crime flourish, asking about deployment, reporting willingness, the Ommeland report and the Groningen enquiry follow-up. The minister answers that police distribution is a shared responsibility, reporting channels are open, several concrete measures (trust persons, regional reinforcement funding, Theseus project, international cooperation) are cited, and the enquiry response is still pending.
The cabinet will still respond to the report of the parliamentary enquiry committee on Groningen gas extraction.
Het kabinet komt nog met een reactie op het rapport van de enquêtecommissie aardgaswinning Groningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘Mishandeling van een boswachter’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a reported assault on a forest ranger in Limburg, rising aggression against rangers, which equipment rangers are authorised to carry, and whether bodycams should be issued. The minister confirmed the incidents, gave incident counts, said equipment choice rests with employers, and noted Staatsbosbeheer's request for pepper spray was met in 2019.
The police do not specifically record incidents of aggression against forest rangers.
De politie registreert niet specifiek op incidenten van agressie tegen boswachters.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de definitieve fatwa en de oproep aan Nederlandse moslims mij te vermoorden

An MP from the PVV asked the government to condemn a Pakistani fatwa calling for the MP's murder, to explain how such threats are handled, and to consider expelling the Pakistani ambassador. The government condemned the threats, said it raised concerns with Pakistan, noted a prosecution decision, and declined to discuss threat cases or intelligence assessments in public.
As is known to your House, I cannot publicly make statements about the working methods of the intelligence and security services, or about concrete threat cases and personal security measures.

Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend kan ik over de werkwijze van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten, alsmede informatie over concrete dreigings-casuïstiek en beveiligingsmaatregelen van personen, in het openbaar geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Smals over het bericht 'Vanaf morgen weer subsidie voor opleiding, maar niet als je boa wil worden'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Smals asked why training to become a buitengewoon opsporingsambtenaar (boa) is excluded from the STAP subsidy scheme and whether this deters future boas. The ministers answered that the training is the employer's responsibility, that the government is exploring whether zij-instromers could be funded under STAP, and that recruitment and retention are the job of employers and municipalities.
The cabinet understands that funding boa training with STAP budget could add value for lateral entrants and is willing to examine this further.
Het kabinet begrijpt dat financiering van boa-opleidingen met STAP-budget voor zij-instromers een meerwaarde kan zijn en is bereid dit nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de ‘Desinformatie-operatie’ van de overheid

An MP asks the government why its earlier answers denied any 'disinformation operation' despite Woo documents showing counter-disinformation bodies, LIMC surveillance of critical citizens, avatar use, and an unclear legal basis; the minister maintains the reporting gives a distorted picture, refers back to earlier answers and a commission report, and denies key allegations. The answers repeatedly decline to add detail or to provide the requested overview of who did what, citing prior answers, privacy, and other responsibilities.
Also, the names of the think tank participants are not made public in connection with the protection of personal privacy.
Tevens worden de namen van de deelnemers van de denktank niet openbaar gemaakt in verband met de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de verblijfplaats van ‘Bolle Jos’

An MP from the VVD asked why a record reward was offered for information on fugitive Jos L. while he is believed to be in Turkey, whether he was briefly arrested there and released, and how Turkey could be made to arrest and extradite Dutch fugitives. The Minister of Justice explained the reward rules and the high severity of the suspicions, declined to comment on the individual case or the alleged Turkish arrest, and described the general extradition process under the European Convention on Extradition.
I cannot make statements about ongoing criminal proceedings.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke procedures kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over Nederlanders in detentie in het buitenland

MP Sneller asked the Justice and Rule of Law ministers about Dutch nationals detained abroad, the EU evaluation of the WETS transfer procedure (administrative rather than judicial, with limited rights for convicted persons) and the WOTS procedure, including the binding test, transparency and evaluation. Minister Weerwind answered that the procedure is compatible with the framework decision, that the convicted person's rights are adequately protected, and that he will send a policy response before the summer recess; he defended the binding test and gave partial, sometimes data-limited figures.
My policy response to the evaluation report of the Council of the European Union will be sent to your House before the summer recess.
Mijn beleidsreactie op het evaluatierapport van de Raad van de Europese Unie zal ik uw Kamer voor het zomerreces doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitspraak dat (ook) de politie bij sociale mediabedrijven de status heeft van ‘trusted flagger’

An MP asked the Justice Minister why police records of 'trusted flagger' notices sent to social media companies since 2020 cannot be retrieved for parliament, and whether this conflicts with the Archiving Act and Open Government Act. The minister answered that no legal duty currently requires police to register these notices retrievably, sees no reason to impose one, and pointed to upcoming EU Digital Services Act reporting obligations for platforms.
At this moment I see no reason to oblige the police to ensure that the requested data can easily be extracted from its systems.
Op dit moment zie ik geen reden om politie te verplichten ervoor te zorgen dat de gevraagde gegevens eenvoudig uit haar systemen kunnen worden gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Politiebond boos over falend communicatiesysteem bij klopjacht op overvallers: ‘Levensgevaarlijk’’

The PVV MP Helder asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police complaints that the C2000 radio network failed during a manhunt for robbers, and about the delayed replacement of C2000. The Minister acknowledges the problems, points to over 97% network coverage and ongoing mitigation measures, and promises biannual updates on the replacement programme.
I will continue to inform you every six months about the status of this matter.
Ik zal u halfjaarlijks blijven informeren over deze stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het artikel over het falende communicatiesysteem bij klopjacht Rijsbergen

An MP asked the Justice Minister about C2000 radio communication failures during the Rijsbergen manhunt, its costs, the push-to-talk backup app, and plans for replacement. The minister acknowledged the problems, described ongoing coverage improvements and monitoring, reported budget figures, and said a replacement proposal will be updated and reported to parliament every half year.
I will continue to inform you every half year about this state of affairs.
Ik zal u halfjaarlijks blijven informeren over deze stand van zaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans, Rajkowski en Rahimi over de berichten 'Naaktbeelden borstkankerpatiënten VS gepubliceerd om ziekenhuis af te persen' en 'Paspoorten van dokters op straat na hack bij oudereninstel

MPs Hermans, Rajkowski and Rahimi (VVD) asked about reports of ransomware attacks on Dutch healthcare institutions, leaked patient and staff data, and how the sector and Z-CERT protect against cyber threats. The minister answered that five ransomware incidents were registered in 2022, outlined existing security norms, Z-CERT support, awareness measures and the National Cybersecurity Strategy, and promised to answer the earlier related questions before the 30 March debate.
I am not aware of how many of these incidents involved patient or staff data being stolen.
Het is mij niet bekend bij hoeveel van deze incidenten er gegevens van patiënten of (zorg-)medewerkers zijn ontvreemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering, Van Esch en Wassenberg over mogelijk illegale afvalinjecties door de NAM in de Noordzee en het Waddengebied

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether NAM's disposal of gas-extraction wastewater by injection into the deep subsurface in the North Sea and Wadden area is illegal, whether injection is safe for mercury-containing waste, and whether a criminal investigation should follow. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service's investigation into the Wadden is ongoing and cannot be discussed, that the North Sea investigation is concluded, that mercury occurs naturally in the deep subsurface, that SodM supervises strict injection conditions, and that initiating a criminal investigation is not for the minister to decide.
The cabinet cannot make further statements about this because the investigation is being conducted by the Public Prosecution Service.
Het kabinet kan daar nu geen nadere mededelingen over doen omdat het onderzoek door het OM wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen inzake het ’Moreel beraad over het klimaat’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a cancelled discussion evening on whether violence should be used to force climate action, the classification of climate activism, the 1980s protest movement, Extinction Rebellion's civil disobedience, police and public prosecution tools against calls to break the law, and whether damages can be recovered from demonstration organisers. The minister condemned calls to violence, said debate is permitted, argued that climate activism is not extremist at present, and described the existing legal and police frameworks for demonstrations, while declining to send a specific police handling framework because none exists as a separate document.
There is no specific policy framework for non-notified climate demonstrations in which people glue or chain themselves in place.
Er is geen specifiek handelingskader voor niet-aangemelde klimaatdemonstraties waarbij mensen zich vastlijmen en vastketenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over jongeren met een licht verstandelijke beperking in de criminaliteit

MP Mutluer asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of Legal Protection about young people with mild intellectual disabilities being recruited into crime and exploited, and about police, care and information gaps. The government acknowledges overrepresentation in youth justice and difficulty for police in recognising the disability, points to ongoing prevention programmes, a forthcoming WODC study and a care-continuity study, but declines to launch new pilots.
We will ask the Scientific Research and Documentation Centre to conduct research on this, and will inform the House about it.
Wij zullen het Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek- en Documentatiecentrum vragen om hier onderzoek naar te doen, en zullen uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuijk over het bericht 'Overheidsinstanties hebben blinde vlek voor licht verstandelijke beperkten'

A CDA MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that authorities have a blind spot for young people with mild intellectual disabilities who are recruited for drug trafficking and prostitution, and what will be done about protection, data sharing and cooperation. The government acknowledges the problem, points to existing programmes (Preventie met Gezag, Samen tegen mensenhandel, a pilot online platform), promises a study on the scale of exploitation and an overview of information-sharing obstacles, but leaves most measures unspecified.
We will ask the Research and Documentation Centre to conduct research into this and will inform the House of Representatives about it.
Wij zullen het Onderzoeks- en Documentatiecentrum vragen om hier onderzoek naar te doen, en zullen uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de strafbaarheid van “stealthing”

MP Mutluer asked the Minister of Justice and Security how many reports of stealthing were filed in the past five years, how many criminal cases and what case law exist, whether current criminal law can punish it, and whether it should be explicitly criminalised. The Minister said stealthing is not a separate registered category so a file review would be needed, noted a Rotterdam court acquitted of rape but convicted for coercion while the prosecution appeals, and stated that stealthing falls under the proposed intentional rape offence in the sexual offences bill.
Stealthing is currently not a separate criminal offence or police recording category under which reports can be registered.
Stealthing is momenteel geen apart strafbaar feit of maatschappelijke klasse (categorie) waarop aangiftes in het politiesysteem geregistreerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Ellian over het bericht ‘IS-vrouwen waren geen brave huismoeders – ze deden in wapens, explosieven en slaven, volgens het OM’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Ellian asked why IS returnees, repatriated at their own request to attend their trials, are largely absent from substantive hearings, and whether Yazidi victims' rights are thereby harmed. The Minister says the victim-rights law's appearance duty is not yet in force, that courts can order attendance, that trial absence is for judges to decide, and that a new implementation date will be announced in April 2023.

In general terms, I would say it goes against my sense of justice if a suspect of terrorist offences, who deliberately travelled to ISIS territory and was then repatriated to the Netherlands by the Dutch State because they wish to be present in person at their criminal case, were then not present at the substantive hearing of the case.

In algemene zin wil ik aangeven dat het tegen mijn rechtvaardigheidsgevoel ingaat indien een verdachte van terroristische misdrijven, die bewust is uitgereisd naar ISIS-gebied en daarna door de Nederlandse Staat naar Nederland is gerepatrieerd omdat hij/zij in persoon aanwezig wil zijn bij de strafzaak, vervolgens niet bij de inhoudelijke behandeling van de strafzaak aanwezig zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Verkuijlen over het artikel ‘Zorgen om schade aan schoolgebouwen in heel Nederland door geweld hangjongeren’

Two VVD MPs asked about damage to school buildings from youth vandalism, how often damages and parents are held liable, convictions, Halt referrals, and whether cameras on school playgrounds should be promoted. The minister answers that no data on damage, claims, or convictions are kept, cites Halt figures, points to the ongoing exploration of expanding parental liability, and refers to municipalities and schools for camera decisions.
There are no figures available on the extent of damage to school buildings.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over de omvang van schade aan schoolgebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over bedrijfsmatige  houders van dieren die telkens opnieuw dieren mishandelen of verwaarlozen

MPs Wassenberg asked the ministers about a dog breeder in Deurne who keeps neglected dogs, including why 80 dogs were left after 21 were seized, and whether the breeder could restart elsewhere. The minister said 21 dogs were taken into custody, the rest were given remediation orders, prior breeding activity in other municipalities is noted, and the Wet aanpak dierenmishandeling en dierverwaarlozing will add tools to close businesses and impose longer animal-keeping bans.
I cannot go into the details of these cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de details van deze casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower inzake de lage straf voor het doodrijden van Shana Leurs

MPs Wilders and Markuszower asked why a driver who killed Shana Leurs received a six-month sentence, and whether minimum sentences, mandatory driving bans and other stricter measures could be introduced. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, defended judicial discretion and the existing legal framework, and pointed to a pending motion on lifetime driving bans and an upcoming evaluation.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to comment on this case, or other individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om op deze zaak, en andere individuele zaken, in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over zorgen om schade aan schoolgebouwen in heel Nederland door geweld hangjongeren

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about damage to school buildings nationwide caused by youth vandalism, the shortage of neighbourhood police officers, city marine wardens as a remedy, and holding parents liable through parenting courses. The minister acknowledged the harm, pointed to ongoing police capacity measures and 700 extra neighbourhood officers from 2026, left the use of city marines to municipalities, and said parenting courses for parents are not legally possible, while exploring wider parental involvement.
Imposing a parenting course on parents when their children commit an offence is not possible under Dutch law.
Het opleggen van een opvoedcursus aan ouders als hun kinderen een delict plegen is niet mogelijk in het Nederlands recht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij en Bikker over het bericht dat het gebruik van zelfdodingspoeder Middel X flink steeg nadat Coöperatie Laatste Wil bekend maakte welke stof het bevat

MPs from SGP, JA21 and ChristenUnie asked whether the rise in use of suicide powder Middel X after the Coöperatie Laatste Wil disclosed its substance was causal, whether reporting duties for doctors or a ban on the cooperative were warranted, and about the status of investigations. The minister answered that a causal link cannot be established from NVIC data, that a reporting duty would conflict with medical confidentiality and is not currently appropriate, that prosecution of ten people is being prepared with the investigating judge, and that a dissolution request is for the Public Prosecution Service to judge.
The Public Prosecution Service has previously publicly announced that it intends to prosecute ten persons involved or formerly involved with the Coöperatie Laatste Wil.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft eerder publiekelijk kenbaar gemaakt dat het voornemens is om tien personen te vervolgen die betrokken zijn of waren bij de Coöperatie Laatste Wil.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Becker over het bericht 'Zelfbenoemde salafistenpolitie zaait angst in moskeeën: moslims met ‘verkeerd geloof’ aan schandpaal genageld; AIVD en NCTV waarschuwen: salafist

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a Telegraaf report on self-appointed 'salafist police' intimidating mosques and imams, and about how the state can detect and act against salafist preachers. The government answered that intimidation is unacceptable and that the NCTV, police, municipalities and a taskforce have limited legal grounds, so some tools (data processing, Europol exchange, online removal) remain constrained, while promising legislation and a strategy on online radicalisation.

For the Taskforce on Problematic Behaviour and Undesirable Foreign Financing, and at the request of local authorities, the NCTV provided assessments of individual persons, including salafist preachers.

Ten behoeve van de Taskforce Problematisch gedrag en ongewenste buitenlandse financiering, alsmede op verzoek van lokale overheden, verstrekte de NCTV duidingen over individuele personen, ook over salafistische aanjagers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van der Graaf en Gündoğan over de rol van de media bij de verspreiding van de rechts-extremistische omvolkingstheorie

MPs asked about the role of media in spreading the Great Replacement theory and whether NCTV had assessed the national security risk, as promised in June 2022. The minister says the NCTV addressed the theory in the Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57, noting it has moved into mainstream debate, but that NCTV's online monitoring of open sources is currently suspended, limiting its analysis.
As described in the cover letter to the Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57, with its publication, follow-up has been given to the request to elaborate on the replacement theory.
Zoals in de aanbiedingsbrief bij het Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57 is beschreven is met het verschijnen van het Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57, opvolging gegeven aan het verzoek
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over achterstallige coronaboetes

An MP asked the Justice Minister why the Public Prosecution Service will not dismiss pending objections to COVID-19 fines, given doubts about the measures' effectiveness, staffing shortages, and costs. The Minister answered that rules must be enforced in a democratic state, the objections will be decided by the prosecutor or a judge, the work is part of the regular process without displacing serious cases, and no cost-benefit analysis was made.
It is in the interest of the functioning of our democratic constitutional state that rules are enforced even if these rules are no longer current during the prosecution process.
Het is in het belang van het functioneren van onze democratische rechtstaat dat regels worden gehandhaafd ook als deze regels tijdens het vervolgingsproces niet meer actueel zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga  over woningaanslagen in Rotterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the cause of a wave of explosive attacks on homes in Rotterdam, possible links between them, concrete steps to catch perpetrators, and police shortages. The minister declined to comment on causes and links while criminal investigations continue, pointed to family feuds and drug-related crime, listed extra patrols and the pending bill on mayoral powers, and said deployment of police capacity is a matter for local authorities.
Criminal investigation is taking place. Its outcomes must be awaited and it is not for me as Minister to make statements about it.
Er vindt strafrechtelijk onderzoek plaats. De uitkomsten daarvan moeten worden afgewacht en het is niet aan mij als Minister om daar uitlatingen over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Eppink over het lokaliseren van Joodse gemeenschappen over de hele wereld door Iran om daar moordaanslagen op te kunnen plegen

MPs Van der Staaij and Eppink asked whether Iran is mapping Jewish communities abroad for attacks, whether threats exist in the Netherlands, and about terror listing of the IRGC and nuclear risks. The government answered that it will act against any concrete threat, declined to detail security measures, said the IRGC cannot legally be listed nationally and lacks EU legal basis, and called a diplomatic solution the best way to prevent an Iranian bomb.
The cabinet cannot make statements about whether, and if so which, security measures are being taken.
Het kabinet kan geen uitspraken doen over of, en zo ja, welke beveiligingsmaatregelen getroffen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht dat ‘de overheid de gegevens van vliegpassagiers verzamelt’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the government collects airline passenger data beyond what the CJEU and the Data Protection Authority consider necessary. The Minister acknowledges the CJEU ruling, describes the data collected and retention periods, and commits to reducing the general retention period from five to three years and adding independent review and filtering measures.

In addition to the existing privacy safeguards, this year I will still make a number of adjustments to the processing of passenger data, in line with the Court's ruling and the request of the Data Protection Authority.

Naast de bestaande privacy waarborgen zal ik dit jaar nog – in lijn met de uitspraak van het Hof en het verzoek van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens – een aantal aanpassingen doen in de verwerking van passagiersgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen inzake het afpakken en herbestemming van misdaadgeld

MP Van Nispen asked how the government plans to return confiscated criminal assets to society more easily, why this is needed, whether it will increase confiscations, and why it is linked to investing in neighbourhoods. Minister Yeşilgöz answered that pilots (Schiedam, then Rotterdam and Breda) are testing how to repurpose assets, that the government will report on any legal obstacles in its half-yearly letters, and that neighbourhood investment is funded separately from asset recovery.
Through these pilots it will become clear whether, and if so which, laws and rules currently stand in the way of structurally repurposing assets for society, and how they should be changed.
Aan de hand van deze pilots zal blijken of, en zo ja welke, wetten en regels momenteel in de weg staan van het structureel maatschappelijk herbestemmen en hoe deze gewijzigd dienen te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de toenemende verharde straatcultuur

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the rise of hard street culture, knife carrying among teenagers, police staffing shortages, progress on the disarming-youth motion, and a Den Haag party's proposals to free up police capacity. The minister acknowledged the reports, explained that capacity pressure stems from growing demands and an ageing workforce with a tight labour market, said a decision on the arms plan would follow a bestuurlijk overleg, and left detailed local capacity measures to the police units and local authorities.
As previously promised, I will inform your House about this shortly.
Zoals eerder toegezegd zal ik uw Kamer hierover binnenkort informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het online gebiedsverbod

D66 MPs asked ministers whether the Utrecht court ruling that the mayor could not impose an online area ban (ruling it an impermissible restriction of free expression reserved to national legislation) should be accepted, and what alternatives exist to tackle online incitement. The government declined to comment on the pending case, outlined administrative measures and a framework for mayoral powers, and said it would consider alternatives without committing to a specific legislative proposal.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to make statements about individual and/or pending cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om uitspraken te doen over individuele en/of lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitspraak dat (ook) de politie bij sociale mediabedrijven de status heeft van ‘trusted flagger’

Van Houwelingen asked the Justice Minister whether the police holds 'trusted flagger' status with social media companies and for all notices the police sent in that capacity since 2020. The minister confirmed awareness of the statement and said the police does not record the requested information in a retrievable way, pointing to a forthcoming public-private framework for reporting harmful content.
the police does not record the requested information in such a way that it can be retrieved from police systems.
registreert de politie de gevraagde informatie niet op zodanige wijze dat de informatie uit de politiesystemen gehaald kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Mutluer over het bericht dat pasfoto’s van buitenlanders ten onrechte door de politie gebruikt worden

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Mutluer asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police use passport photos of foreigners from the CATCH-Vreemdelingen database, questioning the legal basis under the Aliens Act and whether it meets EU requirements. The Minister explains that police biometric experts run facial comparisons on the database only under Article 107(6) conditions, that the database is held separately from criminal law systems, and that practice applies the stricter conditions even to facial images, but does not concede any legal problem.
For the purposes of investigating and prosecuting criminal offences, the police do not have free access to the BVV and CATCH-Vreemdelingen.
De politie heeft ten behoeve van de opsporing en vervolging van strafbare feiten geen vrije toegang tot de BVV en CATCH-Vreemdelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wuite over de bedreiging van schrijver Pim Lammers

An MP asked the Justice and Culture ministers about threats against writer Pim Lammers and whether artistic freedom needs better protection, including a PersVeilig-style reporting platform for artists. The minister condemned the threats, pointed to existing criminal law and PersVeilig, and committed to talks with the sector and PersVeilig to explore further protection.
The Ministry of Education, Culture and Science will in the coming period talk with the sector and PersVeilig, among other things to explore how this issue plays out within these professional groups.
Het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap zal de komende tijd in gesprek gaan met de sector en PersVeilig, onder andere om te verkennen hoe dit onderwerp speelt binnen deze beroepsgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het invoeren van een landelijk keurmerk voor coffeeshops

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the 79 experimental closed-chain coffeeshops and the other coffeeshops should prioritise fighting undermining crime, safety and transparency, and whether a national quality mark for coffeeshops should be introduced. The minister answered that the national government will not support a quality mark because it would endorse a tolerated but formally prohibited activity, that banks and coffeeshops should make their own arrangements on payments, and that the outcome of the experiment will be awaited before any further policy change.
Within this context, it is not considered appropriate for the national government to be involved in establishing a quality mark that expresses a quality judgement on a prohibited activity.
Binnen deze context, wordt het niet passend geacht om als rijksoverheid betrokken te zijn bij het instellen van een keurmerk dat een kwaliteitsoordeel uitdraagt van een verboden activiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Bijna kwart jongere Nederlanders twijfelt aan Holocaust’

An SGP MP asked the Justice Minister how the government responds to a survey finding that nearly a quarter of young Dutch people doubt the Holocaust, and whether further research, education and a ban on explicit Holocaust denial will follow. The minister is shocked by the knowledge gap, points to existing education measures, supports the National Coordinator's recommendations, and says the bill on denial is expected before summer 2023.
The bill is expected to be submitted to your House before summer 2023.
Het wetsvoorstel zal naar verwachting voor de zomer van 2023 bij uw Kamer worden ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht dat de politie kleine criminaliteit laat schieten

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a press report that police in Oost-Nederland leave minor crimes such as fraud, animal cruelty and small cannabis cultivation unpursued, and about the internal guidance document behind this and its impact on victims. The minister confirmed the document is an operational tool still under discussion with mayors, said it is not a list of crimes never pursued, acknowledged capacity shortages, and pointed to extra police capacity, restorative justice and the selectivity framework.
I cannot share it with your House for now, because it is still under discussion with the mayors in the Oost-Nederland regional unit.
Ik kan het nu nog niet delen met uw Kamer, omdat het nog onderwerp van bespreking is met de burgemeesters in de regionale eenheid Oost-Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Dood gehandicapte Naoufel (10) leidt tot conflict nabestaanden en politie’

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the handling of a disabled 10-year-old's body after his death, including why police seized it and why the mother was not informed. The Minister expressed sympathy, described the general procedure, declined to comment on the individual case, and pointed to the complaint routes via the police and the National Ombudsman.
However, I cannot go into this or other individual cases in more detail.
Echter, kan ik niet nader op deze of andere individuele casussen ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Pro-Russische DDoS-aanvallers vallen Nederlandse ziekenhuizen aan'

MPs Tielen and Rajkowski asked the Health and Justice ministers about reported pro-Russian DDoS attacks on Dutch hospitals, their impact on patients and care continuity, the sector's vital-infrastructure status, scrubbing centres, extending Z-CERT to the whole care sector, and sanctions against the perpetrators. The ministers answered that care continuity was not endangered (only hospital websites were briefly unavailable), that the sector's vital designation and a Z-CERT rollout plan will be reported before summer, that scrubbing is up to each organisation, and that sanctions depend on impact and EU unanimity.
The Minister of Health will inform you by letter before summer about the status of designating the healthcare sector as vital.
De Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zal u uiterlijk voor de zomer per Kamerbrief informeren over de stand van zaken van het aanwijzen van de zorgsector als vitale sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het besluit van politie Oost-Nederland om voortaan geen energie te steken in het aanpakken van dierenmishandeling

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about a Oost-Nederland police working document that reportedly deprioritises animal cruelty and other minor crime due to capacity shortages. The Minister answered that the document is an internal operational tool within the existing prosecution selectivity framework, that local bodies including mayors will discuss it, and that animal cruelty is not generally minor crime, while pointing to planned extra police capacity and the Wet aanpak dierenmishandeling.
The document from Oost Nederland reported by the AD is an internal operational working instrument.
Het document uit Oost Nederland waarover het AD heeft bericht is een intern operationeel werkinstrument.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over kinderontvoeringen naar Polen en het negeren van een Europees Aanhoudingsbevel

An MP asked about a Dutch mother who allegedly abducted four children to Poland, Polish courts' use of Hague Convention refusal grounds, and Poland's refusal to execute a European Arrest Warrant. The government acknowledges some enforcement problems rooted in Polish national law, cites an EU Court ruling and a Commission infringement procedure, and promises a protocol on holding states accountable by summer 2023.
I cannot comment on a judicial decision of another EU member state in an individual case.
Op een rechterlijke beslissing van een andere lidstaat van de Europese Unie in een individuele zaak kan ik niet ingaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over de ernstige verwaarlozing van tientallen dieren bij een bedrijf dat in het verleden ook al herhaaldelijk in de fout ging en al onder verscherpt toezicht stond

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers of Agriculture and Justice about severe neglect of dozens of cattle at a farm already under intensified supervision, and how inspection and enforcement failed. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, explained the intensified supervision regime and its limits, and said a bill on animal-keeping bans and farm closures is pending, while declining to discuss individual criminal cases or share inspection reports.
It is standing policy of the Minister of Justice and Security and the Public Prosecution Service not to make statements about individual criminal cases.
Het is staand beleid van de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid en het OM om geen uitspraken te doen over individuele zaken in het strafrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Kröger over de aanhouding van klimaatactivisten

MPs Ellemeet and Kröger asked whether the preemptive arrest of climate activists for incitement was proportionate, whether it chilled the right to demonstrate, and what concrete threat justified it. The Minister answered that the eight people were arrested for incitement that had already occurred, released the same day with a area ban that courts partly upheld, and that the police acted under the prosecutor's authority, while not addressing the preventive-arrest and proportionality concerns in detail.
The eight arrests were made because of the suspicion of a criminal offence, namely incitement.
De acht aanhoudingen zijn verricht als gevolg van de verdenking tot een strafbaar feit, namelijk opruiing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over aanhoudingen door de politie

MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked the Justice and Interior ministers about police arrests of Extinction Rebellion activists before a planned A12 blockade, including Amnesty's concerns about the right to demonstrate. The minister answered that the arrests were for suspected incitement, not preventive detention, that courts upheld most area bans, and that a full response to Amnesty's report will follow before summer 2023.
There has been no question of preventive arrests.
Er is geen sprake geweest van preventieve arrestaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het niet-vervolgen van doodsbedreigers

An MP asks why the Public Prosecution Service declined to prosecute people who threatened him with death, and whether this undermines his safety and the rule of law. The Minister of Justice answers that individual prosecutorial decisions cannot be discussed to avoid political interference, that threats against MPs are assessed with great care regardless of political affiliation, and that the AIVD monitors threats to protected persons.
As Minister of Justice and Security I cannot address individual cases, in order to prevent political interference.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken, dit om politieke bemoeienis te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over fatwa’s en bedreigingen

An MP asks the Prime Minister and several ministers what has concretely been done to identify, prosecute or extradite people who issued fatwas and death threats against him, and how many threat cases were prosecuted. The minister replies that individual cases cannot be discussed, that Pakistan has not answered legal assistance requests, that the Public Prosecution Service decides prosecution case by case, and that threats are forwarded to the intelligence services.
I cannot go into individual cases; the Public Prosecution Service is the designated body to inform you confidentially about such matters.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken, het Openbaar Ministerie is de aangewezen instantie om u, als betrokkene, vertrouwelijk over dergelijke zaken te informeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het opnieuw houden van een foeigesprek met een doodsbedreiger

Wilders asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the Public Prosecution Service handled a death threat by a reprimand instead of prosecution, whether it is failing to act against threats from abroad, and whether it has effectively declared him outlawed. The Minister stressed that threats against MPs are unacceptable, said the OM assesses every complaint with care and that prosecution of individual cases is for the OM, not the minister, and that prosecution abroad depends on foreign legal assistance.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to go into individual cases, in order to prevent political interference.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om in te gaan op individuele zaken om politieke bemoeienis te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Wassenberg over het demonstratierecht

Two MPs from the Animal Party asked about the mass arrests of 768 Extinction Rebellion protesters in The Hague on 28 January, use of force, detention of journalists, pre-emptive arrests for incitement, and unequal treatment compared with farmer protests. The Minister answered that the mayor and police acted to end an unlawful motorway blockade, that the protest right is a fundamental right but does not justify crimes, that pre-emptive arrests were for incitement and courts upheld some restrictions, and that the government will send a letter on the protest right before summer.
Sometimes it is unavoidable for the police to use force in carrying out their duties. The police only do so when it is absolutely necessary.
Het is voor de politie soms onvermijdelijk om bij het uitvoeren van haar taak geweld te gebruiken. Dit doet de politie alleen als het absoluut noodzakelijk is.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over het gebruik van alcohol tijdens het jagen

MPs Vestering and Wassenberg asked whether alcohol use during hunting and transport of hunting weapons should be subject to a zero-tolerance rule, as in France, Hungary and Germany, and whether a ban on alcohol at hunting events with firearms should be introduced. The minister agreed that hunting after drinking is undesirable and dangerous, but said no explicit alcohol rules exist beyond the Weapons and Ammunition Act's general suitability requirement, and declined to legislate a ban, pointing to existing powers to revoke weapon licences.

The Weapons and Ammunition Act has a general principle that it is not responsible to entrust firearms and ammunition to someone under strong psychological pressure, which includes alcohol abuse and where the licence holder appears not to be in control of himself.

Er geldt vanuit de Wet wapens en munitie een algemeen uitgangspunt dat het niet verantwoord is om aan iemand die onder sterke psychische druk staat, wat onder meer tot uitdrukking komt door alcoholmisbruik en waarbij de indruk bestaat dat de vergunninghouder zichzelf niet in de hand heeft, het voorhanden hebben van vuurwapens en munitie toe te vertrouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verkuijlen over het bericht 'Pubers met granaten en tonnen winst door cybercrime: 'Almere visvijver criminelen''

An MP asked why Almere, described as a breeding ground for youth recruited into organised crime, was not included in the 'Preventie met Gezag' programme, and on what criteria municipalities were selected. The minister answered that Almere is being considered for inclusion after a preselection of eight municipalities, that funding per municipality is listed, and that effectiveness will be monitored through a learning approach.
Almere has been selected to be included in the Preventie met Gezag approach.
Almere is geselecteerd om te worden opgenomen binnen de aanpak Preventie met Gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het vrijlaten van twee criminele kopstukken in Dubai

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why two Dutch criminal leaders were released in Dubai, whether they will be arrested and extradited quickly, and how the Netherlands will prevent the UAE from being a safe haven. The Minister declined to comment on ongoing criminal proceedings, said releases pending extradition are not unusual, and described close contact with UAE authorities and plans to deepen treaty cooperation.
I cannot make statements about ongoing criminal proceedings as Minister of Justice and Security.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke procedures kan ik als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de betrokkenheid van het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en de NCTV bij de zaak Engel

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the ministry and the NCTV were involved in the Engel criminal case, whether they had contact with the Public Prosecution Service about it, whether NCTV collects data on activist groups and monitors accounts, and whether NCTV handles individual court cases. The Minister said the ministry is informed in outline of criminal investigations under article 129 of the Judicial Organisation Act without involvement in prosecutorial decisions, refused to disclose the communications citing the state's interest in a pending case under article 68 of the Constitution, denied NCTV contact on the case and account monitoring, and described NCTV's limited data collection and its information role for terrorism suspects.
The House of Representatives has a right to information from the cabinet under article 68 of the Constitution, which may only be refused if disclosure would be contrary to the interests of the State.

De Tweede Kamer heeft op grond van artikel 68 van de Grondwet recht op inlichtingen van het kabinet en zulks kan slechts worden geweigerd indien de verstrekking daarvan in strijd is met het belang van de Staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Brekelmans over moorden in Nederland en de Iraanse Revolutionaire Garde

MPs Ellian and Brekelmans asked whether investigations into the 2015 Almere and 2017 The Hague killings of Iranian-origin Dutchmen could qualify for EU terrorist listing of the IRGC, and whether the government would act on Iranian involvement. The government said the AIVD had strong indications of Iranian involvement and expelled two embassy staff in 2018, but that criminal investigations contain no proof of Iranian involvement, so the IRGC cannot currently be listed, and it continues to press for listing where legally possible.
In public, the AIVD cannot go into the nature of these indications.
In het openbaar kan de AIVD niet ingaan op de aard van deze aanwijzingen.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over communicatie tussen de NCTV en het bestuur van de NPO inzake de omroep Ongehoord Nederland

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security for all communication from February 2022 to February 2023 between the NCTV and the NPO board about broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland. The Minister answered that, as far as she knows, no such communication took place.

As far as I am aware, no communication took place between the National Coordinator for Counterterrorism and Security and the board of the Dutch Public Broadcaster about the broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland.

Er heeft, voor zover mij bekend, geen communicatie plaatsgevonden tussen de Nationaal Coördinator Terrorismebestrijding en Veiligheid en het bestuur van de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep over de omroep Ongehoord Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Belhaj over het bericht 'Medewerker diversiteit hoger onderwijs geïntimideerd en bedreigd

Two MPs from D66 asked the ministers of Education and of Justice about reports that diversity officers in higher education were intimidated and threatened online, and what the government would do to strengthen their position. The minister condemned the doxing and threats, pointed to a pending bill criminalising doxing and a forthcoming approach to online discrimination, but gave only general answers on strengthening diversity officers' position, deferring responsibility for staff safety to institutional boards.
The cabinet will develop an approach in 2023 to intensify cabinet policy against online discrimination, racism and hate speech.
Het kabinet zal in 2023 een aanpak ontwikkelen voor een intensivering van het kabinetsbeleid voor het tegengaan van online discriminatie, racisme en hate speech.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over politiesamenwerking tussen de Benelux-landen

An MP asked the Justice minister why the Netherlands has not yet ratified the new Benelux police cooperation treaty, which Belgium and Luxembourg have already approved, and urged speed.
