The minister explained that the Netherlands is last, that implementing agreements must go through a parliamentary pre-consultation procedure, and that the data protection authority's advice is still pending, while promising to pursue rapid entry into force.

Once the pre-consultation procedure is completed, the Netherlands can deposit the instrument of ratification with the depositary, the Secretary-General of the Benelux Union, and the treaty can enter into force.
Zodra de voorhangprocedure is afgerond kan Nederland de akte van bekrachtiging bij de depositaris – de Secretaris-Generaal van de Benelux Unie – neerleggen en kan het verdrag in werking treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over de rol van notarissen bij dubieuze grondhandel

MPs Boulakjar asked the ministers about notaries' role in dubious land speculation, including duty of care, use of powers of attorney, disciplinary rulings, and ACM/AFM oversight. Minister De Jonge answered that the notarial disciplinary judge assesses duty of care case by case, that the existing framework is sufficient without legal change, and that regulators receive few reports but will act in individual cases.
The assessment of the role of notaries and the associated duty of care in light of land trading is reserved for the notarial disciplinary judge.
De beoordeling van de rol van notarissen en de daarbij behorende zorgplicht in het licht van grondhandel is voorbehouden aan de notariële tuchtrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Aboutaleb: ‘Jonge drugsuithaler is meer gebaat bij gedwongen opvang in gesloten instelling dan met een taakstraf’’

CDA MP Kuik asked the Justice Minister to respond to Rotterdam mayor Aboutaleb's call for closed-institution detention rather than community sentences for minors caught with drugs, and asked about prevention, prosecution numbers and recidivism. The ministers answered that youth courts already have a range of sanctions available, that a meta-analysis shows lower recidivism after community sentences, and that they see no need for further study of alternative sentences.
We therefore see no reason at this time to examine this further.
Wij zien dan ook nu geen aanleiding om dit nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over het doodrijden van wolven

MPs Vestering and Wassenberg asked how many wolves have been killed by vehicles in the Netherlands, why this happens, what measures will prevent it, and whether a driver who fled a collision with a wild animal was punished. The minister answered that 11 confirmed collisions occurred from 2017 to January 2023, that measures such as warning systems and fauna crossings are used but fall outside the ministry's competence, and that the driver in the Hoogersmilde case stopped and police attended.
Taking measures does not fall within the competence of my ministry.
Het treffen van maatregelen ligt niet binnen de bevoegdheid van mijn ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het zo snel mogelijk starten met de volgende fase van het experiment gesloten coffeeshopketen

An MP from D66 asks the ministers how to speed up the closed coffeeshop cannabis experiment, including bank accounts for growers, BIBOB screening delays, imports from Canada, transport rules and oversight. The government answers that a start in early 2024 is expected, that a small-scale transition phase is being considered, that imports are barred by UN treaty, and that banks must keep their gatekeeping role under the Wwft.
Annex 5 is not public and is available for inspection at the Ministry of Justice and Security.
Bijlage 5 is niet openbaar en ligt ter inzage bij het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de inmenging van de Rijksoverheid in het publieke debat over de coronacrisis en het censureren van kritische burgers

Groep Van Haga asked ministers whether the central government covertly influenced public debate on COVID-19, including through 'debunking', alleged avatars and trolls, surveillance of critics, and pressure on media and fact-checkers. The government denied any 'disinformation operation', said it only informs press and debunks factual errors, and pointed to earlier letters, independent LIMC research and existing NCTV/IGJ responsibilities.
No 'disinformation operation' took place as described in the cited article.
Er heeft geen «desinformatie-operatie» plaatsgevonden zoals beschreven in het genoemde artikel.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Die snuivende zanger maakt drugsgebruik doodnormaal’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a public drug-use incident by a singer and how the government would counter the normalisation of drug use, including campaigns, event organisers and municipal permit conditions. The minister condemned the incident and described a targeted prevention strategy aimed at high-use groups, while leaving the broader public campaign and permit-based proposals largely to other actors and existing practice.
I call on event organisers to distribute this intervention among their members.
Ik roep evenementenorganisatoren op deze interventie te verspreiden onder hun achterban.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de mogelijkheid dat de Nederlandse overheid toegang heeft of had tot portals voor het aangeven van desinformatie bij sociale media

Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch government, including ministries, intelligence services, police, regulators and other bodies, has or had access to platform portals for reporting disinformation or other content on social media, and what that access was used for. The government answered that the ministry of BZK holds trusted flagger status at several platforms, used only sparingly around elections, along with several regulators and the police for illegal or harmful content, and that intelligence services will not comment; it could not answer all questions within the deadline and withheld some operational guidance.
Through these channels the Ministry of BZK has no power to compel these companies to remove certain content or take other actions.
Het Ministerie van BZK heeft via deze kanalen geen bevoegdheid deze bedrijven te dwingen bepaalde content te laten verwijderen of andere acties te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Verkuijlen over het bericht ‘jongeren vaker betrokken bij fraude en cybercrime, politie maakt zicht zorgen’

MPs Rajkowski and Verkuijlen asked the Justice Minister about the rise in youth involvement in fraud and cybercrime, parental liability, school prevention programmes and the uptake of HackShield and Hack_Right. The minister replied that no clear rise in 2022 is evident yet, outlined prevention initiatives involving schools, parents and municipalities, and committed to further study and a prosecution overview.
I consider it important to gain more insight into the role of young people in crime.
Ik vind het belangrijk om meer inzicht te vergaren in de rol van jongeren in criminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Gebruik lachgas ondanks verbod nog onbestraft’

The CDA MP Kuik asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the nationwide nitrous oxide (lachgas) ban that took effect on 1 January 2023 cannot yet be fully enforced, what practical bottlenecks exist, and what will be done to enable enforcement quickly. The Minister answers that police are already seizing nitrous oxide and enforcement is possible under local bylaws and other laws, but full uniform enforcement under the Opiumwet requires logistics and procedures to be completed, targeted for 1 July 2023, with a temporary transport exemption in place.

The Public Prosecution Service and the police are doing everything they can to have all logistical and procedural aspects ready by 1 July 2023, so that the nitrous oxide ban can then be enforced fully and uniformly.

Het Openbaar Ministerie en de politie doen er alles aan om op 1 juli 2023 alle logistieke en procesmatige aspecten gereed te hebben, zodat er dan volledig en uniform gehandhaafd wordt op het lachgasverbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over de plaatsing van distikstofmonoxide (lachgas) op Opiumlijst II en de handhaving daarvan

MP Michon-Derkzen asked whether police and the Public Prosecution Service were ready to enforce the nitrous oxide ban on List II of the Opium Act from 1 January 2023, what was needed for effective enforcement, and how enforcement would work if preparations were not complete. The Minister of Justice replied that enforcement against possession already takes place, that an ingroeimodel was agreed with police and prosecutors because of the logistical and safety requirements, that €14 million was structurally allocated, and that other laws are also used in the meantime.
As soon as the results of this further research are known, I will inform your House about this.
Zodra de resultaten van dit nader onderzoek bekend zijn zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Ephraim over de situatie in Den Haag Zuidwest

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about youth knife violence and a neighbourhood security situation in The Hague Zuidwest, including whether migrant youths are to blame, the trend in youth weapon possession, and plans for deprived neighbourhoods. The Minister said the city takes the problem seriously, described preventive and repressive measures and the Preventie met gezag approach, and gave a timeline for the next weapons-and-youth action plan meeting, without giving precise youth possession figures.
The exact weapon possession among youths is not known.
Het exacte wapenbezit onder jongeren is niet bekend
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over een onderzoek naar de oorzaken van de verharding van jeugdcriminaliteit

An MP asks the Justice and Security and Legal Protection ministers whether juvenile crime is becoming more violent and whether comprehensive research into its causes exists. The ministers acknowledge a rise in serious juvenile offences, list ongoing and completed studies (EPIC, WODC deelstudies, Bureau Beke), and say they agree overarching research is important without committing to a new study.
We also believe such research is of great importance and that is why it has been set in motion.
Wij zijn ook van mening dat dergelijk onderzoek van groot belang is en daarom is dat in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de racistische leuzen op de Erasmusbrug

An MP asked the Justice and Interior Ministers about racist slogans projected on the Erasmus Bridge during New Year's Eve, whether the government condemns them, whether further actions are planned, whether a criminal investigation will conclude soon, how to protect vulnerable youth, and how to coordinate with other countries. The government condemned the expressions, said a criminal investigation by the OM and police is ongoing and it cannot comment on it, described planned measures against radicalisation and online extremism, and referred to existing and forthcoming policy documents.
We cannot make further statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kunnen wij geen verdere uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht ‘Russische hackers hebben het gemunt op Nederlandse gasinstallaties’

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch gas infrastructure, on land and at sea, is adequately protected against Russian state-linked cyberattacks and sabotage, and whether emergency plans exist. The minister answered that the operators bear primary responsibility, that the government supports them through information sharing and the Wbni framework with RDI supervision and NCSC assistance, and that gas crisis plans (BH-G, NCP Gas) and a North Sea protection strategy are in place or in development.

In its governing role over vital infrastructure, I set requirements together with the Minister of Justice and Security, which are laid down in laws and regulations, and I supervise compliance with them.
Vanuit haar regierol op de vitale infrastructuur stel ik samen met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid eisen op die worden vastgelegd in wet- en regelgeving en zie ik toe op de naleving ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht 'Regelwerk weerhoudt boeren van melden drugsafval: 'Er moet een vliegende brigade komen die het opruimen overneemt''

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that heavy regulation and costs deter farmers from reporting illegal drug waste dumped on their land, and proposed a 'flying brigade' to clear it. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to an expanded subsidy scheme and invoice-based checks, said the flying brigade idea would be discussed with partners, and promised a letter by May 2023.
No data are known on either the abstention from reporting or the relocation of drug waste.
Over zowel het afzien van meldingen als het verplaatsen van drugsafval zijn geen gegevens bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het artikel ‘Illegale sigarettenfabriek ontdekt in Heerlen, 23 aanhoudingen’

An MP asks the government about an illegal cigarette factory in Heerlen, seizure figures, lost excise revenue, social costs, the link between excise increases and smuggling, and EU cooperation against tobacco smuggling. The state secretary gives detailed seizure data, estimates roughly 50 million euros per year lost to illegal trade, cites studies on excise and smuggling, and says current EU cooperation needs no intensification for now.
The cabinet will inform the House about this with the BNC fiche.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer hierover informeren met het BNC-fiche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga inzake het geweld tegen hulpverleners

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether violence against emergency workers is rising, whether perpetrators should face extra penalties and be evicted or lose benefits, and what is being done about prosecution and reporting rates. The minister agreed the violence is unacceptable, explained the 200% higher prosecution demand policy, rejected extra administrative penalties under the una via principle, and listed existing task force and prevention measures plus a forthcoming WODC study.
Imposing an additional penalty by the mayor or another government body on top of a criminal conviction is contrary to the una via principle.
Het in aanvulling op een strafrechtelijke veroordeling opleggen van een extra straf door de burgemeester of ander overheidsorgaan is in strijd met het una via-beginsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Minhas over het bericht ‘ProRail dumpt Chinese bewakingscamera’s, de NS laat ze hangen’ van Follow The Money

MPs Rajkowski and Minhas asked whether Chinese-made cameras in rail rolling stock, where the rail infrastructure is a designated vital process, are compatible with national security given China's offensive cyber strategy, and whether NS's mitigation measures and NCSC advice are adequate. The government replied that Chinese equipment in vital sectors is not per se undesirable, that vital providers like NS are responsible for risk assessment and mitigation under supervision by the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport, that NS has taken measures such as network separation and no direct internet connection, and that the NCSC does not advise on individual products.
That a particular product or service, in this case cameras, within a vital sector originates from a Chinese provider is not necessarily undesirable.
Dat een bepaald product of dienst, in dit geval camera's, binnen een vitale sector afkomstig is van een Chinese aanbieder is niet per definitie onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de privatisering van politietaken

Two MPs (SP) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the privatisation of police tasks, including which partners join dialogue tables on a future police vision, which stakeholders and disciplines are involved, which tasks are inherently public, and whether Parliament will be involved. The minister answers that strategic dialogue tables and essays will shape a white paper, that Parliament will be informed later, and that the political debate on public versus shared police tasks is needed, though substantive answers on task allocation are deferred.

As stated in my letter of 5 July 2022, I want to arrive at a thorough deepening and I attach importance to carefully going through all parts of the necessary process before formulating a substantive answer to the above questions.

Zoals aangegeven in mijn brief van 5 juli 2022 wil ik komen tot een grondige verdieping en ik hecht eraan alle onderdelen van het hiervoor noodzakelijke proces zorgvuldig te doorlopen, alvorens een inhoudelijk antwoord te formuleren op bovenstaande vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de uitvoering van de motie Mutluer om meer hoogopgeleide mensen bij de politie te krijgen

Mutluer (PvdA) asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the motion to attract more highly educated people to the police is being implemented, including how many detectives and specialists are needed, whether the 720 specialist entry places suffice, and whether universities should provide specialist training. The minister answered that about a quarter of the 10,750 investigation staff are higher-educated, roughly 500 specialists a year are needed, the current 720 places are for now sufficient though labour shortages limit recruitment, and the Police Academy already cooperates with universities and universities of applied sciences.
The police do not work so much with a target figure, but with a staffing plan from which a recruitment task and an internal progression task with the associated training need follow.
De politie werkt niet zozeer met een streefcijfer, maar met een personeelsplan waaruit een wervingsopgave en een doorstroomopgave met bijbehorende opleidingsbehoefte volgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Knops over de toenemende georganiseerde criminaliteit in Limburg

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister about rising organised crime in Limburg, including the police and prosecution capacity gap, the imbalance in international legal assistance requests, and cross-border cooperation. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to added funding for the regional approach, cross-border agreements and EU cooperation, and said more concrete steps were still being developed.
I am monitoring progress and expect to have a better view of the measures during the course of the year.
Ik hou de voortgang in de gaten en verwacht in de loop van het jaar beter zicht op de maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over de rechtsstaat en beloofde verbeteringen na het toeslagenschandaal

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked the government about progress on promises made after the childcare benefits scandal, including the eleven 'buikpijn' cases, the implementation of softer legal discretion, the role of inspectorates and ombudsman signals, the Landsadvocaat, and the Ministerial Commission on the childcare benefits recovery. The minister answered that the cases are being pursued by the relevant departments, gave progress updates across the reaction to the 'Ongekend onrecht' report, and said the Landsadvocaat and commission data are not available as overviews, while promising ongoing reporting to parliament.
No overviews are available of that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat er buitensporig vaak inzage in de persoonsgegevens van slachtoffers van het toeslagenschandaal heeft plaatsgevonden

MP Leijten asked whether police and other authorities queried personal data of victims of the childcare benefits scandal excessively often via the BRP, why, and whether such access is checked or logged. The government answered that police cannot identify victims in their records, that excessiveness cannot be judged generally, that no signals of excessive queries were known beyond the FTM report, and it outlined existing AVG and Wpg accountability and access rules, with logging of police data use (art. 32a Wpg) due to take effect by May 2023.
The police do not know which persons are victims of the childcare benefits affair.
Het is voor de politie niet bekend welke personen gedupeerden van de toeslagenaffaire zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de mogelijkheid voor VvE’s om digitaal vergaderingen te beleggen

Nijboer (PvdA) asked whether VvEs should be allowed to hold digital meetings permanently, and whether repeated extensions of the temporary COVID law create uncertainty and disadvantage less digitally skilled owners. The minister answers that a permanent digital-meeting option is desirable, that a Wet digitale algemene vergadering is in consultation, and that the COVID-based option will not be extended past 1 February 2023 unless circumstances change, with a machtiging-based safeguard for members.
I agree that in practice there appears to be a need to make digital meetings permanently possible.
Ik ben het met u eens, dat in de praktijk behoefte blijkt te bestaan aan het permanent mogelijk maken van digitaal vergaderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het online gebiedsverbod

Two D66 MPs asked the government about Almelo's municipal bylaw banning online posts that could cause physical disruption of public order, including enforcement, constitutional free-speech concerns under Article 7 of the Constitution, and the lack of a promised legal framework for municipal online monitoring. The Justice Minister answered that municipalities are primarily responsible for their bylaws, that enforcement rests with the mayor, that the censorship ban limits municipalities, and that the promised guidance on social media monitoring is delayed to Q1 2023.
I have understanding for the search by municipalities for ways to maintain public order where the cause lies in online conduct.
Ik heb begrip voor de zoektocht van gemeenten naar manieren om de openbare orde te handhaven als de oorzaak is gelegen in online gedragingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over WOB-documenten met betrekking tot de invloed van het NCTV op het coronabeleid

An MP asked the ministers of Justice, Health and Defence about FOIA documents suggesting the NCTV had outsized influence over COVID policy, including the LIMC monitoring, drones, the NDN network and the Twm law. The minister rejected the characterisation as distorted, explained the NCTV's coordinating role, and denied most allegations while stating the Commissie Brouwer found the LIMC trend analyses lacked a legal basis.
Asking by written parliamentary question for personal data of civil servants and their background is therefore not appropriate as such.
Het middels een schriftelijke Kamervraag informeren naar persoonsgegevens van ambtenaren en hun achtergrond is als zodanig dan ook niet gepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het OM dat weigert een doodsbedreiger te vervolgen

An MP asked the Justice Minister why the Public Prosecution Service declined to prosecute a death threat against him, questioning whether the statute of limitations and the threat's handling were selective compared with a case involving a VVD politician. The Minister refused to discuss individual prosecutorial decisions to prevent political interference, while affirming that threats against MPs are unacceptable and that the PPS assesses all such complaints on their merits.
It is not for me, as Minister of Justice and Security, to address individual cases in order to prevent political interference.
Het is niet aan mij om als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om in te gaan op individuele zaken om politieke bemoeienis te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over “het bericht: OM worstelt met namen Schiphol-betogers: ‘ze hadden geen id bij zich”

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that prosecutors struggle to identify Schiphol protesters arrested without ID, including whether sanctions were imposed, what police powers exist to compel identification, and whether incitement training organisers can be pursued. The minister answered that identification investigations are ongoing, detailed how police may hold arrestees and take photos and fingerprints, and said current powers are adequate for now.
In the context of the investigative interest, I cannot currently state how large this group is or how the investigation is being conducted.
In het kader van het opsporingsbelang kan ik op dit moment niet aangeven hoe groot deze groep is of op welke wijze het onderzoek wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Michon-Derkzen en Mutluer over ‘Het schrijnende tekort aan forensisch artsen’

MPs asked the ministers about the severe shortage of forensic doctors, including how often shifts went unfilled, whether child abuse evidence was lost, and what structural solutions exist. The government reported recurring unfilled shifts in some regions, no known cases of lost child-abuse evidence, a temporary arrangement through 2023 with a sustainable solution still being developed, and that more funding is still being sought.
This despite many forensic doctors already working more shifts than desired.
Dit ondanks dat veel forensisch artsen al meer diensten draaien dan gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over oververtegenwoordiging Limburg op de Onderwereldkaart

An MP asks the Justice Minister about Limburg's over-representation on the criminal underworld map, border controls, and calls from the Limburg governor for more police and judiciary capacity. The minister confirms awareness, cites cross-border cooperation, Marechaussee mobile checks as an alternative to border controls, extra police and judicial funding, and a broader anti-drug-crime strategy without committing to reintroduce border controls.
It is wiser to invest in good cross-border cooperation as detailed above, also to prevent so-called waterbed effects.
Het is verstandiger in te zetten op goede grensoverschrijdende samenwerking zoals hierboven gedetailleerd is geschetst, ook om zogenaamde waterbed- effecten te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de uitbuiting van minderjarigen op YouTube

An MP asks the Justice Minister about exploitation of minors on YouTube, including sexualised thumbnails and a lack of oversight. The minister says such content is unacceptable, points to YouTube's community rules, criminal law, reporting channels and upcoming EU rules (Digital Services Act) and a planned Autoriteit, but offers no new oversight powers now.
I find it a worrying development that there are influencers who apparently are willing to push the boundaries of what is permissible.
Ik vind het een zorgelijke ontwikkeling dat er influencers zijn die blijkbaar bereid zijn de grenzen van het toelaatbare op te zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ´Ouders omgekomen Bram (12) uit Haaksbergen willen verbod op klaphamer

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether klaphamers (homemade metal devices producing loud bangs with chemicals, linked to a fatal accident involving a 12-year-old) are regulated, whether they fall under the fireworks decree, and what oversight exists. The minister answered that no national rules or designated supervisor exist, that municipalities can ban them via local ordinances, and that information will be provided to municipalities around September 2023.
No national figures are available on the number of accidents involving klaphamers.
Er zijn geen landelijke cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal ongevallen met klaphamers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de aanpak van criminele families

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the approach to criminal families, following reports that many drug suspects had relatives also suspected of drug offences, and asked about causes, definitions, prevention, a Tilburg coaching initiative and information sharing between RIECs and Zorg- en Veiligheidshuizen. The minister answered that the problem requires tailored, integrated, preventive action, described existing programmes and a pilot with Leger des Heils, and said an information-sharing framework is being concretised.
That is therefore not for me to determine.
Het is daarom niet aan mij om dit te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat bijna alle slachtoffers van het Essex-drama in Nederland zijn geweest

SP MPs asked whether the Essex lorry deaths victims had mostly been in the Netherlands, after a Myria report implied 38 of 39 victims were previously known there, and asked about Dutch handling of Vietnamese human trafficking and smuggling. The State Secretary answered that the passage was a misreading: fingerprint comparison found only two prior Dutch presences, the report was amended, the observation was not subject to the transit-prohibition given no concrete knowledge of smuggling, and no new investigation is planned.
This research showed that two of the 39 victims had been in the Netherlands before the tragedy.
Uit dit onderzoek is gebleken dat twee van de 39 slachtoffers voorafgaand aan het drama in Nederland zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over de documentaire 'Het laatste woord' en de straf die Jurriën in erbarmelijke omstandigheden uitzit in Tunesië

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked about the documentary 'Het laatste woord' and the harsh detention of a Dutch national, Jurriën, sentenced to 20 years in Tunisia. The minister of Foreign Affairs answered that the ministry provides consular assistance, has visited him 54 times, supported clemency requests, and cannot assess the legal proceedings abroad.
It is for the detainee and his lawyer to raise the aspects regarding the legal proceedings and legal remedies, and for the judge to then decide on them.
Het is aan de gedetineerde en zijn advocaat de aspecten ten aanzien van de rechtsgang en rechtsmiddelen aan de orde te stellen en aan de rechter hierover vervolgens te beslissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security which 'partners' were referred to as sources for the Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57. The Minister answered that sources include intelligence services, police, open sources, foreign partners and embassy analyses, and repeated that no internet monitoring was used.

As stated in the answer to the parliamentary questions from MP Van Houwelingen (FvD) about the Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57 dated 14 December 2022, the Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland is based on information from the intelligence and security services and the police, open source information (including media and scientific sources), information from foreign partners and analyses by embassy staff.

Zoals gesteld in de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van het lid Van Houwelingen (FvD) over het Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57 d.d. 14 december 2022, is het Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland gebaseerd op informatie van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten en van de politie, open bronneninformatie (waaronder media en wetenschappelijke bronnen), informatie van buitenlandse partners en analyses van ambassadepersoneel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Nispen en Leijten over Chinese inmenging in Nederland

MPs Van Dijk, Van Nispen and Leijten asked about reports of Chinese 'police service stations' in the Netherlands, whether those staff can stay and be prosecuted, whether the AIVD knew, where the limits of foreign interference lie, what infrastructure Chinese state actors hold and how to prevent its use as leverage, and whether cruciale sectors should be under Dutch control. The government said the stations have been closed after diplomatic protests, that no evidence yet shows staff were sent from China, that investigation continues and prosecution is not ruled out, declined to comment on AIVD knowledge, pointed to its three-track anti-interference approach and a planned espionage bill, and described the Vifo screening law and a reinforced vital-infrastructure approach while citing partial Chinese ownership of Rotterdam container terminals.
Regarding the knowledge level, working methods or sources of the intelligence services, the AIVD, as you know, makes no public statements.
Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten doet de AIVD, zoals bij u bekend, in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Sylvana Simons over het Zwarte Piet-geweld in Staphorst

MPs Klaver and Simons asked the Justice and Interior ministers about violence against anti-Zwarte Piet demonstrators in Staphorst, police preparation and protection, and whether independent inquiries or a demonstration-rights review would follow. The minister condemned the violence, pointed to criminal investigations, a mayoral inquiry and an Inspectorate of Justice and Security inquiry, declined to pre-empt them, and saw no reason to ask the Ombudsman or Safety Board to investigate.
This investigation will in any case focus on the police's performance of duties in preparing for the demonstration, during the confrontation between demonstrators and their attackers, and afterwards.
Dit onderzoek zal in elk geval gericht zijn op de taakuitvoering door de politie bij de voorbereiding op de demonstratie, gedurende de confrontatie tussen demonstranten en hun belagers en daarna.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Tilburg verliest strijd tegen drugsindustrie’, is alarmerende boodschap van 35 professionals’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report by 35 Tilburg professionals saying the fight against drug-related undermining crime is failing and that existing structures are not effective enough to keep youth from drug crime. The minister agreed on the need for prevention, acknowledged information-sharing and funding bottlenecks, and said a letter on the Michon-Derkzen motion follows in spring 2023, while rejecting a national publicity campaign.
That is why I, together with the Minister for Legal Protection, am investing heavily in a broad prevention approach to (organised and undermining) youth crime.
Daarom investeer ik, samen met de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming, fors in een brede preventieaanpak voor (georganiseerde en ondermijnende) jeugdcriminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Piri over het bericht ‘Bedreigde Iraans-Nederlandse activist kreeg telkens nul op rekest bij Nederlandse politie voordat hij werd vermoord’

MPs Van der Lee and Piri asked how police failed to protect an Iranian-Dutch activist who reported repeated threats before being murdered, whether a reporting point for diaspora threats and stronger measures against foreign-regime intimidation are planned, and whether embassies of Morocco, Turkey, China and Iran were confronted. The minister declined to discuss the specific case for security reasons, said protection responsibility lies with local authorities, outlined diplomatic sanctions and a three-track approach, and promised further information on a reporting point.
For security reasons I cannot go into a specific case or the considerations made or not made.
Omwille van veiligheidsredenen kan ik niet ingaan op een specifieke casus en de afwegingen die wel of niet gemaakt zijn.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over spionage met gebruik van Pegasus- of vergelijkbare software

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether the government distinguishes security risks for ministers and senior officials, whether it will raise security measures against spyware such as Pegasus, and how it oversees use of intrusion software. The ministers answered that departments are responsible for their own digital security under the BIO framework, that intrusion software use is subject to legal safeguards and judicial, prosecutorial and intelligence oversight, and that they will not publish which software is used.
To protect means and methods, it is not possible to give public insight into which software the police use when carrying out this power.
Het is voor de afscherming van middelen en methodieken niet mogelijk om openbaar inzicht te geven in welke software de politie gebruikt bij de uitvoering van deze bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Kwint en Van Nispen over de inzet van voorspellende algoritmes met betrekking tot kinderen

MPs from the SP asked the government whether the police would keep using the ProKid Plus algorithm to predict violent crime among children, and about oversight, data, safeguards and links to youth care and the Top400 approach. The minister answered that ProKid Plus was used only once in a 2016 Amsterdam trial, is no longer used, that a new police alerting system (ProKid 23-) is still under legal and ethical assessment, and described existing legal safeguards and oversight, while committing to no new structural rule changes.

The experiences with ProKid Plus underline the importance of good safeguards for the use of algorithms, to which the State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations, together with the Minister for Legal Protection, is giving extra attention.

De ervaringen met ProKid Plus onderstrepen het belang van goede waarborgen voor het gebruik van algoritmen, waar de Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties in samenwerking met de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming extra aandacht voor heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht ‘Kritiek op niet naleven securityregels overheidswebsites: ‘geen rocketscience’’’

An MP asks the Justice and Security and Interior ministers why half of central government domain names fail mandatory security standards that should have been implemented by 2019 and 2021, and how lower governments are being held to account. The state secretary answers that only 50% of Rijksoverheid domains comply with web standards and 55% with email standards, attributes delays partly to external vendors such as Microsoft, and promises a letter to all governments urging compliance and a later update to parliament on the Justice ministry's own implementation.
I find it unacceptable that governments do not have this in order and will, by letter via the umbrella organisations, call on all governments to implement the standards as quickly as possible.
Ik vind het onacceptabel dat overheden dit niet op orde hebben en zal per brief, via de koepelorganisaties 2 , alle overheden oproepen zo snel mogelijk de standaarden te implementeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Ellemeet over de behandeling van politieagenten die hebben meegewerkt aan de documentaire De Blauwe Familie

MPs Mutluer and Ellemeet asked the Justice Minister about the treatment of police officers who took part in the documentary De Blauwe Familie on racism within the police, including reports of no recognition or rehabilitation, a single commendation while others faced criminal proceedings, and a claimed unanswered call from the police chief. The Minister condemned racism, said the police leadership has contacted each participant and will be urged to pursue reconciliation, announced an action plan and a coordinator, and declined to comment on individual cases.
It is not appropriate for me to comment on individual cases.
Het past mij niet om in te gaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat iemand 2,5 jaar onterecht vast zat na machtsmisbruik van de Nederlandse overheid

An MP asked the ministers about a man who was wrongly held for 2.5 years after the Dutch state misused its power in a transfer-of-sentence procedure, and why rule-of-law protection failed. The minister regretted the situation, acknowledged the state acted unlawfully, declined to discuss the individual case further, and said the IOS department has introduced a framework to prevent similar cases.
The Dutch state acknowledged in this procedure that it acted unlawfully by subjecting the person to a second transfer-of-sentence procedure.
De Nederlandse staat heeft in deze procedure erkend dat ze onrechtmatig heeft gehandeld door betrokkene aan een tweede procedure van strafoverdracht te onderwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Werf over het bericht dat er Chinese politiebureaus in Nederland zijn

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van der Werf asked the government about reports of Chinese 'overseas police service stations' in the Netherlands, including their financing, legality, and protection of the Chinese diaspora. The minister answered that the stations were closed after the Chinese ambassador was summoned, that the financing and activities were still under investigation, and that the investigation results would be shared with the House if necessary.
When the investigation is concluded, the House will be informed about it (if necessary confidentially).
Wanneer het onderzoek is afgerond zal de Kamer hierover (indien noodzakelijk vertrouwelijk) worden geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Steeds meer meldingen verwarde personen, maar aanpak moeilijk door privacywet: ‘Je weet niet met wie je te maken hebt.’’

Two VVD MPs asked ministers about rising reports of persons with confused behaviour, data-sharing barriers under privacy law, and whether the national reporting line tracks outcomes. The ministers answered that the national line only forwards callers to regional bodies, that cooperation and data-sharing frameworks are being developed, and that they will keep consulting field partners and the EU on the GDPR.
No, no data is centrally collected on this.
Nee, hierover wordt centraal geen data verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er cruciale informatie ontbreekt in een proces-verbaal

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about a court ruling that a police report omitted and misrepresented facts, leading to the prosecution being declared inadmissible, and about whether victims are informed, whether police conduct was professional, and what measures follow. The minister declined to comment on the individual case pending a Rijksrecherche investigation, stated that such deliberate misinformation in reports is serious, described the professionality framework and disciplinary options, and said the OM is evaluating internally and will report after the investigation.
I am not making any statements on this case at present, because the investigation is ongoing and I do not wish to influence it.
Ik doe op dit moment geen uitspraken over deze zaak, omdat het onderzoek nog loopt en ik dat niet wil beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over stalbezettingen

Bromet (GroenLinks) asked how many stable occupations by animal activists took place in 2021 and 2022. The minister answered that none are known to have occurred in those years, noting police cannot retrieve such figures because a stable occupation is not a separate offence, though one occupation of a calf farm in Apeldoorn in September 2021 led to 84 arrests.
A stable occupation is not a separate criminal offence and is therefore not registered in a uniform way.
Een stalbezetting is geen apart strafbaar feit en wordt dus niet op een eenduidige wijze geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57

An FvD MP asked whether the Minister knows a sentence from the Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57 describing right-wing extremists as an amorphous group blending unclear ideas with personal grievances and psychological problems, and whether underlying analyses exist and can be shared. The Minister confirmed knowing the sentence, said the assessment is based on a shared view of NCTV and partners drawn from current casuistry, and declined to share the underlying analyses, citing risk to national security and investigative methods.
Further disclosure would give too much insight into the investigative methods of these partners.
Verdere inzage geeft teveel kijk in de onderzoeksmethodiek van deze partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Graus over zware mishandeling en wurging van katten in Gouda

PVV MPs Wilders and Graus asked whether an investigation would be launched into the cat strangulations in Gouda, whether the carcasses were sent to the Veterinary Forensic Team, whether animal abusers could face much harsher penalties, and what would be done to prevent such cases and ensure enough capacity. The Minister said investigations are a matter for the police and prosecutors, pointed to existing maximum penalties and a pending bill allowing an independent animal-keeping ban, and said there was no evidence of insufficient capacity.
It is not for the Minister to decide whether to launch a criminal investigation.
Het is niet aan de Minister om te besluiten over het instellen van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de LSI (Landelijke Stuurgroep Interventieteams) en vele tot nu toe onuitgevoerde toezeggingen over privacy, risicoscores van heel veel burgers, onuitgevoerd onderzoek, niet opg

MP Omtzigt asks about the LSI joint intervention-team data sharing, including DPIAs, promised but unpublished documents, a planned external review of risk scores, an advisory analytics committee that is still not set up, and possible GDPR violations. The government answers that DPIAs and a privacy protocol are being prepared, that LSI risk scores were stopped in July 2020, that the advisory committee is still being recruited, and that the requested documents are attached or promised later.
Once the DPIA of the LSI cooperation has been completed, it will be sent to the House.
Zodra de DPIA van de LSI-samenwerking is opgeleverd zal deze aan de Kamer worden toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het innen van een schadevergoedingsmaatregel voor slachtoffers

An SP MP asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers why a victim of online extortion, a vulnerable young man, has received none of the damages awarded by the court, and what is being done to improve collection of compensation orders. Minister Weerwind replied that the CJIB uses a range of collection instruments with a reasonable success rate, that a victim advance scheme exists, that the Donner committee reform is still being developed with a letter promised by 1 June 2023, and that improvements will be considered without committing to specific new measures.
I cannot go into this individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op deze individuele zaak.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het vervolgen van verslagleggingsfraude

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister whether financial statement fraud (art. 336 Sr) is prosecuted actively enough, citing its scale, conviction and prosecution numbers, and a set of proposals (binding instruction to prosecutors, banning trust offices, mandatory audits, UBO and filing enforcement). The government answered that damage cannot be reliably measured, prosecution is adequate and independent of ministerial instruction, and rejected most proposals, noting existing sanctions and oversight mechanisms.
Given what the OM already does on this subject, I consider giving a specific instruction unnecessary and moreover undesirable.
Het geven van een specifieke aanwijzing vind ik mede gelet op wat het OM reeds doet op dit onderwerp dan ook niet nodig en acht ik bovendien onwenselijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Bevers, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Hijink en Kuik over het bericht ‘Openbaar Ministerie wil tien mensen vervolgen voor verstrekking 'Middel X'

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Health ministers about prosecutions over the supply of suicide-enabling substance 'Middel X' linked to the Coöperatie Laatste Wil, and about prevention, victim research, and whether the criminal law or chemical sales rules should be tightened. The government said ten people are being considered for prosecution, that voluntary industry measures remain in place with no new substances found, that regulation by law is complex and of limited effect, and that research on victims and support for bereaved families is underway, while declining to comment on the ongoing criminal case or the adequacy of current law.
As long as the criminal case is ongoing, it is also not appropriate for me to give a judgement on the current legal framework.
Zolang de strafzaak loopt past het mij evenmin om een oordeel te geven over het huidige wettelijke kader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Gestreste ondernemer is makkelijke prooi: trap niet in fraudeval’

An MP asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about phishing and ransomware targeting entrepreneurs, including awareness campaigns, reporting rates, support for victims, telecom measures, and a Belgian-style anti-phishing shield. The ministers answered that existing campaigns, the Digital Trust Center, the Fraudehelpdesk and telecom talks are ongoing, and that a Belgian-style shield is being explored, without new binding commitments.

Yes. As reported in the annex to the letter on the integrated approach to cybercrime of 4 November, the Ministry of Justice and Security, together with the NCSC, is exploring whether an anti-phishing shield modelled on the Belgian example can also be set up in the Netherlands.

Ja. Zoals gemeld in de bijlage bij de Kamerbrief over de integrale aanpak van cybercrime van 4 november jl. verkent het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, tezamen met het NCSC of een «anti-phishing-schild» naar Belgisch voorbeeld ook in Nederland kan worden opgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over het bericht ‘Corruptie is bij de Belastingdienst lastig te traceren’

MPs Idsinga and Michon-Derkzen asked about reports that corruption at the Tax Authority is hard to trace, since systems do not log which data staff access. The State Secretary admits systems do not log data queries, outlines integrity measures, and says the Minister will raise corruption in the MCAO and inform parliament in later letters.
It is correct that the Tax Authority's computer systems do not record (log) which information employees query, because these systems were not designed to capture such information.
Het klopt dat computersystemen van de Belastingdienst niet registreren (loggen) welke informatie medewerkers opvragen omdat deze systemen niet zijn opgezet om dit soort informatie vast te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het laten lopen van echte criminelen door focus op zaak De Mos

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether it is acceptable that 53 cases were dropped, letting drug dealers and growers escape punishment, and why a local politician is being prosecuted while real criminals go free, asking also for staff and cost figures. The minister declined to comment on individual cases because one is before a court, stated that the Public Prosecution Service decides independently under the opportunity principle, and said the cost figures are not kept.
To prevent political interference, the Public Prosecution Service has an independent authority to decide in which cases to prosecute or not.
Om politieke bemoeienis te voorkomen heeft het Openbaar Ministerie een eigenstandige bevoegdheid om te beslissen in welke zaken wel of niet wordt vervolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Kwart van gecontroleerde truckers bij bloemenveiling Aalsmeer zit mogelijk met drugs op achter het stuur’

MPs Van der Staaij and Stoffer asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about reports that a quarter of truck drivers checked at the Aalsmeer flower auction may have had drugs in their system, and about enforcement, sanctions and prevention. The government condemned drug driving, said enforcement is local and risk-based, described the testing and sanction process, and said no specific research into causes or public campaign was planned.
The police record information on individual suspects in the context of drug checks in traffic, not on occupational groups or vehicles.
De politie registreert informatie over de individuele verdachten in het kader van drugscontroles in het verkeer, niet over beroepsgroepen of voertuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over kinderontvoeringen naar het buitenland

An MP asked the Justice Minister why international child abduction from the Netherlands is rising, whether migrant-parent involvement is tracked, how to prevent abductions, and whether penalties should be raised or abducting parents barred from entry. The minister said the data show no structural rise, no further study or risk analysis is needed now, and no bill to increase penalties is planned, while describing prevention training and efforts to improve travel-consent checks.
I do not consider further research necessary at this time.
Nader onderzoek acht ik op dit moment niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘Rellen verpesten kermis in Osdorp’.

Van Haga asks the Justice Minister about youth riots at a fairground in Osdorp, Amsterdam, and how the government will combat them, recover police costs and shopkeepers' losses, and confiscate youths' property or impose area bans and curfews. The Minister points to the prevention-and-sanctions youth crime approach, says policing costs are not recharged, refers victims to civil or criminal compensation routes, and refers back to the answer on question 2.
Costs incurred by the police for enforcing public order are not recharged.
Kosten gemaakt door politie voor handhaving van de openbare orde worden niet doorberekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een ‘speciale portal’ bij techbedrijven

An MP asked whether the Dutch state has access to a special 'portal' at tech companies for flagging disinformation, as reported for the Biden administration, and whether the state keeps contact with these companies. The minister answered that BZK has no access to such a Content Request System but holds trusted flagger status at Meta, Google, Twitter, TikTok and Snapchat, used sparingly and only around elections, and that the ministry maintains contact with these companies in various ways.
The Ministry of BZK does not have access to a Content Request System as described in the articles in the appendices.
Het Ministerie van BZK heeft geen toegang tot een Content Request System zoals beschreven in de artikelen in de bijlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de speech van minister Yeşilgöz-Zegerius tijdens de HJ Schoo-lezing van 2022

Sylvana Simons (BIJ1) asked the Justice Minister ten questions about Dilan Yeşilgöz-Zegerius's 2022 HJ Schoo lecture, covering 'wokeism', free speech, discrimination, police racism and the state's duty to protect citizens. The minister answered that wokeism undermines open debate, that discrimination and racist speech are unacceptable and combated, and that the state acknowledges police and asylum-reception problems without conceding the lecture targeted them.
I would not want to equate making topics undiscussable with discrimination.
Ik zou het onbespreekbaar maken van onderwerpen niet gelijk willen stellen met discriminatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Van der Molen, Knops en Inge van Dijk over studeren op kosten van een brievenbusfirma

MPs asked whether Dutch universities should be subject to anti-money-laundering checks on tuition payments from foreign students, including screening for PEPs and cash payments. The government replied that universities are not obliged institutions under the Wwft, that the National Risk Assessment shows no indication of laundering risk in university services, and that cash tuition payments may be justified in some cases, with the Rijksuniversiteit Groningen receiving about 300,000 euro in cash in 2022.
It is therefore not desirable to make the obligations under the Wwft apply to universities.
Het is daarom niet wenselijk de verplichtingen uit de Wwft voor universiteiten te laten gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Kuik over het bericht “De meest gehate sites ter wereld, in de lucht via Flevoland”

MPs Bontenbal and Kuik asked whether Dutch hosting firms facilitate hate-speech and child-abuse websites such as 8kun and Daily Stormer, and what the government can do. The minister answers that hosts must act on known illegal content, that the ATKM will cover terrorist and child-abuse material while online hate speech remains outside its scope, and that an interdepartmental inventory on hate speech is underway.
There is no legal framework for supervising the content hosted in the Netherlands.
Er bestaat geen wettelijk kader voor toezicht op de content die in Nederland wordt gehost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘De meest gehate sites ter wereld, in de lucht via Flevoland’

An MP asked ministers whether illegal and far-right websites could be hosted via Dutch datacentres and what powers the government has to intervene. The ministers answered that hosts must act once informed of illegal content, that the government relies largely on self-regulation and forthcoming instruments (ATKM, DSA), and that they consider it undesirable for Dutch firms to serve botnet-linked parties.
The Dutch datacentre Serverius did not have to take any action itself for this.
Het Nederlandse datacenter Serverius heeft hiervoor zelf geen actie hoeven te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Mohandis over criminelen die schoolkinderen ronselen met snus

MPs Mutluer and Mohandis asked the Justice Minister and the Health State Secretary about criminals recruiting schoolchildren with snus, including police handling, enforcement against snus sales and planned awareness campaigns. The minister acknowledged the concern, cited a broad youth crime prevention programme, said no police figures on the phenomenon exist, and pointed to ongoing NVWA enforcement and a forthcoming decision on a snus ban.
The police registrations contain no concrete indications of criminals recruiting schoolchildren with snus.
In de registraties van de politie zijn geen concrete aanwijzingen gevonden voor criminelen die schoolkinderen ronselen met snus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over het verbieden van deepfake pornografie

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about banning deepfake pornography, including whether misuse of identity falls under criminal law and what measures are taken. The minister acknowledged the harm, said the law already covers making and distributing such material, and deferred the policy response on enforcement and a WODC recommendation to a later reaction, while noting platform takedown arrangements and a forthcoming letter on provider liability.
The cabinet response to the WODC report on regulating deepfakes will further address the criminal liability and criminal-law approach to deepfake sexual imagery.
In de kabinetsreactie op het rapport van het WODC over de regulering van deepfakes zal nader worden ingegaan op de strafbaarheid en strafrechtelijke aanpak van deepfake seksueel beeldmateriaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Mutluer over schulden bij publieke dienstverleners, waaronder politieagenten en andere ambtenaren

MPs Kuiken and Mutluer asked whether police officers and other civil servants in integrity-sensitive roles are screened for problematic debts, and what is being done given rising energy prices. The ministers confirm debt is a screening criterion for security clearances, describe monitoring of wage garnishments, and list existing support schemes (social funds, financial helplines, occupational social work) across police, central government, Defence and municipalities.
There is no central registration of problematic debts among civil servants as a whole.
Er is geen centrale registratie van problematische schulden onder overheidspersoneel als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik inzake het bericht ‘zelfs camera’s schrikken drugscriminelen niet af’

MP Kuik asked the Minister of Justice and Security about press reports that at least 25 Dutch nationals, including a 15-year-old, were arrested over shootings in Antwerp linked to drug crime, and about cooperation, a national drug coordinator and camera surveillance. The minister could not confirm the arrest figures, said cooperation with Belgium works well and is being strengthened, and described existing measures, including prevention, a sealing power for mayors and a broader anti-organised-crime approach.
No statements can be made about ongoing cases.
Er kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan met betrekking tot lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Sneller over de internationale aanpak van georganiseerde drugscriminaliteit en criminele geldstromen

Two MPs from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the international approach to organised drug crime and criminal money flows, including Dutch-Belgian cooperation, joint investigation teams, liaison officers, cannabis legalisation, and tackling criminal finances such as non-conviction based confiscation. The Minister answered in detail that cooperation is being intensified through existing structures and instruments, that the approach to criminal money flows is a priority, and that a bill on non-conviction based confiscation is in preparation, while declining to set up a new joint police and customs centre and to commit to cannabis legalisation at EU level.
I therefore see the criminal business model as an essential starting point for tackling organised crime.
Het crimineel verdienmodel zie ik dan ook als een essentieel aanknopingspunt voor de aanpak van georganiseerde criminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over het weglopen van tolken bij de politie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about interpreters leaving police work, unpaid invoices, quality concerns and the procurement reform of interpreting services, citing a newspaper report. The minister disputed the picture, said the new intermediary system is largely working, described monitoring and contract measures, and committed to follow-up on payments and quality without conceding structural failure.
Identified defects and shortcomings are taken up by the police contract management and, where necessary, discussed with the intermediary directly or during the fortnightly contract meeting.
Geconstateerde gebreken en onvolkomenheden worden opgepakt door het contractmanagement van de politie en zo nodig direct of tijdens het tweewekelijks contractoverleg besproken met de intermediair.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘NL-Alert tijdens storm te laat verstuurd, meldkamer bijna onbereikbaar’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why a NL-Alert during storm Eunice was sent about an hour late while the 112 emergency line was overloaded, and what will prevent this in future. The minister confirmed the delay (about 75 minutes in total against a 15-minute target), attributed it mainly to the request going to the LOCC instead of the NCC and to tailoring the message text, and said procedures are being improved and the NIPV recommendations are under consideration.
The target time for sending a NL-Alert is 15 minutes.
De streeftijd voor het verzenden van een NL-Alert bedraagt 15 minuten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het SBS6-programma Undercover in Nederland, waar afvalcoaches zonder enige gewetenswroeging misbruik maken van (minderjarige) anorexiapatiënten

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the government will investigate and protect minors with anorexia from exploitative 'pro-ana' coaches shown in an SBS6 broadcast, including possible sexual abuse and dangerous advice. The Minister says the issue is a priority, points to police investigation capacity, funding, prevention and help programmes, and existing criminal law, but commits to no new specific measures beyond ongoing and planned steps.
Ultimately it is up to the public prosecutor to decide in a specific case whether to prosecute, and then up to the judge to assess a pending case and determine any sentence.

Het is uiteindelijk aan de officier van justitie om in een specifieke zaak te bepalen of vervolging wordt ingesteld en vervolgens aan de rechter om een voorliggende zaak te beoordelen en de eventuele strafmaat te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de golf aan explosies en toename van (zelfgemaakte) explosieven

An MP asks the Justice Minister about the ease of buying explosive precursors, the rise in homemade explosives, and low arrest and conviction rates for explosive attacks. The minister says precursor rules apply and are being tightened with industry, a new awareness campaign is planned for early 2023, and it cannot verify the arrest and conviction figures because they are not recorded separately.
The police and Public Prosecution Service systems do not separately register this kind of information.
In de systemen van de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie wordt dit soort informatie niet apart geregistreerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Van Baarle over het artikel 'Rekenkamer waarschuwt voor mogelijke 'vooringenomenheid bij politie-algoritmes' en het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer hierover

MPs Mutluer and Van Baarle asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the Court of Audit's finding on possible bias in police algorithms, including whether the audit applied the right legal framework (AVG instead of Wpg), privacy risks of the CAS system, reliance on citizen reports, and risks of indirect discrimination. The Minister answered that the Wpg and AVG are not interchangeable, that the police judged a data protection impact assessment not mandatory but is pursuing an AI impact assessment, that CAS output is area-based and excludes ethnicity variables while residual bias risks are being studied, and that the police will share a table of deployment counts per speerpunt.

Nevertheless, the House of Representatives (for example via the Standing Committee on Digital Affairs) has the option of asking the Court of Audit to further reflect on the findings concerning the CAS algorithm.

Desalniettemin bestaat voor de Tweede Kamer (bijvoorbeeld via de Vaste commissie Digitale Zaken) de mogelijkheid de Algemene Rekenkamer te vragen nader te reflecteren op de bevindingen rondom het algoritme van het CAS
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten 'Miljoenen voor de schijn van daadkracht” en “Honderden miljoenen verdwenen in de strijd tegen georganiseerde misdaad'

An MP asks whether over 900 million euros allocated to fighting organised crime between 2017 and 2022 was spent on projects and task forces, whether police funding was reduced, how many officers that sum would buy, how trust of experts will be restored after the MIT was dropped, and whether its successor NSOC will succeed. The Minister confirms the amount (926 million), explains the broad approach and that police received over 500 million, argues extra officers alone would not solve the problem, describes consultation with experts and the NSOC's sharper focus, and says success is not guaranteed but will be monitored.
Yes, that is correct. From 2017 to 2022 a total of 926 million euros was made available for combating undermining crime
Ja, dat klopt. Van 2017 tot 2022 is in totaal 926 miljoen euro vrijgemaakt voor de bestrijding van ondermijnende criminaliteit
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het voornemen dat nu ook het Openbaar Ministerie in Den Haag wegens capaciteitsproblemen strafzaken wil schrappen

The SP MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister for a reaction to the Public Prosecution Service in The Hague dropping 53 criminal cases due to capacity problems, and why ancillary confiscation cases were included. The minister regrets the decision, says no other regions face this, explains the selection criteria (cases at least four years old, no direct victims, no serious violence or sex offences) and acknowledges the injustice of confiscation cases being dropped.
I have agreed with the College of Procurators-General that, should such a situation arise again, I will be informed in good time and in advance.
Ik heb met het College van Procureurs-generaal afgesproken dat ik, mocht een dergelijke situatie zich weer voordoen, tijdig en van tevoren wordt geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Helder over het bericht 'Slachtoffers moeten te lang wachten tot er wat gebeurt met hun aangifte'

MPs Markuszower and Helder asked the Minister of Justice about reports that victims wait too long for their complaints to be acted on, citing a shortage of public prosecutors, cases being dropped, and unanswered warnings from the prosecutors' union. The Minister answered that the government is providing structural extra funding and recruitment measures, that no registration exists on the number of unsolved or dismissed cases, and that the College of Procurators-General did respond to the union's letter.
No registration is kept of this; the registration system does not offer a way to do so.
Hiervan wordt geen registratie bijgehouden, het registratiesysteem biedt daarvoor geen mogelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Ellian en Bikker over het bericht 'Justitie Den Haag schrapt 53 zaken: Wietkwekers en drugsdealers ontlopen straf'

MPs Michon-Derkzen, Ellian and Bikker asked the Justice Minister about reports that the Den Haag public prosecution service had requested inadmissibility in 53 old drug-related cases, and whether this signals impunity and why cases were left pending. The minister called it a bad signal, explained the cases were mostly confiscation and older drug cases with no direct victims, that the prosecution service had discretion, and that backlog and capacity measures are underway.
The prosecution service cannot state what the sentencing demand in the cases would have been.
Het OM kan niet aangeven wat de strafeis in de zaken zou zijn geweest.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de te vormen Landelijke Eenheid opsporing in relatie tot de Nationale Samenwerking Ondermijnende Criminaliteit (NSOC) de opvolger van het Multidisciplinaire Interventieteam (MI

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the new national investigation unit (Landelijke Eenheid opsporing) relates to NSOC, the successor to the MIT, covering tasks, leadership, overlap, timing of plans and funding. The minister answered that the LE will be split into two units with tasks, steering and funding unchanged, that NSOC is a complementary cooperation rather than an investigative service, and gave the funding and operational results on request.
Once I have received the transition plan, I will ask the Schneiders committee to issue advice on it.
Zodra ik het transitieplan heb ontvangen, zal ik de commissie Schneiders vragen hierover een advies uit te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er een groot tekort aan officieren van justitie is

MPs Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister how she would respond to reports of a large shortage of public prosecutors, what the consequences are, whether the previous Rutte cabinets' policy caused it, what extra efforts will be made, how the new funding is allocated and when the shortage will be solved. The Minister acknowledged high workload and understaffing, cited a 2020 study attributing it to complexity, legislation and COVID backlogs, listed structural extra funding and recruitment measures, and gave no firm date for solving the shortage.
The College takes the necessary decisions, within existing possibilities, to achieve a responsible and phased expansion of the number of prosecutors.
Het College neemt – binnen de bestaande mogelijkheden – de nodige beslissingen om tot een verantwoorde en gefaseerde uitbreiding van het aantal officieren te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de investeringen tegen ondermijning

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that about 900 million euros spent against undermining crime (ondermijning) between 2017 and 2022 yielded little measurable result, and about the lack of a complete project list. The minister confirmed the 926 million total, explained the shift from incidental project funding to structural funding, admitted no definitive project list exists, and pointed to periodic progress letters for results.
I cannot provide a definitive list of all initiatives and projects financed with undermining funds.
Ik kan geen definitieve lijst verstrekken van alle initiatieven en projecten die met ondermijningsgelden zijn gefinancierd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over onthechtingsproblematiek bij uit Syrië teruggekeerde kinderen

An MP asked the government about the attachment problems of children returning from Syria who are separated from their mothers on arrival, citing a report on integration risks. The minister answered that separation is necessary for security given terrorism suspicions, describes the child protection observation, foster placement and limited mother-child contact arrangements, and says maintaining contact is the starting point within security limits.
The cabinet regards the children as victims who are not responsible for the actions of their parents.
Het kabinet ziet de kinderen als slachtoffers, die niet verantwoordelijk zijn voor het handelen van hun ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over een asielzoeker die 6 weken cel heeft gekregen voor het vernielen van 23 auto’s in Ter Apel

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Justice and Security why an Eritrean asylum seeker who smashed 23 cars in Ter Apel received only six weeks in prison, whether victims will be compensated, why he was not returned to Germany, and what measures will protect residents. The State Secretary declines to comment on the individual case, explains the general prosecution, compensation and VRIS procedures, and lists the nuisance-reduction measures and funding being pursued.
I will not make any further statements about the individual circumstances of this case.
Over de individuele omstandigheden van dit geval doe ik verder geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Segers over de bijeenkomst in Amsterdam waar David Icke zal spreken

MPs Ellian and Segers asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a planned Amsterdam event featuring David Icke, a known Holocaust denier, and what could be done to stop it. The Minister condemned antisemitism and Holocaust denial and urged the organisers to reconsider, noting that censorship is constitutionally barred while criminal speech can be prosecuted afterwards, and that IND was examining an entry ban.
I also support the municipality of Amsterdam in its request to the IND to investigate whether the person concerned can be denied entry to our country.
Ik steun ook de gemeente Amsterdam in de vraag aan de IND om te onderzoeken of betrokkene de toegang tot ons land kan worden geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Minhas over het bericht ‘ProRail dumpt Chinese bewakingscamera’s, de NS laat ze hangen’

MPs Rajkowski and Minhas asked the ministers about reports that NS was buying Chinese-made surveillance cameras for trains and stations and whether the government would restrict such procurement. The government answered that NS uses isolated networks and follows government advice, that concrete procurement criteria are not set in the concession, and that a government guideline and scan of vital infrastructure are being prepared.
As requested in the adopted motion 4 Rajkowski et al., the House will be informed before the Christmas recess about the requested guideline for the central government and its suppliers.
Zoals verzocht in de overgenomen motie 4 Rajkowski c.s. zal de Kamer nog voor het kerstreces geïnformeerd worden over de verzochte richtlijn voor de rijksoverheid en haar leveranciers
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht dat één op de vijf Rotterdamse jongeren een wapen heeft of wel eens draagt

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that one in five Rotterdam youths carries or has a weapon, asking about normalisation, trends, causes of insecurity and the knife-sales ban. The minister answered that weapon carrying is not normal, pointed to the Wapens en Jongeren action plan, police data showing stabilising stabbing suspect numbers, and an evaluation due in early 2023.
At the beginning of 2023 a decision will be taken on continuing the approach.
Begin 2023 wordt er een besluit genomen over de voortzetting van de aanpak.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Wassenberg en Sylvana Simons over het volbouwen van de kust, zonder vergunningen op Bonaire, met bedreiging van het koraal tot gevolg, met actieve medewerking van de hoogste geza

MPs from PvdD and BIJ1 asked whether the appointed governor of Bonaire facilitated coastal construction without permits, threatening coral, and how enforcement and permitting are being strengthened. The government answered that the island council and executive are responsible for investigating, that it is reviewing staffing and rules (including a new environmental regulation), that the Inspectorate will audit permitting and enforcement, and that it has made arrangements to monitor implementation.
I have now asked the Inspectorate for Environment and Transport (ILT) to carry out an audit of permitting, supervision and enforcement.
Ik heb de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) inmiddels gevraagd om een onderzoek (visitatie) te laten uitvoeren op het gebied van vergunningsverlening, toezicht en handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat politie en NFI de grote golf van explosies nauwelijks aankunnen

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police and the NFI struggle to handle the surge in explosions and ram raids, causing investigations to stall, and what the government will do about capacity and funding. The minister acknowledges capacity pressure, argues investigations are not delayed in a harmful way, points to structural extra funding, an annual service level agreement and possible use of other providers, but does not commit to a specific new capacity study.
To reduce pressure on the forensic chain, I have structurally allocated money, in an annual increasing financial series, to make it more robust.
Om de druk op de forensische keten te verminderen heb ik (in een jaarlijks oplopende financiële reeks) structureel geld vrijgemaakt om deze robuuster te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Opsporing komt in gevaar door disfunctioneren tapkamer politie’

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the police wiretap system is malfunctioning, endangering investigations, and about the Elbit contract, the discontinued Fox-IT Replay system, and the risk of having no backup. The minister acknowledged recurring disruptions and an end-of-life system being replaced, said no cases of endangered safety were known, defended the procurement, and gave a contract-continuity assurance.
