Replay was already operationally phased out several years ago because telecom providers switched to another standard and this functionality is included in the current system.
Replay is enkele jaren geleden al operationeel uitgefaseerd omdat telecomaanbieders zijn overgegaan op een andere standaard en deze functionaliteit in het huidige systeem is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het gebruik van een Israëlisch tapsysteem door de afdeling Interceptie & Sensing

An MP asks the Justice Minister about the police wiretap system supplied by Israeli firm Elbit, including its malfunctioning, undisclosed use of a Fox-IT system, staff access, espionage risks and links to controversial exports. The minister answers that the contract stays, stresses security safeguards and denies undisclosed Dutch-company use or staff presence at the Driebergen facility.
Terminating the contract would also lead to very large delays in delivering the new wiretap system.
Het opzeggen van het contract zou ook tot zeer grote vertraging leiden bij de oplevering van het nieuwe tapsysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht dat leden van de zogenoemde Mocro-Maffia vanuit de gevangenis nieuwe misdrijven voorbereiden

An MP asked whether authorities fear that imprisoned leaders of the Mocro-maffia still prepare crimes from detention, and what has been done to stop this. The minister confirms the concern, says current measures are insufficient for a specific group, and announces stricter EBI detention regime and new legislation, while declining to discuss specific investigations.
I cannot go into any criminal investigations or the indications underlying them at this moment.
Op eventuele strafrechtelijke onderzoeken en aanwijzingen die daaraan ten grondslag liggen kan ik op dit moment niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Amalia in vizier Mocro-maffia’

MP Kuik (CDA) asked the Justice Minister how the government will respond to reported threats from criminal networks inside high-security detention, including contact between top criminals in the EBI and Italy's 41bis model. Minister Weerwind answers that the government is taking strong measures: a bill to impose individual restrictions on the most dangerous detainees is due in Q1 2023, EBI call and visit limits are being tightened, and a second EBI is being built, though he does not address the Italian ruling in depth.

That is why I am currently working urgently on a bill that would allow me to impose stronger and further restrictions on the most serious criminals on an individual level than is currently possible under the Penitentiary Principles Act.

Daarom werk ik momenteel met spoed aan een wetsvoorstel waarmee ik aan de meest zware criminelen op individueel niveau sterkere en nog verdergaande beperkingen kan opleggen dan nu onder Penitentiaire beginselenwet mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Opsporing komt in gevaar door disfunctioneren tapkamer politie’

PVV MPs Helder and Wilders asked the Justice Minister about reports that the police wiretap system is outdated, frequently fails, and endangers investigations, plus related questions on camera systems, staff complaints and a 2022 procurement. The minister answered that the new system is being implemented gradually, that the old system still functions adequately, that no known investigation or safety incident was harmed by outages, and that the procurement was fair.
It is correct that the new wiretap system the police acquired in 2019 is still being implemented.
Het klopt dat het nieuwe tapsysteem voor de politie dat in 2019 is aangeschaft op dit moment nog wordt geïmplementeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het Stelsel Beroepsziekten en Dienstongevallen Politie

MP Van der Plas asks whether offsetting earlier smartengeld (pain-and-suffering damages) against material residual damages for police officers with PTSS is consistent with the Helder motion and CARAP advice, and whether the minister will correct cases already affected. The minister defends the offset as part of a generous, interim settlement approach, notes CARAP advice is followed except in two cases, and says the questions could not each be answered separately.
Because the advice contains privacy-sensitive information about those involved, the minister is only informed in outline by the competent authority.
Omdat de adviezen privacygevoelige informatie bevatten over de betrokkenen word ik als Minister door het bevoegd gezag op hoofdlijnen geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Onwel geworden arrestant Borne overleden’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the death of a man who became unwell during arrest and transport in Borne, including the police conduct, use of force, and the Rijksrecherche investigation. The minister confirmed the death and the standard investigation, but declined to answer most detailed questions individually because the case is under investigation, while describing disciplinary statistics and the national sentencing consultation body.
Anticipating the conclusions of the investigation, I cannot go into the substance of this specific case, and for that reason I cannot answer questions 3 to 14 and 16 to 26 individually.
Vooruitlopend op de conclusies van het onderzoek kan ik niet inhoudelijk ingaan op deze specifieke zaak, de vragen 3 t/m 14 en 16 t/m 26 kan ik om die reden niet individueel beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Zedenrecherche ondanks miljoenen nauwelijks opgeschaald’

A VVD MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that sex-crimes investigation units were barely expanded despite millions in funding, including staffing numbers, regional waiting-time differences, and the financial costs of the new sexual offences law. The minister answered in detail: about 87% of the planned 113 FTE expansion has been realised, a new cost projection is provided, and a chain-wide plan to shorten waiting times is expected by end 2022.
Of the total planned staff increase of 113 FTE, 98.7 FTE has been realised, which is 87%.
Van de in totaal voorziene formatie-ophoging van 113 fte is 98,7 fte gerealiseerd, dat is 87%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Agema over het bericht ‘Gespecialiseerde arrestatieteams politie hebben handen vol aan verwarde personen’

MPs Helder and Agema asked the Justice and Security Minister about rising police incidents involving confused persons, the workload of specialised arrest teams, and whether care rather than police should handle them, including questions on street triage, the Eindhoven pilot, bed capacity and dementia shares. The government answered that police intervention is sometimes necessary, that E33 registrations are not suited to steering information, that care is not a police core task, and that it will strengthen police-care-social domain cooperation, with a regional dashboard and an analysis of E33 data promised.
To gain more insight into the problem, Justice and Security and the police are currently working together on an analysis of the E-33 reports.
Om meer inzicht te krijgen in de problematiek, werken JenV en de politie momenteel samen aan een analyse van de E-33-meldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over de bijdrage van de stichting Femmes for Freedom aan  emancipatie van meisjes en vrouwen met een biculturele achtergrond

MP Palland asked the ministers whether the 2020 Peters motion on a lasting role for Femmes for Freedom in the theme of self-determination had been carried out, and what concrete arrangements had been made. The minister answers that the foundation is a durable partner for the government on inclusion and emancipation, lists its involvement in consultations, awareness material, a bill on marital captivity and a funded alliance, while noting other parties may also apply for subsidies.
The Foundation Femmes for Freedom is a durable discussion partner of the national government on issues of inclusion and emancipation of girls and women with a bicultural background.

De Stichting Femmes for Freedom is een duurzame gesprekspartner van de rijksoverheid waar het gaat om vraagstukken op het gebied van inclusie en emancipatie van meisjes en vrouwen met een biculturele achtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over content op websites

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how often police contacted companies such as Twitter about criminal or terms-violating content, which companies were approached, how Twitter responded, and related questions. The minister answered that police do not contact companies to have accounts removed, may notify companies in self-regulation (leaving assessment to the company), that police keep no records retrievable in the requested form, and that police have no task to inform companies about terms violations.
The police do not record these kinds of reports in such a way that the requested information can be retrieved from police systems.
De politie registreert dit soort meldingen niet op zodanige wijze dat de gevraagde informatie uit de politiesystemen kan worden gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het uitblijven van de verkenning naar het gebruik maken van genealogische databanken bij het oplossen van cold case zaken

The MP Ellian asked why the promised exploration of using genealogical DNA databases to solve cold cases had not been shared with the House, and what prevents a small pilot. The Minister replies that the exploration found no technical obstacles but no clear legal basis and no evidence yet of added value in the Dutch context, and that the Public Prosecution Service will report by spring 2023.
The conclusion of my department and that of BZK, however, is that it cannot currently be well defended that there is an adequate legal basis for such an investigation.
De conclusie van mijn departement en dat van BZK is echter dat het op dit moment niet goed verdedigbaar is dat er een afdoende juridische grondslag is voor een dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘onderhandse financiering van vakantiewoningen baart experts zorgen’

SP MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked ministers about reports that private, non-bank mortgage financing of holiday parks and homes raises money-laundering and undermining risks, and about regulation of park takeovers and oversight of gatekeepers. The government answered that such financing can be a risk indicator, that the Actie-agenda vakantieparken and existing Wwft and FIU measures apply, that no regulation of individual transactions is planned, and that it will report the results of the Actie-agenda and a banks/gatekeeper dialogue later.
It is important that all parties that may have insight into this are alert to it in performing their tasks.
Het is belangrijk dat alle betrokken partijen die hierop zicht kunnen hebben, daar alert op zijn bij de uitoefening van hun taken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Markuszower over het bericht ‘Asielchaos zet politie klem’

Two PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister why Amsterdam police must release 10% of their AVIM capacity to asylum identification backlogs, how this affects human trafficking work and public safety, and why the borders are not closed to halt asylum inflow. The minister answered that the reallocation is temporary and may affect other AVIM tasks while trafficking work is protected, and that closing borders is not a sustainable solution, pointing instead to measures such as a national coordinator on nuisance and extra funding.
This may indeed affect AVIM's other work, such as supervision and enforcement tasks under the Aliens Act and participation in various consultation groups.
Dit kan inderdaad invloed hebben op de overige werkzaamheden van AVIM, zoals de toezicht- en handhavingstaken in het kader van de Vreemdelingenwet en deelname in verschillende overleggroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over criminele asielzoekers uit veilige landen

Eerdmans (JA21) asked the State Secretary and Minister of Justice and Security about criminal asylum seekers from safe countries causing nuisance and crime in Amsterdam, and about measures such as detention, returns, and cooperation with countries of origin. The government answered at length, giving incident statistics, stating that police do not register specifically on this group, describing new nuisance-coordination and return measures, and saying detention during the asylum procedure is being explored more broadly while detention is limited by legal conditions.
This cannot be provided. The police do not register specifically on safe-country nationals.
Deze is niet te geven. De politie registreert niet specifiek op veiligelanders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Sneller over het onbenut laten van Bibob-toetsing bij subsidieverlening

MPs Sneller and Michon-Derkzen asked why national ministries, notably RVO and Uitvoering van Beleid SZW, rarely apply the Bibob integrity test when granting subsidies. The minister answers that the test is discretionary, that ministries are in talks to increase its use, that RVO and UVB rely on other controls, and promises an update by the first quarter of 2023.
The Ministry of Justice and Security is engaging with various departments to stimulate the use of the Bibob Act within central government.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid (JenV) gaat met verschillende departementen in gesprek om het gebruik van de Wet Bibob bij de rijksoverheid te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat advocatenkantoor Houthoff nog steeds zaken doet met Russische klanten

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether law firm Houthoff still serves Russian clients despite sanctions, whether the Amsterdam dean (a partner at Nauta-Dutilh) can independently oversee it, what the investigation into Houthoff found, and when legal aid to Russian clients is exempt from sanctions. The minister answered that legal aid is permitted for non-sanctioned Russian clients, that aid necessary for litigation to a sanctioned party is exempt from the prohibition under a line still awaiting European Commission confirmation, that the dean's conflict of interest is addressed by a professional statute and planned reforms creating a national supervisory authority, and declined to detail the internal investigation citing confidentiality.
As I indicated in answer to earlier parliamentary questions, given the special position of the legal profession in our society, supervision of lawyers takes place independently of the government.

Antwoord 3 Zoals ik in antwoord op eerdere Kamervragen 6 heb aangeven vindt, gelet op de bijzondere positie van de advocatuur in onze samenleving, het toezicht op advocaten onafhankelijk van de overheid plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het direct of indirect volgen van politiek geëngageerde burgers op de social media en het mogelijk plegen van censuur

MP Van Haga asked ministers whether government monitors politically engaged citizens on social media, coordinates counter-disinformation with platforms, and whether a police home visit and a later account removal involved state interference. The government answered that platform contacts concern how platforms tackle disinformation with no formal minutes, that no structural policy targets citizens' posts, and that it cannot discuss individual cases such as the Enschede visit.
As indicated in the answer to question 13, individual cases cannot be discussed.
Zoals aangegeven bij het antwoord op vraag 13 kan er niet worden ingegaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over paspoortwalhalla voor topcriminelen

An MP asked the ministers about reports that Dutch municipal officials, including one in The Hague, helped criminals obtain false identities by issuing passports, and about why the official stayed employed for years after an integrity investigation. The state secretary answered that RvIG has engaged The Hague and that the municipality handled personnel sanctions itself, and pointed to a July letter listing measures against identity fraud and a forthcoming RvIG inquiry into procedural deviations.
I want to state up front that the municipality of The Hague is responsible for its own personnel policy.
Ik wil voorop stellen dat de gemeente Den Haag over haar eigen persoonsbeleid gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Michon-Derkzen over de brief ‘Aankondiging van maatregelen ter voorkoming identiteitsfraude’

MPs Rajkowski and Michon-Derkzen asked how many officials issued fraudulent identity documents, whether criminal proceedings exist, which municipalities are involved, and what follow-up is planned for affected citizens and personnel integrity. The government says dozens of cases are known, ongoing criminal investigations cannot be detailed, the RvIG will examine procedural deviations with results expected by year end, and it will promote integrity checks and a possible certification register while noting municipalities hold personnel powers.
I cannot provide further information about these investigations.
Over deze onderzoeken kan ik geen nadere informatie verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de justitiële samenwerking tussen Nederland en India niet goed verloopt

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether she was aware that Dutch authorities get no cooperation from India despite knowing where suspects are, what efforts have been made to improve judicial cooperation, whether she will invest in a new treaty like Belgium's, and whether the Dutch justice chain uses liaison officers in India. The Minister confirmed awareness, said cooperation is continually reviewed and intensification is being explored with Indian authorities, and stated that the integral assessment has not yet led to placing a police liaison in India.
At this moment the possibilities for this are being explored with the Indian authorities.
Op dit moment worden de mogelijkheden daartoe met de Indiase autoriteiten verkend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het SBS-programma Undercover in Nederland

Van Haga asked the Justice Minister about a convicted sex offender who allegedly abused new victims while awaiting appeal, about controls on masseurs who massage children, and about a petition calling for better monitoring of sex offenders. The Minister declined to comment on the ongoing case, said existing criminal law and supervision tools are sufficient, explained the limited IGJ oversight of masseurs, and rejected new measures for now.
However, I cannot interfere in ongoing criminal cases.
Ik kan mij echter niet in lopende strafzaken mengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘NIST kiest wapens tegen kwantumcomputer als cryptokraker’

An MP asked the ministers whether quantum computers threaten secure communication and state and business secrets, what concrete preparations the government is making, and how it is investing in quantum technology. The state secretary agreed the risk is real, described migration to quantum-safe systems, national investments and European participation, and stated the government will publish guidance and coordinate a migration plan.
For the central government and sub-national governments, but also for the private sector, this means they will have to migrate to quantum-safe systems and technologies.
Voor de rijksoverheid en medeoverheden, maar ook voor de private sector, betekent dit dat zij zullen moeten migreren naar kwantumveilige systemen en technologieën.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de opvangcrisis in Nederland

MP Simons asked the government about the reception crisis for asylum seekers, including IND delays, COA capacity shortages, municipalities withholding places, a College voor de Rechten van de Mens finding of discrimination, and calls for emergency legislation. The State Secretary acknowledged the crisis, cited multiple causes and planned measures, and said a bill obliging municipalities to provide reception is in preparation, with a consultation draft targeted for 1 October 2022 and a long-term strategy being updated.
I am currently working on legislation that gives municipalities the formal task of making reception places available to COA.
Ik ben momenteel bezig met het maken van wetgeving die gemeenten de formele taak geeft om opvangplekken beschikbaar te stellen aan het COA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Mutluer over de indexatie van verkeersboetes

MPs Mutluer and Kathmann asked whether the government will index traffic fines to inflation during a cost-of-living crisis and whether it will exempt them, and how many fines were imposed, unpaid, or led to debt. The Minister of Justice and Security replied that fines are indexed annually to correct for price erosion, that the government will address inflation impacts through other means, and that a review of the indexation method is planned.
I have instructed my department to review the long-standing system for indexing Wahv fines based on inflation.
Wel heb ik mijn departement opdracht gegeven om de reeds lang bestaande systematiek voor de indexering van Wahv-boetes gebaseerd op de inflatie tegen het licht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘Minister wil verkeersboetes ook nu laten meestijgen met inflatie’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why traffic fines should be indexed to inflation amid the economic crisis, whether there is any obligation to index them, and whether fines improve road safety. The Minister defended annual indexation to preserve the deterrent weight of fines, admitted no legal obligation exists, and pointed to enforcement measures and a review of the indexation method.
I have, however, instructed my department to review the long-standing system of indexing Wahv fines based on inflation.
Wel heb ik mijn departement opdracht gegeven om de reeds lang bestaande systematiek voor de indexering van Wahv-boetes gebaseerd op de inflatie tegen het licht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over vandalisme bij het Leidse Indië-monument en oproep tot beeldenstorm

Van Haga asks the Justice Minister whether vandalism and calls for an iconoclastic 'beeldenstorm' at Leiden's Indies monument are punishable, whether such groups like Doorbraak could be banned, and how monuments and street names will be protected and offenders tackled. The Minister says existing law (art. 350 and 131 Sr, art. 2:20 BW) suffices, that prosecution depends on circumstances and the Public Prosecution Service, that protecting monuments is a local authority responsibility, and refers back to the answer on question 2 for the rest.
It is up to the Public Prosecution Service to start any investigation into a possible ban on the type of organisations referred to in the question.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om een eventueel onderzoek te starten naar een mogelijk verbod op het in de vraag aangehaalde type organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Ginneken over de hoorplicht bij beroepen tegen verkeersboetes

MPs Sneller and Van Ginneken asked whether the Public Prosecution Service (OM) has failed for years to inform traffic-fine objectors of their right to be heard, whether it wrongly dismissed appeals as manifestly unfounded, and how the appeal threshold increase affects citizens' protection. The minister acknowledged the OM did not actively communicate the hearing right, said talks are underway to restore it, disputed the 90% manifestly-unfounded figure (1.9% actually), and defended the appeal-threshold rise as restoring the legislator's original intent.
The OM reports that persons who themselves indicated they wish to be heard are in fact heard.
Het OM meldt dat betrokkenen die zelf hebben aangegeven gehoord te willen worden, ook daadwerkelijk zijn gehoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het bericht dat de politie onnodig data van burgers opspaart

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the police unlawfully and disproportionately retain citizens' data through automatic BRP afnemersindicaties, and whether a new policy and timeline will end this. The Minister answers that these indications only keep existing data current, that a 2020 police policy framework limits them to five categories, and that she will not order a separate investigation, while noting system adjustments are still pending.
Supervision of general compliance with the Police Data Act is assigned to the Dutch Data Protection Authority, or in the specific case of a criminal investigation to the judge.

Het toezicht op het, in algemene zin, naleven van de Wet politiegegevens is belegd bij de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens dan wel, in het specifieke geval van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek, bij de rechter.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Omtzigt over het nieuws dat de National Health Service (NHS) Tavistock kliniek, de enige genderidentiteitskliniek voor kinderen en jongeren in het Verenigd Koninkrijk, heef

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Omtzigt asked the government about the closure of the Tavistock gender identity clinic in the UK, how Dutch gender care for minors compares, whether rising referrals occur in the Netherlands, and whether the planned legal change to the gender entry in birth records (Transgenderwet) should be paused. The Minister answered that the Dutch approach is multidisciplinary and not affirmative in the Cass-review sense, that referral numbers rose 183% since 2018 with causes still under study, and that he sees no reason to pause the bill, since a judicial review protects children under sixteen.
I see no reason to pause the handling of bill 35 825.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel 35 825 aan te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het OM dat draalt met de vervolging van mensen die mij met de dood bedreigen

Wilders asks why the OM has not decided on prosecution in several long-running death threat cases from Pakistan and hundreds of other threats against him, whether such threats should be prosecuted, and when a promised letter on protecting threatened politicians will come. The minister answers that threats against politicians are unacceptable and the OM assesses each report, but gives no substantive information on individual cases, referring to the OM, and says a letter on measures will follow shortly.
Regarding individual cases, I cannot, as is known, provide any substantive information.
Over individuele zaken kan ik verder, zoals bekend, geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het bericht 'Advies: stop met de crisisaanpak van asielzoekers, creëer meer buffercapaciteit aan opvangplekken'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about advice to stop the crisis approach to asylum reception and build buffer capacity, and about the government's asylum reception policy, funding, municipal role, staffing and crisis organisation. The State Secretary answered at length, acknowledging strain on reception quality, outlining plans for a stable and flexible reception system and a planned legal municipal task, but giving only general answers on several points and deferring details to later letters.
The government's efforts to realise a stable and flexible reception landscape bear this out.
De inzet van het kabinet om een stabiel en flexibel opvanglandschap te realiseren, getuigt hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over de gevaren die boeren op snelwegen veroorzaken

An MP asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about dangers caused by farmers blocking motorways during a June 2022 protest and why police did not enforce more strictly, including how many fines and arrests occurred. The minister acknowledged accidents and dangers, explained police discretion and that offences are pursued afterwards, reported roughly 700 extra fines and over a hundred arrests, and set out advisory principles for local authorities, while admitting Rijkswaterstaat and police do not track the number of tractors or drivers involved.
Rijkswaterstaat does not have a system in place to collect that information.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft namelijk geen systeem waarmee die informatie wordt verzameld.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de NPO Radio 1-uitzending van Argos op zaterdag 11 juni 2022: 'Een onzichtbare muur' en het delen van persoonsgegevens met buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten

The MP asks about an Argos radio report on people wrongly placed on foreign and Dutch terrorism-related lists, the sharing of personal data with foreign intelligence services, and the NCTV's internet monitoring weekly reports on citizens. The Minister answers that wrongly listed people can seek help and that Dutch services share data only under the Wiv 2017 with oversight, while declining to comment on individual cases and conceding that NCTV monitoring of citizens went wrong and will not return in that form.

I am of the view, as I have stated earlier, that when the NCTV analyses or interprets developments, these analyses or interpretations must be factual in nature and aimed at developments relevant to national security.

Ik ben van mening, zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven, dat als de NCTV ontwikkelingen analyseert of duidt, deze analyses of duidingen feitelijk van aard moeten zijn en gericht op relevante ontwikkelingen voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Drugs per post neemt vlucht: 'Overal ter wereld meer dancefeesten''

An MP asks the Justice Minister about the rising number of drug-containing postal parcels, the legal framework for intercepting them, the role of the police Post Interventie Team versus customs, and cooperation with postal firms and foreign partners. The minister explains customs has intensified post controls, outlines the legal powers, announces a joint police-customs postal team starting this year, and describes ongoing barrier-model and cooperation work.
The postal team will not receive independent powers or tasks but will become a platform for cooperation between police and customs to strengthen investigations.
Het postteam zal geen eigenstandige bevoegdheden of taken krijgen maar wordt een platform waarbinnen wordt samengewerkt tussen politie en douane om de opsporing te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Drugs per post neemt vlucht: 'Overal ter wereld meer dancefeesten'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Slootweg asked about a report that drug shipments by post were rising sharply and about customs seizures, staff safety, and cooperation with the US and other countries. The government answered that seizures rose from 4,080 in the first half of 2021 to nearly 13,500 in the first half of 2022, attributed partly to increased customs inspection capacity, described safety measures for postal staff, and said cooperation with the US, Australia and New Zealand is intensive, with a joint postal team planned.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Grote zorgen om jihadisten die in Nederland blijven terwijl paspoort is afgepakt’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that convicted IS terrorists whose Dutch nationality was revoked remain in the Netherlands, and about enforcement, monitoring and reporting duties. The minister answered that of 21 revocations under Article 14(2), only 5 persons have left, mostly due to missing travel documents or non-cooperation, that removal is pursued via detention, reporting duties and possible prosecution, and that the NCTV's coordination role is currently hampered by missing legal basis.
The NCTV cannot currently carry out this task.
Deze taak kan de NCTV momenteel niet uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de grote zorgen om jihadisten die in Nederland blijven terwijl het paspoort is afgepakt

MP Van Nispen asks whether withdrawing the Dutch nationality of convicted jihadists, who may then remain in the Netherlands unmonitored, weakens oversight and public safety, and what the government will do about warnings from the NCTV, municipal mayors and probation services. The minister acknowledges reduced oversight after withdrawal, describes return efforts, monitoring by AVIM and the AIVD, and an ongoing WODC evaluation of counter-terrorism measures, but gives no major new commitments.

In response to the outcomes of this research, the predecessors acknowledged in their letter of 25 June 2020 the dilemma that oversight and room to act regarding those concerned diminish when Dutch nationality has been withdrawn but the persons have not yet left the Netherlands.

Mede als reactie op de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek is door onze voorgangers in de brief van 25 juni 2020 het dilemma onderkend dat het zicht en handelingsperspectief op de betrokkenen verminderen wanneer het Nederlanderschap is ingetrokken, maar betrokkenen nog niet uit Nederland zijn vertrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over de aanpak van illegale boerenacties

An MP asked the Justice Minister how police handle illegal farmer protests, including tractors on motorways without plates and whether offenders are traced afterwards. The minister answered that the law applies equally, set out advisory principles for local authorities, and reported about 700 traffic fines and over a hundred arrests linked to the protests, while stating police cannot separately count protest-related cases.
The police systems have no separate label for farmer protests or for offences involving agricultural vehicles.
In de politiesystemen bestaat geen apart label voor boerenprotesten of voor overtredingen met landbouwvoertuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht Drie doden en drie zwaargewonden bij schietpartij in Kopenhagen’

The MP asks about a shooting in Copenhagen, whether a lone-wolf radicalised attacker is possible in the Netherlands, whether services have enough capacity, and how the NCTV's suspended analysis work affects threat assessment and EU information exchange. The minister answers that the Danish case is not treated as terrorism, that the NCTV's analysis is limited pending a bill on processing personal data, and that EU information exchange is only partly affected.
The suspension of the analysis tasks does affect knowledge and information exchange with EU partners.
Het is wel zo dat de opschorting van de analyse taken gevolgen heeft voor kennis- en informatie-uitwisseling met EU-partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Beckerman over vakantieparken die mogelijk misbruikt worden door criminelen om hun geld wit te wassen

Two MPs from the SP asked ministers about holiday parks possibly misused by criminals for money laundering, including the role of municipalities, BIBOB screening and intimidation of officials. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the problem is known, that an interdepartmental action agenda and guidance exist, that a Kadaster registration change is being evaluated, and that no mandatory BIBOB screening will be imposed, leaving this to municipalities' discretion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt inzake Centric en de mogelijkheid en wenselijkheid een enquête te houden

Omtzigt asked whether the government is aware of the resignation of Centric's board after a conflict with its owner, the planned Ondernemingskamer action over mismanagement, and DNB's departure from Centric, and whether there are public-interest grounds for an enquiry (enquête) that the Advocate-General could order. The minister confirms awareness, notes DNB is re-tendering and temporarily continues using Centric, and says the OM has started a preliminary investigation into whether to request an enquiry, without pre-empting its outcome.
The OM was already aware of signals of ongoing unrest within the company and has started a preliminary investigation to assess whether a request will be made to the Enterprise Chamber.

Het OM was al bekend met de signalen over aanhoudende onrust binnen de onderneming en is een verkennend onderzoek gestart teneinde te beoordelen of een verzoek bij de Ondernemingskamer zal worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Politie: Schietpartij gayclub Oslo was islamitische terreurdaad’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the Oslo gay-club shooting, the LHBTI community's security in the Netherlands, the AIVD's view of jihadist sympathisers, the NCTV's withdrawal from local case consultations, and information exchange with Europol. The minister described the Oslo attack and suspect, said there are currently no concrete signals of heightened risk to LHBTIQ+ people in the Netherlands, and explained that legal limits on personal data currently restrict NCTV's coordination role.
As long as the NCTV cannot or may not process personal data for these analysis and coordination tasks, the NCTV is unable to fulfil all its responsibilities for national security.

Zolang de NCTV voor de uitvoering van deze analyse- en coördinatietaken geen persoonsgegevens kan of mag verwerken is de NCTV niet in staat om al zijn verantwoordelijkheden ten behoeve van de nationale veiligheid waar te kunnen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de verschillen in handhaving bij boerenprotesten en klimaatdemonstraties

An MP asked whether police enforcement differed between farmer protests and climate demonstrations and whether this unequal treatment is desirable. The Minister acknowledged differences but argued circumstances differ, that the law applies equally, and that enforcement is a local matter, offering statistics on fines and arrests without committing to new action.
It is indeed not for me as Minister to step into the responsibility of local authorities.
Het is inderdaad niet aan mij als Minister om in de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal gezag te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het handelen van de politie tijdens de demonstratie van Extinction Rebellion bij het kantoor van de Belastingdienst in Den Haag

Sylvana Simons (BIJ1) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police conduct at a peaceful Extinction Rebellion sit-in at the Belastingdienst in The Hague, including forceful removal, a closed van with dangerous heat, and unequal treatment compared with farmers' protests. The Minister defended the police as acting on the mayor's authority and under the law, declined to comment on pending complaints, rejected an apology, and said courts and other authorities should judge the force used.
It is not for me but for other authorities – and where appropriate for the court – to judge the force used by the police.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan andere autoriteiten – en in voorkomende gevallen aan de rechter – om te oordelen over het geweld dat door de politie is gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het geweld tegen Hindoes in Bangladesh en India

Wilders (PVV) asks the government about violent attacks on Hindus in Bangladesh and India, including the killing of a tailor who supported Nupur Sharma, and about threats against himself, and whether it will condemn the violence and press both governments on protection. The minister condemns all violence against religious minorities, says Dutch policy raises the issue through bilateral and EU human rights dialogue, and notes that the perpetrators are being prosecuted and that the threats from Pakistan are raised with its authorities.
The cabinet firmly condemns all forms of violence against religious minorities and monitors global developments on this, including in Bangladesh.
Het kabinet keurt iedere vorm van geweld tegen religieuze minderheden nadrukkelijk af en monitort de wereldwijde ontwikkelingen hieromtrent, zo ook in Bangladesh.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de Kamerbrief Versterking VTH-stelsel.

An MP asked why the interbestuurlijk programma VTH (IBP VTH) was sent to the Chamber late, why environmental service boundaries are not aligned with safety regions, and how the Van Aartsen recommendations on environmental crime, enforcement capacity, uniform enforcement policy and independence of enforcement bodies are being followed up. The government answered that the programme was delayed by the pre-recess workload, that alignment with safety regions is a stated aim being examined under pillar 1, and that the recommendations are being worked out in pillars 1 to 5 with progress reports twice a year.
As indicated in the programme plan, this recommendation is also being taken up.
Zoals in het programmaplan aangegeven, wordt ook deze aanbeveling opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het rapport Drugs de Baas d.d. 23 juni 2022, Denktank: drugsmisdaad wel te bestrijden, reguleer xtc en onderschep de coke d.d. 22 juni 2022

An MP (Sneller, D66) asked the Justice, Health and Finance ministers about the DenkWerk report 'Drugs de baas', covering the cocaine interception rate, the profitability of Dutch drug wholesale, regulation of ecstasy and MDMA, and port-focused enforcement. The Minister answered that the government did not commission the report, that ecstasy and MDMA cannot be legalised due to international treaties, that the interception percentage is not tracked while seizures in kilos are, and that a plan of action on logistics hubs will be sent to the Chamber by end 2022.
Customs further indicates that its reports are based on established data and recorded facts.
De Douane geeft daarnaast aan dat zij in de rapportages uitgaat van vaststaande gegevens en geconstateerde feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Erkens over het artikel 'Hacker ontdekt dat Chinese zonnepanelen een bedreiging zijn voor ons stroomnet'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a report that Chinese solar inverters could threaten the electricity grid, and about dependence on foreign technology in vital infrastructure. The government answered that it shares concerns about state-actor cyber threats, points to existing and planned EU and national rules (NIS, RED, Cyber Resilience Act, Netcode on Cybersecurity, Vifo screening), and promises a scan of foreign-origin equipment in vital infrastructure in response to a motion, with timing still under exploration.
At present the Ministry of Justice and Security, together with the departments concerned, is exploring how to follow up on the motion.
Op dit moment wordt door het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, in samenwerking met de betrokken departementen, verkend op welke manier opvolging kan worden gegeven aan de motie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Nispen en Leijten over racisme en geweld bij de politie en een incompleet dossier

SP MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Justice Minister about racism and police violence in Rotterdam and a court ruling that the prosecution's file was incomplete, leading to inadmissibility. The minister declined to comment on the pending case, described the internal disciplinary outcome and criminal proceedings, and promised stricter sanctioning of discrimination and a forthcoming update to parliament.
I cannot go into individual cases that are before the court.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken die onder de rechter zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Mutluer over het bericht Prijsexplosie GHB vanwege oorlog in Oekraïne, verslaafden stoppen met de drug

MPs Bikker and Mutluer asked whether the government will expand outreach and addiction care for GHB users after reports of a price spike that could push users to stop abruptly or switch to other drugs. The State Secretary answered that substitution is undesirable, pointed to existing addiction-care initiatives, online information and monitoring, and to the government's drug-prevention and organised-crime policy, without committing to new concrete steps.
Given the concern raised by Novadic-Kentron, we remain alert to signals that give cause for intervention.
Gelet op de vrees van Novadic-Kentron blijven we alert op signalen die aanleiding geven tot ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de toename van het aantal plofkraken

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether she would act against the rise in explosive ATM robberies, including tougher sentences and alternative security measures such as relocating ATMs inside buildings. The minister replied that prosecution guidelines were tightened in 2018 with higher sentence demands, and that measures agreed with municipalities and banks in 2019-2020 have reduced incidents, with monitoring continuing.
The picture for 2022 is for now that the decline is continuing.
Het beeld van 2022 is vooralsnog dat de daling wordt voortgezet
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over het bericht: ‘Woede over autobranden in Eindhoven’

Two PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister about car arsons in Eindhoven, including cars parked against homes, whether this constitutes terrorism and whether Extinction Rebellion should be listed as a terrorist organisation. The Minister said the matter is for police and prosecutors, that no reliable count of offences linked to the group is possible, that the NCTV definition of terrorism is adopted, and that Extinction Rebellion is not on the EU/UN terrorist list, while pledging all lawful means to prevent terrorist offences.
It is not possible for the police and the OM to provide a reliable overview of such criminal activities since May 2018.
Het is voor de politie en het OM niet mogelijk om een betrouwbaar overzicht te geven van betreffende dergelijke strafbare activiteiten sinds mei 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de verdubbeling van het aantal zaken dat de politie zonder onderzoek terzijde schuift

Van Nispen (SP) asks the Justice Minister how she responds to reports that police dropping cases without investigation have doubled since 2018, whether victims of fraud and assault can accept that perpetrators are not traced, whether capacity shortages were foreseeable, whether the plans suffice, and how many dropped cases are acceptable. The minister answers that case selection is a necessary consequence of scarce capacity guided by the OM's screening framework, that staffing should rebalance around 2024–2025, and that some relative scarcity will always remain.
Deploying police capacity is by definition a matter of making choices.
De inzet van politiecapaciteit is per definitie een kwestie van keuzes maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het de vertrouwelijkheid van meldingen die binnenkomen bij de meldkamer

An MP asked the Minister of Justice whether an investigation was opened after reports that confidential data from the police control room leaked to a journalist, and about the number of breach-of-confidentiality cases. The minister declined to open an investigation, saying the police found no indication of data sharing, and gave police disciplinary statistics, noting that the police decide whether to communicate on the matter.
No, no investigation has been launched. The police have no indication that confidential personal data were shared with third parties.
Nee, er is geen onderzoek ingesteld. De politie heeft geen aanwijzingen dat vertrouwelijke persoonsgegevens zouden zijn gedeeld met derden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het rapport van Nils Melzer

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers for all written communication between the two ministries about UN rapporteur Nils Melzer's report. The minister provided a selection of inter-ministerial correspondence as an annex and noted that the rapporteur's letter has since been answered, with the government's reply sent separately.
Based on those parliamentary questions, I have made a selection of the written communication between my ministry and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
Op basis van die Kamervragen heb ik een selectie gemaakt van de schriftelijke communicatie tussen mijn ministerie en het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een jongerenwerker publiekelijk aan de schandpaal is genageld door de overheid zonder dat daar een veroordeling aan ten grondslag ligt

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about a youth worker publicly named as a suspect in subsidy fraud without conviction, questioning police disclosure, seizures, and legal protection. The minister answered that authorities must act lawfully and proportionately, declined substantive comment on the pending case, and acknowledged the police press release was unintentionally identifying, which was regretted.
I cannot make substantive statements about this individual criminal case, which is still before the court.
Over deze individuele strafzaak, die nog onder de rechter is, kan ik zoals bekend geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het rapport ‘World Drug Report 2022, Drug Market Trends Canabis and Opioids‘ van de United Nations office on Drugs and Crime’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the UNODC World Drug Report 2022 findings on cannabis legalisation in US states (higher use, THC levels, drug-driving, violence) and the Dutch cannabis experiment. The minister answered that effects vary by state, that the Dutch experiment is a limited four-year regulated trial, not legalisation, and that Bibob screening applies to investors including tobacco or alcohol industry ones.
In the cannabis experiment, a uniform and limited four-year trial examines whether and how a closed coffeeshop chain can be set up.
In het wietexperiment wordt in een uniform en beperkt experiment van vier jaar bekeken of en hoe een gesloten coffeeshopketen kan worden ingericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht “Nelson M. van verboden pedofielenclub Martijn met wapen en kinderporno opgepakt in Mexico’’

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked the Justice Minister how suspect Nelson M. could travel abroad during a pending child-pornography case and why stricter travel restrictions were not imposed. The minister answered that the court suspended pre-trial detention without finding flight risk, outlined available travel-restriction tools, said choosing measures is for the judge, and declined to comment on the ongoing case.
Regarding an ongoing criminal case, I, as is known, make no statements.
Over een lopende strafzaak doe ik, zoals bekend, geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het schorsen van een Twitteraccount

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the state requested suspension of neurologist Jan Bonte's Twitter account and how often it had requested account suspensions in the past year. The minister answered that neither the police nor the ministry contact platforms to have accounts removed or suspended, that police may only point out possibly unlawful content as anyone can, and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
Neither the police nor the Ministry of Justice and Security contact companies with the aim of having an account removed or suspended.
Zowel de politie als het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid nemen geen contact op met bedrijven met als doel een account te verwijderen of te schorsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het beperkt zicht op het ronselen van jongeren voor gedwongen criminaliteit

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the limited visibility of youths recruited into forced criminality, citing a CKM report estimating about 2,500 suspected victims versus 672 registered victims. The minister agreed criminal exploitation belongs within the fight against undermining crime, pointed to prevention programmes, data-sharing challenges, victim protection measures and planned follow-up research, but did not commit to new specific extra budget beyond existing funding.
The contrast in figures is partly due to data sharing and the challenges surrounding it.
Het contrast in cijfers heeft enerzijds te maken met gegevensdeling en de uitdagingen hieromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Verkuijlen over het rapport ‘Jonge Nederlandse slachtoffers criminele uitbuiting witte vlek in aanpak ondermijning van Centrum kinderhandel en mensenhandel’

MPs Bikker and Verkuijlen asked the ministers about the CKM report on young Dutch victims of criminal exploitation, its link to organised crime, recognition of victims and the Dutch versus UK definitions. The government acknowledges the report, commits to a broader prevention approach, to working with the UK, and to a follow-up letter on the second report and the modernisation of article 273f Sr.
We endorse the findings of the report and the recommendation to anchor the approach to criminal exploitation and make it part of the approach to organised and undermining crime.

Wij onderschrijven de bevindingen uit het rapport en de aanbeveling om de aanpak van criminele uitbuiting te verankeren en deze onderdeel te maken van de aanpak georganiseerde en ondermijnende criminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de helmplicht voor snorfietsers

An MP from GroenLinks asks why the government did not adopt SWOV's advice to permit only the motorcycle helmet for snorfiets riders, and questions the safety, enforcement and effects of allowing the speed-pedelec helmet. The minister defends allowing the speed-pedelec helmet on TNO research, says enforcement is feasible, and rejects delaying the rule.
Permitting the speed-pedelec helmet for the snorfiets rider is a well-considered choice based on thorough TNO research into road safety.
Het toestaan van de speed-pedelec-helm voor de snorfietser is een weloverwogen keuze op basis van gedegen onderzoek door TNO naar de verkeersveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Steeds vaker zelfgeprinte 3D-vuurwapens in onderwereld: ’Op korte afstand dodelijk’

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked whether the spread of 3D-printed firearms, extremist interest in them, and the lack of an explicit ban on publishing gun designs are being addressed. The Minister says police and prosecutors see a rise, that a phenomenon study and an international conference are underway, and that the Commission Wet wapens en munitie is examining a ban on distributing designs, with a final report due in October 2022.

That is why I have instructed the Commission on the Weapons and Ammunition Act to also map out the options for preventing the distribution and publication of 3D weapon designs, including banning them.

Daarom heb ik aan de door mij ingestelde Commissie Wet wapens en munitie de opdracht meegegeven om ook de mogelijkheden in kaart te brengen om het verspreiden en publiceren van ontwerpen van 3D-wapens te verhinderen, waaronder het verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van der Plas over de brandweerzorg

MPs Van Nispen and Van der Plas asked the Justice Minister about relaxed fire-service response times, closures of fire stations and changes made without consulting staff or local councils, and about the lack of data and protective equipment for women firefighters. The minister answered that veiligheidsregio boards are responsible for service levels and accountable to municipal councils, that a new legal framework is due by year-end, and that the region has postponed closure planning and been invited for talks.
Within the legal frameworks, the boards determine the ambitions and quality level of the safety region.
Binnen de wettelijke kaders bepalen de besturen de ambities en het kwaliteitsniveau van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het monitoren van zedendelinquenten

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about recidivism among sex offenders, the follow-up to earlier research on supervision, and how supervision is shared between police, prosecutors and probation. The minister answered at length on the risk-assessment and sentencing process, the 2018 cooperation agreements, and the police's mainly reactive role in supervision.
Sex crimes have a great impact on victims and society.
Zedenmisdrijven hebben veel impact op de slachtoffers en de maatschappij.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het Toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de informa

The SP MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked the Justice and Security Ministry what measures it has taken, following the childcare benefits scandal, to find and fix harsh or disproportionate laws and procedures and to manage its information (including chat messages and FOI requests). The minister replies that the department is carrying out the government-wide inventory of harsh rules under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, is applying a shared analysis toolkit, will report on timelines in an annexed letter, and is clarifying the chat-message retention rules for ministers, with a practical proposal promised by end of August.
To this end, a practical proposal for a uniform working method that ministers can use will be made by the end of August.
Hiertoe wordt voor eind augustus een praktisch voorstel gedaan voor een uniforme werkwijze die door de bewindslieden gebruikt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over meer incidenten met verwarde personen

Van Haga asks whether the rise in incidents involving confused persons is linked to GGZ budget cuts and whether a nationwide network of psycholance ambulances will be set up. The minister says the police report figures do not reflect unique persons, rejects the link to GGZ cuts, and states transport should run via the RAV, leaving regional organisation to local partners.
We consider it important to stress that we must provide appropriate care and support to people showing confused behaviour.
We vinden het belangrijk te benadrukken dat we mensen die verward gedrag vertonen passende zorg en ondersteuning dienen te bieden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het Kremlin aan de Zuidas

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether law firm Houthoff profited from work for sanctioned Russian state banks such as Sberbank, whether it should have done client due diligence, and whether prosecution, confiscation, and a legal framework for supervising lawyers are possible. The minister answered that the Amsterdam bar supervisor found no sanctions breach, declined to comment on the individual case, said prosecution depends on concrete signals, and said a legal framework for lawyer sanctions supervision is being prepared with an outline letter promised before the budget debates.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de situatie met betrekking tot de Oeigoeren

MP Sjoerdsma asked the government about the Xinjiang Police Files, whether the Uyghur situation should be called genocide, UN and ICC follow-up, business complicity, protection of Uyghurs in the Netherlands and family reunification. The minister condemned the abuses, joined a 47-country UN statement, said genocide recognition is under EU-level review, and outlined existing measures while noting limits on information and responsibility lying elsewhere.
The cabinet has noted the visit of UN High Commissioner Bachelet to Xinjiang and the fact that the visit was not an investigative mission.
Het kabinet heeft nota genomen van het bezoek van de VN Hoge Commissaris van de Mensenrechten Bachelet aan Xinjiang en het feit dat het bezoek geen onderzoeksmissie was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Geen cel maar taakstraf voor drugsuithalers: 'Dit is een enorme domper'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a Court of Appeal ruling replacing prison sentences for drug-haul runners in Rotterdam port with suspended sentences and community service, and whether the new offence article 138aa Sr remains effective. The minister defended the law, said sentencing is for independent judges, promised to monitor jurisprudence and report back, and suggested port companies bear responsibility for barriers.
It is not for me to comment on sentences imposed in individual criminal cases. That is for the independent judge to assess.
Het is niet aan mij om mij uit te laten over opgelegde straffen in individuele strafzaken. Dat is aan de onafhankelijke rechter ter beoordeling.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Wassenberg inzake het gebruik van dieren als actiemiddel bij boerendemonstraties

An MP asked whether farmers bringing cows to a demonstration caused animal stress, whether it is permitted to use animals as protest tools, and what powers exist to prevent this. The ministers acknowledged possible stress but said animal welfare rules were met after a police check, found no general ban on using animals in demonstrations, called it undesirable, and pointed to existing legal powers of mayors.
There is no prohibition on using animals as a protest tool at a demonstration.
Er is geen verbod op het inzetten van dieren als actiemiddel bij een demonstratie.
Antwoord op een vraag van het lid Jansen over onteigening

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security for all Council of Ministers and crisis committee documents since 2012 discussing expropriation or violation of property rights. The minister replied that expropriation was not discussed substantively in the crisis committee, only as a scenario regarding Ukrainian refugee housing, and that minutes cannot be disclosed, citing state confidentiality and collective ministerial responsibility, while noting parallel Woo handling.
Minutes of the MCCb and the Council of Ministers cannot be made public.
Verslagen van de MCCb en de ministerraad kunnen niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de toepassing van de strafbeschikking op delicten waarop een maximumgevangenisstraf van meer dan zes jaar staat

An MP asks why the Public Prosecution Service imposed penal orders (strafbeschikkingen) for serious violent and sexual offences carrying more than six years' imprisonment, which the Code of Criminal Procedure does not allow, and how victims' interests are protected. The Minister says dagvaarden is the starting point, the cases are being examined through file research with results expected after summer, victims' wishes play a central role, and the Prosecution Service will be asked to ensure practice complies with the law.
After the summer I will receive the results of the file research from the Public Prosecution Service, after which I will inform the House of Representatives.
Na de zomer zal ik van het Openbaar Ministerie de resultaten van het dossieronderzoek ontvangen, waarna ik uw Kamer zal informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het bericht 'Woonwagenbewoners op de zwarte lijsten bij gemeenten: nationale waakhond doet onderzoek'

Sylvana Simons asked the Justice Minister about a checklist in a municipal information-sharing model protocol that names woonwagenbewoners (Sinti, Roma, Yenishe, Reizigers) as an indicator of undermining crime, and whether this is discriminatory and whether the data gathered should be deleted. The minister acknowledged the reference is wrong and stigmatising, said the checklist will be revised with the SBO and municipalities (expected by September 2022), and that no signals are known of individuals being registered.
That woonwagenbewoners are named as a specific group on the checklist is wrong, because this can be stigmatising.
Dat woonwagenbewoners als specifieke groep worden genoemd op de checklist is verkeerd, want dit kan stigmatiserend werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht dat een vanwege een personeelstekort bij de rechtbank Gelderland zaken niet meer voor de rechter worden gebracht

MP Mutluer asked the Justice Minister about reports that about 1500 criminal cases at the Gelderland district court will be dropped (sepot) due to staff shortages, and whether this is symptomatic elsewhere and how victims will be compensated. The minister acknowledged the shortage and regret, said about 90% of those cases will be dismissed, admitted victims may be harmed and promised to explore compensation and a letter to victims, and to discuss victims' speaking rights for OM penal orders with the College of Procurators-General.
That is why it is being examined how best to meet the victims' needs.
Daarom wordt gekeken op welke wijze het beste tegemoet kan worden gekomen aan de slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het rapport van VN-rapporteur Melzer

An MP asked the Justice Minister about UN rapporteur Melzer's report criticising police conduct at COVID demonstrations, and whether the government had answered his questions within the 60-day deadline. The minister replied that the letter was misplaced on receipt, so the response was delayed, and that a reply to the UN is being prepared and will be sent shortly.
A response is currently being prepared.
Een reactie is op dit moment in voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over oneigenlijk gebruik leefgeld

An MP asked the ministers about reports that Ukrainian arbeidsmigranten who were already in the Netherlands before the war are claiming leefgeld, and how misuse of refugee facilities and exploitation of Ukrainians will be tackled. The government answered that such workers can fall within the temporary protection group and so be eligible, that municipalities get support and verification via the IND, and that the Arbeidsinspectie is investigating possible labour-law violations and the Aanjaagteam recommendations are being implemented.

Persons who were already in the Netherlands as labour migrants before the Russian attack can therefore fall within the target group and in that case are also eligible for reception and the associated leefgeld.

Personen die voor de Russische aanval al in Nederland waren als arbeidsmigrant kunnen derhalve onder de doelgroep vallen en komen in dat geval ook in aanmerking voor opvang en het bijbehorende leefgeld.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het verschijnen van de Annual Review of the Human Rights Situation of Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Trans and Intersex People covering events that occurred in Europe and Central Asi

An MP from Volt asked several ministers about the ILGA Europe 2021 review of LGBTI rights, including Dutch LGBTI conditions, asylum treatment of transgender applicants, violence, intersex surgery, transit leave and bi+ visibility. The government broadly recognises the report's account of the Netherlands, declines to assess other states' asylum procedures, and outlines ongoing measures and studies while promising letters on several items later.
The cabinet considers it too early to anticipate the outcomes of these processes.
Het kabinet vindt het te vroeg om op de uitkomsten van deze trajecten vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de uitvoering van het jeugdstrafrecht en het (op tijd) ontbreken van de juiste hulp voor jongeren

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about long waiting times for court-ordered youth treatment and whether this increases reoffending and pretrial detention. The minister acknowledged the problem, said no data exist on youths waiting in detention, found no link to recidivism, attributed waits to municipal procurement gaps, and pointed to a planned law and a support programme.
No figures are available on the number of young people held in detention waiting for treatment.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal jongeren dat in detentie wacht op een behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het Ceder en Bikker over het bericht ‘Curaçaos roulette’

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked about the Argos report on weak supervision of Curaçao's online gambling sector, its risks, Dutch involvement, and whether the Kingdom should intervene. The government acknowledged insufficient oversight, pointed to Kingdom package measures H.2 and H.19 for reform, and said licensing and enforcement fall under Curaçao's autonomy, with technical assistance offered.
The cabinet nonetheless recognises the statements made in the broadcast and endorses the finding that there is insufficient effective control and supervision of the online gambling sector in Curaçao.

Het kabinet herkent evenwel de uitlatingen die in de uitzending zijn gedaan en onderschrijft de constatering dat er onvoldoende effectieve controle en toezicht is op de online kansspelsector in Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de berichten 'Voortaan dreigt ontslag voor racistische agenten' en 'Ontslag dreigt voor racistische agenten'1-7-2022

MP Sylvana Simons asked the Justice Minister whether the police announcement that racist officers face dismissal is meaningful, how it applies to past conduct, and how complaints and reporting of racism within the force will be assessed and protected. The minister answered that discrimination will now always be sanctioned, with dismissal possible, that the police are developing clearer processes and reporting channels, and that past disciplinary decisions cannot be revoked, though the AGFA advisory body reviews such sanctions.
Vigorously enforcing a clear norm requires that all available disciplinary options are used, from lighter sanctions to dismissal.
Daadkrachtig handhaven van een heldere norm vereist dat alle disciplinaire mogelijkheden worden benut die hiervoor beschikbaar zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over Ard B. die vastzit in een Franse cel

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether a Dutch detainee in a French prison, reportedly ill, would serve only four months there before transfer to the Netherlands, and whether humanitarian grounds would be used to speed up his transfer. The minister replied that a return guarantee was given, no commitment to four months is known, IOS actively pursued the transfer, and the transfer was approved on 28 June with the case handled urgently, though humanitarian conditions do not formally factor into the transfer criteria.
On 28 June I approved the transfer of the person concerned under the Act on mutual recognition and enforcement of custodial and conditional sanctions (WETS).
Op 28 juni jl. heb ik ingestemd met de overbrenging van betrokkene op grond van de Wet wederzijdse erkenning en tenuitvoerlegging vrijheidsbenemende en voorwaardelijke sancties (WETS).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over het bericht 'Onderzoek naar rol OR-voorzitter politie na uitreizen jihadistische broer'

MPs Helder and Wilders asked why no internal investigation was opened into the works council chair of the Landelijke Eenheid whose brother was an IS terrorist, why she was allowed to hold the post without screening, and whether she has access to personnel files. The Minister confirms an orientation investigation is now underway, states the Screening Act is not yet in force, denies access to personnel files, and declines to suspend her or order an external investigation.
It is correct that an orientation investigation is being instituted.
Het klopt dat een oriënterend onderzoek wordt ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Nispen en Leijten over discriminatie en racisme bij politie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten (SP) asked the Justice and Interior ministers about discrimination and racism within the police, following a documentary in which police officers said they would not return to the force. The minister acknowledged the problem, described a new police leadership statement, a national coordinator for combating racism, and a planned tiered sanctions regime, but declined to set a firm timeline and gave limited concrete figures.
I will inform your House as soon as possible about the elaboration of this.
Over de uitwerking hiervan zal ik uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Michon-Derkzen over het verdwijnen van sektesignaal

MPs Van Nispen and Michon-Derkzen asked whether the government would implement the motion for a reporting point for cult signals and why the Sektesignaal point was discontinued. The minister says the motion will be carried out after the Hendriks commission reports on 1 November, police handle cult reports adequately, and cult-related reports at Sektesignaal were fairly stable at around 100 dossiers per year.
I will carry out the motion submitted by your House as intended, so that the functions of the reporting point are housed in the most suitable place.
Ik zal de door uw Kamer ingediende motie conform de bedoeling uitvoeren, zodat de functies van het meldpunt op de meest geschikte plaats worden ondergebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht “Tbs-kliniek Nijmegen: ontsnapping ging te snel om in te grijpen”

An SGP MP asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about the escape of two tbs detainees from the Pompe clinic in Nijmegen, including whether staffing shortages and the unfinished second fence were to blame and whether new security measures would follow. Minister Weerwind answered that the Inspectorate is investigating, extra fences, wire and cameras have been added, one escapee was arrested, and all top-security clinics are being reviewed.
I consider it important that it is looked at very carefully how the escape could happen. The Inspectorate of Justice and Security is doing that.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat heel nauwkeurig wordt gekeken hoe de ontvluchting heeft kunnen gebeuren. Dat doet de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht dat ’Haagse moskee wilde meewerken aan kortstondig uithuwelijken voor seks en geld’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report that a Hague mosque was willing to help arrange short-term marriages for sex and payment, and how this relates to criminal and civil marriage law. The minister confirmed that only civil marriage is legally recognised, that religious marriage without a prior civil marriage is prohibited, and that the relevant offences are enforceable, while stating no signals of such marriages elsewhere and pointing to existing victim support channels.
To date, the cabinet has received no signals that so-called pleasure marriages are being concluded in the Netherlands.
Tot op heden heeft het kabinet geen signalen ontvangen dat er in Nederland zogenaamde plezierhuwelijken worden afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht dat wetgeving doorrijden na een aanrijding aanzienlijk aangescherpt dient te worden

MPs Koerhuis and Michon-Derkzen asked the ministers whether hit-and-run laws should be tightened after a report by a victims' association, including the 12-hour self-reporting rule, drink-driving detection, prosecution and sentencing figures, and comparisons with neighbouring countries. The minister says the 2020 law already raised maximum penalties, that the 12-hour rule is meant to encourage self-reporting, that prosecution remains the burden of the public prosecutor, and that the 12-hour rule and tightening will be examined with police and the prosecution service following an adopted motion, but the questions were not answered one by one in time.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de aanpak van voetbal gerelateerde criminaliteit en het opleggen en handhaven van stadionverboden

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about football-related crime, the rising number of stadium bans, whether bans should be combined with reporting obligations, the digital reporting duty, camera surveillance and face-covering rules. The minister answers that most stadium bans are civil-law measures handled by clubs and the KNVB, that combining them with area bans is only appropriate in serious cases, that the digital reporting duty is delayed by fraud and privacy risks, and that further agreements with partners will be implemented before the new season.
Unfortunately, no figures are available on this.
Helaas zijn hiervan geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Mutluer over het bericht ‘Nauwere samenwerking tussen Nederlandse en Marokkaanse politie’

MPs Piri and Mutluer asked the government why it pursued closer police cooperation with Morocco before answering earlier questions, and whether this could intimidate Moroccan political opponents in the Netherlands given past torture and spyware allegations. The minister answered that Morocco is an important partner against organised crime, that an extradition treaty would only be explored, and that the government finds the alleged spyware use unacceptable, while leaving the allegations to Moroccan authorities and deferring the written consultation answers to a later date.
The visit of the police chief to Morocco was intended as a get-to-know-you meeting, to strengthen relations and discuss mutual interests in better cooperation to combat organised crime.

Het bezoek van de korpschef aan Marokko stond in het teken van nadere kennismaking, het aanhalen van de relaties en het bespreken van de wederzijdse belangen in betere samenwerking om georganiseerde criminaliteit te bestrijden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Havens in Noord-Nederland moeten 'beducht zijn' voor snellere toename drugscriminelen, als Rotterdam overstapt op zwaardere controles’

MPs Inge van Dijk and Slootweg (CDA) asked the Justice and Security Minister and the Finance State Secretary about a report that northern Dutch ports are poorly controlled and vulnerable to drug smuggling if Rotterdam tightens checks, and about whether 100% controls, displacement risks and the 24 million euro package would address this. The government replies that customs, Marechaussee and police have a good information position, that smuggling volumes in northern ports are relatively stable, that it monitors displacement and will not adopt 100% checks on specific goods, and that the structural funds focus on five major hubs with regional funds available for other hubs.

The Politie en Wetenschap research is however a reason to examine, both separately and jointly, what options exist to further strengthen the information position on possible dubious practices in the northern seaports.

Het onderzoek van Politie en Wetenschap is echter wel een aanleiding om, zowel afzonderlijk als in gezamenlijkheid, te onderzoeken welke mogelijkheden er zijn om de informatiepositie over de mogelijke malafide praktijken in de Noordelijke zeehavens verder te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Westerveld over het bericht 'Hoe ‘pro-anacoaches’ kwetsbare meisjes misbruiken' en de uitvoering van de motie Van der Graaf c.s. (Kamerstuk 31015-197)

MPs Bikker and Westerveld asked about reports of 'pro-ana coaches' sexually exploiting girls with eating disorders, and the implementation of a motion on online investigation strategy and criminalising pro-ana content. The Minister outlines a range of prevention, support and criminal-justice measures already underway, but declines a blanket ban on pro-ana sites and says an online investigation strategy is still being developed, with details promised before summer.
In addition, I have committed to discuss with the police the development of an online investigation strategy.
Daarnaast heb ik toegezegd met de politie in gesprek te gaan over het ontwikkelen van een online opsporingsstrategie.
