Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de brandbrief van de NVvR over de werkdruk rechtspraak en OM

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice Minister how the government responds to the NVvR open letter on high workload and overtime at the judiciary and the Public Prosecution Service, and what it will do to reduce workload and safeguard quality. The minister acknowledges the high workload, points to measures already taken (extra officers and judges, structural extra budget, ICT improvements, time-use study follow-up) and says the issue is under discussion with the Raad voor de rechtspraak and the College van procureurs-generaal, without committing to new parliamentary reporting beyond existing channels.
As indicated, the discussion on workload is ongoing.
Zoals aangegeven is het gesprek over werkdruk gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de steun aan een Nederlander die in Syrië gevangen zat en gemarteld is

An MP asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers why the government did little to find and help a Dutch citizen from Arnhem detained and tortured in Syria, and whether his case could support prosecution or state liability proceedings. The government answered that consular options in Syria were extremely limited, that it kept the family informed and explored options, and that it follows the family's decision on whether the case is used in the liability claim.
The Dutch policy of not entering into diplomatic contacts with the Syrian government is motivated by the war crimes and human rights violations committed by the Assad regime.
Het Nederlandse beleid om geen diplomatieke contacten met de Syrische overheid aan te gaan is ingegeven door de oorlogsmisdrijven en mensenrechtenschendingen door het regime van Assad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Ginneken over het bericht dat de clouddienst van Microsoft niet gebruikt kan worden voor de uitwisseling of opslag van gevoelige of bijzondere persoonsgegevens

An MP from D66 asked ministers how they assess reports that Microsoft cloud services cannot be used for sensitive personal data given possible US intelligence access, and what measures will limit such use. The government answered that the DPIA does not rule out Microsoft services, that mitigation such as customer-managed encryption keys and standard contractual clauses apply, and that a national cloud strategy and EU enforcement work are pending.
Risks are identified that affect access to government services, but solutions are also identified to mitigate this risk.
Er worden risico’s gesignaleerd die raken aan de toegang tot overheidsdiensten, maar ook oplossingen geïdentificeerd om dit risico te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Van Baarle over de mogelijke vooringenomenheid bij algoritmes gebruikt door de Politie

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about possible bias in the police predictive algorithm CAS, following an Audit Office report, and whether the system should be suspended. The minister answered that the police have been asked to tighten control procedures, that the system's variables do not include nationality, and that suspension is not necessary now, citing mitigating measures on governance and accountability.
I have therefore asked the police to tighten the procedures for recording these checks in the regular process.
Ik heb de politie daarom gevraagd om in het reguliere proces de procedures voor het vastleggen van deze controles aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de ontwikkelingen rondom de landsadvocaat

MP Van Nispen asks whether the financial supervisor BFT has stopped using the law firm Pels Rijcken, whether BFT should use firms it supervises, and whether stricter requirements should apply to notaries the State uses, and asks about the composition of the Silvis commission. The minister confirms BFT is ending the framework contract, says BFT will assess case by case, that the State's notarial services will be sourced with stricter demands where feasible, and that the Silvis commission will advise on the longer term and may add a notarial expert if needed.
For the future, BFT wants to consider case by case whether, and if so which law firm, is engaged.
Het BFT wil voor de toekomst per kwestie bekijken, of, en zo ja, welk advocatenkantoor wordt ingeschakeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over verspreiden van een extreemrechtse omvolkingstheorie bij de omroep Ongehoord Nederland

MP Sjoerdsma asked whether the government has noted the ombudsman's finding that broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland breached the NPO Journalistic Code, and whether the conclusions can be included in answers to earlier questions. The State Secretary answered yes to both, referring to the answer to question 8.
Yes, see the answer to question 8.
Ja, zie de beantwoording van vraag 8.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van der Werf, Van Strien, De Hoop, Westerveld, Teunissen, Van der Graaf, Van Baarle, Koekkoek en Gündoğan over het verspreiden van een extreemrechtse omvolkingstheorie bij de om

MPs asked the government how the public broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland could broadcast the 'great replacement' conspiracy theory unchallenged, and what risks and sanctions follow. The Secretary of State answered that the NPO Ombudsman found Ongehoord Nederland breached the journalistic code, that the NPO intends to impose a sanction, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media and NPO, not the minister, are responsible for judging compliance with the Mediawet.
It is for the Commissariaat to assess the broadcast of Ongehoord Nieuws in light of the requirements the Mediawet places on broadcasters.
Het is aan het Commissariaat om de uitzending van Ongehoord Nieuws te beoordelen in het licht van de eisen die de Mediawet aan omroepen stelt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de aansturing van het Land Information Manoeuvre Centre (LIMC) door de Nationaal Coördinator Terrorismebestrijding en Veiligheid (NCTV), de samenwerking tussen het LIMC en de

An MP asks the Justice Minister about NCTV steering of the LIMC military information unit, police social media surveillance cooperation with LIMC, and information provided to parliament. The minister answers that NCTV's role was limited to exploratory talks, police OSINT cooperation was a short-lived exploration stopped in October 2020, and police surveillance operates under Politiewet article 3 and the criminal procedure framework without targeting opinions.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Jasper van Dijk over het gebruik van hacksoftware, zoals Pegasus, in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt and Van Dijk asked about Dutch use of hacking software such as Pegasus, including purchases, users, offences, targets, supplier screening, statistics, and the Wet CCIII evaluation. The government answered that police buy commercial intrusion software under judicial authorization, that operational details and expenditures cannot be disclosed for protection of methods, and that the Wet CCIII evaluation is delayed and expected after summer 2022.

Providing third parties with information on which specific software the police hold and use for this special investigative power entails unacceptable risks for the usability of those means and thereby for the investigative interest.

Het verstrekken van informatie aan derden over welke specifieke software de politie beschikt en gebruikt bij de inzet van deze bijzondere opsporingsbevoegdheid, brengt onaanvaardbare risico’s met zich mee voor de inzetbaarheid van die middelen en daarmee het opsporingsbelang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Bikker over het bericht 'Gevaar loert voor Oekraïense vluchtelingen: 'Prostitutie, gedwongen adoptie en uitbuiting''

MPs Kuik (CDA) and Bikker (ChristenUnie) asked how Ukrainian refugees are protected against exploitation, trafficking, and unclear coordination of private reception, and whether a reception ambassador is needed. The State Secretary answered that the government works with partners on awareness, flyers, EMPACT information sharing, and a new reception organisation, while noting dozens of registered incidents and one investigation, with no trafficking found in controls.

The cabinet works with various chain partners, such as civil society organisations (including the Red Cross and the Salvation Army) and churches, to make displaced persons from Ukraine aware of the risks of exploitation when staying with private individuals.

Het kabinet zet zich met de verschillende ketenpartners, zoals maatschappelijke organisaties (zoals het Rode Kruis en het Leger des Heils) en kerken in om ontheemden uit Oekraïne bewust te maken van de risico's op uitbuiting als ze bij particulieren gaan verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Bikker over de aflevering van Undercover in Nederland over uitbuiting en illegale prostitutie

MPs Knops and Bikker asked the Minister of Justice about exploitation and illegal prostitution exposed by a Undercover in Nederland broadcast, including prosecution of pimps, municipal enforcement against facilitators, cooperation with municipalities and housing corporations, and sexual health care for sex workers. The State Secretary answered that prosecution requires coercion or abuse of vulnerability, cited prosecution statistics and municipal enforcement tools, reported that 80% of municipalities have a contact officer, and described the pending Wrs regulation bill and existing sexual health services.
The cabinet is fully committed to tackling all possibilities for abuses in the sex industry.
Het kabinet zet zich ten volste in om alle mogelijkheden tot misstanden in de seksbranche tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het tekort aan forensisch artsen

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the shortage of forensic doctors, which the GGD says leaves evidence of sexual offences and child abuse undetected and forces choices between autopsies and injury examinations, and whether €20 million a year would be provided to NFI and GGDs. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, pointed to temporary fixes, a noodmaatregel letting basic doctors perform autopsies under conditions, regional cooperation, and task-shifting pilots, but gave no immediate structural funding commitment.
Finding solutions to the capacity shortage therefore has the highest priority for me and my colleagues at VWS and BZK.
Het vinden van oplossingen voor het capaciteitstekort heeft daarom de hoogste prioriteit van mij en mijn collega's van VWS en BZK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de bescherming van LHBTI+’ers

MP Mutluer asked the Minister of Justice and Security about protecting LHBTI people from violence and discrimination, including discrimination data, prosecution rates, discrimination detectives, a bill on higher penalties for discriminatory intent, and medical treatment of intersex children. The minister answered that the government shares the concern, cites the Regenboogakkoord, the action plan, a research project and 2 million euro for police, provides discrimination statistics, and says the bill is being considered with Raad van State advice and that the intersex treatment question lies with medical professionals and a planned quality standard.
I expect that this knowledge can also contribute to further policy and initiatives aimed at combating violence against LHBTI persons.
Ik ga ervan uit dat deze kennis ook kan bijdragen aan verder beleid en initiatieven gericht op het tegengaan van geweld tegen LHBTI-personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Erdogans Trolle Schwören sich auf Wahlkampf ein'

MPs Becker and Rajkowski asked the government about reports that Turkish influencers and trolls target Turkish-Dutch and German voters ahead of Turkey's 2023 elections, and whether this interference happens in the Netherlands, along with related questions on counter-strategies, UETD training of candidates, campaign rules and social media regulation. The government condemned unwanted foreign interference, said it has no signals that Turkey is interfering in the 2023 elections, pointed to its existing counter-interference approach, support for municipalities and the Digital Services Act, and did not provide figures on UETD-trained candidates.
These figures are not known to the central government.
Deze cijfers zijn niet bekend bij de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rajkowski over de uitvoering van de gewijzigde motie Becker c.s. over het structureel tegengaan van extremistische uitingen online

MPs Becker and Rajkowski asked how the government will implement the amended Becker motion on structurally countering extremist online expression, including the role of the new terrorist content authority, cooperation with platforms, financing, and Taskforce casework. Minister Van Gennip answered that extremist but non-terrorist online content falls outside the new authority's mandate on proportionality grounds, that the DSA will be used to tighten notice-and-action procedures, and that the Justice Minister will map preventive and repressive instruments, while many questions were answered only by reference to earlier answers or not answered in time.

To consider what options exist to act against this kind of harmful content, the Minister of Justice and Security will map which preventive and repressive instruments other countries have and what these offer the Netherlands.

Om te bezien wat de mogelijkheden zijn om juist tegen dit soort schadelijke content op te treden zal de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid in kaart brengen over wat voor preventief en repressief instrumentarium landen om ons heen beschikken en welke mogelijkheden dit biedt voor Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Segers over een Wob-verzoek met een intimiderend karakter dat als antisemitisch wordt ervaren

MPs Ellian and Segers asked whether the government considers a Wob freedom-of-information request by The Rights Forum to Dutch universities, seeking contacts with Jewish organisations and Israel, to be intimidating and antisemitic, and whether it will tell universities and the group not to answer or to stop. The minister answered that the request is a legitimate right under the Woo, that universities must decide how to handle it under the law, that fourteen public universities have said they will not answer parts of it, and that the minister has received many reactions from the Jewish community viewing the request as antisemitic.
It is for the university's governing board to handle this request further along the lines of the law.
Het is aan het instellingsbestuur van de universiteit dit verzoek langs de lijnen van de wet verder te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over bedreigingen aan het adres van de Russisch-Orthodoxe kerk in Nederland

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Justice Minister about threats against Russian Orthodox churches in the Netherlands and whether the government would engage with the communities and local authorities. The minister condemned the threats, said local authorities and police are responsible for security and protection, and visited a Russian Orthodox parish in Amsterdam.
It is therefore up to the local triangle to decide how threats are handled and how this is communicated to those involved.
Het is dan ook aan de lokale driehoek om te bepalen hoe met bedreigingen wordt omgegaan en hoe daarover met betrokkenen wordt gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Michon-Derkzen over het artikel 'Problemen bij kinderzedenzaken: schrijnend tekort aan forensisch artsen'

MPs Van den Hil and Michon-Derkzen asked about a reported shortage of forensic doctors that delays examinations of minors in sex-crime cases, and about measures to address it. The Minister replies that the shortage is serious, that an interim fix via NFI hiring of FMO covers the 0-12 age group, and that task redistribution pilots, a recruitment campaign and a study on physician assistants are underway, though structural solutions and timelines remain uncertain.
It is very serious that forensic evidence examination of minor victims of sex offences is under pressure due to the shortage of forensic doctors.
Het is zeer ernstig dat het sporenonderzoek bij minderjarige slachtoffers van zedendelicten onder druk staat door het tekort aan forensische artsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Segers over een aangevallen Joods voetbalteam

MPs Ellian and Segers asked the Minister of Justice and Security about an attack on a Jewish futsal team, the Hitler salute at the incident, and the response to antisemitic incidents. The minister condemned antisemitism, pointed to ongoing criminal and KNVB investigations, and described existing reporting, expertise and prevention measures without committing to new concrete steps.
Because the case is still under investigation, I cannot comment on this specific case.
Omdat de zaak nog in onderzoek is, kan ik mij over dit specifieke geval niet uitlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Hooligans dreigen door georganiseerde vechtpartijen en training politie te overmannen’

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a report that organised hooligan fight groups are becoming more professional and threaten to overpower police, and asks about training, specialist approaches and equipment. The minister confirms the trends, says police are alert to planned fights, promises to ask the police chief to review ME training, and notes ongoing research into whether ME equipment is adequate.
Based on the results of the research, I will ask the police chief to consider whether the training programme needs to be adjusted.
Op basis van de resultaten van het onderzoek zal ik de korpschef vragen te bezien of het trainingsprogramma aangepast moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Bikker over de situatie van Nederlandse kinderen in Syrische kampen

Two MPs asked the government about the situation of Dutch children in Syrian Kurdish camps, including their numbers, access to education, radicalisation prevention and repatriation. The government answered that about 60 children with a Dutch link are in the camps, that the Netherlands supports humanitarian aid without direct control over services, and that repatriated children are placed in youth care facilities.
I cannot make statements about individual cases, the numbers per camp and the ages.
Over individuele gevallen, de aantallen per kamp en leeftijden kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ´dreiging uit extreemrechtse hoek neemt toe´

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether an extreme-right attack in the Netherlands is plausible, how many extreme-right actors exist, what the NCTV and police are doing online, and when the EU terrorist online content regulation will be implemented. The minister confirms an attack is conceivable, says the total number of extreme-right actors is unknown (several hundred accelerationist sympathisers), notes that NCTV analysis work is limited pending a data-processing bill, and promises further information before the summer recess.
The total number of extreme-right actors in the Netherlands is not known.
Het totaal aantal rechts-extremisten in Nederland is niet bekend.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Save the Children waarschuwt Repatriëring buitenlandse kinderen uit Syrische kampen kan nog wel 30 jaar duren’ en n.a.v. het Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland van a

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that repatriating foreign children from Syrian camps could take 30 years, the threat to national security, support in the camps, education, and how repatriated children are cared for. The government answered that the children are victims of their parents' choices, that repatriation is weighed case by case with security and foreign-relations considerations, and it described humanitarian aid, EU cooperation and the child-protection process without committing to new concrete steps.

If a situation arises in which the cabinet concludes that efforts must be made to transfer suspects to the Netherlands for prosecution because impunity threatens, the House will be informed in advance, in line with the Laan-Geselschap motion.

Als zich een situatie voordoet waarin het kabinet tot het oordeel komt dat een inspanning geleverd moet worden om verdachten ter berechting naar Nederland over te brengen, omdat straffeloosheid dreigt, wordt uw Kamer hierover conform de motie Laan-Geselschap voorafgaand geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over ‘de voortgang omtrent de autoriteit terroristische content en kinderporno’

The MP asked about the state of the authority for terrorist content and child pornography, the implementation of the EU TOI regulation from 7 June 2022, and the administrative-law bill on online child pornography. The minister answered that the authority is being set up and aims to be operational in autumn once the implementing act enters into force, that interim arrangements are legally impossible or undesirable, and that the child pornography bill will be submitted to parliament after the Council of State advice is processed, aimed for this summer.
The draft Implementation Act is now ready, has received advice from the Council of State and is ready to be sent to your House.
Het voorstel van de Uitvoeringswet is inmiddels gereed, door de Raad van State van advies voorzien en gereed voor verzending aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski, Brekelmans en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Omstreden Chinese camera’s hangen overal in Nederland, ook bij ministeries'

MPs from the VVD asked whether Chinese Hikvision and Dahua cameras are used at government buildings, including police and ministries, and what security checks apply when procuring them. The government answered that it does not know how many Chinese cameras are in use, that procurement follows general information-security rules with each organisation assessing national-security risks itself, and that a cross-government study into such risks will be carried out.
It is not known how many cameras this specifically concerns.
Het is niet bekend om hoeveel camera's het specifiek gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Van Ginneken over het gebruik van omstreden Chinese bewakingscamera’s door de Nederlandse overheid en politie

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Van Ginneken asked the ministers whether the Dutch government and police use Chinese surveillance cameras (Hikvision, Dahua), what security risks this poses, and what will be done. The government confirmed use of Chinese cameras, stated that national security is weighed in procurement case by case, announced a study into camera risks within central government, but said the police will keep using Dahua cameras and no central overview exists.
For this reason there is no central overview available of Chinese cameras in use by the government, the risks associated with them, or the considerations behind their purchase.

Daarom is er geen centraal overzicht beschikbaar van Chinese camera’s in gebruik bij de overheid en eventuele risico’s die daarmee verbonden zijn en ook niet van de afwegingen die ten grondslag lagen bij de aankoop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over dwang richting gemeenten om asielzoekers op te vangen

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the government whether there is an asylum crisis, why it previously denied one, and what legal basis exists to force municipalities to provide asylum reception, including the role of safety-region chairs and the Rotterdam letter. The state secretary answered that a crisis exists only for Ukrainian displaced persons, that no binding legal instrument currently compels municipalities on asylum reception, and that the government will explore one and avoid the term 'aanwijzing' in future.
A study is currently underway into the possibilities of arriving at a binding legal instrument to realise asylum reception.
Momenteel vindt een verkenning plaats naar de mogelijkheden om tot een dwingend juridisch instrumentarium te komen om asielopvang te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van der Graaf en Piri over de situatie aan de grens met Oekraïne

MPs asked the government about human trafficking risks for Ukrainian refugees at the border, including unaccompanied children, and whether it would press for EU coordination and raise the issue in Council meetings. The government answered that it shares the concerns, has raised them in EU and UN contacts, and describes registration, monitoring and awareness measures in the Netherlands.
The cabinet generally shares UNHCR's concerns about signals of human traffickers in Europe exploiting vulnerable people, including unaccompanied children fleeing Ukraine.

Het kabinet deelt in algemene zin de zorgen van UNHCR over signalen van mensenhandelaren in Europa die misbruik maken van kwetsbare personen, inclusief alleenstaande kinderen die uit Oekraïne vluchten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over individuele ambtsberichten

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked about how Dutch individual intelligence reports (ambtsberichten) on Rwanda are produced, whether they can be verified, whether lawyers of genocide suspects get access, and the state of Rwanda's rule of law after Dutch aid ends. The government answered that the process uses vetted informants and independent sources, that courts can inspect underlying files confidentially, that ICJ monitoring of trials continues until final judgment, and that development aid is being phased out while human rights funding continues.

The competent court and/or the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State can obtain confidential access to the underlying documents to assess whether they support the conclusions of the individual intelligence report.

De bevoegde rechtbank en/of de Afdeling Bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State kan op vertrouwelijke basis inzage krijgen in de achterliggende stukken om te bezien of die de conclusies van het individuele ambtsbericht kunnen dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over het bericht 'FIOD schorst speciale eenheid ‘onaanvaardbaar lang'

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance ministry about the suspension of the FIOD's Team Specialistische Operaties and a court's finding that the suspension was unacceptably long. The state secretary answered that mediation is ongoing, the suspension was justified by serious circumstances, the FIOD does not intend to dissolve the team, and investigations were not hindered.
In its ruling, the court pointed to an unacceptably long suspension.
In zijn uitspraak heeft de rechter gewezen op een onaanvaardbare lange schorsing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over de weigering van bedrijven op basis van geautomatiseerde kredietchecks

Two SP MPs asked whether automated credit checks by companies, which collect and retain privacy-sensitive data, are desirable, what legal basis exists, whether human intervention is required under the GDPR, who must correct erroneous data, and where citizens can turn when wrongly excluded. The minister acknowledged the impact on citizens, explained the GDPR principles and data controller responsibilities, and referred supervision to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens while describing existing rectification rights and programmes.
However, it cannot be established in general terms on which legal basis(es) the processing in the context of offering credit checks is based.
Het is echter niet in algemene zin vast te stellen op welke grondslag(en) de verwerkingen in het kader van het aanbieden van kredietchecks zijn gebaseerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Sylvana Simons over discriminerende rapportages van de NCTV

MPs Azarkan and Simons asked the Justice Minister about NCTV weekly reports that examined and stigmatised parties such as DENK and BIJ1, including a remark calling MP Kuzu the 'long arm of Turkey', and whether this amounted to political monitoring. The Minister acknowledged that some normative remarks about MPs should not have appeared, said the reports were discontinued in March 2021, and explained the planned legal basis and the ongoing data clean-up, while denying that parties were monitored as such.
That should not have happened. Analyses and interpretations must be factual in nature and focused on developments relevant to national security.
Dat had niet gemoeten. Analyses en duidingen moeten feitelijk van aard zijn en gericht zijn op relevante ontwikkelingen voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het buitensluiten van de partij Richard de Mos

MPs Van Haga asked whether the prolonged criminal investigation into Richard de Mos's party, and its exclusion from coalition talks in The Hague, undermines rule of law and public trust, and whether the government will urge the Public Prosecution Service to speed up or drop the case. The minister replied that coalition choices are for the parties and that the OM acts independently, so the government will not press for speed or dismissal of an individual case.
The OM makes these decisions without political interference, as is proper in a state governed by the rule of law.
Het OM neemt deze beslissingen zonder politieke inmenging, zoals dat hoort in een rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het gebrek aan ingrijpen door de politie bij een automobilist die een demonstrant opzettelijk aanrijdt

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why police did not intervene when a motorist deliberately drove into a demonstrator at a protest near Leeuwarden air base, and about the investigation, the role of the Public Prosecution Service and the legal framework. The minister replied that police judged intervention unnecessary as the situation resolved quickly, that complaints and a criminal complaint are being handled, that the prosecutor closed the case without prosecution, and that policing falls under local authority accountable to the municipal council, so the minister declined to judge individual conduct.
The police action took place under the responsibility of the local authority. It is not for me as Minister to pass judgment on this based on video footage.
Het politieoptreden vond plaats onder verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal gezag. Het is niet aan mij als Minister om hierover op basis van videobeelden een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Nispen over het voornemen van de NS om de boa-bevoegdheid weg te halen bij hoofdconducteurs

MPs Alkaya and Van Nispen asked the government about NS's plan to remove the boa (special investigating officer) powers from its 2,800 head conductors, including the role of cost savings, staff shortages, safety impacts and consultation with staff. The state secretary answered that NS is responsible for safety and the decision, that the change saves about 5.7 million euro a year with little boa use, that safety is preserved through Veiligheid & Service staff, and that NS is exploring keeping boa powers for willing conductors.
NS is responsible for the safety of its passengers and staff. It is up to NS to decide on the necessary safety measures, such as the deployment of boas, in consultation with the works council.

NS is verantwoordelijk voor de veiligheid van haar reizigers en personeel. Het is aan NS om over de benodigde veiligheidsmaatregelen, zoals de inzet van boa's, te besluiten in afstemming met de ondernemingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Helder over het afnemen van de boa-status van hoofdconducteurs

Two PVV MPs asked the State Secretary and Justice Minister about NS removing the boa (special investigating officer) powers of train conductors and the resulting safety risks for staff and passengers. The government answered that NS is responsible for these operational decisions, expects only a small rise in assistance requests that can be absorbed, and that the conductors remain supervisors who call in Veiligheid & Service staff when needed.
It is therefore up to NS to decide on the necessary measures, such as the deployment of boa's, in consultation with the works council.
Het is daarom aan NS om over de benodigde maatregelen te besluiten, zoals de inzet van boa's, in afstemming met de ondernemingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht dat het Verenigd Koninkrijk asielzoekers een enkele reis Rwanda geeft

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked whether the government shares concerns about the UK plan to send some asylum seekers one-way to Rwanda, including human rights and refugee convention compliance, and whether it would confront the UK. The government answered that the UK is outside EU asylum law but bound by the Refugee Convention and ECHR, that Rwanda's human rights concerns depend on implementation, and that it would raise the matter bilaterally or internationally only if international law were shown to be breached.
Should it turn out that the UK is thereby violating international law, the cabinet will raise this both bilaterally and internationally.
Wanneer zou blijken dat het VK hiermee internationaal recht schendt, zal het kabinet dit aankaarten op zowel bilateraal als internationaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kuiken over misstanden in de turnsport

Two MPs asked the ministers about alleged misconduct in gymnastics and the handling of former gymnasts' disciplinary case by the Instituut Sportrechtspraak, including whether the process was careful and why earlier warnings were not acted on. The minister says the disciplinary commission is independent and cannot be judged by the ministry, but promises a broader evaluation of sports disciplinary law, talks with the former gymnasts and the ISR, and an external study on the line between disciplinary and criminal law.
It is up to the independent disciplinary committee of the ISR to give a substantive judgment and rule on an individual case.
Het is aan de onafhankelijke tuchtcommissie van het ISR om een inhoudelijk oordeel te geven en daarmee uitspraak te doen over een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitspraak van de voorzieningenrechter dat het OM niet goed is omgegaan met het verschoningsrecht van advocaten

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister how the Public Prosecution Service (OM) should handle lawyer-client privilege after a court ruled it breached privilege by reading lawyers' emails, and whether it would change practice, filter at providers, destroy such emails and review other cases. The minister accepted the ruling's core points, announced interim stricter procedures (provider filtering, secrecy officers, graying out, publication of policy) and an updated guideline, while declining further investigation of past cases and appealing the ruling.
In addition, based on the ruling, so-called 'un-graying' can only occur after a final, irrevocable judicial decision.
Daarnaast geldt, op basis van de uitspraak, dat het zogenoemde «ontgrijzen» slechts aan de orde kan zijn na onherroepelijk rechterlijk oordeel.
Antwoord op van de leden Agema en Van der Plas over de inzet van influencers tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Agema and Van der Plas asked how many influencers the government deployed during the COVID-19 crisis, which messages, on which platforms, at what cost, and whether they opposed dissenting views or MPs. The minister answered in detail: 60 influencers were used under the Alleen Samen campaign, costs were listed, and the government denied commissioning influencers to counter dissenters or MPs.
In total, 60 influencers were deployed during the coronavirus crisis under the Alleen Samen campaign, both paid and unpaid.
In totaal zijn 60 influencers ingezet tijdens de coronacrisis in het kader van de campagne Alleen Samen, zowel betaald als belangeloos.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de toegenomen geweldsaanwendingen door de politie

An MP asked the Justice Minister why police use of force rose in 2021, how this affects police capacity and public trust, and whether inexperienced trainees are deployed with few-years officers. The minister said causes cannot yet be reliably identified, pointed to a pending evaluation of the new registration method, and stated that trainees are supervised by certified practice supervisors while the police monitor the situation.
On the basis of the figures, however, it is not possible to draw sound conclusions about the causes of this.
Op basis van de cijfers is het echter niet mogelijk verantwoorde conclusies te trekken over de oorzaken hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de toegenomen geweldsaanwendingen door de politie

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the police's rise in use of force in 2021, attributed to more demonstrations, reflects a failure of de-escalation, and asked for independent investigation and evaluation. The minister replied that de-escalation is the starting point, that force is used in only 0.12% of incidents, that all force is reviewed internally and by the public prosecutor, and that an evaluation of the new registration method is pending in the second half of 2022.
Every use of force must be reported to the assisting officer of justice.
Iedere geweldsaanwending moet worden gemeld bij de hulpofficier van justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Ambulanceverpleegkundige Laura (39): 'Hij greep me bij mijn nek''

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van den Hil asked the Justice and Security and Long-term Care ministers about reports that an ambulance nurse was assaulted, that police initially did not want to take her report, and whether the ELA agreements on violence against public-service workers were followed. The minister says police and prosecutors apply the ELA agreements, that the next evaluation is due in 2024, and that some reporting issues will be discussed with the sector, but declines to comment on the individual case and disputes the claimed doubling of incidents.
As is known, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sylvana Simons en Piri over de mishandeling van asielzoekers uit Wit-Rusland in Polen

MPs Simons and Piri asked about reported mistreatment, arbitrary detention and possible racism against asylum seekers from Belarus in Poland, and how the government presses Poland and the EU to ensure equal treatment and enforce EU law. The minister said the government finds the reports worrying, supports border detention under EU rules with safeguards, has raised rule-of-law and humanitarian concerns bilaterally and in EU bodies, and noted that the European Commission, as guardian of the treaties, can act under Article 258.
The government attaches importance to member states complying with Union law, especially where fundamental rights are concerned.
Het kabinet hecht eraan dat lidstaten het Unierecht naleven, in het bijzonder wanneer dit fundamentele rechten betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de datahonger van de overheid

The MP Leijten asked how many bodies can access a citizen's BRP personal data, whether access should be restricted, why ministries and police can query family data, and how the SILA's access can persist despite earlier commitments. The Secretary of State answered that access is strictly authorised per user and purpose, that some queries are necessary, that the SILA access will be ended via a forthcoming general administrative order with consent through MijnOverheid, and that uncontrolled logging of purposes is not planned.
It is not possible to estimate the number of users who can query data about an arbitrary citizen, because that would require analysing logging data on search-based disclosures for all citizens.

Het is niet mogelijk een schatting te geven van het aantal gebruikers dat gegevens kan opvragen over een willekeurige burger omdat daarvoor protocolleringsgegevens over verstrekkingen op basis van zoekvragen (ad 1) van (alle) burgers moeten worden geanalyseerd

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over de berichten 'Je kunt me kankerjood noemen, maar ik meld het wel' en 'Nederlands joodse man onthult het antisemitisme waar hij mee te maken heeft'

MPs Wilders and Markuszower asked the Justice Minister about reports of a Jewish man in Wijchen repeatedly harassed, spat on and assaulted by a group of youths, and about police and prosecution handling. The minister replied that the police investigated every report, the prosecutor found insufficient evidence for prosecution, police held 'stop talks' with youths and parents, and discrimination handling will be strengthened through the local partnership.
I cannot make any further statements about the identity of those involved in this case.
Over de identiteit van de betrokkenen in deze zaak kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het uitkeren van een schadevergoeding aan de Groesbeekse kopschoppers

MP Van Nispen asks why the Public Prosecution Service paid compensation to the Groesbeek 'kopschoppers' after withdrawing from the case, and why the reasons for the withdrawal remain secret. The Minister answers that compensation is awarded by the court on equity grounds, declines to judge individual court decisions, and states that secrecy over 'serious interests' is necessary to protect them, noting the Procurator-General found the prosecution's balancing reasonable.
Neither the OM nor I can, however, give openness about the serious interests.
Het OM noch ik kunnen echter openheid geven over de zwaarwegende belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het bericht dat Polen niet-Oekraïense vluchtelingen opsluit in detentiecentra

MP Sylvana Simons asked the Dutch ministers whether they knew of reports that Poland detains non-Ukrainian refugees, including Africans, in detention centres without papers, confiscates phones and forces unsigned documents, and what the government would do about this and the discrimination. The government said it is concerned, that UNHCR and IOM confirmed some detentions, that it raised human rights concerns bilaterally and in EU fora, and that it will press the European Commission to act under Article 258 TFEU.
The cabinet considers the reports of possible violations of human rights safeguards during the asylum procedure worrying.
Het kabinet acht de berichtgeving over mogelijke schendingen van mensenrechtelijke waarborgen tijdens de asielprocedure zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Bisschop over het bericht 'Agent werd onwel na vermoedelijk contact met zelfmoordpoeder'

MPs Stoffer and Bisschop asked about a police officer who became ill after possible contact with suicide powder, the safety of responders, the code on chemical substances, and calls for a ban. The ministers answered that the link to the substance is not confirmed, that responder risks are very limited, and that they see no reason to change the voluntary code or legislate, and declined to comment on an ongoing criminal investigation.
In the interest of the ongoing criminal investigation, the Minister of Justice and Security cannot make any statements about this.
In het belang van het lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek kan de Minister van JenV hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht dat er steeds meer zedenzaken op de plank belanden

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that sexual offence cases are increasingly stalled, the risk this poses to victims' willingness to report, and what is being done about delays and the rights and information of victims. The minister acknowledged that the professional case-handling norms have not been met for years, announced new agreements with the police, prosecution and judiciary and a separate letter to parliament in May, while largely defending complexity and quality as reasons for longer timelines.
Nevertheless, I note that, despite improvement measures in recent years, the professional case-handling norms have not been met in recent years.
Toch constateer ik dat, ondanks de verbetermaatregelen uit de afgelopen jaren, de professionele ketennormen de laatste jaren niet worden gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Tinne (35) niet het eerste slachtoffer 'ontgifting''

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about risks of detox farms using ayahuasca, rising use and providers, prosecutions, and whether penalties should be raised. The minister said there is no data on providers or users, that possession and sale of ayahuasca (DMT) are banned, that prosecution is case-by-case without specific figures, and that a study on drug trade penalties will be shared before year end.
The Public Prosecution Service has no figures available on this, because this qualification is not recorded as such in its systems.
Het OM heeft hierover geen cijfers beschikbaar, omdat deze kwalificatie niet als zodanig in de systemen zit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Nispen over de landsadvocaat en fraude-onderzoeken

MPs Omtzigt and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about Pels Rijcken, the State's counsel firm, refusing to share an internal fraud investigation with the public prosecutor and about related fraud, claims and governance questions. The minister answered that the prosecutor and firm are following the statutory procedure for confidential information, that the investigation results were made available to Parliament for confidential inspection, and that many questions cannot be answered because of ongoing criminal investigations.
The prosecution service and Pels Rijcken are currently following the appropriate statutory procedure for disclosing data subject to a duty of confidentiality.
Het OM en Pels Rijcken doorlopen momenteel de geëigende wettelijke procedure die bestaat voor verstrekking van gegevens waarop een geheimhoudingsplicht rust.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en van Nispen over de kosten van het opruimen van drugsdumpingen en de zaak van de 90-jarige gedupeerde landeigenaar

MPs Van Nispen and Beckerman asked about municipal and provincial demands that a 90-year-old landowner pay for clean-up of chemical drug waste dumped on his land, and about the adequacy of the national compensation scheme. The minister declined to comment on the individual case citing a pending objection procedure, acknowledged the scheme's EUR 25,000 cap is being exceeded in large cases, and said talks with the provinces and BIJ12 are ongoing with an update promised before summer.
There is an objection procedure ongoing in this case with the competent authority.
Er loopt in deze zaak een bezwaarprocedure bij het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Grondeigenaren moeten opdraaien voor drugsafval op hun terrein’

MPs Bikker and Van Esch asked whether landowners stuck with costs of large-scale drug waste dumping (exceeding the 25,000 euro subsidy cap) should be protected, and about subsidy adequacy and underspending. The minister answered that the Rijk has no statutory duty but co-funds costs via a regulation, that talks with IPO, BIJ12 and Noord-Brabant are ongoing, and promised to inform parliament before summer.
I will inform your House, on behalf of the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, before the summer about the state of affairs.
Ik zal uw Kamer, mede namens de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, voor de zomer informeren over de stand van zaken hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sylvana Simons en Omtzigt over het niet openbaren van het onderzoeksrapport over de aanleiding voor de zelfdoding van een politieagent

MPs Simons and Omtzigt asked why the report on the causes of a police officer's suicide was not made public, who decided this, and whether it would be shared with the House, and asked about a whistleblower scheme for national security information. The minister said the report was given to relatives under a confidentiality condition, the police chief decided with all parties, and the report is now being sent to the House with privacy protections, while describing existing whistleblower channels and an announced extra police reporting point.
I am sending your House today the report of the Brouwer Commission.
Ik zend uw Kamer vandaag het rapport van de Commissie Brouwer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Brekelmans over het bericht dat 45 miljard euro Russisch vermogen van personen en organisaties op sanctielijsten in Nederland staat

MPs Heinen and Brekelmans asked the government about a report that EUR 45 billion of Russian assets held by sanctioned persons and entities sits in the Netherlands, and why freezes have been limited, how other countries compare, what has been done to clarify sanctions implementation, and how evasion is prosecuted. Minister Hoekstra rejected the EUR 45 billion estimate as overstated because ownership runs through layered foreign structures, stated that over half a billion euro has been frozen and that prosecutors and the FIOD act on evasion, and described outreach to businesses and a new steering group, while noting that some implementation questions remain.
Twenty yachts under construction are also under enhanced Customs supervision.
Ook staan er twintig jachten in aanbouw onder verscherpt toezicht van de Douane.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Helder over de trage voortgang van onderzoeken naar de Deventer moordzaak

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security why investigations into the Deventer murder case have dragged on for nearly a decade and what steps will speed them up. The minister answered that the review research is now complete, the results were handed to the defence, the delay was caused by a broader review and COVID, and that no further measures are needed since the research has concluded.
The investigation, carried out on the orders of the Advocate-General at the Supreme Court, has now been completed.
Het onderzoek, dat is uitgevoerd in opdracht van de advocaat-generaal (AG) bij de Hoge Raad, is inmiddels voltooid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht 'Halsema: drugseconomie draait op volle toeren, jongeren sneller in zware criminaliteit’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Justice and Security about Amsterdam's regional safety report showing drug crime, youth involvement in serious crime and weapons possession, and about the effect of the stricter penalties for container 'uithalers'. The minister answers that organised crime is a top priority, that the new penalties appear to have reduced uithalers in Rotterdam though the total effect is hard to prove, and outlines prevention investments, neighbourhood-focused measures and an ongoing evaluation of preventive frisking.
Currently the instrument of preventive frisking is being evaluated.
Momenteel wordt het instrument preventief fouilleren geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over grensoverschrijdend gedrag bij de politie

MP Mutluer asked the Minister of Justice and Security about cross-boundary misconduct (bullying, discrimination, harassment) within the police, including its causes, reporting channels, independent investigation and external expertise. The minister acknowledged higher-than-average rates, attributed them to team and workload factors, described existing reporting channels including the police ombudsman, and said further steps would be reported to parliament in autumn 2022.
I aim to inform your House about this in the autumn.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer hierover te informeren in het najaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over een cyberaanval in Oekraïne

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister about reports of a Russian cyberattack on Ukrainian power plants, the Industroyer2 malware and Sandworm group, whether Dutch vital providers and small firms are protected, and the status of a motion on protecting entrepreneurs. The minister answered that attribution is complex, Industroyer2 has no known Dutch targets so far, the NCSC is in contact with vital providers, responsibility for protection lies primarily with firms, and the Chamber will be informed on the motion before summer.
Such intelligence investigations are generally not communicated publicly.
Over dergelijke inlichtingenonderzoeken wordt doorgaans niet publiekelijk gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Ginneken over dwingend recht en het toepassen van de menselijke maat door het CBR

MPs Sneller and Van Ginneken asked whether the CBR (driving licence authority) and the courts can take personal circumstances into account, given that the Wegenverkeerswet and RMRG leave little room for balancing interests, and how this fits with proportionality and the Raad van State's reflection report. Minister Harbers answered that the legal framework is strict by design, the CBR uses passend contact and mitigating measures within it, the government is considering an Awb provision allowing administrative bodies to depart from mandatory rules, and a CBR knelpuntenbrief is expected in Q2 2022.

The cabinet is considering various amendments to better safeguard the general principles of proper administration, increase room for tailored decisions, and put the citizen's perspective at the forefront of service delivery.

Het kabinet overweegt diverse wijzigingen om de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur beter te borgen, ruimte voor maatwerk te vergroten en het burgerperspectief in de dienstverlening voorop te stellen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Van der Staaij over de uitwerking van de plannen inzake het toevoegen van ‘hate speech’ onder Artikel 83 Verdrag betreffende de werking van de Europese Unie (VWEU)

MPs Stoffer and Van der Staaij asked the government how it assesses the European Commission's plan to add hate speech and hate crime to the EU crimes list under Article 83 TFEU, covering necessity, legal basis, proportionality, free speech, and the link to Dutch law. The Minister of Justice answered that the government supports the proposal in principle, considers Dutch law largely adequate but benefits from EU-level harmonisation, and will assess any later directive against fundamental rights and Dutch criminal law when it appears.
The cabinet will guard the balance between, on the one hand, the importance of combating crime and, on the other, a possible infringement of fundamental rights.
Het kabinet zal waken voor de balans tussen enerzijds het belang van de criminaliteitsbestrijding en een mogelijke inbreuk op grondrechten anderzijds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over evaluaties na politiedoden met onbegrepen gedrag, in het bijzonder naar aanleiding van de dood van Sammy Baker

Sylvana Simons (BIJ1) asked whether multidisciplinary evaluations involving police, ambulance, GGD and mental health services are standard after fatal police interventions with people showing confusing behaviour, and whether such evaluations took place after the deaths of Sammy Baker and Cyprian Broekhuis, and whether a standard should be created. The Minister replied that after fatal incidents the prosecutor is notified and the Rijksrecherche investigates, that no standard periodic case review exists though local contacts do, declined to comment on individual cases, and saw no need for a standard, while promising a further letter before summer on police-mental health cooperation.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Op individuele gevallen kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Grinwis over de technische correcties van de CO2-doelen voor de glastuinbouwsector

MPs Valstar and Grinwis asked about technical corrections to CO2 emission ceilings for the greenhouse horticulture sector for 2018 to 2020, including delays and financial consequences. The ministers confirmed a correction for 2018 in line with the covenant criteria, said 2019 and 2020 ceilings would also be corrected and published, and committed to a new individual system and covenant 2021–2030.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het volgen van politiek geëngageerde burgers op sociale media en het mogelijk plegen van censuur

An MP asks ministers whether the government monitored and pressured politically engaged citizens on social media, including a BVNL board member, and whether this amounted to censorship or coordinated trolling. The government denies targeting individuals, says monitoring tools are used only to gauge public debate, denies censorship and trolling, and states it has no legal basis for requiring platforms to remove disinformation.
This is not correct. The central government does not discredit citizens with critical opinions.
Dit klopt niet. De rijksoverheid brengt burgers met een kritische mening niet in diskrediet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de Rijswijkse moordzaak

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the 1985 Rijswijk triple murder, whether the investigation was closed due to links to the Surinamese regime, and whether the case should be reopened after a podcast. The Minister said the investigation covered several scenarios including mistaken identity, closed for lack of leads, cannot disclose details for privacy and investigative reasons, and that prosecution is no longer possible because the offences are time-barred.

Since this is an unsolved case still under the attention of the Den Haag police cold case team, there is, in view of investigative interests and the privacy of victims and relatives, no reason to make investigation data public.

Nu het een niet-opgehelderde zaak betreft die nog onder de aandacht is van het cold caseteam van politie Den Haag, is er – met het oog op de belangen van opsporing en de privacy van slachtoffers en nabestaanden – geen aanleiding om onderzoeksgegevens openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht 'Online criminelen bestoken de wereld met cyberaanvallen vanuit Nederland'

An MP asked the ministers of Justice, Economic Affairs and the State Secretary for Interior about reports that criminals use Dutch servers and hosting resellers for cyberattacks, asking about scale, enforcement, cooperation and hosting-sector responsibility. The government answered that ransomware is a growing threat with low reporting rates, that enforcement is complicated by foreign perpetrators and anonymity, and that it supports EU measures and sector codes while pointing to ongoing coalition agreement work.
If your House requests a technical briefing, this can be provided.
Indien uw Kamer verzoekt om een technische briefing kan daarin worden voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Rajkowski inzake berichten omtrent cyberaanvallen op Oekraïne en Nederlandse servers

Two VVD MPs asked whether Russia used Dutch servers to launch cyberattacks on Ukraine, whether hosting firms screen tenants, and what police can do. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that hosting firms have no legal duty to screen clients, police lack screening powers, and the government supports EU Digital Services Act rules for notice-and-takedown and reseller abuse, while ruling out stricter police checks on hosters.
Screening of clients by hosting providers is not a legal obligation.
Het screenen van klanten door hostingproviders is geen wettelijke verplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Rajkowski inzake het bericht ‘Ddos'er die fiscus, banken en Tweakers aanviel, krijgt 200 uur taakstraf’

MPs Rajkowski and Ellian asked about a news report on a DDoS attacker sentenced to 200 hours of community service, including whether such attacks on vital services are treated as aggravating, conviction numbers, recidivism, the Hack_Right intervention and delays in criminal cases. The Minister answered that attacks on vital infrastructure can raise the maximum sentence, gave limited conviction figures, said recidivism data are unavailable, described Hack_Right and planned funding, and declined to analyse published judgments on reasonable-time violations as too time-consuming.
Examining published judgments on rechtspraak.nl is very time-consuming and current capacity does not allow such research to be carried out.
Het onderzoeken van gepubliceerde uitspraken op rechtspraak.nl is zeer tijdrovend en de huidige capaciteit laat het momenteel niet toe een dergelijk onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Minhas over het bericht ‘Alarm om agressie op spoor en station’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Minhas asked about rising aggression against rail and public transport staff, including the role of conductors as boa's, their equipment and police response times. The Minister answered that incidents rose (NS 660 to 744, regional transport 787 to 977), outlined the NS request for database access to verify identities, and promised talks with NS and police but gave limited concrete commitments.
To improve the information position of boa's when establishing identity, it is important to give them better access to information so they can carry out their tasks independently.
Om de informatiepositie van boa's te verbeteren bij het vaststellen van de identiteit is het belangrijk hen betere toegang te geven tot informatie voor een zelfstandige taakuitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Sneller over een vrijwillige bijdrage aan het Internationaal Strafhof ten behoeve van een onderzoek naar oorlogsmisdrijven, misdrijven tegen de menselijkheid en genocide geple

Two D66 MPs asked whether the government knows of the ICC prosecutor's opening of an investigation into Ukraine and the prosecutor's call for extra funding, and whether it will provide extra money. The government confirmed awareness, supports the investigation, and will pay a voluntary contribution of 1 million euro to the ICC's trust fund while pushing partners for more funding.
The Netherlands will transfer a voluntary financial contribution of 1 million euros to the Trust Fund recently established for the Office of the Prosecutor.
In dat licht zal Nederland een vrijwillige financiële bijdrage van 1 miljoen euro overmaken aan het Trust Fund dat recent ten behoeve van het Parket van de Aanklager is opgericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over belangenbehartigers die betalen voor cliëntgegevens om zaken binnen te halen

MPs Van Nispen and Ellian asked whether the government will act against third parties paying for victims' personal data to win injury claims, and whether a fee ban should be considered. The minister acknowledged the practice, said existing rules and the sector's Nationaal Keurmerk Letselschade adequately protect victims, and declined to introduce a fee ban for now.
The existing rules and regulations provide sufficiently adequate protection for injury victims against dishonest practices, so a fee ban is, in my view, not currently on the agenda.

De bestaande norm- en regelgeving bieden voldoende adequaat bescherming aan slachtoffers met letselschade tegen malafide praktijken, waardoor een provisieverbod wat mij betreft nu niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Ergernis mkb over aandeel klimaatkosten'

Leijten (SP) asks why SMEs bear about 80% of climate subsidy costs while large industry contributes little, and whether households are disproportionately burdened. Minister Jetten replies that the 2020 cost split was shifted to 33% households and 67% businesses with large energy users paying more, that the polluter-pays principle is endorsed, and that existing exemptions will be phased out.
I am of the view that with the measures the cabinet is taking a good balance is achieved in the burdens falling on small and larger enterprises.
Ik ben van mening dat met de maatregelen die het kabinet treft een goed evenwicht wordt gerealiseerd in de lasten die optreden bij kleine en grotere ondernemingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Leijten over het bericht ‘Maxima als test voor de monarchie’ uit het Algemeen Dagblad van 31 januari 2022 en de documentaire ‘Een Porseleinen Huwelijk van BNNVARA

MPs Sneller and Leijten asked the Prime Minister and ministers about press and documentary reports on the 2001 decision not to prosecute Jorge Zorreguieta, the role of the Prosecution Service, and an intelligence check on him and Edwin de Roy van Zuydewijn without ministers being informed. The government answered in detail on the chain of communication, the BVD check, and safeguards, denying political influence over the prosecution decision and describing the current naslag arrangements.
No indication of political influence on the content of this decision has been found.
Van politieke beïnvloeding van de inhoud van deze beslissing is niet gebleken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Thijssen over de berichten ‘Studenten zien warmtekosten verdubbelen: ‘Het is mijn vakantiebudget’ en ‘Forse prijsverhoging voor huishoudens met ‘duurzame’ stadsverwarming: ‘We s

MPs Nijboer and Thijssen asked about reports of doubled heating costs for students and steep price rises on district heating, asking whether students should get the extra energy allowance, whether heat tariffs should be decoupled from gas prices, and whether tenants should be protected from passed-on costs. The minister answered that students are excluded from the categorical energy allowance in favour of individual assistance, that the new heat supply act will decouple tariffs from gas prices by late 2022, and that passing on higher energy costs is reasonable.
I am currently looking at how to submit this bill to the Council of State before the summer and then to the House of Representatives at the end of 2022.
Ik bekijk momenteel hoe ik dit wetsvoorstel voor de zomer aan kan bieden aan de Raad van State en daarna eind 2022 aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Kuiken, Nijboer en De Hoop over 50.000 opvangplekken voor vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne

Opposition PvdA MPs asked how the government will support municipalities in securing and managing about 50,000 reception places for Ukrainian refugees, and about preparations for education, healthcare, housing, language lessons and work. The government answered that safety regions coordinate place creation with municipalities, a national reception programme is being prepared, and that housing, education and healthcare measures are being worked out, with further letters promised.
The cabinet considers it important that displaced persons from Ukraine residing in our country have the opportunity to learn the Dutch language
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat ontheemden uit Oekraïne die in ons land verblijven de mogelijkheid hebben om de Nederlandse taal te leren

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken, Dekker-Abdulaziz en Rajkowski over de beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen inzake de vacature 'Senior beleidsmedewerker interceptie en digitale opsporing' bij het Minist

Three MPs asked the Justice Minister about a senior policy vacancy on interception and digital investigation, and whether intelligence services could intercept encrypted OTT communications, and how quantum threats to encryption should be handled. The minister said intelligence services fall under other ministers, that an inventory of lawful access to encrypted evidence is underway with EU work pending, that OTT providers are currently not subject to decryption obligations, and that quantum effects on encryption fall outside the inventory's scope.
I cannot speak for the intelligence and security services (IenV services), as these services fall under the portfolios of the Ministers of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and of Defence.

Ik kan niet voor de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten (IenV-diensten) spreken, deze diensten vallen onder de portefeuille van de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het gebrek aan een planning rond afspraken over eergerelateerd geweld en zelfbeschikking uit het coalitieakkoord

The MP Becker asked the ministers whether the coalition agreement's commitments on honour-related violence, self-determination and female genital mutilation are adequately planned, and when proposals on penalties, reporting duties and protection orders will come. The government answers that a multi-year prevention programme on self-determination and a broader plan on harmful practices will be sent to the House before the summer recess, that existing law already allows prosecution of accomplices, and that no separate proposal will be sent on that point.
As indicated in the answer to question 5, the House will be further informed about the approach to harmful practices, including a multi-year programme to promote self-determination.

Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 5 aangegeven, wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd over de inzet op schadelijke praktijken waaronder ook over een meerjarig programma gericht op de bevordering van zelfbeschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Omtzigt over het bericht dat het onderzoek naar fraude bij de landsadvocaat onvolledig en niet onafhankelijk genoeg was

MPs Van Nispen and Omtzigt asked the Justice Minister about reports that the deken's investigation into fraud at Pels Rijcken was incomplete and insufficiently independent, and about the effectiveness of oversight of law firms. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, pointed to planned reforms creating a single national supervisor for advocates, and said talks with the NOvA are ongoing, with no firm commitment on the specific demands.
Given the independence of the legal profession and its supervision, I am reluctant to respond to an individual case, and this is no exception.
Gelet op de onafhankelijkheid van de advocatuur en het toezicht daarop ben ik terughoudend met het reageren op een individuele casus, zo ook deze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een vergewisplicht voor websites met naaktbeelden en pornografisch materiaal

An MP asks whether a court ruling requiring adult websites to verify consent of people appearing in intimate material should lead to a general duty on platforms to verify consent and age, and whether the minister will discuss consequences with the industry. The minister says the ruling confirms earlier positions, rejects a general verification duty as conflicting with EU liability rules and no-general-monitoring principles, but will raise platform obligations in existing working groups and EU-level agreements.
A general verification duty is in tension with the liability exclusion for service hosting providers and the prohibition of general monitoring.
Een algemene vergewisplicht staat op gespannen voet met de uitsluiting van aansprakelijkheid zoals die geldt voor service hosting providers en het verbod op algemene monitoring
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de racistische intimidatie van een gezin in Giethoorn en de gebrekkige reactie daarop van lokale instanties

MPs Belhaj asked about the racist intimidation of a Turkish-origin family in Giethoorn and the slow police and municipal response. The minister acknowledged the failings, said police will stress discrimination policy, a discrimination detective pilot is planned, and the mayor's role is being discussed, but declined to comment on individual cases.
It is not for the cabinet to intervene in individual cases, and for that reason no substantive answer can be given to this question.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om in individuele zaken te treden en om die reden kan op deze vraag geen inhoudelijk antwoord worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Criminelen gebruiken foute hostingbedrijven voor activiteiten vanuit Nederland'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police warnings regarding Dutch hosting companies that rent server space to criminals, including what actions were taken and whether hosts can be held liable. The minister replied that hosts currently enjoy conditional liability protection under EU and Dutch law, that the police share lists with the hosting industry body without tracking outcomes, and that the government supports tighter notice-and-takedown rules in the Digital Services Act.
Due to the lack of quantitative data and the low reporting willingness for cybercrime offences, a reliable estimate of the damage is not available.
Vanwege het ontbreken van kwantitatieve gegevens en de lage aangiftebereidheid van cybercrimedelicten is een betrouwbare inschatting van de schade niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het stopzetten van de succesvolle gedragsinterventie “sport en gedrag”

MP Van Nispen asks whether the 'Sport en Gedrag' behavioural intervention, which runs on project funding until end-2022, will be continued and funded structurally, and whether Halt or the Justice Ministry should take it over. The Minister says the intervention is well-regarded but its effects are not yet proven, that funding after 2022 is still under discussion with Halt and the KNVB, and that the justice role of Halt does not cover cases without a police report.
For a decision on funding after 2022 it is therefore still too early.
Voor een besluit over de financiering na 2022 is het daarom nu nog te vroeg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en De Neef over het bericht 'Weer meer incidenten met verwarde personen'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and De Neef asked about rising police registrations of incidents involving people with confused behaviour (over 100,000 in 2020, 130,184 in 2021) and whether most are care matters rather than police matters, plus what measures and national teams have done, how municipal approaches differ, and whether the Veldhoven model and suggested joint police-care consultations should be adopted. The minister answered that the registration rise is not a clear indicator of growth, outlined ongoing triage pilots and national programmes, and promised to consider the suggestions and inform parliament before summer.

Although I share the concerns about the number of registrations, based on the registration of E33 reports it is not possible to state in general terms what share of these cases actually required care or support.

Hoewel ik de zorgen over het aantal registraties deel, is het op basis van de registratie van E33-meldingen niet mogelijk om in algemene zin aan te geven in welk aandeel van deze gevallen eigenlijk zorg of ondersteuning nodig was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over omgang met explosieven door overheden

Senator Stoffer (SGP) asked ministers about the handling of explosives by government, after a WWII aircraft bomb exploded on a Wassenaar beach, including steps, coordination, responsibilities, costs and whether a central authority is needed. The government answered that the process runs through municipalities, police and the EODD, that existing coordination suffices, that no central authority or further centralisation is warranted, and it declined to consult additional expert bodies.
Further coordination and centralisation does not lead to more efficient policy, and therefore not to a reduction in costs.
Verdere coördinatie en centralisatie leidt niet tot doelmatiger beleid, en daarmee dus niet tot reductie van kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Michon-Derksen over activiteiten van radicaal extremistische dierenactivisten

MPs Van Campen and Michon-Derkzen asked about criminal activities by radical animal-rights extremists (stable occupations, break-ins, arson, smear campaigns, online intimidation), overview of cases and sentences, enforcement roles, legal basis and disclosure of farm data.
