The minister said no overview is available since there is no specific classification for animal-rights extremism, police remain primarily responsible with an agreed contact point and factsheet, and existing legal grounds suffice, while committing to examine stronger penalties and to send a letter to farm organisations before summer.
It is not possible for the police and the Public Prosecution Service to provide an overview of the past 10 years of such criminal activities on and around agricultural businesses.
Het is voor de politie en het OM niet mogelijk om een overzicht te geven van de afgelopen 10 jaar betreffende dergelijke strafbare activiteiten op en rond een agrarisch bedrijf
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Werf over de oproep om Rusland uit te sluiten van INTERPOL

Two MPs from D66 asked whether the government supports calls to exclude Russia from INTERPOL over fears of misuse of its systems against critics. The Minister of Justice and Security confirmed awareness of the calls, explained INTERPOL's corrective measures against Russia's National Central Bureau, and said the Netherlands requested a review, noting that measures were adopted and apply until the next Executive Committee meeting.
The Minister of Justice and Security on 4 March sent a letter asking the Secretary General of INTERPOL to assess the need for corrective measures against the Russian Federation.

De Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid heeft op 4 maart jl. per brief de Secretaris Generaal van INTERPOL verzocht de noodzaak tot het opleggen van corrigerende maatregelen ten aanzien van de Russische Federatie te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Chinese douanescanners Schiphol en Rotterdamse haven onder vuur: 'Dit is onbegrijpelijk''

CDA MPs asked ministers about reports that Chinese-owned Nuctech scanners are used by Dutch customs and whether Nuctech's ties to the Chinese state, low bids and security risks were properly assessed. The government answered that it weighs national security risks case by case, found no abnormally low bids, cannot guarantee that the Chinese state has no access to the scanners, and is conducting follow-up security research.
The cabinet cannot give any guarantees about this.
Het kabinet kan hier geen garanties over geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht dat 'Vandalen coronarellen ontlopen betalen van aangerichte schade'

An MP asked the Justice Minister how the government responds to reports that rioters over COVID measures escape paying for damage, and why damages recovery from perpetrators has been limited. The minister answered that businesses were compensated via a scheme, that recovery from offenders is partly successful but not yet concluded, and that the government is working with the prosecution service on recovery options and awaits the advisory commission's proposals.
Figures on the criminal recovery of damage compensation measures are not registered.
Cijfers rondom het strafrechtelijk vorderen van de schademaatregelen worden niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de vandalen van de coronarellen het betalen van aangerichte schade ontlopen

An SP MP asked why perpetrators of the January 2021 Covid-protest riots have paid little of the damage they caused, and why a victim-damage fund was never set up. The Minister of Justice answered that about 55 convicted rioters were ordered to pay about €551,000, of which only about €36,700 had been collected by January 2022, that the government compensated affected businesses and took over their claims, and that it is still examining how to recover these amounts from perpetrators.
However, I can assure you that it is my ambition to have perpetrators pay as much as possible for the damage caused.
Ik kan u echter verzekeren dat het mijn ambitie is om daders zoveel als mogelijk te laten betalen voor de aangerichte schade.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Ellian over het bericht dat veel vandalen de forse schade van de coronarellen niet hoeven te vergoeden

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Ellian asked whether perpetrators of damage during the 2021 COVID curfew riots are escaping paying compensation, and why enforcement differs between regions. The Minister acknowledges that offenders should pay, reports that about 55 perpetrators have compensation orders totalling roughly €551,000 with €36,700 collected so far, and says that cessation of claims to the state for the Regeling Bedrijvenschade is being examined with the OM, while noting that full recovery will not be possible in all cases.
Figures on criminal-procedure claims for damages orders are not recorded, so it cannot be shown whether there are large differences between regions.
Cijfers rondom het strafrechtelijk vorderen van de schademaatregelen worden niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het verspreiden van schadelijke desinformatie over de wolf

An MP asked the ministers of Nature and Nitrogen and of Justice and Security about a hound among sheep reports, wolf diet, Flemish penalties, and how to combat disinformation about wolves through criminal law, platform responsibility and awareness campaigns. The minister answered that there is no central data on livestock killed by dogs, that existing law and penalties are adequate, that disinformation is protected speech except where it leads to unlawful acts, and that a wolf plan with information will follow after summer.
Figures on farm animals killed by dogs are not available, because there is no central registration of this.
Cijfers van landbouwhuisdieren die gedood worden door honden zijn niet beschikbaar, omdat hier geen centrale registratie van plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het tegengaan criminele activiteiten via de verzending van postpakketten

An MP asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about rising drug trafficking through parcel post, the Customs and police interception results, the Sensing project, screening rates, and whether senders should be required to identify themselves. The minister reported intensified Customs controls and seizures, planned a Multidisciplinary Post Team, and rejected a sender identification requirement as ineffective and disproportionate, while committing to examine ways to lift sender anonymity.
It is not possible to state how many parcels or postal items are checked in this way, as this is not recorded.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel pakketten of poststukken op deze wijzen gecontroleerd worden, dit wordt niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het bericht 'Experts: kabinet kan levering gas deze winter niet garanderen'

MP Thijssen asked the government whether the Netherlands can guarantee gas supply this winter, why it did not fill strategic reserves or require long-term contracts like other states, and whether it had acted irresponsibly. Minister Jetten answered that the Norg Akkoord and a statutory supply-security regulation protect household supply, that the market is integrated and the government does not leave security fully to the market, and that the government is considering mandatory storage fill levels while maintaining that long-term contracts for Dutch supply would be impractical.
The cabinet has taken various measures to ensure supply security for protected customers.
Het kabinet heeft diverse maatregelen genomen om de leveringszekerheid te borgen voor beschermde afnemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over procesafspraken tussen verdachte en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM)

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about plea-style agreements (procesafspraken) between the public prosecution service and suspects, which courts have found lack a statutory basis. The Minister replied that the agreements fall within prosecutorial discretion, that a draft OM directive is under discussion and will be published once final, and that no legislative change is considered necessary.
It is therefore desirable that, as the College of Procurators General intends, the conditions for making procedural agreements are laid down transparently in an OM directive.

Het is daarom gewenst dat – zoals het College van procureurs-generaal zich voorneemt – de randvoorwaarden voor het maken van procesafspraken op transparante wijze worden vastgelegd in een OM-aanwijzing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht 'European gas prices shoot to new high as energy crunch worsens'

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary about European gas price spikes, supply security risks, preparedness measures, a prioritisation framework for industrial gas users, gas storage levels, dependence on imports, nuclear phase-out effects, coal plant output limits, and follow-up on a motion for an independent security-of-supply study. The Minister answered at length, describing the Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas preparations, export phase-down plans, storage figures, and TenneT monitoring, while stating that the independent study requires a tender procedure and the storage obligation will be detailed later.

As indicated in the answers to questions 2 and 3, the cabinet has started preparations, in response to the gas market situation, for implementing the Gas Protection and Recovery Plan under current legislation.

Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op de vragen 2 en 3 is het kabinet naar aanleiding van de situatie in de gasmarkt voorbereiding gestart voor het uitvoeren van het Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas onder de huidige wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de antwoorden op schriftelijke vragen over fors hogere elektriciteits- en gasprijzen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Climate and Energy whether the government's figures on Dutch gas storage fill levels were too optimistic, whether the storage was sufficiently full to secure supply to protected customers in a cold winter, and whether the government should call on consumers to reduce gas use earlier. The minister acknowledged that the earlier figures mixed Dutch storage with cross-border German storage, referred to the Norg Agreement for protected customers, and explained the three crisis levels of the Protection and Recovery Plan, noting that no member state had declared a crisis level.

The presented 45% was the fill level at the beginning of the second week of December of the Dutch high-calorific gas storages combined with the fill level of storages just across the German border that are directly accessible from the Netherlands.

De gepresenteerde 45% was de vulgraad aan het begin van de tweede week van december van de Nederlandse opslagen voor hoogcalorisch gas gecombineerd met de vulgraad net over de grens met Duitsland gelegen opslagen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over uithuisgeplaatste kinderen en het toeslagenschandaal

An MP asked the government about children placed out of home in the childcare benefits scandal, including reunification prospects, complaint procedures at the youth care inspectorate and certified institutions, the scope of the inspectorates' investigation, and legal protection for parents and children. The minister answered at length, often stating that the inspectorates lack competence to handle individual complaints, declined to name the investigators, and said the requested two-week deadline could not be met.
I am not willing to give you the names of the staff (officials) of the inspectorates who carry out the investigation.
Ik ben niet bereid u de namen te geven van de medewerkers (ambtenaren) van de inspecties die het onderzoek uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Nispen, Knops en Agnes Mulder over de toetreding van de EU tot het EVRM

MPs Van Dijk, Van Nispen, Knops and Mulder asked about the status of the EU's accession to the European Convention on Human Rights, the remaining legal and political objections, and when talks would resume. The minister replied that negotiations are progressing slowly through seven rounds since 2020, that several legal objections remain (partly resolved), the next round is scheduled for May 2022, and the Netherlands will actively push to speed up accession.
The Netherlands wishes to fulfil the treaty obligation for the EU's accession to the ECHR as quickly as possible.
Nederland wenst de verdragsrechtelijke verplichting tot toetreding van de EU tot het EVRM zo snel mogelijk te vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Boucke over het bericht dat Rusland BUK-afweersystemen bij de grens met Oekraïne plaatst

Two D66 MPs asked the government about reports that Russia placed BUK and S-300/S-400 air defence systems near the Ukrainian border and what this means for civil aviation safety, including IFALPA and ECA warnings and recommendations from the Dutch Safety Board on airspace closure criteria. The ministers answered that monitoring continues, that KLM and other airlines suspended Ukraine flights, that Dutch airspace-closure powers for airlines face legal and practical objections, and that the government is working on international criteria.
Dutch airlines did not fly there.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de WNL-documentaire ‘Vertrouwelijk’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether Peter R. de Vries declined police protection, whether any other protective measures were taken, and what was done about reports of him being followed. The Minister declined to provide any information on whether protective measures were taken, citing operational security, and deferred to the ongoing Dutch Safety Board investigation while describing general strengthening of the protection system.
I cannot make any statements about whether security measures were taken or not.
Over al dan niet genomen beveiligingsmaatregelen kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boucke over de verdere stappen in het project over de aanlanding van de Kabel Ten noorden van de Waddeneilanden (TNW)

Two D66 MPs asked the minister about the next steps for the cable landing of Net op Zee Ten noorden van de Waddeneilanden, including routes through the Ems and the Westerschelde precedent for stability and maintenance. The minister answered that a stable route is preferred, that an eastern Ems route will be examined in the new programme, and that the route under the shipping channel will be included in the study, pending contact with German authorities.
I intend to include the route variant under the shipping channel in the study.
Ik ben voornemens de routevariant onder de vaargeul op te nemen in het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over de vacature 'Senior beleidsmedewerker interceptie en digitale opsporing'

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a vacancy for a senior policy officer on interception and digital investigation, including research into lawful interception of encrypted OTT messaging services such as WhatsApp and Signal, and about the purpose, pros and cons of end-to-end encryption and how such communication could be made interceptable. The minister confirms the vacancy and the ongoing inventory, explains that encryption currently blocks lawful access, and says the work is open-ended, with a WODC study on encryption's impact and an EU-level process pending, while declining to give concrete options yet.
I cannot yet give an answer to this. Should the research produce results, I will inform the House of the outcomes and take them into account in the assessment and further deliberation.
Ik kan hierop nog geen antwoord geven. Ik zal uw Kamer indien het onderzoek resultaten heeft opgeleverd informeren over de uitkomsten en meenemen in de weging en verdere gedachtenvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Warmerdam over het gebruik van het stroomstootwapen bij patiënten in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg

An MP asked the Justice and Security and Long-term Care ministers about police use of the taser on psychiatric patients, including the LOC's call for a ban, the status of promised independent health-effects research, alternatives and the risks for vulnerable people. The minister says police use there is exceptional and a ban is undesirable, that police cannot count taser use in care settings, that the promised research is more complex than expected and will be reported later, and that no equivalent alternatives are known.
This question cannot be answered. The police do not explicitly register a mental health institution as an 'incident location' in their registration system.
Deze vraag kan niet worden beantwoord. De politie registreert niet expliciet een ggz-instelling als «incident locatie» in haar registratiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over witwaspraktijken bij de landsadvocaat

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice Minister about money-laundering practices linked to the state's legal adviser Pels Rijcken, including whether it should be prosecuted, the status of investigations, the planned expert commission, whether a Bibob check should apply, and why no sanction was imposed unlike ING. The Minister declined substantive comment citing ongoing criminal investigations, pointed to the Bar and financial supervisor reviews, said the commission's details would follow, and explained the ING transaction as a prosecutorial matter.
Since the criminal investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make substantive statements about this in the interest of the investigation.
Aangezien het strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog lopende is, kan ik in het belang van het onderzoek geen inhoudelijke uitspraken hierover doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder, Markuszower en de Graaf over het bericht ‘Hoofddoek boa moet kunnen’

MPs Helder, Markuszower and De Graaf asked whether Arnhem's decision to allow headscarves on municipal enforcement officers' (boa) uniforms conflicts with two adopted House motions, and what the minister will do about it. The minister said municipal councils may adopt their own motions, that a national guideline on boa uniform neutrality will be drafted in dialogue with the VNG and local government, and that the choice of instrument will be reported to the House in spring.

To this end, I will, in dialogue with the Association of Netherlands Municipalities (VNG) and local government, draft a guideline that secures the neutrality and nationwide uniformity and recognisability of the boa uniform.

Hiertoe zal ik, in dialoog met de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) en het lokaal bestuur, een richtlijn opstellen waarin de neutraliteit en landelijke uniformiteit en herkenbaarheid van het boa-uniform worden geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'Op bezoek bij omstreden fietskoeriers: 'We zullen nooit pushen om harder te rijden''

An MP asked the ministers whether the rapid rise of quick-delivery couriers causes traffic danger, nuisance and streetscape decline, what tools municipalities have, and about research, consultations and youth-courier initiatives. The minister answered that municipalities hold the main instruments, that research results are due later in 2022 and that consultations with the G4 will be shared after the summer.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het meedoen van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid aan de Nationale Week Zonder Vlees & Zuivel en het invoeren van het principe 'Carnivoor? Geef het door!'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the ministry would take part in the National Week Without Meat and Dairy and adopt a plant-based catering default, citing climate and health benefits. The minister answered that the ministry joins government-wide initiatives, shifts canteen and meeting catering toward plant-based food, and that the answers were not ready in time.
Within JenV, the various company restaurants and the catering for meetings therefore increasingly focus on plant-based food.
Binnen JenV 5 worden bij de verschillende bedrijfsrestaurants en bij de catering voor vergaderingen daarom steeds meer ingezet op plantaardige voeding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over het bericht 'FIOD-speurders thuis na vergoedingenruzie'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Idsinga asked about reports that the FIOD suspended its Team Specialistische Operaties over an allowance dispute, and about the team's role, the cause, and the atmosphere within the FIOD. The Secretary of State declined to give details, citing an ongoing labour and court dispute and the employer's duty of care, while saying investigations continue with partner agencies and that the directorate seeks a swift resolution.
No statement is made on the specific content. The matter is before the court.
Over de specifieke inhoud wordt geen mededeling gedaan. De zaak is onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Knops over het bericht 'FIOD-speurders thuis na vergoedingenruzie'

CDA MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reports that a FIOD special operations team was sent home for months over an allowance dispute and alleged fear-based management culture. The State Secretary declined to discuss specifics because of the labour and court proceedings, denied knowledge of such a culture without signals, and said efforts were underway to find a quick solution.
This is a labour-law dispute between employees and their employer. I cannot make any public statements about it.
Er is hier sprake van een arbeidsrechtelijk geschil tussen werknemers en hun werkgever. Ik kan hierover in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over mogelijke schendingen van het verschoningsrecht door OM en FIOD

MP Van Nispen asked whether the OM and FIOD have breached legal privilege (verschoningsrecht) for lawyers, how they handle privileged material, whether the Landsadvocaat was consulted, who supervises the geheimhouder-officier van justitie, and whether an independent review or central body is needed. The Minister explains the procedures (rechter-commissaris review, geheimhouder-officier and -medewerker, Hoge Raad 2020 ruling, OM guidance being updated) and says the PG at the Hoge Raad supervises the OM, declining to add a new review power for now.
In the interest of ongoing cases I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan in het belang van lopende zaken niet op individuele zaken ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de mogelijkheden van 112 bellen als iemand niet kan spreken

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about the 112 emergency protocol when callers cannot speak, the accessibility of alternative 112 options, a silent-call code, the registration requirement for emergency SMS, and the share of prank or misuse calls. The minister described the protocol and disconnection rules, said alternatives are being made easier and a 'can't speak now' button is planned, noted 1,361 SMS registrations, and reported that about 40 percent of 112 calls are misuse.
In a future update of the 112NL app this option will be introduced via an 'I cannot speak now' button.
In een toekomstige update van de 112NL-app wordt deze mogelijkheid geïntroduceerd middels een «ik-kan-nu-niet-spreken-knop».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over harde kritiek op politieonderdeel dat voor geheime operaties verantwoordelijk is

An MP asked the Justice Minister about harsh criticism of the police unit running covert operations, including an unsafe work climate, favouritism and internal conflict, and about the Brouwer commission findings on a death linked to the team's work. The minister acknowledges structural problems, points to a corrective programme ordered by the police chief and a pending Sorgdrager advisory report on safeguards, and says accountability for individual staff rests with police leadership.
It is not appropriate for me as Minister of Justice and Security to make statements about the functioning of individual police officers.
Het past mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid niet om uitspraken te doen over het functioneren van individuele politiemedewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over suïcide onder agenten waarbij het dienstwapen is gebruikt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about suicides among police officers using their service weapon, including delays in the promised guidance for supervisors on taking back service weapons, the inspectorate's handling of a family's concerns, and whether criminal investigation is blocked by state immunity. The minister answered that the handbook was finished in 2019, that a supervisor conversation guide is being developed, that the inspectorate's findings were shared only verbally at the family's request, and that the prosecutor's decision not to investigate the state is not for the minister to judge.
Beforehand it was agreed with the next of kin and their lawyer that the findings would only be shared orally with them.
Vooraf is met de nabestaande en diens advocaat afgesproken de uitkomsten enkel mondeling met hen te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht ‘De digitale knokploeg van Forum voor Democratie’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that Forum voor Democratie supporters on Telegram threaten political opponents and share addresses, and what police and platforms can do. The minister declined to judge the specific case, outlined police observation powers and platform obligations, and noted pending doxing legislation.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to comment on this specific case.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om mij uit te spreken over dit specifieke geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht ‘verdrievoudiging van bedreigingen en geweld tegen gemeenteraadsleden

MPs Inge van Dijk and Palland asked about a report that threats and violence against municipal councillors had tripled since 2015, and about support, aftercare and measures against intimidation. The minister responded that the government works with the Netwerk Weerbaar Bestuur on norms, prevention and aftercare, will report monitoring results before summer, and that the doxing bill will be sent to parliament after the Council of State advises.
I consider it important to periodically monitor how the number and form of intimidation and threats against councillors and other local political office holders develop.
Ik vind het belangrijk om periodiek te monitoren hoe het aantal gevallen en de vorm van intimidatie en bedreiging onder raadsleden en andere decentrale politieke ambtsdragers zich ontwikkelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de strafbaarstelling van femicide

An MP asked the Minister of Justice whether femicide with a sexist motive should get its own offence with a higher maximum sentence than ordinary manslaughter, and whether the current definition of premeditation is too hard to prove in cases after stalking or abuse. The minister answered that the existing offences suffice, pointed to a bill raising the manslaughter maximum from 15 to 25 years, and said prevention efforts with police and Veilig Thuis are the focus.
For additional legislative measures in the form of a specific offence of manslaughter with a sexist motive carrying a higher maximum penalty, I see no need.
Voor aanvullende wetgevende maatregelen in de vorm van een specifieke strafbaarstelling van doodslag met een seksistisch oogmerk met een hoger strafmaximum zie ik geen noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de gevolgen van een uitspraak van het Europees Hof voor de energietaken van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM)

Deputy MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked the government about the consequences of a September 2021 EU Court of Justice ruling on the independence of national energy regulators for ACM's tariff powers, the Energiewet, gas connection removal costs, the volume correction scheme, offshore wind cost recovery and connection deadlines. Minister Jetten answered that the national legislator may no longer set certain tariff rules, which are being removed from the draft Energiewet, that existing tariffs stay valid for 2022, and that ACM will handle connection deadlines, while declining to provide detailed connection-time data.
The ruling means that ACM, rather than the legislator, will have to set or approve the deadlines for realising connections and ensure compliance with European principles.

De uitspraak betekent dat de ACM in plaats van de wetgever de termijnen voor het realiseren van aansluitingen zal moeten vaststellen of goedkeuren en daarbij moet zorgen dat wordt voldaan aan de Europese beginselen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het bericht 'Windparken veel rendabeler dan de overheid vooraf inschat'

MP Thijssen asked whether subsidies for onshore wind projects under the SDE++ scheme are excessive, given a study finding high equity returns (47%), and about profit-sharing with local residents. The minister acknowledges the risk of overstimulation, says the true extent cannot be determined yet, points to an ongoing independent evaluation and PBL advice, and rejects mandatory profit-sharing as impractical.
I will inform your House of the outcomes of the evaluation as soon as possible.
Ik zal uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk over de uitkomsten van de evaluatie informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het bericht ‘gigabytes aan data van asielzoekers doorzocht: geen terrorist gevonden’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about press reports that the police's Athene pilot wrongly harvested and analysed data from asylum seekers' phones without finding terrorists, and whether this risked ethnic profiling and privacy violations. The minister defended the project as aimed at identity verification and detecting terrorism and trafficking, said ethnicity was not an indicator, stopped the project, destroyed the data, and pointed to existing algorithm guidelines and a planned algorithm register without accepting wrongdoing or offering compensation.
The project has been stopped and all investigative information previously received by AVIM under the Athene project has been destroyed.
Het project is stopgezet en alle door AVIM eerder ontvangen opsporingsinformatie in het kader van het project Athene is vernietigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ginneken, Van der Laan en Simons over de moorden op, geweld tegen en zelfdodingen door trans-personen in Nederland

MPs Simons, Van der Laan and Van Ginneken asked about murders of, violence against, and suicides among trans people in the Netherlands, including official statistics, a registration system, anti-violence and reporting policy, and suicide prevention. The Minister answered that no separate registration system is planned, cited police and prosecution data, and described existing LHBTI safety, reporting and suicide-prevention measures and waiting-list efforts in trans care.
In light of the available material, I see no reason to set up an additional registration system.
In het licht van het beschikbare materiaal, zie ik geen aanleiding om een aanvullend registratiesysteem in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Gebiedsverboden en mobiele flitspalen: zo wil Haagse VVD verkeersaso’s aanpakken'

MPs Koerhuis and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked the ministers about enforcement of traffic rules on municipal roads, the number and use of speed cameras, and how the Public Prosecution Service decides where to place them. The government answered that enforcement is set locally by the tripartite consultation (mayor, police, prosecution), that flitspaal placement follows a published policy framework, and that it will inform the House in early 2022 on new enforcement tools for notorious offenders.
Police deployment for traffic enforcement is determined locally in the tripartite consultation (mayor, police and Public Prosecution Service).
De inzet van de politie op verkeershandhaving wordt lokaal in de driehoek (burgemeester, politie en OM) bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Energy Charter Treaty: stalled reform fuels EU fears for climate”

An MP asks whether the stalled modernisation of the Energy Charter Treaty shows that the Netherlands should withdraw, why it is not in the anti-ECT alliance, and how fossil investment protection and pending ISDS cases against the Netherlands fit with climate goals. Minister Jetten answers that the Netherlands pursues modernisation via the Commission mandate, keeps withdrawal as a possible option if talks fail, and will submit any amendment to parliament for approval.
In accordance with the Constitution and the Approval and Publication of Treaties Act, a proposed amendment to the ECT will be submitted to the States General for approval.
Conform de Grondwet en de Rijkswet goedkeuring en bekendmaking verdragen zal een voorgestelde verdragswijziging van het ECT aan de Staten-Generaal worden voorgelegd voor goedkeuring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over het Energy Charter Treaty

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked the government about the modernisation of the Energy Charter Treaty, arbitration claims by RWE, Uniper and Riverstone over Dutch coal-phase-out policy, and whether investor claims threaten climate policy. The government answered that the EU seeks to align the treaty with the Paris Agreement, that it is still negotiating and will reconsider options such as withdrawal after the next negotiation rounds, and that it has made the arbitration procedures and subsidy documents partly transparent while withholding confidential commercial information.
Due to commercially confidential information, I cannot make the subsidy decision and the underlying advice public.
Vanwege bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie kan ik het subsidiebesluit en de onderliggende adviezen niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Van Ginneken over kindermisbruik

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about child sexual abuse networks, police capacity and psychological support, the removal of abuse imagery online, and legal options under the Digital Services Act. The minister declined to discuss individual prosecutions and operational methods, pointed to existing takedown practices, the planned ATKM oversight authority and EU proposals, and did not commit to new capacity.
Because of operational interests, no further detail is given on specific investigative methods or investigations.
Vanwege het operationeel belang wordt niet nader ingegaan op specifieke opsporingsmethoden of -onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Erkens over het bericht 'Facebook vs. Zeewolde: hoe lokale politici moeten beslissen over een landelijke kwestie'

MPs Rajkowski and Erkens asked about the planned large Meta data centre in Zeewolde, its impact on grid capacity, energy use, heat reuse, national coordination and the conditions attached to the sale of state land. The minister answered that national spatial policy prefers hyperscale centres at the country's edges, set conditions for the land sale, and committed to tighten national steering and admission criteria in a joint letter this spring.
In line with the coalition agreement, this cabinet will tighten national steering and the admission criteria for (hyperscale) data centres.
In lijn met het coalitieakkoord zal dit kabinet de landelijke regie en de toelatingscriteria ten aanzien van (hyperscale) datacenters aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over de plannen voor het hyperscale datacenter van Facebookmoederbedrijf Meta in Zeewolde en andere datacenters

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch (PvdD) asked about Meta's hyperscale data centre plans in Zeewolde, the sale of state land, energy and water use, and grid tariffs. The minister answered that the state conditions the land sale on energy and water standards, and that the government will tighten national steering and licensing criteria for hyperscale data centres.
The cabinet will tighten the choices in the NOVI regarding data centres.
Het kabinet zal de keuzes in de NOVI over datacenters aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een verdwenen onderzoek van de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid

MP Van Nispen asks why an Inspectorate report on police capacity for weapons-licensing (korpscheftaken) was withdrawn and never reached parliament, and whether the ministry pressured the inspectorate. The minister replies that the report was withdrawn on the inspectorate's own initiative because its focus drifted to management capacity, that parliament was informed earlier, and that the inspectorate's independence is adequate, while promising concrete steps and a follow-up letter on the related Wpbr report.
The draft report focused on management aspects, such as financing and the allocation of strength and resources.
Het conceptrapport was gericht op beheersaspecten, zoals de financiering en de verdeling van sterkte en middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Boucke over het artikel 'Anode Energie vraagt faillissement aan vanwege energieprijzen'

MPs Erkens and Boucke asked about the bankruptcy of Anode Energie and other energy suppliers, consumer losses, supplier protection, licensing by the ACM, and possible stress tests. The minister said about 160,000 customers were affected, outlined a study into stricter financial requirements and consumer protection, and announced Energiewet changes such as VOG screening and Bibob checks.

At this moment I am conducting a study into whether it is desirable and possible to set further requirements for the legal framework and, if so, which requirements best achieve the aim and are workable for both energy suppliers and the ACM.

Op dit moment doe ik een onderzoek naar de vraag of het wenselijk en mogelijk is om nadere eisen te stellen aan het wettelijke kader en zo ja, welke eisen het doel het beste bereiken en goed uitvoerbaar zijn voor zowel energieleveranciers als de ACM.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Michon-Derkzen over de berichten ‘Verkeerde waterstanden en gebrek aan regie: veel ging mis bij aanpak watersnood Limburg’ en ‘Waterschap was niet voorbereid op watersnood Limbur

MPs Minhas and Michon-Derkzen asked the ministers about press reports that the Limburg flood response suffered from wrong water-level forecasts and poor coordination, and about the water board's preparedness and the COT evaluation. The minister answered that the water board will implement the COT recommendations, that a flood emergency plan for the Heuvelland is being prepared, and that broader crisis-system reforms and risk mapping are underway, without giving a firm timeline for every point.
The Limburg Water Board is responsible for implementing the recommendations of the COT.
Het Waterschap Limburg is verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de aanbevelingen van het COT.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Bikker over het bericht ‘Meer verkeersongelukken in 2021, politie maakt zich zorgen’

MPs Grinwis and Bikker asked about police concern over rising traffic accidents in 2021, including risky behaviour, nitrous oxide use in traffic, and the road safety targets and funding for dangerous N-roads. The minister outlined prevention and enforcement measures, said the nitrous oxide ban cannot take effect by 1 July 2022 due to procedure, and committed to a road safety target and prioritisation of N-road investments.
The cabinet is committed to reducing traffic participation under the influence of all drugs, and specifically nitrous oxide.
Het kabinet zet zich ervoor in om verkeersdeelname onder invloed van alle drugs, en ook specifiek van lachgas, terug te dringen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Peter de Groot over de uitspraak 201908401/1/R1 van de Raad van State over het verstrekken van omgevingsvergunningen door de gemeente Zutphen aan IJsselwind bv en het waterschap

Two VVD MPs asked the government about the Council of State ruling that annulled the zoning plan and permits for the IJsselwind wind park and the consequences of the related Delfzijl Zuid ruling for general wind turbine rules, municipal and provincial powers, and RES planning. The minister answered that local authorities may set their own environmental norms pending a new plan-MER, that wind projects may be delayed but the 2030 target is expected to be met, and that regional dialogue will address legitimacy and cross-border effects.
The State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management has set in motion the process for carrying out a plan environmental impact assessment for the general environmental rules.
De Staatssecretaris van IenW heeft het proces om een plan-milieueffectrapportage uit te voeren voor de algemene milieuregels in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht 'Mogelijk grote rol voor zonne-energie op de Noordzee'

An MP asked the government about TNO research and pilots for solar energy on the North Sea, its alignment with the Routekaart Zon op water, ecological effects and possible tenders combining wind and solar. The government answered that ecological effects are not yet known, that only small pilots exist, that NWO research and monitoring are planned, and that it will discuss the matter in the Noordzeeoverleg.
There is still much unknown about the ecological effects of solar energy on water.
Er is nog veel onbekend over de ecologische effecten van zon op water.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over knelpunten in de biovergistingssector

An MP asked about financial distress in the biogas fermentation sector caused by energy price volatility, the risk of large SDE++ subsidy clawbacks, and possible bankruptcies, and proposed individual accountant-based recalculation and an independent review. The minister acknowledged the problem, referred firms to RVO for possible offsetting, and rejected individual recalculation and an independent review, noting that fixed-price contracts are a business risk.
I have less insight into recent developments in feedstock prices for fermenters, as these are very diverse in nature and price formation is not transparent here.
Ik heb in mindere mate zicht op de recente ontwikkeling van de prijs van grondstoffen voor vergisters aangezien deze zeer divers van aard zijn en de prijsvorming hier niet transparant is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over een opmerkelijke ommekeer van de Autoriteit Consument & Markt

An MP asked the ministers why the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) reversed its draft guidance so that network operators may no longer own electrolysers, and whether this hinders the energy transition. The ministers answer that the ACM is entitled to interpret the law, that the legal framework on network operators and electrolysis is unclear, and that they will clarify it through consultation and a future Energy Act, while the existing Gasunie hydrogen storage pilot is unaffected.

Based on the ACM's guidance on network companies and alternative energy carriers, I find that the current statutory provisions on the scope of network companies in relation to electrolysis are not sufficiently clear and are open to interpretation.

Mede op basis van de «Leidraad netwerkbedrijven en alternatieve energiedragers» van de ACM constateer ik dat de huidige wettelijke bepalingen rondom de ruimte van netwerkbedrijven in relatie tot elektrolyse niet voldoende helder zijn en openstaan voor interpretatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bontenbal over CO2-levering aan de glastuinbouw

MPs Boswijk and Bontenbal asked why the Amsterdam waste-energy company AEB chose CCS without supplying captured CO2 to greenhouse horticulture, and what barriers and government role exist for CO2 supply and combined CCS/CCU. The minister acknowledges the choice, says the sector needs about 2.5 Mton externally sourced CO2 and that the SDE++ and CO2 allocation pilot still have flexibility and legal-clarity barriers, while committing to a new convenant and a possible roadmap before summer.
If necessary, agreements can also be made there to draw up a roadmap. We will come back to this before the summer.
Zo nodig kunnen daar ook afspraken in worden gemaakt om roadmap op te stellen. Hier komen we voor de zomer op terug.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Weer meer CO2-uitstoot veroorzaakt door biomassa'

An SP MP asks whether the 16 percent rise in CO2 emissions from biomass in 2020 is acceptable, how much subsidy biomass received, how this fits the Van Esch motion banning new biomass subsidies, and how the Van Raan/Leijten motion on measuring biomass co-firing emissions is being implemented. The minister answers that low-grade wood subsidies were closed to new applications in 2021 but existing grants continue, that about 814 million euro was paid for biomass projects in 2021, and that CBS and PBL will be asked to report and project these emissions annually.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de schaarste aan gas en de productiebeperking van kolencentrales

An MP from the PVV asked the minister why coal plant output limits take effect on 1 January 2022 given gas scarcity, rising imports from coal plants abroad, and climate effects. The minister defended the flexible energy mix and the planned coal output cap as compatible with supply security, promising to monitor and act if risks emerge.
If I conclude that this measure leads to unacceptable risks for the security of electricity supply or gas supply, I will take measures to prevent this.

Als ik tot de conclusie kom dat deze maatregel tot onaanvaardbare risico's leidt voor de leveringszekerheid van elektriciteit of de voorzieningszekerheid van gas, zal ik maatregelen nemen om dit te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de zorg van TenneT bij het CO2-plafond voor kolencentrales

MP Stoffer asked whether TenneT's concerns about the annual-basis CO2 cap for coal plants, which carries supply-security risks if plants run mostly early in the year, were taken seriously and whether a supplementary risk analysis would be requested. The minister answered that the annual cap was chosen deliberately to protect security of supply, that no extra action is planned for now but developments will be monitored, and that TenneT will make an additional analysis for 2022.
TenneT has meanwhile indicated that it will make an additional analysis for the year 2022 on the Monitoring Security of Supply 2021 regarding the measures for the coal plants.
TenneT heeft inmiddels aangegeven voor het jaar 2022 een aanvullende analyse te zullen maken op de Monitoring Leveringszekerheid 2021 met betrekking tot de maatregelen voor de kolencentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over de leveringszekerheid van elektriciteit in Nederland

MPs Bontenbal and Erkens asked the Dutch government about the security of electricity supply in the Netherlands, including European coordination, TenneT's monitoring, neighbouring countries' nuclear and coal phase-outs, and the coal CO2 cap. The minister answered that supply adequacy is currently sufficient, that a strategic reserve is the preferred option if needed, that TenneT will supplement its 2021 monitoring within two months, and that a CO2 import/export correction will be considered when the Climate Act is amended.
TenneT has indicated that it will make an additional analysis of the Security of Supply Monitoring 2021 within two months for 2022 regarding the coal plant measures.

TenneT heeft inmiddels aangegeven voor het jaar 2022 binnen twee maanden een aanvullende analyse te zullen maken op de Monitoring Leveringszekerheid 2021 met betrekking tot de maatregelen voor de kolencentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over dreigende grootschalige stroomuitval

An MP asked the minister about media reports and expert warnings of large-scale power outages in the Netherlands and Europe in winter 2021-2022, linked to gas scarcity, coal plant closures and weather-dependent renewables. The minister replied that electricity supply is currently secure, citing TenneT monitoring and ENTSO-E outlooks, outlined measures such as a possible strategic reserve and a Value of Lost Load study, and rejected the claim that renewables and coal closures endanger supply.
The security of electricity supply is currently in order.
De leveringszekerheid van elektriciteit is momenteel op orde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Peter de Groot en Leijten over de invloed van de windlobby op de rapporten van het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) over de gezondheidseffecten van windturbines

MPs Erkens, Peter de Groot and Leijten asked whether RIVM omitted the wind-lobby influence on its reports on health effects of wind turbines, and how independent future research can be ensured. The minister said the RIVM's authority is not in question, that funding source alone should not exclude studies, and that RIVM is exploring additional health research and a study on setback distances.
I do not think it is for me or the cabinet to respond to this discussion, which belongs in the scientific domain.
Ik vind het niet aan mij of het kabinet om te reageren op deze discussie, die in het wetenschappelijk domein thuishoort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht dat de Franse rechter het windturbinesyndroom erkent

An MP asked whether a French court's recognition of 'wind turbine syndrome' should change Dutch policy, and whether RIVM findings were influenced by the wind lobby. The minister answered that medical science, not courts, decides on recognising a syndrome, that RIVM acted independently, and that the government will set new national wind turbine norms via a planMER and a health research scoping study.
In their research, RIVM is independent and disinterested and works according to standard international publication protocols.
In hun onderzoek is het RIVM onafhankelijk en belangeloos en werkt het volgens standaard internationale protocollen voor publicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de berichten 'Epidemioloog haalt uit: ‘RIVM-conclusies over windmolens deugen niet’' en 'RIVM verzweeg invloed windlobby op positieve rapporten'

An MP from the PVV asked the government about claims that RIVM reports on wind turbine health effects were too favourable and influenced by the wind industry, and about measures to protect residents. The minister declined to take a position on the scientific dispute, acknowledged hinder and sleep disturbance as health effects, and pointed to a planMER and RIVM work, while refusing to halt wind turbine construction.
For a substantive response I therefore refer to the response of the RIVM.
Voor een inhoudelijke reactie verwijs ik daarom naar de reactie van het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de compensatieregelingen bij hogere energiekosten

An MP asked whether residents of large complexes such as students and elderly people, who often lack their own energy contract, benefit from the energy tax cut and the extra 200 euro compensation for low incomes. The government answered that residents receive compensation through the energy tax reduction and that targeted support exists, but acknowledged that the distribution cannot be tailored to each household and promised to report on energy prices every two months.
The cabinet therefore continues to closely monitor the development of energy prices.
Het kabinet blijft daarom de ontwikkeling van de energieprijzen nauwlettend in de gaten houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Jasper van Dijk over het feit dat de regering brieven met aanwijzingen aan gemeentes stuurde zonder wettelijke grondslag

MPs Omtzigt and Van Dijk asked whether letters the government sent to municipalities instructing them to create emergency asylum reception places, called 'aanwijzingen', had any legal basis, and whether they amounted to mere requests. The government answered that the letters had no basis in Dutch law, were not legally binding, were intended as urgent requests, and that it will no longer use the term 'aanwijzing' in this way, while refusing to share some correspondence yet and not answering the criminal-law questions.
The cabinet regrets this. Therefore the cabinet no longer wishes to use the term 'aanwijzing' in a situation like this in this way.
Het kabinet betreurt dat. Daarom wil het kabinet de term «aanwijzing» in een situatie zoals deze niet meer op deze wijze gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Peter de Groot over de haalbaarheidsstudie ‘klimaatneutrale paden TSN IJmuiden’ van Roland Berger

Two VVD MPs asked the cabinet about the Roland Berger feasibility study on climate-neutral routes for Tata Steel IJmuiden, including state financial support, the size of the subsidy need, infrastructure, permit acceleration and inter-government coordination. The minister said the study is an important next step, that financial needs and support options are not yet known and depend on Tata Steel's own business case, that no funds are yet reserved, and that a new cabinet would decide, while permit speed-up and coordination are being explored without an interdepartmental taskforce.
That also cannot be expected at this stage of the process.
Dat kan in deze fase van het proces ook nog niet verwacht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Zeer nauwe verbintenis Roland Berger en Tata

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports of close ties between consultancy Roland Berger and Tata Steel, questioning the independence of a study on green steel production. The minister answered that the past Tata/Roland Berger alliance concerned Indian advisory work, ended around 2012, was not linked to Tata Steel Netherlands, and that the scenarios studied have been published.
Both FNV and the group Zeester (former Tata Steel directors) have designated Roland Berger as a competent organisation to investigate the sustainability options for Tata Steel.
Zowel FNV, alsook de groep Zeester (oud-directeuren van Tata Steel) hebben Roland Berger aangewezen als een competente organisatie om de verduurzamingsmogelijkheden voor Tata Steel te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de fors hogere elektriciteits- en gasprijzen

The CDA MP Bontenbal asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about sharply higher electricity and gas prices, including whether this amounts to a European energy crisis, its causes, and how households and firms are affected. The government answered that prices reflect tight global supply and demand, that gas storage is adequate for protected users and monitored, that support measures and a ministerial taskforce are in place, and that the next government will address storage obligations.

I will also ask TenneT in good time next year to assess whether security of supply is sufficiently in order for the coming winter as well, or whether additional measures are needed that can then be developed.

Ook zal ik TenneT tijdig in het komende jaar vragen om te beoordelen of leveringszekerheid ook in de volgende winter voldoende op orde is, dan wel dat aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn die dan kunnen worden uitgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over cumulatie van uitstoot en overlast in Zuid-Limburg

MPs Peter de Groot and Erkens asked about cumulative emissions and nuisance in cross-border South Limburg, including the planned Lixhe biomass plant in Belgium, and whether Dutch municipalities and the province can be stakeholders in the Belgian permit process. The State Secretary answered that Dutch bodies were not yet formally recognised as stakeholders, that the matter is for the bordering authorities to resolve, and that the government will raise concerns diplomatically and with Dutch local authorities.

I believe the province of Limburg and the Dutch municipalities concerned should be able to formally raise these objections in the procedure and that they should be weighed in assessing the application.

Ik vind dat de provincie Limburg en de betrokken Nederlandse gemeenten deze bezwaren formeel moeten kunnen inbrengen in de procedure en dat deze ook meegewogen moeten worden bij de beoordeling van de aanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht ‘Welkom Energie officieel failliet: gedupeerde klanten zien kans op compensatie slinken’

The MP asks about the bankruptcy of energy supplier Welkom Energie, whose roughly 90,000 customers may lose money such as overpaid advances, and how government protects consumers from price rises and supplier failures. The Secretary of State explains that insolvency rules apply equally to all creditors so consumers are unsecured creditors with uncertain recovery, that the government is reviewing ACM supervision and financial requirements for suppliers, and that a Energiewet with stricter oversight is being prepared.

I want to examine whether it is desirable and feasible to impose further requirements in this area and, if so, which requirements best achieve the goal and are workable for both energy suppliers and the ACM.

Ik wil onderzoeken of het wenselijk en mogelijk is om hier nadere eisen aan te stellen en zo ja, welke eisen het doel het beste bereiken en goed uitvoerbaar zijn voor zowel energieleveranciers als de ACM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Thijssen over de sluiting van de Onyx-centrale

MPs Kröger and Thijssen asked why the 212.5 million euro subsidy for closing the Onyx coal plant is so high, whether it could be corrected for market developments, how the workers' social plan is secured, and whether ETS allowances and sensitive documents will be withdrawn or disclosed. The state secretary answered that the subsidy was checked for overcompensation, is conditional on a social plan and state-aid approval, that a letter on ETS allowances will follow, and that confidential business information prevents publication of the subsidy decision, though the documents were made available to parliament confidentially.
Because of business-confidential information, I cannot make the subsidy decision and the underlying advice public.
Vanwege bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie kan ik het subsidiebesluit en de onderliggende adviezen niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van het lid Erkens over het bericht ‘Ook energieleverancier Enstroga valt om door hoge gasprijs’

An MP asked the government about energy supplier bankruptcies (Enstroga and others) caused by high gas prices, the protection of affected customers, the fairness of contracts and tariffs, and support for vulnerable households. The State Secretary answered that customers are redistributed under legal supply-security rules, that a generic energy tax cut and municipal support funds are being provided, and that ACM monitors tariff reasonableness, while individual compensation is deemed impractical.
Consumers are protected to ensure that they do not end up without gas or electricity.
Consumenten worden beschermd om ervoor te zorgen dat ze niet zonder gas of elektriciteit komen te zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Sprong in het duister met waterstofmiljarden'

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about Gasunie's warnings, Court of Audit criticism of state-backed consortia, public funding for hydrogen projects, and contacts with the NortH2 consortium of Shell, Equinor and RWE. The government says public funds are earmarked and disclosed via budget documents, that no commitments were made to NortH2, that Gasunie will be asked to limit itself to knowledge sharing, and that further market-model choices will be communicated to parliament.
I therefore always inform your House in a timely manner about concrete policy intentions, especially where this leads to the spending of public funds.
Ik informeer uw Kamer daarom altijd tijdig over concrete beleidsvoornemens, zeker waar dit leidt tot de besteding van publieke middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Nederland deed mee in herfinanciering van omstreden gasproject Australië'

MP Van der Lee asked why the state-backed export credit insurer financed the Ichthys LNG project, which flares gas, and how such support will be prevented in future, and whether such credits belong on the fossil fuel subsidy list. The Secretary of State explained the 2012 policy predated the 2021 exclusion rule, that a 2020 change was technical, and that new COP26-based policy to end fossil export support is being developed for end-2022 implementation, while declining to treat export credit as a subsidy.
Following the policy tightened this year, an application for an export credit insurance will from now on be checked for whether gas is routinely vented or flared.
Naar aanleiding van het dit jaar aangescherpte beleid zal bij een aanvraag voor een exportkredietverzekering (ekv) voortaan gekeken worden of er routinematig ontgast of afgefakkeld wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het toepassen van een milieueffectrapportage voorafgaand aan het vaststellen van de besluitvorming rondom de Regionale Energie Strategieën

An MP asked whether environmental impact assessment under the SEA Directive is required before Regional Energy Strategies (RES) are finalised, and how the government squares wind-park permits and the Aarhus Convention with recent Council of State and CJEU rulings. The State Secretary answered that the SEA Directive does not require a plan-MER for norms set in permits or zoning plans, that existing permits need not be withdrawn, that an already-in-progress RES is not a SEA-type plan so a plan-MER is voluntary, and that participation meets Aarhus, while promising a working group report by year-end.
An already-in-progress RES is not a "plan or programme" within the meaning of the SEA Directive, because a RES is not a plan or programme prescribed by legislative or administrative provisions.

Een al in besluitvorming zijnde RES is geen «plan of programma» in de zin van de SMB-richtlijn, omdat een RES geen plan of programma is dat door wettelijke of bestuursrechtelijke bepalingen is voorgeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over ‘foute investeringen die de klimaatramp verergeren’

Leijten (SP) asked the state secretaries about an IMF finding of 5.9 trillion dollars in fossil fuel subsidies in 2020, the rise in public investment in fossil fuels since the Paris Agreement, G7 phase-out plans, and the role of hedge funds buying fossil shares divested by institutional investors. The government acknowledged the IMF figure is mainly unpriced external costs, stressed carbon pricing and international coordination, and rejected a private investment ban on oil and gas and a 'Klimaatbank' as not opportune.
I do not have cumulative data on what share of this has been invested in oil and gas.
Ik beschik niet over cumulatieve data over welk aandeel hiervan is geïnvesteerd in olie en gas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over grootschalige energieopslagprojecten in Nederland (Kamerstuk 29023, nr. 270)

An MP asked the state secretary about the role of large-scale energy storage in the Dutch electricity system, existing and planned instruments and budgets, legal obstacles, and projects in the pipeline. The state secretary answered that storage is one flexibility option alongside interconnection and demand response, listed subsidy schemes and a 35 million euro reservation for hydrogen storage, and said TenneT monitors security of supply annually, while declining to appraise individual projects.
I have recently informed the House of Representatives about the expected developments in underground energy storage.
Ik heb de Tweede Kamer recent geïnformeerd over de verwachte ontwikkelingen op het gebied van ondergrondse energieopslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de inzet van de Europese Commissie op het verduurzamen van de industrie door middel van groene waterstof

An MP asked the state secretary whether the European Commission's push for 50% green hydrogen in industry by 2030 makes decarbonisation more expensive than the Dutch CCS and blue hydrogen route, and how it fits with existing climate agreements. The government answered that green hydrogen is likely more expensive in the short term, that exact costs are hard to determine, that a demand-creation instrument and import strategy are being developed, and that research is ongoing with a letter promised at year end.
On the outcomes of this ongoing research I will inform you at the end of this year with the promised letter to parliament on hydrogen.
Over de uitkomsten van dit lopende onderzoek informeer ik u eind dit jaar met de toegezegde Kamerbrief over waterstof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Klink, Amhaouch en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Kabinet maakt reuzendraai: stopt toch met financieren fossiele brandstofprojecten in het buitenland'

MPs from VVD and CDA asked the government about the impact of signing the COP26 pledge to end international public support for unabated fossil energy by end 2022, including effects on firms, jobs, existing export credit insurance, transition support and funding. The minister answered that roughly a quarter of the export credit portfolio is fossil-linked, that 39 countries and institutions have signed, that new policy will be implemented by end 2022, and that existing policies and contracts are unaffected.
In 2022 the cabinet will work on new policy to end international public support for the fossil energy sector, particularly regarding the export credit insurance (ekv).
Het kabinet zal in 2022 werken aan nieuw beleid voor het beëindigen van internationale overheidssteun aan de fossiele energie sector, in het bijzonder voor wat betreft de ekv.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Bontenbal over het onderzoek van Indufor naar biomassa uit Estland, in reactie op het SOMO-rapport

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about an Indufor peer review that disputes the SOMO report on Estonian wood pellet sustainability, and about why the NGOs left the biomass covenant. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands Emissions Authority is investigating the matter, declined to judge either report's content before that inquiry concludes, and defended the continued use of biomass for high-value applications.
Once the NEa investigation is completed, I will inform your House about it.
Zodra het onderzoek van de NEa is afgerond zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Leijten over de uitvoering van de motie Erkens/Leijten (Kamerstuk 32813-731)

MPs Leijten and Erkens asked the State Secretary for Energy and Climate about the status of research into the effects of distance standards for onshore wind turbines, who is involved, whether court cases and independence of studies are considered, and whether wind-on-land is needed to reach the 35 TWh target given rooftop solar potential. The government answered that research by Arcadis is underway with results expected February 2022, that stakeholders will be involved, that studies on a 45 dB noise norm show reduced potential, and that the 35 TWh target is not assured.
The research has recently been commissioned from the external research bureau Arcadis.
Het onderzoek is recent in opdracht gegeven bij het externe onderzoeksbureau Arcadis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over zonnepanelen op daken

The MP asks about the technical rooftop area available for solar panels, structural load limits, provincial subsidies for weak roofs, system cost distortions in SDE++ and municipal powers to require panels. The government answers that data are limited, points to studies and the RES framework, says subsidies for weak roofs are a choice for a new cabinet, and describes a draft Bbl amendment allowing municipalities to require panels for industrial and other buildings.
The Minister of BZK and I have only limited information on the technical rooftop area available for placing solar panels.
De Minister van BZK en ik beschikken maar beperkt over informatie over het technische potentieel aan dakoppervlakte dat beschikbaar is voor de plaatsing van zonnepanelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Geurts over collectieve warmtesystemen in de gebouwde omgeving

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary about heat networks: the forfaitair efficiency assumption in energy labels, the supply temperature for district heating, the size of heat districts, and local government capacity to set them. The State Secretary defended the forfaitair method and the energy label design, argued that the draft law's criteria protect optimisation and innovation, noted the Expertise Centrum Warmte and ongoing talks with VNG and IPO for support, and rejected the suggested conflict of interests.
Municipalities have by far the most knowledge of the specific characteristics of the local situation.
Gemeenten hebben bij uitstek kennis van de specifieke kenmerken van de lokale situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over lokale initiatieven voor kernenergie

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about a Limburg provincial study into nuclear energy, whether the government would support such studies, and the role of small modular reactors and provinces. The state secretary said a national scenario study is due mid-2022, that further nuclear decisions are for a next cabinet, that SMRs carry risks, and that provinces are essential to any further nuclear development.
I find it interesting that Limburg is commissioning research into the possibilities for nuclear energy in Limburg and I will consult with Limburg about this research
Ik vind het interessant dat Limburg aangeeft onderzoek te laten doen naar de mogelijkheden voor kernenergie in Limburg en zal met Limburg in overleg treden over dit onderzoek
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de nationale CO2-heffing in relatie tot de SDE++

An MP asked whether not netting the national CO2 levy against SDE++ subsidies for CCS risks overstimulating CCS and distorting investment choices versus sustainable alternatives. The State Secretary rejected these concerns, arguing the levy is a stick not meant to reduce subsidy gaps, the SDE++ correction applies uniformly, and an overstimulation test and ETS-price correction guard against excess subsidy.
Finally, an overstimulation test applies whereby the actual costs and revenues of a project are examined afterwards to prevent overstimulation.
