Motie van het lid Ceder c.s. over belemmeringen waar reservisten mee te maken kunnen krijgen in kaart brengen en oplossingen daarvoor aandragen
Asks the government to map obstacles reservists face with employers and propose solutions, including strengthening reservists' legal position toward employers.
requests the government to map the obstacles reservists may face and propose solutions
verzoekt de regering de belemmeringen waar reservisten mee te maken kunnen krijgen in kaart te brengen en oplossingen daarvoor aan te dragen
Amendement van het lid Boswijk c.s. over financiering van het Veteranen Search Team
Amendment provides 150,000 euro from the Defence budget to support the Veterans Search Team, routed through the Netherlands Veterans Institute with an evaluation after one year.
With this amendment 150,000 euro is made available for financing the Veterans Search Team
Met dit amendement wordt € 150.000 beschikbaar gesteld voor de financiering van het Veteranen Search Team
Motie van het lid Ram c.s. over een pas op de plaats maken bij langjarige financiële verplichtingen voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking
Asks the demissionary government to pause entering new long-term financial commitments for development cooperation, or implementing them.
requests the government to pause, during the caretaker period, the entering into new long-term financial commitments for development cooperation

verzoekt de regering om in de demissionaire periode een pas op de plaats te maken waar het gaat om het aangaan van nieuwe langjarige financiële verplichtingen op het gebied van ontwikkelingssamenwerking
Motie van het lid Boswijk c.s. over de mogelijkheden onderzoeken voor het met Oekraïne delen van kennis en licenties ten aanzien van door Nederland geleverde middelen
Asks the government to explore with industry sharing knowledge and licences so Ukraine can produce munitions and other items Netherlands supplies.
requests the government to explore together with industry the possibilities to share knowledge and licences
verzoekt de regering om samen met het bedrijfsleven de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om kennis en licenties
Motie van het lid Ceder c.s. over meer oog voor lokale cultuur, tradities en overtuigingen bij het vaststellen van een handelsverdrag of ontwikkelingssamenwerking
Asks the government, when concluding trade agreements or development cooperation, not to make ideologies a condition for support and to respect local culture and beliefs.
and in doing so not to set ideologies as a condition for obtaining support or trade agreements
daarbij geen ideologieën als voorwaarde te stellen voor het verkrijgen van steun of handelsovereenkomsten
Motie van de leden Erkens en Tuinman over onderzoeken hoe de Nederlandse industrie meer betrokken kan worden bij zelfstandige en licentieproductie van munitie in Europa
Asks the government to investigate how Dutch industry can be involved in independent and licensed production of munitions in Europe.
requests the cabinet to investigate how Dutch industry can be more involved in independent and licensed production in Europe
verzoekt het kabinet te onderzoeken hoe de Nederlandse industrie meer betrokken kan worden bij zelfstandige productie en licentieproductie in Europa
Motie van de leden Boswijk en Tuinman over de mogelijkheid onderzoeken dat leden van de Staten-Generaal als reservist opleidingen en trainingen bij Defensie volgen
Asks the government to explore whether members of the States General can join Defence as reservists for training and exercises during recess.
requests the government to investigate whether there is a possibility for members of the States General to follow training as reservists at Defence
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of er een mogelijkheid is te vinden dat leden van de Staten-Generaal als reservist opleidingen en trainingen bij Defensie kunnen volgen
Motie van de leden Tuinman en Boswijk over het onderzoeken van voorstellen met betrekking tot het internationaal aanbesteden van militaire projecten
Asks the government to explore broader international tendering exemptions for military projects with a large concept development element.
requests the government to explore, in line with the Knops motion, proposals and/or broader interpretation regarding international tendering for military projects
verzoekt de regering om in lijn van de motie-Knops voorstellen en/of ruimere interpretatie te onderzoeken met betrekking tot internationaal aanbesteden voor militaire projecten
Motie van het lid Tuinman c.s. over alle medewerkers van Defensie die geen militair of reservist zijn vrijblijvend uitnodigen om reservist te worden
Asks the State Secretary for Defence to invite non-military Defence staff to voluntarily become reservists.
requests the State Secretary of Defence to invite all Defence staff who are not military or reservists to voluntarily become reservists
verzoekt de Staatssecretaris van Defensie alle medewerkers van Defensie die geen militair of reservist zijn vrijblijvend uit te nodigen om reservist te worden
Motie van het lid Boswijk c.s. over het inventariseren en wegnemen van regels en procedures die het opschalen van externe opleidingscapaciteit belemmeren
Asks the government to inventory and remove rules and procurement procedures that hinder scaling up external training capacity for the armed forces.
requests the government to inventory which rules and procedures still hinder scaling up external training capacity and to remove these obstacles
verzoekt de regering te inventariseren welke regels en procedures momenteel nog het opschalen van externe opleidingscapaciteit belemmeren en deze belemmeringen weg te nemen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veltman en Ellian over mogelijke Nederlandse bijstand bij natuurbranden in Zuid-Europa

Two VVD MPs asked the Defence Minister about Dutch assistance for wildfires in Southern Europe, including why requests were not met and whether helicopters could be sent. The minister answered that two Chinook helicopters were deployed to Spain from 19 to 31 August, dropping nearly 3 million litres of water, and described Defence's general readiness for such requests.
Following the Spanish request, the cabinet decided to provide two Chinook transport helicopters to help fight the wildfires.
Naar aanleiding van het Spaanse verzoek heeft het kabinet besloten om twee Chinook-transporthelikopters te leveren om te helpen bij het bestrijden van de natuurbranden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Paternotte en Podt over stikstofbelemmeringen op defensielocaties

MPs from D66 asked the government about nitrogen (stikstof) rules blocking expansion of Dutch military training sites and air bases, including the consequences for NATO readiness and the specific permit barriers at each location. The State Secretary for Defence answered that a TNO study finds the impact on operational readiness 'enormous', that defence sites mostly lack nature permits, that permit procedures are slow and complex with no generic defence exemption under the Habitat and Birds Directives, and that the ministerial commission and an EU defence readiness omnibus are being used to find solutions.
The management summary of the TNO study and the Haskoning research report were sent to your House on 3 July 2025.
Het managementuittreksel van het onderzoek van TNO en het onderzoeksrapport van Haskoning zijn op 3 juli 2025 aan uw Kamer verzonden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dobbe over het bericht dat de tweelingbroer van de staatsecretaris van Defensie directeur wordt van een drone-bedrijf

SP MPs asked the Defence minister whether the Defence state secretary's twin brother taking a job at a drone company, while the army invests millions in drones, creates a conflict of interest, and what safeguards exist. The minister answered that the appointment was known within Defence, cited existing post-employment and integrity rules, and promised the state secretary would be cautious in direct contacts with AI Armaments.

Furthermore, the State Secretary will be restrained in direct contacts with AI Armaments, and specific communication about and/or specific cooperation with AI Armaments falls under the responsibility of the Minister.

Verder geldt dat de Staatssecretaris terughoudend zal zijn in directe contacten met AI Armaments en dat specifieke communicatie over en/of specifieke samenwerking met AI Armaments onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de Minister valt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over de uitbreiding van militaire trainingsfaciliteiten op ’t Harde

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked how long permit procedures for expanding military training facilities take, whether this slows defence readiness, and how regulations, nature protection and noise concerns will be handled. The government acknowledges lengthy permit procedures and the tension with defence urgency, outlines short- and long-term steps such as accelerating existing permits, the NPRD programme and a planned bill, but gives no average processing time.
An average processing time for permit procedures for expanding Dutch military facilities cannot be given.
Een gemiddelde doorloopsnelheid van vergunningsprocedures voor uitbreiding van de Nederlandse militaire faciliteiten is niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over pensioenfondsen en verzekeraars die bereid zijn geld te steken in de versterking van defensie

Two CDA MPs asked whether pension funds and insurers are willing to invest in defence but are waiting for a plan from The Hague, and why this takes so long. The government answers that Defence is talking with industry and investors, that financing is a shared responsibility, that investment decisions remain with financial institutions, and lists initiatives such as Defport, a financing table and planned measures, without giving a firm timetable.
Ultimately it remains up to banks, insurers, pension funds and other investors themselves to decide to what extent and how they want to invest in the defence industry.
Uiteindelijk blijft het aan banken, verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen en andere investeerders zelf om te bepalen in welke mate en op welke wijze zij willen investeren in de defensie-industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de natuurvergunningproblematiek bij Defensie

An MP asked whether nitrogen (stikstof) nature-permit rules, tightened by the Council of State's December 2024 rulings, are blocking Defence expansion and training, and whether Defence should be exempted. The government confirms the rulings affect Defence (especially retroactive intern salderen), says impact and capacity needs are still being analysed, notes the MCE&N will consider Defence's interests, but does not exempt Defence and points to the planned Wet op de defensiegereedheid instead.
Defence is bound by existing laws and regulations.
Defensie is gehouden aan bestaande wet- en regelgeving.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht “Rendement innovatie defensie erg groot: ‘magnetron, mobieltje en ducttape met dank aan leger" en het daaraan gerelateerde onderzoek ‘The economic returns on defense

An MP asked the ministers of Defence about a RaboResearch study finding high economic returns on defence R&D, and about whether Europe should build a DARPA-like agency and reach a 2% R&T benchmark. The government acknowledges the study's relevance, outlines increased R&D budgets since 2022 and 2024, and rejects a DARPA-like institute and a fixed 2% growth path for now.

At this moment no added value is seen in setting up an additional DARPA-like institute at European or national level, because existing institutes and instruments fulfil this role in cooperation as desired.

Op dit moment wordt er geen meerwaarde gezien in het oprichten van een aanvullend DARPA-achtig instituut op Europees of nationaal niveau, omdat de al aanwezige instituten en instrumenten deze rol in samenwerking naar wens vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over de productiecapaciteit van munitie en defensiematerieel

MP Wijen-Nass asked whether the government would take a strategic stake in defence start-ups and whether it would contact the German economics minister to produce shortfall munitions in German industry. The State Secretary replied that a stake remains an option under the economic security instrument, with a letter promised in Q1 2025, and that Defence already discusses production scaling with Germany, which decides on its own industrial capacity.
Your House will be informed in Q1 2025 about how Defence and the Ministry of Economic Affairs will further strengthen the strategic position of the defence industry in the long term.
Uw Kamer wordt in Q1 2025 geïnformeerd over hoe Defensie en Economische Zaken (EZ) de strategische positie van de defensie-industrie verder gaan versterken op de lange termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Hirsch en Nordkamp over de handhaving van de internationale rechtsorde ten aanzien van Israël

Three GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about export licences for military and dual-use goods to Israel, journalist access to Gaza, and Israel's halt on visas for international NGO staff. The minister answered that two military export licences were granted since 7 October 2023, 28 dual-use licences in 2024, that F-35 parts and engines are no longer exported to Israel after the court ruling, and that Israel should allow journalists and aid workers access but no sanctions or consequences were announced.
The Netherlands calls on Israel to facilitate the work of aid organisations, including by improving visa issuance.
Nederland roept Israël op om het werk van hulporganisaties te faciliteren, inclusief middels verbetering van visumverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Van der Werf over gaten in de beveiliging van defensiecomplexen

MPs Van Kent and Van der Werf asked about security gaps at defence sites, including turnstiles that allowed intruders to slip onto bases, and what has been done about them. The State Secretary answered that emergency measures were in place before the broadcast, a permanent fix by the supplier would be complete by year end, and that the most sensitive assets are protected by stricter tiers, while withholding details of those measures as highly classified.
The supplier of the turnstiles was also immediately instructed to develop a lasting solution so that intrusion in this way is no longer possible.
Ook is direct aan de leverancier van de tourniquets opdracht gegeven een duurzame oplossing te ontwikkelen zodat insluipen op deze manier niet meer mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Wal over het artikel ‘Vrijwillig dienjaar is succes, zegt Defensie: bijna driekwart wil blijven’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about the voluntary service year, including vacancies, rejected applicants, bottlenecks and plans to expand places faster. The State Secretary answered that roughly 11,600 vacancies exist, that the service year will be expanded to about 1,000 places in 2025 with ambitions to go further, and listed investments and planned measures.
For 2025 an expansion to 1,000 service-year military personnel is foreseen.
Voor 2025 is een uitbreiding voorzien naar 1.000 dienjaarmilitairen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tuinman over het artikel 'Optimising Dutch Air and Space Power Policy Recommendations for Defending the Netherlands and Deterring Aggression as Part of NATO'

An MP asked the Defence Minister about an RUSI report on Dutch air and space power, including F-35 readiness, SEAD/DEAD priorities, MQ-9 Reapers, and the handling of the report and its recommendations. The Minister answered that the government agrees more investment is needed, cites the Defence White Paper 2022, defends current F-35 transition and procurement choices, and declines to commission a separate report, though several answers defer to other bodies or pending processes.
For that reason, I currently do not consider it necessary to commission a separate report on these themes.
Daarom acht ik het opstellen van een separaat rapport over deze thema's momenteel niet nodig.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans, Diederik van Dijk en Tuinman over het bericht dat de Europese coördinator van het in Duitsland verboden Samidoun, genaamd Mohammed Khatib, op 10 juni 2024 komt spreken op de Radb

MPs Eerdmans, Diederik van Dijk and Tuinman asked whether the government would engage Germany on Samidoun's Radboud University talk, bar the speaker from entry, ban the organisation, and push for EU terrorist listing. The minister answered that the government will talk with Germany, that the universities bear responsibility for event conditions, that the entry ban law does not allow refusing entry, and that listing is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service and the Foreign Ministry, with the motion being investigated.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to consider whether there are grounds to ban an organisation, not for the cabinet.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te bezien of er redenen zijn waarom een organisatie verboden moet worden, niet aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tuinman over het artikel 'Kiew ruft Ukrainer aus dem Ausland zurück und erwartetUnterstützung – doch die Bundesregierung spielt auf Zeit'

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Ukraine's suspension of consular services for men aged 18 to 60 abroad, its mobilisation implications for Ukrainians in the Netherlands, and the Ukrainian ambassador's remarks. The government answers that consular assistance is Ukraine's decision, that the Netherlands was informed and remains in contact with the embassy, that lapsed documents do not make residence illegal, and that questions were answered before the debate.
Under international law there is no obligation for a state to provide consular assistance.
Er bestaat onder internationaal recht geen verplichting voor een staat om consulaire bijstand te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tuinman over het artikel 'Defensie stuurt special forces voor hun gezondheid op cursus sjamanistisch ademhalen'

An MP (Tuinman, BBB) asked the State Secretary of Defence about the BaseQamp pilot, which offered breathing, cold exposure and meditation training to active military personnel, and why it was paused and then stopped after IMG and IVD reviews raised concerns about aftercare, integration with military healthcare and use of unaccredited experience experts. The State Secretary answered most questions, explaining the pilot's funding, its position outside military mental healthcare, and the decision to stop it, while stating BaseQamp is not treatment and that the IMG does not investigate post-service care.
The Inspectorate of Military Health Care received signals from various quarters during 2023 expressing concerns about BaseQamp.
De Inspectie Militaire Gezondheidszorg (IMG) heeft in de loop van 2023 uit verschillende hoeken signalen ontvangen met zorgen over BaseQamp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Tuinman over aanbestedingsbureaucratie bij defensieaankopen

MPs Eerdmans and Tuinman asked the Defence Minister about procurement bureaucracy slowing defence acquisitions and whether Article 346 TFEU exemptions are used as promised. The state secretary acknowledged the need to reduce administrative burden, said exemptions may be invoked more often given the threat picture, declined to give frequency figures for Article 346, and promised to inform parliament before summer.
Defence makes no statements about the frequency of applying Article 346(1)(b) TFEU, because of the protection of the security interest for which that provision is applied.

Defensie doet geen uitspraken over de frequentie van het toepassen van artikel 346 lid 1 sub b VWEU, dit vanwege de bescherming van het veiligheidsbelang waar artikel 346 lid 1 sub b VWEU voor wordt toegepast.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Olger van Dijk, Tuinman, De Roon en Stoffer over meldingen in het veiligheidssysteem ECCAIRS over het luchtruim boven Oekraïne voor 17 juli 2014, de datum waarop vlucht MH17/KL410

MPs asked the minister for details of three Eccairs safety reports on Ukrainian airspace filed in 2014 before MH17 was shot down, and for the reports to be shared with parliament. The minister declined, citing a pending Council of State case and EU Regulation 376/2014 confidentiality rules, and promised to inform parliament after the ruling expected in Q3 2024.
Because this procedure is still ongoing, no further information can be provided.
Omdat deze procedure nog loopt, kan verder geen informatie worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tuinman over het bericht ‘IT-bedrijf Atos dieper in schulden, overheidsklanten nemen maatregelen.’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about reports that IT firm Atos is deep in debt, whether this was reflected in risk analyses for the GrIT programme, how it affects the project's goals, and what the way forward is. The government said it monitors Atos closely with Kyndryl (main contractor) preparing contingency measures, that goals need not change for now, and that details are withheld for commercial confidentiality.
Due to commercial confidentiality, I cannot currently go into further detail on the situation surrounding Atos or the measures being prepared.
Vanwege de commerciële vertrouwelijkheid kan ik op dit moment niet verder ingaan op de situatie rondom Atos of de maatregelen die worden voorbereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Tuinman, Boswijk, Dobbe, Van Oostenbruggen, Nordkamp en Dassen over vrouwen in de krijgsmacht

Seven MPs asked the state secretary about women's advancement, part-time service, childcare, uniforms, sexual misconduct, the frontline role of women and veterans' support in the armed forces. The answers describe incremental measures such as a new part-time leave variant, modular training, a new combat uniform system and a 2023 harassment report count, and state that operational experience is not a formal condition for promotion.
Participation in deployments is not a condition for promotion in rank.
Deelname aan uitzendingen is niet voorwaardelijk om door te groeien in rang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tuinman en Boswijk over het bericht 'Kajsa Ollongren: mooi als VDL Nedcar militaire voertuigen gaat produceren'

MPs Tuinman and Boswijk asked the Defence Minister about reports on converting the VDL Nedcar plant in Born to produce military vehicles, munitions and drones, and about related defence industry, NATO and budget questions. The minister answered that talks with VDL are ongoing but the plant is not currently suited to such production, that licence production and collaboration with industry are being explored, and that choices on force composition will be made by the next cabinet.
The cabinet will inform the House further about progress when that is possible.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer nader informeren over de voortgang wanneer dat mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ceder en Tuinman over het artikel 'Rijksambtenaren Buitenlandse Zaken demonstreren tegen Nederlands Israëlbeleid'

MPs Stoffer, Ceder and Tuinman asked whether civil servants of the Foreign Ministry demonstrating for a ceasefire during lunch breaks, and their associated petition, conflict with government policy and the Civil Servants Act 2017. The minister answered that the demonstrations fall in the lunch break, that the call for a permanent ceasefire is not government policy, that civil servants have freedom of expression subject to Article 10 of the Act (assessed case by case by the employer), and that the ministry has held internal discussions and reminded staff of guidance.
Civil servants, like all other citizens, enjoy freedom of expression.
Ambtenaren kennen net als alle andere burgers de vrijheid van meningsuiting.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tuinman over de, op vrijdag 12 januari 2024 plaatsgevonden, door de Verenigde Staten geleide aanvallen op Houthi trainings-, lanceer- en opslaglocaties van drones, raketten, kruisvluchtwape

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about Dutch capacity to counter Houthi drone, missile and cruise-missile attacks at sea, the Defence Projects Overview, munitions stocks and deep-strike plans. The minister answered that the Netherlands contributes staff officers to Operation Prosperity Guardian and a US-led coalition, is studying a further maritime contribution, and that acquisition timelines and munitions shortfalls remain constrained by available funds.
Once the study gives reason to do so, your House will be informed.
Zodra het onderzoek hier aanleiding toe geeft, zal uw Kamer worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Tuinman en Diederik van Dijk over de mogelijke oprichting van een eigen tankbataljon

MPs Boswijk, Tuinman and Diederik van Dijk asked the government about reviving a national tank battalion, its cost, its links with Germany and the timing of a Leopard 2A8 procurement decision. The government says a tank battalion is not funded and that the decision on it is left to the next cabinet, while giving substantive answers on cost structure, the German cooperation and technology, and withholding only the commercially confidential cost breakdown, which it supplies in a confidential annex.
This cost specification contains commercially confidential elements.
Deze kostenspecificatie bevat commercieel vertrouwelijke elementen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tuinman over de zorgen van Commandant der Strijdkrachten Onno Eichelsheim over de capaciteit van de Defensieindustrie

An MP from BBB asked the Defence Minister about the Chief of Defence's concerns over defence industry capacity, munitions production timelines, unmanned systems units, MQ-9 drones and the Defensievisie 2035. The Minister answered that existing European framework contracts can meet munitions needs within four years, that unmanned systems will be integrated into existing units rather than separate ones, and that the 2035 vision remains valid in analysis but is being adapted.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Tuinman en Erkens over het artikel ‘NATO’s Vilnius summit: the consequences for the Allies’

MPs Boswijk, Tuinman and Erkens asked the Dutch government about NATO's New Force Model, its personnel implications for small allies and the Netherlands, and related lessons learned. The Minister answered that the personnel needs will only be clear once NATO details the force model, that Dutch constitutional tasks depend on improved personnel levels, and that the Netherlands contributes to lessons-learned work.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Lanschot over peperdure wervingscampagnes die nauwelijks nieuwe militairen opleveren

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Defence about costly recruitment campaigns that yield few new soldiers, including campaign spending, applications versus appointments, performance indicators, bottlenecks, attrition, and whether conscription should be reintroduced. The State Secretary answered at length, disputing the press portrayal, providing spending and intake figures, explaining selection attrition and measures underway, and rejecting compulsory service for now while preparing a voluntary Defence survey and retaining the conscription option as a last resort.
Yes. I have read the article, but the picture it paints does not match reality.
Ja. Ik heb het artikel gelezen, maar het geschetste beeld komt niet overeen met de werkelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul, Vedder en Boswijk over het bericht ‘Geen demonstratie voor veilige kruising’

CDA MPs asked the ministers about traffic safety on the N9 near the vlotbruggen (floating bridges) in North Holland, including structural fixes, Defence-related traffic from Den Helder, and how residents are involved. The minister replied that small targeted measures were carried out in 2023/2024 at the Burgervlotbrug and Sint Maartensvlotbrug, that a review of a fixed crossing is the province's responsibility with results expected in 2027, and that no concrete further improvements are yet planned.
The previous cabinet invested roughly €4 million in traffic safety at the Sint Maartensvlotbrug and Burgervlotbrug.
Het voorgaande kabinet heeft voor ongeveer € 4 miljoen geïnvesteerd in de verkeersveiligheid in Sint Maartensvlotbrug en Burgervlotbrug.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Peter de Groot over militair-civiele samenwerking op Lelystad Airport

MPs Ellian and Peter de Groot asked about military-civil cooperation at Lelystad Airport, including whether passenger flights are needed for F-35 stationing, the timing of decisions, permits and regional support. The government answered that a decision on commercial flights and fighter jet stationing is expected later this year, that preparations continue in parallel, and that it recognises regional support would fall away without passenger flights, while committing to further work and a letter.
The cabinet aims to take a definitive decision by the end of this year on fighter aircraft capacity and the opening of Lelystad Airport to commercial traffic.
Het kabinet streeft ernaar om eind dit jaar een definitief besluit te nemen over jachtvliegtuigcapaciteit en de openstelling van Lelystad Airport voor handelsverkeer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de mogelijke uitbreiding van het oefengebied van defensie op de Weerterheide

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about possible expansion of a military training area onto the Weerterheide, including the impact of possible expropriation, public consultation, alternatives, and protection of nature. The government acknowledges the burden on residents, explains consultation steps and that expropriation is a last resort, but refuses to rule it out and declines to adopt the proposed safeguards.
In the interest of care and transparency, I cannot share these documents earlier.
In het kader van zorgvuldigheid en transparantie kan ik deze documenten niet eerder delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Nordkamp over het werkbezoek van de staatssecretaris van Defensie aan Microsoft en Amazo

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Defence about his March 2025 working visit to Microsoft and Amazon in Seattle, its purpose and programme, and Defence's dependence on non-European cloud providers. The government answered that the visit aimed at understanding tech developments and sovereignty, that no commitments were made, that Defence uses a risk-spread multicloud approach and is exploring European alternatives, and that only unclassified or lightly classified data is stored with US providers.
For privacy reasons we cannot give names or functions, but talks were held with both companies at director and corporate vice president level.
Vanwege privacy kunnen wij geen namen of functies geven, maar er is gesproken met beide bedrijven op het niveau van director & corporate vice president.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nordkamp over de problemen met de Scania Gryphus

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the State Secretary for Defence about problems with the Scania Gryphus trucks, including tyre-pressure height issues, winter-tyre limits, marines' safety concerns, and whether the vehicle is unfit. The State Secretary answered that all variants meet the requirements, the height issue was fixed by adjusting tyre pressure, and that the vehicle does not limit readiness, while acknowledging ongoing issues being resolved with the supplier.
Defence subsequently informed the House on 9 June 2017 about its choice of the Scania Gryphus.
Defensie heeft uw Kamer vervolgens op 9 juni 2017 over haar keuze voor de Scania Gryphus geïnformeerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over beperkte oefenmogelijkheden voor de luchtmacht

An MP from the SGP asked the State Secretary for Defence about the very limited flying and training opportunities for the Air Force after Ramstein Flag, including whether the Besluit militaire luchthavens and noise rules should be evaluated, and how the National Programme for Defence Space (NPRD) addresses this. The State Secretary acknowledged the constraints, said a revision of the Bml replacing the noise metric is being prepared with a letter due in Q3 2025, and described planned expansion of sorties and the NPRD decision timeline, while noting noise-space flexibility and inventorying further bottlenecks.
I will inform the House about this in the third quarter of this year.
Hierover informeer ik uw Kamer in het derde kwartaal van dit jaar.
Antwoord op het lid Eerdmans over het persbericht van 16 januari 2025 met als titel 'Defensie over op 100% duurzame elektriciteit'

MP Eerdmans asked the State Secretary of Defence how the switch to 100% sustainable electricity fits Defence's operational readiness, supply security during crises, back-up systems, contracts for 2026-2027, strategic dependence, costs, and FTE devoted to sustainability. The answers state that only fixed defence sites switch to Dutch-sourced green electricity, that weapon systems keep fossil variants, that emergency generators back up critical processes, that contracts with Eneco and Vattenfall cover 2025-2027, that the extra cost is about 0.3% (details commercially confidential), and that 17 FTE work on sustainability goals.
The content and financial scope of this are commercially confidential.
De inhoud en financiële omvang hiervan is commercieel vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Wal over de kamerbrief over de bijstelling van de planning van het Nationaal Programma Ruimte voor Defensie

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Defence why the delay in the environmental impact study (planMER) for the National Defence Space Programme was only communicated now, what studies justify it, whether results will be delayed, and how this affects local authorities and defence interests. The State Secretary explains that the first siting round took longer than planned, that additional in-depth studies and consultation require more time, that the full picture will be released rather than partial results, and that the final policy vision by year-end cannot be fully guaranteed.
Should I notice that the process appears to be further delayed, I will inform your House of this as soon as possible.
Mocht ik signaleren dat het proces verder lijkt te vertragen, zal ik uw Kamer hier zo snel mogelijk over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nordkamp over uitspraken tijdens de BNR-podcast Boekestijn & De Wijk inzake stikstofregels

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence to explain remarks on a BNR podcast calling nitrogen rules for Defence activities unacceptable, including threats of legal action, the status of EU law versus NATO commitments, and an ILT report on Defence environmental violations. The State Secretary answered that stricter Council of State rulings threaten combat-readiness activities, that legal options are possible if Defence is blocked, and that political choices and a planned Defence readiness law are being pursued, while not sharing internal advice.
It is of great importance that EU regulation does not hinder fulfilment of these obligations.
Het is van groot belang dat EU-regelgeving het nakomen van deze verplichtingen niet belemmert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nordkamp over het lopende onderzoek van FIOD naar scheepsbouwbedrijf Damen Shipyards in verband met corruptieverdenkingen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about the ongoing FIOD investigation into corruption suspicions at Damen Shipyards, including whether such investigations should count in defence procurement and whether the company has adequately reformed its compliance. The State Secretary declined to give details on ongoing criminal investigations, stated that exclusion rules do not allow ongoing investigations to bar bidders, and described Damen's compliance programme and continued enhanced export-credit monitoring as evidence of reform.
No statements can be made about ongoing criminal investigations, and Defence has no insight into the FIOD's methods or the ongoing investigation.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan en Defensie heeft geen inzage in de werkwijze van de FIOD en het lopende onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Omwonenden Rossum-Agelo langer in onzekerheid over mogelijk munitiedepot: “Kan maart worden’”

MP Boswijk asked the State Secretary for Defence about the consequences of explosion safety zones A, B and C around a large ammunition depot, the treatment of farmland and cultural-historical sites, how community impact is assessed, and how the national spatial programme process and stakeholder information will proceed. The State Secretary explained the zone restrictions in detail and described the planned assessment process, but gave largely procedural answers on farmland and location choice, leaving the final decision to the cabinet after consultation.
After administrative consultation between Defence and the provinces and municipalities in spring 2025, the cabinet will decide on the provisional preferred alternatives for the NPRD.
Na bestuurlijk overleg door Defensie met de provincies en gemeenten in het voorjaar van 2025 zal het kabinet een besluit nemen over de voorlopige voorkeursalternatieven voor het NPRD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het dreigende tekort aan nieuwe commando’s

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Defence about a looming shortage of new special forces commandos, irregular outflow of experienced operators, a possible SOF allowance, and equipment procurement delays. The State Secretary answered that irregular outflow fell from 8.7% in 2022 to 2.3% in 2024, that the existing pay package is competitive, and that procurement processes already have designated contacts, though no structural SOF budget exists.
Apart from that, I continue to look at all options to limit irregular outflow and to work towards a well-staffed armed forces.
Los daarvan blijf ik naar alle opties kijken om irreguliere uitstroom te beperken en te werken aan een goed gevulde krijgsmacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over militairen die op missie niet worden doorbetaald in het weekend en over reservisten zonder verlof

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence whether deployed soldiers receive only a deployment allowance for weekend days without salary or hour compensation, why exercise and deployment pay differ, whether pay will be reconsidered in consultation with unions, and how reservists' leave and pension rules will be handled following a court ruling. The State Secretary defended the differing allowance structures as justified and agreed with unions, promised further work on a new regulation for deployments, and gave a limited answer on reservists' leave compensation and no information on other European countries' rules.
Defence and the unions are currently working out this regulation. This consultation is confidential.
Defensie en de vakbonden werken deze regeling momenteel uit. Dit overleg is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pool over de demonstratie op 24 september jl. bij de Kromhout Kazerne te Utrecht

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about a pro-Palestinian protest that blocked access to the Kromhout Barracks and forced cancellation of a Defence-NIDV industry event, and whether conceding to such actions encourages further protest. The Minister replied that cancellation was a joint decision for participant safety, called it regrettable, noted that mayors assess whether to restrict demonstrations near military sites, and said talks on a new date are underway.
The decision to cancel the meeting was taken in joint consultation between NIDV and Defence.
Het besluit om de bijeenkomst af te lasten is in gezamenlijk overleg tussen de NIDV en Defensie genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitrusting van de speciale troepen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence why special forces commanders buy their own equipment because central procurement is slow, and whether they should get an individual equipment budget. The government admits longer delivery times, calls self-purchase undesirable for safety and quality reasons, and rejects an individual budget while pointing to projects such as DOKS and a boot-choice concept.
To improve the quality, comfort and delivery time of the equipment, several projects are underway.
Om de kwaliteit, het draagcomfort en de levertijd van de uitrusting te verbeteren lopen er verschillende projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heite over het rapport ‘Onderzoek naar een sociaal veilige werkomgeving bij Defensie'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about the Giebels report on social safety in Defence, including the status of its five recommendations, whistleblower reports, confidentiality clauses in settlements, and anonymous reporting. The government answered that most recommendations have been implemented, that six misstand reports were received 2019–2023 with five investigated, that it cannot give some counts for privacy or lack of central registration, and that anonymous reporting is being prepared.
In the interest of the privacy of reporters, I therefore make no statements about the requested number.
In het belang van de privacy van melders doe ik daarom geen uitspraken over het gevraagde aantal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het platform DBDAAP

An FVD MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about the usage, number of developers, applications, data volume, costs and ongoing development of the DBDAAP defence big data platform. The State Secretary answered that it has been in use since September 2022, with about 90 users, 34 applications and over 20 terabytes of data, that about 8.2 million euros has been spent, and that development continues in the defence data lab, though application names are withheld for confidentiality.
Due to the confidential nature of these applications, it is not possible to share their names.
Vanwege het vertrouwelijke karakter van deze applicaties is het niet mogelijk de namen hiervan te delen.

m: Motie van het lid Rik Janssen over de geheimhoudingsplicht
Asks the government to propose further narrowing the notary's duty of confidentiality for criminal investigations, including conduct by notaries themselves.
requests the government to come with proposals to further restrict notaries' duty of confidentiality for the detection of criminal offences
verzoekt de regering met voorstellen te komen om de geheimhoudingsplicht van notarissen verder in te perken ten behoeve van de opsporing van strafbare feiten
Amendement van het lid Rik Janssen over de openbaarheid van tuchtmaatregelen

Makes the registration of final disciplinary reprimands, warnings and fines for notaries non-public by default, reversing the bill's approach so that publicity applies unless the chamber decides otherwise.
The effectiveness of disciplinary law is best served by the greatest possible publicity of disciplinary case law.
De effectiviteit van tuchtrecht is gebaat bij een zo groot mogelijke openbaarheid van tuchtrechtspraak.
Motie van het lid Rik Janssen over de capaciteit van het Bureau Financieel Toezicht
Asks the government to examine one year after a bill whether the Bureau Financieel Toezicht has enough capacity to supervise the notariat and to report to the House.
requests the government to examine, one year after introduction of this bill, whether the capacity of the Bureau Financieel Toezicht is adequate
verzoekt de regering een jaar na invoering van dit wetsvoorstel te onderzoeken of de capaciteit van het Bureau Financieel Toezicht afdoende is

qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vos over de mogelijkheid niet langer heel Nederland aan te wijzen als kwetsbare zone in het kader van de Nitraatrichtlijn

An FVD MP asked whether the Netherlands can narrow the Nitrates Directive's vulnerable-zone scope from the whole territory to parts of it, so that the stricter 2026 manure rules apply less broadly. The minister answered that the 7th action programme applies nationwide, so no zones are designated, that revision is for the next cabinet's 8th programme, and that the Commission must be notified and could start infringement proceedings if designation is inadequately justified.
Since in the Netherlands the action programmes apply to the entire Dutch territory, there is no list of vulnerable zones that can be revised.
Aangezien in Nederland actieprogramma's van toepassing zijn op het gehele Nederlandse grondgebied is er geen lijst van kwetsbare zones die herzien kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de tijdige aanbieding van het verbod op stroomstootapparatuur in de veehouderij

MP Ouwehand asked whether the ban on electric shock devices in livestock farming was submitted to the Ministry of Justice and Security by the 15 December 2025 deadline and whether it will take effect on 1 January 2026. Minister Wiersma answered yes on both points, stating the ban was submitted on time and the AMvB has been published in the Staatsblad.
The ban was submitted to the Ministry of Justice and Security (J&V) on time.
Het verbod is tijdig aangeboden aan het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid (J&V).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht ‘Nederland is een ontbossingsland’

MP Teunissen asked the government about reports that the Netherlands contributes to global deforestation via finance, ports and consumption, including Rabobank's ranking and the adequacy of EU deforestation rules. The minister answered that companies and financial institutions must follow OECD and UN standards, that existing EU sustainability rules apply but are being simplified, and that the EUDR enforcement details remain uncertain pending final EU text.

How a financial institution gives effect to compliance with these international guidelines, and what choices it makes regarding investments or engaging with companies, is the responsibility of the institutions themselves.

Hoe een financiële instelling invulling geeft aan de naleving van deze internationale richtlijnen, en welke keuzes zij maakt ten aanzien van investeringen of het aangaan van gesprekken met bedrijven, is de verantwoordelijkheid van de instellingen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de vogelgriep

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about avian flu: the high poultry density, possible structural measures such as bans on new or expanded poultry farms in water-rich and dense areas, risks to wild birds and humans, and pandemic risk. The minister answered that an impact analysis on structural measures is underway, due early 2026, and that current measures are kept under review, with no additional measures beyond the existing plan.
I am currently having an impact analysis carried out on these structural measures.
Ik laat momenteel een impactanalyse uitvoeren naar deze structuurmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel ‘Wat hebben Nederlandse landbouwbedrijven op een beurs in Rusland te zoeken?’1

Members of D66 asked the government about Dutch agricultural firms exhibiting at a fair in Krasnodar and continuing to operate in Russia, including whether agricultural machinery exports strengthen Russia and whether export bans and company conduct should be addressed. The minister answered that the government balances sanctions against food security, pursues a ban on specific high-tech agricultural machinery exports, notes that Dutch-linked export figures cannot be solely attributed to machinery, and will inform parliament further on a motion.
The cabinet continues to work towards banning exports of specific high-grade agricultural machinery to Russia.
Het kabinet blijft zich inspannen voor het verbieden van de export van specifieke, hoogwaardige landbouwmachines naar Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over landbouwgif in populaire snoepgroenten voor jonge kinderen

An MP asked the government about pesticide residues in sweet vegetables for young children, including hormone-disrupting and PFAS pesticides, and whether the 0.01 mg/kg baby-food limit should apply to such products. The state secretary answered that residues stay within the legal MRLs, that EFSA considers current risk assessment suitable for young children, and that the Ctgb is still studying Danish findings before deciding on any withdrawals.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het artikel 'Kippenboeren zitten klem door vogelgriep en stikstof

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether eggs from a Dutch poultry farm vaccinated against bird flu carry a label, and whether consumers can be told if eggs come from vaccinated hens. The minister answered that the vaccine is a licensed vector vaccine rather than mRNA, that eggs from vaccinated hens are safe, and that packaging does not state which vaccines were administered, consistent with practice for decades.
Packaging of eggs and meat does not state which vaccines have been administered.
Op verpakkingen van eieren en vlees staat niet welke vaccins zijn toegediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de rondrazende vogelgriep en de grote risico’s voor de volksgezondheid

MPs Ouwehand asked the ministers about rising avian influenza outbreaks, mass culling since October, and why structural measures on poultry density announced in 2023 have not been implemented, as well as the pandemic risk and the Bekedam advice. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, said an impact analysis on structural measures is still underway and that a balanced decision will follow, and promised a January 2026 progress report on the zoonosis action plan.
Antwoord op vragen van leden De Hoop en Kostić over werkzaamheden aan de A-pier op Schiphol

MPs De Hoop and Kostić asked whether Schiphol's ongoing A-pier construction lacks a valid Natura 2000 permit, who is responsible for permitting and enforcement, and whether works should be halted. The State Secretary confirms the works require a permit that was annulled by the court in June 2025, that enforcement is a discretionary balancing of nature against airport interests, and that a pending enforcement request will be decided separately without prejudging the outcome.
I cannot anticipate that decision-making in answering these parliamentary questions.
Op die besluitvorming kan ik bij de beantwoording van deze Kamervragen niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt en Den Hollander over het uitblijven van een verbod op stroomstootapparatuur in de veehouderij

MPs Podt and Den Hollander asked why the promised ban on electric livestock prods has not been sent to parliament and what the obstacles are. The minister says the ban is being implemented by general administrative order after Council of State advice, with no legal obstacles, and that enforcement by the NVWA is limited because loading of animals in national transport is not reported to it.
There is no bill that will be sent to the House.
Er is geen wetsvoorstel dat naar de Kamer zal worden verstuurd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Podt, Bromet, Eerdmans, Grinwis, Beckerman, Graus en Dassen over ‘het door de Kamer geëiste verbod op stroomstootapparatuur in de veehouderij, dat de minister nog altijd niet hee

MPs from eight parties asked the minister why the ban on electric shock equipment in livestock farming, which parliament demanded, is still unsigned and may not take effect on 1 January 2026. The minister replied that the final decision steps are ready, that an exception to the standard two-month entry-into-force period may allow 1 January 2026, and that the aim remains entry into force on that date.
Within the cabinet policy on fixed change moments, I see room to use an exception to the standard two-month entry-into-force period, so that entry into force on 1 January 2026 remains possible.

Binnen het kabinetsbeleid over de vaste verandermomenten zie ik ruimte om gebruik te maken van een uitzonderingsgrond op de vaste invoeringstermijn van twee maanden, waardoor inwerkingtreding op 1 januari 2026 een mogelijkheid blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over het NGT-voorstel naar aanleiding van het Argos artikel

An MP asks the agriculture and economic affairs ministers about Dutch lobbying to loosen EU rules on new genomic techniques (NGT) after an Argos report, including whether the parliamentary motion against patents on NGT traits was respected in trilogue negotiations and whether small breeders' concerns were given priority. The Staatssecretaris answers that the Dutch government is not directly in the trilogues, that it pursued the motion's aim of avoiding patent blockades and transparency, that patent issues have only been discussed exploratively, and that the Raad agreement is a fair compromise on labelling, choice and patents, while promising to inform parliament before votes.
I always inform the House about votes in the Agriculture and Fisheries Council via the annotated agenda, and I will continue to do so.
Ik informeer uw Kamer altijd over stemmingen in de Landbouw- en Visserij Raad middels de geannoteerde agenda, dit zal ik blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Slagt-Tichelman en Gabriëls over het bericht dat gemeenten een landelijke aanpak voor bestrijdingsmiddelen willen

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the minister about municipalities' calls for a national approach to pesticides in bulb cultivation, including a statutory spray-free zone and national rules, and about the government's health-in-all-policies approach. The minister answered that a legal framework already exists for municipalities to act locally, that a study on spray-zone width is under way, that the sector is reducing pesticide use voluntarily, and that no national statutory spray-free zone will be introduced.
I agree with the municipality of Midden-Drenthe that this issue is complex, and I endorse the importance of mutual trust and open communication between farmers and residents.
Ik ben het eens met de gemeente Midden-Drenthe dat dit vraagstuk complex is, en onderschrijf het belang van onderling vertrouwen en open communicatie tussen agrariërs en omwonenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over ‘PFAS-houdende bestrijdingsmiddelen en het Deense verbod daarop.’

MP Bromet asks the minister about a Danish study showing the PFAS compound TFA leaches easily into groundwater, Denmark's withdrawal of 23 pesticides, the Ctgb's delay in reviewing them, the continued use of fluopyram products, and extended sell-off periods for Luna Sensation. Minister Wiersma replies that the Ctgb is still studying the Danish research, cannot yet give a timeline, will inform parliament once it decides, and that existing permits and phase-out periods remain in force while the Ctgb has the lead.
Once the Ctgb has taken a decision, I will inform your House of it.
Zodra er een besluit is genomen door het Ctgb zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over de waardering van onderzaai als rustgewas

An MP asked why undersowing a cover crop in maize is recognised as an eco-activity under the CAP but not as a rest crop under manure rules, and whether the rules could be changed. The minister answered that the timing rules for rest crops reflect the CDM's classification, that undersowing is allowed as an alternative for the cover-crop obligation, and that the rest-crop list will be reviewed with new CDM advice, with any change possibly only from 2027.
As announced in the draft 8th Action Programme, I intend to ask the CDM for advice on an assessment framework for determining rest crops.
Zoals aangekondigd in het concept 8 e actieprogramma, ben ik voornemens de CDM advies te vragen over een afweegkader voor het vaststellen van rustgewassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de recente update van AERIUS

An SGP MP asks the Minister of Agriculture whether the RIVM's recent AERIUS update wrongly failed to correct for likely overestimation of dry nitrogen deposition in dune areas (Solleveld measurements), and what this means for local ammonia concentrations and permitting, such as housing projects in western Netherlands. The Minister answers that RIVM is independent and decides on model methods, that the 2014 Solleveld measurements are not suitable for calibration but a new measurement campaign runs to end-2026, that halving deposition velocity would raise concentrations 15-20% but there is no scientific basis yet for that, and that the DEPAC model will be adjusted only once sufficient consistent evidence exists.
At present, however, there is no substantive (scientific) basis for halving the deposition velocity.
Er is op dit moment echter geen inhoudelijke (wetenschappelijke) onderbouwing om de depositiesnelheid te halveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Flach over de door China opgelegde importheffingen voor varkensvlees

MPs Stoffer and Flach asked about Chinese provisional anti-dumping duties of 20% to 62.4% on EU pork, their effect on Dutch exporters, the WTO legitimacy of the Chinese claims, and whether the government would seek a delay. The state secretary answers that effects are still unclear but that Dutch exports to China (about 374 million euro in 2024) are at risk, that the Commission is assessing WTO conformity, and that the ministries have submitted written objections and remain in close contact with the sector.
The European Commission is currently further analysing the investigation and the provisional measures for conformity with World Trade Organization (WTO) rules.
De Europese Commissie analyseert het onderzoek en de voorlopige maatregelen momenteel nader op conformiteit met regels van de Wereldhandelsorganisatie (WTO)
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over ‘de rechterlijke uitspraak dat Nederland burgers onvoldoende beschermt tegen landbouwgif’

MP Kostić asks the government how it will respond to a court ruling that the Netherlands inadequately protects residents from pesticide use near homes, including whether it will apply the precautionary principle, correct the Ctgb's approach, reinstate the pesticide bill and ban spraying near housing. The minister replies that the ruling is a non-final civil case with no direct effect on other crops, rejects the claim of failure by the legislature and the Ctgb, points to ongoing research and existing rules, and declines to commit to new bans or a fixed timeline.
The ruling is not final; a merits procedure and cassation are possible.
De uitspraak is niet onherroepelijk, o.a. een bodemprocedure en cassatie zijn mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over een Nationaal Hitteplan voor dieren

An MP from PvdD asked the Minister of Agriculture about a national heat plan for farm animals, pressing for enforceable rules on transport temperatures, waiting times at slaughterhouses, stocking density and shelter in pastures. The Minister largely pointed to existing plans, NVWA enforcement, ongoing work on a 30-degree transport guideline and a shelter project, declining some demands such as a fixed 15-minute waiting limit and lower stocking density.
For the 30-degree policy guideline, I previously informed the House that I am working to remove as much as possible the concerns of entrepreneurs
Voor de beleidsregel 30 graden geldt dat ik eerder de Kamer heb geïnformeerd dat ik aan de slag ga met het zoveel mogelijk wegnemen van de zorgen van ondernemers
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het instellen van een verbod op verre diertransporten tijdens de zomermaanden, net zoals Vlaanderen heeft gedaan

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the Netherlands will follow Flanders in banning long-distance animal transports in summer heat and immediately introduce a 30-degree maximum temperature rule. The minister answered that bilateral export agreements have ended, NVWA checks heat conditions, and the 30-degree rule is delayed pending a night-slaughter exploration and EU negotiations.
I want to complete this exploration.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het stikstofplan 'Bouwstenendocument emissiereductie landbouw'

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture whether the government will adopt the stakeholder 'building blocks' document on nitrogen emission reduction, whether it complies with the Habitats Directive, the Greenpeace court ruling and the advice of the state advocate, and whether binding deposition and emission targets for 2030 will be legally secured. The Minister states that the document was used in the government's follow-up package, that the shift from deposition to emission steering is consistent with EU obligations, that the court did not order binding targets, and that sectoral emission targets will be set and legally anchored.
The cabinet is pursuing a shift from deposition to emission-based steering.
Het kabinet zet in op een omslag van depositie naar emissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het wetsvoorstel van het lid Ouwehand

An MP asked the agriculture minister about a private member's bill on animal slaughter, including whether it exceeds EU minimum rules and affects religious freedom. The minister answered that the bill is an initiative of parliament, that notification to the EC is a procedural step without implying government support, and that the government will form its view later in the process.
The process of handling it is of course also for your House.
Het proces van behandeling daarvan is uiteraard ook aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het krantenartikel van de Volkskrant “Powerplay bewindspersonen BBB: landbouwpost in Rome blijft voorlopig leeg”

An MP asked why the Permanent Representative post in Rome (FAO, WFP, IFAD) has stayed unfilled since December 2024, whether agriculture ministers rejected selection-committee candidates, and what this means for Dutch influence. The government said the selection procedure is still ongoing after reopening to candidates outside the civil service, declined to comment on candidates or internal ministerial discussions, and acknowledged reduced visibility and influence while the post is vacant.
The discussions of the Council of Ministers and the appointments before it are not public, and what is discussed is confidential.
De besprekingen van de ministerraad en de benoemingen die voorliggen zijn niet openbaar en hetgeen besproken wordt, is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ‘een integrale audit van ideologisch gedreven overheidsuitgaven en mogelijke systeemfraude in de overheidsadministratie’ aan

An FvD MP asked for a full audit of ideologically motivated government spending, including subsidies to organisations that have sued the state, checks on ghost employees and unused payment cards, and a DOGE-style taskforce. The government declined to create a list of litigating organisations or a taskforce, citing existing audit bodies (ADR, Algemene Rekenkamer) and disproportionate cost, while providing partial data on payroll ages and payment cards.
The Internal Audit Service of the State (ADR) and the Netherlands Court of Audit (AR) are both independent auditors that oversee lawful and efficient use of public funds.
De Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) en de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) zijn beide onafhankelijke controleurs die toezien op rechtmatig en doelmatig gebruik van overheidsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over “het bericht dat de minister van LVVN haar bevoegdheid misbruikte om de publicatie van emissiegegevens te verhinderen

MP Podt (D66) asks whether Minister Wiersma misused her powers and acted unlawfully by re-running the objection procedure and delaying publication of farm emissions data containing farmers' addresses, despite an Advisory Council and court ruling favouring publication. The minister defends the delay as a careful protection of farmers' privacy and safety, refuses to withdraw the appeal, and promises a study into farmers' social safety.
The use of this power is in accordance with the legal framework and is aimed at careful decision-making, not at delaying disclosure.
Het gebruik van deze bevoegdheid is in overeenstemming met het wettelijk kader en is gericht op een zorgvuldige besluitvorming, niet op het vertragen van openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de terroristische brandstichting bij kippenslachterij Plukon en het openlijk dreigen met nieuwe aanslagen

An MP from BBB asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about an arson attack on the Plukon poultry slaughterhouse, the ALF's implied threat of more attacks, and whether the group should be designated terrorist, plus questions on firefighter risks, prosecution and prevention. The government condemned the violence, said police and the prosecution are investigating and it cannot anticipate outcomes, explained the NCTV's terrorism definition and that the threat picture does not currently show a demonstrable violent threat from animal rights activism, and promised to invite sector organisations for talks.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service (OM) are currently investigating the incident.
De politie en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) doen op dit moment onderzoek naar het incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt en Bamenga over “Het Uitvoeringsprogramma Impuls KRW Utrecht”

Two D66 MPs asked why the Netherlands is failing Water Framework Directive targets, why Utrecht province is adopting extra measures (notably on pesticides) that the national government is not, and how pesticide, nitrate and KRW rules can be aligned. The minister answers that the targets are shared with provinces and municipalities, that national action focuses on generic pesticide and nutrient measures and reauthorisation, and that the Utrecht programme is a provincial choice, while acknowledging further measures will be needed.
It is up to individual government bodies to weigh to what extent additional measures are appropriate.
Het is aan individuele overheidsorganen om af te wegen in hoeverre aanvullende maatregelen gepast zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over jongeren werkzaam in de bollenteelt

An MP asked whether 13-17 year olds may work with bulbs treated with pesticides, how many minors work in bulb growing, whether inspections target them, and whether rules are adequate. The Secretary of State answered that minors may only handle such bulbs under strict conditions (no CMR substances, residues minimised, employer obligations under the Arbobesluit), that data on minors' health risks are not yet known, and that the government is in talks with the sector about clarifying the rules.
SZW is in talks with the sector (LTO, Stigas) and trade unions about the practice regarding young people and crop protection products.
SZW is in gesprek met de sector (LTO, Stigas) en vakbonden over de praktijk rond jongeren en gewasbeschermingsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het overleg met maatschappelijke partijen in het kader van stikstof

An MP asked how the 3 July 2025 consultation with societal parties on the nitrogen (stikstof) policy went, whether a measures package was on the table, and whether the measures on the MCEN long list had been costed and could be shared with parliament. The minister answered that no package was presented, that four knowledge institutes are analysing the measures and results will be shared only after cabinet decision-making, and that the questions were answered within three weeks.
As usual, the underlying documents from external parties containing relevant analyses, facts, risks and explanations will be shared with the House and made public after cabinet decision-making.

Zoals gebruikelijk worden de onderliggende documenten van externe partijen die relevante analyses, feiten, risico's en toelichtingen bevatten na besluitvorming in het kabinet gedeeld met Uw Kamer en openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de noodzaak van het stellen van een concrete maximumnorm om varkens te beschermen tegen ziekmakende giftige staldampen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture to set a concrete maximum ammonia concentration for pig barns, citing the NVWA's call, Wageningen UR and EFSA findings, and norms in Germany and France. The Minister answered that the open welfare norm needs measurable, enforceable and practically feasible specification, that the evidence does not establish a clear dose-response threshold, and that a maximum ammonia norm is intended to be included in the AMvB dierwaardige veehouderij.
I intend to include a norm for a maximum ammonia concentration for pig barns in the AMvB dierwaardige veehouderij.
Ik ben voornemens een norm voor een maximum ammoniakconcentratie voor varkensstallen op te nemen in de AMvB dierwaardige veehouderij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het niet beboeten van ernstig dierenleed door botbreuken, bloedingen en ontwrichtingen bij miljoenen kippen, eenden en kalkoenen

An MP asked the minister why enforcement against bird-catching injuries in poultry was limited to above 1% injury thresholds, whether NVWA can still act after a court ruling, and whether breeding restrictions or consumer disclosure would be pursued. The minister answered that enforcement continues in a revised form, defends the sector's voluntary improvements, and refused breeding restrictions and consumer communication while committing to study the ruling and adjust oversight of catching and transport.
The NVWA will study the court ruling carefully and arrive at the most effective solution for supervising the catching, loading and transport process, applying appropriate enforcement where necessary.

De NVWA zal de uitspraak van de rechter goed bestuderen en daarbij komen tot de meest effectieve oplossing om toezicht te houden op het vang-, laad- en transportproces en waar nodig passende handhaving toe te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de beoordeling van verslechtering in Natura 2000 gebieden

MP Flach (SGP) asks how the Habitats Directive's deterioration test should be applied in nature goal analyses, including whether critical deposition values are treated as targets and how soil monitoring should be improved. The Secretary of State answers at length, largely by reference to existing guidance, the Ecological Authority's advice and planned improvements, while stating that the court's reasoning on critical deposition values is accepted as it stands.
The Ecological Authority checks whether the nature goal analyses draw correct conclusions about developments in the protected nature values.
De Ecologische Autoriteit toetst of in de natuurdoelanalyses op de juiste wijze conclusies worden getrokken over de ontwikkelingen in de beschermde natuurwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP from JA21 asked ministers across many departments how much money, which diversity, gender and inclusion policies, courses, quotas, KPIs and consultants their implementing agencies use. The government answered that spending is mostly embedded in general HR policy, lists the agencies' trainings and monitoring tools, and provided the requested figures per organisation where available.
There is a large number of implementing and sui generis organisations.
Er is sprake van een groot aantal uitvoerings- en sui generis organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van Campen en Van der Plas over het binnendringen van stallen

MPs Van Campen and Van der Plas asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers how a court ruling allowing a demonstration exception to unlawful entry (art. 138 Sr) affects prosecution of activists occupying livestock barns, and whether laws should change. The minister declined to comment on the ruling, said the law already covers entry without forced entry, and pointed to a WODC study due in summer 2025 that may inform possible legal changes.
I understand the discomfort the ruling will cause for some. At the same time, it is an independent judicial ruling that we must respect, and as Minister I will not comment on its substance.

Ik heb begrip voor het ongemak dat het vonnis bij sommigen zal opleveren. Tegelijkertijd is er wel sprake van een rechterlijk en onafhankelijk vonnis dat we hebben te respecteren en dat ik als Minister ook niet inhoudelijk zal becommentariëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het RIVM-advies om geen particuliere eieren meer te eten

MP Flach (SGP) asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Agriculture about the RIVM advice to stop eating eggs from backyard hens, why locational factors and the English-only report were not examined or published in Dutch, and what keepers can do to reduce PFAS uptake. The government answered that the wider investigation into PFAS sources is ongoing, that findings on bio-accumulation via worms and housing options are expected by year end, and that a Dutch public summary will follow later this year.
The RIVM report is part of a longer-running investigation aimed at identifying the sources of elevated PFAS levels in eggs.
Het RIVM-rapport is onderdeel van een langer lopend onderzoekstraject met als doel de bronnen van verhoogde PFAS-gehaltes in eieren te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het massale gebruik van glyfosaat voor de productie van veevoer

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether glyphosate use for feed crops, its proximity to homes, possible health and Parkinson's risks, and bee losses justify a ban or tighter measures. The minister replied that the EU re-approval rests on independent science, that a legal ban on glyphosate uses is not possible, that a draft decree to make alternatives mandatory is with the Raad van State, and that RIVM research on glyphosate and Parkinson's will report in 3-5 years.
Partly because of your House's wish, I have taken steps to make alternatives to the use of crop protection products mandatory.
Mede vanwege de wens van uw Kamer heb ik wel stappen gezet om alternatieven voor het gebruik van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen te verplichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over stikstofdifferentiatie ten behoeve van suikerbieten, tarwe, gerst of aardappelen op kleigrond

An MP asked whether farmers on clay soil whose 2024 wet-weather yield losses push their three-year average below the threshold could be exempted from nitrogen differentiation, and whether the conditions could be loosened. The minister refused to disregard 2024 or use a three-year average, arguing the conditions protect water quality, and said she does not intend to loosen them.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daar ben ik niet toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de gevolgen van het niet naleven van Europese milieu- en natuurwetgeving

An MP asked the ministers what EU legal tools besides infringement procedures could force the Netherlands to comply with environmental and nature law, and about related talks with the Commission and other member states. The minister answered that the Commission could theoretically cut EU funds such as CAP money, that talks with the Commission are confidential so details cannot be disclosed, and that compliance is discussed with other states without a central focus on level playing field.
To be able to exchange views openly with the Commission on various issues and possible solutions now and in the future, confidentiality is of great importance.
Om nu en in de toekomst met de Commissie open van gedachten te kunnen wisselen over verschillende vraagstukken en mogelijke oplossingsrichtingen, is vertrouwelijkheid van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked multiple ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy, budgets, training, quotas and evaluation within implementing agencies. The answers, given for RVO and TNO, describe small budgets, existing training programmes, targets for gender and cultural diversity and no external consultants.
No external organisations or consultants have been hired.
Er zijn geen externe organisaties of consultants ingehuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

MP Eerdmans asked ministers about the budget, content, training, monitoring and external advisers of diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The government answered for the NVWA, estimating about €70,000 for 2025, listing planned priorities and training, and stating it has no external consultants and no removal of artworks; it also said it would answer per agency separately.
Question 8: Could you provide the answers per implementing agency separately? Answer 8: Yes.
Vraag 8 Zou u de beantwoording per uitvoeringsinstantie afzonderlijk kunnen aanleveren? Antwoord 8 Ja.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paulusma over regulering van bestrijdingsmiddelen

Two D66 MPs asked about the difference between low- and high-risk pesticides, health risks to farmers, residents and children, and whether municipalities can regulate pesticides and set spray-free zones. The minister explains the EU categories (candidates for substitution are approved for 7 years with comparative assessment), states that no carcinogenic substances are approved and that the RIVM is researching Parkinson, COPD and leukaemia, promises to improve municipal knowledge and information, but declines to set a national spray-free zone rule pending a research plan.
I maintain close contact with the VNG on the pesticide policy field.
Ik onderhoud nauw contact met de VNG over het beleidsterrein gewasbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het insecticide deltamethrin

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister about the insecticide deltamethrin, citing a court ruling on the Ctgb's failure to assess hormone-disrupting effects and recent studies on neurotoxicity, and asks for an Article 21 review and a ban. The minister replies that the Ctgb has adjusted its method, that the substance is already under EU re-evaluation with new limits that cover the cited effects, and that there is currently no reason to press the Commission for an early review.
Following this ruling, the Ctgb announced on 30 July 2024 that it would adjust its method for assessing crop protection products in certain respects.
Naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak heeft het Ctgb op 30 juli 2024 bekendgemaakt de werkwijze bij de beoordeling van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen op onderdelen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over vaccinatie tegen vogelgriep

MP Van Meijeren (FVD) asked the minister about the poultry avian influenza vaccination pilot, its selection of farms, vaccine choice and evidence, safety, consumer labelling, trade and economic effects, and whether it could lead to mandatory vaccination. The minister answered at length that the step-by-step approach relies on EMA-approved vectorvaccines and stakeholder consultation, and states that labelling is not required and that a broader scenario will be communicated by year-end.
Once I have more insight into a concrete scenario, I will inform the House about it.
Zodra ik meer zicht heb op een concreet scenario informeer ik de Kamer hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over de onafhankelijkheid en transparantie van de review op het VGO-III-onderzoek
