MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked whether the peer review of the VGO-III goat-farm health study was independent and transparent, and whether a new independent review will be commissioned. The minister answers that the study was peer reviewed in journals, two independent epidemiologists reviewed it in 2020, the Gezondheidsraad is advising on its evidence, and no new independent review is planned.

As indicated in the letter to Parliament accompanying the VGO-III final report, the Health Council has been asked to provide further interpretation of the evidence on health effects for residents near goat farms.

Zoals in de Kamerbrief bij het eindrapport VGO-III is aangegeven, is de Gezondheidsraad gevraagd om een nadere duiding te geven van de bewijslast met betrekking tot gezondheidseffecten voor omwonenden van geitenhouderijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in executive agencies; this answer from the Education minister covers DUO and NWO. The minister says there are no plans to intensify or scale back the policy, explains the budget and training offered, and states that the set of questions concerns internal personnel policy rather than checks on executive power.
OCW has no specific diversity or gender policy.
OCW heeft geen specifiek diversiteits- of genderbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de natuurvergunningproblematiek bij Defensie

An MP asked whether nitrogen (stikstof) nature-permit rules, tightened by the Council of State's December 2024 rulings, are blocking Defence expansion and training, and whether Defence should be exempted. The government confirms the rulings affect Defence (especially retroactive intern salderen), says impact and capacity needs are still being analysed, notes the MCE&N will consider Defence's interests, but does not exempt Defence and points to the planned Wet op de defensiegereedheid instead.
Defence is bound by existing laws and regulations.
Defensie is gehouden aan bestaande wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over innovaties in de landbouw

An MP from D66 asked the agriculture minister about emission-reducing livestock innovations, the Lely Sphere subsidy, the reliability of the ammonia emission measurement method, and the wider effects of relying on innovation. The minister answered that the Lely Sphere is one of several subsidised techniques, that a measurement protocol and certification system are being revised, and that flanking policy is being explored within a ministerial commission, without committing to a specific new structural change.
It is desirable to reduce the uncertainty margins where possible. Work is being done on this.
Het is wenselijk om de onzekerheidsmarges waar mogelijk te verkleinen. Hier wordt aan gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel ‘Er woedt een keurmerkenstrijd om het ‘groene’ bosje bloemen’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about Royal FloraHolland's MPS sustainability certificate, whether it exceeds legal requirements, its effect on organic growers and consumer confusion. The minister answered that the certificate partly adds requirements beyond the law, that the market sets its own standards, and that no commitment to change the scheme or talk with FloraHolland was given.
It is up to the market to determine the substantive requirements of various market-driven certification schemes and labels, such as those of MPS, and not up to the government.
Het is aan de markt om de inhoudelijke eisen van verschillende marktgedreven certificatieschema's en keurmerken, zoals die van MPS, te bepalen en niet aan de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked the ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removal, quotas, success metrics and consultants. The government answered for the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, saying the spending is about EUR 60,000 within normal operations, no artworks were removed, the statutory disability quota applies, and no external consultants were hired.
External organisations or consultants are not hired to advise on the above-mentioned themes.
Externe organisaties of consultants worden niet ingehuurd voor advisering op het gebied van bovengenoemde thema’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de ernstige vogelgriep-situatie

An MP asks the ministers about the severe avian influenza situation, including the need for financial support for animal rescue organisations handling wild birds, the risk to humans, and the government's refusal so far to fund them. The minister answers that human risk is low to moderate, that animal rescue groups have no formal task in removing dead wild birds, that no financial support is needed for now, and that the situation will be reassessed if it worsens.
Financial support is currently not something I consider necessary.
Financiële ondersteuning acht ik op dit moment niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The Minister of Health answered for RIVM: a €50,000 budget for 2025, continuation of existing policy, a 2.76% quota plus government-wide targets, and a hired project leader costing €24,000.
RIVM currently has a Diversity & Inclusion policy budget of €50,000 reserved for 2025.
Het RIVM heeft momenteel een Diversiteit & Inclusie (D&I) beleidsbudget van € 50.000,– euro gereserveerd voor 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paulusma over veehouderij en gezondheid omwonenden (VGO-III)

MPs Podt and Paulusma asked the ministers of Agriculture and of Health about the health risks for residents living near goat farms, including the rising goat numbers despite earlier advice on distances, the lack of causal proof, and whether direct measures will follow. The ministers answered that the risks are taken seriously, that the Health Council has been asked to advise in two parts (June and November 2025) before any follow-up policy is decided, and that talks with provinces and a WUR advice on reducing pathogens in stables are underway.
We take the health risks shown in the VGO-III report very seriously.
De gezondheidsrisico’s die uit het VGO-III rapport blijken, nemen we heel serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Rooderkerk over het bericht 'Schoof: binnen twee maanden stikstofplan, 'economie moet blijven functioneren''

Two D66 MPs asked the agriculture minister for sector-level agricultural emissions figures, whether the 2030 climate target for farming is achievable, the budget gap, and how the stikstof (nitrogen) lock affects green projects. The minister gave breakdowns for 2023, said 2024 figures and the 2030 target status will follow later, outlined planned policy measures, and promised a joint package to be announced in the spring budget.
The cabinet will consider the required budgets for the various challenges, including the climate task, during the spring budget decision-making.
Het kabinet zal bij de voorjaarsbesluitvorming stil staan bij de benodigde budgetten voor de verschillende opgaven, waaronder de klimaatopgave.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Pierik over de import van Russische kunstmest en de mogelijkheden om alternatieven zoals RENURE sneller toe te laten

Pierik (BBB) asked the minister about EU plans to cut imports of Russian fertiliser and how to speed up alternatives such as RENURE, and whether to press for it at the EU Foreign Affairs Council. Minister Wiersma answered that the Netherlands supports tariffs on Russian fertiliser and is actively lobbying the Commission and member states for fast RENURE approval, but declined to answer the Council question in time and did not commit to changing the Aa-list policy.
I am currently working hard to get RENURE approved and am also raising this point with my European colleagues and the European Commission.
Ik zet mij momenteel vol in voor de toelating van RENURE en breng hierbij ook dit punt onder de aandacht van mijn Europese collega's en de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de schokkende beelden van ernstig dierenleed op een hertenboerderij

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister about hidden-camera footage showing prolonged suffering of deer shot in a commercial deer farm, and whether the NVWA was present, had inspected, and could close the farm. The Minister says the footage is shocking and the NVWA is reviewing it, but gives no commitment to close the farm, states no inspections occurred in three years, and offers to talk with the deer farmers' association.
The NVWA's investigation into these images is ongoing, so no statement can yet be made on this question.
Het onderzoek van de NVWA naar deze beelden loopt, waardoor er over deze vraag nog geen uitspraak gedaan kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de noodzaak van het stellen van een concrete maximumnorm om varkens te beschermen tegen ziekmakende giftige staldampen

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the minister why no quantitative maximum ammonia norm (such as 20 ppm) has been set for pig stables despite long-running enforcement problems with the open norm, and whether the WUR report implies continued health risks. The minister acknowledged the enforcement protocol is inadequate and that the open norm has been delayed, but rejected the need for a fixed numeric limit now, saying the WUR findings are being weighed in the path toward more animal-friendly farming without committing to a 20 ppm norm.
I am weighing the outcomes of this research in the process toward more animal-friendly livestock farming.
De uitkomsten van dit onderzoek weeg ik mee in het traject om te komen tot een nog meer dierwaardige veehouderij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over “Toezichthouder en ministerie van landbouw negeren EU-regels die kalfjes moeten beschermen, zeggen experts”

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture whether Dutch rules on calf housing (isolated single boxes, visual and physical contact) fall short of the EU Calves Directive and whether the NVWA enforces them, and what will be done about it. The minister denies any incomplete implementation, says the Dutch rules match the EU minimum, and promises a Dutch animal-friendly livestock decree to be submitted to parliament in summer.
Rectification is not necessary; the Calves Directive has been correctly implemented in Dutch regulations.
Rectificatie is niet nodig, de Kalverrichtlijn is correct geïmplementeerd in de Nederlandse regelgeving.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen, Meulenkamp, Bromet, Holman, Boomsma en Podt over gesprekken met de Deutsche Umwelthilfe en Agora Agrar gedurende het werkbezoek aan Berlijn van 15 tot en met 18 januari 2025

Six MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the German Stoffstrombilanzverordnung, a nutrient balance regime for farms, could inform the Dutch design of an enforceable nutrient balance and emissions targets, and whether the Dutch government would engage German authorities and report back. The minister answered that the German scheme is similar to the planned Dutch balance, that Dutch data sources exist, that lessons will be drawn, and that the minister is willing to talk with Germany and inform parliament if this yields insights.
I am willing to discuss this with the German government. If this leads to additional insights, I will inform you about it.
Ik ben bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan met de Duitse overheid. Indien dit tot aanvullende inzichten leidt, zal ik u hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over het artikel 'Derogatiebedrijven helpen kabinet een handje: 'Nitraatconcentratie daalt naar, op of onder de norm''

An MP asks ministers whether the reported fall in nitrate levels on derogation farms, and the claim that ending the manure derogation will help water quality, are supported by RIVM and Wageningen research and by the European Commission. The ministers answer that the reports were shared with the Commission, that ending the derogation may reduce grassland and shift fertiliser use, and that additional measures such as the 7th and 8th Nitrate Action Programmes are needed.
Yes, these reports have been shared with the European Commission by the Minister of LVVN.
Ja, deze rapporten zijn door de Minister van LVVN met de Europese Commissie gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de uitspraken over het aanmerken van het spuiwater uit de stikstofkraker als dierlijke meststof

An MP asked whether ammonia-stripper effluent should be treated as animal manure under the Nitrates Directive, questioning the EC's position on it. The minister answers that the stripper effluent remains animal manure because it results from active processing of manure, that the EC has interpreted it as subject to the 170 kg N/ha limit, and that no relevant EU Court case law exists.
This therefore makes it a product of animal manure and it falls under the definition of animal manure in the Nitrates Directive.
Daarmee is het een product van dierlijke mest en valt het onder de begripsbepaling van dierlijke mest in de Nitraatrichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked eight ministers how much money, which policies, courses, quotas, KPIs and external consultants their implementing agencies use for diversity, gender and inclusion policy. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management refers to the answers already sent on 14 January 2025 for the whole ministry, including Rijkswaterstaat, as no other information is available.
As no other information is available, reference is made to the information already shared with the House on 14 January.
Aangezien er geen andere informatie beschikbaar is, wordt daarom verwezen naar de informatie die op 14 januari al met de Kamer is gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked several ministers how much is spent on diversity, gender and inclusion policy at executive agencies, how it is shaped, whether artworks were removed, and how success is measured. The Minister of Finance answered with budget figures, the continuation of current policy, quota and ambition targets, and confirmed separate answers per agency.
In the coming years the current diversity, gender and inclusion policy will be continued in its current form.
De komende jaren wordt het huidige diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid voortgezet zoals huidig vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht 'Vandaag gestolen, morgen in Polen: ‘De hele polder wordt leeggeroofd'

MPs Bikker and Grinwis asked the ministers of Justice and Agriculture about a news report on mass theft of farm machinery in rural areas, asking about its scale, registration, cross-border organised crime, funding for rural trust persons and ANPR cameras. The minister answered that theft shows no rising trend in police figures, outlined existing prevention and cross-border cooperation measures, and said budget for trust persons is secured through brancheorganisaties while police capacity is under strain.
The police have no insight into the amounts of the stolen vehicles.
De politie heeft geen inzicht in de bedragen van de gestolen voertuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removals and targets. The government answered per agency, stating UWV spends about €320,000 in 2025 and SVB about €340,967, with targets and training described and no external consultants hired.
UWV intends to continue monitoring this policy in the coming years.
UWV is voornemens dit beleid de komende jaren te blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Van der Plas over de actualisatie van de Beleidslijn grote rivieren

Two MPs from SGP and BBB asked the ministers how the update of the Beleidslijn Grote Rivieren would affect farms in flood-overflow areas such as the Kampereilanden, including investment room, stable renewal and manure use. Minister Madlener replies that grounded agricultural firms keep development options under exceptions, that the update is not seen as a significant obstacle to Kampen, that the government will study boundaries for specific areas and that compensation is available under the Omgevingswet.
For agricultural businesses located in the former flow-carrying regime, almost nothing changes.
Voor agrarische bedrijven, die in de voormalige stroomvoerende regime liggen, verandert er nagenoeg niets.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Holman over de aanpak, en het gebruik van de term, piekbelasters

An MP asked the Agriculture Minister about the 'piekbelaster' label in the Lbv-plus nitrogen scheme, the 25 km deposition cut-off, Natura 2000 proximity data, the Greenpeace court ruling and provincial plans. The minister said the label is no longer used, that no list of such farms exists or is shared, that the ministry lacks the farm-location data, and that the other points are for the policy process.
Because of uncertainty about the performance of low-emission stable techniques, my predecessor made an exception in October 2023 for two housing systems.
Vanwege de onzekerheid rond de werking van emissiearme staltechnieken heeft mijn ambtsvoorganger in oktober 2023 een uitzondering gemaakt voor een tweetal huisvestingssystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel 'Wiersma: voorlopig geen ondergrens voor stikstofuitstoot, juridische check duurt minimaal 1,5 jaar' (Trouw)

An MP from D66 asks why the minister announced the nitrogen deposition floor (rekenkundige ondergrens) via media rather than a parliamentary letter, why the expert opinion was not shared with parliament, and whether the timeline of at least 1.5 years was communicated. The minister answers that no new process step was taken, the expert opinion will be published after the Raad van State advises, and the legal durability will take 1 to 1.5 years, while the floor could be applied in permitting in the meantime.
I intend to make the expert opinion and the peer reviews public after the Advisory Division of the Council of State has issued its advice on this.
Ik ben voornemens om het expertoordeel en de peerreviews openbaar te maken nadat de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State hierover haar voorlichting heeft uitgebracht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de grondgebondenheidseis voor melkveestallen in de Maatlat Duurzame Veehouderij

MP Flach asked whether the full grondgebondenheid requirement for dairy barns in the Maatlat Duurzame Veehouderij, which gates MIA/Vamil tax benefits, blocks barn renewal for welfare, emissions and fire safety, and whether it should be relaxed. The minister acknowledged the concern, said the Milieulijst 2025 now judges grondgebondenheid only on phosphate, and committed to consult colleagues on changing the condition in the Milieulijst 2026.
I will consult with my colleagues of Infrastructure and Water Management and Finance to see whether this can be given a different form in the Milieulijst 2026.
Ik ga in overleg met mijn collega's van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en Financiën om te bezien of deze in de Milieulijst 2026 op een andere wijze invulling kan krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Eerdmans over het nieuws dat Russische geheim agenten met vissersschepen naar Nederland kunnen reizen

MPs asked whether the NVWA can fully inspect Russian fish imports, impose fines or seize cargo, and whether the government will push for a ban on Russian whitefish, sanctions on Norebo, restrictions on Russian crews and measures against financing of Russia via Dutch ports. The minister answered that inspections are risk-based within EU benchmarks, that the NVWA lacks powers over catch quotas, that no fines were issued, and that the government favours exploring a whitefish import ban while leaving options open and withholding details of its negotiating position.
It is not in the interest of the Dutch negotiating position, nor of the surprise effect necessary for sanctions to be effective, to go into more detail on the Dutch negotiating position.

Het is niet in het belang van de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie en van de voor de effectiviteit van sancties noodzakelijke verrassingseffect om in meer detail op de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het beschermen van dieren tegen hitte

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture about protecting livestock from heat, citing EFSA findings on heat stress thresholds, the 35-degree transport rule, lowering the maximum transport temperature to 30 degrees, heat shelter in pastures, and a heat plan. The Minister says the 30-degree rule will be notified to the European Commission, that the sector and keepers bear responsibility with no separate government heat plan, and points to existing enforcement, a shelter project and a heat-stress plan of action.
I am starting the notification process with the European Commission.
Ik start het notificatieproces bij de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over de Afrikaanse varkenspest

MP Vedder (CDA) asked the Minister of Agriculture about the spread of African swine fever toward the Dutch border, its introduction routes, containment measures, access to affected areas, economic impact, provincial preparedness and wild boar management. Minister Wiersma answered at length that introduction risk remains small, outlined EU-based containment measures to be decided case by case, and described cooperation with provinces and EU partners, though no figures on damage were available.
Such insights are not known to me.
Dergelijke inzichten zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Podt over de pandemische paraatheid van Nederland in het licht van recente internationale ontwikkelingen en aangekondigde bezuinigingen

MPs Paulusma and Podt asked the ministers about Dutch pandemic preparedness amid international outbreaks, planned budget cuts of 300 million euros, staffing, vaccination willingness, and bird flu risks. The government answered largely by describing existing EU frameworks and programmes, noting that cuts are phased in and clarity will come mid-2025, and committing to further analysis and studies on bird flu structural measures.
The Ministry of VWS expects to be able to provide more clarity on funding for 2026 and beyond by mid-2025.
Het Ministerie van VWS verwacht medio 2025 meer duidelijkheid te kunnen geven over de middelen voor 2026 en verder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over Agri-PV

MP Vermeer (BBB) asked the ministers whether the definition of agri-PV (combined agriculture and solar energy) should leave room for innovation, whether the agricultural land designation stays agricultural, and about tax, fertiliser, GLB subsidy and ANLb nature-payment rules. The government answered yes to most questions, committed to a WEnR study and to possibly amending the GLB regulation, but declined general statements on tax treatment and fertiliser quantities, citing case-by-case assessment.
Within taxation, it must be assessed case by case whether entitlement to the various schemes can be claimed.
Binnen de fiscaliteit moet per geval worden beoordeeld of er aanspraak kan worden gemaakt op de verschillende regelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de hoge dierenartskosten en de macht van (private equity) ketens

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Agriculture about rising veterinary costs and private equity chain dominance after a clinic closure, and whether the government would act via research, legislation and competition oversight. The State Secretary replied that a study on veterinary tariffs is underway and will be shared shortly, and that the competition-law part of the motion falls under the Economic Affairs minister, who will report in spring 2025.

I expect to be able to send you this study, including my response to the results, the external analysis of foreign countries and my exploration of possible government measures, in the very short term.

Ik verwacht dat ik u dit onderzoek, inclusief mijn reactie op de resultaten, de externe analyse naar het buitenland en mijn verkenning naar mogelijke maatregelen vanuit de overheid, op zeer korte termijn kan doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Bromet over de berichten dat Zeeuwse buffels te veel PFAS binnenkrijgen

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked why the NVWA knew for two years that Zeeland water buffalo contained too much PFAS without informing the province or nature organisation, and what risks and remedies exist. The State Secretary answered that the owner was informed, no food safety risk existed since the meat was no longer sold, communication improvements and RIVM research are underway, but no direct action on the province's request was committed.

Because the buffalo were no longer slaughtered for human consumption and there was no food safety risk, there was no need to inform other parties such as the province of Zeeland and the nature organisation Het Zeeuwse Landschap.

Omdat de buffels hierna niet meer werden afgevoerd voor humane consumptie en er geen sprake was van een voedselveiligheidsrisico, bestond geen noodzaak andere partijen zoals de provincie Zeeland en natuurorganisatie Het Zeeuwse Landschap op de hoogte te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked all ministries about spending, design, training, quotas, success metrics, external consultants and the government's view of 'woke' policy on diversity and inclusion in the civil service. The government answered that diversity and inclusion policy aims at a representative civil service, sets numerical ambitions for gender and cultural diversity, and says no artworks were removed and no quota beyond the statutory banenafspraak applies.
For an overview of the money earmarked for diversity and inclusion policy per ministry for the coming year, as far as now known, I refer to the annexes.
Voor een overzicht van het geld dat het komende jaar geoormerkt is voor diversiteit en inclusiebeleid per ministerie, voor zover nu bekend, verwijs ik naar de bijlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het intrekken van vergunningen bij onderbezetting van stallen

An MP asked the ministers whether they were aware of Council of State rulings requiring municipalities to justify not withdrawing unused livestock-housing permits, and whether this creates legal uncertainty for farmers. The minister said the duty to give reasons was not tightened, that good reasoning is possible, and that he will talk with the VNG and Omgevingsdienst NL about ensuring legal certainty within the existing framework.

Therefore I will, possibly together with my colleagues of Housing and Spatial Planning and of Public Transport and Environment, enter into discussion about permits with the VNG and Omgevingsdienst NL to see what is needed to secure the desired legal certainty in practice.

Daarom ga ik, eventueel samen met mijn collega van Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening (VRO) en mijn collega van Openbaar Vervoer en Milieu (OVM), in gesprek over vergunningen met de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) en met de Omgevingsdienst NL om te bezien wat er nodig is om in de praktijk de gewenste rechtszekerheid daarvan te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen vragen de leden Kostić, Ram, Graus, Hirsch, Paternotte, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de wrede jacht op kangoeroes en de Nederlandse betrokkenheid daarbij

MPs from several parties asked the government about the cruel kangaroo hunt, Dutch imports of kangaroo meat and leather, and calls for an import ban. The Staatssecretaris answered that animal welfare concerns are shared, that Australia regulates its own hunting, that an import ban can only be set at EU level and must comply with WTO rules, and that a plan under a prior motion is being prepared; several answers were deferred.
Banning the import of a product from a country outside the European Union, in this case Australia, can only be arranged at European level.
Import van een product verbieden dat uit een land komt van buiten de Europese Unie, in dit geval Australië, kan alleen op Europees niveau geregeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Bontenbal over het potentiële valmeerproject bij de Haringvlietmonding

MPs Grinwis and Bontenbal asked the government about the proposed Delta21 valmeer (storage reservoir) at the Haringvliet mouth, its energy value, flood safety, ecological impact, strategic autonomy, and whether it should be included in the grid security plan and a cost-benefit analysis. The minister answers that the project has potential value as large-scale electricity storage but faces large uncertainties and ecological drawbacks, and commits to a broader cost-benefit comparison of flexibility options and an update of the energy storage roadmap.

As promised during the budget debate of the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth (7 November 2024), the cabinet is willing to map the pros and cons of a valmeer project for the energy system, including a comparison with other flexibility applications.

Zoals is toegezegd tijdens de begrotingsbehandeling van het Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei (7 november 2024) is het kabinet bereid om in kaart te brengen wat de voor- en nadelen zijn van een valmeerproject voor het energiesysteem, inclusief een vergelijking met andere flexibiliteitstoepassingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostic´ over het niet ondertekenen van de overeenkomst waarmee toezichthouders eindelijk kunnen ingrijpen bij het houden van te veel dieren in stallen

An MP asked the minister why the data-sharing agreement allowing enforcement bodies to check actual animal numbers in stables has not been signed, despite a motion adopted by parliament. The minister confirmed awareness of the motion, said he is consulting parties on next steps, and agreed with them to take joint steps toward a broadly supported agreement.
I spoke with the relevant parties about this on Monday. We have agreed to take joint next steps, with the aim of reaching a broadly supported agreement.
Ik heb maandag met betrokken partijen hierover gesproken. We hebben afgesproken gezamenlijk vervolgstappen te zetten, met als doel om tot een gedragen overeenkomst te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Holman over stikstofvergunning plasticfabrikant

MPs Van Campen and Holman asked the minister about a court ruling forcing the province of Brabant to reduce the unused nitrogen permit space of plastics producer Sabic, asking about legal basis, precedent, and national nitrogen policy. The minister answered that the court's order is conditional, that the province must decide anew, that precedent is only relevant if upheld on appeal, and that the government is pursuing structural emission reduction, while committing to inform parliament on a motion about intern salderen.
I will inform you shortly about the implementation of this motion.
Over de uitwerking van deze motie zal ik u op korte termijn informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over pesticiden in vogelvoer

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture about pesticide residues found in bird feed, including PBO, deltamethrin and chlorpyrifos-methyl, and what the government will do to phase out harmful pesticides and label or regulate bird feed. The minister answered that the residues stay below legal maximum residue limits, that the NVWA controls feed, that consumers choose their own bird feed, and that no quantitative pesticide-reduction targets existed in the 2013 Gezonde Groei, Duurzame Oogst policy note.
In the PAN Nederland study, pesticide residues were found in bird feeds, but these are below the legal MRL standards.
In het onderzoek van PAN Nederland zijn residuen van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen in vogelvoeders aangetroffen, maar deze liggen onder de wettelijke MRL-normen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Krul, Paternotte, Stultiens, Kostić, Beckerman, Eerdmans, Dassen, Ergin, Stoffer en Ceder over het bericht 'Bezorgdheid om bezuinigingsplannen onderwijs: 'Maakt Nederland op lange

MPs from several parties asked the government about the education, research and innovation budget cuts, their effect on the economy, productivity, startups, internships in care and agriculture innovation. The minister answered that the cuts were a political trade-off, that the government cannot reliably model long-term growth effects, and that a number of impacts cannot be quantified in advance.
It is not possible to give a precise estimate of the consequences of this for welfare.
Het is niet mogelijk om een precieze inschatting te geven van de gevolgen hiervan op de welvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostic´ over het instemmen van Nederland voor uitstel van verplichtingen voor het traceren van pesticiden om de last voor boeren te verlichten

An MP asked why the minister supported, in the EU Council, postponing traceability rules for pesticide use registers and how government can monitor, enforce and protect citizens without this data. The minister replied that Dutch practice largely complies already, that CBS monitoring continues on the EU schedule, that a digital monitor is being reconsidered with the sector, and that authorities can demand register data for supervision.
I will inform the House further about this in the short term.
Daar zal ik de Kamer op korte termijn verder over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het Radio 1 interview ‘5 jaar BBB: Waar komt de partij vandaan en waar gaan ze naar toe’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Agriculture whether she endorses a BBB MP's remarks on agricultural policy and whether the government will fully implement the coalition agreement's commitments on nitrates derogation, Natura 2000, manure and generic cuts to animal rights. The minister declined to comment on the party colleague's remarks, said she is working to deliver the agreement while depending on negotiations and EU factors, and referred to earlier letters for details, stating she cannot guarantee no generic cut.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Klimaatminister voorspelt dat haar eigen beleid niet voldoende is'

An MP asks the agriculture minister whether the coalition's climate policy is sufficient to meet the 2030 targets, and about the emissions effects of dropping the nature/land programme, reintroducing red diesel and dropping the manure market plan. The minister answers that the 2024 Climate and Energy Outlook will show whether targets are met, that specific emissions effects are hard to isolate, and that further policy will be decided in the spring budget decision, but does not answer several questions in substance.
To what extent the current, planned and scheduled policy will achieve the 2030 climate targets will become clear from the Climate and Energy Outlook 2024.
In hoeverre met het huidige, voorgenomen en geagendeerde beleid de klimaatdoelen voor 2030 gehaald worden, zal moeten blijken uit de Klimaat- en Energieverkenning van 2024
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Meulenkamp over het bericht “Meisje (14) sloot zichzelf op in hok van rottweiler na brute aanval: ’Zichzelf gered’'', van de Telegraaf

An MP asked the minister about a 14-year-old girl who locked herself in a rottweiler's kennel after a dog attack, and about measures against dangerous dogs, including breed bans, a national reporting point, compensation for victims and dogs with pedigrees. The government answered that it prioritises a national incident reporting point and a mandatory pedigree certificate for certain dogs, that breed bans do not reduce bites, and that victims can already claim damages through liability insurance or civil and criminal procedures.
I will therefore take measures to counter bite incidents.
Ik zal daarom maatregelen nemen om bijtincidenten tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het Lid Michon-Derkzen over het uitrijden van mest met drugsafval door boeren in Baarle-Nassau

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van Campen asked the ministers whether drug waste being spread with manure on Baarle-Nassau fields reflects a wider problem, what tools police and environmental services have, and how municipalities and farmers can be protected. The ministers answered that the case is still under investigation, the scale of drug-waste dumping is unknown, existing enforcement tools and the Veilig Buitengebied and farmer contact-person initiatives are described, and no cases of food-chain harm are known.
The investigation into the Baarle-Nassau case is still ongoing. It has not yet been established how the drug waste ended up on the field.
Het onderzoek in de casus Baarle-Nassau loopt nog. Er is nog niet vastgesteld hoe het drugsafval op de akker terecht is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Rooderkerk, Podt en Bamenga over het schrappen van het Nationaal Programma Landelijk Gebied (NPLG)

MPs from D66 asked whether the National Programme for the Rural Area (NPLG) remains government policy, what the quantitative effects of scrapping it are on climate, nature, and Water Framework Directive goals, and how alternative measures and the decision-making process were handled. The minister answers that the cabinet is ending the NPLG in favour of an implementation-focused, area-specific approach with contours due by year-end, while stating that the international targets stay in place, and that scrapping was agreed in inter-ministerial consultation and in the Regeerprogramma.
As a cabinet we are taking a different course and ending the NPLG, as the draft had been adopted by the previous caretaker cabinet.
Als kabinet slaan we een andere koers in en stoppen met het NPLG, zoals dat als ontwerp nog door het vorige demissionaire kabinet was vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het artikel 'Bekende stikstofexperts slaan uitnodiging Tweede Kamer af'

An MP asks the agriculture minister about nitrogen experts declining a Lower House invitation and whether scientists are being used to find loopholes; the minister denies this, says a peer review of a scientifically based calculation floor for nitrogen deposition will be completed by year end, and that the Council of State's advisory division will be asked to advise if the review supports a floor. Answers to questions on consultation, disclosure of expert advice, costs and timing are given, with the minister declining to share advice until the process is finished.
At this moment I cannot yet share these advices with the Chamber because I am still working on elaborating the follow-up steps.
Op dit moment kan ik deze adviezen nog niet delen met de Kamer omdat ik nog bezig ben met de uitwerking van de vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen, Grinwis en Bromet over het bericht dat de minister alle basisscholen in Nederland het boek “Wat zeg ik? Hondentaal voor kids”

MPs Van Campen, Grinwis and Bromet asked whether the ministry of agriculture was really sending the children's dog-behaviour book to all primary schools, why, and at what cost. The state secretary confirmed it, said it was meant to reduce dog bites among children aged 6-10 and cost about EUR 45,000, but that after consultation with the education ministry the mailing was cancelled and an alternative destination is being considered.
In consultation with the State Secretary of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (OCW), it has now been decided not to send the books to primary schools anymore.
Inmiddels is in overleg met de Staatssecretaris van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW) besloten de boeken niet meer te versturen aan basisscholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht ‘Bollenteelt levert mooie plaatjes op, maar overheid komt met verbod: ‘Risico voor drinkwater’’

An MP from D66 asked the minister whether other provinces or municipalities want a ban on non-organic bulb cultivation near drinking water catchment areas, what barriers exist, what the costs of water purification are, and how pesticide approval (Ctgb) relates to Water Framework Directive norms. The minister replied that provinces hold the powers over groundwater protection, that the issue will be raised in administrative consultation, that a study on banning pesticides in groundwater protection areas is ongoing, and that the Ctgb adjusted its working method after European Court rulings without yet changing its groundwater protection approach.
Provinces have far-reaching powers to protect groundwater.
Provincies hebben vergaande bevoegdheden om grondwater te beschermen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Flach over groeiend aantal boeren dat wordt benaderd door onder meer drugscriminelen

Two MPs asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about a reported rise in farmers approached by drug criminals offering use of barns, and what is being done. The minister acknowledged the problem, said the data does not show a rising trend, and described existing measures (advisors, Veilig Buitengebied, reporting lines) while declining to give police-level detail on how cases are handled.
This specific theme is also not registered as a separate category by the police.
Dit specifieke thema wordt ook niet als aparte categorie geregistreerd door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het bericht ‘Minister Wiersma trekt ruim 200 miljoen extra uit voor aanpak PAS-melders’

MP Van Campen asks whether the €226.9 million for PAS-melders is on top of the €250 million from the Voorjaarsnota 2024, how it is effective, what provinces must do, and whether external netting can legalise PAS-melders. Minister Wiersma explains the €250 million was reduced by reserved amounts, outlines the provincial approach, the Lbv-plus and planned TNO follow-up research, and that the Transitiefonds is replaced by a €5 billion budget.
The amount made available under this scheme is lower because part of it is held separately for anticipated costs, as explained in the publication.
Het beschikbaar gestelde bedrag in deze regeling is lager omdat hiervan een deel apart wordt gehouden voor voorziene kosten zoals is toegelicht in de publicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Flach over blauwtong

MP Flach asks the agriculture minister about the current spread and severity of bluetongue (BTV-3), the effectiveness of vaccines and whether vaccination limits transmission, alternative management measures, and support for the sheep sector. The minister reports 6,352 BTV-3 infections, partial protection from vaccines with no effectiveness estimate yet, limited evidence on vaccination reducing spread, identified protective factors (early shearing, ventilation), and a commissioned study into the sheep sector's finances to be completed by end December.
I cannot give an estimate of the effectiveness now, but the experts' impression is that there is indeed protection against symptoms.
Ik kan nu geen inschatting geven van de effectiviteit, maar de indruk van de deskundigen is dat er wel degelijk sprake is van bescherming tegen verschijnselen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de regeling Samenwerking in veenweidegebieden en Natura 2000 overgangsgebieden

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about the first application round of the scheme for cooperation in peat meadow areas and Natura 2000 transition zones, including oversubsidy risks for already-extensive (e.g. organic) farms, state aid compliance, and design choices. The minister gave figures on applications, budgets requested versus available, and said the conditions will be reviewed before the next round, while defending the calculation method and rejecting some concerns.
That is why I intend to tighten the requirements for reducing livestock nitrogen excretion in the next opening.
Daarom ben ik voornemens bij de volgende openstelling de eisen voor de reductie van stikstofdierexcretie aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over “de gevolgen van de uitzonderlijk natte weersomstandigheden voor boeren en tuinders”

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture about the consequences of exceptionally wet weather for farmers and growers, covering damage, support schemes, manure rules, subsidy payments and water management. The Minister answered most questions in substance, pointing to extended manure spreading periods, flexibility in CAP eco-schemes, overmacht claims and the Brede weersverzekering, while declining to quantify damage or commit to new compensation.
The extent of the financial damage suffered by farmers is not known to me.
De omvang van de door boeren geleden financiële schade is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over onveranderde structurele mishandeling van eenden bij transport, 6 jaar na beloofde beterschap

An MP asks the minister whether rough catching and loading of ducks for slaughter, shown in drone footage six years after the sector promised improvement, amounts to structural animal cruelty and what will be done. The minister acknowledges the footage shows unacceptable rough handling at several farms, says the sector must act, and commits to renewed talks with the sector and the NVWA on stricter enforcement.
The NVWA is further investigating whether an adjusted enforcement approach can persuade the sector to handle ducks so that no unnecessary stress, pain or suffering occurs.
De NVWA onderzoekt verder of met een aangepaste handhavingsaanpak de sector bewogen kan worden eenden zodanig te behandelen dat er geen onnodige stress, pijn of lijden ontstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over “Het ernstig lijden van dieren bij de slacht”

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister about slaughter speeds, stunning methods such as water-bath and CO2 stunning, and unstunned ritual slaughter, citing animal suffering. The minister acknowledges risks at high speeds and the moral duty to limit suffering, but refuses to lower slaughter speeds or ban current stunning methods, pointing to EU rules and the existing convenant on ritual slaughter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de bescherming van dieren tegen stalbranden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture about animal deaths in barn fires, the lack of escape routes, and the uptake of OvV safety recommendations, including fire-safety inspections in a draft decree. The Minister acknowledges the severity, says recommendations are at various stages of implementation, and states she is still considering whether to amend the draft decree before re-submitting it to parliament.

If I decide to amend matters, I will inform the House as soon as possible and resubmit the amended draft decree to the Houses for prior submission, so that the House can express its view on any changes.

Indien ik besluit zaken aan te passen zal ik de Kamer hierover zo spoedig mogelijk informeren en het aangepaste Ontwerpbesluit opnieuw aan de Kamers voorhangen, zodat de Kamer zich uit kan spreken over de eventuele wijzigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over “Het langverwachte verbod op stroomstootwapens in de veehouderij”

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister about the long-promised ban on electric prods in livestock farming, the ministry's handling of the draft decree and exemptions for vets and slaughterhouses, and whether the sector can be trusted to self-regulate. The minister acknowledges the footage and the Chamber's prior motions, but declines to commit to a full ban or to specific steps, saying she first wants to consult the sector.
I choose to first discuss this with the sector and want to reach a jointly supported approach with the sector.
Ik kies ervoor om hierover eerst in gesprek te gaan met de sector en wil samen met de sector tot een gedragen werkwijze komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostic´ over de dreigende dood van miljoenen zwerfhonden in Turkije

An MP asked the ministers whether Turkey's proposed law, expected to kill millions of stray dogs, should be opposed, and whether the Dutch humane approach (capture, sterilisation, vaccination, registration) could be promoted with Turkey. The government confirmed awareness, said humane solutions should be sought where possible, and said Turkey's approach is an internal matter, though the Dutch approach will be shared with Turkish authorities where relevant.
The concrete approach applied by Turkey is an internal Turkish matter.
De concrete benadering die door Turkije wordt toegepast is een Turkse interne aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het op 18 juli 2024 in NRC gepubliceerde bericht ‘Commerciële dierenartsketens zetten onderzoek naar hoge rekeningen naar hun hand’

MP Beckerman asks why the ministry involved commercial veterinary chains in consultations on a study into vet fees, why no report of the stakeholder meeting exists, and how independence and access to care are ensured. The minister says stakeholders were only consulted on draft research questions, the study is independent, and the final results are expected this autumn.
There is therefore no question of influence over the research, only involvement.
Er is dan ook geen sprake van invloed op het onderzoek, wel betrokkenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Pierik en Van der Plas over de handhaving op de huis- en hobbydierenlijst

MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked whether the Minister is aware of a commitment made in court to suspend enforcement of the breeding ban for animals on the pet list and whether enforcement could be paused for all non-listed species until six weeks after the ruling. The Minister confirmed awareness but declined to suspend enforcement broadly, citing risk-based supervision and animal welfare, while pointing to reversible contraception and a practical solution pending the objection phase.
So I cannot commit to temporarily refraining from enforcement altogether.
Dus ik kan niet toezeggen om voorlopig helemaal af te zien van handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht Wc-papier komt vaak uit de groene woestijn van Brazilië

An MP asked whether FMO's 40 million euro loan to Suzano, a Brazilian pulp company, is justified given NGO claims of environmental and Indigenous harm, and whether the state should tighten FMO's sustainability policy and EU rules on financial flows linked to deforestation. The minister replied that FMO operates at arm's length within agreed frameworks, that FSC certification and an Environmental and Social Action Plan mitigate the risks, that the state cannot itself change FMO's policy, and that the EU will assess financial-flow rules by June 2025.
The State cannot itself change or tighten FMO's CSR and sustainability policy.
De Staat kan niet zelf het IMVO- en duurzaamheidsbeleid van FMO wijzigen of aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Holman over de publicatie verkenning rekenkundige ondergrens gedaan door TNO en UvA

Opposition MPs Holman and Boomsma asked the agriculture minister whether the current 0.005 mol/ha/year nitrogen deposition threshold is scientifically justified, how quickly a justified threshold could be introduced, and what steps will ease permit granting and help PAS-melders before their 1 March 2025 deadline. Minister Wiersma answered that no scientifically justified threshold has yet been found, that follow-up research is being commissioned, and that she will set out next steps and timelines in the coming weeks, while the other questions are answered largely by reference to ongoing work.
In the coming weeks I will work out the next steps.
De komende weken ga ik de vervolgstappen uitwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over Provincies die vragen om een generaal pardon voor PAS-melders

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether she would pursue a general pardon (generaal pardon) for PAS-melders, farmers who notified nitrogen-permit activities, after several provinces requested it. The minister answered that a general pardon is not legally feasible in the short term according to the Landsadvocaat's advice, pointing to alternative tracks such as a broadened tailor-made approach and personal guidance, while not ruling out a pardon or comparable alternative.
I see leads for follow-up research and will commission this in the short term.
Ik zie aanknopingspunten voor vervolgonderzoek en zal dit op korte termijn in opdracht geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostic´ en Teunissen over dierlijk vet in biobrandstof

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about animal fat used in biofuel, its links to intensive livestock farming, palmoil deforestation and fraud in imported used cooking oil. The state secretary answered that the fat is a low-value waste product, that limits apply and that Dutch oversight by independent certifiers and the Netherlands Emissions Authority is robust, while promising to press the Commission on inspections in Asia.
The Netherlands has a robust system that oversees the supply chain of biofuels.
Nederland staat voor een robuust systeem dat toeziet op de toeleveringsketen van biobrandstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over ernstig dierenleed bij de training en inzet van politiehonden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Justice Minister about a police dog shot during an arrest, the mistreatment of dogs at a Schiedam training school, and whether police dog use should be phased out. The minister said the shooting is under internal investigation and not discussed in detail, that no central figures on dog injuries are kept, that the training school involved was a different association and an investigation is ongoing, and that phasing out police dogs is not on the table but animal welfare is being improved.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to make statements about individual cases, nor about the final results of internal police investigations into a specific incident.

Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om uitlatingen te doen over individuele gevallen en evenmin over uiteindelijke resultaten van intern politieonderzoek naar een concreet incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de totstandkoming van de 25 kilometer maximale rekenafstand

Baudet (FvD) asked the minister to provide all documentation on the origins of the 25-kilometre maximum calculation distance around Natura 2000 areas, including the RIVM analysis cited in the 2021 letter. The minister replied that the documents were already published in June 2024 as part of a Woo decision on AERIUS Calculator version 2021.
As part of this decision, all documentation concerning the establishment of the maximum calculation distance of 25 kilometres has been published.
Als onderdeel van dit besluit is alle documentatie aangaande de totstandkoming van de maximale rekenafstand van 25 kilometer gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op op de vragen van het lid Ouwehand over ‘de politieke beloften die al decennia aan dieren worden gedaan, maar nooit zijn nagekomen’

An MP asks the agriculture minister why past promises to improve animal welfare in livestock farming (from 2001 Wijffels committee onwards, with 2012/2022 targets) were never fulfilled, and questions the Wet dieren evaluation, the Raad voor Dierenaangelegenheden principles, and the minister's remarks about Caring Farmers. The minister answers that the sector has changed significantly, the evaluation's aim was policy-neutral, the principles are already anchored in the Wet dieren, and commits only to following the coalition agreement.
The coalition agreement is leading for me.
Het Hoofdlijnenakkoord is voor mij leidend.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vliegenthart en Moorman over het bericht ‘Reclame Code Commissie geeft pro life-organisatie ‘stevige tik op de vingers’ vanwege misleidende abortusfolder'

MPs Vliegenthart and Moorman asked about a Reclame Code Commissie ruling that an anti-abortion organisation's folder was misleading, and what the government would do about misinformation on abortion care in GP waiting rooms. The State Secretary said the government is funding research and strategies against misinformation, that the choice of materials is up to GP practices, and that the RCC is the appropriate body to act, not the ministry.
I have not contacted Kies Leven following the ruling. The Advertising Code Committee is an independent body that oversees compliance with the advertising code.
Ik heb geen contact opgenomen met Kies Leven naar aanleiding van de uitspraak. De Reclame Code Commissie is een onafhankelijk orgaan dat toeziet op naleving van de reclamecode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Vliegenthart over de uitzending van Max Meldpunt Actueel aangaande ouderenmishandeling

MPs Bushoff and Vliegenthart asked the health ministry about under-reporting of elder abuse after a Max Meldpunt broadcast, including prevalence, prevention, GP detection, caregiver leave and a proposal to give Veilig Thuis court-petitioning powers. The state secretary acknowledged under-reporting, announced a Maastricht prevalence study due mid-2026, pointed to existing awareness measures, and rejected giving Veilig Thuis primary petitioner powers in court.
I do not share the view, however, that Veilig Thuis should be given more powers as primary petitioner before the court.
Ik deel de opvatting echter niet dat Veilig Thuis meer bevoegdheden als primaire verzoeker bij de rechter zou moeten krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vliegenthart en Bushoff over borstkankerscreening

MPs Vliegenthart and Bushoff asked about breast cancer screening in Zutphen, where screening was reduced amid staff shortages and cancer rates are higher. The State Secretary answered that routes were reorganised rather than units closed, staff shortages drive longer screening intervals, and access and comfort measures are being pursued.
In this case, fewer buses were not run; the route was adjusted instead.
Er zijn in dit geval niet minder bussen gaan rijden, maar de route is aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Vliegenthart over het bericht dat kraamzorg niet meer overal in Nederland gegarandeerd kan worden

MPs Bushoff and Vliegenthart asked the minister whether access to maternity care (kraamzorg) should depend on income or postcode, how many families miss out, whether private equity is causing withdrawal from deprived neighbourhoods, and what the government will do about it. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says the causes are multiple and that a study and sector agreements are underway, points to NZa oversight of insurers' duty of care and planned legislation (Wibz, fusion test), and declines additional national funding for a free-care pilot in Amsterdam Zuidoost.
I am investigating which additional measures are necessary to structurally safeguard accessibility.
Ik onderzoek welke aanvullende maatregelen aanvullend noodzakelijk zijn om de toegankelijkheid structureel te borgen.
